teaching_sense.en_definition: To be left with a scar after an injury has healed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指受伤部位在伤口愈合后留下疤痕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jibqa' b'marka fuq il-ġilda wara li tkun fieqet ferita.

sense_translations.en_definition: to have a scar after an injury has healed
sense_translations.zh_definition: 伤口愈合后留下疤痕。

collocations.en: was left scarred after an injury
an arm that was left scarred

formal.mt: Id-driegħ tmerrek wara li fieqet il-ferita, u l-marka baqgħet tidher fuq il-ġilda.
formal.en: The arm was left scarred after the wound healed, and the mark remained visible on the skin.
formal.zh: 伤口愈合后，手臂留下了疤痕，皮肤上的印记仍然清晰可见。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għad għandek dik il-marka fuq driegħek? Mark: Driegħi tmerrek wara l-ferita; issa fieqet, imma l-marka baqgħet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do you still have that mark on your arm? Mark: My arm was left scarred after the injury; the wound has healed now, but the mark remains.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你的手臂上怎么还留着那个印子？马克：受伤后留下了疤痕；现在伤口已经好了，但印子还在。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għad għandek dik il-marka fuq driegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għad għandek dik il-marka fuq driegħek?
messages.zh: 你的手臂上怎么还留着那个印子？
messages.en: Why do you still have that mark on your arm?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Driegħi tmerrek wara l-ferita; issa fieqet, imma l-marka baqgħet.
messages.mt_standard: Driegħi tmerrek wara l-ferita; issa fieqet, imma l-marka baqgħet.
messages.zh: 受伤后，我的手臂留下了疤痕；现在伤口已经好了，但印子还在。
messages.en: My arm was left scarred after the injury; the wound has healed now, but the mark remains.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面定格在伤口愈合之后：伤好了，疤还在；用 tmerrek 记住“留下疤痕”这个动词意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A scab or scar left by an injury.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受伤后在皮肤上留下的痂或疤痕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qoxra jew marka fuq il-ġilda li tibqa' wara ferita.

sense_translations.en_definition: the scab or scar left by an injury
sense_translations.zh_definition: 伤后留下的痂或疤痕。

collocations.en: a scab or scar on the knee
a scab or scar left after an injury
collocations.zh: 受伤后留下的痂或疤痕

formal.mt: It-tabib eżamina t-tmerrik fuq l-irkoppa u l-ġilda ta' madwaru.
formal.en: The doctor examined the scab or scar on the knee and the surrounding skin.
formal.zh: 医生检查了膝盖上伤后留下的痂或疤痕，以及周围的皮肤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi dik il-marka fuq irkopptok? Pawlu: Dak it-tmerrik baqa' wara li waqajt mir-rota.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that mark on your knee? Pawlu: That scar was left after I fell off my bike.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你膝盖上的那个印子是什么？保罗：那是我从自行车上摔下来后留下的疤。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你膝盖上的那个印子是什么？
messages.en: What is that mark on your knee?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak it-tmerrik baqa' wara li waqajt mir-rota.
messages.mt_standard: Dak it-tmerrik baqa' wara li waqajt mir-rota.
messages.zh: 那是我从自行车上摔下来后留下的疤。
messages.en: That scar was left after I fell off my bike.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象指着膝盖说“这块痂、这道疤”：tmerrik 是能被指出来的名词，所指是受伤后留下的痕迹。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of yielding or releasing juice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产生或释放汁液的过程，即出汁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih joħroġ il-meraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出汁；汁液的释放或流出。

collocations.en: the yielding of juice by fruit
the release of juice from grapes during pressing
collocations.zh: 葡萄受压时的出汁过程

formal.mt: Waqt l-għasir tal-għeneb, l-istudenti osservaw it-tmerriq u ġabru l-meraq f'reċipjent.
formal.en: While pressing the grapes, the students observed the release of juice and collected it in a container.
formal.zh: 压榨葡萄时，学生们观察了出汁过程，并用容器收集汁液。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex hemm skutella taħt l-għeneb? Toni: Biex niġbru l-meraq; waqt l-għasir qed naraw it-tmerriq.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is there a bowl under the grapes? Toni: To collect the juice; we are watching the juice come out during pressing.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：葡萄下面为什么放着一个碗？托尼：用来收集汁液；我们正在观察压榨时的出汁过程。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 葡萄下面为什么放着一个碗？
messages.en: Why is there a bowl under the grapes?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex niġbru l-meraq; waqt l-għasir qed naraw it-tmerriq.
messages.mt_standard: Biex niġbru l-meraq; waqt l-għasir qed naraw it-tmerriq.
messages.zh: 用来收集汁液；我们正在观察压榨时的出汁过程。
messages.en: To collect the juice; we are watching the juice come out during pressing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象葡萄受压后汁液滴进碗里：tmerriq 指“汁液出来的过程”，记忆重点放在出汁这一动态画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To flash, emit rays, or radiate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 闪出光亮，发出射线，或向外辐射。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti leħħa, joħroġ raġġi, jew jarmi radjazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闪光；突然闪出亮光。
发出光线或射线。
辐射；向外发散。

formal.mt: Matul l-osservazzjoni, id-dawl tmerżaq għal mument u r-raġġi tiegħu dehru fuq il-ħajt.
formal.en: During the observation, the light flashed for a moment and its rays appeared on the wall.
formal.zh: 观察过程中，灯光闪亮了一瞬间，光线映在了墙上。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajt dak id-dawl ħdejn it-tieqa? Adam: Iva, tmerżaq għal mument u mbagħad għeb.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you see that light by the window? Adam: Yes, it flashed for a moment and then disappeared.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你看见窗边那道光了吗？亚当：看见了，它闪了一下，然后就消失了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看见窗边那道光了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that light by the window?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tmerżaq għal mument u mbagħad għeb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tmerżaq għal mument u mbagħad għeb.
messages.zh: 看见了，它闪了一下，然后就消失了。
messages.en: Yes, it flashed for a moment and then disappeared.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一幅向外放光的图串联三个义项：突然亮一下是闪光，发出一道道光是放射，向外散发是辐射。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The emission of rays or sparks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出射线或火花的现象或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħruġ ta' raġġi jew xrar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 射线或火花的发出；放射或迸出火花的现象。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tmerżiq ta' xrar waqt il-qtugħ tal-metall.
formal.en: The report describes the emission of sparks during the cutting of metal.
formal.zh: 报告描述了切割金属时火花迸出的现象。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'kien dak id-dawl qasir ħdejn il-metall? Mark: Kien tmerżiq ta' xrar waqt il-qtugħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: What was that brief light beside the metal? Mark: It was sparks being emitted during the cutting.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：金属旁边刚才那一下亮光是什么？马克：那是切割时迸出的火花。

messages.speaker: Lara (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: X'kien dak id-dawl qasir ħdejn il-metall?
messages.mt_standard: X'kien dak id-dawl qasir ħdejn il-metall?
messages.zh: 金属旁边刚才那一下亮光是什么？
messages.en: What was that brief light beside the metal?

messages.speaker: Mark (师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien tmerżiq ta' xrar waqt il-qtugħ.
messages.mt_standard: Kien tmerżiq ta' xrar waqt il-qtugħ.
messages.zh: 那是切割时迸出的火花。
messages.en: It was sparks being emitted during the cutting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象切割金属时火花向外飞散，把整场“发出射线或火花的现象”装进名词 tmerżiq 里记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Compassion for someone, or an expression of pity for their suffering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对他人遭遇或痛苦的同情，也指表达怜悯的言语或举动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mogħdrija għal min qed ibati, jew kliem jew ġest li jesprimiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 同情；对他人痛苦的怜悯之情。
怜悯的表达；表示同情的言语或举动。

collocations.en: compassion towards someone who is suffering

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tagħha, l-awtriċi esprimiet tmeskin lejn il-familja li kienet tilfet darha.
formal.en: In her letter, the writer expressed compassion for the family that had lost its home.
formal.zh: 作者在信中表达了对那个失去家园的家庭的同情。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għedt lil Sara meta smajt l-aħbar? Toni: Għedtilha kliem ta' tmeskin u staqsejtha kif stajt ngħinha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did you say to Sara when you heard the news? Toni: I said some words of sympathy and asked how I could help her.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：听到消息后，你对萨拉说了什么？托尼：我说了些表示同情的话，还问她我能怎么帮忙。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għedt lil Sara meta smajt l-aħbar?
messages.mt_standard: X'għedt lil Sara meta smajt l-aħbar?
messages.zh: 听到消息后，你对萨拉说了什么？
messages.en: What did you say to Sara when you heard the news?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għedtilha kliem ta' tmeskin u staqsejtha kif stajt ngħinha.
messages.mt_standard: Għedtilha kliem ta' tmeskin u staqsejtha kif stajt ngħinha.
messages.zh: 我说了些表示同情的话，还问她我能怎么帮忙。
messages.en: I said some words of sympathy and asked how I could help her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“心里同情，嘴上表达”记忆：tmeskin 既可指内心的怜悯，也可指把这份同情表达出来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be wiped vigorously or to be smeared with a substance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物体表面被用力擦拭，或被某种物质涂抹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jintmesaħ bil-qawwa jew jinkesa b'sustanza midluka fuq il-wiċċ tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被用力擦拭；被使劲擦抹。
被涂抹；表面被抹上某种物质。

collocations.en: was wiped vigorously with a cloth

formal.mt: Il-bank tax-xogħol tmeslaħ bil-qawwa b'ċarruta biex jitneħħa l-ħmieġ minn fuqu.
formal.en: The workbench was wiped vigorously with a cloth to remove the dirt from its surface.
formal.zh: 工作台被用布使劲擦拭，以清除表面的污垢。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex wiċċek mimli żebgħa? Pawlu: Wiċċi tmeslaħ biż-żebgħa waqt ix-xogħol; lanqas indunajt!
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is your face covered in paint? Pawlu: My face got smeared with paint while I was working; I did not even notice!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你脸上怎么都是颜料？保罗：干活时脸上被抹上了颜料，我都没注意到！

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你脸上怎么都是颜料？
messages.en: Why is your face covered in paint?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Wiċċi tmeslaħ biż-żebgħa waqt ix-xogħol; lanqas indunajt!
messages.mt_standard: Wiċċi tmeslaħ biż-żebgħa waqt ix-xogħol; lanqas indunajt!
messages.zh: 干活时脸上被抹上了颜料，我都没注意到！
messages.en: My face got smeared with paint while I was working; I did not even notice!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一块表面的两种遭遇：被布使劲擦，或被颜料抹上；tmeslaħ 两个义项都从承受动作的一方理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Constant wiping, or the act of smearing a substance over a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持续或反复擦拭的行为，也指把某种物质抹在表面上的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tindif b'mess ripetut ta' ċarruta jew ħaġa simili, jew it-tixrid ta' sustanza fuq wiċċ billi tidlikha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不断擦拭；持续或反复擦抹。
涂抹；把某种物质抹开或抹在表面上的行为。

collocations.en: the constant wiping of the glass
the smearing of paint on the paper

formal.mt: It-tmesliħ kontinwu tal-ħġieġ b'ċarruta maħmuġa ħalla marki fuq il-wiċċ tiegħu.
formal.en: Constant wiping of the glass with a dirty cloth left marks on its surface.
formal.zh: 用脏布不断擦拭玻璃，在玻璃表面留下了印痕。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex il-karta kollha kuluri mħalltin? Adam: Dan it-tmesliħ taż-żebgħa kien apposta; qed nagħmel sfond għall-istampa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is the paper covered in mixed colours? Adam: This smearing of the paint was deliberate; I am making a background for the picture.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这张纸上怎么到处都是混在一起的颜色？亚当：这些颜料是故意涂抹开的，我正在给画做背景。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 这张纸上怎么到处都是混在一起的颜色？
messages.en: Why is the paper covered in mixed colours?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tmesliħ taż-żebgħa kien apposta; qed nagħmel sfond għall-istampa.
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tmesliħ taż-żebgħa kien apposta; qed nagħmel sfond għall-istampa.
messages.zh: 这些颜料是故意涂抹开的，我正在给画做背景。
messages.en: This smearing of the paint was deliberate; I am making a background for the picture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把手在表面上来回移动的动作拍成短片：擦来擦去是不断擦拭，推开颜料是涂抹；tmesliħ 是这类行为的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Continuous movement from one place to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持续从一个地方移动到另一个地方，指不停走动或来回奔走。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċaqliq kontinwu minn post għal ieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: constant movement from one place to another
sense_translations.zh_definition: 不停地从一个地方移动到另一个地方；持续来回走动。

collocations.en: constant movement from one place to another
collocations.zh: 不停地从一处走到另一处
在各个房间之间不停走动

formal.mt: It-tmesrik kontinwu bejn l-uffiċċji jnaqqas il-ħin disponibbli għax-xogħol.
formal.en: Constant movement between offices reduces the time available for work.
formal.zh: 在各办公室之间不停奔走，会减少可用于工作的时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex int daqshekk għajjien? Mark: Bit-tmesrik minn kamra għal oħra! Dejjem ninsa xi ħaġa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you so tired? Mark: From constantly going from room to room! I always forget something.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么这么累？马克：在一个个房间之间跑来跑去累的！我总是忘东西。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么这么累？
messages.en: Why are you so tired?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bit-tmesrik minn kamra għal oħra! Dejjem ninsa xi ħaġa.
messages.mt_standard: Bit-tmesrik minn kamra għal oħra! Dejjem ninsa xi ħaġa.
messages.zh: 在一个个房间之间跑来跑去累的！我总是忘东西。
messages.en: From constantly going from room to room! I always forget something.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己忘了钥匙又忘手机，在几个房间之间不停折返；用这个动态画面记住“持续来回走动”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be wiped with force or vigorous movements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面或物体受到用力擦拭，强调擦拭动作的力度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintmesaħ b'saħħa jew b'movimenti qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被使劲擦拭；受到用力擦抹。

collocations.en: was wiped vigorously with a cloth

formal.mt: Il-wiċċ tal-mejda tmessaħ b'ċarruta biex jitneħħew it-tbajja'.
formal.en: The tabletop was wiped vigorously with a cloth to remove the stains.
formal.zh: 桌面被用抹布使劲擦拭，以去除污渍。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-bank għadu maħmuġ? Pawlu: Le, tmessaħ bis-saħħa u issa nadif.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is the counter still dirty? Pawlu: No, it was wiped vigorously and now it is clean.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：台面还脏吗？保罗：不脏了，已经用力擦过，现在干净了。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 台面还脏吗？
messages.en: Is the counter still dirty?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tmessaħ bis-saħħa u issa nadif.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tmessaħ bis-saħħa u issa nadif.
messages.zh: 不脏了，已经用力擦过，现在干净了。
messages.en: No, it was wiped vigorously and now it is clean.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把桌面想成句子的主角：它正被抹布来回使劲擦。记住这里说的是“被擦”，而且擦得用力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be touched by someone's hands, including gentle fondling or groping.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到他人用手触摸，可指轻柔抚摸，也可指摸索或不受欢迎的触碰，具体含义取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintmess bl-idejn, kemm b'ġentilezza kif ukoll b'mod mhux mixtieq.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be groped, fondled or otherwise touched
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被摸索、被抚摸或以其他方式受到触碰。

formal.mt: Il-pazjent tmesses biss wara li ta l-kunsens tiegħu għall-eżami.
formal.en: The patient was touched only after giving his consent to the examination.
formal.zh: 只有在患者同意接受检查之后，才对其进行了身体接触。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-qattus qed jgħaġġel lejja? Ben: Għax tmesses bil-mod minnek qabel u issa jridek terġa' tfissdu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the cat hurrying towards me? Ben: Because you stroked him gently earlier, and now he wants you to fuss over him again.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：猫怎么急着朝我跑过来？本：因为你刚才轻轻抚摸了它，现在它又想让你疼它了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 猫怎么急着朝我跑过来？
messages.en: Why is the cat hurrying towards me?

messages.speaker: Ben (猫主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax tmesses bil-mod minnek qabel u issa jridek terġa' tfissdu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax tmesses bil-mod minnek qabel u issa jridek terġa' tfissdu.
messages.zh: 因为你刚才轻轻抚摸了它，现在它又想让你疼它了。
messages.en: Because you stroked him gently earlier, and now he wants you to fuss over him again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记“受到手的触碰”这个中心画面，再看语境判断是温柔抚摸、摸索还是不受欢迎的触碰。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of touching with the hands, including fondling or groping.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用手触摸的行为，可表示亲昵抚摸、摸索或一般触碰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tmiss bl-idejn, b'ġentilezza jew b'mod mhux mixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱抚；带有亲昵意味的抚摸。
用手摸索；也可指不受欢迎的身体摸弄或猥亵性触摸。
触摸；用手接触的行为。

collocations.zh: 不受欢迎的触碰或摸弄

formal.mt: It-tmessis tal-oġġetti esposti mhux permess, għax jista' jagħmel ħsara lill-uċuħ tagħhom.
formal.en: Touching the objects on display is not permitted because it can damage their surfaces.
formal.zh: 禁止触摸展品，因为触摸可能损坏其表面。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kelb tiegħek iħobb it-tmessis? Rita: Iva, imma bil-mod. Jekk jitbiegħed, ieqaf.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does your dog like being petted? Rita: Yes, but gently. If he moves away, stop.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的狗喜欢让人抚摸吗？丽塔：喜欢，不过要轻一点。它要是走开，就停下来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的狗喜欢让人抚摸吗？
messages.en: Does your dog like being petted?

messages.speaker: Rita (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma bil-mod. Jekk jitbiegħed, ieqaf.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma bil-mod. Jekk jitbiegħed, ieqaf.
messages.zh: 喜欢，不过要轻一点。它要是走开，就停下来。
messages.en: Yes, but gently. If he moves away, stop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一只手串起三个场景：温柔抚摸、伸手摸索、普通触碰。这个名词命名的是触摸行为，具体色彩靠语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of wiping a surface vigorously.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用力擦拭表面的动作或过程，强调擦拭本身。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li timsaħ wiċċ b'saħħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用力擦拭；使劲擦抹的动作。

collocations.en: vigorous wiping with a damp cloth

formal.mt: It-tmessiħ b'ċarruta mhux xierqa jista' jagħmel ħsara lill-wiċċ delikat.
formal.en: Vigorous wiping with an unsuitable cloth can damage the delicate surface.
formal.zh: 使用不合适的抹布用力擦拭，可能损坏脆弱的表面。

colloquial.mt: Nina: It-tebgħa għadha hemm? David: Le, wara dak it-tmessiħ kollu fl-aħħar marret.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is the stain still there? David: No, after all that vigorous wiping, it finally came off.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：污渍还在吗？戴维：没了，使劲擦了那么久，终于擦掉了。

messages.speaker: Nina (家人)
messages.zh: 污渍还在吗？
messages.en: Is the stain still there?

messages.speaker: David (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, wara dak it-tmessiħ kollu fl-aħħar marret.
messages.mt_standard: Le, wara dak it-tmessiħ kollu fl-aħħar marret.
messages.zh: 没了，使劲擦了那么久，终于擦掉了。
messages.en: No, after all that vigorous wiping, it finally came off.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象顽固污渍需要使劲擦很久；给整个“用力擦拭的过程”贴上 tmessiħ 标签，把它当动作名词记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be pierced or stabbed with a small folding knife.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到小折刀的刺穿或刺伤，强调承受这一动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittaqqab jew jindarab b'mus.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be pierced or stabbed with a pen-knife
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被小折刀刺穿或刺伤。

collocations.en: was pierced or stabbed with a penknife
was accidentally pierced with a penknife

formal.mt: Il-kartun tmewwes b'mus waqt il-ftuħ tal-pakkett.
formal.en: The cardboard was pierced with a penknife while the package was being opened.
formal.zh: 打开包裹时，硬纸板被小折刀刺穿了。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif saret din it-toqba fil-kartun? David: Tmewwes bi żball meta ftaħt il-pakkett bil-mus.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did this hole get in the cardboard? David: It was accidentally pierced when I opened the package with the penknife.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：硬纸板上这个洞是怎么来的？戴维：我用小折刀打开包裹时，不小心把它刺穿了。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 硬纸板上这个洞是怎么来的？
messages.en: How did this hole get in the cardboard?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tmewwes bi żball meta ftaħt il-pakkett bil-mus.
messages.mt_standard: Tmewwes bi żball meta ftaħt il-pakkett bil-mus.
messages.zh: 我用小折刀打开包裹时，不小心把它刺穿了。
messages.en: It was accidentally pierced when I opened the package with the penknife.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拆包裹后，纸板留下一个小折刀刺出的洞；同时记住三个要点：承受动作、小折刀、刺穿或刺伤。

gloss_zh: 变得波浪起伏；被弄成波浪形

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become wavy or to be made to rise and fall in a wave-like shape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得呈波浪形，或受到作用而形成波浪般的起伏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu forma ta' mewġ jew jingħata forma b'tlugħ u nżul bħal tal-mewġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得呈波浪形；出现波浪般的起伏。
被弄成波浪形；被使之呈连续起伏状。

collocations.en: the paper became wavy because of the moisture
collocations.zh: 纸张因受潮而变得起伏不平

formal.mt: Il-baħar tmewweġ meta żdied ir-riħ, u d-dgħajjes iż-żgħar baqgħu fil-port.
formal.en: The sea became wavy as the wind strengthened, and the small boats remained in port.
formal.zh: 随着风力增强，海面起了波浪，小船留在港内。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-karta mhix ċatta? Mark: Tmewwġet għax waqa' l-ilma fuqha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why isn't the paper flat? Mark: It became wavy because water spilled on it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这张纸怎么不平了？马克：水洒在上面，把它弄得起伏不平了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 这张纸怎么不平了？
messages.en: Why isn't the paper flat?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 水洒在上面，把它弄得起伏不平了。
messages.en: It became wavy because water spilled on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中画一条直线，再把它变成波浪线；这个变化帮助记住“变得起伏”以及“被弄成波浪形”两个义项。

gloss_zh: 用小折刀刺戳；挥舞小折刀

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of stabbing with or brandishing a pen-knife.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用小折刀刺戳的行为，或挥舞小折刀的行为；具体意思由上下文决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jagħti daqqiet b'sikkina tal-but jew ixejjirha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用小折刀刺戳。
挥舞小折刀。

collocations.en: a case of stabbing with or brandishing a pen-knife
collocations.zh: 一起用小折刀刺戳或挥舞小折刀的事件

collocations.en: stabbing with or brandishing a pen-knife
collocations.zh: 用小折刀刺戳或挥舞小折刀

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi każ ta' tmewwis li fih persuna ndarbet b'sikkina tal-but.
formal.en: The report describes a case of stabbing in which a person was injured with a pen-knife.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一起用小折刀刺伤他人的事件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ifisser tmewwis f'din is-sentenza? Pawlu: Hawn ifisser li xi ħadd qed ixejjer sikkina tal-but.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does tmewwis mean in this sentence? Pawlu: Here it means that someone is brandishing a pen-knife.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：tmewwis 在这个句子里是什么意思？保罗：这里指有人在挥舞小折刀。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: tmewwis 在这个句子里是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tmewwis mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ifisser li xi ħadd qed ixejjer sikkina tal-but.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ifisser li xi ħadd qed ixejjer sikkina tal-but.
messages.zh: 这里指有人在挥舞小折刀。
messages.en: Here it means that someone is brandishing a pen-knife.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tmewwis 配成两张词义卡：一张写“小折刀刺戳”，另一张写“挥舞小折刀”；读句子时靠动作和结果判断具体义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of dismay or despondency, especially when something discouraging happens.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 遭遇令人不安或失望的事情时产生的惊惶沮丧，或灰心消沉的情绪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' skoraġġiment jew qtigħ il-qalb, speċjalment wara xi ħaġa li tnikket jew tħasseb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因坏消息或意外情况而产生的惊惶、沮丧。
灰心消沉；失去希望的低落情绪。

collocations.en: a feeling of dismay or despondency
collocations.zh: 一种惊惶沮丧或灰心消沉的感觉
听到坏消息后的惊惶沮丧

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tagħha, l-awtriċi tesprimi sens ta' tmewwit wara li tilfet kull tama li l-proġett jitkompla.
formal.en: In her letter, the writer expresses despondency after losing all hope that the project would continue.
formal.zh: 写信人在信中表达了灰心消沉之情，因为她已经完全不再指望项目能够继续。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex hawn sens ta' tmewwit f'din l-ittra? Mark: Għax il-kittieb jaħseb li m'hemm ebda tama li s-sitwazzjoni titjieb.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is there a sense of despondency in this letter? Mark: Because the writer thinks there is no hope that the situation will improve.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这封信为什么流露出灰心消沉的情绪？马克：因为写信人觉得情况已经没有好转的希望了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hawn sens ta' tmewwit f'din l-ittra?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hawn sens ta' tmewwit f'din l-ittra?
messages.zh: 这封信为什么流露出灰心消沉的情绪？
messages.en: Why is there a sense of despondency in this letter?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-kittieb jaħseb li m'hemm ebda tama li s-sitwazzjoni titjieb.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-kittieb jaħseb li m'hemm ebda tama li s-sitwazzjoni titjieb.
messages.zh: 因为写信人觉得情况已经没有好转的希望了。
messages.en: Because the writer thinks there is no hope that the situation will improve.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tmewwit 时画一条情绪线：听到坏消息时惊惶沮丧，觉得没有希望时灰心消沉；两端对应这里的两个义项。

gloss_zh: 波浪状；海面波动；连续起伏

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wavy form or undulating movement, including choppy conditions on the sea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 波浪形的状态或连续起伏的运动，也可指海面波浪翻动的状况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma jew moviment b'tlugħ u nżul bħal tal-mewġ, inkluż iċ-ċaqliq tal-mewġ fuq il-baħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 波浪状；呈波浪形或起伏不平的状态。
海面短促波浪翻动、颠簸不平的状况。
连续的波状起伏；波浪式运动或形态。

formal.mt: It-tmewwiġ tal-baħar għamel il-vjaġġ bid-dgħajsa inqas komdu għall-passiġġieri.
formal.en: The choppiness of the sea made the boat trip less comfortable for the passengers.
formal.zh: 海面波浪翻动，使乘客乘船时感到更加颠簸不适。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex l-istampa mhix ċatta? Ben: Dan it-tmewwiġ fil-karta ġie mill-umdità.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why isn't the picture flat? Ben: This waviness in the paper came from the moisture.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这张图片怎么不平了？本：纸上这些波浪状起伏是受潮造成的。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 这张图片怎么不平了？
messages.en: Why isn't the picture flat?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 纸上这些波浪状起伏是受潮造成的。
messages.en: This waviness in the paper came from the moisture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把受潮纸张、起浪海面和飘动布料并排想象：它们共有波状起伏，这个名词可以命名这种形态或运动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be worn or damaged by repeated small bites.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到反复的小口啃咬而磨损或损坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mittiekel jew imħassar b'gdim żgħir u ripetut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被反复啃咬；被啃蚀。

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstab li l-qafas tal-injam tmexmex mill-ġrieden.
formal.en: During the inspection, it was found that the wooden frame had been gnawed by mice.
formal.zh: 检查中发现，木框曾遭老鼠啃咬。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ġara lil dan il-bord? Ġużeppi: Tmexmex mill-ġrieden; ara l-marki żgħar tas-snien.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened to this board? Ġużeppi: It was gnawed by mice; look at the little tooth marks.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这块木板怎么了？朱塞佩：被老鼠啃了，你看这些小牙印。

messages.speaker: Lara (住户)
messages.zh: 这块木板怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to this board?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (木匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Tmexmex mill-ġrieden; ara l-marki żgħar tas-snien.
messages.mt_standard: Tmexmex mill-ġrieden; ara l-marki żgħar tas-snien.
messages.zh: 被老鼠啃了，你看这些小牙印。
messages.en: It was gnawed by mice; look at the little tooth marks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tmexmex 放在木板旁，想象木板上密密的小牙印；用“木板被啃了”记住它表示承受啃咬的动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of biting something repeatedly in small bites, often gradually wearing it away.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用小口反复咬某物的动作，常使物体逐渐磨损或缺损。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att ta' gdim żgħir u ripetut li jista' jiekol jew iħassar xi ħaġa ftit ftit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复的小口啃咬；啃蚀。

formal.mt: It-tmexmix tal-injam mill-ġrieden ħalla marki ċari fuq il-qafas.
formal.en: The gnawing of the wood by mice left clear marks on the frame.
formal.zh: 老鼠对木头的啃咬在框架上留下了清晰的痕迹。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Qed tisma' dak il-ħoss ta' tmexmix? Toni: Iva, naħseb li hemm ġurdien wara l-armarju.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can you hear that gnawing sound? Toni: Yes, I think there is a mouse behind the cupboard.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你听到那个啃咬声了吗？托尼：听到了，我觉得柜子后面有只老鼠。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tisma' dak il-ħoss ta' tmexmix?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tisma' dak il-ħoss ta' tmexmix?
messages.zh: 你听到那个啃咬声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that gnawing sound?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, naħseb li hemm ġurdien wara l-armarju.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, naħseb li hemm ġurdien wara l-armarju.
messages.zh: 听到了，我觉得柜子后面有只老鼠。
messages.en: Yes, I think there is a mouse behind the cupboard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tmexmix 记成“啃咬这件事”，把 tmexmex 记成“被啃咬”；用同一块有牙印的木头区分名词动作与动词状态。

gloss_zh: 被使行走；被移动；被带领、指挥或管理

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made to walk or moved, or to be led, directed, or managed by someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被促使行走或被移动，也可指受到他人的带领、指挥或管理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mġiegħel jimxi, imċaqlaq, jew immexxi minn xi ħadd li jiggwidah, jidderieġih jew jieħu ħsiebu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被使行走；在他人的促使下走动。
被移动；被移到另一个位置。
被带领；在他人的引领下行动。
被指挥；受到指导或指示。
被管理；由他人负责组织和运作。

collocations.en: was managed by a new team

formal.mt: Il-proġett tmexxa minn tim ġdid li kien responsabbli għall-baġit u għall-iskeda tax-xogħol.
formal.en: The project was managed by a new team responsible for the budget and work schedule.
formal.zh: 该项目由一个新团队管理，该团队负责预算和工作进度安排。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn mar l-armarju li kien hawn? David: Tmexxa fil-kamra l-oħra biex ikollna aktar spazju.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where did the cupboard that was here go? David: It was moved into the other room so we would have more space.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：原来放在这里的柜子去哪儿了？戴维：搬到另一个房间了，这样我们就能腾出更多空间。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn mar l-armarju li kien hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn mar l-armarju li kien hawn?
messages.zh: 原来放在这里的柜子去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did the cupboard that was here go?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tmexxa fil-kamra l-oħra biex ikollna aktar spazju.
messages.mt_standard: Tmexxa fil-kamra l-oħra biex ikollna aktar spazju.
messages.zh: 搬到另一个房间了，这样我们就能腾出更多空间。
messages.en: It was moved into the other room so we would have more space.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 tmexxa 画五幅被动场景：人被促使走、柜子被移动、队伍被带领、行动被指挥、项目被管理；靠主语判断意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of organizing and managing work, or of leading and guiding people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 组织和管理工作的活动，或领导并引导他人的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li wieħed jorganizza u jieħu ħsieb ix-xogħol, jew imexxi u jiggwida lin-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 管理；对工作、资源或机构运作的组织与安排。
领导；带领和引导他人的活动或能力。

formal.mt: It-tmexxija tal-proġett tinkludi l-ippjanar tax-xogħol, it-tqassim tar-riżorsi u s-segwitu tal-progress.
formal.en: Project management includes planning the work, allocating resources, and monitoring progress.
formal.zh: 项目管理包括工作规划、资源分配和进度跟踪。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex it-tim qed jaħdem daqshekk tajjeb? Mark: Għax hemm tmexxija tajba, u kulħadd jaf x'għandu jagħmel.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why is the team working so well? Mark: Because there is good leadership, and everyone knows what to do.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这个团队为什么配合得这么好？马克：因为领导得好，而且每个人都知道自己该做什么。

messages.speaker: Elena (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex it-tim qed jaħdem daqshekk tajjeb?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex it-tim qed jaħdem daqshekk tajjeb?
messages.zh: 这个团队为什么配合得这么好？
messages.en: Why is the team working so well?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hemm tmexxija tajba, u kulħadd jaf x'għandu jagħmel.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hemm tmexxija tajba, u kulħadd jaf x'għandu jagħmel.
messages.zh: 因为领导得好，而且每个人都知道自己该做什么。
messages.en: Because there is good leadership, and everyone knows what to do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tmexxija 放在团队白板中央：安排任务和资源时译“管理”，带领大家前进时译“领导”；两种译法都围绕组织与引导。

gloss_zh: 被赶开；对某人或某物感到厌恶

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be driven away, or to feel strong disgust toward something or someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被驱赶离开，或对某人、某物产生强烈的厌恶感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mkeċċi minn post, jew iħoss stmerrija lejn xi ħaġa jew xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被赶开；被驱逐离去。

sense_translations.en_definition: to feel repugnance at sth. or sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某物或某人感到厌恶、反感。

collocations.zh: 闻到那股气味感到恶心

collocations.en: felt repugnance at what he saw

formal.mt: Il-viżitatur tmeżmeż bir-riħa qawwija tal-iskart li kien tħalla fil-bitħa.
formal.en: The visitor felt disgust at the strong smell of the rubbish that had been left in the courtyard.
formal.zh: 院子里堆放的垃圾散发出强烈气味，令来访者感到恶心。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex ħareġ Mark mill-kċina? Lara: Tmeżmeż bir-riħa tal-ħalib qares.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did Mark leave the kitchen? Lara: He felt disgust at the smell of the sour milk.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：马克为什么从厨房出去了？拉拉：酸牛奶的气味让他觉得恶心。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么从厨房出去了？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave the kitchen?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 酸牛奶的气味让他觉得恶心。
messages.en: He felt disgust at the smell of the sour milk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tmeżmeż 配两张独立图片：一张是被赶离原处，另一张是闻到难闻气味后皱眉；分别记住“被赶开”和“感到厌恶”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong feeling of disgust or intense aversion toward something or someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某物产生的强烈厌恶、反感或憎恶之情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens qawwi ta' stmerrija jew mibegħda lejn xi ħaġa jew xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 厌恶；强烈的反感。
憎恶；极其强烈的厌恶。

formal.mt: Fl-artiklu tagħha, l-awtriċi tesprimi tmeżmiż lejn il-moħqrija tal-annimali.
formal.en: In her article, the writer expresses abhorrence of cruelty to animals.
formal.zh: 作者在文章中表达了对虐待动物行为的憎恶。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif ħassejtek meta rajt kif kienu qed jittrattaw lill-kelb? Pawlu: Ħassejt sens ta' tmeżmiż; ma niflaħx nara moħqrija bħal dik.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you feel when you saw how they were treating the dog? Pawlu: I felt repugnance; I cannot bear to see cruelty like that.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看到他们那样对待那只狗，你有什么感受？保罗：我感到很厌恶，我受不了那样的残忍行为。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħassejtek meta rajt kif kienu qed jittrattaw lill-kelb?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħassejtek meta rajt kif kienu qed jittrattaw lill-kelb?
messages.zh: 看到他们那样对待那只狗，你有什么感受？
messages.en: How did you feel when you saw how they were treating the dog?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħassejt sens ta' tmeżmiż; ma niflaħx nara moħqrija bħal dik.
messages.mt_standard: Ħassejt sens ta' tmeżmiż; ma niflaħx nara moħqrija bħal dik.
messages.zh: 我感到很厌恶，我受不了那样的残忍行为。
messages.en: I felt repugnance; I cannot bear to see cruelty like that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tmeżmiż 写在“厌恶感”标签上：难闻事物引起反感，残忍行为引起憎恶；它是情绪名词，可用 sens ta' tmeżmiż 帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To say words quietly and indistinctly, often to oneself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 低声而含糊地说话，常指独自嘟囔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħid kliem b'leħen baxx u mhux ċar, spiss bejnu u bejn ruħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 低声嘟囔；含糊地小声说话。
被咀嚼；被牙齿嚼碎。

formal.mt: Wara li qara l-ittra, ir-raġel tmiegħed xi kliem li ħadd ma fehem.
formal.en: After reading the letter, the man muttered some words that nobody understood.
formal.zh: 读完信后，那个男人嘟囔了几句，谁也没听懂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tmiegħed Mark meta ra l-kont? Rita: Għax deherlu għoli wisq, imma ma riedx jilmenta quddiem kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark mutter when he saw the bill? Rita: Because he thought it was too high, but he didn't want to complain in front of everyone.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark看到账单时为什么嘟囔了几句？Rita：因为他觉得太贵了，但又不想当着大家的面抱怨。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tmiegħed Mark meta ra l-kont?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tmiegħed Mark meta ra l-kont?
messages.zh: Mark看到账单时为什么嘟囔了几句？
messages.en: Why did Mark mutter when he saw the bill?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax deherlu għoli wisq, imma ma riedx jilmenta quddiem kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Għax deherlu għoli wisq, imma ma riedx jilmenta quddiem kulħadd.
messages.zh: 因为他觉得太贵了，但又不想当着大家的面抱怨。
messages.en: Because he thought it was too high, but he didn't want to complain in front of everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅嘴部画面记忆：嘴里含糊出声是“嘟囔”，食物在嘴里被嚼是“被咀嚼”；按句中主语判断义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To roll one's body on the ground.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让身体在地面上翻滚或打滚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idur b'ġismu fuq l-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在地面上翻滚；在地上打滚。

formal.mt: Wara l-mixja, il-kelb tmiegħek fil-ħaxix għal ftit minuti.
formal.en: After the walk, the dog rolled in the grass for a few minutes.
formal.zh: 散步后，那只狗在草地上打了几分钟滚。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-kelb kollu trab? Pawlu: Għax tmiegħek fuq l-art fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the dog covered in dust? Pawlu: Because he rolled on the ground in the garden.
colloquial.zh: Lara：狗身上怎么全是灰？Pawlu：因为它刚才在花园的地上打滚。

messages.speaker: Lara (宠物主人)
messages.zh: 狗身上怎么全是灰？
messages.en: Why is the dog covered in dust?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 因为它刚才在花园的地上打滚。
messages.en: Because he rolled on the ground in the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小狗在草地上左右翻身，把这个词与“身体贴着地面打滚”的连续动作一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To play about or move around energetically for fun.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了玩乐而嬉闹，或兴奋地蹦跳活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jilgħab u jiċċaqlaq b'ħafna enerġija għall-gost.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嬉闹；玩耍。
欢蹦乱跳；兴高采烈地蹦跳嬉戏。

formal.mt: Matul il-ħin tal-logħob, it-tifel tmiegħeż fil-bitħa ma' sħabu.
formal.en: During playtime, the boy played around in the yard with his friends.
formal.zh: 游戏时间里，那个男孩和伙伴们在院子里嬉闹。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif ħammeġ il-ħwejjeġ kollha Leo? David: Tmiegħeż fil-ġnien mal-ħbieb wara l-iskola.
colloquial.en: Anna: How did Leo get all his clothes dirty? David: He played around in the garden with his friends after school.
colloquial.zh: Anna：Leo怎么把衣服全弄脏了？David：他放学后和朋友们在花园里嬉闹。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.zh: Leo怎么把衣服全弄脏了？
messages.en: How did Leo get all his clothes dirty?

messages.speaker: David (父亲)
messages.zh: 他放学后和朋友们在花园里嬉闹。
messages.en: He played around in the garden with his friends after school.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它配上孩子开心蹦跳的画面：普通玩闹对应第一个义项，动作更活泼的欢蹦乱跳对应第二个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take one's time, slow down, or delay proceeding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 行动慢慢吞吞、放慢速度，或迟迟没有继续进行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu l-affarijiet bil-mod, inaqqas il-pass jew idum qabel ikompli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磨蹭；慢慢吞吞地行动。
放慢速度；减缓行动的节奏。
耽搁；延迟行动或继续进行。

formal.mt: Ix-xufier tmiehel meta wasal ħdejn l-iskola, għax kien hemm tfal jaqsmu t-triq.
formal.en: The driver slowed down when he reached the school because children were crossing the road.
formal.zh: 司机开到学校附近时放慢了速度，因为有孩子正在过马路。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex wasal tard Luke? Sara: Tmiehel fit-triq biex iħares lejn il-ħwienet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Luke arrive late? Sara: He dawdled on the way to look at the shops.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Luke为什么迟到了？Sara：他在路上磨蹭着看商店。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Luke为什么迟到了？
messages.en: Why did Luke arrive late?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tmiehel fit-triq biex iħares lejn il-ħwienet.
messages.mt_standard: Tmiehel fit-triq biex iħares lejn il-ħwienet.
messages.zh: 他在路上磨蹭着看商店。
messages.en: He dawdled on the way to look at the shops.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“慢下来”串联三个义项：闲逛时是磨蹭，行进时是减速，迟迟不行动时就是耽搁。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The fulfilment of something hoped for or intended, or a state of perfection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 愿望或意图得到实现的状态，也可指圆满、完美的境界。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-twettiq ta' xi ħaġa mixtieqa jew maħsuba, jew stat ta' perfezzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 实现；达成，尤指愿望或意图的实现。
完美；圆满无缺的状态。

formal.mt: Il-ftuħ taċ-ċentru kien it-tmiema ta' xewqa li l-komunità kellha għal ħafna snin.
formal.en: The opening of the centre was the fulfilment of a wish the community had held for many years.
formal.zh: 这个中心的开放，实现了社区多年来的愿望。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'tfisser 'tmiema' f'din is-sentenza dwar ix-xewqa tagħha? Mark: Hawn tfisser li x-xewqa tagħha saret realtà.
colloquial.en: Rita: What does 'tmiema' mean in this sentence about her wish? Mark: Here it means that her wish came true.
colloquial.zh: Rita：这个讲她愿望的句子里，tmiema是什么意思？Mark：这里是说她的愿望实现了。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tfisser 'tmiema' f'din is-sentenza dwar ix-xewqa tagħha?
messages.mt_standard: X'tfisser 'tmiema' f'din is-sentenza dwar ix-xewqa tagħha?
messages.zh: 这个讲她愿望的句子里，tmiema是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tmiema' mean in this sentence about her wish?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser li x-xewqa tagħha saret realtà.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser li x-xewqa tagħha saret realtà.
messages.zh: 这里是说她的愿望实现了。
messages.en: Here it means that her wish came true.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象愿望清单上画出一个完整的圆：愿望达成是“实现”，圆满无缺的状态是“完美”。

gloss_zh: 能达到结局的；能得出结论的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing something that reaches a conclusion or comes to an end.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某事物能够达到结局、得出结论或走向结束。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jasal għal konklużjoni jew jintemm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容能达到结局或得出结论的事物。

collocations.en: a process that reaches a conclusion

formal.mt: Il-proċess huwa tmiemi: wara l-aħħar pass, jasal għal konklużjoni.
formal.en: The process reaches a conclusion: after the final step, it comes to an end.
formal.zh: 这个过程能走向结束：完成最后一步后，它便告终。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'raġunament tmiemi'? Pawlu: Raġunament li jasal għal konklużjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'raġunament tmiemi' mean? Pawlu: Reasoning that reaches a conclusion.
colloquial.zh: Lara：raġunament tmiemi是什么意思？Pawlu：就是能得出结论的推理。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: raġunament tmiemi是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'raġunament tmiemi' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 就是能得出结论的推理。
messages.en: Reasoning that reaches a conclusion.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在推理步骤的末端画一个终点，提醒自己这个形容词描述“能走到结论或结局”的性质。

gloss_zh: 八（置于名词前的短形式）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The short form of the number eight used before a noun to state a quantity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数字“八”置于名词前表示数量时使用的短形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-forma qasira ta' tmienja li tintuża qabel nom biex turi kwantità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: tmienja（八）用作定语、置于名词前时的短形式。

formal.mt: Il-librerija xtrat tmien kotba ġodda għall-istudenti.
formal.en: The library bought eight new books for the students.
formal.zh: 图书馆为学生购入了八本新书。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm għandna siġġijiet għall-mistednin? Mark: Għandna tmien siġġijiet, wieħed għal kull persuna.
colloquial.en: Maja: How many chairs do we have for the guests? Mark: We have eight chairs, one for each person.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们有多少把椅子给客人坐？Mark：有八把，每人一把。

messages.speaker: Maja (聚会主人)
messages.zh: 我们有多少把椅子给客人坐？
messages.en: How many chairs do we have for the guests?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna tmien siġġijiet, wieħed għal kull persuna.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna tmien siġġijiet, wieħed għal kull persuna.
messages.zh: 有八把，每人一把。
messages.en: We have eight chairs, one for each person.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记成“八后面紧跟要数的东西”：看到tmien kotba，就把短形式和后面的名词一起读成“八本书”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 800, used to express a quantity of eight hundred.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词八百，表示八个一百合成的数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 800, li juri kwantità ta' tmien gruppi ta' mija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 八百。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, in-numru totali ta' viżitaturi kien tmien mija.
formal.en: According to the report, the total number of visitors was eight hundred.
formal.zh: 根据报告，访客总人数为八百。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm kien hemm nies fil-kunċert? Pawlu: Kien hemm tmien mija b'kollox.
colloquial.en: Sara: How many people were at the concert? Pawlu: There were eight hundred in total.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：音乐会现场有多少人？保罗：总共有八百人。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 音乐会现场有多少人？
messages.en: How many people were at the concert?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 总共有八百人。
messages.en: There were eight hundred in total.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画八个方框，每框写一百，合起来就是八百；把 tmien mija 整组对应到 800，并留意这里写 tmien。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 98, one more than ninety-seven and one less than ninety-nine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数字98，比九十七多一，比九十九少一。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 98, wieħed aktar minn sebgħa u disgħin u wieħed inqas minn disgħa u disgħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 九十八；数字98。

formal.mt: L-istudent kiseb tmienja u disgħin punt minn mija fl-eżami finali.
formal.en: The student scored ninety-eight points out of one hundred in the final examination.
formal.zh: 这名学生在期末考试中得了九十八分，满分为一百分。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kemm jiswa dan il-ġakkett? Marija: Tmienja u disgħin ewro. Rita: Tajjeb, nista' nippruvah?
colloquial.en: Rita: How much does this jacket cost? Marija: Ninety-eight euros. Rita: All right, can I try it on?
colloquial.zh: Rita：这件夹克多少钱？Marija：九十八欧元。Rita：好的，我可以试穿吗？

messages.speaker: Rita (顾客)
messages.zh: 这件夹克多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this jacket cost?

messages.speaker: Marija (店员)
messages.zh: 九十八欧元。
messages.en: Ninety-eight euros.

messages.speaker: Rita (顾客)
messages.zh: 好的，我可以试穿吗？
messages.en: All right, can I try it on?

cognitive_memory_aid: 按词序记成“八、和、九十”：先说个位tmienja，再用u连接十位disgħin，合起来就是九十八。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 48, used to express a quantity of forty-eight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词四十八，表示四十八个单位的数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 48, li juri kwantità ta' tmienja u erbgħin unità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 四十八。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport fih tmienja u erbgħin paġna.
formal.en: The report contains forty-eight pages.
formal.zh: 这份报告共有四十八页。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm għandna ħin biex inlestu? Mark: Għandna tmienja u erbgħin siegħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: How much time do we have to finish? Mark: We have forty-eight hours.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们还有多少时间完成？马克：我们有四十八小时。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 我们还有多少时间完成？
messages.en: How much time do we have to finish?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 我们有四十八小时。
messages.en: We have forty-eight hours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把四十八拆成“八加四十”：tmienja 是八，u 连接，erbgħin 是四十；按这个顺序记住整组数词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 28, used to express a quantity of twenty-eight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词二十八，表示二十八个单位的数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 28, li juri kwantità ta' tmienja u għoxrin unità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 二十八。

formal.mt: Fil-kors hemm tmienja u għoxrin student.
formal.en: There are twenty-eight students on the course.
formal.zh: 这门课程有二十八名学生。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm għandha żmien oħtok? Pawlu: Għandha tmienja u għoxrin sena.
colloquial.en: Sara: How old is your sister? Pawlu: She is twenty-eight years old.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你姐姐多大了？保罗：她二十八岁。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你姐姐多大了？
messages.en: How old is your sister?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 她二十八岁。
messages.en: She is twenty-eight years old.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把二十八想成“八加二十”：先说 tmienja，再用 u 接上 għoxrin；想象二十颗珠子旁边另放八颗。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 78, used to express a quantity of seventy-eight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词七十八，表示七十八个单位的数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 78, li juri kwantità ta' tmienja u sebgħin unità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 七十八。

formal.mt: Għall-kunċert inbiegħu tmienja u sebgħin biljett.
formal.en: Seventy-eight tickets were sold for the concert.
formal.zh: 这场音乐会售出了七十八张票。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm hemm siġġijiet fis-sala? Toni: Hemm tmienja u sebgħin siġġu.
colloquial.en: Lara: How many chairs are there in the hall? Toni: There are seventy-eight chairs.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：大厅里有多少把椅子？托尼：有七十八把椅子。

messages.speaker: Lara (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 大厅里有多少把椅子？
messages.en: How many chairs are there in the hall?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.zh: 有七十八把椅子。
messages.en: There are seventy-eight chairs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象七排各十把椅子，旁边再加八把：总数七十八；说数时先说八 tmienja，再接 u sebgħin。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 68, used to express a quantity of sixty-eight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词六十八，表示六十八个单位的数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 68, li juri kwantità ta' tmienja u sittin unità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 六十八。

formal.mt: It-tul tar-rotta huwa tmienja u sittin kilometru.
formal.en: The length of the route is sixty-eight kilometres.
formal.zh: 这条路线全长六十八公里。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kemm għandu żmien missierek? David: Għandu tmienja u sittin sena.
colloquial.en: Nina: How old is your father? David: He is sixty-eight years old.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你父亲多大了？戴维：他六十八岁。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你父亲多大了？
messages.en: How old is your father?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 他六十八岁。
messages.en: He is sixty-eight years old.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把六十八分成六十和八，但按“八加六十”的顺序读：tmienja u sittin；用六十八岁生日的画面巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 38, used to express a quantity of thirty-eight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词三十八，表示三十八个单位的数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 38, li juri kwantità ta' tmienja u tletin unità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 三十八。

formal.mt: Il-librerija rċeviet tmienja u tletin ktieb ġdid.
formal.en: The library received thirty-eight new books.
formal.zh: 图书馆收到了三十八本新书。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm dam il-vjaġġ? Karl: Dam tmienja u tletin minuta.
colloquial.en: Maja: How long did the journey take? Karl: It took thirty-eight minutes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这趟路花了多长时间？卡尔：花了三十八分钟。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这趟路花了多长时间？
messages.en: How long did the journey take?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.zh: 花了三十八分钟。
messages.en: It took thirty-eight minutes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象三摞各十本书，旁边另有八本，共三十八本；用“八 tmienja 加 u 三十 tletin”的顺序记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 88, used to express a quantity of eighty-eight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词八十八，表示八十八个单位的数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 88, li juri kwantità ta' tmienja u tmenin unità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 八十八。

formal.mt: Għall-ikla attendew tmienja u tmenin mistieden.
formal.en: Eighty-eight guests attended the dinner.
formal.zh: 八十八位来宾出席了晚宴。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kemm hu l-kont b'kollox? Mark: Huwa tmienja u tmenin ewro.
colloquial.en: Anna: How much is the bill in total? Mark: It is eighty-eight euros.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：账单总共多少钱？马克：八十八欧元。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 账单总共多少钱？
messages.en: How much is the bill in total?

messages.speaker: Mark (服务员)
messages.zh: 八十八欧元。
messages.en: It is eighty-eight euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到两个八时，分别联想个位八 tmienja 和八十 tmenin；中间放 u，按“八加八十”读出八十八。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 58, used to express a quantity of fifty-eight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词五十八，表示五十八个单位的数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 58, li juri kwantità ta' tmienja u ħamsin unità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 五十八。

formal.mt: Il-vjaġġ dam tmienja u ħamsin minuta.
formal.en: The journey lasted fifty-eight minutes.
formal.zh: 这段旅程用时五十八分钟。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm tiswa din il-borża? Rita: Tiswa tmienja u ħamsin ewro.
colloquial.en: Mark: How much does this bag cost? Rita: It costs fifty-eight euros.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个包多少钱？丽塔：五十八欧元。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个包多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this bag cost?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 五十八欧元。
messages.en: It costs fifty-eight euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“五十八欧元”的价签帮助记忆：tmienja 是八，ħamsin 是五十，中间用 u 连接，读作“八加五十”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have one's statement contradicted or one's judgment questioned by someone else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 自己的说法受到他人反驳，或自己的判断受到他人质疑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun hemm min imur kontra dak li wieħed jgħid jew jiddubita mill-ġudizzju tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被别人反驳，即自己的说法受到相反意见的否定。
自己的判断或决定被别人质疑，尤其是事后受到挑剔。

formal.mt: Il-kelliem tmiera waqt il-laqgħa, iżda mbagħad ippreżenta d-dokumenti li jappoġġjaw l-argument tiegħu.
formal.en: The speaker was contradicted during the meeting, but then presented the documents supporting his argument.
formal.zh: 发言者在会议上受到反驳，但随后出示了支持自己论点的文件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark waqaf jitkellem? Pawlu: Għax tmiera darbtejn, u ried jiċċekkja l-fatti qabel ikompli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark stop talking? Pawlu: Because he was contradicted twice, and he wanted to check the facts before continuing.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么不说下去了？保罗：因为他被反驳了两次，想先核实事实再继续。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 马克为什么不说下去了？
messages.en: Why did Mark stop talking?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax tmiera darbtejn, u ried jiċċekkja l-fatti qabel ikompli.
messages.mt_standard: Għax tmiera darbtejn, u ried jiċċekkja l-fatti qabel ikompli.
messages.zh: 因为他被反驳了两次，想先核实事实再继续。
messages.en: Because he was contradicted twice, and he wanted to check the facts before continuing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己发言后有人举手反驳，把 tmiera 与“说法或判断受到挑战”的场景一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of giving food to a person or an animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给人或动物提供食物的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti tal-ikel lil persuna jew lil annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喂养；给人或动物喂食的行为或过程。

formal.mt: Il-voluntiera huma responsabbli mit-tmigħ tal-annimali kull filgħodu.
formal.en: The volunteers are responsible for feeding the animals every morning.
formal.zh: 志愿者负责每天早晨给动物喂食。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Wasal ħin it-tmigħ tal-qattus? Mark: Iva, l-ikel tiegħu lest fil-kċina.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is it time to feed the cat? Mark: Yes, his food is ready in the kitchen.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：到给猫喂食的时间了吗？马克：到了，它的食物已经在厨房准备好了。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 到给猫喂食的时间了吗？
messages.en: Is it time to feed the cat?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 到了，它的食物已经在厨房准备好了。
messages.en: Yes, his food is ready in the kitchen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tmigħ 记成“把食物送到嘴边”这一整个喂食过程；它是表示行为的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The long attributive form of the number eight, used before nouns in combinations such as tmint ijiem and tmint elef.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数词“八”的长定语形式，用在 tmint ijiem（八天）、tmint elef（八千）等名词组合中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-forma twila ta' tmienja meta tintuża quddiem nom, bħal fi tmint ijiem u tmint elef.

sense_translations.zh_definition: tmienja（八）的长定语形式，用于修饰后面的名词。

formal.mt: Il-kors intensiv idum tmint ijiem u jinkludi eżerċizzji ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The intensive course lasts eight days and includes daily exercises.
formal.zh: 这门强化课程为期八天，包含每日练习。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm se ddum hemm? Lara: Tmint ijiem; nerġa' lura nhar it-Tnejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: How long will you stay there? Lara: Eight days; I'll be back on Monday.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你会在那里待多久？拉拉：八天；我星期一回来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你会在那里待多久？
messages.en: How long will you stay there?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tmint ijiem; nerġa' lura nhar it-Tnejn.
messages.mt_standard: Tmint ijiem; nerġa' lura nhar it-Tnejn.
messages.zh: 八天；我星期一回来。
messages.en: Eight days; I'll be back on Monday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“tmint ijiem＝八天”整块记忆，看到 tmint 就想到后面还跟着它所修饰的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 8,000, equal to eight groups of one thousand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数值 8,000，即八个一千，中文读作“八千”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 8,000, jiġifieri elf għal tmien darbiet.

formal.mt: Il-kollezzjoni tal-librerija tinkludi tmint elef ktieb f'diversi lingwi.
formal.en: The library's collection includes eight thousand books in various languages.
formal.zh: 图书馆的馆藏包括八千本不同语言的书籍。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm ġbart għall-proġett? Pawlu: Tmint elef ewro s'issa, u għadna niġbru.
colloquial.en: Lara: How much have you raised for the project? Pawlu: Eight thousand euros so far, and we're still collecting.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为这个项目筹到了多少钱？保罗：到目前为止八千欧元，我们还在继续筹款。

messages.speaker: Lara (志愿者)
messages.zh: 你为这个项目筹到了多少钱？
messages.en: How much have you raised for the project?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (筹款负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Tmint elef ewro s'issa, u għadna niġbru.
messages.mt_standard: Tmint elef ewro s'issa, u għadna niġbru.
messages.zh: 到目前为止八千欧元，我们还在继续筹款。
messages.en: Eight thousand euros so far, and we're still collecting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tmint elef 与“8 × 1,000＝8,000”配对记忆，再用 tmint elef ewro 练习金额表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 18,000, equal to eighteen groups of one thousand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数值 18,000，即十八个一千，中文读作“一万八千”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 18,000, jiġifieri elf għal tmintax-il darba.

formal.mt: Il-librerija rċeviet donazzjoni ta' tmintax-il elf ewro biex tixtri kotba ġodda.
formal.en: The library received a donation of eighteen thousand euros to buy new books.
formal.zh: 图书馆收到了一万八千欧元的捐款，用于购置新书。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm tiswa din il-karozza? Rita: Tmintax-il elf ewro, skont ir-reklam.
colloquial.en: Mark: How much does this car cost? Rita: Eighteen thousand euros, according to the advertisement.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这辆车多少钱？丽塔：广告上写的是一万八千欧元。

messages.speaker: Mark (购车者)
messages.zh: 这辆车多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this car cost?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 广告上写的是一万八千欧元。
messages.en: Eighteen thousand euros, according to the advertisement.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先按“十八个千”理解 tmintax-il elf，再转换为中文“一万八千”，用数字 18,000 核对。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be musty or to give off an unpleasant smell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有霉味，或散发出其他难闻的气味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu riħa ta' moffa jew joħroġ riħa ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 带有霉味；散发出潮湿、久放形成的陈霉气味。
发出难闻的气味；发臭。

collocations.en: the fabric developed a bad smell

formal.mt: Id-drapp tmiżżeż wara li nħażen għal żmien twil f'post niedi.
formal.en: The fabric became musty after being stored for a long time in a damp place.
formal.zh: 这块布料长期存放在潮湿的地方后有了霉味。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'riħa għandu dan ix-xugaman! Mark: Tmiżżeż għax baqa' mxarrab fil-basket.
colloquial.en: Sara: This towel smells awful! Mark: It developed a bad smell because it stayed wet in the basket.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这条毛巾的味道真难闻！马克：它一直湿着放在篮子里，所以有了异味。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 这条毛巾的味道真难闻！
messages.en: This towel smells awful!

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 它一直湿着放在篮子里，所以有了异味。
messages.en: It developed a bad smell because it stayed wet in the basket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开装着湿毛巾的篮子后闻到异味，用这个嗅觉场景记住动词 tmiżżeż。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition of being musty or having an unpleasant smell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有霉味或其他难闻气味的状态，也可指这种气味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat ta' xi ħaġa li għandha riħa ta' moffa jew riħa ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 霉味；潮湿或久放的东西所带有的陈霉气味或状态。
臭味；带有难闻气味的状态。

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, ġiet innutata riħa ta' tmiżżiż fil-kamra fejn jinżammu d-dokumenti.
formal.en: During the inspection, a musty smell was noticed in the room where the documents are kept.
formal.zh: 检查时，人们发现存放文件的房间里有一股霉味。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed ixxomm din ir-riħa ta' tmiżżiż? Lara: Iva, ġejja mill-armarju; ejja niftħuh u naraw x'hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you smell this mustiness? Lara: Yes, it's coming from the cupboard; let's open it and see what's inside.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你闻到这股霉味了吗？拉拉：闻到了，是从柜子里传出来的；我们打开看看里面有什么吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed ixxomm din ir-riħa ta' tmiżżiż?
messages.mt_standard: Qed ixxomm din ir-riħa ta' tmiżżiż?
messages.zh: 你闻到这股霉味了吗？
messages.en: Can you smell this mustiness?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġejja mill-armarju; ejja niftħuh u naraw x'hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġejja mill-armarju; ejja niftħuh u naraw x'hemm.
messages.zh: 闻到了，是从柜子里传出来的；我们打开看看里面有什么吧。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from the cupboard; let's open it and see what's inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tmiżżiż 当作给“那股霉味”贴上的名词标签，再用 riħa ta' tmiżżiż 整组复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Providing nourishment, or relating to the act or process of feeding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够提供营养、起滋养作用的；或与喂食、喂养过程有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti nutriment jew li għandu x'jaqsam mat-tmigħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有营养的；能够滋养身体的。
与喂食或喂养有关的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-proċess tmugħi tal-annimali u l-ikel li jingħata lil kull grupp.
formal.en: The report describes the animals' feeding process and the food given to each group.
formal.zh: 报告描述了动物的喂养过程，以及提供给各组动物的食物。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'għandna għall-ikla llum? Pawlu: Soppa tal-għads; ridt inħejji ikel tmugħi għall-familja.
colloquial.en: Rita: What are we having for our meal today? Pawlu: Lentil soup; I wanted to prepare nourishing food for the family.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我们今天这顿吃什么？保罗：扁豆汤；我想给家人做些有营养的食物。

messages.speaker: Rita (妻子)
messages.zh: 我们今天这顿吃什么？
messages.en: What are we having for our meal today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Soppa tal-għads; ridt inħejji ikel tmugħi għall-familja.
messages.mt_standard: Soppa tal-għads; ridt inħejji ikel tmugħi għall-familja.
messages.zh: 扁豆汤；我想给家人做些有营养的食物。
messages.en: Lentil soup; I wanted to prepare nourishing food for the family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张学习卡记 tmugħi：一张画营养餐表示“滋养的”，另一张画喂食流程表示“与喂养有关的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To show oneself off in order to attract attention or admiration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了吸引注意或获得赞赏而炫耀、卖弄自己。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juri lilu nnifsu biex jiġbed l-attenzjoni jew l-ammirazzjoni ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 炫耀自己；在人前卖弄自己。

collocations.en: showed himself off in front of the guests
showed himself off in his new clothes

formal.mt: Waqt ir-riċeviment, il-mistieden tnabbar bil-ħwejjeġ għaljin tiegħu biex jiġbed l-attenzjoni.
formal.en: During the reception, the guest showed himself off in his expensive clothes to attract attention.
formal.zh: 招待会上，那位宾客穿着昂贵的衣服炫耀自己，以吸引注意。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajtu lil Pawlu fil-festa? Kemm tnabbar bil-ġakketta l-ġdida! Mark: Iva, ried li kulħadd iħares lejh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see Pawlu at the party? He really showed himself off in that new jacket! Mark: Yes, he wanted everyone to look at him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在聚会上看到保罗了吗？他穿着新夹克，可真会卖弄！马克：是啊，他想让所有人都看他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu lil Pawlu fil-festa? Kemm tnabbar bil-ġakketta l-ġdida!
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu lil Pawlu fil-festa? Kemm tnabbar bil-ġakketta l-ġdida!
messages.zh: 你在聚会上看到保罗了吗？他穿着新夹克，可真会卖弄！
messages.en: Did you see Pawlu at the party? He really showed himself off in that new jacket!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ried li kulħadd iħares lejh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ried li kulħadd iħares lejh.
messages.zh: 是啊，他想让所有人都看他。
messages.en: Yes, he wanted everyone to look at him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人穿上新外套不停展示自己，把这个吸引目光的画面与 tnabbar 连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have dirt or unwanted material removed by cleaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经过清洁而去除污垢或杂物，变得干净。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir nadif wara li jitneħħew minnu l-ħmieġ jew affarijiet mhux mixtieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被清洁、洗净或打扫干净。

formal.mt: Il-bank tnaddaf bis-sapun u bl-ilma qabel ma beda x-xogħol.
formal.en: The workbench was cleaned with soap and water before work began.
formal.zh: 工作开始前，工作台已用肥皂和水清洗干净。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-mejda lesta, imma l-art għadha ma tnaddfitx? Ben: L-art le, iżda l-bank tnaddaf diġà.
colloquial.en: Lara: The table is ready, but has the floor still not been cleaned? Ben: The floor hasn't, but the workbench has already been cleaned.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：桌子准备好了，但地板还没打扫吗？本：地板还没有，不过工作台已经清洁好了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-mejda lesta, imma l-art għadha ma tnaddfitx?
messages.mt_standard: Il-mejda lesta, imma l-art għadha ma tnaddfitx?
messages.zh: 桌子准备好了，但地板还没打扫吗？
messages.en: The table is ready, but has the floor still not been cleaned?

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: L-art le, iżda l-bank tnaddaf diġà.
messages.mt_standard: L-art le, iżda l-bank tnaddaf diġà.
messages.zh: 地板还没有，不过工作台已经清洁好了。
messages.en: The floor hasn't, but the workbench has already been cleaned.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住清洁前后两张桌面的对比图：关注东西被弄干净的结果，用 tnaddaf 表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made level so that the surface is ready for threshing grain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 地面为了进行谷物脱粒而被整平。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir invell biex ikun lest għad-dris tal-qamħ.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be levelled in preparation for threshing
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为准备打谷、进行谷物脱粒而被整平。

collocations.en: the surface of the threshing floor was levelled
collocations.zh: 打谷场的地面被整平了

formal.mt: Il-wiċċ tal-qiegħa tnaddar qabel ma nġieb il-qamħ għad-dris.
formal.en: The surface of the threshing floor was levelled before the grain was brought in for threshing.
formal.zh: 谷物运来脱粒之前，打谷场的地面已经整平。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Il-post tnaddar għad-dris? Ġużeppi: Iva, issa l-wiċċ hu invell u nistgħu nġibu l-qamħ.
colloquial.en: Toni: Has the place been levelled for threshing? Ġużeppi: Yes, the surface is level now, and we can bring in the grain.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：这地方已经为打谷整平了吗？朱塞佩：是的，现在地面平整了，可以把谷物运来了。

messages.speaker: Toni (农民)
messages.zh: 这地方已经为打谷整平了吗？
messages.en: Has the place been levelled for threshing?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农场工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa l-wiċċ hu invell u nistgħu nġibu l-qamħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa l-wiċċ hu invell u nistgħu nġibu l-qamħ.
messages.zh: 是的，现在地面平整了，可以把谷物运来了。
messages.en: Yes, the surface is level now, and we can bring in the grain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用先整平打谷场、再运来谷物的顺序记 tnaddar，把整平和准备脱粒一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be forced to leave one's country or home and live elsewhere in exile.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被迫离开自己的国家或家园，到别处流亡或居住。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun imġiegħel jitlaq minn pajjiżu jew minn daru u jgħix fl-eżilju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被流放或放逐，被迫离开故国或家园。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-poeta tnaffa minn pajjiżu u kellu jgħix 'il bogħod minn familtu.
formal.en: In the novel, the poet was exiled from his country and had to live far from his family.
formal.zh: 小说中，诗人被逐出自己的国家，不得不远离家人生活。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-poeta fl-istorja ma setax imur lura d-dar? David: Għax tnaffa minn pajjiżu u ma tħalliex jirritorna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why couldn't the poet in the story go home? David: Because he was exiled from his country and wasn't allowed to return.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：故事里的诗人为什么不能回家？戴维：因为他被逐出自己的国家，而且不获准返回。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-poeta fl-istorja ma setax imur lura d-dar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-poeta fl-istorja ma setax imur lura d-dar?
messages.zh: 故事里的诗人为什么不能回家？
messages.en: Why couldn't the poet in the story go home?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax tnaffa minn pajjiżu u ma tħalliex jirritorna.
messages.mt_standard: Għax tnaffa minn pajjiżu u ma tħalliex jirritorna.
messages.zh: 因为他被逐出自己的国家，而且不获准返回。
messages.en: Because he was exiled from his country and wasn't allowed to return.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故事人物提着行李被迫离开故乡，把不能自由回家的处境与 tnaffa 联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become frightened or irritated by something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某事而受到惊吓，或感到恼怒、不耐烦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss il-biża' jew id-dwejjaq minħabba xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到惊吓；感到害怕。
被惹恼；感到烦躁或不耐烦。

collocations.en: was frightened by the loud noise
was irritated by the repeated questions

formal.mt: Iż-żiemel tnaffar bil-ħoss qawwi u waqaf f'nofs it-triq.
formal.en: The horse was frightened by the loud noise and stopped in the middle of the road.
formal.zh: 那匹马被巨响吓到，停在了路中央。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex Mark telaq minn ħdejn il-mejda? Leo: Tnaffar bil-mistoqsijiet ripetuti; ried ftit kwiet.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did Mark leave the table? Leo: He was irritated by the repeated questions; he wanted some peace and quiet.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：马克为什么离开桌边了？里奥：反复的提问让他烦了，他想安静一会儿。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark telaq minn ħdejn il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark telaq minn ħdejn il-mejda?
messages.zh: 马克为什么离开桌边了？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave the table?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tnaffar bil-mistoqsijiet ripetuti; ried ftit kwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Tnaffar bil-mistoqsijiet ripetuti; ried ftit kwiet.
messages.zh: 反复的提问让他烦了，他想安静一会儿。
messages.en: He was irritated by the repeated questions; he wanted some peace and quiet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景记 tnaffar：马听见巨响受惊，人听见反复追问生烦；结合语境判断是哪一种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small drum; the diminutive form of tanbur.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种小鼓；是 tanbur 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tanbur żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' tanbur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小鼓，是 tanbur 的指小形式。

collocations.en: the rhythm of the small drum

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni tal-mużika, l-istudent daqq it-tnajbar biex iżomm ritmu regolari.
formal.en: During the music lesson, the student played the small drum to maintain a steady rhythm.
formal.zh: 音乐课上，学生敲着小鼓来保持稳定的节奏。

colloquial.mt: Ella: Nista' ndoqq it-tnajbar illum? Mark: Iva, ibda b'ritmu sempliċi u jien inkanta miegħek.
colloquial.en: Ella: Can I play the small drum today? Mark: Yes, start with a simple rhythm, and I'll sing along with you.
colloquial.zh: 埃拉：今天我可以敲小鼓吗？马克：可以，先打一个简单的节奏，我跟着你唱。

messages.speaker: Ella (音乐学生)
messages.zh: 今天我可以敲小鼓吗？
messages.en: Can I play the small drum today?

messages.speaker: Mark (音乐老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ibda b'ritmu sempliċi u jien inkanta miegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ibda b'ritmu sempliċi u jien inkanta miegħek.
messages.zh: 可以，先打一个简单的节奏，我跟着你唱。
messages.en: Yes, start with a simple rhythm, and I'll sing along with you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tanbur 和 tnajbar 配成一大一小两幅鼓的图：看到 tnajbar 就想到其中的小鼓。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be prepared as food by cooking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指食物经过烹煮而被做熟，强调食物受到烹调的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi msajjar biex ikun jista' jittiekel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被烹煮；经过烹调而被做熟

formal.mt: Il-laħam tnajjar fuq nar baxx għal sagħtejn qabel ma ġie servut.
formal.en: The meat was cooked over low heat for two hours before it was served.
formal.zh: 肉用小火烹煮了两个小时，然后才上桌。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan il-laħam tnajjar fil-forn? Pawlu: Iva, tnajjar bil-mod, u issa lest biex nieklu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Was this meat cooked in the oven? Pawlu: Yes, it was cooked slowly, and now it is ready for us to eat.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这肉是在烤箱里做的吗？保罗：对，慢慢烤熟的，现在可以吃了。

messages.speaker: Marija (家人)
messages.zh: 这肉是在烤箱里做的吗？
messages.en: Was this meat cooked in the oven?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tnajjar bil-mod, u issa lest biex nieklu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tnajjar bil-mod, u issa lest biex nieklu.
messages.zh: 对，慢慢烤熟的，现在可以吃了。
messages.en: Yes, it was cooked slowly, and now it is ready for us to eat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象锅里的肉慢慢变熟，把 tnajjar 连到“食物被烹煮”的画面，注意主语是食物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity or process of preparing food by cooking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过加热等方式制作食物的活动或过程，即烹饪、烹煮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività jew il-proċess li bih jissajjar l-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烹饪；制作熟食的活动或过程

formal.mt: Il-ħin tat-tnajjir jiddependi mid-daqs tal-biċċiet tal-laħam.
formal.en: The cooking time depends on the size of the pieces of meat.
formal.zh: 烹饪时间取决于肉块的大小。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kemm jieħu ħin it-tnajjir ta' dan il-platt? Mark: Madwar nofs siegħa; sadattant nistgħu nippreparaw l-insalata.
colloquial.en: Nina: How long does cooking this dish take? Mark: About half an hour; meanwhile, we can prepare the salad.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这道菜要做多久？马克：大约半小时；这期间我们可以准备沙拉。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm jieħu ħin it-tnajjir ta' dan il-platt?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm jieħu ħin it-tnajjir ta' dan il-platt?
messages.zh: 这道菜要做多久？
messages.en: How long does cooking this dish take?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Madwar nofs siegħa; sadattant nistgħu nippreparaw l-insalata.
messages.mt_standard: Madwar nofs siegħa; sadattant nistgħu nippreparaw l-insalata.
messages.zh: 大约半小时；这期间我们可以准备沙拉。
messages.en: About half an hour; meanwhile, we can prepare the salad.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tnajjir 想成菜谱上的“烹饪过程”栏目；它是活动名称，可以和“时间”搭配记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The croaking of frogs or the harsh squawking of birds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 青蛙发出的呱呱声，或鸟类发出的粗哑、尖厉的叫声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħoss taż-żrinġijiet jew l-għajjat aħrax tal-għasafar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蛙鸣；青蛙等发出的低哑呱呱声
鸟类发出的粗哑、尖厉的叫声

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl, it-tnaqniq taż-żrinġijiet instema' minn ħdejn l-għadira.
formal.en: During the night, the croaking of frogs could be heard from near the pond.
formal.zh: 夜里，可以听到池塘附近传来的蛙鸣。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qed tisma' dak it-tnaqniq? Luqa: Iva, ġej mill-pappagalli fil-ġnien ta' ħdejna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you hear that squawking? Luqa: Yes, it is coming from the parrots in the garden next door.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你听到那阵粗哑的鸟叫了吗？卢卡：听到了，是隔壁花园里的鹦鹉在叫。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 你听到那阵粗哑的鸟叫了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that squawking?

messages.speaker: Luqa (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej mill-pappagalli fil-ġnien ta' ħdejna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej mill-pappagalli fil-ġnien ta' ħdejna.
messages.zh: 听到了，是隔壁花园里的鹦鹉在叫。
messages.en: Yes, it is coming from the parrots in the garden next door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tnaqniq 配两幅有声画面：池塘里的蛙鸣和鹦鹉的粗哑叫声，用发声动物区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have feathers plucked off, or to have weeds removed from an area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指禽鸟的羽毛被拔除，或某片土地上的杂草被清除。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitneħħielu r-rix, jew jitneħħa l-ħaxix ħażin minn post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被拔毛；羽毛被拔除
被除草；土地上的杂草被拔除

collocations.zh: 花园里的杂草被清除了

formal.mt: Il-ġnien tnaqqa mill-ħaxix ħażin qabel ma tħawlu l-fjuri.
formal.en: The garden was cleared of weeds before the flowers were planted.
formal.zh: 栽种花卉之前，花园里的杂草已经被清除。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Il-ġnien tnaqqa diġà? Ġorġ: Iva, dalgħodu; issa nistgħu nħawlu l-fjuri.
colloquial.en: Anna: Has the garden been weeded already? Ġorġ: Yes, this morning; now we can plant the flowers.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：花园已经除过草了吗？乔治：对，今天早上除的；现在可以种花了。

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.zh: 花园已经除过草了吗？
messages.en: Has the garden been weeded already?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dalgħodu; issa nistgħu nħawlu l-fjuri.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dalgħodu; issa nistgħu nħawlu l-fjuri.
messages.zh: 对，今天早上除的；现在可以种花了。
messages.en: Yes, this morning; now we can plant the flowers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两种“拔除”的结果：鸡身上的毛被拔掉，花园里的草被拔掉；看到主语就选择对应义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have a hole made through it by a sharp object or tool.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被尖锐物体或工具穿透，从而形成孔洞。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Issir fih toqba permezz ta' oġġett bil-ponta jew għodda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被刺穿；被穿孔或打出孔洞

formal.mt: Il-kartun tnaqqab b'labra biex jgħaddi l-ħajt mit-toqba.
formal.en: The cardboard was pierced with a needle so that the thread could pass through the hole.
formal.zh: 纸板被针扎出一个孔，以便让线穿过去。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex ħareġ l-ilma mill-barmil? Toni: Għax il-qiegħ tnaqqab b'musmar.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did the water leak out of the bucket? Toni: Because the bottom was pierced by a nail.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：桶里的水为什么漏出来了？托尼：因为桶底被钉子扎穿了。

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 桶里的水为什么漏出来了？
messages.en: Why did the water leak out of the bucket?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.zh: 因为桶底被钉子扎穿了。
messages.en: Because the bottom was pierced by a nail.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tnaqqab 配上“钉子穿过桶底，水从孔里漏出”的画面，牢记结果是出现穿透的孔。

gloss_zh: 被啄；被啃咬；被少量多次偷取

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be pecked or nibbled, or to be stolen a little at a time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被鸟啄食或被小口啃咬，也指钱物被一点一点地偷走。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittiekel b'daqqiet tal-munqar jew b'gdim żgħir, jew jinsteraq ftit ftit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被啄；被鸟用喙啄食
被小口啃咬；被一点一点地吃掉

sense_translations.en_definition: to be stolen in small amounts
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被少量多次偷取；被一点一点地偷走

collocations.en: was stolen a little at a time

formal.mt: Il-qamħ li tħalla barra tnaqqar mit-tiġieġ matul il-jum.
formal.en: The wheat that was left outside was pecked by the chickens during the day.
formal.zh: 留在外面的麦子在白天被鸡啄食了。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dan il-ħobż għaliex għandu marki żgħar? David: Tnaqqar mill-ġrieden matul il-lejl; irridu narmuh.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why does this bread have little marks on it? David: It was nibbled by mice during the night; we need to throw it away.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这面包上怎么有小小的痕迹？戴维：夜里被老鼠啃过了；我们得把它扔掉。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ħobż għaliex għandu marki żgħar?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ħobż għaliex għandu marki żgħar?
messages.zh: 这面包上怎么有小小的痕迹？
messages.en: Why does this bread have little marks on it?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tnaqqar mill-ġrieden matul il-lejl; irridu narmuh.
messages.mt_standard: Tnaqqar mill-ġrieden matul il-lejl; irridu narmuh.
messages.zh: 夜里被老鼠啃过了；我们得把它扔掉。
messages.en: It was nibbled by mice during the night; we need to throw it away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一点一点少掉”的画面串记三个义项：鸡啄一点、鼠啃一点、钱物被偷一点；这是记忆联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made smaller in amount, lowered in price, or subtracted from a total.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数量或程度被降低、价格被打折，或某个数额从总数中被扣除。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir inqas fl-ammont, jinżillu l-prezz, jew jitneħħa minn total.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被减少；数量、程度或规模被降低
被打折；售价被降低
被扣除；从总额或总数中被减去

formal.mt: L-ammont imħallas bil-quddiem tnaqqas mit-total tal-kont.
formal.en: The amount paid in advance was deducted from the total bill.
formal.zh: 预先支付的款项已从账单总额中扣除。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Il-prezz ta' dan il-kowt tnaqqas? Mark: Iva, tnaqqas minn mitt ewro għal tmenin ewro.
colloquial.en: Elena: Has the price of this coat been reduced? Mark: Yes, it was reduced from one hundred euros to eighty euros.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这件外套降价了吗？马克：对，从一百欧元降到了八十欧元。

messages.speaker: Elena (顾客)
messages.zh: 这件外套降价了吗？
messages.en: Has the price of this coat been reduced?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tnaqqas minn mitt ewro għal tmenin ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tnaqqas minn mitt ewro għal tmenin ewro.
messages.zh: 对，从一百欧元降到了八十欧元。
messages.en: Yes, it was reduced from one hundred euros to eighty euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一个向下箭头：数量减少、价格打折、总额扣款都往下走；再用上下文判断具体义项。

gloss_zh: 被凿刻；被雕塑；被雕刻；被刮削；被削刻

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be shaped or marked by chiseling, sculpting, carving, scraping, or whittling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 材料通过凿刻、雕塑、雕刻、刮削或削刻而被加工，形成形状或表面痕迹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħata forma jew isiru marki fih bi skarpell, sikkina jew għodda oħra li tneħħi l-materjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被凿刻；用凿子凿出形状或痕迹
被雕塑；被加工成雕塑形体
被雕刻；通过刻削形成形状、文字或图案
被刮削；表面材料被刮去
被削刻；用刀逐片削去材料而成形

formal.mt: L-isem tal-bennej tnaqqax fil-ġebel fuq id-daħla tal-bini.
formal.en: The builder's name was carved in stone above the entrance to the building.
formal.zh: 建筑工匠的名字被刻在建筑入口上方的石头上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan l-għasfur tnaqqax fl-injam? Ben: Iva, missieri għamlu b'sikkina żgħira.
colloquial.en: Lara: Was this bird carved in wood? Ben: Yes, my father made it with a small knife.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这只鸟是用木头雕出来的吗？本：对，是我父亲用一把小刀做的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这只鸟是用木头雕出来的吗？
messages.en: Was this bird carved in wood?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 对，是我父亲用一把小刀做的。
messages.en: Yes, my father made it with a small knife.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象工匠从材料表面逐步去掉小块：凿石、塑形、刻字、刮面、削木，借工具动作区分五个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making a hole in something by puncturing or piercing it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用尖物刺穿某物或在其表面扎出孔洞的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil ta' toqba f'xi ħaġa permezz ta' oġġett bil-ponta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刺孔；用尖物扎出孔洞。
穿刺；用尖物刺穿某物。

formal.mt: It-tnaqqib tal-karta għandu jsir fuq wiċċ protett biex il-mejda ma ssirilhiex ħsara.
formal.en: The puncturing of the paper should be done on a protected surface so that the table is not damaged.
formal.zh: 应在有防护的台面上给纸刺孔，以免损坏桌子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex poġġejt dik il-biċċa kartun taħt il-karta? Toni: Għat-tnaqqib; hekk il-labra ma tagħmilx ħsara lill-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you put that piece of cardboard under the paper? Toni: For the puncturing; that way the needle won't damage the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么在纸下面放那块硬纸板？托尼：为了给纸刺孔；这样针就不会损坏桌子。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex poġġejt dik il-biċċa kartun taħt il-karta?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex poġġejt dik il-biċċa kartun taħt il-karta?
messages.zh: 你为什么在纸下面放那块硬纸板？
messages.en: Why did you put that piece of cardboard under the paper?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tnaqqib; hekk il-labra ma tagħmilx ħsara lill-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tnaqqib; hekk il-labra ma tagħmilx ħsara lill-mejda.
messages.zh: 为了给纸刺孔；这样针就不会损坏桌子。
messages.en: For the puncturing; that way the needle won't damage the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和针尖穿过纸张、留下小孔的画面相连，记住它表示刺孔这一动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of removing weeds or plucking things such as feathers by pulling them out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把杂草拔除，或把羽毛等物一根根拔下来的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tneħħija tal-ħaxix ħażin jew il-qlugħ ta' affarijiet bħar-rix billi jinġibdu 'l barra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 除草；清除不需要的杂草。
拔除；把羽毛等物拔下来的动作。

formal.mt: It-tnaqqija tal-ħaxix ħażin madwar il-pjanti għandha ssir b'attenzjoni biex ma ssirilx ħsara lill-għeruq tagħhom.
