formal.en: Weeding around the plants should be done carefully so that their roots are not damaged.
formal.zh: 清除植物周围的杂草时应小心，以免伤到植物的根。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'se nagħmlu fil-ġnien illum? Mark: Nibdew bit-tnaqqija tal-ħaxix ħażin, imbagħad insaqqu l-fjuri.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are we going to do in the garden today? Mark: We'll start with weeding, then water the flowers.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们今天在花园里做什么？马克：先除草，然后给花浇水。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们今天在花园里做什么？
messages.en: What are we going to do in the garden today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nibdew bit-tnaqqija tal-ħaxix ħażin, imbagħad insaqqu l-fjuri.
messages.mt_standard: Nibdew bit-tnaqqija tal-ħaxix ħażin, imbagħad insaqqu l-fjuri.
messages.zh: 先除草，然后给花浇水。
messages.en: We'll start with weeding, then water the flowers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指把杂草或羽毛一根根拔出来，用这个共同动作串联除草与拔除两个义项。

gloss_zh: 啄食；小口啃食；零零碎碎地做事

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pecking, eating in small bites, or doing something a little at a time in scattered efforts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟类啄食、小口啃食，或把事情分成零零碎碎的小动作来做。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daqqiet żgħar bil-munqar, ikel b'gdim żgħir, jew xogħol magħmul ftit ftit u b'mod imقطع.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 啄食；用鸟喙一下下地啄。
小口啃食；一点点地咬着吃。

sense_translations.en_definition: performing actions in dribs and drabs
sense_translations.zh_definition: 零零碎碎地做事；每次只做一点，断断续续地进行。

formal.mt: It-tnaqqir tal-għasafar ħalla marki żgħar fuq it-tuffieħ fil-ġnien.
formal.en: The birds' pecking left small marks on the apples in the garden.
formal.zh: 鸟儿的啄食在花园里的苹果上留下了小痕迹。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadek ma spiċċajtx ix-xogħol? Pawlu: Le, qed nagħmlu bit-tnaqqir, ftit filgħodu u ftit filgħaxija.
colloquial.en: Lara: Haven't you finished the work yet? Pawlu: No, I'm doing it in dribs and drabs, a little in the morning and a little in the evening.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你还没把活儿做完吗？保罗：没有，我在零零碎碎地做，早上做一点，晚上做一点。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你还没把活儿做完吗？
messages.en: Haven't you finished the work yet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, qed nagħmlu bit-tnaqqir, ftit filgħodu u ftit filgħaxija.
messages.mt_standard: Le, qed nagħmlu bit-tnaqqir, ftit filgħodu u ftit filgħaxija.
messages.zh: 没有，我在零零碎碎地做，早上做一点，晚上做一点。
messages.en: No, I'm doing it in dribs and drabs, a little in the morning and a little in the evening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用小鸟一口一口啄的画面记忆，再把每次只取一点延伸到小口吃和零碎做事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A decrease or reduction in an amount, price, extent, or duration, including a discount or curtailment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数量、价格、范围或持续时间的减少或削减，也可指折扣或活动的缩减。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inqas fi kwantità, prezz, firxa jew tul ta' żmien, inkluż skont jew limitazzjoni ta' attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 减少；数量或程度变小。
削减；使数量、规模或程度降低。
折扣；从原价中减去的金额或比例。
缩减；对活动、范围或持续时间加以限制或缩短。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jipproponi tnaqqis fl-ispejjeż permezz ta' użu aħjar tar-riżorsi.
formal.en: The report proposes a reduction in costs through better use of resources.
formal.zh: 报告建议通过更有效地使用资源来削减费用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm xi tnaqqis fil-prezz ta' din il-ġakketta? Rita: Iva, illum tiswa għaxar ewro inqas.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there any discount on this jacket? Rita: Yes, today it costs ten euros less.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这件夹克有折扣吗？丽塔：有，今天便宜十欧元。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm xi tnaqqis fil-prezz ta' din il-ġakketta?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm xi tnaqqis fil-prezz ta' din il-ġakketta?
messages.zh: 这件夹克有折扣吗？
messages.en: Is there any discount on this jacket?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, illum tiswa għaxar ewro inqas.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, illum tiswa għaxar ewro inqas.
messages.zh: 有，今天便宜十欧元。
messages.en: Yes, today it costs ten euros less.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中画一个向下箭头：数量下降是减少，预算下降是削减，价格下降就可能是折扣。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of shaping or decorating material by chiselling, whittling, or sculpting it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过凿刻、削刻或雕塑来改变材料形状或制作装饰的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' forma jew tiżjin lil materjal billi jitneħħew biċċiet minnu b'għodda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凿刻；用凿子切削或刻出形状。
削刻；用刀一点点削去材料，尤其是木料。
雕塑；把材料加工成具有立体形态的作品。

formal.mt: Il-kors jintroduċi lill-istudenti għat-tnaqqix fil-ġebel u għall-użu tal-għodod meħtieġa.
formal.en: The course introduces students to stone carving and the use of the necessary tools.
formal.zh: 这门课程向学生介绍石材凿刻及所需工具的使用。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan l-għasfur tal-injam għamiltu int? Toni: Iva, għamiltu waqt lezzjoni tat-tnaqqix fl-injam.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you make this wooden bird yourself? Toni: Yes, I made it during a woodcarving lesson.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这只木鸟是你自己做的吗？托尼：是的，我在木雕课上做的。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这只木鸟是你自己做的吗？
messages.en: Did you make this wooden bird yourself?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għamiltu waqt lezzjoni tat-tnaqqix fl-injam.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għamiltu waqt lezzjoni tat-tnaqqix fl-injam.
messages.zh: 是的，我在木雕课上做的。
messages.en: Yes, I made it during a woodcarving lesson.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象凿子或小刀一点点去掉材料，让石头或木头显出形状，串联凿刻、削刻与雕塑。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become caught in a trap or a situation from which escape is difficult.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 落入陷阱，或陷入难以脱身的处境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqabad f'nassa jew f'sitwazzjoni li jkun diffiċli joħroġ minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被困住；落入陷阱而无法轻易脱身。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-volpi tnassab f'nassa u ma setax jeħles waħdu.
formal.en: In the story, the fox became caught in a trap and could not free himself.
formal.zh: 在故事中，狐狸落入了陷阱，无法自行脱身。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-volpi ma setax jaħrab? Ben: Għax tnassab; kellu bżonn l-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why couldn't the fox escape? Ben: Because he was trapped; he needed help.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：狐狸为什么逃不掉？本：因为它被困住了，需要帮助。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 狐狸为什么逃不掉？
messages.en: Why couldn't the fox escape?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 因为它被困住了，需要帮助。
messages.en: Because he was trapped; he needed help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词放进狐狸落入陷阱的故事里，重点记住主语是被困住的一方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become a Christian by adopting the Christian faith.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接受基督教信仰，成为基督徒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir Nisrani billi jħaddan il-fidi Nisranija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 皈依基督教；转而接受基督教信仰。

collocations.en: converted to Christianity of his own free will
converted to Christianity after much reflection
collocations.zh: 经过深思后皈依了基督教

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-protagonist tnassar wara li studja t-tagħlim Nisrani.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist converted to Christianity after studying Christian teachings.
formal.zh: 在小说中，主人公研习基督教教义后皈依了基督教。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-personaġġ kien diġà Nisrani fil-bidu tal-istorja? Mark: Le, tnassar aktar tard, wara ħafna ħsieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was the character already a Christian at the beginning of the story? Mark: No, he converted to Christianity later, after much reflection.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：故事开始时，这个人物已经是基督徒了吗？马克：不是，他后来经过深思才皈依了基督教。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-personaġġ kien diġà Nisrani fil-bidu tal-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: Il-personaġġ kien diġà Nisrani fil-bidu tal-istorja?
messages.zh: 故事开始时，这个人物已经是基督徒了吗？
messages.en: Was the character already a Christian at the beginning of the story?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tnassar aktar tard, wara ħafna ħsieb.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tnassar aktar tard, wara ħafna ħsieb.
messages.zh: 不是，他后来经过深思才皈依了基督教。
messages.en: No, he converted to Christianity later, after much reflection.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用故事人物从尚未信教到成为基督徒的身份变化来记忆，抓住皈依这一转变。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be caught in a trap or become the target of someone else's scheme.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 落入陷阱，或遭到他人设计、算计。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqabad f'nassa jew ikun il-mira ta' pjan qarrieqi magħmul minn ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被困住；落入陷阱。
遭人算计；成为他人阴谋或诡计针对的对象。

collocations.en: was schemed against by his companion

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, iż-żagħżugħ tnassas minn sieħbu permezz ta' wegħda falza.
formal.en: In the story, the young man was trapped by his companion through a false promise.
formal.zh: 在故事中，年轻人遭到同伴算计，因一个虚假的承诺而落入圈套。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Pietru ma jafdax lil sieħbu? Luka: Għax darba tnassas minnu; wiegħdu xogħol, imma ried biss flusu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why doesn't Pietru trust his companion? Luka: Because he was once trapped by him; he promised him work, but only wanted his money.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：彼得为什么不信任他的同伴？卢卡：因为他曾被那个同伴算计过；对方答应给他工作，其实只想骗他的钱。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pietru ma jafdax lil sieħbu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pietru ma jafdax lil sieħbu?
messages.zh: 彼得为什么不信任他的同伴？
messages.en: Why doesn't Pietru trust his companion?

messages.speaker: Luka (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax darba tnassas minnu; wiegħdu xogħol, imma ried biss flusu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax darba tnassas minnu; wiegħdu xogħol, imma ried biss flusu.
messages.zh: 因为他曾被那个同伴算计过；对方答应给他工作，其实只想骗他的钱。
messages.en: Because he was once trapped by him; he promised him work, but only wanted his money.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人把虚假承诺做成圈套：主语落入其中，便能同时记住被困和遭算计两个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of catching birds or other animals using traps.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用陷阱捕捉鸟类或其他动物的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li biha jinqabdu għasafar jew annimali oħra permezz ta' nases.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 设陷阱捕捉动物；诱捕活动。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi diversi metodi ta' tnassib tal-għasafar.
formal.en: The report describes various methods of bird trapping.
formal.zh: 报告描述了多种诱捕鸟类的方法。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dan il-ktieb jitkellem dwar it-tnassib? Pawlu: Iva, jispjega kif jinqabdu l-għasafar permezz ta' nases.
colloquial.en: Marta: Does this book discuss trapping? Pawlu: Yes, it explains how birds are caught using traps.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这本书讲诱捕吗？保罗：对，它解释了怎样用陷阱捕鸟。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: 这本书讲诱捕吗？
messages.en: Does this book discuss trapping?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jispjega kif jinqabdu l-għasafar permezz ta' nases.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jispjega kif jinqabdu l-għasafar permezz ta' nases.
messages.zh: 对，它解释了怎样用陷阱捕鸟。
messages.en: Yes, it explains how birds are caught using traps.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tnassib 配上“陷阱旁有鸟”的画面，记住它指设陷阱捕捉这一活动。

gloss_zh: 地区或国家的基督教化

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process by which people in a region or country convert to Christianity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某个地区或国家的人们皈依基督教的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih in-nies f'reġjun jew pajjiż jikkonvertu għall-Kristjaneżmu.

sense_translations.en_definition: conversion to christianity in a region or country
sense_translations.zh_definition: 某地区或国家居民皈依基督教的过程；地区或国家的基督教化。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina l-proċess tat-tnassir f'dan ir-reġjun.
formal.en: The study examines the process of Christianization in this region.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察了该地区的基督教化过程。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ifisser it-tnassir f'dan it-test? Mark: Ifisser il-proċess li bih in-nies ta' reġjun jikkonvertu għall-Kristjaneżmu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does Christianization mean in this text? Mark: It means the process by which the people of a region convert to Christianity.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这篇文章里的“基督教化”是什么意思？马克：就是一个地区的人们皈依基督教的过程。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的“基督教化”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does Christianization mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser il-proċess li bih in-nies ta' reġjun jikkonvertu għall-Kristjaneżmu.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser il-proċess li bih in-nies ta' reġjun jikkonvertu għall-Kristjaneżmu.
messages.zh: 就是一个地区的人们皈依基督教的过程。
messages.en: It means the process by which the people of a region convert to Christianity.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tnassir 放进“地区居民逐渐皈依基督教”的课堂示意图，按整个地区的宗教转变来记。

gloss_zh: 密谋；策划阴谋；暗中倾轧

teaching_sense.en_definition: Secret planning or manipulation intended to achieve an aim, often by dishonest means.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为达到某种目的而暗中谋划或操纵的活动，常带有不诚实或阴谋的意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tfassil ta' pjanijiet bil-moħbi jew il-manipulazzjoni biex jintlaħaq għan, spiss b'mezzi qarrieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 暗中谋划；为达到目的而耍心机。
密谋；秘密策划阴谋或不正当行动。
阴谋活动；秘密操纵或相互倾轧。

formal.mt: Ir-rumanz juri kif it-tnassis politiku jeqred il-fiduċja bejn il-karattri.
formal.en: The novel shows how political intrigue destroys trust between the characters.
formal.zh: 这部小说展示了政治阴谋如何破坏人物之间的信任。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed iżommu dawk il-laqgħat sigrieti? David: Fil-film hemm ħafna tnassis; kulħadd irid jieħu l-poter.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are they holding those secret meetings? David: There's a lot of scheming in the film; everyone wants to take power.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：他们为什么开那些秘密会议？戴维：这部电影里有很多阴谋活动，人人都想夺权。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed iżommu dawk il-laqgħat sigrieti?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed iżommu dawk il-laqgħat sigrieti?
messages.zh: 他们为什么开那些秘密会议？
messages.en: Why are they holding those secret meetings?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-film hemm ħafna tnassis; kulħadd irid jieħu l-poter.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-film hemm ħafna tnassis; kulħadd irid jieħu l-poter.
messages.zh: 这部电影里有很多阴谋活动，人人都想夺权。
messages.en: There's a lot of scheming in the film; everyone wants to take power.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电影里几个人关门低声谋划，把 tnassis 与“暗中算计、策划阴谋”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become mouldy, rotten, or musty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得发霉、腐烂，或产生霉味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiżviluppa l-moffa, jitħassar jew jieħu riħa ta' moffa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发霉；表面开始长出霉菌。
腐烂；因腐败而逐渐变质或损坏。
变得有霉味；产生潮湿、陈旧的气味。

formal.mt: L-injam tnawwar wara li baqa' f'post niedi għal żmien twil.
formal.en: The wood rotted after being kept in a damp place for a long time.
formal.zh: 木材长期放在潮湿的地方后腐烂了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-ħobż tnawwar? Toni: Iva, ara l-moffa fuqu. Tiekolx minnu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has this bread gone mouldy? Toni: Yes, look at the mould on it. Don't eat any of it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这面包发霉了吗？托尼：对，你看上面的霉。别吃了。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 这面包发霉了吗？
messages.en: Has this bread gone mouldy?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara l-moffa fuqu. Tiekolx minnu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara l-moffa fuqu. Tiekolx minnu.
messages.zh: 对，你看上面的霉。别吃了。
messages.en: Yes, look at the mould on it. Don't eat any of it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“面包长霉、木头腐烂、旧物有霉味”三幅画面记 tnawwar，注意它表达变坏这一变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming mouldy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物品逐渐长霉、发生霉变的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa tiżviluppa l-moffa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发霉的过程；霉变。

formal.mt: L-esperiment isegwi t-tnawwir tal-ħobż f'ambjent niedi.
formal.en: The experiment tracks bread going mouldy in a damp environment.
formal.zh: 这项实验追踪面包在潮湿环境中的霉变过程。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'qed tosserva f'dan l-esperiment? Luqa: It-tnawwir tal-ħobż. Qed nieħu ritratt kuljum.
colloquial.en: Marija: What are you observing in this experiment? Luqa: Bread going mouldy. I'm taking a photo every day.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你在这个实验里观察什么？卢卡：面包的霉变过程。我每天都拍一张照片。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.zh: 你在这个实验里观察什么？
messages.en: What are you observing in this experiment?

messages.speaker: Luqa (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tnawwir tal-ħobż. Qed nieħu ritratt kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: It-tnawwir tal-ħobż. Qed nieħu ritratt kuljum.
messages.zh: 面包的霉变过程。我每天都拍一张照片。
messages.en: Bread going mouldy. I'm taking a photo every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tnawwir 想成记录面包每天长霉的相册，记住这是名词，指整个霉变过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 12,000, equal to twelve groups of one thousand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数词一万二千，即十二个一千。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 12,000, jiġifieri tnax-il darba elf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一万二千，数字写作 12,000。

formal.mt: Il-librerija għandha tnax-il elf ktieb fil-kollezzjoni tagħha.
formal.en: The library has twelve thousand books in its collection.
formal.zh: 这家图书馆藏有一万二千本书。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kemm tiswa din il-karozza? Mark: Tnax-il elf ewro. Il-prezz miktub fuq it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Anna: How much does this car cost? Mark: Twelve thousand euros. The price is written on the window.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这辆车多少钱？马克：一万二千欧元。价格写在车窗上。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 这辆车多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this car cost?

messages.speaker: Mark (销售员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tnax-il elf ewro. Il-prezz miktub fuq it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Tnax-il elf ewro. Il-prezz miktub fuq it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 一万二千欧元。价格写在车窗上。
messages.en: Twelve thousand euros. The price is written on the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 tnax-il elf 就先想“十二组一千”，再换成中文“一万二千”，避免误读成一千二百。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be trimmed or dressed into a suitable shape, especially by cutting stone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过削切或凿削而被修整成合适的形状，尤其用于石料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqata' jew jinħadem biex jieħu forma xierqa, speċjalment meta jkun ġebel.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be trimmed (used especially of stone)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被削整或凿整，尤其指石料被修整。

formal.mt: Il-ġebel tnaġġar skont il-qies meħtieġ qabel ma ntuża fil-bini tal-ħajt.
formal.en: The stone was dressed to the required size before it was used to build the wall.
formal.zh: 石料在用于砌墙之前，先被凿整到所需尺寸。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dan il-ġebel lest għall-ħajt? Pawlu: Iva, tnaġġar skont il-qies u issa joqgħod sew.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is this stone ready for the wall? Pawlu: Yes, it has been trimmed to size and now fits properly.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这些石料可以用来砌墙了吗？保罗：可以，已经按尺寸凿整好了，现在正好合适。

messages.speaker: Rita (建筑工人)
messages.zh: 这些石料可以用来砌墙了吗？
messages.en: Is this stone ready for the wall?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (石匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tnaġġar skont il-qies u issa joqgħod sew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tnaġġar skont il-qies u issa joqgħod sew.
messages.zh: 可以，已经按尺寸凿整好了，现在正好合适。
messages.en: Yes, it has been trimmed to size and now fits properly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象粗糙石块被凿去多余边角，最后刚好嵌进墙里；用这个修整过程记 tnaġġar。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or manner of speaking with a noticeably nasal voice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用明显带有鼻音的声音说话的行为或方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mod kif wieħed jitkellem minn imnieħru, b'vuċi li tinstema' nażali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 带着鼻音说话；用鼻声说话。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tat-teatru, l-istudent uża tnaħniħ esaġerat biex jagħti vuċi distinta lill-karattru.
formal.en: In the theatre exercise, the student used exaggerated nasal speech to give the character a distinctive voice.
formal.zh: 戏剧练习中，学生用夸张的鼻音说话，为角色塑造了独特的声音。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan it-tnaħniħ kollu? Qed tagħmel vuċi għal xi karattru? Ben: Iva, qed nipprova vuċi umoristika għad-dramm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why all this nasal talk? Are you doing a voice for a character? Ben: Yes, I'm trying out a funny voice for the play.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么一直捏着鼻音说话？是在模仿某个角色的声音吗？本：是的，我在为这出戏尝试一种滑稽的声音。

messages.speaker: Maja (排练伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan it-tnaħniħ kollu? Qed tagħmel vuċi għal xi karattru?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan it-tnaħniħ kollu? Qed tagħmel vuċi għal xi karattru?
messages.zh: 你怎么一直捏着鼻音说话？是在模仿某个角色的声音吗？
messages.en: Why all this nasal talk? Are you doing a voice for a character?

messages.speaker: Ben (学生演员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed nipprova vuċi umoristika għad-dramm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed nipprova vuċi umoristika għad-dramm.
messages.zh: 是的，我在为这出戏尝试一种滑稽的声音。
messages.en: Yes, I'm trying out a funny voice for the play.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用平常声音说一句话，再故意加入明显鼻音；把第二种说话方式作为名词 tnaħniħ 来记。

gloss_zh: 被剥光衣服；被脱至赤裸

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have all one's clothes removed and be left naked.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身上的衣服被全部脱去，处于赤裸状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitneħħewlu l-ħwejjeġ kollha u jitħalla għarwien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被剥光衣服；被脱去全部衣物而赤裸。

formal.mt: Ix-xhud stqarr li tnażża' għarwien kontra r-rieda tiegħu.
formal.en: The witness stated that he had been stripped naked against his will.
formal.zh: 证人陈述说，他曾在违背本人意愿的情况下被剥光衣服。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex il-priġunier tnażża' għarwien fl-istorja? Pietru: Il-gwardji ġegħluh ineħħi ħwejġu.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why was the prisoner stripped naked in the story? Pietru: The guards made him take off his clothes.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：故事里的囚犯为什么被剥光衣服？彼得：守卫强迫他脱掉衣服。

messages.speaker: Elena (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 故事里的囚犯为什么被剥光衣服？
messages.en: Why was the prisoner stripped naked in the story?

messages.speaker: Pietru (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 守卫强迫他脱掉衣服。
messages.en: The guards made him take off his clothes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tnażża' 与“衣服被全部脱去”的完整情境配对记忆，重点记住本义中的赤裸结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive inspiration or an idea from something seen, heard, read, or experienced.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从所见、所闻、阅读内容或经历中受到启发，获得想法或创作灵感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu ispirazzjoni jew idea minn xi ħaġa li jara, jisma', jaqra jew jesperjenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到启发；获得灵感或创作上的启迪。

formal.mt: Il-poeta tnebbaħ mill-pajsaġġ tal-gżira meta kiteb din il-poeżija.
formal.en: The poet was inspired by the island's landscape when he wrote this poem.
formal.zh: 诗人创作这首诗时，从岛上的景色获得了灵感。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn ġiet l-idea ta' din il-pittura? Daniel: L-artist tnebbaħ min-natura waqt mixja fil-kampanja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did the idea for this painting come from? Daniel: The artist was inspired by nature during a walk in the countryside.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这幅画的创意从哪里来？丹尼尔：画家在乡间散步时，从大自然获得了灵感。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn ġiet l-idea ta' din il-pittura?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn ġiet l-idea ta' din il-pittura?
messages.zh: 这幅画的创意从哪里来？
messages.en: Where did the idea for this painting come from?

messages.speaker: Daniel (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: L-artist tnebbaħ min-natura waqt mixja fil-kampanja.
messages.mt_standard: L-artist tnebbaħ min-natura waqt mixja fil-kampanja.
messages.zh: 画家在乡间散步时，从大自然获得了灵感。
messages.en: The artist was inspired by nature during a walk in the countryside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象画家散步看见风景，脑中忽然出现画面，用这个“灵感来了”的瞬间记住 tnebbaħ。

gloss_zh: 被迫花钱；因外因而支出

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made to spend money because of an external cause or circumstance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由于外部原因或某种情况而不得不花钱、产生支出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kellu jonfoq il-flus minħabba xi ħaġa jew xi ċirkustanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被促使或迫使花钱；因某种原因而不得不支出。

collocations.en: was made to spend money because of the repairs
was made to spend more than he had planned
collocations.zh: 不得不花费超过原定计划的钱

formal.mt: Minħabba l-ħsara mhux mistennija fil-karozza, is-sid tneffaq aktar milli kien ippjana.
formal.en: Because of the unexpected damage to the car, the owner was made to spend more than he had planned.
formal.zh: 由于汽车意外受损，车主不得不花费超过原定计划的钱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu reġa' tneffaq minħabba l-karozza? | Mark: Iva, kellu jħallas għal tiswija oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was Pawlu made to spend money on the car again? | Mark: Yes, he had to pay for another repair.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗又因为汽车的问题不得不花钱了吗？ | 马克：是啊，他又得付一次修理费。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗又因为汽车的问题不得不花钱了吗？
messages.en: Was Pawlu made to spend money on the car again?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kellu jħallas għal tiswija oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kellu jħallas għal tiswija oħra.
messages.zh: 是啊，他又得付一次修理费。
messages.en: Yes, he had to pay for another repair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象汽车突然坏了，钱包只好打开：重点记住外因导致花钱，而不只是主动购物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become swollen, or figuratively to become proud or vain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体部位变得肿胀；也可比喻人变得骄傲或自负。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sar minfuħ f'parti tal-ġisem, jew, b'mod figurattiv, sar kburi jew vanituż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 处于肿胀状态；肿起来。
变得骄傲、自负或爱慕虚荣。

collocations.en: became vain because of the praise
collocations.zh: 因受到赞扬而变得自负

formal.mt: Wara l-inċident, l-għaksa tal-plejer tneffħet u ma setax ikompli jilgħab.
formal.en: After the accident, the player's ankle became swollen and he could not continue playing.
formal.zh: 事故发生后，球员的脚踝肿了起来，无法继续比赛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn meta rebaħ il-premju, Mark tneffaħ bit-tifħir. | Pawlu: Veru, issa jaħseb li jaf kollox!
colloquial.en: Maja: Since winning the prize, Mark has become vain because of all the praise. | Pawlu: True, now he thinks he knows everything!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克得奖后，被大家夸得自负起来了。 | 保罗：可不是，现在他觉得自己什么都懂！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn meta rebaħ il-premju, Mark tneffaħ bit-tifħir.
messages.mt_standard: Minn meta rebaħ il-premju, Mark tneffaħ bit-tifħir.
messages.zh: 马克得奖后，被大家夸得自负起来了。
messages.en: Since winning the prize, Mark has become vain because of all the praise.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, issa jaħseb li jaf kollox!
messages.mt_standard: Veru, issa jaħseb li jaf kollox!
messages.zh: 可不是，现在他觉得自己什么都懂！
messages.en: True, now he thinks he knows everything!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个义项连成画面：脚踝肿起来，自我评价也能膨胀起来；用这个学习联想区分身体肿胀和心理自负。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or sound of moaning, especially from pain or discomfort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出呻吟的行为或声音，尤其指疼痛或不适时的呻吟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-ħoss ta' min jokrob, speċjalment minħabba wġigħ jew skumdità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呻吟；因疼痛、不适等而发出的低声哼吟。

formal.mt: L-infermiera semgħet tnegħija mill-kamra u daħlet biex tara jekk il-pazjent kellux bżonn l-għajnuna.
formal.en: The nurse heard moaning from the room and went in to see whether the patient needed help.
formal.zh: 护士听到房间里传来呻吟，便进去查看病人是否需要帮助。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt dik it-tnegħija mill-kamra? | Pawlu: Iva, se mmur nara jekk in-nannu għandux bżonn xi ħaġa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear that moaning from the room? | Pawlu: Yes, I'll go and see whether Grandpa needs anything.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听到房间里那阵呻吟了吗？ | 保罗：听到了，我去看看爷爷需不需要什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.zh: 你听到房间里那阵呻吟了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that moaning from the room?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se mmur nara jekk in-nannu għandux bżonn xi ħaġa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se mmur nara jekk in-nannu għandux bżonn xi ħaġa.
messages.zh: 听到了，我去看看爷爷需不需要什么。
messages.en: Yes, I'll go and see whether Grandpa needs anything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用听觉画面记忆：安静房间里传来因不舒服而发出的低低呻吟，把词义与声音联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pleasant words that are agreeable or pleasing to hear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让人听来愉快、舒心或觉得动听的话语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem sabiħ li jagħti gost lil min jisimgħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 悦耳、动听或令人愉快的话语。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra ta' ringrazzjament, it-tnegħim kien akkumpanjat minn eżempji konkreti tal-għajnuna li rċeviet il-familja.
formal.en: In the thank-you letter, the pleasant words were accompanied by concrete examples of the help the family had received.
formal.zh: 在感谢信中，动听的言语还配有具体事例，说明这家人曾得到哪些帮助。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm kien hemm tnegħim fil-messaġġ tiegħek! | Pawlu: Kont sinċier; vera apprezzajt l-għajnuna tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Maja: Your message had so many lovely words! | Pawlu: I meant them; I really appreciated your help.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的留言里有好多暖心的话！ | 保罗：我都是真心的，真的很感谢你的帮助。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm kien hemm tnegħim fil-messaġġ tiegħek!
messages.mt_standard: Kemm kien hemm tnegħim fil-messaġġ tiegħek!
messages.zh: 你的留言里有好多暖心的话！
messages.en: Your message had so many lovely words!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont sinċier; vera apprezzajt l-għajnuna tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Kont sinċier; vera apprezzajt l-għajnuna tiegħek.
messages.zh: 我都是真心的，真的很感谢你的帮助。
messages.en: I meant them; I really appreciated your help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象读到一张写满暖心话的感谢卡，心情随之变好；借这个场景记住令人愉快的话语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Light sleeping or the act of taking a short nap.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 浅浅地睡着、打瞌睡，或进行短时间的小睡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Irqad ħafif jew l-att li torqod għal ftit ħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打瞌睡；处于浅睡或半睡半醒的状态。
小睡；短时间睡一会儿。

collocations.en: a little dozing on the sofa

formal.mt: Fil-ġurnal tiegħu, l-istudent kiteb li ftit tnegħis wara l-ikel għenu jħossu aktar mistrieħ.
formal.en: In his diary, the student wrote that a short nap after lunch helped him feel more rested.
formal.zh: 这名学生在日记中写道，午饭后小睡片刻让他感觉休息得更充分。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tgħid għal ftit tnegħis qabel noħorġu? | Pawlu: Tajjeb, imma qajjimni wara għoxrin minuta.
colloquial.en: Maja: How about a little nap before we go out? | Pawlu: All right, but wake me after twenty minutes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：出门前先小睡一会儿怎么样？ | 保罗：好，不过二十分钟后叫醒我。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tgħid għal ftit tnegħis qabel noħorġu?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tgħid għal ftit tnegħis qabel noħorġu?
messages.zh: 出门前先小睡一会儿怎么样？
messages.en: How about a little nap before we go out?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, imma qajjimni wara għoxrin minuta.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, imma qajjimni wara għoxrin minuta.
messages.zh: 好，不过二十分钟后叫醒我。
messages.en: All right, but wake me after twenty minutes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象午饭后在沙发上眼皮渐沉，再设一个二十分钟闹钟：前者提示打瞌睡，后者提示短暂小睡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An innocent, straightforward manner, or a shy and embarrassed manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 天真、不加掩饰的率直态度；也指害羞或尴尬时显露的窘态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imġiba innoċenti u sinċiera, jew imġiba mistħija u mħawda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天真率直；没有心机、直露真情的特质。
羞怯、局促或因尴尬而显得不好意思的神态。

collocations.zh: 回答中流露的天真率直

formal.mt: It-tnegħiġ fit-tweġiba tat-tifel wera li kien qed jgħid dak li tassew kien jaħseb.
formal.en: The ingenuousness in the boy's answer showed that he was saying what he truly thought.
formal.zh: 男孩回答中流露的天真率直，表明他说的确实是自己的真实想法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt it-tnegħiġ ta' Mark meta ammetta l-iżball? | Pawlu: Iva, niżżel għajnejh u beda jitkellem bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you notice Mark's sheepishness when he admitted the mistake? | Pawlu: Yes, he lowered his eyes and began speaking quietly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你注意到马克承认错误时那副不好意思的样子了吗？ | 保罗：注意到了，他垂下眼睛，开始小声说话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt it-tnegħiġ ta' Mark meta ammetta l-iżball?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt it-tnegħiġ ta' Mark meta ammetta l-iżball?
messages.zh: 你注意到马克承认错误时那副不好意思的样子了吗？
messages.en: Did you notice Mark's sheepishness when he admitted the mistake?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, niżżel għajnejh u beda jitkellem bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, niżżel għajnejh u beda jitkellem bil-mod.
messages.zh: 注意到了，他垂下眼睛，开始小声说话。
messages.en: Yes, he lowered his eyes and began speaking quietly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排记两个课堂画面：孩子直说心里话是天真率直，承认错误后垂下眼睛是羞怯窘态。

gloss_zh: 呻吟；叹息；一声叹息；一声抽泣

teaching_sense.en_definition: Moaning or sighing, or an individual sigh or sob expressing pain or emotion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呻吟或叹息的行为，也可指表达痛苦或情绪的一声叹息或抽泣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tokrob jew titniehed, jew ħoss wieħed ta' tnehida jew bikja qasira li jesprimi wġigħ jew emozzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呻吟；发出表达疼痛或不适的声音。
叹息；因某种情绪而叹气的行为。
一声叹息；一次带有情绪的呼气声。
一声抽泣；哭泣时发出的一次哽咽声。

formal.mt: Meta waslet l-aħbar li kulħadd kien qawwi u sħiħ, instema' tnehid ta' serħan fost il-qraba.
formal.en: When the news arrived that everyone was safe and well, a sigh of relief was heard among the relatives.
formal.zh: 当所有人都平安无事的消息传来时，亲属们发出了如释重负的叹息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dan it-tnehid kollu? Ġralek xi ħaġa? | Pawlu: Le, għadni kemm spiċċajt ix-xogħol kollu. Fl-aħħar nista' nistrieħ!
colloquial.en: Maja: What's all this sighing? Has something happened to you? | Pawlu: No, I've just finished all the work. At last I can rest!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：怎么一直叹气呀？你出什么事了吗？ | 保罗：没有，我刚把所有工作做完，终于可以休息了！

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dan it-tnehid kollu? Ġralek xi ħaġa?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dan it-tnehid kollu? Ġralek xi ħaġa?
messages.zh: 怎么一直叹气呀？你出什么事了吗？
messages.en: What's all this sighing? Has something happened to you?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għadni kemm spiċċajt ix-xogħol kollu. Fl-aħħar nista' nistrieħ!
messages.mt_standard: Le, għadni kemm spiċċajt ix-xogħol kollu. Fl-aħħar nista' nistrieħ!
messages.zh: 没有，我刚把所有工作做完，终于可以休息了！
messages.en: No, I've just finished all the work. At last I can rest!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四格声音卡记忆：疼时呻吟、愁时叹气、放下心时一声长叹、哭时一声抽泣；再靠语境选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Frivolous activity or joking that is not treated as serious.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不被当作正经事情的嬉闹、无聊消遣或开玩笑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attività frivola jew ċajt li ma jkunx serju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻浮、无聊或不正经的消遣活动；瞎闹。
开玩笑；说笑；嬉闹。
衰退或逐渐变得虚弱的过程。

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, it-tnejjik fixkel id-diskussjoni u ħela l-ħin tal-parteċipanti.
formal.en: During the meeting, fooling around disrupted the discussion and wasted the participants' time.
formal.zh: 会议期间的嬉闹干扰了讨论，浪费了与会者的时间。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Ejja nagħmlu filmat ieħor tad-daħk! Maja: Biżżejjed tnejjik għal-lum; irridu nispiċċaw ix-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Mark: Let's make another funny video! Maja: Enough fooling around for today; we need to finish the work.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们再拍一个搞笑视频吧！玛雅：今天闹够了，我们得把工作做完。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 我们再拍一个搞笑视频吧！
messages.en: Let's make another funny video!

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Biżżejjed tnejjik għal-lum; irridu nispiċċaw ix-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Biżżejjed tnejjik għal-lum; irridu nispiċċaw ix-xogħol.
messages.zh: 今天闹够了，我们得把工作做完。
messages.en: Enough fooling around for today; we need to finish the work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“工作没做完，却一直拍搞笑视频”的画面记住嬉闹义；另把“逐渐衰弱”单独做一张义项卡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 92, one more than ninety-one and one less than ninety-three.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数九十二，即比九十一多一、比九十三少一的数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 92, wieħed aktar minn wieħed u disgħin u wieħed inqas minn tlieta u disgħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 九十二；92。

formal.mt: Il-librerija rċeviet tnejn u disgħin ktieb ġdid matul ix-xahar.
formal.en: The library received ninety-two new books during the month.
formal.zh: 图书馆本月收到了九十二本新书。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm għandu żmien in-nannu tiegħek? Mark: Għandu tnejn u disgħin sena u għadu jħobb jaqra kuljum.
colloquial.en: Maja: How old is your grandfather? Mark: He is ninety-two and still enjoys reading every day.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你爷爷多大了？马克：他九十二岁了，仍然喜欢每天读书。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爷爷多大了？
messages.en: How old is your grandfather?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu tnejn u disgħin sena u għadu jħobb jaqra kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu tnejn u disgħin sena u għadu jħobb jaqra kuljum.
messages.zh: 他九十二岁了，仍然喜欢每天读书。
messages.en: He is ninety-two and still enjoys reading every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“二和九十”来拆读：tnejn 是二，u 是和，disgħin 是九十；合起来就是九十二。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 42, one more than forty-one and one less than forty-three.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数四十二，即比四十一多一、比四十三少一的数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 42, wieħed aktar minn wieħed u erbgħin u wieħed inqas minn tlieta u erbgħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 四十二；42。

formal.mt: Il-vjaġġ mill-istazzjon sal-ajruport dam tnejn u erbgħin minuta.
formal.en: The journey from the station to the airport took forty-two minutes.
formal.zh: 从车站到机场的行程用了四十二分钟。

colloquial.mt: Maja: F'liema paġna qiegħed l-eżerċizzju? Mark: F'paġna tnejn u erbgħin, taħt l-istampa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What page is the exercise on? Mark: On page forty-two, below the picture.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：练习在第几页？马克：在第四十二页，图片下面。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 练习在第几页？
messages.en: What page is the exercise on?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: F'paġna tnejn u erbgħin, taħt l-istampa.
messages.mt_standard: F'paġna tnejn u erbgħin, taħt l-istampa.
messages.zh: 在第四十二页，图片下面。
messages.en: On page forty-two, below the picture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把四十二想成“二和四十”：先说 tnejn，再接 u erbgħin；用翻到第四十二页的动作巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 22, one more than twenty-one and one less than twenty-three.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数二十二，即比二十一多一、比二十三少一的数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 22, wieħed aktar minn wieħed u għoxrin u wieħed inqas minn tlieta u għoxrin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 二十二；22。

formal.mt: Tnejn u għoxrin student ħadu sehem fil-kors tal-lingwa.
formal.en: Twenty-two students took part in the language course.
formal.zh: 二十二名学生参加了这门语言课程。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm se tagħlaq sena għada? Maja: Se nagħlaq tnejn u għoxrin sena.
colloquial.en: Mark: How old will you be tomorrow? Maja: I'll turn twenty-two.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你明天满多少岁？玛雅：我明天满二十二岁。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明天满多少岁？
messages.en: How old will you be tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nagħlaq tnejn u għoxrin sena.
messages.mt_standard: Se nagħlaq tnejn u għoxrin sena.
messages.zh: 我明天满二十二岁。
messages.en: I'll turn twenty-two.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象二十二岁生日蛋糕上的两个数字二；读词时按“二和二十”，即 tnejn u għoxrin 来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 72, one more than seventy-one and one less than seventy-three.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数七十二，即比七十一多一、比七十三少一的数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 72, wieħed aktar minn wieħed u sebgħin u wieħed inqas minn tlieta u sebgħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 七十二；72。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti għandhom jibagħtu t-tweġibiet tagħhom fi żmien tnejn u sebgħin siegħa.
formal.en: Participants should send their answers within seventy-two hours.
formal.zh: 参加者应在七十二小时内提交答案。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm għandna siġġijiet għas-serata? Maja: Għandna tnejn u sebgħin siġġu; għaddejthom dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Mark: How many chairs do we have for the evening event? Maja: We have seventy-two chairs; I counted them this morning.
colloquial.zh: 马克：晚上的活动有多少把椅子？玛雅：有七十二把，我今天早上数过了。

messages.speaker: Mark (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 晚上的活动有多少把椅子？
messages.en: How many chairs do we have for the evening event?

messages.speaker: Maja (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna tnejn u sebgħin siġġu; għaddejthom dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna tnejn u sebgħin siġġu; għaddejthom dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 有七十二把，我今天早上数过了。
messages.en: We have seventy-two chairs; I counted them this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象七排十把椅子，旁边再放两把；读成“二和七十”，把 tnejn u sebgħin 与七十二对应起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 62, one more than sixty-one and one less than sixty-three.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数六十二，即比六十一多一、比六十三少一的数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 62, wieħed aktar minn wieħed u sittin u wieħed inqas minn tlieta u sittin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 六十二；62。

formal.mt: Skont il-lista tar-reġistrazzjoni, tnejn u sittin persuna attendew il-laqgħa.
formal.en: According to the registration list, sixty-two people attended the meeting.
formal.zh: 根据登记名单，共有六十二人参加了会议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Sa liema paġna rridu naqraw għal għada? Mark: Sa paġna tnejn u sittin, inkluż l-aħħar eżerċizzju.
colloquial.en: Maja: Up to which page do we need to read for tomorrow? Mark: Up to page sixty-two, including the last exercise.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：明天之前我们要读到第几页？马克：读到第六十二页，包括最后一道练习。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Sa liema paġna rridu naqraw għal għada?
messages.mt_standard: Sa liema paġna rridu naqraw għal għada?
messages.zh: 明天之前我们要读到第几页？
messages.en: Up to which page do we need to read for tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Sa paġna tnejn u sittin, inkluż l-aħħar eżerċizzju.
messages.mt_standard: Sa paġna tnejn u sittin, inkluż l-aħħar eżerċizzju.
messages.zh: 读到第六十二页，包括最后一道练习。
messages.en: Up to page sixty-two, including the last exercise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在第六十二页贴一张写着“二和六十”的便签；先读 tnejn，再接 u sittin，练习个位在前的顺序。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 82, coming after eighty-one and before eighty-three.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数词八十二，位于八十一之后、八十三之前。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 82, li jiġi wara wieħed u tmenin u qabel tlieta u tmenin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 八十二。

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jaqraw it-test f'paġna tnejn u tmenin qabel il-lezzjoni.
formal.en: Students should read the text on page eighty-two before the lesson.
formal.zh: 学生应在上课前阅读第八十二页的课文。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema paġna rridu naqraw? Mark: Paġna tnejn u tmenin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which page do we need to read? Mark: Page eighty-two.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们要读哪一页？马克：第八十二页。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 我们要读哪一页？
messages.en: Which page do we need to read?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 第八十二页。
messages.en: Page eighty-two.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和书上的页码82一起记：看到八十二，就练说 tnejn u tmenin。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 52, one more than fifty-one and one less than fifty-three.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数五十二，即比五十一多一、比五十三少一的数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 52, wieħed aktar minn wieħed u ħamsin u wieħed inqas minn tlieta u ħamsin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 五十二；52。

formal.mt: Il-pakkett fih tnejn u ħamsin karta, mingħajr il-jokers.
formal.en: The pack contains fifty-two cards, excluding the jokers.
formal.zh: 这副牌不计大小王，共有五十二张。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaddejthom il-karti kollha? Mark: Iva, hemm tnejn u ħamsin karta. Ma jonqos xejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you counted all the cards? Mark: Yes, there are fifty-two cards. None are missing.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你数完所有的牌了吗？马克：数完了，有五十二张，一张也没少。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你数完所有的牌了吗？
messages.en: Have you counted all the cards?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm tnejn u ħamsin karta. Ma jonqos xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm tnejn u ħamsin karta. Ma jonqos xejn.
messages.zh: 数完了，有五十二张，一张也没少。
messages.en: Yes, there are fifty-two cards. None are missing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用五十二张扑克牌作记忆画面；把读法拆成“二和五十”，对应 tnejn、u、ħamsin。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large tub used for washing clothes by hand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于手洗衣物的大盆或洗衣桶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent kbir li jintuża biex jinħaslu l-ħwejjeġ bl-idejn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 洗衣盆；供手洗衣物使用的大盆或桶。

formal.mt: Il-ħwejjeġ tħallew jixxarrbu fi tnell mimli ilma qabel inħaslu bl-idejn.
formal.en: The clothes were left to soak in a washtub full of water before being washed by hand.
formal.zh: 这些衣物先放在装满水的洗衣盆里浸泡，然后再用手洗。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn inpoġġi dawn il-ħwejjeġ biex jixxarrbu? Rita: Fit-tnell ħdejn il-vit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where should I put these clothes to soak? Rita: In the washtub beside the tap.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些衣服放在哪里浸泡？丽塔：放在水龙头旁边的洗衣盆里。

messages.speaker: Maja (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn inpoġġi dawn il-ħwejjeġ biex jixxarrbu?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn inpoġġi dawn il-ħwejjeġ biex jixxarrbu?
messages.zh: 这些衣服放在哪里浸泡？
messages.en: Where should I put these clothes to soak?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 放在水龙头旁边的洗衣盆里。
messages.en: In the washtub beside the tap.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象水龙头旁摆着一个泡满衣服的大盆，把这幅洗衣画面与 tnell 配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To spend time behaving frivolously or joking instead of taking something seriously.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以嬉闹、玩笑等轻浮方式消磨时间，没有认真对待眼前的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jgħaddi l-ħin jiċċajta jew jagħmel affarijiet bla serjetà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沉迷嬉闹；尽情做些不严肃的事情。
衰退；情况或状态变差。
受损；遭到损坏。

collocations.en: he fooled around during the lesson

formal.mt: L-istudent tnellaħ waqt il-lezzjoni u ma segwiex l-ispjegazzjoni tal-għalliem.
formal.en: The student fooled around during the lesson and did not follow the teacher's explanation.
formal.zh: 这名学生上课时嬉闹，没有认真听老师讲解。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark ma spiċċax ix-xogħol? Pawlu: Tnellaħ mal-ħbieb minflok ħadem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why didn't Mark finish the work? Pawlu: He fooled around with his friends instead of working.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么没完成工作？保罗：他只顾和朋友们嬉闹，没有干活。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 马克为什么没完成工作？
messages.en: Why didn't Mark finish the work?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 他只顾和朋友们嬉闹，没有干活。
messages.en: He fooled around with his friends instead of working.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“上课只顾嬉闹”的场景记住动作义；另把“衰退、受损”分栏记，避免把三个义项混成一个。

gloss_zh: 轻浮嬉闹；开玩笑；愚蠢行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: Frivolous behavior or joking that shows a lack of seriousness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现出不够认真态度的嬉闹、玩笑或轻浮行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imġiba bla serjetà, bħal ċajt jew għemil iblah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻浮；不严肃的嬉闹行为。
开玩笑；嬉闹。
愚蠢；傻气的言行。

formal.mt: It-tnelliħ waqt il-laqgħa fixkel id-diskussjoni u ħela l-ħin tal-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The joking around during the meeting disrupted the discussion and wasted the participants' time.
formal.zh: 会议中的嬉闹打断了讨论，也浪费了与会者的时间。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Biżżejjed tnelliħ; irridu nispiċċaw ix-xogħol. Mark: Sewwa, issa naħdem bis-serjetà.
colloquial.en: Rita: Enough fooling around; we need to finish the work. Mark: All right, I'll work seriously now.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：别再嬉闹了，我们得把工作做完。马克：好，我现在认真干活。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 别再嬉闹了，我们得把工作做完。
messages.en: Enough fooling around; we need to finish the work.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 好，我现在认真干活。
messages.en: All right, I'll work seriously now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 biżżejjed tnelliħ 当作“嬉闹够了”的整句提示，记住这里命名的是嬉闹这种行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become infested with ants.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某个地方出现大量蚂蚁，受到蚂蚁侵扰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li post jimtela bin-nemel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生蚂蚁；遭到大量蚂蚁侵扰。

collocations.en: the drawer became infested with ants
the cupboard became infested with ants

formal.mt: L-armarju tnemmel wara li tħalla ikel mikxuf fih għal diversi jiem.
formal.en: The cupboard became infested with ants after uncovered food was left inside it for several days.
formal.zh: 食物没有盖好，在柜子里放了几天，结果柜子里生了蚂蚁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tbattal il-kexxun? Mark: Tnemmel; irrid inneħħi l-ikel u nnaddfu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you emptying the drawer? Mark: It's become infested with ants; I need to remove the food and clean it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把抽屉里的东西都拿出来？马克：里面生蚂蚁了，我得把食物拿走，再清理一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把抽屉里的东西都拿出来？
messages.en: Why are you emptying the drawer?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tnemmel; irrid inneħħi l-ikel u nnaddfu.
messages.mt_standard: Tnemmel; irrid inneħħi l-ikel u nnaddfu.
messages.zh: 里面生蚂蚁了，我得把食物拿走，再清理一下。
messages.en: It's become infested with ants; I need to remove the food and clean it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开抽屉看见蚂蚁围着食物爬，把“地方生蚂蚁了”这个变化与 tnemmel 一起记。

gloss_zh: 被探听私事；被窥探；被监视

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have one's private affairs pried into or to be secretly watched by another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 自己的私事受到他人探听，或自己受到他人暗中窥探、监视。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ħaddieħor jistħarreġ il-ħajja privata ta' persuna jew josservaha bil-moħbi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被探听私事；受到他人窥探。
被暗中监视；受到秘密侦察。

collocations.en: he was pried upon by a nosy neighbor
collocations.zh: 他被一个爱打听的邻居窥探私事

formal.mt: Ir-raġel tnemmes minn persuna li kienet tosserva d-dar tiegħu u tistaqsi dwar il-ħajja privata tiegħu.
formal.en: The man was spied on by someone who watched his house and asked about his private life.
formal.zh: 有人观察这名男子的住所，并打听他的私生活，对他进行窥探。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt li Pawlu tnemmes minn ġar. Mark: Iva, dak il-ġar kien jistaqsi lil kulħadd dwar il-ħajja privata tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: I heard that Pawlu was pried upon by a neighbor. Mark: Yes, that neighbor kept asking everyone about his private life.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我听说有个邻居一直窥探保罗的私事。马克：是啊，那个邻居老是向大家打听他的私生活。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt li Pawlu tnemmes minn ġar.
messages.mt_standard: Smajt li Pawlu tnemmes minn ġar.
messages.zh: 我听说有个邻居一直窥探保罗的私事。
messages.en: I heard that Pawlu was pried upon by a neighbor.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak il-ġar kien jistaqsi lil kulħadd dwar il-ħajja privata tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak il-ġar kien jistaqsi lil kulħadd dwar il-ħajja privata tiegħu.
messages.zh: 是啊，那个邻居老是向大家打听他的私生活。
messages.en: Yes, that neighbor kept asking everyone about his private life.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“自己的隐私被别人探听”的视角记忆，特别记住词义中的“被”，避免误当成主动监视别人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop freckles on the skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 皮肤上长出雀斑，变得带有雀斑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fuq il-ġilda jibdew jidhru l-freckles.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长出雀斑；皮肤变得有雀斑。

collocations.zh: 他的鼻子上长出了雀斑

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt il-ġdid jidher li wiċċ it-tifel tnemmex, speċjalment madwar l-imnieħer.
formal.en: The new photograph shows that the boy's face has become freckled, especially around the nose.
formal.zh: 从新照片中可以看出，男孩脸上长出了雀斑，鼻子周围尤其明显。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Innutajt li wiċċ Mark tnemmex? Rita: Iva, għandu tikek żgħar fuq imnieħru wkoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you noticed that Mark's face has become freckled? Rita: Yes, he has little spots on his nose too.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你注意到马克脸上长雀斑了吗？丽塔：注意到了，他鼻子上也有小斑点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你注意到马克脸上长雀斑了吗？
messages.en: Have you noticed that Mark's face has become freckled?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandu tikek żgħar fuq imnieħru wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandu tikek żgħar fuq imnieħru wkoll.
messages.zh: 注意到了，他鼻子上也有小斑点。
messages.en: Yes, he has little spots on his nose too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象对比两张脸部照片，后一张鼻子周围多了雀斑，用前后变化记住“长出雀斑”的动词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A prickling or pins-and-needles sensation felt in a part of the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体某个部位出现的针刺般发麻感觉，即麻刺感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni ta' tingiż jew qisu labar żgħar f'parti tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 麻刺感；像细针轻刺一样的发麻感觉。
蚁患；某处受到大量蚂蚁侵扰的情况。

collocations.en: an infestation of ants in the cupboard

formal.mt: Il-pazjent iddeskriva tnemmil fis-swaba' ta' idu l-leminija.
formal.en: The patient described a tingling sensation in the fingers of his right hand.
formal.zh: 患者描述了右手手指的麻刺感。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi tnemmil f'saqajja wara li qgħadt bilqiegħda fit-tul. Mark: Qisni naf dik is-sensazzjoni; ġratli wkoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: My feet are tingling after sitting for a long time. Mark: I think I know that feeling; it's happened to me too.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：坐了很久以后，我双脚麻麻的。马克：我想我知道那种感觉，我也有过。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi tnemmil f'saqajja wara li qgħadt bilqiegħda fit-tul.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi tnemmil f'saqajja wara li qgħadt bilqiegħda fit-tul.
messages.zh: 坐了很久以后，我双脚麻麻的。
messages.en: My feet are tingling after sitting for a long time.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qisni naf dik is-sensazzjoni; ġratli wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Qisni naf dik is-sensazzjoni; ġratli wkoll.
messages.zh: 我想我知道那种感觉，我也有过。
messages.en: I think I know that feeling; it's happened to me too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分两幅画记忆：手指发麻对应身体感觉，柜子里蚂蚁成群对应蚁患；这是学习联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Intrusive curiosity about other people's private affairs, or an intrusive, sexually interested gaze.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对他人私事的冒昧窥探，或带有色情意味、令人不适的盯看。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Indħil kurjuż fil-ħajja privata ta' ħaddieħor, jew ħars insistenti lejn xi ħadd b'interess sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 窥探；冒昧打听他人的私事
色迷迷地盯看；带有色情意味地打量

formal.mt: Ir-regolament jipprojbixxi t-tnemmis fil-ħajja privata tal-impjegati.
formal.en: The regulations prohibit prying into employees' private lives.
formal.zh: 规章禁止窥探员工的私生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tistaqsi tant dwar il-ġirien? Mark: Għandek raġun, dan it-tnemmis żejjed. Aħjar inħallihom bi kwiethom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you asking so much about the neighbours? Mark: You're right, this is too much prying. I'd better leave them alone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么打听这么多邻居的事？马克：你说得对，这样窥探太过分了。我还是别打扰他们了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tistaqsi tant dwar il-ġirien?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tistaqsi tant dwar il-ġirien?
messages.zh: 你为什么打听这么多邻居的事？
messages.en: Why are you asking so much about the neighbours?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun, dan it-tnemmis żejjed. Aħjar inħallihom bi kwiethom.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun, dan it-tnemmis żejjed. Aħjar inħallihom bi kwiethom.
messages.zh: 你说得对，这样窥探太过分了。我还是别打扰他们了。
messages.en: You're right, this is too much prying. I'd better leave them alone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人既爱偷听私事，又爱盯人打量，用这两个越界场景记住“窥探”和“色迷迷地盯看”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The appearance or development of freckles on the skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 皮肤上雀斑的出现或形成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-formazzjoni jew id-dehra ta' nemex fuq il-ġilda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长出雀斑；雀斑的形成或出现

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni tal-wiċċ issemmi tnemmix ħafif fuq l-imnieħer u l-ħaddejn.
formal.en: The description of the face mentions slight freckling on the nose and cheeks.
formal.zh: 这段面部描写提到鼻子和脸颊上有轻微的雀斑分布。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fir-ritratt jidher it-tnemmix fuq wiċċi? Nina: Iva, speċjalment fuq imnieħrek. Ir-ritratt sabiħ ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you see the freckling on my face in the photo? Nina: Yes, especially on your nose. It's a lovely photo.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：照片里能看见我脸上的雀斑吗？妮娜：能，鼻子上尤其明显。这张照片很好看。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 照片里能看见我脸上的雀斑吗？
messages.en: Can you see the freckling on my face in the photo?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, speċjalment fuq imnieħrek. Ir-ritratt sabiħ ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, speċjalment fuq imnieħrek. Ir-ritratt sabiħ ħafna.
messages.zh: 能，鼻子上尤其明显。这张照片很好看。
messages.en: Yes, especially on your nose. It's a lovely photo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把脸颊上慢慢出现小雀斑的画面与这个词配对，记住它表示雀斑的出现或形成。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An unsteady flickering, especially the changing light or movement of a flame.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不稳定的闪动，尤其指火焰的光亮或形态忽明忽暗、摇曳变化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Teptip mhux regolari, speċjalment fid-dawl jew fil-moviment ta' fjamma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闪烁；尤指火焰的明灭摇曳

formal.mt: It-tnemnim tal-fjamma ħoloq dellijiet li bdew jiċċaqalqu fuq il-ħajt.
formal.en: The flickering of the flame created shadows that began to move across the wall.
formal.zh: 火焰的闪烁使墙上的影子开始晃动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tara t-tnemnim tax-xemgħa? Pawlu: Iva, hemm ftit riħ mit-tieqa. Nagħlaqha?
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you see the candle flickering? Pawlu: Yes, there's a little breeze coming through the window. Shall I close it?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看见烛火在闪动吗？保罗：看见了，窗户那边吹进来一点风。我把窗户关上好吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你看见烛火在闪动吗？
messages.en: Can you see the candle flickering?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm ftit riħ mit-tieqa. Nagħlaqha?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm ftit riħ mit-tieqa. Nagħlaqha?
messages.zh: 看见了，窗户那边吹进来一点风。我把窗户关上好吗？
messages.en: Yes, there's a little breeze coming through the window. Shall I close it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象窗边烛火一明一暗、墙上影子随之晃动，把整幅画面当作这个名词的记忆提示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become easily annoyed or impatient.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得容易恼火、不耐烦或烦躁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir irritat jew bla sabar u jibda jiddejjaq malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得烦躁；变得容易发脾气

collocations.en: became irritable because of the noise

formal.mt: Wara stennija twila, il-passiġġier tnerveż u talab aktar informazzjoni.
formal.en: After a long wait, the passenger became irritable and asked for more information.
formal.zh: 等了很久之后，这位乘客变得烦躁，要求提供更多信息。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex tnerveż Mark? Nina: Kien qed jipprova jaħdem, imma kien hemm ħafna storbju.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Mark get irritable? Nina: He was trying to work, but there was a lot of noise.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克为什么烦躁起来了？妮娜：他当时想工作，可是周围很吵。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 马克为什么烦躁起来了？
messages.en: Why did Mark get irritable?

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien qed jipprova jaħdem, imma kien hemm ħafna storbju.
messages.mt_standard: Kien qed jipprova jaħdem, imma kien hemm ħafna storbju.
messages.zh: 他当时想工作，可是周围很吵。
messages.en: He was trying to work, but there was a lot of noise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“排队越久，耐心越少，终于烦躁起来”的小故事，记住这个词强调情绪变得易怒。

gloss_zh: 被弄得忘记；因影响而疏忽

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made to forget something or to neglect it because of an influence or distraction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到某种影响或干扰而忘记某事，或因此疏忽应当关注的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mġiegħel jinsa xi ħaġa jew jittraskuraha minħabba influwenza jew distrazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弄得忘记；因某种影响而忘掉
被弄得疏忽；因某种影响而忽略

collocations.en: was made to forget what he wanted to say
collocations.zh: 被弄得忘了原本想说的话

collocations.en: was led to neglect his duties
collocations.zh: 受影响而疏忽了自己的职责

formal.mt: Minħabba d-distrazzjonijiet kontinwi, Mark tnessa dak li kellu jgħid fil-laqgħa.
formal.en: Because of the constant distractions, Mark was made to forget what he had to say at the meeting.
formal.zh: 由于不断受到干扰，马克忘了自己在会上要说的话。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark għaliex waqaf f'nofs is-sentenza? Lara: Bit-telefon idoqq il-ħin kollu, tnessa dak li ried jgħid.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark stop in the middle of his sentence? Lara: With the phone ringing all the time, he was made to forget what he wanted to say.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么说到一半停下来了？拉拉：电话一直响，弄得他忘了原本想说什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 马克为什么说到一半停下来了？
messages.en: Why did Mark stop in the middle of his sentence?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Bit-telefon idoqq il-ħin kollu, tnessa dak li ried jgħid.
messages.mt_standard: Bit-telefon idoqq il-ħin kollu, tnessa dak li ried jgħid.
messages.zh: 电话一直响，弄得他忘了原本想说什么。
messages.en: With the phone ringing all the time, he was made to forget what he wanted to say.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电话铃声打断发言，使人忘词；再联想到干扰使人疏忽职责，记住两个义项都有外在影响。

gloss_zh: 使人忘却；促成遗忘的作用

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or effect of causing someone to forget.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人忘记某事的行为或作用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew l-effett li jwassal lil xi ħadd biex jinsa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人忘却；引起遗忘的行为或作用

collocations.en: a means of making someone forget

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, il-mużika sservi bħala mezz ta' tnessija tal-inkwiet ta' kuljum.
formal.en: In the story, music serves as a means of making people forget their everyday worries.
formal.zh: 在这个故事里，音乐起着使人忘却日常烦恼的作用。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Għaliex tagħżel kummiedja wara ġurnata diffiċli? Maja: Għalija, id-daħk huwa mezz ta' tnessija tal-inkwiet, anki jekk għal ftit.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Why do you choose a comedy after a difficult day? Maja: For me, laughter is a way to forget my worries, even if only for a little while.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：辛苦了一天之后，你为什么会选喜剧看？玛雅：对我来说，笑一笑能让我忘掉烦恼，哪怕只是一会儿。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tagħżel kummiedja wara ġurnata diffiċli?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tagħżel kummiedja wara ġurnata diffiċli?
messages.zh: 辛苦了一天之后，你为什么会选喜剧看？
messages.en: Why do you choose a comedy after a difficult day?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalija, id-daħk huwa mezz ta' tnessija tal-inkwiet, anki jekk għal ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Għalija, id-daħk huwa mezz ta' tnessija tal-inkwiet, anki jekk għal ftit.
messages.zh: 对我来说，笑一笑能让我忘掉烦恼，哪怕只是一会儿。
messages.en: For me, laughter is a way to forget my worries, even if only for a little while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把喜剧带来笑声、笑声使烦恼暂时淡出的过程画成三格漫画，用来记住“使人忘却的作用”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To occur one after another, to alternate, or to be rotated, especially when crops are grown in succession.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个接一个地发生，交替出现，或按次序轮换，尤其指农作物轮作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iseħħ wieħed wara l-ieħor, jalterna, jew jinbidel ma' ieħor skont ordni, speċjalment fil-każ tal-uċuħ tar-raba'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 相继发生；接连出现
交替；轮流出现
轮换；尤指农作物轮作

collocations.en: wheat was rotated with broad beans

formal.mt: Skont il-pjan tal-biedja, il-qamħ tnewweb mal-ful fl-istess għalqa.
formal.en: According to the farming plan, wheat was rotated with broad beans in the same field.
formal.zh: 按照耕种计划，同一块田里的小麦与蚕豆进行了轮作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex din is-sena hemm il-ful f'dik l-għalqa? Pawlu: Il-qamħ tnewweb mal-ful, kif kien ippjanat.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are there broad beans in that field this year? Pawlu: The wheat was rotated with broad beans, as planned.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那块田今年为什么种了蚕豆？保罗：按照计划，原先的小麦换成了蚕豆，实行轮作。

messages.speaker: Lara (农场访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex din is-sena hemm il-ful f'dik l-għalqa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex din is-sena hemm il-ful f'dik l-għalqa?
messages.zh: 那块田今年为什么种了蚕豆？
messages.en: Why are there broad beans in that field this year?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qamħ tnewweb mal-ful, kif kien ippjanat.
messages.mt_standard: Il-qamħ tnewweb mal-ful, kif kien ippjanat.
messages.zh: 按照计划，原先的小麦换成了蚕豆，实行轮作。
messages.en: The wheat was rotated with broad beans, as planned.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先画接连出现的圆点，再画交替的两种颜色，最后画小麦与蚕豆轮作，依次记住三个义项。

gloss_zh: 被递交；被传递；被送达；被传达

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be handed over or passed on to someone, delivered to a recipient, or conveyed as information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被交到某人手中、被继续传递或送达，也可指信息被传达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħata jew jgħaddi għand xi ħadd, jitwassal lil min għandu jirċevih, jew jiġi kkomunikat bħala informazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被递交；被交到某人手中
被传递；被转交
被送达；被交付
被传达；被传送

collocations.en: the document was handed over to the client
the message was conveyed to the director

formal.mt: Id-dokument tnewwel lir-rappreżentant tal-kumpanija fi tmiem il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The document was handed over to the company's representative at the end of the meeting.
formal.zh: 会议结束时，文件被递交给了公司代表。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Id-dokument tnewwel lil Mark? Lara: Iva, issa qiegħed għandu. Se jaqrah wara l-ikla.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was the document passed on to Mark? Lara: Yes, he has it now. He'll read it after lunch.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：文件转交给马克了吗？拉拉：交了，现在在他手里。他午饭后会看。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 文件转交给马克了吗？
messages.en: Was the document passed on to Mark?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa qiegħed għandu. Se jaqrah wara l-ikla.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa qiegħed għandu. Se jaqrah wara l-ikla.
messages.zh: 交了，现在在他手里。他午饭后会看。
messages.en: Yes, he has it now. He'll read it after lunch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象文件从一只手传到另一只手，再把文件换成消息，串起“被递交、被转交、被送达、被传达”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rotation in a planned sequence, such as growing different crops on the same land in successive seasons.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按计划依次轮换，尤指在同一块土地上分季种植不同作物的轮作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bidla skont ordni ppjanat, bħal meta jitkabbru għelejjel differenti fl-istess għalqa minn staġun għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轮换；轮作，例如在同一块田地上依次种植不同作物。

formal.mt: Il-pjan tar-razzett jinkludi t-tnewwib tal-għelejjel biex l-istess wiċċ ma jitkabbarx fl-istess għalqa kull sena.
formal.en: The farm plan includes crop rotation so that the same crop is not grown in the same field every year.
formal.zh: 农场计划包括作物轮作，以免每年都在同一块田里种植同一种作物。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex se niżirgħu l-fażola hawn din is-sena? Pawlu: Minħabba t-tnewwib tal-għelejjel; is-sena l-oħra kellna l-qamħ.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why are we going to sow beans here this year? Pawlu: Because of crop rotation; last year we had wheat.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：为什么今年要在这里种豆子？保罗：因为要轮作；去年这里种的是小麦。

messages.speaker: Marija (农场学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex se niżirgħu l-fażola hawn din is-sena?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex se niżirgħu l-fażola hawn din is-sena?
messages.zh: 为什么今年要在这里种豆子？
messages.en: Why are we going to sow beans here this year?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tnewwib tal-għelejjel; is-sena l-oħra kellna l-qamħ.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tnewwib tal-għelejjel; is-sena l-oħra kellna l-qamħ.
messages.zh: 因为要轮作；去年这里种的是小麦。
messages.en: Because of crop rotation; last year we had wheat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一块田里的作物按季节轮流登场，把 tnewwib 和“今年豆子、明年小麦”的轮作画面联系起来。

gloss_zh: 编织；被移交、传递、送达或传达

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of weaving, or the process of something being handed over, passed on, delivered, or conveyed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指编织活动；也指某物被移交、转传、送达，或信息等被传达的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħidma li biha jsir drapp minn ħjut, jew il-proċess li fih xi ħaġa tingħata, tgħaddi għand ħaddieħor, titwassal jew tiġi kkomunikata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 编织；将线交织成织物的活动。
被交出；被移交给另一人或另一方。
被传递；被继续转交或转传。
被递送；被送达指定的人或地点。
被传达或输送；内容或事物被传送到另一方。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tnewwil tad-drapp bl-użu ta' ħjut ta' kuluri differenti.
formal.en: The report describes the weaving of cloth using threads of different colours.
formal.zh: 报告描述了使用不同颜色的线编织布料的过程。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tnewwil tad-dokumenti lil Mark? Pawlu: Jien; se nagħtihomlu wara l-laqgħa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who will handle the handing over of the documents to Mark? Pawlu: I will; I'll give them to him after the meeting.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：谁来负责把文件移交给马克？保罗：我来；开完会我就交给他。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tnewwil tad-dokumenti lil Mark?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tnewwil tad-dokumenti lil Mark?
messages.zh: 谁来负责把文件移交给马克？
messages.en: Who will handle the handing over of the documents to Mark?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 我来；开完会我就交给他。
messages.en: I will; I'll give them to him after the meeting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tnewwil 做两张情景卡：一张画线织成布，另一张画文件或信息传到别人手中；分开记忆编织义与传递义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The faint shining or flickering of a weak light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 微弱光线隐约发亮或轻轻闪烁的现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dija ħafifa jew it-teptip ta' dawl dgħajjef.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 微光闪烁；微弱而隐约的发光现象。

formal.mt: It-tnewwim tax-xemgħa kien jidher mit-tieqa tal-kamra mudlama.
formal.en: The glimmering of the candle could be seen through the window of the dark room.
formal.zh: 透过那间昏暗房间的窗户，可以看见烛光微微闪烁。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Qed tara t-tnewwim tad-dawl hemm bogħod? Pawlu: Iva, imma d-dawl tant hu dgħajjef li bilkemm jidher.
colloquial.en: Marija: Can you see the glimmering of the light in the distance? Pawlu: Yes, but the light is so weak that it's barely visible.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你看见远处那一点闪烁的微光了吗？保罗：看见了，不过光太弱，几乎看不清。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara t-tnewwim tad-dawl hemm bogħod?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara t-tnewwim tad-dawl hemm bogħod?
messages.zh: 你看见远处那一点闪烁的微光了吗？
messages.en: Can you see the glimmering of the light in the distance?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma d-dawl tant hu dgħajjef li bilkemm jidher.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma d-dawl tant hu dgħajjef li bilkemm jidher.
messages.zh: 看见了，不过光太弱，几乎看不清。
messages.en: Yes, but the light is so weak that it's barely visible.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tnewwim 放进夜晚远望的画面：远处只有一点微光忽隐忽现，记住它强调微弱的闪光现象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be removed from a place or position, or deleted from a text or record.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从某个地方或位置被移走、撤除，或从文字、记录中被删除。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġie mwarrab minn post jew pożizzjoni, jew ġie mħassar minn test jew rekord.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被移除、移走或撤除。
被删除；从文本、文件或记录中被去掉。

formal.mt: L-ostaklu tneħħa mit-triq sabiex il-vetturi setgħu jgħaddu mingħajr diffikultà.
formal.en: The obstacle was removed from the road so that vehicles could pass without difficulty.
formal.zh: 障碍物已从道路上移除，以便车辆顺利通行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex l-isem tiegħi tneħħa mil-lista? | Pawlu: Tneħħa bi żball. Se nżidu lura issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why was my name deleted from the list? | Pawlu: It was deleted by mistake. I'll add it back now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么我的名字被从名单上删掉了？ | 保罗：是不小心删掉的，我现在就加回去。

messages.speaker: Maja (活动参加者)
messages.zh: 为什么我的名字被从名单上删掉了？
messages.en: Why was my name deleted from the list?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Tneħħa bi żball. Se nżidu lura issa.
messages.mt_standard: Tneħħa bi żball. Se nżidu lura issa.
messages.zh: 是不小心删掉的，我现在就加回去。
messages.en: It was deleted by mistake. I'll add it back now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象道路上的障碍被搬走，名单上的名字被擦掉；两幅画面都强调某物被去除后的结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of taking something away or clearing it from a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某物从原处拿走、移除或清除的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li xi ħaġa tittieħed minn postha jew titneħħa minn fejn tkun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 移除；去除；清除。
派遣；发送。

formal.mt: It-tneħħija tal-iskart mill-bitħa għandha ssir qabel jibda x-xogħol.
formal.en: The removal of waste from the courtyard should take place before work begins.
formal.zh: 应在工作开始前清除院子里的垃圾。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tneħħija ta' dawn il-kaxxi? Mark: Jien. Se noħroġhom wara l-ikel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will take care of removing these boxes? Mark: I will. I'll take them out after lunch.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁来负责搬走这些箱子？马克：我来。午饭后我把它们搬出去。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tneħħija ta' dawn il-kaxxi?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tneħħija ta' dawn il-kaxxi?
messages.zh: 谁来负责搬走这些箱子？
messages.en: Who will take care of removing these boxes?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我来。午饭后我把它们搬出去。
messages.en: I will. I'll take them out after lunch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象清理院子时把垃圾一袋袋搬走，将 tneħħija 与“移除这个动作”一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 给某人脱衣；脱去某人的衣物

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of removing someone's clothes or helping someone take their clothes off.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脱去某人的衣物，或帮助某人脱衣的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jitneħħew il-ħwejjeġ minn fuq persuna jew li persuna tingħata għajnuna biex tneħħihom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给某人脱衣；脱去某人身上的衣物。

formal.mt: Waqt it-tneżżigħ tal-pazjent qabel l-eżami, l-infermier ħa ħsieb il-privatezza tiegħu.
formal.en: While undressing the patient before the examination, the nurse took care to protect his privacy.
formal.zh: 检查前给病人脱衣时，护士注意保护了病人的隐私。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Tista' tgħinni bit-tneżżigħ tat-tarbija qabel il-banju? Pawlu: Żgur, inneħħilha l-kalzetti waqt li inti tħejji l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Marija: Can you help me undress the baby before her bath? Pawlu: Of course, I'll take off her socks while you prepare the water.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：给宝宝洗澡前，你能帮我给她脱衣服吗？保罗：当然，你准备水，我来给她脱袜子。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tgħinni bit-tneżżigħ tat-tarbija qabel il-banju?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tgħinni bit-tneżżigħ tat-tarbija qabel il-banju?
messages.zh: 给宝宝洗澡前，你能帮我给她脱衣服吗？
messages.en: Can you help me undress the baby before her bath?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur, inneħħilha l-kalzetti waqt li inti tħejji l-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur, inneħħilha l-kalzetti waqt li inti tħejji l-ilma.
messages.zh: 当然，你准备水，我来给她脱袜子。
messages.en: Of course, I'll take off her socks while you prepare the water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给宝宝洗澡前逐件脱去衣物，把 tneżżigħ 记成“给某人脱衣”这项动作的名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be the target of teasing or joking remarks made by another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到别人的逗弄或取笑，成为玩笑话针对的对象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun il-mira ta' ċajt jew kummenti ta' tgħajjir minn persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被逗弄；被人拿来开玩笑或取笑。

collocations.zh: 因为自己的帽子而被取笑

formal.mt: It-tifel tnibbex minn sħabu minħabba l-kappell il-ġdid tiegħu, u l-għalliem talabhom jieqfu.
formal.en: The boy was teased by his classmates because of his new hat, and the teacher asked them to stop.
formal.zh: 男孩因为戴了新帽子而被同学取笑，老师要求他们停止。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex Mark ma jridx jilbes dak il-kappell? Pawlu: Ilbieraħ tnibbex minn sħabu minħabba fih, u ħassu ħażin.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why doesn't Mark want to wear that hat? Pawlu: Yesterday his friends teased him about it, and he felt upset.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：马克为什么不想戴那顶帽子？保罗：昨天朋友们因为那顶帽子取笑他，他很难过。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark ma jridx jilbes dak il-kappell?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark ma jridx jilbes dak il-kappell?
messages.zh: 马克为什么不想戴那顶帽子？
messages.en: Why doesn't Mark want to wear that hat?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ilbieraħ tnibbex minn sħabu minħabba fih, u ħassu ħażin.
messages.mt_standard: Ilbieraħ tnibbex minn sħabu minħabba fih, u ħassu ħażin.
messages.zh: 昨天朋友们因为那顶帽子取笑他，他很难过。
messages.en: Yesterday his friends teased him about it, and he felt upset.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tnibbex 的画面加一支指向人物的箭头：玩笑从别人那里传来，这个人是“被取笑”的一方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become moist or wet through contact with water or another liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因接触水或其他液体而被润湿或弄湿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir niedi jew imxarrab minħabba kuntatt mal-ilma jew ma' likwidu ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被润湿；被加上少量水分而变得潮润。
被弄湿；因水或其他液体而变湿。

collocations.en: was moistened with a little water
was made wet by the rain

formal.mt: Id-drapp tnidda bi ftit ilma qabel ma ntuża biex jitnaddaf il-wiċċ tal-mejda.
formal.en: The cloth was moistened with a little water before it was used to clean the tabletop.
formal.zh: 这块布先用少量水润湿，然后用于清洁桌面。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Id-drapp tnidda wisq? Pawlu: Le, fih biss ftit ilma; tajjeb biex timsaħ il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did the cloth get too wet? Pawlu: No, it only has a little water in it; it's good for wiping the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：布是不是弄得太湿了？保罗：没有，只沾了一点水，正好用来擦桌子。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 布是不是弄得太湿了？
messages.en: Did the cloth get too wet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, fih biss ftit ilma; tajjeb biex timsaħ il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Le, fih biss ftit ilma; tajjeb biex timsaħ il-mejda.
messages.zh: 没有，只沾了一点水，正好用来擦桌子。
messages.en: No, it only has a little water in it; it's good for wiping the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象干布接触水后变潮，把 tnidda 记成“被润湿、被弄湿”的变化；少量水和较多水分别帮助记住两个义项。

gloss_zh: 结露；逐渐覆上露水的过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process by which a surface becomes covered with dew.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面逐渐形成或覆上露水的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih wiċċ jinkesa bin-nida.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐结露、变得带有露水的过程。

collocations.en: the process of leaves becoming dewy
the process of grass becoming dewy

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw it-tniddija tal-weraq matul il-lejl u rreġistraw il-qtar li deher filgħodu.
formal.en: The students observed the leaves becoming dewy overnight and recorded the droplets that appeared in the morning.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了叶片在夜间结露的过程，并记录了清晨出现的水滴。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex il-ħaxix hu mxarrab jekk ma niżlitx xita? Pawlu: Minħabba t-tniddija; matul il-lejl inkesa bin-nida.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why is the grass wet if it hasn't rained? Pawlu: Because it became dewy; dew covered it during the night.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：没有下雨，草怎么湿了？保罗：因为结露了，夜里草上覆了一层露水。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-ħaxix hu mxarrab jekk ma niżlitx xita?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-ħaxix hu mxarrab jekk ma niżlitx xita?
messages.zh: 没有下雨，草怎么湿了？
messages.en: Why is the grass wet if it hasn't rained?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tniddija; matul il-lejl inkesa bin-nida.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tniddija; matul il-lejl inkesa bin-nida.
messages.zh: 因为结露了，夜里草上覆了一层露水。
messages.en: Because it became dewy; dew covered it during the night.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tniddija 配上一段夜间叶片慢慢出现露珠的小动画，记住它表示“结露的过程”；拼写时特别留意连续的两个 d。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The launch of an event or product, the publication of a work, or an announcement making information known.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 活动或产品的推出，作品的出版发布，或向他人宣布信息的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-preżentazzjoni ta' avveniment jew prodott lill-pubbliku, il-pubblikazzjoni ta' xogħol, jew it-tħabbir ta' informazzjoni.

sense_translations.en_definition: launch or an event or product
sense_translations.zh_definition: 活动或产品的推出、发布。
出版；作品或资料的公开发表。
宣布；将消息或信息公开告知。

collocations.en: the launch of a new product
the publication or launch of a book

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija ħabbret li t-tnidija tal-prodott il-ġdid se ssir f'Novembru.
formal.en: The company announced that the launch of the new product would take place in November.
formal.zh: 公司宣布，新产品将于十一月发布。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Meta se ssir it-tnidija tal-ktieb tiegħek? Pawlu: Nhar il-Ġimgħa fil-librerija; ejja jekk tista'.
colloquial.en: Marija: When is your book launch? Pawlu: On Friday at the library; come if you can.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你的新书发布会什么时候举行？保罗：星期五，在图书馆；有空就来吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta se ssir it-tnidija tal-ktieb tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Meta se ssir it-tnidija tal-ktieb tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你的新书发布会什么时候举行？
messages.en: When is your book launch?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (作者)
messages.mt_spoken: Nhar il-Ġimgħa fil-librerija; ejja jekk tista'.
messages.mt_standard: Nhar il-Ġimgħa fil-librerija; ejja jekk tista'.
messages.zh: 星期五，在图书馆；有空就来吧。
messages.en: On Friday at the library; come if you can.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象发布台上依次亮出产品、书本和公告，串起 tnidija 的推出、出版与宣布三义；它只有一个 d，可与表示结露的 tniddija 对照记忆。

gloss_zh: 被推出；被公布；被出版；被宣告

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be launched or formally made known to the public, as a project, publication, or announcement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指项目等被正式推出，或信息、出版物等被公开发布。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mniedi jew imħabbar pubblikament, bħal proġett, ktieb jew avviż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被推出；被启动。
被公开宣传；被广泛公布。
被出版；被刊行。
被正式宣布；被宣告。

formal.mt: Il-proġett tnieda uffiċjalment waqt konferenza fil-belt.
formal.en: The project was officially launched during a conference in the city.
formal.zh: 该项目在市内举行的一场会议上正式启动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-proġett il-ġdid tnieda diġà? Mark: Iva, tnieda lbieraħ, u llum nistgħu nirreġistraw.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has the new project been launched yet? Mark: Yes, it was launched yesterday, and we can register today.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那个新项目已经启动了吗？马克：对，昨天启动了，我们今天就能报名。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个新项目已经启动了吗？
messages.en: Has the new project been launched yet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tnieda lbieraħ, u llum nistgħu nirreġistraw.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tnieda lbieraħ, u llum nistgħu nirreġistraw.
messages.zh: 对，昨天启动了，我们今天就能报名。
messages.en: Yes, it was launched yesterday, and we can register today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象新项目在发布会上揭幕：从幕后进入公众视野，串联记住“被推出、被公布、被出版、被宣告”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To begin feeling sleepy and become less alert.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 开始感到困倦，精神不再清醒，有打瞌睡的感觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibda jħoss in-ngħas u jkun inqas attent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得昏昏欲睡；开始犯困。

formal.mt: Wara l-ikla ta' nofsinhar, l-istudent tniegħes u sabha diffiċli biex jikkonċentra.
formal.en: After lunch, the student became drowsy and found it difficult to concentrate.
formal.zh: 午饭后，这名学生开始犯困，觉得很难集中注意力。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex waqaf jaqra Pawlu? Lara: Tniegħes wara l-ikel. Se jistrieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Pawlu stop reading? Lara: He became drowsy after eating. He's going to rest for a while.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗为什么不读了？拉拉：他吃完饭犯困了，准备休息一会儿。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么不读了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu stop reading?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tniegħes wara l-ikel. Se jistrieħ ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Tniegħes wara l-ikel. Se jistrieħ ftit.
messages.zh: 他吃完饭犯困了，准备休息一会儿。
messages.en: He became drowsy after eating. He's going to rest for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象午饭后捧着书，眼皮慢慢往下掉：记的是“开始犯困”的变化过程，还不一定已经睡着。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become like a sheep in appearance or behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在外貌或行为上变得像绵羊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir jixbah lil nagħġa fid-dehra jew fl-imġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得像绵羊；呈现绵羊般的样子或行为。

formal.mt: Fil-ħrafa, ir-raġel tniegħeġ u beda jimxi mal-merħla.
