formal.en: In the fairy tale, the man became like a sheep and began walking with the flock.
formal.zh: 在童话里，那个男人变得像绵羊，开始跟着羊群走。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara lir-raġel fil-ħrafa? Pawlu: Tniegħeġ! Issa jimxi man-nagħaġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to the man in the fairy tale? Pawlu: He became like a sheep! Now he walks with the sheep.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：童话里的那个男人怎么了？保罗：他变得像绵羊了！现在他跟着羊一起走。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 童话里的那个男人怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the man in the fairy tale?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 他变得像绵羊了！现在他跟着羊一起走。
messages.en: He became like a sheep! Now he walks with the sheep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词义画成童话画面：人物逐渐显出绵羊的样子，再走进羊群；重点记住“变得像绵羊”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be pierced or penetrated by something passing into or through it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被某物刺入或穿过，形成刺穿、穿透的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mtaqqab jew minfud minn xi ħaġa li tidħol fih jew tgħaddi minn ġo fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被刺穿；被戳破。
被穿透；被穿入。

formal.mt: Waqt il-prova, il-kartun tniffed minn musmar u dehret toqba fuq in-naħa l-oħra.
formal.en: During the test, the cardboard was pierced by a nail, and a hole appeared on the other side.
formal.zh: 测试时，纸板被钉子刺穿，另一面出现了一个孔。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex hemm toqba fil-kartun? Nina: Tniffed minn musmar li kien fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why is there a hole in the cardboard? Nina: It was pierced by a nail that was on the table.
colloquial.zh: 马克：纸板上为什么有个孔？妮娜：它被桌上的一颗钉子刺穿了。

messages.speaker: Mark (手工课学生)
messages.zh: 纸板上为什么有个孔？
messages.en: Why is there a hole in the cardboard?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tniffed minn musmar li kien fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Tniffed minn musmar li kien fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 它被桌上的一颗钉子刺穿了。
messages.en: It was pierced by a nail that was on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“钉子穿过纸板”的画面记忆，注意主语是承受穿刺的纸板，对应“被刺穿、被穿透”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To puff up, or to make something flaky, especially pastry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 膨胀鼓起；或使食物，尤其是酥皮，形成易碎的薄层。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintefaħ, jew jagħmel xi ħaġa, speċjalment l-għaġina, tifforma saffi rqaq li jitfarrku faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 膨起；鼓胀起来。
使起酥；使形成容易剥落或碎裂的薄层。

collocations.zh: 马耳他酥皮馅饼膨起来了

formal.mt: Waqt il-ħami, il-pastizz tniffex u s-saffi tal-għaġina nfetħu.
formal.en: During baking, the pastizz puffed up and the pastry layers opened out.
formal.zh: 烘烤过程中，马耳他酥皮馅饼膨起，酥皮的层次随之展开。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara kemm tniffex il-pastizz! Toni: Iva, u s-saffi tal-għaġina jidhru ċari.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look how much the pastizz has puffed up! Toni: Yes, and you can clearly see the pastry layers.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看，这个酥皮馅饼膨得多高！托尼：是啊，酥皮的层次也看得很清楚。

messages.speaker: Maja (烘焙学员)
messages.zh: 看，这个酥皮馅饼膨得多高！
messages.en: Look how much the pastizz has puffed up!

messages.speaker: Toni (烘焙老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u s-saffi tal-għaġina jidhru ċari.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u s-saffi tal-għaġina jidhru ċari.
messages.zh: 是啊，酥皮的层次也看得很清楚。
messages.en: Yes, and you can clearly see the pastry layers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象烤箱里的酥皮先向上鼓起，再显出一层层薄酥皮，用这个画面分别记住“膨起”和“使起酥”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Breathing, or any small, barely noticeable movement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呼吸这一活动；也指任何幅度很小、不易察觉的动静。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-teħid u l-ħruġ tan-nifs, jew kull ċaqliq żgħir li bilkemm jinħass.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呼吸；吸气与呼气的活动。
任何轻微动作；一点点动静。

formal.mt: Fil-kamra kwieta, it-tniffis tat-tarbija kien jinstema' b'mod ċar.
formal.en: In the quiet room, the baby's breathing could be heard clearly.
formal.zh: 在安静的房间里，婴儿的呼吸声清晰可闻。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'qed tisma'? Lara: It-tniffis tat-tarbija. Hawn tant kwiet li nisma' kull nifs.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are you listening to? Lara: The baby's breathing. It's so quiet here that I can hear every breath.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你在听什么？拉拉：宝宝的呼吸。这里太安静了，每一次呼吸我都听得到。

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.zh: 你在听什么？
messages.en: What are you listening to?

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tniffis tat-tarbija. Hawn tant kwiet li nisma' kull nifs.
messages.mt_standard: It-tniffis tat-tarbija. Hawn tant kwiet li nisma' kull nifs.
messages.zh: 宝宝的呼吸。这里太安静了，每一次呼吸我都听得到。
messages.en: The baby's breathing. It's so quiet here that I can hear every breath.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象安静房间里胸口随呼吸微微起伏：用“呼吸带来的细小起伏”联系“呼吸”和“轻微动静”两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have the skin pierced by something sharp or to receive an insect sting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 皮肤被尖锐物刺到，或受到昆虫的蜇刺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li l-ġilda tittaqqab b'xi ħaġa bil-ponta jew li wieħed jirċievi tingiża minn insett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被针、刺等尖锐物刺到。
被蜂等动物蜇到。

formal.mt: Waqt li kien qed jaħdem fil-ġnien, il-ħaddiem tniggeż b'xewka f'sebgħu.
formal.en: While working in the garden, the worker was pricked in the finger by a thorn.
formal.zh: 那名工人在花园干活时，手指被一根刺扎到了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed jibki Pawlu? Nina: Tniggeż minn naħla waqt li kien fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is Pawlu crying? Nina: He was stung by a bee while he was in the garden.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Pawlu为什么在哭？Nina：他在花园里被蜜蜂蜇到了。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: Pawlu为什么在哭？
messages.en: Why is Pawlu crying?

messages.speaker: Nina (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Tniggeż minn naħla waqt li kien fil-ġnien.
messages.mt_standard: Tniggeż minn naħla waqt li kien fil-ġnien.
messages.zh: 他在花园里被蜜蜂蜇到了。
messages.en: He was stung by a bee while he was in the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指突然缩回的动作：针尖让人被刺，蜜蜂让人被蜇，两种情境都能帮助记住这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of stinging or pricking, or the sharp sensation caused by it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蜇刺或针刺的动作，也可指由此产生的尖锐刺痛感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni ta' tingiż jew ta' titqib b'xi ħaġa bil-ponta, jew is-sensazzjoni qawwija li tirriżulta minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜇刺；蜇刺造成的刺痛。
针刺；用尖锐物轻刺的动作或感觉。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipant iddeskriva sensazzjoni ta' tniggiż ħafif fil-ġilda.
formal.en: The participant described a mild stinging sensation in the skin.
formal.zh: 参与者描述了皮肤上轻微的刺痛感。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif tħossha idek issa? Toni: Għadni nħoss ftit tniggiż, imma inqas minn qabel.
colloquial.en: Lara: How does your hand feel now? Toni: I still feel a little stinging, but less than before.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你的手现在感觉怎么样？Toni：还有一点刺痛，不过比刚才轻了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的手现在感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How does your hand feel now?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni nħoss ftit tniggiż, imma inqas minn qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni nħoss ftit tniggiż, imma inqas minn qabel.
messages.zh: 还有一点刺痛，不过比刚才轻了。
messages.en: I still feel a little stinging, but less than before.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用词类对照来记：这个词把蜇刺或针刺当作一种动作或感觉来谈，想象皮肤上一点点的刺痛。

gloss_zh: 被引导或迫使绕过拐角

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be directed or made to move round a corner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被引导或迫使改变行进方向，绕过一个拐角。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jew xi ħaġa jitmexxa jew jiġi mġiegħel idur ma' kantuniera.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be made to go round a corner
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被引导或迫使绕过拐角。

collocations.en: was made to go round the corner
was made to turn right round a corner

formal.mt: Il-karrettun tnikkeb mal-kantuniera bl-għajnuna ta' żewġ ħaddiema.
formal.en: The cart was made to go round the corner with the help of two workers.
formal.zh: 在两名工人的协助下，手推车被引导绕过了拐角。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Il-karrettun għadda mill-kantuniera? Ġanni: Iva, tnikkeb bil-mod bl-għajnuna ta' żewġ ħaddiema.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did the cart get round the corner? Ġanni: Yes, it was slowly guided round with the help of two workers.
colloquial.zh: Marta：手推车绕过拐角了吗？Ġanni：绕过去了，两名工人帮着慢慢把它转了过去。

messages.speaker: Marta (仓库主管)
messages.zh: 手推车绕过拐角了吗？
messages.en: Did the cart get round the corner?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (仓库工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tnikkeb bil-mod bl-għajnuna ta' żewġ ħaddiema.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tnikkeb bil-mod bl-għajnuna ta' żewġ ħaddiema.
messages.zh: 绕过去了，两名工人帮着慢慢把它转了过去。
messages.en: Yes, it was slowly guided round with the help of two workers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个人推着手推车绕过墙角，重点记住车是受到外力引导才转过去的。

gloss_zh: 变得悲伤、忧郁；被点上点；被加上标点

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become sad or melancholy; in separate uses, to be marked with dots or punctuation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得悲伤或忧郁；另有被点上点、被加上标点的用法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed isir imdejjaq jew mimli swied il-qalb; f'użi oħra, li xi ħaġa tiġi mmarkata bit-tikek jew bis-sinjali tal-punteġġjatura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被点上点；被标上点状记号。
被加上标点符号。
变得悲伤；感到难过。
逐渐变得忧郁；心情渐渐低落。

formal.mt: Meta sar jaf li l-librerija kienet se tagħlaq, ir-resident tnikket ħafna.
formal.en: When he learned that the library was going to close, the resident became very sad.
formal.zh: 得知图书馆即将关闭时，那位居民非常难过。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex Mark ma ġiex magħna? Rita: Tnikket għax ħabibu telaq, u ried joqgħod ftit waħdu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why didn't Mark come with us? Rita: He became sad because his friend left, and he wanted to spend a little time alone.
colloquial.zh: Anna：Mark为什么没跟我们一起来？Rita：朋友离开了，他很难过，想自己待一会儿。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark为什么没跟我们一起来？
messages.en: Why didn't Mark come with us?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tnikket għax ħabibu telaq, u ried joqgħod ftit waħdu.
messages.mt_standard: Tnikket għax ħabibu telaq, u ried joqgħod ftit waħdu.
messages.zh: 朋友离开了，他很难过，想自己待一会儿。
messages.en: He became sad because his friend left, and he wanted to spend a little time alone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分开建立两组记忆画面：人物低头对应悲伤或忧郁，纸上添点对应点记号或加标点；读句子时按语境选择。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of changing direction, swerving, or taking a turn.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 改变行进方向、突然偏转或进行拐弯的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tinbidel id-direzzjoni tal-moviment, issir dawra jew issir lewża għal naħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 转向；改变方向的动作。
突然偏转；行进中猛然转向一侧。
拐弯；沿路线转入另一个方向。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tnikkib f'daqqa tal-vettura lejn ix-xellug.
formal.en: The report describes the vehicle's sudden swerve to the left.
formal.zh: 报告描述了车辆突然向左偏转的情况。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għaliex waqgħet il-kaxxa minn fuq is-sit? Mark: Minħabba t-tnikkib f'daqqa tal-karozza.
colloquial.en: Lina: Why did the box fall off the seat? Mark: Because of the car's sudden swerve.
colloquial.zh: Lina：箱子为什么从座位上掉下来了？Mark：因为车子突然转了方向。

messages.speaker: Lina (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex waqgħet il-kaxxa minn fuq is-sit?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex waqgħet il-kaxxa minn fuq is-sit?
messages.zh: 箱子为什么从座位上掉下来了？
messages.en: Why did the box fall off the seat?

messages.speaker: Mark (司机)
messages.zh: 因为车子突然转了方向。
messages.en: Because of the car's sudden swerve.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一条路线，再把箭头转向右边；这个名词指转向这件事，突然转向时还可表示偏转。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lack of promptness or effort, or the act of lingering or loitering instead of moving on.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 行动或做事不够积极及时的松懈状态，也指迟迟不走的逗留或闲荡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' ħeffa jew ħeġġa, jew il-fatt li wieħed idum f'post jew jiġġerra minflok ikompli fi triqtu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 松懈；做事懒散、不够积极及时。
逗留；迟迟不离开。
闲荡；没有明确目的地逗留或徘徊。

formal.mt: It-tnikkir fix-xogħol wassal biex il-kompitu ma tlestiex fil-ħin.
formal.en: Slackness at work meant that the task was not completed on time.
formal.zh: 工作上的松懈导致任务未能按时完成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex wasalt tard? Toni: Minħabba t-tnikkir tiegħi fit-triq; bqajt nitkellem ma' ħabib.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you arrive late? Toni: Because I lingered in the street; I stayed talking to a friend.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么迟到了？Toni：因为我在街上耽搁了，一直在跟朋友聊天。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么迟到了？
messages.en: Why did you arrive late?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tnikkir tiegħi fit-triq; bqajt nitkellem ma' ħabib.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tnikkir tiegħi fit-triq; bqajt nitkellem ma' ħabib.
messages.zh: 因为我在街上耽搁了，一直在跟朋友聊天。
messages.en: Because I lingered in the street; I stayed talking to a friend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象该出发的人还在街角聊天，该工作的人迟迟不动手；用这种拖拖拉拉的画面记住松懈和逗留。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling or state of grief, sorrow, or melancholy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 悲痛、忧伤或忧郁的感受与状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sentiment jew stat ta' niket, dwejjaq jew swied il-qalb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 悲痛；常指因失去重要的人或事物而产生的深切痛苦。
忧伤；内心的难过和哀伤。
忧郁；低沉而绵延的悲伤情绪。

formal.mt: Fl-aħħar tal-ittra, l-awtur jesprimi tnikkit profond minħabba t-telfa ta' ħabib antik.
formal.en: At the end of the letter, the author expresses deep grief over the loss of an old friend.
formal.zh: 在信的末尾，作者表达了失去一位老友的深切悲痛。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kif ħassejtek meta rajt id-dar vojta? Pawlu: Ħassejt sens ta' tnikkit; ftakart fil-ġranet li qattajna hemm.
colloquial.en: Rita: How did you feel when you saw the empty house? Pawlu: I felt a sense of melancholy; I remembered the days we spent there.
colloquial.zh: Rita：看到空荡荡的房子时，你是什么感受？Pawlu：我感到一阵忧伤，想起了我们在那里度过的日子。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħassejtek meta rajt id-dar vojta?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħassejtek meta rajt id-dar vojta?
messages.zh: 看到空荡荡的房子时，你是什么感受？
messages.en: How did you feel when you saw the empty house?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħassejt sens ta' tnikkit; ftakart fil-ġranet li qattajna hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Ħassejt sens ta' tnikkit; ftakart fil-ġranet li qattajna hemm.
messages.zh: 我感到一阵忧伤，想起了我们在那里度过的日子。
messages.en: I felt a sense of melancholy; I remembered the days we spent there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象看着空房子回忆旧日时光，把心中那份忧伤命名为这个名词；它表示情绪本身，可深可浅。

gloss_zh: 哼唧；带抱怨意味的呜咽声

teaching_sense.en_definition: A whining sound or manner of complaining, especially one that continues.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有抱怨或不满意味的哼唧声，也可指持续发出这种声音的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss ta' tgergir jew ilment li jista' jibqa' sejjer għal xi żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出抱怨式的哼唧或呜咽声；本词条按名词理解为这种声音或行为。

formal.mt: L-għalliema semgħet it-tnis tat-tifel u staqsietu bil-kalma x'kien qed idejqu.
formal.en: The teacher heard the boy's whining and calmly asked him what was bothering him.
formal.zh: 老师听见男孩哼哼唧唧，便平静地问他有什么烦心事。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'inhu dak it-tnis? Pawlu: It-tifel irid joħroġ jilgħab, imma għadha nieżla x-xita.
colloquial.en: Marija: What's that whining? Pawlu: The boy wants to go out and play, but it's still raining.
colloquial.zh: Marija：那是什么哼唧声？Pawlu：孩子想出去玩，可外面还在下雨。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 那是什么哼唧声？
messages.en: What's that whining?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tifel irid joħroġ jilgħab, imma għadha nieżla x-xita.
messages.mt_standard: It-tifel irid joħroġ jilgħab, imma għadha nieżla x-xita.
messages.zh: 孩子想出去玩，可外面还在下雨。
messages.en: The boy wants to go out and play, but it's still raining.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tnis 配上孩子想出去却遇雨的画面，记住那种带抱怨的哼唧声；本条按名词记忆。

gloss_zh: 被织成；被设计；被密谋策划

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be woven into fabric, or figuratively to be designed or secretly plotted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指织物被织成；也可比喻某个方案被设计，或某项阴谋被策划。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża għal drapp li jsir billi jingħaqdu l-ħjut, jew għal pjan li jitfassal jew komplott li jitħejja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被编织；由交织的线织成。
被设计；构想或方案被安排成形。
被密谋策划；通常指阴谋或秘密行动被筹划。

collocations.en: the fabric was woven by hand

formal.mt: Id-drapp espost fil-mużew tnisseġ bl-idejn, u l-viżitaturi jistgħu jaraw kif il-ħjut jingħaqdu flimkien.
formal.en: The fabric displayed in the museum was woven by hand, and visitors can see how the threads join together.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出的布料由手工织成，参观者可以看出线与线如何交织。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan id-drapp tnisseġ bl-idejn? Ġużeppi: Iva, u ħa ħafna ħin biex sar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Was this fabric woven by hand? Ġużeppi: Yes, and it took a long time to make.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这块布是手工织的吗？Ġużeppi：是的，做它花了很长时间。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这块布是手工织的吗？
messages.en: Was this fabric woven by hand?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (织工)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u ħa ħafna ħin biex sar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u ħa ħafna ħin biex sar.
messages.zh: 是的，做它花了很长时间。
messages.en: Yes, and it took a long time to make.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象线被织成布，再把方案和阴谋想成逐步织成的网；这是串联三个义项的学习画面，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of producing offspring through reproduction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过生殖产生后代的过程，可用于人的生育或动物的繁殖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih il-bnedmin jew l-annimali jipproduċu wlied jew frieħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生育；繁殖；产生后代的过程。

formal.mt: Il-lezzjoni tal-bijoloġija tispjega t-tnissil tal-annimali u kif jibda l-iżvilupp tal-frieħ.
formal.en: The biology lesson explains animal reproduction and how the development of offspring begins.
formal.zh: 这节生物课讲解动物繁殖，以及后代的发育如何开始。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fuq xiex kienet il-lezzjoni llum? Mark: Fuq it-tnissil tal-annimali. Sara: Allura tgħallimtu kif ikollhom il-frieħ?
colloquial.en: Sara: What was today's lesson about? Mark: Animal reproduction. Sara: So you learned how they have offspring?
colloquial.zh: Sara：今天的课讲什么？Mark：动物繁殖。Sara：所以你们学了动物怎样产生后代？

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 今天的课讲什么？
messages.en: What was today's lesson about?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 动物繁殖。
messages.en: Animal reproduction.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 所以你们学了动物怎样产生后代？
messages.en: So you learned how they have offspring?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象生物课上一对动物和它们的幼崽，把 tnissil 记成产生后代的过程，再用节育搭配巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity or process of interlacing threads to make fabric.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让线相互交织而制成布料的活动或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività jew il-proċess li bih il-ħjut jingħaqdu ma' xulxin biex isir id-drapp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 编织；将线交织成织物的过程或工艺。

formal.mt: Il-kors jintroduċi lill-istudenti għat-tnissiġ tad-drapp u għall-għażla tal-ħjut.
formal.en: The course introduces students to fabric weaving and the selection of threads.
formal.zh: 这门课程向学生介绍布料织造和线材的选择。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Qed nitgħallem it-tnissiġ bl-idejn. Rita: Kemm hu sabiħ! X'qed tagħmel bil-ħjut? Nina: Biċċa drapp żgħira biex nitħarreġ.
colloquial.en: Nina: I'm learning to weave by hand. Rita: How lovely! What are you making with the threads? Nina: A small piece of fabric for practice.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我在学手工编织。Rita：真好！你在用这些线做什么？Nina：织一小块布练习。

messages.speaker: Nina (编织课学员)
messages.zh: 我在学手工编织。
messages.en: I'm learning to weave by hand.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu sabiħ! X'qed tagħmel bil-ħjut?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu sabiħ! X'qed tagħmel bil-ħjut?
messages.zh: 真好！你在用这些线做什么？
messages.en: How lovely! What are you making with the threads?

messages.speaker: Nina (编织课学员)
messages.zh: 织一小块布练习。
messages.en: A small piece of fabric for practice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tnissiġ 写在线材和织布机的图片旁，记为编织这项活动；再与表示被织成的 tnisseġ 对照。

gloss_zh: 被拔毛；被剪毛；被掏空钱袋

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have feathers, hair, or wool removed, or figuratively to be relieved of one's money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 羽毛、毛发或羊毛被拔除或剪去；也可比喻钱被拿走或花掉，以致钱袋被掏空。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża meta jitneħħa r-rix, ix-xagħar jew is-suf, jew b'mod figurattiv meta persuna tispiċċa mingħajr flus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被拔毛；羽毛或毛发被拔除。
被剪毛；身上的毛或羊毛被剪去。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be relieved of one's cash
sense_translations.zh_definition: 钱被拿走或耗光；比喻被掏空钱袋。

collocations.en: he was cleaned out at the casino

formal.mt: Is-serduk tnittef qabel ma tħejja għat-tisjir.
formal.en: The rooster was plucked before being prepared for cooking.
formal.zh: 这只公鸡在烹调准备之前先被拔了毛。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Għaliex Ġanni ma ġiex magħna? Marija: Tnittef fil-każinò lbieraħ u llum m'għandux flus biex joħroġ.
colloquial.en: Toni: Why didn't Ġanni come with us? Marija: He was cleaned out at the casino yesterday, and today he has no money to go out.
colloquial.zh: Toni：Ġanni 怎么没跟我们来？Marija：他昨天在赌场把钱输光了，今天没钱出来玩。

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: Ġanni 怎么没跟我们来？
messages.en: Why didn't Ġanni come with us?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tnittef fil-każinò lbieraħ u llum m'għandux flus biex joħroġ.
messages.mt_standard: Tnittef fil-każinò lbieraħ u llum m'għandux flus biex joħroġ.
messages.zh: 他昨天在赌场把钱输光了，今天没钱出来玩。
messages.en: He was cleaned out at the casino yesterday, and today he has no money to go out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅画记 tnittef：鸡被拔毛、羊被剪毛、钱包被掏空；把第三幅当作金钱义的比喻提示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become soiled or to begin giving off an unpleasant smell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得污脏，或开始散发难闻的气味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża meta xi ħaġa titħammeġ jew tibda toħroġ riħa ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弄脏；受到污物沾染。
开始发臭；开始散发难闻的气味。

collocations.en: the shirt became soiled with dirt
the food started to smell bad in the heat
collocations.zh: 食物在高温下开始发臭

formal.mt: L-ikel li tħalla barra mill-friġġ tnitten u kellu jintrema.
formal.en: The food left out of the refrigerator began to smell bad and had to be thrown away.
formal.zh: 放在冰箱外的食物开始发臭，只好丢掉。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Minn fejn ġejja din ir-riħa? Pawlu: L-ikel fil-borża tnitten. Se narmih issa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is this smell coming from? Pawlu: The food in the bag has started to smell bad. I'll throw it away now.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这股气味从哪儿来的？Pawlu：袋子里的食物发臭了。我现在就把它扔掉。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 这股气味从哪儿来的？
messages.en: Where is this smell coming from?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ikel fil-borża tnitten. Se narmih issa.
messages.mt_standard: L-ikel fil-borża tnitten. Se narmih issa.
messages.zh: 袋子里的食物发臭了。我现在就把它扔掉。
messages.en: The food in the bag has started to smell bad. I'll throw it away now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tnitten 配上脏衬衫和发臭食物两张图，分别记住变脏与开始发臭；注意它表示状态发生变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of pulling out feathers or hairs, including facial hair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将羽毛或毛发拔除的动作或过程，包括拔除面部毛发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li jitneħħa r-rix jew ix-xagħar billi jinġibed 'il barra, inkluż ix-xagħar tal-wiċċ.

sense_translations.en_definition: plucking (e.g. of feathers, facial hair etc.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拔除羽毛或毛发的行为，例如拔禽类羽毛、面部毛发等。

formal.mt: Id-dimostrazzjoni turi t-tnittif tar-rix bħala parti mit-tħejjija tat-tiġieġ għat-tisjir.
formal.en: The demonstration shows feather plucking as part of preparing chickens for cooking.
formal.zh: 这次示范展示了拔除羽毛这一鸡肉烹调准备步骤。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għal xiex għandek bżonn il-pinzetta? Nina: Għat-tnittif ta' ftit xagħar tal-wiċċ.
colloquial.en: Rita: What do you need the tweezers for? Nina: To pluck a few facial hairs.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你要镊子做什么？Nina：拔几根脸上的毛。

messages.speaker: Rita (姐妹)
messages.zh: 你要镊子做什么？
messages.en: What do you need the tweezers for?

messages.speaker: Nina (姐妹)
messages.zh: 拔几根脸上的毛。
messages.en: To pluck a few facial hairs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象镊子夹住一根毛并拔出来，把 tnittif 记作拔毛这一动作的名称，再联系羽毛和面部毛发两个场景。

gloss_zh: 弄脏；污损；散发臭味；沉溺淫欲

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of soiling or dirtying something, giving off a bad smell, or indulging in lechery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指弄脏、污损或散发臭味的行为或过程；另可指沉溺淫欲的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li xi ħaġa titħammeġ jew toħroġ riħa ħażina; jista' jirreferi wkoll għal imġiba ta' żina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 污损；使物品沾上污物的行为或过程。
弄脏；使某物变脏的行为或过程。
散发臭味；释放难闻气味的过程或现象。
沉溺淫欲；放纵色欲的行为，带贬义。

collocations.en: the soiling of clothes with mud
the giving off of a bad smell by waste

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tnittin tal-iskart u l-effett tar-riħa fuq ir-residenti.
formal.en: The report describes the bad smell given off by the waste and its effect on residents.
formal.zh: 报告描述了垃圾散发臭味的情况，以及气味对居民的影响。

colloquial.mt: Mark: It-tnittin tal-iskart qed idejjaqni. Sara: Lili wkoll. Ejja noħorġu l-borża u naħslu l-barmil.
colloquial.en: Mark: The smell coming from the waste is bothering me. Sara: Me too. Let's take the bag out and wash the bin.
colloquial.zh: Mark：垃圾散发的臭味让我很难受。Sara：我也是。我们把袋子拿出去，再洗一下垃圾桶吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 垃圾散发的臭味让我很难受。
messages.en: The smell coming from the waste is bothering me.

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lili wkoll. Ejja noħorġu l-borża u naħslu l-barmil.
messages.mt_standard: Lili wkoll. Ejja noħorġu l-borża u naħslu l-barmil.
messages.zh: 我也是。我们把袋子拿出去，再洗一下垃圾桶吧。
messages.en: Me too. Let's take the bag out and wash the bin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tnittin 做四格记忆卡：污损、弄脏、散臭、沉溺淫欲；前两格意思接近，最后一格单独标注贬义，避免混用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To come out slowly as a liquid, to be secreted, or to be disclosed through a leak.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指液体缓慢渗出、物质被分泌，或信息被泄露。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ bil-mod bħala likwidu, jiġi prodott bħala tnixxija, jew jinkixef permezz ta' żvelar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被缓慢渗出；以少量液体的形式渗出。
被分泌出来。
被泄漏；信息被泄露。

collocations.en: liquid that oozed from the wound
a report that was leaked to the press
collocations.zh: 被泄露给新闻界的报告

formal.mt: Ir-rapport intern tnixxa lill-istampa qabel il-laqgħa uffiċjali.
formal.en: The internal report was leaked to the press before the official meeting.
formal.zh: 内部报告在正式会议之前被泄露给了新闻界。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm l-ilma taħt il-flixkun? Mark: Ftit ilma tnixxa minn taħt it-tapp.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is there water under the bottle? Mark: A little water leaked out from under the cap.
colloquial.zh: Maja：瓶子下面怎么有水？Mark：有一点水从瓶盖下面漏出来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 瓶子下面怎么有水？
messages.en: Why is there water under the bottle?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit ilma tnixxa minn taħt it-tapp.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit ilma tnixxa minn taħt it-tapp.
messages.zh: 有一点水从瓶盖下面漏出来了。
messages.en: A little water leaked out from under the cap.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把液体渗出来和消息漏出去画成两幅图，帮助联记这个词的实体义与信息义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become dry after moisture is removed, or to wither as moisture is lost.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指水分被除去后变干，或因失去水分而枯萎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir niexef wara li titneħħa l-umdità, jew jidbiel minħabba nuqqas ta' ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弄干；被晾干或烘干。
枯萎；变得干枯。

collocations.en: fabric that was dried in the sun
grass that withered because of drought

formal.mt: Id-drapp tnixxef kompletament qabel ma tqiegħed fil-kaxxa.
formal.en: The fabric was dried completely before it was placed in the box.
formal.zh: 布料完全干燥后才被放进箱子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' nuża x-xugaman? Pawlu: Iva, tnixxef sew fix-xemx.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I use the towel? Pawlu: Yes, it dried thoroughly in the sun.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我可以用这条毛巾吗？Pawlu：可以，已经在太阳下晒透了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 我可以用这条毛巾吗？
messages.en: Can I use the towel?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 可以，已经在太阳下晒透了。
messages.en: Yes, it dried thoroughly in the sun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象湿毛巾晒干，再想象青草失水枯萎，用水分减少这一画面联记两个义项。

gloss_zh: 干涸；干燥；脱水；水分流失

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of drying up or becoming dry through the removal or loss of water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 水分被除去或流失而造成的干燥、干涸或脱水过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa tinxef minħabba t-tneħħija jew it-telf tal-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 干涸；逐渐变干的过程。
干燥；水分被大量除去的过程或状态。
水分流失；失水。

formal.mt: L-istudju jkejjel it-telf tal-ilma waqt it-tnixxif tal-ħamrija.
formal.en: The study measures water loss during the drying of the soil.
formal.zh: 该研究测量土壤干燥过程中的水分流失。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed iddendel il-ħwejjeġ barra? Samwel: Hemm ir-riħ, u t-tnixxif ikun aktar mgħaġġel.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are you hanging the clothes outside? Samwel: It's windy, so the drying will be quicker.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你为什么把衣服晾到外面？Samwel：外面有风，衣服会干得更快。

messages.speaker: Nina (家人)
messages.zh: 你为什么把衣服晾到外面？
messages.en: Why are you hanging the clothes outside?

messages.speaker: Samwel (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm ir-riħ, u t-tnixxif ikun aktar mgħaġġel.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm ir-riħ, u t-tnixxif ikun aktar mgħaġġel.
messages.zh: 外面有风，衣服会干得更快。
messages.en: It's windy, so the drying will be quicker.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词记成水分离开的整个过程：衣服变干、土壤干涸，都能放进同一幅记忆图。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The slow escape or emergence of liquid in small amounts through an opening or surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 液体以少量、缓慢的方式从孔隙或表面渗出的现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħruġ bil-mod ta' likwidu fi kwantitajiet żgħar minn fetħa jew minn wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 渗出；液体缓慢、少量地流出的现象。

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni ġiet osservata tnixxija bil-mod ta' ilma minn xquq fil-ħajt.
formal.en: During the inspection, slow oozing of water from cracks in the wall was observed.
formal.zh: 检查时发现水正从墙体裂缝中缓慢渗出。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex hemm roqgħa mxarrba mal-ħajt? Toni: Hemm tnixxija żgħira ta' ilma minn din ix-xaqq.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why is there a wet patch on the wall? Toni: A little water is oozing from this crack.
colloquial.zh: Rita：墙上怎么有一块湿斑？Toni：这条裂缝里正渗出一点水。

messages.speaker: Rita (住户)
messages.zh: 墙上怎么有一块湿斑？
messages.en: Why is there a wet patch on the wall?

messages.speaker: Toni (维修工)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm tnixxija żgħira ta' ilma minn din ix-xaqq.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm tnixxija żgħira ta' ilma minn din ix-xaqq.
messages.zh: 这条裂缝里正渗出一点水。
messages.en: A little water is oozing from this crack.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象墙缝慢慢冒出小水珠，把这个名词与少量、缓慢、渗出的画面一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become covered with Bermuda grass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指一片地方逐渐长满狗牙根草，即百慕大草。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinkesa bil-ħaxix tal-Bermuda.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be covered with bermuda grass
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被狗牙根草覆盖；长满百慕大草。

collocations.en: the garden became covered with Bermuda grass
became completely covered with Bermuda grass

formal.mt: Maż-żmien, il-ġnien tniġġem u l-art inkesiet bil-ħaxix tal-Bermuda.
formal.en: Over time, the garden became covered with Bermuda grass, which spread across the ground.
formal.zh: 随着时间推移，花园长满了狗牙根草，地面被这种草覆盖。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'ġara mill-ġnien? Nina: Tniġġem kollu. Issa l-art kollha miksija bil-ħaxix tal-Bermuda.
colloquial.en: Mark: What happened to the garden? Nina: It became completely covered with Bermuda grass. Now the whole ground is covered with it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：花园怎么了？妮娜：全长满狗牙根草了。现在整个地面都被这种草覆盖了。

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.zh: 花园怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the garden?

messages.speaker: Nina (园主)
messages.mt_spoken: Tniġġem kollu. Issa l-art kollha miksija bil-ħaxix tal-Bermuda.
messages.mt_standard: Tniġġem kollu. Issa l-art kollha miksija bil-ħaxix tal-Bermuda.
messages.zh: 全长满狗牙根草了。现在整个地面都被这种草覆盖了。
messages.en: It became completely covered with Bermuda grass. Now the whole ground is covered with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象花园地面铺满一张狗牙根草织成的绿毯；这个词要连同具体草种记忆，不能只记成一般的“长草”。

gloss_zh: 被污染；被弄脏；受到沾染

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become polluted, dirty, or contaminated by an unwanted substance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因不需要的物质进入或附着而变脏、受污染或受到沾染。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir maħmuġ jew kontaminat minħabba sustanzi mhux mixtieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被污染，常用于水、空气或环境。
被弄脏；沾上污物。
受到污染或沾染，混入不洁或不需要的物质。

collocations.en: the shirt got dirty with mud

formal.mt: L-ilma tax-xmara tniġġes wara li daħal fih skart mill-fabbrika.
formal.en: The river water became polluted after waste from the factory entered it.
formal.zh: 工厂废物进入河流后，河水受到了污染。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex se tbiddel il-flokk? Pawlu: Tniġġes bit-tajn meta kont fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you going to change your shirt? Pawlu: It got dirty with mud while I was in the garden.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么要换上衣？保罗：我在花园里的时候，上衣被泥弄脏了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么要换上衣？
messages.en: Why are you going to change your shirt?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我在花园里的时候，上衣被泥弄脏了。
messages.en: It got dirty with mud while I was in the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把清水混入污物、白衣沾上泥点并排想象：共同变化都是“变得不洁”，分别对应受污染和被弄脏。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or result of making air, water, a place, or a substance dirty or contaminated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使空气、水、场所或物质变脏、受到污染的过程或结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew ir-riżultat li bih l-arja, l-ilma, post jew sustanza jsiru maħmuġin jew ikkontaminati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 污染，尤指空气、水或环境受到有害物质影响。
污损；玷污，使原本洁净的事物变得不洁。
弄脏；污物积聚而造成的脏污。
沾污；有害物质或杂质混入造成的污染。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-effetti tat-tniġġis tal-arja fuq il-kwalità tal-ħajja fil-belt.
formal.en: The report describes the effects of air pollution on the quality of life in the city.
formal.zh: 报告描述了空气污染对城市生活质量的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma nistgħux ngħumu hawn? Mark: Minħabba t-tniġġis tal-ilma. Aħjar immorru bajja oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why can't we swim here? Mark: Because of the water pollution. We'd better go to another beach.
colloquial.zh: Maja：为什么我们不能在这里游泳？Mark：因为水污染。我们最好去另一个海滩。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 为什么我们不能在这里游泳？
messages.en: Why can't we swim here?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tniġġis tal-ilma. Aħjar immorru bajja oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tniġġis tal-ilma. Aħjar immorru bajja oħra.
messages.zh: 因为水污染。我们最好去另一个海滩。
messages.en: Because of the water pollution. We'd better go to another beach.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词放进两幅画面记忆：灰色空气和脏污海水，分别对应空气污染与水污染。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be entered in a register or written down as a record.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指姓名、信息或内容被登记在册，或被书写记录下来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi miktub f'reġistru jew jitqiegħed bil-miktub bħala rekord.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被登记；被录入名册或登记簿。
被写下；被以文字记录。

collocations.en: a name that was entered in the register
a comment that was written in the notes

formal.mt: L-isem tal-parteċipant tniżżel fir-reġistru qabel il-bidu tas-sessjoni.
formal.en: The participant's name was entered in the register before the session began.
formal.zh: 参加者的姓名在活动开始前已被登记在册。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Ismi qiegħed fuq il-lista? David: Iva, tniżżel dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is my name on the list? David: Yes, it was written down this morning.
colloquial.zh: Marija：名单上有我的名字吗？David：有，今天早上已经记下来了。

messages.speaker: Marija (参加者)
messages.zh: 名单上有我的名字吗？
messages.en: Is my name on the list?

messages.speaker: David (活动工作人员)
messages.zh: 有，今天早上已经记下来了。
messages.en: Yes, it was written down this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己的名字被写进签到表，用被记录下来的结果联记登记与书写两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to lowering something or bringing it down to a lower position or level.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示使某物降到较低位置、水平或程度的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' li xi ħaġa titniżżel għal pożizzjoni jew livell aktar baxx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 降低的；使位置、水平或程度下降的。
使落下的；使某物移到较低位置的。

formal.mt: It-tniżżil tal-bandiera sar fi tmiem iċ-ċerimonja.
formal.en: The lowering of the flag took place at the end of the ceremony.
formal.zh: 降旗在仪式结束时进行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex hemm daqshekk nies fil-ħanut? Ben: Minħabba t-tniżżil tal-prezzijiet; ħafna affarijiet issa jiswew inqas.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are there so many people in the shop? Ben: Because of the price reductions; lots of things now cost less.
colloquial.zh: Sara：店里怎么有这么多人？Ben：因为降价了，现在很多东西都便宜了。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 店里怎么有这么多人？
messages.en: Why are there so many people in the shop?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tniżżil tal-prezzijiet; ħafna affarijiet issa jiswew inqas.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tniżżil tal-prezzijiet; ħafna affarijiet issa jiswew inqas.
messages.zh: 因为降价了，现在很多东西都便宜了。
messages.en: Because of the price reductions; lots of things now cost less.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在旗帜和价格标签旁各画一个向下箭头，用位置下降与数值降低联记词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Forced removal from one's country or home, or the condition of living away because of such removal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被迫离开自己的国家或家园的放逐行为，或由此形成的流放生活状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tkeċċija bilfors minn pajjiż jew dar, jew il-qagħda ta' min jgħix 'il bogħod minħabba din it-tkeċċija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 流放；被迫远离祖国或家园的生活状态。
放逐；强迫某人离开一个国家或地方。

collocations.zh: 将他放逐出自己的国家

formal.mt: Ir-rumanz jiddeskrivi s-snin ta' tnoffija tal-protagonist u x-xewqa tiegħu li jerġa' lura lejn daru.
formal.en: The novel describes the protagonist's years of exile and his wish to return home.
formal.zh: 这部小说描写了主人公多年的流放生活，以及他重返家园的愿望。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex il-karattru ma jistax imur lura d-dar? Ġanni: Minħabba t-tnoffija tiegħu; kellu jitlaq minn pajjiżu.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why can't the character go back home? Ġanni: Because of his banishment; he had to leave his country.
colloquial.zh: Elena：这个人物为什么不能回家？Ġanni：因为他被放逐了，不得不离开自己的国家。

messages.speaker: Elena (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-karattru ma jistax imur lura d-dar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-karattru ma jistax imur lura d-dar?
messages.zh: 这个人物为什么不能回家？
messages.en: Why can't the character go back home?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tnoffija tiegħu; kellu jitlaq minn pajjiżu.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tnoffija tiegħu; kellu jitlaq minn pajjiżu.
messages.zh: 因为他被放逐了，不得不离开自己的国家。
messages.en: Because of his banishment; he had to leave his country.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小说人物被迫离开家园、久久盼望归来，用这段情境记住流放与放逐。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country in West Africa whose official Maltese name is Repubblika Togoliża.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 西非国家多哥，其马耳他语正式国名为 Repubblika Togoliża，即多哥共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Punent li l-isem uffiċjali tiegħu huwa r-Repubblika Togoliża.

sense_translations.en_definition: Togo (a country in West Africa; official name: Repubblika Togoliża)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 多哥，西非国家；正式名称为多哥共和国，马耳他语为 Repubblika Togoliża。

formal.mt: It-Togo, magħruf uffiċjalment bħala r-Repubblika Togoliża, huwa pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Punent.
formal.en: Togo, officially known as the Togolese Republic, is a country in West Africa.
formal.zh: 多哥，正式名称为多哥共和国，是一个西非国家。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn qiegħed it-Togo fuq il-mappa? Mark: Fl-Afrika tal-Punent. Ejja nfittxuh flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Togo on the map? Mark: In West Africa. Let's find it together.
colloquial.zh: Maja：多哥在地图上的哪里？Mark：在西非。我们一起找找吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 多哥在地图上的哪里？
messages.en: Where is Togo on the map?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 在西非。我们一起找找吧。
messages.en: In West Africa. Let's find it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把大写国名 Togo 与中文多哥配对，再在非洲地图西部标一个点，连同地理位置一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 多哥的；多哥人（通常指男性）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or connected with Togo, its people, or its culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自多哥的，或与多哥、其人民及文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mit-Togo jew li għandu x'jaqsam mat-Togo, man-nies tiegħu jew mal-kultura tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: Togolese (of, from or relating to Togo)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 多哥的；来自多哥的；与多哥有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Togolese (native or inhabitant of Togo) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 多哥人；多哥本地人或居民，通常指男性。

formal.mt: Il-mużew stieden artist Togoliż biex jippreżenta x-xogħol tiegħu.
formal.en: The museum invited a Togolese artist to present his work.
formal.zh: 博物馆邀请了一位多哥艺术家介绍他的作品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-ikel Togoliż? Mark: Iva, ħabib mit-Togo sajru għalina.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this Togolese food? Mark: Yes, a friend from Togo cooked it for us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是多哥食物吗？马克：是的，一位来自多哥的朋友做给我们吃的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是多哥食物吗？
messages.en: Is this Togolese food?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，一位来自多哥的朋友做给我们吃的。
messages.en: Yes, a friend from Togo cooked it for us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Togoliż 放进“多哥艺术家”和“多哥食物”两个场景来记：修饰事物时是“多哥的”，单独指人时可表示多哥男子。

gloss_zh: 汤加的；汤加人（通常指男性）；汤加语

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or connected with Tonga, its people, or its culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自汤加的，或与汤加、其人民及文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej minn Tonga jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' Tonga, man-nies tagħha jew mal-kultura tagħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: Tongan (of, from or relating to Tonga)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 汤加的；来自汤加的；与汤加有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Tongan (native or inhabitant of Tonga) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 汤加人；汤加本地人或居民，通常指男性。
汤加语。

formal.mt: L-università stiednet kittieb Tongan biex jitkellem dwar il-letteratura ta' pajjiżu.
formal.en: The university invited a Tongan writer to speak about his country's literature.
formal.zh: 大学邀请了一位汤加作家讲述其祖国的文学。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema lingwa qed titgħallem? Mark: Qed nitgħallem it-Tongan ma' ħabib minn Tonga.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which language are you learning? Mark: I'm learning Tongan with a friend from Tonga.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在学哪种语言？马克：我在跟一位来自汤加的朋友学习汤加语。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你在学哪种语言？
messages.en: Which language are you learning?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nitgħallem it-Tongan ma' ħabib minn Tonga.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nitgħallem it-Tongan ma' ħabib minn Tonga.
messages.zh: 我在跟一位来自汤加的朋友学习汤加语。
messages.en: I'm learning Tongan with a friend from Tonga.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 Tongan 配三张学习卡：“汤加的作家”“一位汤加男子”“学习汤加语”。同一个词可表归属、人或语言，要看句中用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The shape and physical features of an area of land, or the study and description of those features.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某片土地的形状、起伏及其他地表特征，也指对这些特征的研究和描述。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-forma u l-karatteristiċi fiżiċi tal-art f'żona, jew l-istudju u d-deskrizzjoni tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地形；地表形态及其特征；研究或描述这些特征的地形学。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-topografija taż-żona u juri l-għoljiet u l-widien fuq mappa.
formal.en: The report describes the area's topography and shows the hills and valleys on a map.
formal.zh: 报告描述了该地区的地形，并在地图上标出了山丘和山谷。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex din il-mixja tidher diffiċli? Pawlu: Ħares lejn it-topografija fuq il-mappa: hemm ħafna għoljiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does this walk look difficult? Pawlu: Look at the topography on the map: there are lots of hills.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么这条步行路线看起来很难走？保罗：看看地图上的地形：那里有很多山丘。

messages.speaker: Lara (徒步伙伴)
messages.zh: 为什么这条步行路线看起来很难走？
messages.en: Why does this walk look difficult?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (徒步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħares lejn it-topografija fuq il-mappa: hemm ħafna għoljiet.
messages.mt_standard: Ħares lejn it-topografija fuq il-mappa: hemm ħafna għoljiet.
messages.zh: 看看地图上的地形：那里有很多山丘。
messages.en: Look at the topography on the map: there are lots of hills.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 topografija 想成一张展示山丘、山谷和高低起伏的地图：它回答“这片土地是什么形状”，也可指研究这些特征的学问。

gloss_zh: 从地形上看；在地形方面

teaching_sense.en_definition: With regard to the shape and physical features of the land.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 就土地的形状、起伏和地表特征而言；从地形角度来看。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'dak li għandu x'jaqsam mal-forma u mal-karatteristiċi fiżiċi tal-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从地形上看；在地形方面；就地表形态而言。

formal.mt: Iż-żewġ żoni huma topografikament differenti: waħda hija ċatta u l-oħra għandha ħafna għoljiet.
formal.en: The two areas are topographically different: one is flat and the other has many hills.
formal.zh: 这两个地区在地形上有所不同：一个地势平坦，另一个有许多山丘。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dawn iż-żewġ postijiet jixxiebhu? Mark: Topografikament, iva. It-tnejn għandhom għoljiet u widien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are these two places similar? Mark: Topographically, yes. Both have hills and valleys.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这两个地方相似吗？马克：从地形上看，是的。两处都有山丘和山谷。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这两个地方相似吗？
messages.en: Are these two places similar?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Topografikament, iva. It-tnejn għandhom għoljiet u widien.
messages.mt_standard: Topografikament, iva. It-tnejn għandhom għoljiet u widien.
messages.zh: 从地形上看，是的。两处都有山丘和山谷。
messages.en: Topographically, yes. Both have hills and valleys.

cognitive_memory_aid: 每次看到 topografikament，就在脑中先说“从地形上看”，再接“相似”或“不同”；这样能记住它是限定比较角度的副词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the shape and physical features of the land, or to their measurement and representation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与土地的形状、起伏、地表特征或其测量和表示有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-forma u mal-karatteristiċi fiżiċi tal-art, jew mal-kejl u mar-rappreżentazzjoni tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地形的；与地形特征、地形测量或地形表示有关的。

formal.mt: Qabel ma beda x-xogħol, sar stħarriġ topografiku biex jitkejlu l-livelli tal-art.
formal.en: Before work began, a topographic survey was carried out to measure the ground levels.
formal.zh: 开工前进行了地形测量，以测定地面的高程。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'juri dan il-pjan topografiku? Pawlu: Juri l-għoli tal-art u fejn hemm l-għoljiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does this topographic plan show? Pawlu: It shows the elevation of the land and where the hills are.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这张地形图显示什么？保罗：它显示地面的高程，以及山丘所在的位置。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这张地形图显示什么？
messages.en: What does this topographic plan show?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Juri l-għoli tal-art u fejn hemm l-għoljiet.
messages.mt_standard: Juri l-għoli tal-art u fejn hemm l-għoljiet.
messages.zh: 它显示地面的高程，以及山丘所在的位置。
messages.en: It shows the elevation of the land and where the hills are.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 topografiku 贴在“测量”和“图”旁边记：stħarriġ topografiku 是地形测量，pjan topografiku 是地形图，词语负责说明“与地形有关”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who studies, measures, and maps the shape and physical features of the land.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究、测量并绘制土地形状、起伏和地表特征的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tistudja u tkejjel il-forma u l-karatteristiċi fiżiċi tal-art u tfassal mapep tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地形测绘员；从事地形测量、描绘或研究的专业人员；地形学家。

collocations.zh: 一位经验丰富的地形测绘员

formal.mt: It-topografu kejjel l-għoli tal-art u ħejja mappa dettaljata tas-sit.
formal.en: The topographer measured the elevation of the land and prepared a detailed map of the site.
formal.zh: 地形测绘员测量了地面的高程，并绘制了一张详细的场地图。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jkejjel din l-art? Mark: Għada jiġi topografu. Huwa se jħejji wkoll mappa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is going to measure this land? Mark: A topographer is coming tomorrow. He will also prepare a map.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁来测量这块地？马克：明天会来一位地形测绘员。他还会绘制一张地图。

messages.speaker: Maja (土地所有者)
messages.zh: 谁来测量这块地？
messages.en: Who is going to measure this land?

messages.speaker: Mark (项目负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada jiġi topografu. Huwa se jħejji wkoll mappa.
messages.mt_standard: Għada jiġi topografu. Huwa se jħejji wkoll mappa.
messages.zh: 明天会来一位地形测绘员。他还会绘制一张地图。
messages.en: A topographer is coming tomorrow. He will also prepare a map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人在山坡上测量高度，再把结果画成地图，这个人就是 topografu。用“测量地形的人”这个完整画面记住职业含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small hairpiece worn to cover a bald area of the head.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 戴在头上、用来遮盖局部秃发区域的小块假发或补发片。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa xagħar artifiċjali li tintlibes biex tgħatti parti qargħa tar-ras.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 局部假发；用来遮盖头部秃发区域的补发片。

collocations.en: a toupee made of natural hair

formal.mt: Għall-produzzjoni teatrali, l-attur libes toppu li kien jaqbel mal-kulur ta' xagħru.
formal.en: For the theatrical production, the actor wore a toupee that matched his hair colour.
formal.zh: 在这部戏剧演出中，演员戴了一块与自己发色相配的局部假发。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan it-toppu jaqbel mal-kulur ta' xagħri? Lara: Iva, jaqbel sew. Trid tippruvah?
colloquial.en: Mark: Does this toupee match my hair colour? Lara: Yes, it matches well. Would you like to try it on?
colloquial.zh: 马克：这块补发片跟我的发色相配吗？拉拉：是的，很相配。你想试戴一下吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-toppu jaqbel mal-kulur ta' xagħri?
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-toppu jaqbel mal-kulur ta' xagħri?
messages.zh: 这块补发片跟我的发色相配吗？
messages.en: Does this toupee match my hair colour?

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.zh: 是的，很相配。你想试戴一下吗？
messages.en: Yes, it matches well. Would you like to try it on?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 toppu 记成头上用来补住一小块缺发位置的发片；配合 jilbes toppu“他戴着局部假发”，用试戴和比对发色的画面帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A region in space whose gravity is so strong that even light cannot escape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 太空中引力极强、连光也无法逃逸的区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reġjun fl-ispazju fejn il-gravità hija tant qawwija li lanqas id-dawl ma jista' jaħrab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黑洞；引力强到连光都无法逃逸的太空区域。

collocations.en: the gravity of a black hole
a black hole at the centre of a galaxy

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif il-gravità ta' toqba sewda taffettwa l-materja ta' madwarha.
formal.en: The report describes how the gravity of a black hole affects the matter around it.
formal.zh: 报告描述了黑洞的引力如何影响周围的物质。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi toqba sewda? Pawlu: Hija reġjun fl-ispazju fejn lanqas id-dawl ma jista' jaħrab.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is a black hole? Pawlu: It is a region in space where even light cannot escape.
colloquial.zh: Maja：什么是黑洞？Pawlu：它是太空中连光都无法逃逸的区域。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是黑洞？
messages.en: What is a black hole?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija reġjun fl-ispazju fejn lanqas id-dawl ma jista' jaħrab.
messages.mt_standard: Hija reġjun fl-ispazju fejn lanqas id-dawl ma jista' jaħrab.
messages.zh: 它是太空中连光都无法逃逸的区域。
messages.en: It is a region in space where even light cannot escape.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词组配上黑洞示意图，想象光线也逃不出来的太空区域，整组记住“黑洞”。

gloss_zh: 重量；沉重感；道德上的重负

teaching_sense.en_definition: Physical weight or heaviness, or the figurative burden of guilt or moral responsibility.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体的重量或身体感到的沉重，也指罪疚、道德责任带来的精神重负。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-piż jew is-sens ta' piż fiżiku, jew il-piż morali tal-ħtija jew tar-responsabbiltà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 物理上的重量；身体或物体的沉重感。
道德上的重负；罪疚感或道德责任带来的精神压力。

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, il-karattru jħoss it-toqla tal-ħtija wara li jigdeb lil ħabibu.
formal.en: In the story, the character feels the weight of guilt after lying to his friend.
formal.zh: 故事中，这个人物对朋友撒谎后，感到了罪疚的重负。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Wara dik il-mixja twila, qed inħoss toqla f'saqajja. Mark: Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda u nistrieħu ftit.
colloquial.en: Lara: After that long walk, my legs feel heavy. Mark: Let's sit down and rest for a bit.
colloquial.zh: Lara：走了那么远，我觉得双腿很沉。Mark：我们坐下来休息一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara dik il-mixja twila, qed inħoss toqla f'saqajja.
messages.mt_standard: Wara dik il-mixja twila, qed inħoss toqla f'saqajja.
messages.zh: 走了那么远，我觉得双腿很沉。
messages.en: After that long walk, my legs feel heavy.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda u nistrieħu ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda u nistrieħu ftit.
messages.zh: 我们坐下来休息一会儿吧。
messages.en: Let's sit down and rest for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双腿像绑着重物，再把这种沉重感移到心里：身体沉重和良心重负都可联想记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small weighted disc fitted to a spindle to help it rotate during spinning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 装在纺锤上的小型配重圆盘，用来帮助纺锤在纺线时旋转。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Diska żgħira b'piż imwaħħla ma' magħżel biex tgħinu jdur waqt l-għażil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纺轮；装在纺锤上、辅助旋转的配重圆盘。

formal.mt: Il-wirja tinkludi magħżel b'toqqala tat-tafal u spjegazzjoni tal-użu tiegħu fl-għażil.
formal.en: The exhibition includes a spindle with a clay whorl and an explanation of its use in spinning.
formal.zh: 展览陈列了一支带陶制纺轮的纺锤，并说明了它在纺线中的用途。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhi dik id-diska fuq il-magħżel? Rita: Dik hija t-toqqala; tgħin lill-magħżel idur waqt l-għażil.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is that disc on the spindle? Rita: That is the whorl; it helps the spindle rotate during spinning.
colloquial.zh: Nina：纺锤上那个圆盘是什么？Rita：那是纺轮，纺线时帮助纺锤旋转。

messages.speaker: Nina (参观者)
messages.zh: 纺锤上那个圆盘是什么？
messages.en: What is that disc on the spindle?

messages.speaker: Rita (讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik hija t-toqqala; tgħin lill-magħżel idur waqt l-għażil.
messages.mt_standard: Dik hija t-toqqala; tgħin lill-magħżel idur waqt l-għażil.
messages.zh: 那是纺轮，纺线时帮助纺锤旋转。
messages.en: That is the whorl; it helps the spindle rotate during spinning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一根纺锤，再在轴上添一个配重圆盘，把圆盘标成 toqqala，借图记住“纺轮”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dropsy: swelling caused by an abnormal accumulation of fluid in body tissues.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 水肿，即液体在身体组织中异常积聚而引起的肿胀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nefħa kkawżata minn akkumulazzjoni mhux normali ta' fluwidu fit-tessuti tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 水肿；积水病，指体内液体异常积聚所致的肿胀。

formal.mt: Fit-test, il-kelma torbiċija tirreferi għal nefħa marbuta ma' akkumulazzjoni ta' fluwidu fit-tessuti.
formal.en: In the text, the word torbiċija refers to swelling associated with an accumulation of fluid in the tissues.
formal.zh: 在这篇文本中，torbiċija 指与组织内液体积聚有关的肿胀。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser torbiċija f'din is-sentenza? Pawlu: Tfisser nefħa fil-ġisem minħabba fluwidu li jinġabar fit-tessuti.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does torbiċija mean in this sentence? Pawlu: It means swelling in the body caused by fluid collecting in the tissues.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这句话里的 torbiċija 是什么意思？Pawlu：指液体在组织中积聚而引起的身体肿胀。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 torbiċija 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does torbiċija mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser nefħa fil-ġisem minħabba fluwidu li jinġabar fit-tessuti.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser nefħa fil-ġisem minħabba fluwidu li jinġabar fit-tessuti.
messages.zh: 指液体在组织中积聚而引起的身体肿胀。
messages.en: It means swelling in the body caused by fluid collecting in the tissues.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把组织想成吸水后鼓起的海绵，用“液体积聚、组织肿起”的画面记住水肿这一词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Thorium, a chemical element.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 钍，一种化学元素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku msejjaħ thorium bl-Ingliż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钍，化学元素名称。

formal.mt: Fit-tabella tal-elementi kimiċi, l-isem torju jidher ħdejn l-isem Ingliż thorium.
formal.en: In the table of chemical elements, the name torju appears beside the English name thorium.
formal.zh: 在化学元素表中，马耳他语名称 torju 列在英语名称 thorium 旁边。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif ngħidu thorium bil-Malti? Mark: Ngħidu torju; huwa isem ta' element kimiku.
colloquial.en: Lara: How do we say thorium in Maltese? Mark: We say torju; it is the name of a chemical element.
colloquial.zh: Lara：thorium 用马耳他语怎么说？Mark：说 torju，它是一个化学元素的名称。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: thorium 用马耳他语怎么说？
messages.en: How do we say thorium in Maltese?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ngħidu torju; huwa isem ta' element kimiku.
messages.mt_standard: Ngħidu torju; huwa isem ta' element kimiku.
messages.zh: 说 torju，它是一个化学元素的名称。
messages.en: We say torju; it is the name of a chemical element.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做一张三语元素卡：正面写 torju，背面并列写“钍、thorium”，通过对应练习记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A machine that rotates a workpiece while a cutting tool shapes it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使工件旋转，并用刀具对其进行切削成形的机床。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magna li ddawwar biċċa materjal waqt li għodda tal-qtugħ tagħtiha l-forma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 车床；通过旋转工件并用刀具切削来加工的机床。

formal.mt: Fil-ħanut tax-xogħol, it-torn jintuża biex jagħti forma ċilindrika lil biċċiet tal-injam.
formal.en: In the workshop, the lathe is used to give pieces of wood a cylindrical shape.
formal.zh: 在工场中，车床用于把木料加工成圆柱形。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Liema magna użajt biex għamilt dan il-manku? Toni: Użajt it-torn biex tajt forma lill-injam.
colloquial.en: Nina: Which machine did you use to make this handle? Toni: I used the lathe to shape the wood.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你用哪台机器做了这个把手？Toni：我用车床给木料加工成形。

messages.speaker: Nina (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema magna użajt biex għamilt dan il-manku?
messages.mt_standard: Liema magna użajt biex għamilt dan il-manku?
messages.zh: 你用哪台机器做了这个把手？
messages.en: Which machine did you use to make this handle?

messages.speaker: Toni (木工师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Użajt it-torn biex tajt forma lill-injam.
messages.mt_standard: Użajt it-torn biex tajt forma lill-injam.
messages.zh: 我用车床给木料加工成形。
messages.en: I used the lathe to shape the wood.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象木料在机器上旋转、刀具削出圆柱的画面，把整台机器贴上 torn 的标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To come or go back to a place where one was before.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 回到先前所在的地方；返回或回来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jerġa' jiġi jew imur f'post fejn kien qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 返回；回到先前所在的地方。

formal.mt: Wara żjara qasira fil-belt, Pawlu torna lejn ir-raħal tiegħu.
formal.en: After a short visit to the city, Pawlu returned to his village.
formal.zh: 在城里短暂停留后，Pawlu 回到了自己的村庄。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu Pawlu? Mark: Torna d-dar wara l-ikla.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Pawlu? Mark: He returned home after the meal.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 在哪里？Mark：他吃完饭就回家了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他吃完饭就回家了。
messages.en: He returned home after the meal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条从家出发又折回家的箭头，在回程箭头旁写 torna，把动作记成“返回”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of operating a lathe to shape a piece of material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 操作车床，使材料经切削而成形的加工活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol li jsir fuq torn biex biċċa materjal tingħata forma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 操作车床进行加工；车削作业。

formal.mt: Il-kors jinkludi lezzjonijiet dwar it-tornar tal-injam u l-użu tal-għodod meħtieġa.
formal.en: The course includes lessons on woodturning and the use of the necessary tools.
formal.zh: 这门课程包括木材车削及所需工具使用方法的教学。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qed titgħallem fil-kors? Toni: It-tornar tal-injam; illum għamilna manku żgħir.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you learning on the course? Toni: Woodturning; today we made a small handle.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你在课程里学什么？Toni：木材车削，今天我们做了一个小把手。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在课程里学什么？
messages.en: What are you learning on the course?

messages.speaker: Toni (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tornar tal-injam; illum għamilna manku żgħir.
messages.mt_standard: It-tornar tal-injam; illum għamilna manku żgħir.
messages.zh: 木材车削，今天我们做了一个小把手。
messages.en: Woodturning; today we made a small handle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张图对照记忆：机器图标写 torn，操作机器加工木料的过程图写 tornar，记住后者是加工活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The fare paid for a ticket covering both the outward and return journeys.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 购买包含去程和回程的车票或船票所需支付的票价。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prezz ta' biljett li jkopri l-vjaġġ 'il barra u lura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 往返票的票价。

collocations.en: the price of the return fare

formal.mt: Qabel ix-xiri tal-biljett, il-passiġġier talab informazzjoni dwar il-prezz tat-tornata.
formal.en: Before buying the ticket, the passenger requested information about the return fare.
formal.zh: 购买车票前，乘客询问了往返票价。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kemm hi t-tornata? Pawlu: Għaxar ewro, u tinkludi l-vjaġġ lura.
colloquial.en: Marija: How much is the return fare? Pawlu: Ten euros, and it includes the journey back.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：往返票多少钱？保罗：十欧元，包含回程。

messages.speaker: Marija (乘客)
messages.zh: 往返票多少钱？
messages.en: How much is the return fare?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (售票员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaxar ewro, u tinkludi l-vjaġġ lura.
messages.mt_standard: Għaxar ewro, u tinkludi l-vjaġġ lura.
messages.zh: 十欧元，包含回程。
messages.en: Ten euros, and it includes the journey back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象售票窗口把去程和回程画成一个圈，圈旁标出的总票价就是 tornata；记住它在本条中表示票价。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who operates a lathe to shape material as it rotates.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 操作车床，利用材料旋转来加工成形的工人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħaddem torn biex tagħti forma lil materjal waqt li dan idur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 操作车床的人；车床操作工。
车工，即使用车床加工材料的工人。

collocations.en: to work as a lathe operator

formal.mt: It-tornitur kejjel il-biċċa tal-metall qabel ma beda jaħdimha fuq it-torn.
formal.en: The turner measured the piece of metal before beginning to machine it on the lathe.
formal.zh: 车工先测量了金属件，然后才开始在车床上加工。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min jista' jagħmel din il-biċċa fuq it-torn? Mark: Staqsi lil Ġużeppi; jaħdem bħala tornitur.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who can make this part on the lathe? Mark: Ask Ġużeppi; he works as a turner.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁能用车床做这个零件？马克：问问朱塞佩，他是车工。

messages.speaker: Sara (车间同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min jista' jagħmel din il-biċċa fuq it-torn?
messages.mt_standard: Min jista' jagħmel din il-biċċa fuq it-torn?
messages.zh: 谁能用车床做这个零件？
messages.en: Who can make this part on the lathe?

messages.speaker: Mark (车间同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Staqsi lil Ġużeppi; jaħdem bħala tornitur.
messages.mt_standard: Staqsi lil Ġużeppi; jaħdem bħala tornitur.
messages.zh: 问问朱塞佩，他是车工。
messages.en: Ask Ġużeppi; he works as a turner.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tornitur 放进车间画面：机器旋转，工人操作。用“旋转的车床旁站着车工”这幅图记住它指人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Waste of something useful, such as time, money, or water; also ruin or destruction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对时间、金钱、水等有用资源的浪费；也可指毁坏或毁灭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-użu ta' ħin, flus, ilma jew riżorsi oħra għalxejn; tista' tfisser ukoll qerda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 毁坏；毁灭；使事物遭到破坏的状态或结果。
浪费；对时间、金钱、材料等资源的不必要消耗。

formal.mt: L-iskola introduċiet miżuri biex tnaqqas it-toħlija ta' ilma fil-kmamar tal-banju.
formal.en: The school introduced measures to reduce water waste in the bathrooms.
formal.zh: 学校采取了措施，以减少洗手间内的水资源浪费。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għala għalaqt il-vit? Pawlu: Ħadd ma kien qed juża l-ilma. Kienet toħlija.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you turn off the tap? Pawlu: Nobody was using the water. It was a waste.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么把水龙头关了？保罗：没有人在用水。那样是在浪费。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把水龙头关了？
messages.en: Why did you turn off the tap?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħadd ma kien qed juża l-ilma. Kienet toħlija.
messages.mt_standard: Ħadd ma kien qed juża l-ilma. Kienet toħlija.
messages.zh: 没有人在用水。那样是在浪费。
messages.en: Nobody was using the water. It was a waste.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象无人使用却一直流水的水龙头，用 toħlija ta' ilma 记住“浪费水”；另把“毁坏”作为独立义项记忆，按上下文区分。

gloss_zh: 汽车鸣笛声；按汽车喇叭

teaching_sense.en_definition: The sounding of a car horn, or the noise produced by it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 汽车喇叭被按响的行为，或由此发出的鸣笛声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-daqq tal-ħorn ta' karozza jew il-ħoss li jagħmel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 汽车喇叭的鸣响；汽车鸣笛声

formal.mt: It-tpaqpiq tal-ħorn fit-triq dejqa fixkel il-lezzjoni li kienet għaddejja.
formal.en: The honking of the horn in the narrow street disrupted the lesson that was in progress.
formal.zh: 狭窄街道上传来的汽车鸣笛声干扰了正在进行的课堂教学。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak it-tpaqpiq kollu? Pawlu: Hemm karozza quddiem il-bieb; ix-xufier qed jistenna lil xi ħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's all that honking? Pawlu: There's a car outside the door; the driver is waiting for someone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：怎么一直有汽车鸣笛声？保罗：门外有辆车，司机正在等人。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 怎么一直有汽车鸣笛声？
messages.en: What's all that honking?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm karozza quddiem il-bieb; ix-xufier qed jistenna lil xi ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm karozza quddiem il-bieb; ix-xufier qed jistenna lil xi ħadd.
messages.zh: 门外有辆车，司机正在等人。
messages.en: There's a car outside the door; the driver is waiting for someone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和堵车时接连响起的汽车喇叭联系起来，想象窗外一阵阵鸣笛声，帮助记住它表示鸣笛行为或声音。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of arranging or placing material in layers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把材料一层接一层地铺放或排列的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tqegħid ta' materjal f'saffi, wieħed fuq l-ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把材料逐层铺放；分层放置

formal.mt: It-tparpin tal-materjal f'saffi rqaq għen biex tinkiseb wiċċa uniformi.
formal.en: Placing the material in thin layers helped achieve an even surface.
formal.zh: 把材料分成薄层逐层铺放，有助于形成均匀的表面。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif sejjer it-tparpin tal-materjal? Mark: Sewwa, imma għad fadalli żewġ saffi x'nagħmel.
colloquial.en: Sara: How is the layering of the material going? Mark: Well, but I still have two layers left to do.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：材料一层层铺得怎么样了？马克：挺顺利，不过还剩两层要铺。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 材料一层层铺得怎么样了？
messages.en: How is the layering of the material going?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, imma għad fadalli żewġ saffi x'nagħmel.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, imma għad fadalli żewġ saffi x'nagħmel.
messages.zh: 挺顺利，不过还剩两层要铺。
messages.en: Well, but I still have two layers left to do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把材料像千层糕一样逐层铺开，每铺完一层再加下一层；用这个动作画面记住分层铺放的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making off or running away from a place or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从某个地方或处境中溜走、逃离的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħarba minn post jew minn sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 溜走；匆忙离去的行为
逃跑；逃离的行为

formal.mt: Ix-xhud iddeskriva t-tparpir tar-raġel mill-post qabel il-wasla tal-pulizija.
formal.en: The witness described the man's flight from the scene before the police arrived.
formal.zh: 证人描述了那名男子在警察到达前逃离现场的经过。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt dak it-tparpir meta deher il-kelb? Ben: Iva, ħarab jiġri u ħalla l-basket warajh!
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see that dash to get away when the dog appeared? Ben: Yes, he ran off and left his bag behind!
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你看到狗一出现，他就赶紧逃跑的样子了吗？本：看到了，他拔腿就跑，连包都落下了！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt dak it-tparpir meta deher il-kelb?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt dak it-tparpir meta deher il-kelb?
messages.zh: 你看到狗一出现，他就赶紧逃跑的样子了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that dash to get away when the dog appeared?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħarab jiġri u ħalla l-basket warajh!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħarab jiġri u ħalla l-basket warajh!
messages.zh: 看到了，他拔腿就跑，连包都落下了！
messages.en: Yes, he ran off and left his bag behind!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人听到动静便拔腿离开现场，把溜走和逃跑两个义项连成同一个画面；这个词命名的是逃离行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be given in exchange for another thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为交换而被交出，并换得另一件东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħata oġġett u jittieħed ieħor minfloku bħala skambju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被交换；被拿去换取另一物

collocations.en: the book was exchanged for another
collocations.zh: 这本书被换成了另一本

collocations.mt: l-oġġett tpartat ma' wieħed tal-istess valur
collocations.en: the item was exchanged for one of equal value
collocations.zh: 这件物品被换成了等值的另一件

formal.mt: Il-ktieb tpartat ma' volum ieħor tal-istess valur, bi qbil bejn iż-żewġ sidien.
formal.en: The book was exchanged for another volume of equal value, by agreement between the two owners.
formal.zh: 经两位物主同意，这本书被换成了另一本等值的书。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-ktieb l-aħmar? Pawlu: Tpartat ma' dak il-blu; it-tnejn qbilna fuq l-iskambju.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the red book? Pawlu: It was exchanged for that blue one; we both agreed to the exchange.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那本红色的书呢？保罗：换成那本蓝色的了，我们俩都同意这样交换。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那本红色的书呢？
messages.en: Where is the red book?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tpartat ma' dak il-blu; it-tnejn qbilna fuq l-iskambju.
messages.mt_standard: Tpartat ma' dak il-blu; it-tnejn qbilna fuq l-iskambju.
messages.zh: 换成那本蓝色的了，我们俩都同意这样交换。
messages.en: It was exchanged for that blue one; we both agreed to the exchange.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一本红书被换成一本蓝书，把注意力放在被换走的书上，记住这个动词表示某物被交换。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become flabby and loose, especially when describing skin in old age.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得松软、松垮，尤其用于描述年老时皮肤逐渐失去紧实度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir laxk u inqas sod, speċjalment meta jingħad għall-ġild fix-xjuħija.

sense_translations.en_definition: to become flabby and loose (used especially of skin in old age)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得松软、松弛，尤其指年老时皮肤变得松垮

collocations.zh: 随着年龄增长而变松弛

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tal-karattru anzjan, l-awtur kiteb li l-ġild ta' wiċċu tpartax bl-età.
formal.en: In describing the elderly character, the author wrote that the skin on his face had become loose with age.
formal.zh: 作者描写这位年长人物时，写到他脸上的皮肤随着年龄增长而变得松弛。

colloquial.mt: Rita: F'dan ir-ritratt nara li l-ġild ta' wiċċi tpartax xi ftit. Anna: Għaddew ħafna snin, imma t-tbissima tiegħek għadha l-istess.
colloquial.en: Rita: In this photo I can see that the skin on my face has become a little loose. Anna: Many years have passed, but your smile is still the same.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：看这张照片，我发现自己脸上的皮肤有点松弛了。安娜：都过去这么多年了，可你的笑容还是一样。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dan ir-ritratt nara li l-ġild ta' wiċċi tpartax xi ftit.
messages.mt_standard: F'dan ir-ritratt nara li l-ġild ta' wiċċi tpartax xi ftit.
messages.zh: 看这张照片，我发现自己脸上的皮肤有点松弛了。
messages.en: In this photo I can see that the skin on my face has become a little loose.

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaddew ħafna snin, imma t-tbissima tiegħek għadha l-istess.
messages.mt_standard: Għaddew ħafna snin, imma t-tbissima tiegħek għadha l-istess.
messages.zh: 都过去这么多年了，可你的笑容还是一样。
messages.en: Many years have passed, but your smile is still the same.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用多年后对比照片的情景记忆：皮肤从紧实变得松弛，重点记住这是表示变松过程的动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of giving one thing and receiving another in return.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把一件东西交给对方，同时从对方取得另一件东西的交换行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' ħaġa u t-teħid ta' oħra minflokha bħala skambju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 交换、互换的行为

formal.mt: Il-librerija organizzat attività ta' tpartit ta' kotba, fejn kull parteċipant seta' jagħti ktieb u jieħu ieħor.
formal.en: The library organized a book exchange activity where each participant could give a book and take another.
formal.zh: 图书馆组织了一次书籍交换活动，每位参与者都可以拿出一本书，再换取另一本。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Trid nagħmlu tpartit? Nagħtik dan il-ktieb u inti tagħtini dak tiegħek. Sara: Tajjeb, hekk ikollna t-tnejn xi ħaġa ġdida x'naqraw.
colloquial.en: Mark: Shall we make a swap? I'll give you this book and you give me yours. Sara: All right, then we'll both have something new to read.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们交换一下好吗？我给你这本书，你把你的那本给我。萨拉：好啊，这样我们俩都有新书看了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid nagħmlu tpartit? Nagħtik dan il-ktieb u inti tagħtini dak tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Trid nagħmlu tpartit? Nagħtik dan il-ktieb u inti tagħtini dak tiegħek.
messages.zh: 我们交换一下好吗？我给你这本书，你把你的那本给我。
messages.en: Shall we make a swap? I'll give you this book and you give me yours.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, hekk ikollna t-tnejn xi ħaġa ġdida x'naqraw.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, hekk ikollna t-tnejn xi ħaġa ġdida x'naqraw.
messages.zh: 好啊，这样我们俩都有新书看了。
messages.en: All right, then we'll both have something new to read.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个人同时把手里的书递给对方，用来回交换的双向箭头记住这个名词；它指整个交换行为。

gloss_zh: 逐渐松弛；变松垮的过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming flabby or less firm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 逐渐失去紧实度、变得松软或松垮的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir laxka u inqas soda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得松软、松垮的过程

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jiddeskrivi t-tpartix gradwali tal-ġild bħala waħda mill-bidliet fid-dehra tal-karattru.
formal.en: The chapter describes the gradual loss of firmness in the skin as one of the changes in the character's appearance.
formal.zh: 这一章把皮肤逐渐松弛描述为该人物外貌变化的一个方面。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'tifhem b'tpartix tal-ġild? Rita: Meta l-ġild bil-mod isir inqas sod u aktar laxk.
colloquial.en: Lara: What do you mean by the skin becoming flabby? Rita: When the skin gradually becomes less firm and looser.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你说的皮肤逐渐松弛是什么意思？丽塔：就是皮肤慢慢失去紧实度，变得更松垮。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你说的皮肤逐渐松弛是什么意思？
messages.en: What do you mean by the skin becoming flabby?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta l-ġild bil-mod isir inqas sod u aktar laxk.
messages.mt_standard: Meta l-ġild bil-mod isir inqas sod u aktar laxk.
messages.zh: 就是皮肤慢慢失去紧实度，变得更松垮。
messages.en: When the skin gradually becomes less firm and looser.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把皮肤逐年失去紧实度想象成一段慢放影片，记住这个名词强调变松弛的过程，可与表示变松的动词对照学习。

gloss_zh: 被临时编造；被虚构出来

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made up or invented, sometimes spontaneously as the need arises.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被编造或虚构出来，也可指为应付眼前情况而临时编出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi vvintat jew magħmul minn moħħ xi ħadd, xi drabi dak il-ħin stess.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be made up on the fly
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被当场编出；被临时编造
被编造；被虚构出来

collocations.en: the story was made up on the spot
collocations.zh: 这个故事是当场编出来的

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont tpaspar waqt l-eżerċizzju tal-kitba u ma kienx ibbażat fuq ġrajja vera.
formal.en: The story was invented during the writing exercise and was not based on a true event.
formal.zh: 这个故事是在写作练习中编出来的，并非根据真实事件写成。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Dak ir-rakkont kien lest minn qabel? Lara: Le, tpaspar dak il-ħin stess, meta t-tfal talbu storja oħra.
colloquial.en: Ben: Was that story prepared beforehand? Lara: No, it was made up right then, when the children asked for another story.
colloquial.zh: 本：那个故事是事先准备好的吗？劳拉：不是，是孩子们要求再听一个故事时当场编出来的。

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ir-rakkont kien lest minn qabel?
messages.mt_standard: Dak ir-rakkont kien lest minn qabel?
messages.zh: 那个故事是事先准备好的吗？
messages.en: Was that story prepared beforehand?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tpaspar dak il-ħin stess, meta t-tfal talbu storja oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tpaspar dak il-ħin stess, meta t-tfal talbu storja oħra.
messages.zh: 不是，是孩子们要求再听一个故事时当场编出来的。
messages.en: No, it was made up right then, when the children asked for another story.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象孩子突然要求听故事，一个情节就被当场编了出来；用这个场景同时记住临时编出和被虚构两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Acting as a situation develops, or working out how to do something without a ready solution.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据眼前情况边做边调整，或在没有现成办法时摸索出解决方法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-aġir skont kif tiżviluppa sitwazzjoni, jew it-tfittxija ta' mod kif issir xi ħaġa mingħajr soluzzjoni lesta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 没有预先安排好所有步骤，而是根据现场情况即时行动和调整。
通过思考、尝试和摸索，弄清某件事或找到处理办法。

collocations.en: working things out to find a solution
collocations.zh: 为找到解决办法而摸索

formal.mt: Meta nbidel il-programm, it-tpaspir fuq il-post għen lill-organizzaturi jkomplu bl-attività.
formal.en: When the programme changed, improvisation on the spot helped the organisers continue the activity.
formal.zh: 活动安排发生变化时，现场的临机应变帮助组织者继续开展活动。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għandek struzzjonijiet biex tarma din l-ixkaffa? Pawlu: Le, qed nipprova nifhem kif tintrama. Hemm ftit tpaspir!
colloquial.en: Marta: Do you have instructions for assembling this shelf? Pawlu: No, I'm trying to work out how it goes together. There's a bit of figuring things out!
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你有组装这个架子的说明书吗？保罗：没有，我正试着弄明白怎么装，还得摸索一下！

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek struzzjonijiet biex tarma din l-ixkaffa?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek struzzjonijiet biex tarma din l-ixkaffa?
messages.zh: 你有组装这个架子的说明书吗？
messages.en: Do you have instructions for assembling this shelf?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, qed nipprova nifhem kif tintrama. Hemm ftit tpaspir!
messages.mt_standard: Le, qed nipprova nifhem kif tintrama. Hemm ftit tpaspir!
messages.zh: 没有，我正试着弄明白怎么装，还得摸索一下！
messages.en: No, I'm trying to work out how it goes together. There's a bit of figuring things out!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tpaspir 联想成组装架子时“边试边想”的画面：既可记临场应变，也可记摸索出办法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The movement of birds from one region to another, often with the changing seasons.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟类从一个地区迁往另一个地区的活动，常随季节变化而发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment tal-għasafar minn reġjun għal ieħor, spiss mal-bidla tal-istaġuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸟类在不同地区之间的迁徙，尤其指随季节变化而进行的迁移。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw it-tpassija tal-għasafar u niżżlu n-noti tagħhom dwar id-direzzjoni tat-titjir.
formal.en: The students observed the migration of birds and recorded notes about their direction of flight.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了鸟类迁徙，并记录了它们的飞行方向。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hawn daqshekk għasafar illum? Ninu: Qed naraw it-tpassija. Ara dawk ukoll, għaddejjin minn fuqna!
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are there so many birds here today? Ninu: We're watching the migration. Look at those too, passing above us!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今天这里怎么有这么多鸟？尼努：我们看到的是鸟类迁徙。再看那几只，正从我们头顶飞过！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天这里怎么有这么多鸟？
messages.en: Why are there so many birds here today?

messages.speaker: Ninu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed naraw it-tpassija. Ara dawk ukoll, għaddejjin minn fuqna!
messages.mt_standard: Qed naraw it-tpassija. Ara dawk ukoll, għaddejjin minn fuqna!
messages.zh: 我们看到的是鸟类迁徙。再看那几只，正从我们头顶飞过！
messages.en: We're watching the migration. Look at those too, passing above us!

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tpassija 时想象一群候鸟越过天空，并把它与 tal-għasafar“鸟类的”一起记成“鸟类迁徙”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave rudely towards someone or to speak in a vulgar manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对人表现得粗鲁无礼，或使用粗俗的语言说话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib ruħu b'nuqqas ta' rispett lejn xi ħadd jew jitkellem b'mod vulgari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表现得粗鲁无礼，缺乏对他人的尊重。

sense_translations.en_definition: to speak in a vulgar manner
sense_translations.zh_definition: 说话粗俗，使用不得体或粗鄙的言辞。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif il-klijent tpastaż mal-impjegat u uża kliem vulgari.
formal.en: The report describes how the customer behaved rudely towards the employee and used vulgar language.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这名顾客如何对员工表现无礼，并使用粗俗言辞。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex telaq hekk irrabjat? Ġanni: Għax dak ir-raġel tpastaż miegħu. Lanqas ħallieh jitkellem.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did he leave so angry? Ġanni: Because that man was rude to him. He didn't even let him speak.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：他怎么那么生气地走了？詹尼：因为那个男人对他很无礼，连话都不让他说。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 他怎么那么生气地走了？
messages.en: Why did he leave so angry?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dak ir-raġel tpastaż miegħu. Lanqas ħallieh jitkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dak ir-raġel tpastaż miegħu. Lanqas ħallieh jitkellem.
messages.zh: 因为那个男人对他很无礼，连话都不让他说。
messages.en: Because that man was rude to him. He didn't even let him speak.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tpastaż 放进“他对老师无礼”这个动作场景中；同时记住，粗鲁既能表现在举止上，也能表现在言语中。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Behaviour that is rude and shows a lack of respect for others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现出粗鲁和不尊重他人的行为或举止。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imġiba goffa li turi nuqqas ta' rispett lejn ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗鲁无礼、不尊重他人的行为。

formal.mt: Il-maniġer irċieva lment dwar it-tpastiż ta' impjegat waqt laqgħa mal-klijenti.
formal.en: The manager received a complaint about an employee's rude behaviour during a meeting with customers.
formal.zh: 经理收到了一项投诉，涉及一名员工在与顾客会面时的粗鲁行为。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Smajt kif kellimha? Toni: Iva, dak it-tpastiż ma kienx hemm bżonnu. Seta' wieġeb bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did you hear how he spoke to her? Toni: Yes, that rudeness was unnecessary. He could have answered calmly.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你听见他怎么跟她说话了吗？托尼：听见了，完全没必要那么无礼。他本来可以平静地回答。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听见他怎么跟她说话了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear how he spoke to her?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak it-tpastiż ma kienx hemm bżonnu. Seta' wieġeb bil-kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak it-tpastiż ma kienx hemm bżonnu. Seta' wieġeb bil-kalma.
messages.zh: 听见了，完全没必要那么无礼。他本来可以平静地回答。
messages.en: Yes, that rudeness was unnecessary. He could have answered calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 成对记忆：tpastaż 表示“表现得无礼”这一动作，tpastiż 表示“无礼行为”这个名词；用词性帮助区分拼写。

gloss_zh: 闲聊声；含混不清的谈话声

teaching_sense.en_definition: Casual chatter, or the sound of people talking when their words are not clearly distinguishable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随意闲聊，或能听到有人说话却听不清具体词句的谈话声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Diskors ħafif u informali, jew ħoss ta' nies jitkellmu mingħajr ma l-kliem jinstema' ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻松随意、往往持续不断的闲聊或聊天声。
