词句难以分辨、听不清内容的谈话声。

formal.mt: Fir-reġistrazzjoni jinstema' tpatpit fl-isfond, iżda l-kliem ma jingħarafx.
formal.en: Chatter can be heard in the background of the recording, but the words cannot be made out.
formal.zh: 录音背景中可以听到谈话声，但无法分辨具体词句。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qed tisma' xi ħadd jitkellem barra? Mark: Iva, imma nisma' biss tpatpit. Ma nifhimx x'qed jgħidu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you hear someone talking outside? Mark: Yes, but all I can hear is indistinct chatter. I can't understand what they're saying.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你听见外面有人说话吗？马克：听见了，但只能听到含混的谈话声，听不懂他们在说什么。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tisma' xi ħadd jitkellem barra?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tisma' xi ħadd jitkellem barra?
messages.zh: 你听见外面有人说话吗？
messages.en: Can you hear someone talking outside?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma nisma' biss tpatpit. Ma nifhimx x'qed jgħidu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma nisma' biss tpatpit. Ma nifhimx x'qed jgħidu.
messages.zh: 听见了，但只能听到含混的谈话声，听不懂他们在说什么。
messages.en: Yes, but all I can hear is indistinct chatter. I can't understand what they're saying.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tpatpit 配上咖啡馆里一片聊天声的画面：近处是闲聊，远处听不清词句时就是含混的谈话声。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be repaid, or to be avenged through a retaliatory response.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 得到偿还或回报；也可指某种伤害或冒犯受到报复。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitħallas lura jew jingħata kumpens għalih; jew issir vendetta għal xi offiża jew ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 得到偿还或回报。
所受的伤害、冒犯或不公得到报复，即有人为此作出报复性回应。

collocations.zh: 所受的侮辱得到了报复

formal.mt: Skont il-ftehim, id-dejn tpatta b'għaxar pagamenti ndaqs.
formal.en: Under the agreement, the debt was paid back in ten equal instalments.
formal.zh: 根据协议，这笔债务分十期等额偿还。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Pawlu għadu għandu jieħu l-flus? Luqa: Le, id-dejn tpatta lbieraħ. Issa kollox imħallas.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is Pawlu still owed the money? Luqa: No, the debt was paid back yesterday. Everything is paid now.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：保罗那笔钱还没收回来吗？卢卡：已经收回来了，债务昨天就还清了，现在全付清了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗那笔钱还没收回来吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu still owed the money?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, id-dejn tpatta lbieraħ. Issa kollox imħallas.
messages.mt_standard: Le, id-dejn tpatta lbieraħ. Issa kollox imħallas.
messages.zh: 已经收回来了，债务昨天就还清了，现在全付清了。
messages.en: No, the debt was paid back yesterday. Everything is paid now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个主语记 tpatta：债务“得到偿还”，侮辱“得到报复”；特别记住这里表达的是事情受到相应处理。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Revenge for a wrong, or payback in response to something someone has done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 针对伤害或不公的报复，也可指对他人先前行为作出的回报或报偿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vendetta għal xi ħsara jew offiża, jew ħlas lura għal dak li jkun għamel xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因受到伤害、冒犯或不公而对相关者进行的报复。
对他人先前行为的回报或报偿；在负面语境中也指报复。

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, ix-xewqa għat-tpattija twassal lill-karattru prinċipali biex jerġa' jfittex lill-għadu tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the desire for revenge leads the main character to seek out his enemy again.
formal.zh: 故事中，复仇的愿望促使主人公再次寻找他的敌人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ġibtli l-ikel? Daniel: Bħala tpattija għall-għajnuna tiegħek ilbieraħ. Għentni ħafna!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you bring me food? Daniel: As payback for your help yesterday. You helped me a lot!
colloquial.zh: 玛娅：你为什么给我带吃的？丹尼尔：回报你昨天的帮忙呀。你帮了我大忙！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么给我带吃的？
messages.en: Why did you bring me food?

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bħala tpattija għall-għajnuna tiegħek ilbieraħ. Għentni ħafna!
messages.mt_standard: Bħala tpattija għall-għajnuna tiegħek ilbieraħ. Għentni ħafna!
messages.zh: 回报你昨天的帮忙呀。你帮了我大忙！
messages.en: As payback for your help yesterday. You helped me a lot!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tpattija 记成“对先前事情的回应”：接 offiża“冒犯”可理解为报复，接 għajnuna“帮助”可理解为回报。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become flabby, losing firmness or tone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 失去原有的紧实感或张力，变得松弛、松软。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef is-sodezza u jsir artab u laxk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得松弛或松软，尤其指身体失去紧实感。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru jinnota li ġismu tpaxpax wara perjodu twil mingħajr attività fiżika.
formal.en: In the narrative, the character notices that his body has become flabby after a long period without physical activity.
formal.zh: 叙事中，这个人物注意到，长时间没有进行身体活动后，自己的身体变得松弛了。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Ili ħafna ma nagħmel eżerċizzju, u ġismi tpaxpax. Rita: Trid tiġi timxi miegħi għada? Nistgħu mmorru sal-baħar.
colloquial.en: Toni: I haven't exercised in ages, and my body has become flabby. Rita: Would you like to come for a walk with me tomorrow? We can walk down to the sea.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：我好久没锻炼了，身体都变松弛了。丽塔：明天要跟我一起散步吗？我们可以走到海边。

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ili ħafna ma nagħmel eżerċizzju, u ġismi tpaxpax.
messages.mt_standard: Ili ħafna ma nagħmel eżerċizzju, u ġismi tpaxpax.
messages.zh: 我好久没锻炼了，身体都变松弛了。
messages.en: I haven't exercised in ages, and my body has become flabby.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tiġi timxi miegħi għada? Nistgħu mmorru sal-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Trid tiġi timxi miegħi għada? Nistgħu mmorru sal-baħar.
messages.zh: 明天要跟我一起散步吗？我们可以走到海边。
messages.en: Would you like to come for a walk with me tomorrow? We can walk down to the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tpaxpax 时想象身体从紧实变得松软的前后画面；重点记“变得松弛”这一变化过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A soft, loose condition of flesh or skin, lacking firmness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 肌肉或皮肤缺乏紧实度、显得松软或松弛的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat li fih il-laħam jew il-ġilda jkunu rotob u laxki, mingħajr sodizza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体组织松软、不结实的状态。
皮肤松弛、不紧致的状态。

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni ssemmi t-tpaxpix tal-ġilda madwar id-dirgħajn.
formal.en: The description mentions looseness of the skin around the arms.
formal.zh: 这段描述提到了手臂周围皮肤松弛的情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser tpaxpix f'din is-sentenza? Mark: Ifisser li l-ġilda tkun laxka u mhux soda.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does tpaxpix mean in this sentence? Mark: It means that the skin is loose and lacks firmness.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这句话里的 tpaxpix 是什么意思？马克：就是皮肤松弛、不紧实。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 tpaxpix 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tpaxpix mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-ġilda tkun laxka u mhux soda.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-ġilda tkun laxka u mhux soda.
messages.zh: 就是皮肤松弛、不紧实。
messages.en: It means that the skin is loose and lacks firmness.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它和手臂皮肤松松软软的画面联想，记住这是描述松弛状态的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel delighted or to take pleasure in an experience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某种经历而感到欣喜，或从中获得乐趣、尽情享受。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħass ferħ jew pjaċir kbir b'xi ħaġa jew b'esperjenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到欣喜；非常高兴。
享受；从某事中获得乐趣。

collocations.en: delighted in listening to the music

formal.mt: Il-pubbliku tpaxxa jisma' l-kunċert li sar fit-teatru.
formal.en: The audience delighted in listening to the concert held at the theatre.
formal.zh: 观众尽情享受了在剧院举行的音乐会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Leo ħa gost bil-ħarġa? Mark: Iva, tpaxxa bil-baħar u bil-veduta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Leo enjoy the outing? Mark: Yes, he really enjoyed the sea and the view.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：利奥这次出游玩得开心吗？马克：开心，他尽情享受了大海和风景。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 利奥这次出游玩得开心吗？
messages.en: Did Leo enjoy the outing?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 开心，他尽情享受了大海和风景。
messages.en: Yes, he really enjoyed the sea and the view.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人望着海景满脸陶醉，把这个动词记成开心地享受眼前体验。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Delight or pleasurable enjoyment, including festive revelry or luxurious comfort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 愉悦和享乐，也可指热闹的欢宴或奢华舒适的享受。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjaċir u ferħ; tista' tfisser ukoll briju waqt festa jew tgawdija ta' lussu u kumdità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欣喜；令人心情愉快的享受。
欢宴；热闹尽兴的欢庆活动。
奢华；超出基本需要的舒适享受。

collocations.en: a life of luxury and enjoyment

formal.mt: Il-ġnien, bil-fjuri u bil-kuluri tiegħu, huwa tpaxxija għall-għajnejn.
formal.en: The garden, with its flowers and colours, is a delight for the eyes.
formal.zh: 花园里鲜花盛开、色彩缤纷，令人赏心悦目。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kienet il-festa lbieraħ? Mark: Kienet lejla ta' tpaxxija, bil-kant u ż-żfin sa tard!
colloquial.en: Maja: How was the party yesterday? Mark: It was an evening of revelry, with singing and dancing until late!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：昨天的聚会怎么样？马克：真是尽兴的一晚，大家唱歌跳舞到很晚！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天的聚会怎么样？
messages.en: How was the party yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienet lejla ta' tpaxxija, bil-kant u ż-żfin sa tard!
messages.mt_standard: Kienet lejla ta' tpaxxija, bil-kant u ż-żfin sa tard!
messages.zh: 真是尽兴的一晚，大家唱歌跳舞到很晚！
messages.en: It was an evening of revelry, with singing and dancing until late!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用赏花的愉悦、宴会的欢庆和舒适的奢华三个画面，串起这个名词的三种意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make peace with someone after a disagreement or quarrel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在意见不合或争吵之后与某人和好，恢复和平关系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jerġa' jkun fi sliem ma' xi ħadd wara nuqqas ta' qbil jew ġlieda.

sense_translations.en_definition: to have made peace with sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经与某人和好；与某人达成了和解。

collocations.en: he made peace with his brother
he made peace after the quarrel

formal.mt: Wara diskussjoni twila, Mark tpaċa ma' sieħbu u t-tnejn qablu li jkomplu jaħdmu flimkien.
formal.en: After a long discussion, Mark made peace with his colleague, and both agreed to continue working together.
formal.zh: 经过长时间讨论，马克与同事和解了，两人同意继续合作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark għadu miġġieled ma' ħuh? Nina: Le, ilbieraħ tpaċa miegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is Mark still on bad terms with his brother? Nina: No, he made peace with him yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克还在跟兄弟闹矛盾吗？妮娜：没有，他昨天就跟兄弟和好了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克还在跟兄弟闹矛盾吗？
messages.en: Is Mark still on bad terms with his brother?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有，他昨天就跟兄弟和好了。
messages.en: No, he made peace with him yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两人争吵后重新握手，把 tpaċa 连同 ma' ħuh 一起记成“他与兄弟和好了”，突出和解已经发生。

gloss_zh: 对立双方之间的和解；调解

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of bringing rivals into peaceful relations with one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使相互对立或竞争的人恢复和平关系的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih persuni rivali jerġgħu jkunu fi sliem ma' xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 促成对立者之间的和解；使竞争或敌对双方恢复和平关系。

formal.mt: Il-medjatur mexxa l-laqgħa bil-għan li jiffaċilita t-tpaċija bejn iż-żewġ gruppi rivali.
formal.en: The mediator led the meeting with the aim of facilitating reconciliation between the two rival groups.
formal.zh: 调解人主持了会议，旨在促成两个对立团体之间的和解。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex sejħulhom għal-laqgħa? David: Biex jgħinu fit-tpaċija bejn iż-żewġ gruppi.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why were they called to the meeting? David: To help bring about reconciliation between the two groups.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：为什么叫他们来开会？戴维：为了帮助两个团体达成和解。

messages.speaker: Anna (社区居民)
messages.zh: 为什么叫他们来开会？
messages.en: Why were they called to the meeting?

messages.speaker: David (社区志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex jgħinu fit-tpaċija bejn iż-żewġ gruppi.
messages.mt_standard: Biex jgħinu fit-tpaċija bejn iż-żewġ gruppi.
messages.zh: 为了帮助两个团体达成和解。
messages.en: To help bring about reconciliation between the two groups.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tpaċija 想成两队对手围桌商谈的整个和解过程；记忆重点是“和解这件事”，因此它是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A question asking whether the person addressed speaks English.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 询问对方是否会说英语的问句。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mistoqsija biex tkun taf jekk il-persuna li qed tkellem tafx titkellem bl-Ingliż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 你会说英语吗？

collocations.en: Excuse me, do you speak English?
collocations.zh: 打扰一下，你会说英语吗？

collocations.en: Do you speak English or Maltese?
collocations.zh: 你说英语还是马耳他语？

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju bil-miktub, l-istudent juża l-mistoqsija 'Tpaċpaċ bl-Ingliż?' biex jistaqsi dwar il-lingwa tal-interlokutur.
formal.en: In the written exercise, the student uses the question 'Do you speak English?' to ask about the other person's language.
formal.zh: 在书面练习中，学生用“你会说英语吗？”询问交谈对象使用的语言。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Skużani, tpaċpaċ bl-Ingliż? Pawlu: Iva, kif nista' ngħinek?
colloquial.en: Emma: Excuse me, do you speak English? Pawlu: Yes, how can I help you?
colloquial.zh: 埃玛：打扰一下，你会说英语吗？保罗：会，有什么可以帮你的吗？

messages.speaker: Emma (游客)
messages.zh: 打扰一下，你会说英语吗？
messages.en: Excuse me, do you speak English?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (当地居民)
messages.zh: 会，有什么可以帮你的吗？
messages.en: Yes, how can I help you?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象旅行时先用 Skużani 引起注意，再整句问 Tpaċpaċ bl-Ingliż?；把它作为“你会说英语吗”的完整问句记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Light, informal conversation about everyday or unimportant matters.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围绕日常小事进行的轻松、非正式交谈。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħdit ħafif u informali dwar affarijiet ta' kuljum jew ta' ftit importanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闲聊；关于日常琐事的轻松交谈或寒暄。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa bdiet bi ftit tpaċpiċ dwar it-temp qabel ma l-parteċipanti ddiskutew l-aġenda.
formal.en: The meeting began with a little small talk about the weather before the participants discussed the agenda.
formal.zh: 会议开始时，大家先就天气寒暄了几句，然后才讨论议程。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dwar xiex kontu qed titkellmu? Luqa: Ftit tpaċpiċ dwar it-temp, xejn speċjali.
colloquial.en: Marta: What were you talking about? Luqa: Just a little small talk about the weather, nothing special.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你们刚才在聊什么？卢卡：就随便聊了聊天气，没什么特别的。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们刚才在聊什么？
messages.en: What were you talking about?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit tpaċpiċ dwar it-temp, xejn speċjali.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit tpaċpiċ dwar it-temp, xejn speċjali.
messages.zh: 就随便聊了聊天气，没什么特别的。
messages.en: Just a little small talk about the weather, nothing special.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tpaċpiċ 配上咖啡桌旁聊天气的画面：内容轻松、话题日常，整件事就是“闲聊”，不必涉及重要议题。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become soft and loose rather than firm, especially in the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体等由紧实变得松软、松弛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir artab u mitluq minflok sod, speċjalment meta jingħad għall-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得松弛、松软，尤指身体不再紧实。

collocations.zh: 他的身体稍微变松弛了

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru jinnota li ġismu tpaħpaħ matul is-snin.
formal.en: In the novel, the character notices that his body has become flabby over the years.
formal.zh: 在小说中，这个人物注意到自己的身体多年来变得松弛了。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Naħseb li ġismi tpaħpaħ ftit. Sara: Jien ma ndunajtx.
colloquial.en: Mark: I think my body has become a little flabby. Sara: I hadn't noticed.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我觉得自己的身体有点松弛了。萨拉：我倒没注意到。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我觉得自己的身体有点松弛了。
messages.en: I think my body has become a little flabby.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我倒没注意到。
messages.en: I hadn't noticed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用前后两幅图记 tpaħpaħ：前一幅紧实，后一幅松软。这个动词强调“变得松弛”的变化过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition of being soft and loose rather than firm, especially in the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体等缺乏紧实度、呈现松软松弛的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kundizzjoni ta' ġisem jew parti minnu li tkun ratba u mitluqa minflok soda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 松弛；身体等松软而不紧实的状态。

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni fil-ġrajja ssemmi t-tpaħpiħ ta' ġismu u l-ħwejjeġ wesgħin li kien jilbes.
formal.en: The description in the story mentions the flabbiness of his body and the loose clothes he used to wear.
formal.zh: 故事中的描写提到了他身体的松弛状态，以及他常穿的宽松衣服。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'tpaħpiħ' hawn? Lara: Tfisser li l-ġisem ikun artab u mitluq, mhux sod.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does the word 'tpaħpiħ' mean here? Lara: It means that the body is soft and loose rather than firm.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这里的 tpaħpiħ 是什么意思？拉拉：指身体松软、松弛，不紧实的状态。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 这里的 tpaħpiħ 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'tpaħpiħ' mean here?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li l-ġisem ikun artab u mitluq, mhux sod.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li l-ġisem ikun artab u mitluq, mhux sod.
messages.zh: 指身体松软、松弛，不紧实的状态。
messages.en: It means that the body is soft and loose rather than firm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tpaħpiħ 当作照片上标注的“松弛状态”：它是名词。与表示“变得松弛”的动词 tpaħpaħ 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be treated with smoke, or figuratively to be deceived or taken advantage of.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到烟熏处理；用于比喻时，指被欺骗或被人占便宜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġie trattat bid-duħħan; f'sens figurattiv, ġie mqarraq jew ingannat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被烟熏；受到烟熏处理或熏制。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be taken for a ride
sense_translations.zh_definition: 受骗上当；被人蒙骗或利用。

collocations.en: a customer who was taken for a ride

formal.mt: Il-ġobon tpejjep qabel ma ġie ppakkjat għall-bejgħ.
formal.en: The cheese was smoked before it was packaged for sale.
formal.zh: 奶酪在包装出售前经过了烟熏处理。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Leo tassew ħallas għal biljett falz? Mark: Iva, tpejjep; il-biljett ma kien jiswa xejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Leo really pay for a fake ticket? Mark: Yes, he was taken for a ride; the ticket was worthless.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：利奥真的花钱买了张假票？马克：是啊，他上当了，那张票根本没用。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Leo tassew ħallas għal biljett falz?
messages.mt_standard: Leo tassew ħallas għal biljett falz?
messages.zh: 利奥真的花钱买了张假票？
messages.en: Did Leo really pay for a fake ticket?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tpejjep; il-biljett ma kien jiswa xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tpejjep; il-biljett ma kien jiswa xejn.
messages.zh: 是啊，他上当了，那张票根本没用。
messages.en: Yes, he was taken for a ride; the ticket was worthless.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排记住两幅图：奶酪被烟熏、顾客被骗钱；再靠句子的主语判断具体意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of teasing someone by making them believe something untrue, or deceiving them to take advantage of them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让别人相信不实之事来开玩笑、戏弄，或以欺骗手段利用对方的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li bih wieħed iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jemmen xi ħaġa falza, bħala ċajta jew biex jieħu vantaġġ minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逗弄某人；编些不实的话让对方信以为真，以此开玩笑。
蒙骗某人；通过欺骗利用对方或占对方便宜。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-bejgħ ta' biljetti foloz bħala tpejjip tal-klijenti.
formal.en: The report describes the sale of fake tickets as taking customers for a ride.
formal.zh: 报告将出售假票的行为描述为蒙骗顾客。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Veru li rbaħt karozza? Mark: Le, kien biss tpejjip! Maja: Għal mument emmintek!
colloquial.en: Maja: Is it true that you won a car? Mark: No, I was just pulling your leg! Maja: For a moment I believed you!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你真的赢了一辆车吗？马克：没有，只是逗你玩！玛雅：我刚才还真信了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你真的赢了一辆车吗？
messages.en: Is it true that you won a car?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有，只是逗你玩！
messages.en: No, I was just pulling your leg!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我刚才还真信了！
messages.en: For a moment I believed you!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用朋友假称中奖来记住逗弄，用商家出售假票来记住蒙骗；这个名词指这些行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The singing or melodious calls of birds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟儿发出的鸣唱声，常指悦耳、连续的啁啾声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kant tal-għasafar, speċjalment meta jkun ħelu u pjaċevoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸟鸣；鸟儿的鸣唱声。

formal.mt: Filgħodu, it-tpennin tal-għasafar instema' fil-ġnien kollu.
formal.en: In the morning, birdsong could be heard throughout the garden.
formal.zh: 清晨，整个花园都能听见鸟儿的鸣唱声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tisma' dak it-tpennin? Mark: Iva, ġej mill-għasafar fis-siġra ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you hear that birdsong? Mark: Yes, it's coming from the birds in the tree beside the window.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你听见那阵鸟鸣了吗？Mark：听见了，是窗边那棵树上的鸟儿在叫。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听见那阵鸟鸣了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that birdsong?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej mill-għasafar fis-siġra ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej mill-għasafar fis-siġra ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 听见了，是窗边那棵树上的鸟儿在叫。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from the birds in the tree beside the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tpennin 和清晨开窗听鸟唱的画面绑定，记住它指听见的鸟鸣声。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To billow in the wind, or to hang suspended, especially as clothes do on a line.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 像旗帜那样在风中鼓动、飘扬；也指悬挂着，尤其用于晾衣绳上的衣物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintefaħ u jiċċaqlaq mar-riħ, jew ikun imdendel, speċjalment bħal ħwejjeġ fuq ħabel.

sense_translations.en_definition: to billow (e.g. of a flag in the wind)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在风中鼓动、飘扬，例如旗帜迎风展开起伏。

sense_translations.en_definition: to hang (used especially of clothes on a line)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 悬挂着，尤其指衣物挂在晾衣绳上。

collocations.en: to hang on the washing line

formal.mt: Id-drapp tperper mal-ħabel tal-ħasil matul wara nofsinhar.
formal.en: The cloth hung on the washing line throughout the afternoon.
formal.zh: 整个下午，那块布都挂在晾衣绳上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt id-drapp aħmar fuq il-bejt? Mark: Iva, tperper fir-riħ qisu bandiera.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see the red cloth on the roof? Mark: Yes, it billowed in the wind like a flag.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看见屋顶上的那块红布了吗？Mark：看见了，它像旗帜一样迎风鼓动。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看见屋顶上的那块红布了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the red cloth on the roof?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 看见了，它像旗帜一样迎风鼓动。
messages.en: Yes, it billowed in the wind like a flag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象晾衣绳上的布先悬挂着，风来时又鼓起飘动，用同一画面记住 tperper 的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The billowing or flapping movement of something in the wind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体在风中鼓起、起伏或反复拍动的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment ta' xi ħaġa li tintefaħ jew titħabbat mar-riħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鼓动；布料等鼓起并起伏的动作。
迎风拍动；物体被风吹得来回摆动、拍打的动作。

formal.mt: It-tperpir tal-bandiera kien jidher ċar fir-riħ qawwi.
formal.en: The billowing of the flag was clearly visible in the strong wind.
formal.zh: 强风中，可以清楚地看见旗帜鼓动起伏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak il-ħoss ħdejn id-dgħajsa? Mark: Dak it-tperpir tal-qlugħ; ir-riħ qiegħed iħabbathom.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that sound near the boat? Mark: That's the flapping of the sails; the wind is making them flap.
colloquial.zh: Maja：船旁边是什么声音？Mark：那是船帆拍动的声音，风正吹得它们来回拍打。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 船旁边是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that sound near the boat?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak it-tperpir tal-qlugħ; ir-riħ qiegħed iħabbathom.
messages.mt_standard: Dak it-tperpir tal-qlugħ; ir-riħ qiegħed iħabbathom.
messages.zh: 那是船帆拍动的声音，风正吹得它们来回拍打。
messages.en: That's the flapping of the sails; the wind is making them flap.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tperpir 配上旗帜鼓起、船帆啪啪拍动的短动画，记住它是动作名称这一名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To expose oneself to a chilly draught.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让自己处在一股冷风中，例如待在有冷风吹入的敞开窗边。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jesponi ruħu għal kurrent ta' arja kiesħa, bħal ħdejn tieqa miftuħa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to expose oneself to a chilly draught
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使自己暴露在一股冷风中；让冷风吹着自己。

collocations.en: to expose oneself to a chilly draught beside an open window
collocations.zh: 在敞开的窗边让冷风吹着自己

collocations.en: to expose oneself to a chilly draught in the doorway
collocations.zh: 在门口让冷风吹着自己

formal.mt: Waqt il-waqfa, Mark tperreċ ħdejn it-tieqa miftuħa, fejn kien dieħel kurrent ta' arja kiesħa.
formal.en: During the break, Mark exposed himself to a chilly draught beside the open window, where cold air was coming in.
formal.zh: 休息时，Mark 待在敞开的窗边，让吹进来的冷风吹着自己。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark daħal ġewwa? Pawlu: Tperreċ fil-bieb u ħass il-bard.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark come inside? Pawlu: He exposed himself to the chilly draught in the doorway and felt cold.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 为什么进屋了？Pawlu：他在门口吹了冷风，觉得冷了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 为什么进屋了？
messages.en: Why did Mark come inside?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 他在门口吹了冷风，觉得冷了。
messages.en: He exposed himself to the chilly draught in the doorway and felt cold.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己站在敞开的窗边，冷风一阵阵吹过来；用这个具体场景记住 tperreċ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become sluggish or feel weary and lacking in energy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得精神不振、行动迟缓，或感到疲倦而缺乏精力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir bla ħeġġa jew iħoss għeja u nuqqas ta' enerġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐变得懒倦、无精打采。
感到倦怠乏力，提不起精神。

collocations.en: to grow lethargic after a meal
to feel weary after a long day
collocations.zh: 忙了一整天后感到乏力

formal.mt: Wara sigħat ta' stennija, Mark tperċaħ u ma kellux ħeġġa biex ikompli jaqra.
formal.en: After hours of waiting, Mark grew lethargic and lacked the energy to continue reading.
formal.zh: 等了几个小时后，Mark 变得无精打采，提不起精神继续阅读。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu għadu fuq is-sufan? Mark: Tperċaħ wara ġurnata twila u jrid jistrieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is Pawlu still on the sofa? Mark: He feels worn out after a long day and wants to rest a little.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 怎么还坐在沙发上？Mark：他忙了一整天，感到很乏力，想休息一会儿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 怎么还坐在沙发上？
messages.en: Why is Pawlu still on the sofa?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tperċaħ wara ġurnata twila u jrid jistrieħ ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Tperċaħ wara ġurnata twila u jrid jistrieħ ftit.
messages.zh: 他忙了一整天，感到很乏力，想休息一会儿。
messages.en: He feels worn out after a long day and wants to rest a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人等得没了精神、整个人瘫在沙发上，用 tperċaħ 记住变得懒倦这一变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of sluggishness, low energy, or weariness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 精神不振、缺乏精力或感到疲乏的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' nuqqas ta' ħeġġa, nuqqas ta' enerġija jew għeja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倦怠；无精打采、缺乏活力的状态。
疲乏；身心疲倦的感觉。

formal.mt: Fl-aħħar tal-ġurnata, sens ta' tperċiħ għamilha diffiċli għal Mark biex jikkonċentra fuq ir-rapport.
formal.en: At the end of the day, a feeling of weariness made it difficult for Mark to concentrate on the report.
formal.zh: 一天快结束时，一阵疲乏感让 Mark 难以集中精神处理报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqaft taqra? Mark: Għandi sens ta' tperċiħ; se nistrieħ ftit u mbagħad inkompli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you stop reading? Mark: I'm feeling weary; I'll rest a little and then carry on.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么不读了？Mark：我觉得有些疲乏，先休息一会儿再继续。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么不读了？
messages.en: Why did you stop reading?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi sens ta' tperċiħ; se nistrieħ ftit u mbagħad inkompli.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi sens ta' tperċiħ; se nistrieħ ftit u mbagħad inkompli.
messages.zh: 我觉得有些疲乏，先休息一会儿再继续。
messages.en: I'm feeling weary; I'll rest a little and then carry on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tperċiħ 当作给疲乏状态贴的标签；与表示变得懒倦的动词 tperċaħ 配对记忆。

gloss_zh: 被低声说出；被贴耳嘶声说出

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be spoken in a whisper or hissed into someone's ear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指话语被轻声说出，或被人贴近耳朵用嘶声说出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad b'leħen baxx ħafna jew b'ħoss bħal s f'widnejn xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被低声说出；被悄悄耳语传达。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be hissed in sb.'s ear
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被贴近某人的耳朵，用低低的嘶声说出。

collocations.en: to be whispered or hissed into someone's ear
collocations.zh: 被贴近某人的耳朵低声或嘶声说出

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, is-sigriet tpespes bejn żewġ parteċipanti biex ħadd aktar ma jisimgħu.
formal.en: During the meeting, the secret was whispered between two participants so that nobody else would hear it.
formal.zh: 会议期间，两名与会者低声传递了这个秘密，以免其他人听见。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt l-isem li ntqal? Mark: Bilkemm; l-isem tpespes f'widni b'leħen baxx ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear the name that was said? Mark: Barely; the name was whispered into my ear very quietly.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你听清刚才说的名字了吗？Mark：勉强听见，那个名字是贴着我的耳朵很轻地说出来的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听清刚才说的名字了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear the name that was said?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bilkemm; l-isem tpespes f'widni b'leħen baxx ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Bilkemm; l-isem tpespes f'widni b'leħen baxx ħafna.
messages.zh: 勉强听见，那个名字是贴着我的耳朵很轻地说出来的。
messages.en: Barely; the name was whispered into my ear very quietly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个秘密被贴耳轻声传递；学习 tpespes 时，把注意力放在话语被低声说出。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Whispering or the production of a low hissing sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 轻声耳语的行为或声音，也可指发出低低的嘶声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħdit b'leħen baxx ħafna jew ħoss baxx bħal s.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 耳语；低声说话的行为或声音。
嘶声；发出类似低低的“嘶嘶”声。

formal.mt: Waqt il-preżentazzjoni, it-tpespis bejn xi parteċipanti fixkel lil dawk li kienu qed jisimgħu.
formal.en: During the presentation, whispering between some participants disturbed those who were listening.
formal.zh: 演示期间，部分与会者的耳语打扰了正在听讲的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn ġej dak it-tpespis? Mark: Minn dawk iż-żewġ ħbieb hemm wara; qed jitkellmu bil-mod biex ma jfixklux.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is that whispering coming from? Mark: From those two friends at the back; they're speaking quietly so they don't disturb anyone.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那阵耳语是从哪里传来的？Mark：是后面那两个朋友，他们怕打扰别人，所以压低了声音。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 那阵耳语是从哪里传来的？
messages.en: Where is that whispering coming from?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn dawk iż-żewġ ħbieb hemm wara; qed jitkellmu bil-mod biex ma jfixklux.
messages.mt_standard: Minn dawk iż-żewġ ħbieb hemm wara; qed jitkellmu bil-mod biex ma jfixklux.
messages.zh: 是后面那两个朋友，他们怕打扰别人，所以压低了声音。
messages.en: From those two friends at the back; they're speaking quietly so they don't disturb anyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tpespis 记作一小团低低的声音：有人悄悄说话，也可能发出嘶声；它是声音或行为的名词。

gloss_zh: 眨眼；微光闪烁；忽明忽暗

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of blinking, or the glimmering or flickering of light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 眼睛反复开合的动作，或光线微微闪动、忽明忽暗的现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment tal-għajnejn meta jingħalqu u jinfetħu, jew dawl li jiddi b'mod ħafif jew mhux stabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 眨眼；眼睑反复闭合和张开的动作。
微光闪动；微弱光芒时隐时现。
光线闪烁；亮度不稳定而忽明忽暗。

formal.mt: It-tpetpit tad-dawl fil-kuritur ġie rrappurtat lill-persuna responsabbli mill-manutenzjoni.
formal.en: The flickering of the light in the corridor was reported to the person responsible for maintenance.
formal.zh: 走廊灯光闪烁的情况已报告给维修负责人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan it-tpetpit tad-dawl qed idejjaqni. Pawlu: Ejja nixegħlu l-lampa l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: This flickering light is bothering me. Pawlu: Let's turn on the other lamp.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这盏灯一直闪，弄得我很烦。Pawlu：我们把另一盏灯打开吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 这盏灯一直闪，弄得我很烦。
messages.en: This flickering light is bothering me.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 我们把另一盏灯打开吧。
messages.en: Let's turn on the other lamp.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把眨眼和灯光闪动放在同一幅画面里：眼睛一开一合，灯光一亮一暗，都是反复闪动的感觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of passing urine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 排出尿液的行为，即小便这一动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed joħroġ l-awrina minn ġismu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 排尿；将尿液排出体外的动作。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti ntalbu jirreġistraw il-ħin tat-tpexpix fid-djarju tagħhom.
formal.en: The participants were asked to record the time of urination in their diaries.
formal.zh: 参与者被要求在各自的日志中记录排尿时间。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Agħlaq il-bieb waqt it-tpexpix, jekk jogħġbok. Toni: Tajjeb, nagħlqu issa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Close the door while you pee, please. Toni: Okay, I'll close it now.
colloquial.zh: Marija：小便的时候请把门关上。Toni：好，我现在就关。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Agħlaq il-bieb waqt it-tpexpix, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Agħlaq il-bieb waqt it-tpexpix, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 小便的时候请把门关上。
messages.en: Close the door while you pee, please.

messages.speaker: Toni (儿子)
messages.zh: 好，我现在就关。
messages.en: Okay, I'll close it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用厕所里的时间顺序记忆：排尿时对应 waqt it-tpexpix，排尿后对应 wara t-tpexpix，中心词表示排尿动作。

gloss_zh: 鸟鸣；鸟儿啾啾叫的声音

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chirping sounds made by birds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟儿发出的短促、清脆的啾啾鸣叫声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħsejjes qosra u rqaq li jagħmlu l-għasafar meta jgħannu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸟儿的啾啾鸣叫声；鸟鸣。

formal.mt: Matul l-osservazzjoni ta' filgħodu, it-tpezpiz tal-għasafar instema' ċar fil-ġnien.
formal.en: During the morning observation, the chirping of birds could be heard clearly in the garden.
formal.zh: 在早晨的观察过程中，可以清楚地听到花园里的鸟鸣。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tisma' t-tpezpiz tal-għasafar? Mark: Iva, ġej mis-siġra ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you hear the birds chirping? Mark: Yes, it's coming from the tree beside the window.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你听见鸟儿在叫吗？Mark：听见了，声音是从窗边那棵树上传来的。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听见鸟儿在叫吗？
messages.en: Can you hear the birds chirping?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 听见了，声音是从窗边那棵树上传来的。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from the tree beside the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象清晨推开窗，树上小鸟接连啾啾叫；把整个鸟鸣声景与 tpezpiz 连在一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Casual or excessive talk with little substance, sometimes involving gossip about others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 内容不多的闲谈或说个不停的絮叨，有时也指议论他人私事的八卦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem bla wisq sustanza, ħafna diskors żejjed, jew tqassis dwar nies oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无关紧要的闲聊；漫无目的的闲谈。
絮絮叨叨；说个不停而内容琐碎。
八卦；关于他人私事的闲言闲语。

formal.mt: It-tpeċliq waqt il-laqgħa ħa ħafna ħin u dewwem id-diskussjoni prinċipali.
formal.en: The idle chatter during the meeting took up a lot of time and delayed the main discussion.
formal.zh: 会议上的闲聊占用了大量时间，拖延了主要议题的讨论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kienu jgħidu dwar il-ġirien? Mark: Tpeċliq biss; ma nafx jekk hux veru.
colloquial.en: Maja: What were they saying about the neighbours? Mark: Just gossip; I don't know whether it's true.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他们刚才在说邻居什么？马克：只是些八卦，我也不知道是真是假。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他们刚才在说邻居什么？
messages.en: What were they saying about the neighbours?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tpeċliq biss; ma nafx jekk hux veru.
messages.mt_standard: Tpeċliq biss; ma nafx jekk hux veru.
messages.zh: 只是些八卦，我也不知道是真是假。
messages.en: Just gossip; I don't know whether it's true.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象茶桌旁话说了一大堆却没有重点，再联想到议论邻居，记住闲聊、絮叨和八卦。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To blink repeatedly or to strain one's eyes while trying to see something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接连眨眼，或为了看清东西而费力用眼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għalaq u fetaħ għajnejh kemm-il darba, jew sforza għajnejh biex jara xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复眨眼；接连闭眼再睁开。
费力用眼；为了看清而使眼睛吃力。

collocations.en: blinked repeatedly in the bright light
strained his eyes to read the small letters

formal.mt: Pawlu tpeċpeċ biex jaqra l-ittri żgħar fuq it-tikketta.
formal.en: Pawlu strained his eyes to read the small letters on the label.
formal.zh: 保罗费力地辨认标签上的小字。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Leo tpeċpeċ hekk meta ħareġ? Mark: Ix-xemx kienet qawwija ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Leo blink so much when he went outside? Mark: The sunlight was very bright.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：利奥出去时怎么眨了那么多下眼睛？马克：阳光太强了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Leo tpeċpeċ hekk meta ħareġ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Leo tpeċpeċ hekk meta ħareġ?
messages.zh: 利奥出去时怎么眨了那么多下眼睛？
messages.en: Why did Leo blink so much when he went outside?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 阳光太强了。
messages.en: The sunlight was very bright.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词中重复出现的片段当作记忆节拍，联想眼皮一开一合；看小字吃力时再联想另一义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The effort or strain placed on the eyes when trying hard to see.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了看清东西而产生的用眼负担或眼睛吃力的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isforz li jsir bl-għajnejn meta wieħed jipprova jara b'diffikultà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 眼睛承受的负担；费力看东西时的用眼吃力。

collocations.en: eye strain from trying to see better
collocations.zh: 为了看得更清楚而费力用眼

formal.mt: Il-qarrej semma t-tpeċpiċ tal-għajnejn waqt il-qari tat-test b'ittri żgħar.
formal.en: The reader mentioned eye strain while reading the text in small print.
formal.zh: 这位读者提到，阅读小字文本时眼睛很吃力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' taqra din it-tikketta? Mark: B'dan it-tpeċpiċ kollu, aħjar inġib il-lenti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you read this label? Mark: With all this effort to see, I'd better get the magnifying glass.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能看清这个标签吗？马克：看得这么费劲，我还是去拿放大镜吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你能看清这个标签吗？
messages.en: Can you read this label?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: B'dan it-tpeċpiċ kollu, aħjar inġib il-lenti.
messages.mt_standard: B'dan it-tpeċpiċ kollu, aħjar inġib il-lenti.
messages.zh: 看得这么费劲，我还是去拿放大镜吧。
messages.en: With all this effort to see, I'd better get the magnifying glass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象盯着标签上的小字看得眼睛吃力，把这个名词记成用眼时承受的负担。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be painted, drawn, or tattooed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被人用颜料画出、用笔绘出，或作为纹身图案纹在皮肤上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħata forma bħala stampa bil-kulur jew bil-lapes, jew bħala tatwaġġ fuq il-ġilda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被绘成画；被人用颜料画出。
被绘出；被人用笔等工具画出来。
被纹上；图案被作为纹身纹在皮肤上。

formal.mt: Il-pajsaġġ tpinġa bl-akwarell u ġie esebit fil-wirja tal-iskola.
formal.en: The landscape was painted in watercolour and displayed at the school exhibition.
formal.zh: 这幅风景画用水彩绘成，并在学校展览中展出。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan id-disinn tpinġa bil-lapes? Leo: Iva, oħti għamlitu lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Nina: Was this design drawn in pencil? Leo: Yes, my sister did it yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个图案是用铅笔画的吗？Leo：是的，我姐姐昨天画的。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个图案是用铅笔画的吗？
messages.en: Was this design drawn in pencil?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，我姐姐昨天画的。
messages.en: Yes, my sister did it yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 让图案站在句子中心：它被颜料画出、被铅笔绘出，或被纹在皮肤上；共同记住图案承受绘制这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be painted as a picture or artistic image.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为图画或艺术形象被人用颜料绘制出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinħoloq bħala kwadru jew xbieha permezz tal-pittura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被绘成；被人用颜料画出来。

formal.mt: Il-kwadru tpitter biż-żejt fuq it-tila u ġie ppreżentat lill-pubbliku fil-gallerija.
formal.en: The picture was painted in oils on canvas and presented to the public at the gallery.
formal.zh: 这幅画以油彩绘于画布上，并在画廊向公众展示。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dan il-kwadru tpitter hawn? David: Iva, l-artist ħadem ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Rita: Was this picture painted here? David: Yes, the artist worked beside the window.
colloquial.zh: Rita：这幅画是在这里画的吗？David：是的，画家当时就在窗边作画。

messages.speaker: Rita (参观者)
messages.zh: 这幅画是在这里画的吗？
messages.en: Was this picture painted here?

messages.speaker: David (画室主人)
messages.zh: 是的，画家当时就在窗边作画。
messages.en: Yes, the artist worked beside the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象画布上的作品在回答来历：这幅画在哪里被画成、用什么颜料画成；用被绘制的作品来记住这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity or process of painting a picture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用颜料绘制一幅图画的活动或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li wieħed joħloq kwadru bil-kuluri.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of painting a picture
sense_translations.zh_definition: 作画这一行为；绘制一幅图画的过程。

formal.mt: Il-lezzjoni kienet iddedikata għat-tpittir ta' pajsaġġ, b'attenzjoni għall-għażla tal-kuluri.
formal.en: The lesson was devoted to painting a landscape, with attention to the choice of colours.
formal.zh: 这堂课专门练习风景画的绘制，并着重关注色彩的选择。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif marret il-lezzjoni tat-tpittir? Ben: Tajjeb ħafna! Pinġejt il-baħar u żewġ dgħajjes.
colloquial.en: Anna: How did the painting lesson go? Ben: Very well! I painted the sea and two boats.
colloquial.zh: Anna：绘画课上得怎么样？Ben：很好！我画了大海和两条船。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.zh: 绘画课上得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the painting lesson go?

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb ħafna! Pinġejt il-baħar u żewġ dgħajjes.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb ħafna! Pinġejt il-baħar u żewġ dgħajjes.
messages.zh: 很好！我画了大海和两条船。
messages.en: Very well! I painted the sea and two boats.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把注意力放在调色、下笔到完成图画的整个过程：tpittir 是作画这项活动，可与绘画课的场景一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be put or placed in a particular position or location.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被人放到某个位置或地点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitqiegħed f'post jew f'pożizzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被放；被人放到某处。
被放置；被安放在某个位置。

formal.mt: Il-vażun tpoġġa fiċ-ċentru tal-mejda qabel il-wasla tal-mistednin.
formal.en: The vase was placed in the centre of the table before the guests arrived.
formal.zh: 客人到来之前，花瓶被放在了桌子中央。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fejn tpoġġa l-ktieb tiegħi? Ġanni: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn it-telefon.
colloquial.en: Marta: Where was my book put? Ġanni: On the table, next to the phone.
colloquial.zh: Marta：我的书被放到哪里了？Ġanni：在桌子上，电话旁边。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.zh: 我的书被放到哪里了？
messages.en: Where was my book put?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (室友)
messages.zh: 在桌子上，电话旁边。
messages.en: On the table, next to the phone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一本书被放到桌上，再问它被放在哪里；把物品和落点连起来，记住 tpoġġa 表示被放置。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of putting, placing, or depositing something in a particular place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某物放到、摆到或存放到某个地方的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iqiegħed xi ħaġa f'post partikolari jew jiddepożitaha hemm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放置；将某物安放或安排在特定位置。
放这一动作；把某物放到某处的行为。
存放；将某物放入指定地点或将钱款存入账户的行为。

collocations.en: putting the books on the shelf
collocations.zh: 把书放到书架上的动作

collocations.en: the deposit of money into a bank account

formal.mt: Il-pjan juri t-tpoġġija tal-għamara fis-sala u jħalli spazju biżżejjed għall-mogħdija.
formal.en: The plan shows the placement of the furniture in the hall and leaves enough space for passage.
formal.zh: 平面图标明了大厅内家具的摆放，并留出了足够的通行空间。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Togħġbok it-tpoġġija tal-għamara? Karl: Iva, imma ejja nressqu s-siġġu eqreb lejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Elena: Do you like the furniture arrangement? Karl: Yes, but let's move the chair closer to the window.
colloquial.zh: Elena：你喜欢家具这样摆放吗？Karl：喜欢，不过我们把椅子挪得离窗户近一点吧。

messages.speaker: Elena (室友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢家具这样摆放吗？
messages.en: Do you like the furniture arrangement?

messages.speaker: Karl (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ejja nressqu s-siġġu eqreb lejn it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ejja nressqu s-siġġu eqreb lejn it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 喜欢，不过我们把椅子挪得离窗户近一点吧。
messages.en: Yes, but let's move the chair closer to the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个落点记忆这个名词：家具放在房间里、书放在架子上、钱存进账户中，共同指放置或存放这件事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Habitation, or the place and environment in which people, animals or plants live.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 居住，或人、动物、植物生活的地方及环境；用于自然环境时可指栖息地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għajxien f'post, jew il-post u l-ambjent fejn jgħixu nies, annimali jew pjanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 居住；在某地生活。
栖息地；生物生活的自然环境。

formal.mt: Il-ħarsien tat-tpożdija naturali huwa essenzjali biex dawn l-għasafar jibqgħu jgħixu f'din iż-żona.
formal.en: Protecting the natural habitat is essential for these birds to continue living in this area.
formal.zh: 保护自然栖息地，是让这些鸟类继续在这一地区生存的必要条件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex irridu nżommu din l-għadira nadifa? Pawlu: Għax hija tpożdija naturali għal ħafna annimali żgħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do we need to keep this pond clean? Pawlu: Because it is a natural habitat for many small animals.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们为什么要保持这个池塘清洁？保罗：因为这里是许多小动物的自然栖息地。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex irridu nżommu din l-għadira nadifa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex irridu nżommu din l-għadira nadifa?
messages.zh: 我们为什么要保持这个池塘清洁？
messages.en: Why do we need to keep this pond clean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hija tpożdija naturali għal ħafna annimali żgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hija tpożdija naturali għal ħafna annimali żgħar.
messages.zh: 因为这里是许多小动物的自然栖息地。
messages.en: Because it is a natural habitat for many small animals.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把人居住的地方和动物栖息的环境画在同一张图里，用“生活在哪里”串联两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be engaged to perform a task, or to be set alight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受聘或受委托执行某项任务；也指某物被点燃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mqabbad biex iwettaq biċċa xogħol, jew jingħata n-nar.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be engaged to carry out a task
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被雇用或受委托执行某项任务。
被点燃；被放火烧着。

collocations.en: was engaged to repair the roof

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem tqabbad biex isewwi s-saqaf tal-iskola matul il-vaganzi.
formal.en: The worker was engaged to repair the school's roof during the holidays.
formal.zh: 这名工人受聘在假期期间修理学校的屋顶。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min se jsewwi s-saqaf? Mark: Ġużeppi tqabbad biex jagħmel ix-xogħol. Ġej għada.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is going to repair the roof? Mark: Ġużeppi was engaged to do the job. He is coming tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁来修屋顶？马克：已经请了朱塞佩来做。他明天过来。

messages.speaker: Lara (住户)
messages.zh: 谁来修屋顶？
messages.en: Who is going to repair the roof?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġużeppi tqabbad biex jagħmel ix-xogħol. Ġej għada.
messages.mt_standard: Ġużeppi tqabbad biex jagħmel ix-xogħol. Ġej għada.
messages.zh: 已经请了朱塞佩来做。他明天过来。
messages.en: Ġużeppi was engaged to do the job. He is coming tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记两幅画：工人接到修屋顶的任务，篝火被人点起；用人物和火焰区分两个义项。

gloss_zh: 被调整适配；被配对；被比较；被出租（土地）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be adapted to something, matched, compared, or leased, especially when referring to farmland.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被调整以适应某事物、被配对或被比较；也可指土地被出租，尤用于农田。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi adattat għal xi ħaġa, imqabbel ma' xi ħaġa oħra, jew mogħti bil-kera, speċjalment fil-każ ta' art agrikola.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被调整或改编，以适应某事物。
被配对；被配成相合的一组。
被比较；与另一事物作对照。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be leased (usually used of farmland)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被出租、租给他人使用，通常用于农田。

collocations.zh: 与另一份报告作了比较
被安排与一名搭档配对

formal.mt: Ir-rapport il-ġdid tqabbel ma' dak tas-sena li għaddiet biex jiġu identifikati l-bidliet.
formal.en: The new report was compared with last year's report to identify the changes.
formal.zh: 新报告与去年的报告进行了比较，以找出其中的变化。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ma' min tqabbel Mark għal-logħba? Lara: Ma' Pawlu. Se jilagħbu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who was Mark paired with for the game? Lara: With Pawlu. They are going to play together.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：比赛时马克被安排和谁搭档？拉拉：和保罗。他们会一起比赛。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 比赛时马克被安排和谁搭档？
messages.en: Who was Mark paired with for the game?

messages.speaker: Lara (队友)
messages.zh: 和保罗。他们会一起比赛。
messages.en: With Pawlu. They are going to play together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做四张情境卡分别记忆：方案适配、人员配对、报告比较、农田出租；读句子时先找情境线索。

gloss_zh: 被使跳跃；被不当地优先安排

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made to jump, or to be given priority that one does not deserve.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被促使或要求跳跃；也指被给予不应享有的优先待遇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mġiegħel jaqbeż, jew jingħata prijorità li ma jistħoqqlux.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被使跳跃；被要求或促使跳过去。
被不当地优先安排；获得不应享有的优先待遇。

collocations.en: was made to jump over an obstacle
was unfairly allowed ahead in the queue
collocations.zh: 被不当地安排插到队伍前面

formal.mt: Waqt it-taħriġ, iż-żiemel tqabbeż minn fuq ostaklu baxx.
formal.en: During training, the horse was made to jump over a low obstacle.
formal.zh: 训练期间，这匹马被要求跳过一道低矮的障碍物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif daħal qabilna jekk wasal warajna? Mark: Tqabbeż fil-kju mingħajr raġuni. Mhux sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did he get in before us if he arrived after us? Mark: He was allowed ahead in the queue without a reason. That is not fair.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他明明比我们晚到，怎么先进去的？马克：他没有理由就被安排到前面了。这不公平。

messages.speaker: Maja (排队顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif daħal qabilna jekk wasal warajna?
messages.mt_standard: Kif daħal qabilna jekk wasal warajna?
messages.zh: 他明明比我们晚到，怎么先进去的？
messages.en: How did he get in before us if he arrived after us?

messages.speaker: Mark (排队顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tqabbeż fil-kju mingħajr raġuni. Mhux sew.
messages.mt_standard: Tqabbeż fil-kju mingħajr raġuni. Mhux sew.
messages.zh: 他没有理由就被安排到前面了。这不公平。
messages.en: He was allowed ahead in the queue without a reason. That is not fair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想马被要求跳过栏杆，再想有人被安排越过队伍；这只是帮助区分义项的情境联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The engagement of someone to perform a particular task or job.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 聘请或委托某人执行特定任务、承担某项工作的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' biċċa xogħol jew ta' kompitu lil xi ħadd biex iwettqu.

sense_translations.en_definition: engagement of sb. to carry out a task
sense_translations.zh_definition: 聘请或委托某人执行一项任务。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat approva t-tqabbid ta' espert biex jeżamina l-kundizzjoni tal-bini.
formal.en: The committee approved the engagement of an expert to examine the condition of the building.
formal.zh: 委员会批准聘请一名专家检查建筑物的状况。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi ddeċidejtu dwar is-saqaf? Mark: Qbilna dwar it-tqabbid ta' ħaddiem. Se jibda nhar it-Tnejn.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did you decide about the roof? Mark: We agreed on engaging a worker. He will start on Monday.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：屋顶的事你们怎么决定了？马克：我们同意请一名工人。他星期一开工。

messages.speaker: Lara (住户)
messages.zh: 屋顶的事你们怎么决定了？
messages.en: What did you decide about the roof?

messages.speaker: Mark (住户代表)
messages.mt_spoken: Qbilna dwar it-tqabbid ta' ħaddiem. Se jibda nhar it-Tnejn.
messages.mt_standard: Qbilna dwar it-tqabbid ta' ħaddiem. Se jibda nhar it-Tnejn.
messages.zh: 我们同意请一名工人。他星期一开工。
messages.en: We agreed on engaging a worker. He will start on Monday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张写着姓名和工作任务的委托单，把这个名词记成“请某人来办这件事”这一行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rhyming words, especially in verse, or matching things or people into corresponding pairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使词语押韵，尤其用于诗歌；也指把事物或人员配成相应的一组。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-użu ta' kliem li jirrima, speċjalment fil-poeżija, jew it-tqegħid ta' affarijiet jew persuni f'pari li jaqblu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 押韵；使词语，尤其诗行末尾的词语，具有相呼应的韵音。
配对；将相对应或相配的事物、人员组成一组。

formal.mt: It-tqabbil tal-kliem fl-aħħar tal-versi jgħin biex il-poeżija tinstema' aktar mużikali.
formal.en: Rhyming the words at the ends of the lines helps the poem sound more musical.
formal.zh: 让诗行末尾的词语押韵，有助于增强诗歌的音乐感。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'irridu nagħmlu b'dawn il-karti? Pawlu: Nagħmlu tqabbil ta' stampi ma' kliem. Poġġi kull stampa ħdejn il-kelma t-tajba.
colloquial.en: Nina: What do we need to do with these cards? Pawlu: We need to match pictures with words. Put each picture beside the correct word.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这些卡片要怎么用？保罗：我们要做图片与词语配对。把每张图片放在对应的词语旁边。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这些卡片要怎么用？
messages.en: What do we need to do with these cards?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħmlu tqabbil ta' stampi ma' kliem. Poġġi kull stampa ħdejn il-kelma t-tajba.
messages.mt_standard: Nagħmlu tqabbil ta' stampi ma' kliem. Poġġi kull stampa ħdejn il-kelma t-tajba.
messages.zh: 我们要做图片与词语配对。把每张图片放在对应的词语旁边。
messages.en: We need to match pictures with words. Put each picture beside the correct word.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两种配合来记忆：诗句末尾的声音彼此押韵，桌上的图片和词卡彼此配对。

gloss_zh: 插队；给予不应有的优先待遇

teaching_sense.en_definition: Queue-jumping, or giving someone undeserved priority, such as in a queue or a promotion process.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 插队，或在排队、晋升等安排中给予某人不应享有的优先待遇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qbiż tal-kju jew l-għoti ta' prijorità lil xi ħadd li ma jistħoqqlux, pereżempju fi kju jew fi proċess ta' promozzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 插队；不按原有排队次序提前。

sense_translations.en_definition: giving priority to sb. who does not merit it (e.g. in a queue or in a promotion exercise)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给予某人不应享有的优先待遇，例如在排队或晋升安排中让其不当地优先。

collocations.zh: 在晋升中给予不应有的优先待遇

formal.mt: Il-proċedura għandha tkun ċara biex jiġi evitat it-tqabbiż fil-promozzjonijiet.
formal.en: The procedure should be clear to prevent people from receiving undeserved priority in promotions.
formal.zh: 程序应当清晰，以避免有人在晋升中获得不应享有的优先待遇。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed jilmentaw in-nies fil-kju? Mark: Minħabba t-tqabbiż. Xi nies qed jidħlu qabel min ilu jistenna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are the people in the queue complaining? Mark: Because of queue-jumping. Some people are going in ahead of those who have been waiting.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：排队的人为什么在抱怨？马克：因为有人插队。有些人比已经等了很久的人先进去。

messages.speaker: Maja (排队顾客)
messages.zh: 排队的人为什么在抱怨？
messages.en: Why are the people in the queue complaining?

messages.speaker: Mark (排队顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tqabbiż. Xi nies qed jidħlu qabel min ilu jistenna.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tqabbiż. Xi nies qed jidħlu qabel min ilu jistenna.
messages.zh: 因为有人插队。有些人比已经等了很久的人先进去。
messages.en: Because of queue-jumping. Some people are going in ahead of those who have been waiting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条排队线和一张晋升名单，再画人无理挤到前面；两种场景都突出“不应有的优先”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To examine things together in order to identify both their similarities and their differences.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把事物放在一起考察，找出它们的相同点和不同点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Teżamina affarijiet flimkien biex tara kemm ix-xebh kif ukoll id-differenzi bejniethom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 比较并对照；考察事物之间的相同点与不同点。

collocations.en: was compared and contrasted with another text
collocations.zh: 与另一篇文本比较异同

collocations.en: was compared and contrasted with a similar case

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi, it-test tqabel ma' test ieħor biex joħorġu ċari kemm ix-xebh kif ukoll id-differenzi.
formal.en: In the analysis, the text was compared and contrasted with another text to make both the similarities and the differences clear.
formal.zh: 在分析中，这篇文本与另一篇文本进行了对照，以明确呈现两者的相同点和不同点。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'għamilna b'dan it-test fil-lezzjoni? Pawlu: Tqabel ma' test ieħor. Ħarisna lejn dak li għandhom komuni u lejn id-differenzi.
colloquial.en: Nina: What did we do with this text in the lesson? Pawlu: It was compared and contrasted with another text. We looked at what they have in common and at their differences.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：课上我们对这篇文本做了什么？保罗：把它和另一篇文本作了对照。我们看了它们的共同点和不同点。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 课上我们对这篇文本做了什么？
messages.en: What did we do with this text in the lesson?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tqabel ma' test ieħor. Ħarisna lejn dak li għandhom komuni u lejn id-differenzi.
messages.mt_standard: Tqabel ma' test ieħor. Ħarisna lejn dak li għandhom komuni u lejn id-differenzi.
messages.zh: 把它和另一篇文本作了对照。我们看了它们的共同点和不同点。
messages.en: It was compared and contrasted with another text. We looked at what they have in common and at their differences.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两个相交的圆：交集写共同点，两侧写不同点；看到这个词就提醒自己两方面都要比较。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move about with playful jumps or repeated bouncing movements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以嬉戏的方式跳跃，或接连蹦来蹦去。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiċċaqlaq b'qabżiet ta' logħob jew jaqbeż minn post għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欢快地嬉戏跳跃。
接连蹦跳，蹦来蹦去。

collocations.en: The lamb gambolled in the field.
collocations.zh: 小羊在田里欢快地蹦跳。

collocations.en: The dog bounced around with joy.

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, il-ħaruf tqabeż fl-għalqa qrib ommu.
formal.en: During the observation, the lamb gambolled in the field near its mother.
formal.zh: 观察期间，小羊在田里靠近母羊的地方嬉戏跳跃。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-kelb tqabeż daqshekk? Mark: Ra l-ballun u feraħ!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the dog bounce around so much? Mark: It saw the ball and got excited!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：狗刚才怎么蹦得那么厉害？马克：它看到球，高兴起来了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 狗刚才怎么蹦得那么厉害？
messages.en: Why did the dog bounce around so much?

messages.speaker: Mark (狗主人)
messages.zh: 它看到球，高兴起来了！
messages.en: It saw the ball and got excited!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tqabeż 配上小羊撒欢、狗见球蹦跳的画面，记住它强调活泼的跳跃动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Playful jumping or movement with light, repeated hops.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 嬉戏时的跳跃活动，或轻快而连续的蹦跳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qbiż waqt il-logħob jew il-moviment b'qabżiet ħfief u ripetuti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欢快嬉戏时的蹦跳活动。
轻快、连续的蹦跳或跳步。

formal.mt: It-tqabiż tal-ħrief fl-għalqa ġibed l-attenzjoni tal-viżitaturi.
formal.en: The lambs' gambolling in the field attracted the visitors' attention.
formal.zh: 小羊们在田里的嬉戏蹦跳吸引了访客的注意。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dan it-tqabiż kollu fil-kuritur? Pawlu: It-tfal ferħu għax waslet in-nanna!
colloquial.en: Sara: What's all this skipping in the corridor? Pawlu: The children are excited because Grandma has arrived!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：走廊里怎么都在蹦蹦跳跳？保罗：奶奶来了，孩子们高兴呀！

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.zh: 走廊里怎么都在蹦蹦跳跳？
messages.en: What's all this skipping in the corridor?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 奶奶来了，孩子们高兴呀！
messages.en: The children are excited because Grandma has arrived!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tqabiż 当作一段蹦蹦跳跳的活动名称；用“小羊的嬉戏蹦跳”提醒自己这是名词。

gloss_zh: 玩得开心；嬉闹；嬉戏跳跃

teaching_sense.en_definition: To enjoy oneself by playing, frolicking, or moving about playfully.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过玩耍、嬉闹或嬉戏跳跃来享受快乐时光。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu gost jilgħab, jiċċajta jew jiċċaqlaq b'mod ferrieħi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 玩得开心，度过愉快的时光。
玩耍、嬉闹。
欢快地嬉戏跳跃。

collocations.en: The boy had fun with his friends.
collocations.zh: 男孩和朋友们玩得很开心。

collocations.en: The puppy played around on the rug.

formal.mt: Waqt il-ħin tal-logħob, it-tifel tqabras ma' sħabu fil-ġnien.
formal.en: During playtime, the boy had fun playing with his companions in the garden.
formal.zh: 游戏时间里，男孩在花园中和同伴们开心地玩耍。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif mar Leo għand in-nanna? David: Tqabras mal-kuġini u ma riedx jitlaq!
colloquial.en: Lara: How did Leo get on at Grandma's? David: He had a great time with his cousins and didn't want to leave!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：利奥在奶奶家怎么样？戴维：他和表兄弟姐妹们玩得很开心，都不想走了！

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.zh: 利奥在奶奶家怎么样？
messages.en: How did Leo get on at Grandma's?

messages.speaker: David (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Tqabras mal-kuġini u ma riedx jitlaq!
messages.mt_standard: Tqabras mal-kuġini u ma riedx jitlaq!
messages.zh: 他和表兄弟姐妹们玩得很开心，都不想走了！
messages.en: He had a great time with his cousins and didn't want to leave!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象孩子和伙伴嬉闹到舍不得回家，用这个完整画面记住 tqabras 的“玩得开心、嬉闹”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Playful frolicking, including lively play on the floor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 活泼的嬉戏蹦跳，也指在地板上的嬉闹活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Logħob ferrieħi bil-qbiż u ċ-ċaqliq, inkluż logħob mal-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欢快的嬉戏蹦跳。
在地板上玩耍、嬉闹。

formal.mt: It-tqabris tal-ġriewi fuq it-tapit kompla għal diversi minuti.
formal.en: The puppies' frolicking on the rug continued for several minutes.
formal.zh: 小狗们在地毯上的嬉闹持续了好几分钟。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu dan it-tqabris kollu mal-art? Ben: Qed nilgħab mal-ġeru; ara kemm hu ferħan!
colloquial.en: Nina: What's all this playing around on the floor? Ben: I'm playing with the puppy; look how happy he is!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：怎么在地上闹得这么欢？本：我在陪小狗玩，你看它多开心！

messages.speaker: Nina (姐姐)
messages.zh: 怎么在地上闹得这么欢？
messages.en: What's all this playing around on the floor?

messages.speaker: Ben (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nilgħab mal-ġeru; ara kemm hu ferħan!
messages.mt_standard: Qed nilgħab mal-ġeru; ara kemm hu ferħan!
messages.zh: 我在陪小狗玩，你看它多开心！
messages.en: I'm playing with the puppy; look how happy he is!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给地毯上孩子和小狗嬉闹的场景贴上 tqabris 标签，记住它是嬉闹活动的名词。

gloss_zh: 自荐；主动提出由自己承担

teaching_sense.en_definition: To offer oneself as a candidate or volunteer for a role or task.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主动提出自己作为某个职位、角色或任务的候选人或志愿承担者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joffri lilu nnifsu għal kariga jew biex jagħmel biċċa xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 主动自荐，提出由自己担任某个角色或承担某项任务。

collocations.en: put himself forward as a candidate

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, Mark tqaddam bħala kandidat għall-kariga ta' segretarju.
formal.en: During the meeting, Mark put himself forward as a candidate for the position of secretary.
formal.zh: 会议期间，马克自荐为秘书职位的候选人。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min tqaddam biex jgħin fil-festa? Luqa: Pawlu; qal li jista' jiġi kmieni.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who volunteered to help at the party? Luqa: Pawlu; he said he can come early.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：谁主动提出帮忙办聚会了？卢卡：保罗，他说可以早点来。

messages.speaker: Anna (聚会组织者)
messages.zh: 谁主动提出帮忙办聚会了？
messages.en: Who volunteered to help at the party?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu; qal li jista' jiġi kmieni.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu; qal li jista' jiġi kmieni.
messages.zh: 保罗，他说可以早点来。
messages.en: Pawlu; he said he can come early.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象开会时有人举手说“我来承担”，用这个自荐画面记住 tqaddam，重点是主动提出自己。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become dry, or to become very thin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 失去水分而变干；也指身体变得很瘦、消瘦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinxef jew isir irqiq ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变干，逐渐失去水分。
变得很瘦，变得消瘦。

collocations.en: The meat dried in the sun.

formal.mt: Matul il-proċess, il-laħam tqadded bil-mod u tilef ħafna mill-ilma li kien fih.
formal.en: During the process, the meat dried slowly and lost much of the water it contained.
formal.zh: 在这一过程中，肉慢慢变干，失去了其中的大量水分。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-qattus tqadded ħafna dan l-aħħar. Toni: Innutajt ukoll; se nieħdu għand il-veterinarju.
colloquial.en: Marija: The cat has become very skinny lately. Toni: I've noticed too; we'll take him to the vet.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：猫最近瘦了好多。托尼：我也注意到了，我们带它去看兽医吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (猫主人)
messages.zh: 猫最近瘦了好多。
messages.en: The cat has become very skinny lately.

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Innutajt ukoll; se nieħdu għand il-veterinarju.
messages.mt_standard: Innutajt ukoll; se nieħdu għand il-veterinarju.
messages.zh: 我也注意到了，我们带它去看兽医吧。
messages.en: I've noticed too; we'll take him to the vet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“肉变干”和“猫变瘦”两张记忆卡区分 tqadded 的两个义项；这是教学联想，不表示两者成因相同。

gloss_zh: 被圣化；（弥撒等仪式）被举行

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become sanctified or sacred; of a religious ritual, especially Mass, to be celebrated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被圣化或成为神圣的；用于宗教仪式，尤其指弥撒被举行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir qaddis jew sagru; meta jingħad dwar rit reliġjuż, speċjalment il-quddies, jiġi ċċelebrat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被圣化；成为神圣的。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be celebrated (used of rituals, especially Christian mass)
sense_translations.zh_definition: （宗教仪式，尤其是基督教弥撒）被举行。

collocations.en: Mass was celebrated in the chapel

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-post tqaddes u ġie ddedikat għat-talb.
formal.en: In the account, the place was sanctified and dedicated to prayer.
formal.zh: 在这段叙述中，这个地方被圣化，并被指定为祈祷之所。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-quddies tqaddes hawn ilbieraħ? Mark: Iva, fil-kappella ż-żgħira.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was Mass celebrated here yesterday? Mark: Yes, in the small chapel.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：昨天这里举行弥撒了吗？马克：举行了，在那座小圣堂里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天这里举行弥撒了吗？
messages.en: Was Mass celebrated here yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 举行了，在那座小圣堂里。
messages.en: Yes, in the small chapel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记忆：地点变得神圣，弥撒得以举行；看到地点或仪式作主语时，分别判断这两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of hitting someone with a stick.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用棍子或棒子击打他人的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed isawwat lil xi ħadd b'bastun.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of hitting sb. with a stick
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用棍棒打某人的行为。

collocations.en: a victim of beating with a stick

formal.mt: Ix-xhud iddeskriva t-tqaddib bil-bastun li ra fil-bitħa.
formal.en: The witness described the beating with a stick that he saw in the courtyard.
formal.zh: 证人描述了他在院子里目睹的棍棒殴打行为。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jiġifieri tqaddib f'din is-sentenza? Noel: Ifisser li xi ħadd sawwat lil persuna oħra b'bastun.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does tqaddib mean in this sentence? Noel: It means that someone beat another person with a stick.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这句话里的 tqaddib 是什么意思？诺埃尔：意思是有人用棍棒殴打另一个人。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 tqaddib 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tqaddib mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Noel (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li xi ħadd sawwat lil persuna oħra b'bastun.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li xi ħadd sawwat lil persuna oħra b'bastun.
messages.zh: 意思是有人用棍棒殴打另一个人。
messages.en: It means that someone beat another person with a stick.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词与“棍棒击打人”的画面绑定；重点同时记住受击者是人、使用的工具是棍棒。

gloss_zh: 食品干制保存；干燥脱水

teaching_sense.en_definition: The drying of food to preserve it, or the process of removing moisture more generally.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为保存食物而进行的干燥处理，也可泛指去除水分的干燥过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tnixxif tal-ikel biex jinżamm għal aktar żmien, jew it-tneħħija tal-umdità b'mod aktar ġenerali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过干燥食物来延长保存时间；食品干制。
干燥；脱水；去除水分的过程。

collocations.en: the drying of tomatoes for preservation
the drying of meat for preservation

formal.mt: It-tqaddid inaqqas l-ilma fl-ikel u jgħin biex dan jinżamm għal żmien itwal.
formal.en: Drying reduces the water in food and helps it keep for longer.
formal.zh: 干制可减少食物中的水分，帮助食物保存更长时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qtajt it-tadam bin-nofs? Rita: Qed inħejjih għat-tqaddid, biex inżommuh għal aktar żmien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you cut the tomatoes in half? Rita: I'm preparing them for drying so we can keep them longer.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把番茄切成两半？丽塔：我在准备把它们制成番茄干，这样能保存久一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (女儿)
messages.zh: 你为什么把番茄切成两半？
messages.en: Why did you cut the tomatoes in half?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed inħejjih għat-tqaddid, biex inżommuh għal aktar żmien.
messages.mt_standard: Qed inħejjih għat-tqaddid, biex inżommuh għal aktar żmien.
messages.zh: 我在准备把它们制成番茄干，这样能保存久一点。
messages.en: I'm preparing them for drying so we can keep them longer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象鲜番茄逐渐变成番茄干：水分减少对应“干燥”，保存时间变长对应“食品干制保存”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The aging or wearing of an object as a result of use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物品由于使用而逐渐老化、磨损或变旧的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih oġġett jiqdiem jew jintlibes minħabba l-użu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某物由于使用而老化或变旧。

collocations.en: the aging of fabric through use

formal.mt: L-eżami tal-kampjun wera tqaddim tad-drapp minħabba użu fit-tul.
formal.en: Examination of the sample showed that the fabric had aged through prolonged use.
formal.zh: 对样本的检查显示，布料因长期使用而出现了老化。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan it-tqaddim tas-siġġu ġej mill-użu ta' kuljum? David: Iva, nużawh kuljum u l-wiċċ tiegħu beda jintlibes.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is this aging of the chair from everyday use? David: Yes, we use it every day, and its surface has started to wear.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这把椅子变旧是因为天天使用吗？戴维：是的，我们每天都用，表面已经开始磨损了。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tqaddim tas-siġġu ġej mill-użu ta' kuljum?
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tqaddim tas-siġġu ġej mill-użu ta' kuljum?
messages.zh: 这把椅子变旧是因为天天使用吗？
messages.en: Is this aging of the chair from everyday use?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nużawh kuljum u l-wiċċ tiegħu beda jintlibes.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nużawh kuljum u l-wiċċ tiegħu beda jintlibes.
messages.zh: 是的，我们每天都用，表面已经开始磨损了。
messages.en: Yes, we use it every day, and its surface has started to wear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一把天天坐、表面逐渐磨旧的椅子记忆；把“反复使用导致变旧”作为这个名词的核心画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of making someone or something holy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或事物成为神圣的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih persuna jew ħaġa ssir qaddisa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣化；使人或事物成为神圣的过程。

formal.mt: It-test reliġjuż jiddeskrivi t-tqaddis tal-ħajja permezz tat-talb u tal-għajnuna lill-oħrajn.
formal.en: The religious text describes the sanctification of life through prayer and helping others.
formal.zh: 这篇宗教文本描述了通过祈祷和帮助他人使生命得到圣化的过程。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ifisser tqaddis hawn? Pawlu: Il-proċess li bih persuna jew ħaġa ssir qaddisa.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does tqaddis mean here? Pawlu: The process by which a person or thing becomes holy.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这里的 tqaddis 是什么意思？保罗：指人或事物成为神圣的过程。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 tqaddis 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tqaddis mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-proċess li bih persuna jew ħaġa ssir qaddisa.
messages.mt_standard: Il-proċess li bih persuna jew ħaġa ssir qaddisa.
messages.zh: 指人或事物成为神圣的过程。
messages.en: The process by which a person or thing becomes holy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tqaddis 记作“圣化这件事”的名称，再与动词 tqaddes“被圣化”配对，帮助区分过程名词和动作动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small hole or opening; the diminutive of toqba.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 很小的孔或洞，是 toqba 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Toqba żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' toqba.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small hole (the diminutive form of 'toqba')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小孔、小洞，是 toqba 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small hole in the wall
a small hole in the shirt

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstabet tqajba fil-pajp, li minnha kien qed inixxi l-ilma.
formal.en: During the inspection, a small hole was found in the pipe, through which water was leaking.
formal.zh: 检查时发现管道上有一个小孔，水正从孔中漏出。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara, hemm tqajba fil-qmis tiegħi! Rita: Agħtihieli u nħithielek.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look, there's a small hole in my shirt! Rita: Give it to me and I'll sew it up for you.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看，我的衬衫上有个小洞！丽塔：拿给我，我帮你缝好。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.zh: 看，我的衬衫上有个小洞！
messages.en: Look, there's a small hole in my shirt!

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 拿给我，我帮你缝好。
messages.en: Give it to me and I'll sew it up for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 toqba 的洞想象成缩小到针尖大小，就能记住 tqajba 表示小孔。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become dry as moisture is lost.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 失去水分而变干。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir niexef billi jitlef l-umdità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 干燥；变干。

formal.mt: Id-drapp tqajjar għal kollox qabel ma tqiegħed fil-kaxxa.
formal.en: The cloth dried completely before it was placed in the box.
formal.zh: 布料完全干燥后才被放入箱中。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Id-drapp għadu mxarrab? Ġużeppi: Le, tqajjar fix-xemx.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is the cloth still wet? Ġużeppi: No, it dried in the sun.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：那块布还湿着吗？朱塞佩：不，已经晒干了。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 那块布还湿着吗？
messages.en: Is the cloth still wet?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (室友)
messages.zh: 不，已经晒干了。
messages.en: No, it dried in the sun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象湿布挂在太阳下，水分慢慢消失，用这个过程记住变干的动作。

gloss_zh: 被戴上镣铐；被锁链束缚

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be restrained with shackles or chains.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被加上镣铐或锁链，使身体活动受到限制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinżamm marbut bil-ktajjen jew bil-manetti, b'mod li ma jkunx jista' jiċċaqlaq liberament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被戴上镣铐；被锁链束缚。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rakkont, il-priġunier tqajjed minn saqajh qabel it-trasferiment.
formal.en: According to the account, the prisoner was shackled by the feet before the transfer.
formal.zh: 据记述，囚犯在转移前被戴上了脚镣。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex il-priġunier fil-film ma setax jimxi sew? David: Għax tqajjed minn saqajh.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why couldn't the prisoner in the film walk properly? David: Because he had been shackled by the feet.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：电影里的囚犯为什么走不好路？戴维：因为他的双脚被上了镣铐。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-priġunier fil-film ma setax jimxi sew?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-priġunier fil-film ma setax jimxi sew?
messages.zh: 电影里的囚犯为什么走不好路？
messages.en: Why couldn't the prisoner in the film walk properly?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为他的双脚被上了镣铐。
messages.en: Because he had been shackled by the feet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象人物脚上被扣上镣铐的瞬间，记住这个动词描述被束缚的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Somewhat heavy, though not extremely so; the diminutive of tqil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有一些重量、拿着稍沉的，是 tqil 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ftit tqil, iżda mhux tqil ħafna; il-forma diminuttiva ta' tqil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有点重的、稍沉的，是 tqil 的指小形式。

formal.mt: Il-pakkett huwa tqajjel u għandu jinġarr b'attenzjoni.
formal.en: The parcel is somewhat heavy and should be carried carefully.
formal.zh: 这个包裹有点重，搬运时应当小心。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tista' żżommli dan il-ktieb għal mument? Ben: Iva, imma tqajjel! X'hemm fih?
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you hold this book for me for a moment? Ben: Yes, but it's a bit heavy! What's in it?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你能帮我拿一下这本书吗？本：可以，不过它有点沉！里面是什么内容？

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' żżommli dan il-ktieb għal mument?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' żżommli dan il-ktieb għal mument?
messages.zh: 你能帮我拿一下这本书吗？
messages.en: Can you hold this book for me for a moment?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 可以，不过它有点沉！里面是什么内容？
messages.en: Yes, but it's a bit heavy! What's in it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tqil 的重感调低一点，想象一本拿得动但稍压手的书，记住有点重。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be woken from sleep, or to be helped or lifted into a standing position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从睡眠中被唤醒；也可指被扶起或抬起而站立。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitwaqqaflu l-irqad, jew jiġi megħjun jew merfugħ biex joqgħod fuq saqajh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被叫醒；从睡眠中被唤醒。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be raised to one's feet
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被扶起或抬起而站立。

formal.mt: Wara li waqa', ir-raġel tqajjem fuq saqajh bl-għajnuna ta' żewġ persuni.
formal.en: After falling, the man was raised to his feet with the help of two people.
formal.zh: 那名男子跌倒后，在两个人的帮助下被扶起站立。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex ħuk għadu bi ngħas? Toni: Tqajjem mill-ħoss kmieni dalgħodu u ma reġax raqad.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why is your brother still sleepy? Toni: He was woken by the noise early this morning and didn't go back to sleep.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你弟弟为什么还困着？托尼：他今天一大早被响声吵醒，之后就没再睡着。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 你弟弟为什么还困着？
messages.en: Why is your brother still sleepy?

messages.speaker: Toni (哥哥)
messages.mt_spoken: Tqajjem mill-ħoss kmieni dalgħodu u ma reġax raqad.
messages.mt_standard: Tqajjem mill-ħoss kmieni dalgħodu u ma reġax raqad.
messages.zh: 他今天一大早被响声吵醒，之后就没再睡着。
messages.en: He was woken by the noise early this morning and didn't go back to sleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面分别记义：睡着的人被叫醒，倒地的人被扶起；再靠上下文判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition of being held or restrained in chains.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体被锁链锁住、活动受到限制的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' min ikun marbut bil-ktajjen u ma jkunx jista' jiċċaqlaq liberament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被锁链锁住或束缚的状态。

collocations.en: a prolonged state of being chained

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont jiddeskrivi t-tqajjid tal-priġunier u d-diffikultà tiegħu biex jiċċaqlaq.
formal.en: The account describes the prisoner's confinement in chains and his difficulty moving.
formal.zh: 这段记述描写了囚犯被锁链束缚的状态，以及他行动时的困难。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'tqajjid' f'din is-sentenza? Mark: Ifisser li l-priġunier kien marbut bil-ktajjen.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'tqajjid' mean in this sentence? Mark: It means that the prisoner was held in chains.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这句话里的 tqajjid 是什么意思？马克：意思是那个囚犯处于被锁链束缚的状态。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 tqajjid 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tqajjid' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-priġunier kien marbut bil-ktajjen.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-priġunier kien marbut bil-ktajjen.
messages.zh: 意思是那个囚犯处于被锁链束缚的状态。
messages.en: It means that the prisoner was held in chains.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把镜头停在一个人被锁链锁住的画面上，记住这里是名词，表示持续的受缚状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of waking someone from sleep or rousing someone to attention or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把人从睡眠中叫醒，或使人振奋、注意起来并开始行动的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tqajjem lil xi ħadd mill-irqad jew tqanqlu biex jagħti kas jew jaġixxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 唤醒；把人从睡眠中叫醒。
激起；使人振奋、警觉或行动起来。

formal.mt: It-tqajjim tat-tfal għandu jsir bil-mod, b'vuċi kalma u mingħajr għajjat.
formal.en: Waking the children should be done gently, in a calm voice and without shouting.
formal.zh: 叫醒孩子们时应动作轻柔、语气平静，不要大喊。

colloquial.mt: Marta: It-tqajjim tat-tfal għada nħallih f'idejk? David: Iva, inqajjimhom jien fis-sebgħa.
colloquial.en: Marta: Can I leave waking the children tomorrow to you? David: Yes, I'll wake them at seven.
colloquial.zh: Marta：明天叫醒孩子们的事交给你，可以吗？David：可以，我七点叫醒他们。

messages.speaker: Marta (母亲)
messages.zh: 明天叫醒孩子们的事交给你，可以吗？
messages.en: Can I leave waking the children tomorrow to you?

messages.speaker: David (父亲)
messages.zh: 可以，我七点叫醒他们。
messages.en: Yes, I'll wake them at seven.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词连到两个画面：轻声叫醒熟睡的孩子，以及用讲话让人群振奋起来；共同点都是让人从静止转向活跃。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making something dry, usually laundry or wet clothes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使物品变干的过程，通常指洗后衣物或湿衣服的晾干。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jitnixxfu l-affarijiet, normalment il-ħwejjeġ maħsula jew imxarrbin.

sense_translations.en_definition: drying (usually used of laundry or wet clothes)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使之变干；通常指洗后衣物或湿衣服的晾干。

formal.mt: Għat-tqajjir tal-ħwejjeġ, ħallu biżżejjed spazju bejn biċċa u oħra biex tgħaddi l-arja.
formal.en: For drying clothes, leave enough space between individual items to allow air to circulate.
formal.zh: 晾衣服时，各件衣物之间应留出足够空间，让空气流通。

colloquial.mt: Nina: It-tqajjir tal-ħwejjeġ qed jieħu ħafna ħin illum. Karl: Iva, għadhom imxarrbin. Ejja nħalluhom barra ftit ieħor.
colloquial.en: Nina: The clothes are taking a long time to dry today. Karl: Yes, they're still wet. Let's leave them outside a little longer.
colloquial.zh: Nina：今天衣服晾干要好久。Karl：是啊，还湿着呢。再放外面晾一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tqajjir tal-ħwejjeġ qed jieħu ħafna ħin illum.
messages.mt_standard: It-tqajjir tal-ħwejjeġ qed jieħu ħafna ħin illum.
messages.zh: 今天衣服晾干要好久。
messages.en: The clothes are taking a long time to dry today.

messages.speaker: Karl (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadhom imxarrbin. Ejja nħalluhom barra ftit ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadhom imxarrbin. Ejja nħalluhom barra ftit ieħor.
messages.zh: 是啊，还湿着呢。再放外面晾一会儿吧。
messages.en: Yes, they're still wet. Let's leave them outside a little longer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住一条挂满湿衣服的晾衣绳：衣服从湿到干的整个过程就是这个名词所指的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of finding the size, length, or amount of something by measuring it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过量度来确定物体大小、长度或数量的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih tkejjel xi ħaġa biex tkun taf id-daqs, it-tul jew il-kwantità tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 测量；通过量度确定尺寸或数量。

formal.mt: It-tqajjis tat-tul tal-mejda għandu jsir qabel ma jinqata' d-drapp.
formal.en: The length of the table should be measured before the fabric is cut.
formal.zh: 裁剪布料之前，应先测量桌子的长度。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għamilt it-tqajjis tal-mejda? Toni: Iva, it-tul tagħha hu metru u nofs.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you measured the table? Toni: Yes, it's one and a half metres long.
colloquial.zh: Lara：桌子的尺寸量过了吗？Toni：量过了，长一米半。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 桌子的尺寸量过了吗？
messages.en: Have you measured the table?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, it-tul tagħha hu metru u nofs.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, it-tul tagħha hu metru u nofs.
messages.zh: 量过了，长一米半。
messages.en: Yes, it's one and a half metres long.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象先拉开卷尺、再读取数字、最后记录尺寸的三个步骤，把这个词固定在测量的过程上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be sealed so that water cannot enter, or to be thrown out of a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被封堵或做防水处理，使水无法进入；也可指被从某处赶出去。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jingħalaq kontra d-dħul tal-ilma, jew li jitkeċċa minn xi post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被密封或做防水处理。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be thrown out of a place
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被从某处赶出去或撵出去。

collocations.en: the vessel was sealed against water
collocations.zh: 船只经过了密封防水处理

collocations.en: he was thrown out of the bar
