formal.mt: Il-bastiment tqalfat qabel it-tluq biex ma jidħolx ilma fih matul il-vjaġġ.
formal.en: The vessel was sealed against water before departure to prevent water from entering during the voyage.
formal.zh: 船只在出发前进行了密封防水处理，以免航行途中进水。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex Mark qed jistenna barra? Samwel: Tqalfat mill-bar wara li beda jgħajjat mal-persunal.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why is Mark waiting outside? Samwel: He was thrown out of the bar after he started shouting at the staff.
colloquial.zh: Rita：Mark为什么在外面等着？Samwel：他开始冲工作人员大喊，之后就被赶出了酒吧。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark为什么在外面等着？
messages.en: Why is Mark waiting outside?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tqalfat mill-bar wara li beda jgħajjat mal-persunal.
messages.mt_standard: Tqalfat mill-bar wara li beda jgħajjat mal-persunal.
messages.zh: 他开始冲工作人员大喊，之后就被赶出了酒吧。
messages.en: He was thrown out of the bar after he started shouting at the staff.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张情景卡分别记忆：船缝被封住以防进水，以及某人被赶出门外；根据主语和地点判断具体词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The work of sealing something against water, especially by filling gaps or joints.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为防止进水而进行的密封工作，尤其指填补缝隙或接缝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol li bih jingħalqu xquq jew ġonot biex ma jgħaddix ilma minnhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 防水密封；封堵以防止水进入或渗过。
填缝；用材料填实缝隙或接缝以实现密封。

formal.mt: It-tqalfit tal-ġonot għandu jitlesta qabel ma l-bastiment jitniżżel fl-ilma.
formal.en: The caulking of the joints must be completed before the vessel is lowered into the water.
formal.zh: 船只下水之前，必须完成接缝的填缝密封工作。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Lestejt it-tqalfit tal-bastiment? Ġorġ: Kważi. Fadal ġonta waħda biss.
colloquial.en: Marija: Have you finished caulking the vessel? Ġorġ: Almost. There's just one joint left.
colloquial.zh: Marija：船的填缝密封做完了吗？Ġorġ：快了，只剩一处接缝。

messages.speaker: Marija (船主)
messages.zh: 船的填缝密封做完了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished caulking the vessel?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (修船工)
messages.zh: 快了，只剩一处接缝。
messages.en: Almost. There's just one joint left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象工人沿着船体接缝一点点填入密封材料；把这个名词记成填缝防水这项工作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be cooked by frying, including being lightly fried in a pan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过煎炸而被烹熟，也包括在平底锅中稍微煎一下。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jissajjar bil-qali, inkluż li jinqela ħafif f'taġen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被煎或炸；用煎炸的方式烹制。
被放在平底锅中稍微煎一下。

collocations.zh: 它在平底锅中被稍微煎了一下

formal.mt: Il-ħut tqalla ħafif fit-taġen bi ftit żejt u mbagħad ġie servut mal-ħaxix.
formal.en: The fish was lightly pan-fried in a little oil and then served with vegetables.
formal.zh: 鱼用少量油在平底锅中稍煎，随后搭配蔬菜上桌。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan il-ħut tqalla jew sar fil-forn? Pawlu: Tqalla ħafif fit-taġen, bi ftit żejt biss.
colloquial.en: Anna: Was this fish fried or baked in the oven? Pawlu: It was lightly pan-fried, with just a little oil.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这鱼是煎的，还是烤箱烤的？Pawlu：在平底锅里稍微煎了一下，只放了一点油。

messages.speaker: Anna (食客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ħut tqalla jew sar fil-forn?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ħut tqalla jew sar fil-forn?
messages.zh: 这鱼是煎的，还是烤箱烤的？
messages.en: Was this fish fried or baked in the oven?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (厨师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tqalla ħafif fit-taġen, bi ftit żejt biss.
messages.mt_standard: Tqalla ħafif fit-taġen, bi ftit żejt biss.
messages.zh: 在平底锅里稍微煎了一下，只放了一点油。
messages.en: It was lightly pan-fried, with just a little oil.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把没有末尾撇号的 tqalla 放进平底锅画面：主语是鱼或其他食物，意思是食物被煎炸。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel nauseous, or to become fed up with something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体上感到恶心、想吐，或心理上对某事厌烦、受够了。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss dardir, jew li jiddejjaq b'xi ħaġa għax ma jiflaħhiex aktar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到恶心、想吐。
感到厌烦；受够了。

collocations.en: he felt nauseous during the journey
he became fed up with the noise

formal.mt: Wara diversi sigħat ta' storbju kontinwu, ir-resident tqalla' u talab ftit kwiet.
formal.en: After several hours of continuous noise, the resident became fed up and asked for some quiet.
formal.zh: 连续数小时的噪声让这位住户忍无可忍，于是他要求安静一些。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu tqalla' waqt il-vjaġġ. Nistgħu nieqfu ftit? Mark: Iva, nieqaf hawn biex jieħu ftit arja.
colloquial.en: Sara: Pawlu felt nauseous during the journey. Can we stop for a moment? Mark: Yes, I'll stop here so he can get some air.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Pawlu路上觉得恶心。我们能停一会儿吗？Mark：可以，我在这里停车，让他透透气。

messages.speaker: Sara (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu tqalla' waqt il-vjaġġ. Nistgħu nieqfu ftit?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu tqalla' waqt il-vjaġġ. Nistgħu nieqfu ftit?
messages.zh: Pawlu路上觉得恶心。我们能停一会儿吗？
messages.en: Pawlu felt nauseous during the journey. Can we stop for a moment?

messages.speaker: Mark (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nieqaf hawn biex jieħu ftit arja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nieqaf hawn biex jieħu ftit arja.
messages.zh: 可以，我在这里停车，让他透透气。
messages.en: Yes, I'll stop here so he can get some air.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把末尾撇号当作学习时的醒目标记：这个词联系人的不适感，既可身体恶心，也可心理上受够了。

gloss_zh: 呈粪便状；成形为粪条状

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take on a shape resembling a turd.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成形后呈现出类似一条或一块粪便的外形。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jieħu forma li tixbah biċċa ħmieġ.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be shaped like a turd
sense_translations.zh_definition: 呈粪便状；外形像一条或一块粪便。

collocations.en: the clay took on a turd-like shape
it took on a turd-like shape during shaping
collocations.zh: 它在塑形过程中成了粪便状

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżerċizzju tal-iffurmar, it-tafal tqallat, jiġifieri ħa forma li tixbah biċċa ħmieġ.
formal.en: During the shaping exercise, the clay took on a turd-like shape, meaning that it acquired a form resembling a piece of excrement.
formal.zh: 在塑形练习中，黏土成了粪便状，也就是说，它的外形像一块粪便。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Ara t-tafal tiegħi, tqallat! Omar: Veru! Erġa' agħtih forma tonda.
colloquial.en: Lina: Look at my clay; it's ended up looking like a turd! Omar: It has! Make it round again.
colloquial.zh: Lina：看我的黏土，弄得像块便便了！Omar：还真是！再把它弄圆吧。

messages.speaker: Lina (陶艺学员)
messages.zh: 看我的黏土，弄得像块便便了！
messages.en: Look at my clay; it's ended up looking like a turd!

messages.speaker: Omar (同班学员)
messages.zh: 还真是！再把它弄圆吧。
messages.en: It has! Make it round again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象陶艺课上黏土意外捏成便便形状；这个词描述的是外形相似，记住画面即可，不要把它理解为材料变成了粪便。

gloss_zh: 辗转反侧；海面变得汹涌

teaching_sense.en_definition: To turn repeatedly from side to side, especially in bed; when describing the sea, to become rough.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指人在床上等处反复翻身、辗转反侧；用于海时，指海面变得汹涌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idur minn naħa għal oħra, speċjalment fis-sodda; meta jingħad għall-baħar, isir imqalleb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复翻身，辗转反侧。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be rough (used of the sea)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 指海面波涛汹涌、海况不平静。

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl, il-baħar tqalleb u l-vjaġġ bid-dgħajsa ġie pospost.
formal.en: During the night, the sea became rough and the boat trip was postponed.
formal.zh: 夜间海面变得汹涌，乘船行程因此推迟。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark raqad sew ilbieraħ? Nina: Le, tqalleb fis-sodda l-lejl kollu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Mark sleep well yesterday? Nina: No, he tossed and turned in bed all night.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克昨天睡得好吗？妮娜：不好，他整夜都在床上翻来覆去。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克昨天睡得好吗？
messages.en: Did Mark sleep well yesterday?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 不好，他整夜都在床上翻来覆去。
messages.en: No, he tossed and turned in bed all night.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把床上不停翻身的人和海上不断翻动的波浪并排想象，用两个动态画面记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of turning things over or rummaging through them; also confusion or a state of upset.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 翻动或翻找东西的动作，也可表示混乱、心绪不宁或受到扰动的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li ddawwar jew tqalleb l-affarijiet, jew tfittex fosthom; ukoll konfużjoni jew taqlib fil-ħsieb u fis-sentimenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把东西翻过来或反复翻动的动作。
混乱、纷乱或令人摸不清头绪的状态。
不安、烦乱或受到扰动的状态。
为寻找东西而到处翻找、翻动杂物。

formal.mt: It-tqallib tal-ħamrija sar qabel it-tħawwil sabiex l-art tkun lesta għaż-żrieragħ.
formal.en: The soil was turned over before planting so that the ground would be ready for the seeds.
formal.zh: 种植前进行了翻土，使土地做好播种准备。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dan it-tqallib kollu fil-kxaxen? Pawlu: Qed infittex iċ-ċwievet; ma nistax insibhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's all this rummaging through the drawers? Pawlu: I'm looking for the keys; I can't find them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么一直在抽屉里翻来翻去？保罗：我在找钥匙，怎么也找不到。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你怎么一直在抽屉里翻来翻去？
messages.en: What's all this rummaging through the drawers?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed infittex iċ-ċwievet; ma nistax insibhom.
messages.mt_standard: Qed infittex iċ-ċwievet; ma nistax insibhom.
messages.zh: 我在找钥匙，怎么也找不到。
messages.en: I'm looking for the keys; I can't find them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 依次想象翻土、翻抽屉、思绪混乱和心里不安四幅图；这是帮助区分义项的学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of nausea, the act of vomiting, or the act of making someone feel nauseous.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 恶心想吐的感觉、实际呕吐的行为，或使某人感到恶心的作用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dardir, l-azzjoni li tirremetti, jew l-azzjoni li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss id-dardir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恶心、想吐但不一定已经呕吐的感觉。
呕吐，即胃里的东西经口排出的行为。
使某人感到恶心、产生想吐的感觉。

collocations.zh: 强烈的恶心或剧烈呕吐

formal.mt: Waqt il-vjaġġ bil-baħar, il-passiġġier ħass sens ta' tqalligħ u talab biex joqgħod bilqiegħda.
formal.en: During the sea journey, the passenger felt nauseous and asked to sit down.
formal.zh: 海上航行期间，这位乘客感到恶心，提出想坐下来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ftaħt it-tieqa? Mark: Din ir-riħa qed iġġibli t-tqalligħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you open the window? Mark: This smell is making me nauseous.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么把窗户打开了？马克：这股气味让我恶心得想吐。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把窗户打开了？
messages.en: Why did you open the window?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 这股气味让我恶心得想吐。
messages.en: This smell is making me nauseous.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按闻到怪味、觉得想吐、实际呕吐三个画面记忆；分别对应致恶心、恶心感和呕吐行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of passing solid lumps of faeces out of the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从体内排出成块粪便的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li biha joħorġu biċċiet ta' ħmieġ solidu mill-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 排泄粪块，即排出成块的粪便。

collocations.en: the animal's passing of solid faeces

formal.mt: Il-veterinarju osserva t-tqallit tal-annimal u rreġistra l-forma tal-ħmieġ.
formal.en: The veterinarian observed the animal passing solid faeces and recorded the shape of the droppings.
formal.zh: 兽医观察了这只动物排出粪块的过程，并记录了粪便的形状。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-kelb għad għandu diffikultà fit-tqallit? Toni: Le, illum għamel il-bżonnijiet tiegħu bla diffikultà.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is the dog still having difficulty passing solid faeces? Toni: No, he did his business without difficulty today.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：狗狗排便还是有困难吗？托尼：没有了，今天它顺利排便了。

messages.speaker: Rita (宠物主人)
messages.zh: 狗狗排便还是有困难吗？
messages.en: Is the dog still having difficulty passing solid faeces?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, illum għamel il-bżonnijiet tiegħu bla diffikultà.
messages.mt_standard: Le, illum għamel il-bżonnijiet tiegħu bla diffikultà.
messages.zh: 没有了，今天它顺利排便了。
messages.en: No, he did his business without difficulty today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词义具体记成排出成块粪便这一动作；重点是粪便排出，而不是恶心或呕吐。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a kicking movement with a foot or leg.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用脚或腿做出踢、蹬的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel moviment b'siequ jew b'riġlu biex jagħti daqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 踢，用脚或腿蹬踢。

formal.mt: Iż-żiemel tqames b'saqajh ta' wara meta sema' ħoss qawwi.
formal.en: The horse kicked with its hind legs when it heard a loud noise.
formal.zh: 这匹马听到巨响时，用后腿蹬踢了一下。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tbegħedt miż-żiemel? Pawlu: Għax tqames, u bżajt li jolqotni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you move away from the horse? Pawlu: Because it kicked, and I was afraid it would hit me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么离那匹马远了些？保罗：因为它踢了一下，我怕被它踢到。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么离那匹马远了些？
messages.en: Why did you move away from the horse?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax tqames, u bżajt li jolqotni.
messages.mt_standard: Għax tqames, u bżajt li jolqotni.
messages.zh: 因为它踢了一下，我怕被它踢到。
messages.en: Because it kicked, and I was afraid it would hit me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象马突然抬起后腿向外一蹬，把这个词牢牢记成踢出的动作。

gloss_zh: 踢动；坐立不安的小动作

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of kicking, or repeated restless movements made while fidgeting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 踢动、蹬踢的动作，也可指因坐立不安而不停做小动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tagħti bis-saqajn, jew movimenti żgħar u ripetuti għax ma toqgħodx kwiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 踢动或蹬踢的动作。
坐立不安地动来动去，不停做小动作。

formal.mt: L-għalliema nnotat it-tqamis tat-tifel fuq is-siġġu waqt il-qari.
formal.en: The teacher noticed the boy fidgeting on his chair during reading time.
formal.zh: 阅读时，老师注意到那个男孩坐在椅子上不停扭动。

colloquial.mt: Omm: X'inhu dan it-tqamis kollu fuq is-siġġu? Ben: Is-siġġu mhux komdu; nista' noqgħod fuq l-ieħor?
colloquial.en: Mum: Why are you fidgeting so much on that chair? Ben: The chair isn't comfortable; can I sit on the other one?
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：你怎么在椅子上动个不停？本：这把椅子不舒服，我可以坐另一把吗？

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dan it-tqamis kollu fuq is-siġġu?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dan it-tqamis kollu fuq is-siġġu?
messages.zh: 你怎么在椅子上动个不停？
messages.en: Why are you fidgeting so much on that chair?

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-siġġu mhux komdu; nista' noqgħod fuq l-ieħor?
messages.mt_standard: Is-siġġu mhux komdu; nista' noqgħod fuq l-ieħor?
messages.zh: 这把椅子不舒服，我可以坐另一把吗？
messages.en: The chair isn't comfortable; can I sit on the other one?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个动作画面记忆：马腿向外蹬踢，孩子在椅子上扭动；本词是这些动作的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To go mad; in a separate sense, to bathe in moonlight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发狂；另一个独立义项是沐浴在月光中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġġennen; f'tifsira oħra, joqgħod fid-dawl tal-qamar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发狂，变得疯狂。
沐浴月光，让自己置身于月光之中。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-vjaġġatur waqaf ħdejn il-baħar u tqammar fid-dawl tal-qamar.
formal.en: In the story, the traveller stopped by the sea and bathed in moonlight.
formal.zh: 故事中，旅人停在海边，沐浴着月光。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif irreaġixxa Mark meta ra l-kont? Nina: Tqammar bir-rabja u beda jgħajjat.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did Mark react when he saw the bill? Nina: He went mad with anger and started shouting.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克看到账单后有什么反应？妮娜：他气得发狂，开始大喊大叫。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif irreaġixxa Mark meta ra l-kont?
messages.mt_standard: Kif irreaġixxa Mark meta ra l-kont?
messages.zh: 马克看到账单后有什么反应？
messages.en: How did Mark react when he saw the bill?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 他气得发狂，开始大喊大叫。
messages.en: He went mad with anger and started shouting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分别记住大发雷霆的人和站在月光下的旅人两个场景；这是双义记忆法，不表示月光导致发狂。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be tied up with rope or another binding material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被绳索或其他捆绑材料绑住、束缚起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintrabat b'ħabel jew b'materjal ieħor li jżommu marbut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被捆绑起来，被绑住。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-priġunier tqammat b'ħabel ma' siġġu qabel ma wasal l-għassies.
formal.en: In the novel, the prisoner was tied to a chair with rope before the guard arrived.
formal.zh: 小说中，守卫到来之前，囚犯已被人用绳子绑在椅子上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara lill-eroj fil-film? Pawlu: Tqammat ma' siġġu, imma mbagħad ħeles.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to the hero in the film? Pawlu: He was tied to a chair, but then he got free.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：电影里的主角怎么了？保罗：他被绑在椅子上，不过后来挣脱了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影里的主角怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the hero in the film?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tqammat ma' siġġu, imma mbagħad ħeles.
messages.mt_standard: Tqammat ma' siġġu, imma mbagħad ħeles.
messages.zh: 他被绑在椅子上，不过后来挣脱了。
messages.en: He was tied to a chair, but then he got free.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电影主角被绳子固定在椅子上，牢记主语是被绑住的人，抓住被捆绑这一含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To kick or to become very restless and unable to remain still.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 踢蹬，或变得十分躁动，无法安静地待着。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti bis-saqajn jew isir bla kwiet ħafna u ma joqgħodx bi kwietu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 踢；用脚踢蹬。
变得十分躁动；开始坐立不安。

formal.mt: Wara stennija twila, it-tifel tqammes u ma setax jibqa' bilqiegħda.
formal.en: After a long wait, the boy became very restless and could no longer remain seated.
formal.zh: 等了很久以后，男孩变得十分躁动，再也坐不住了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqaft ħdejn iż-żiemel? Mark: Għax tqammes u tajjeb nagħtuh ftit spazju.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you stop beside the horse? Mark: Because it kicked, and we should give it some space.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么在马旁边停下来了？马克：因为它踢蹬了一下，我们应该给它留点空间。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么在马旁边停下来了？
messages.en: Why did you stop beside the horse?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax tqammes u tajjeb nagħtuh ftit spazju.
messages.mt_standard: Għax tqammes u tajjeb nagħtuh ftit spazju.
messages.zh: 因为它踢蹬了一下，我们应该给它留点空间。
messages.en: Because it kicked, and we should give it some space.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把马踢蹬和孩子坐不住并排想象，两个场景都用身体动个不停来记住这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Influence exerted by, or attributed to, the moon.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 月亮所产生的影响，或被归因于月亮的影响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Influwenza tal-qamar jew influwenza attribwita lill-qamar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 月亮的影响；被认为来自月亮的作用。

collocations.zh: 月亮影响所产生的效果

formal.mt: F'dan it-test, il-kelma 'tqammir' tirreferi għall-influwenza attribwita lill-qamar.
formal.en: In this text, the word 'tqammir' refers to influence attributed to the moon.
formal.zh: 在这篇文章中，tqammir 一词指被归因于月亮的影响。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'tqammir' hawn? Pawlu: Tfisser l-influwenza tal-qamar.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'tqammir' mean here? Pawlu: It means the influence of the moon.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里的 tqammir 是什么意思？保罗：意思是月亮的影响。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 tqammir 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tqammir' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 意思是月亮的影响。
messages.en: It means the influence of the moon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一轮月亮，再从月亮画出表示影响的箭头，用这幅图记住词义；联想图本身不证明具体影响存在。

gloss_zh: 踢蹬；坐立不安的小动作

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of kicking, or repeated restless movements such as fidgeting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 踢蹬的动作，或因不安而反复扭动、动来动去的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti bis-saqajn jew movimenti ripetuti ta' min ma joqgħodx bi kwietu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 踢；踢蹬的动作。
坐立不安时反复扭动或做小动作。

formal.mt: It-tqammis kontinwu tat-tifel fuq is-siġġu fixkel lill-istudenti l-oħra waqt il-qari.
formal.en: The boy's constant fidgeting on his chair distracted the other students during reading.
formal.zh: 阅读时，男孩不停地在椅子上扭动，分散了其他学生的注意力。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dak il-ħoss taħt il-mejda? Ben: It-tqammis ta' ħija; qed jolqot is-siġġu bis-saqajn.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's that noise under the table? Ben: My brother's kicking; he's hitting the chair with his feet.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：桌子底下是什么声音？本：是我弟弟在踢蹬，他的脚正踢着椅子。

messages.speaker: Sara (姐姐)
messages.zh: 桌子底下是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that noise under the table?

messages.speaker: Ben (哥哥)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tqammis ta' ħija; qed jolqot is-siġġu bis-saqajn.
messages.mt_standard: It-tqammis ta' ħija; qed jolqot is-siġġu bis-saqajn.
messages.zh: 是我弟弟在踢蹬，他的脚正踢着椅子。
messages.en: My brother's kicking; he's hitting the chair with his feet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给踢脚和椅上扭动各画一张动作图，再给整组动作贴上名词标签 tqammis，记住它表示行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of discomfort or physical unease.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不舒服、难受或身体不自在的感觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni ta' skumdità jew ta' nuqqas ta' kumdità fil-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不适；不舒服或难受的感觉。

formal.mt: Wara li qagħad bilqiegħda għal żmien twil, ir-raġel ħass tqammit f'dahru.
formal.en: After sitting for a long time, the man felt discomfort in his back.
formal.zh: 坐了很长时间以后，这名男子感到背部不适。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex trid tieqaf ftit? David: Għandi tqammit f'dahri u nixtieq nimxi ftit.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why do you want to stop for a moment? David: I have some discomfort in my back and would like to walk a little.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么想停一会儿？戴维：我背有点不舒服，想走动一下。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么想停一会儿？
messages.en: Why do you want to stop for a moment?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi tqammit f'dahri u nixtieq nimxi ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi tqammit f'dahri u nixtieq nimxi ftit.
messages.zh: 我背有点不舒服，想走动一下。
messages.en: I have some discomfort in my back and would like to walk a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象久坐后挪动身体、总觉得不舒服的场景，把这种不适感和 tqammit 一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be carried or lugged, especially when the object is heavy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 重物被搬运、抬走或费力地移动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinġarr jew jiġi mċaqlaq minn post għal ieħor, speċjalment meta jkun tqil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被费力地搬运；被吃力地拖带或搬走。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be carried (used of a heavy object)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被搬运或抬运，指较重的物体。

formal.mt: Il-bagoll tqil tqandel minn żewġ ħaddiema sal-kamra ta' fuq.
formal.en: The heavy trunk was carried upstairs by two workers.
formal.zh: 那个沉重的大箱子由两名工人抬到了楼上的房间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-bagoll il-kbir? Toni: Tqandel sal-karozza; kien tqil wisq għal persuna waħda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where's the big trunk? Toni: It was carried to the car; it was too heavy for one person.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个大箱子在哪里？托尼：已经搬到车旁了，一个人搬实在太重。

messages.speaker: Maja (搬家者)
messages.zh: 那个大箱子在哪里？
messages.en: Where's the big trunk?

messages.speaker: Toni (帮忙的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tqandel sal-karozza; kien tqil wisq għal persuna waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Tqandel sal-karozza; kien tqil wisq għal persuna waħda.
messages.zh: 已经搬到车旁了，一个人搬实在太重。
messages.en: It was carried to the car; it was too heavy for one person.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个沉重大箱子被两个人抬走，把注意力放在箱子被搬运的经历上，记住这个动词的被动含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of carrying or lugging objects, especially heavy ones.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 搬运物品的行为，尤其指搬抬重物或费力搬运。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jinġarru oġġetti minn post għal ieħor, speċjalment oġġetti tqal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 搬运；将物品从一处带到另一处的行为。
费力搬运；吃力地搬抬重物。

formal.mt: It-tqandil tal-għamara ħa sagħtejn u kien jeħtieġ erba' ħaddiema.
formal.en: Carrying the furniture took two hours and required four workers.
formal.zh: 家具搬运花了两个小时，需要四名工人参与。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għad baqa' ħafna tqandil? Samwel: Żewġ kaxxi biss, imma huma tqal; tgħinni nġorrhom?
colloquial.en: Rita: Is there still a lot of carrying left? Samwel: Just two boxes, but they're heavy; will you help me carry them?
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：还有很多东西要搬吗？萨姆韦尔：只剩两个箱子，不过很重，你能帮我搬吗？

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 还有很多东西要搬吗？
messages.en: Is there still a lot of carrying left?

messages.speaker: Samwel (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żewġ kaxxi biss, imma huma tqal; tgħinni nġorrhom?
messages.mt_standard: Żewġ kaxxi biss, imma huma tqal; tgħinni nġorrhom?
messages.zh: 只剩两个箱子，不过很重，你能帮我搬吗？
messages.en: Just two boxes, but they're heavy; will you help me carry them?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整段搬家具、抬箱子的劳动想成一个活动名称：tqandil 表示搬运这件事，可结合重物场景记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become untidy or scruffy, especially when hair is disturbed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得凌乱或邋遢，尤其指头发受到扰动后不再整齐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir imħawwad jew diżordinat, speċjalment meta x-xagħar ma jibqax f'postu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变凌乱；被弄乱，尤指头发。
变得邋遢；外观变得不整洁。

formal.mt: Matul il-mixja, xagħar it-tifel tqanfed bir-riħ.
formal.en: During the walk, the boy's hair became tousled in the wind.
formal.zh: 散步时，男孩的头发被风吹乱了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xagħrek tqanfed! Mark: Iva, barra hemm ħafna riħ. Għandek moxt?
colloquial.en: Maja: Your hair got all messed up! Mark: Yes, it's very windy outside. Have you got a comb?
colloquial.zh: Maja：你的头发都乱了！Mark：是啊，外面风很大。你有梳子吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的头发都乱了！
messages.en: Your hair got all messed up!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, barra hemm ħafna riħ. Għandek moxt?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, barra hemm ħafna riħ. Għandek moxt?
messages.zh: 是啊，外面风很大。你有梳子吗？
messages.en: Yes, it's very windy outside. Have you got a comb?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出门前梳齐的头发被风吹成乱蓬蓬的一团，用这个画面记住“变凌乱、变邋遢”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of ruffling or messing up hair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把头发拨乱、揉乱或弄得蓬乱的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tħawwad ix-xagħar u tħallih mhux f'postu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弄乱、揉乱头发的动作。

formal.mt: It-tqanfid tax-xagħar biddel id-dehra tal-attur qabel ir-ritratt.
formal.en: Tousling the actor's hair changed his appearance before the photograph.
formal.zh: 拍照前，把演员的头发弄蓬乱改变了他的外观。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tħawwadli xagħri? Mark: Ftit tqanfid biss! Maja: Imma għadni kemm irranġajtu!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you messing up my hair? Mark: Just a little tousling! Maja: But I've only just tidied it!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么弄乱我的头发？Mark：只是轻轻揉一下！Maja：可我才刚整理好！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么弄乱我的头发？
messages.en: Why are you messing up my hair?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 只是轻轻揉一下！
messages.en: Just a little tousling!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 可我才刚整理好！
messages.en: But I've only just tidied it!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成名词画面：一只手伸过来揉乱头发；重点是“揉乱这件事”，而非头发的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have to endure something unwillingly because there is little or no choice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因为没有多少选择而不得不忍受某事，心里并不情愿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu jissaporti xi ħaġa kontra qalbu għax ma jkollux għażla.

sense_translations.en_definition: to have to bear sth. against one's will
sense_translations.zh_definition: 不得不违背自己的意愿承受某事；被迫忍受。

collocations.en: had to put up with the noise unwillingly
had to bear the situation against his will

formal.mt: Matul it-tiswijiet, l-inkwilin tqanna' bil-ħoss għax ma kellux fejn imur.
formal.en: During the repairs, the tenant reluctantly had to put up with the noise because he had nowhere to go.
formal.zh: 维修期间，租客因为无处可去，只得不情愿地忍受噪声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark kif għadda l-lejl b'dak il-ħoss kollu? Pawlu: Tqanna' bih; ma kellux kamra oħra fejn jorqod.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Mark get through the night with all that noise? Pawlu: He had to put up with it unwillingly; he had no other room to sleep in.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那么吵，Mark 昨晚怎么熬过来的？Pawlu：他只得忍着；没有别的房间可以睡。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark kif għadda l-lejl b'dak il-ħoss kollu?
messages.mt_standard: Mark kif għadda l-lejl b'dak il-ħoss kollu?
messages.zh: 那么吵，Mark 昨晚怎么熬过来的？
messages.en: How did Mark get through the night with all that noise?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tqanna' bih; ma kellux kamra oħra fejn jorqod.
messages.mt_standard: Tqanna' bih; ma kellux kamra oħra fejn jorqod.
messages.zh: 他只得忍着；没有别的房间可以睡。
messages.en: He had to put up with it unwillingly; he had no other room to sleep in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象隔壁整夜装修，自己又无处可去：心里不愿意，现实却只能忍着，记住“被迫忍受”。

gloss_zh: 不情愿的忍受；勉强承受

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or experience of putting up with something reluctantly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 心里不情愿却仍然忍受某事的行为或经历。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li wieħed jissaporti xi ħaġa kontra qalbu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不情愿地忍受；勉强承受某事。

formal.mt: It-tqannigħ ta' kuljum b'dawn il-kundizzjonijiet ħżiena għejja lill-ħaddiema.
formal.en: Reluctantly putting up with these poor conditions every day exhausted the workers.
formal.zh: 每天勉强忍受这些恶劣条件，使工人们疲惫不堪。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu kuntent bix-xogħol? Mark: Le, dan tqannigħ biss; qed jibqa' għax għandu bżonn il-paga.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Pawlu happy with his job? Mark: No, he's just reluctantly putting up with it; he's staying because he needs the wages.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 对工作满意吗？Mark：不，他只是在勉强忍着；他留下来是因为需要这份工资。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 对工作满意吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu happy with his job?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dan tqannigħ biss; qed jibqa' għax għandu bżonn il-paga.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dan tqannigħ biss; qed jibqa' għax għandu bżonn il-paga.
messages.zh: 不，他只是在勉强忍着；他留下来是因为需要这份工资。
messages.en: No, he's just reluctantly putting up with it; he's staying because he needs the wages.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给“皱着眉头忍下去”这件事贴上名词标签；记忆重点是带着不情愿的忍受过程。

gloss_zh: 激动起来；受激而不安；被激怒；被唤起

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become excited or emotionally stirred, agitated, provoked, or aroused by something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到某事刺激后激动、心绪不安、被激怒，或产生被唤起的感觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss eċċitament, emozzjoni jew aġitazzjoni, jew jirreaġixxi għal xi ħaġa li tipprovokah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到兴奋；激动起来。
心绪受到扰动；变得不安或躁动。
受到挑衅；被激怒或被刺激得作出反应。
被唤起感觉或欲望；被激发。

collocations.en: was emotionally stirred by the speech

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċerimonja, il-missier tqanqal meta sema' isem ibnu.
formal.en: During the ceremony, the father became emotional when he heard his son's name.
formal.zh: 典礼上，父亲听到儿子的名字时激动起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark tqanqal daqshekk? Pawlu: Qalulu li rebaħ il-premju! Maja: Mela nifhem għaliex!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark get so excited? Pawlu: They told him he'd won the prize! Maja: That explains it!
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 为什么那么激动？Pawlu：他们告诉他，他得奖了！Maja：那我就明白了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 为什么那么激动？
messages.en: Why did Mark get so excited?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 他们告诉他，他得奖了！
messages.en: They told him he'd won the prize!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我就明白了！
messages.en: That explains it!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象平静的心湖被消息激起波浪：好消息使人兴奋，挑衅使人激动不安，语境决定具体情绪。

gloss_zh: 动荡；兴奋；躁动；唤起；情绪激动；震动；刺激感；冲动

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stirring or disturbance experienced as upheaval, excitement, agitation, arousal, strong emotion, shock, a thrill, or an urge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种被激起或受到扰动的状态，可依语境指动荡、兴奋、躁动、唤起、强烈情绪、震动、刺激感或冲动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' taqlib, eċċitament, aġitazzjoni jew emozzjoni qawwija; jista' jkun ukoll xokk, sensazzjoni eċċitanti jew xewqa qawwija li tagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动荡；原有秩序或状态受到剧烈扰动。
兴奋；激动的状态。
躁动；心绪不安或受到扰动。
感觉、情绪或欲望的唤起。
情绪；内心受到触动而产生的感情。
震惊；受到强烈冲击时的心理震动。
强烈而短暂的兴奋感；刺激感。
强烈欲望；想要做某事的冲动。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tqanqil politiku li seħħ wara t-tħabbira tar-riżultati.
formal.en: The report describes the political upheaval that followed the announcement of the results.
formal.zh: 报告描述了结果公布后出现的政治动荡。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif ħassejtek meta tlajt fuq il-palk? Mark: Ħassejt tqanqil kbir; kont eċċitat u ftit imbeżża'.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you feel when you went on stage? Mark: I felt a huge rush of emotion; I was excited and a little scared.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你上台时是什么感觉？Mark：我心里一阵强烈的激动；既兴奋，又有点害怕。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħassejtek meta tlajt fuq il-palk?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħassejtek meta tlajt fuq il-palk?
messages.zh: 你上台时是什么感觉？
messages.en: How did you feel when you went on stage?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħassejt tqanqil kbir; kont eċċitat u ftit imbeżża'.
messages.mt_standard: Ħassejt tqanqil kbir; kont eċċitat u ftit imbeżża'.
messages.zh: 我心里一阵强烈的激动；既兴奋，又有点害怕。
messages.en: I felt a huge rush of emotion; I was excited and a little scared.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把多个义项放进“平静被打破”的记忆图：社会层面是动荡，内心层面可表现为兴奋、躁动、震惊或冲动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process by which something becomes heavy or heavier.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物逐渐变重、重量增加的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih xi ħaġa ssir tqila jew iżjed tqila.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变重的过程；逐渐变得沉重。

formal.mt: It-tqantir tal-borża hekk kif timtela jagħmilha aktar diffiċli biex tinġarr.
formal.en: The bag's becoming heavier as it fills makes it more difficult to carry.
formal.zh: 袋子随着装入的东西增多而变重，因而更难搬运。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-borża qed issir tqila! Mark: It-tqantir tagħha ġej mill-kotba li qed iżżid. Maja: Mela nieqaf inżid.
colloquial.en: Maja: This bag is getting heavy! Mark: It's becoming heavier because of the books you're adding. Maja: Then I'll stop adding more.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个袋子越来越重了！Mark：它变重是因为你一直往里面加书。Maja：那我不再加了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个袋子越来越重了！
messages.en: This bag is getting heavy!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tqantir tagħha ġej mill-kotba li qed iżżid.
messages.mt_standard: It-tqantir tagħha ġej mill-kotba li qed iżżid.
messages.zh: 它变重是因为你一直往里面加书。
messages.en: It's becoming heavier because of the books you're adding.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我不再加了。
messages.en: Then I'll stop adding more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象往袋子里一本本加书，手上的重量持续增加；用连续画面记住“变重的过程”这个名词义。

gloss_zh: 被节省下来；被省着使用

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be saved or used sparingly so that less money or fewer resources are spent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 钱款或资源被节省下来，或通过节约使用而减少消耗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi ffrankat jew jintuża bil-qies biex jonqos l-infiq jew il-konsum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被节省下来；指钱款或资源得以省下。
被节约使用；被省着用。

collocations.zh: 每一分钱都被省了下来

formal.mt: Matul il-proġett, il-fjuwil tqanċeċ permezz ta' ppjanar aħjar tal-vjaġġi.
formal.en: During the project, fuel was economised through better journey planning.
formal.zh: 项目进行期间，通过更合理地规划行程，燃料得到了节约使用。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif irnexxielkom tonfqu daqshekk ftit? Rita: Kull ċenteżmu tqanċeċ, u xtrajna biss dak li kellna bżonn.
colloquial.en: Mark: How did you manage to spend so little? Rita: Every cent was saved, and we bought only what we needed.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你们怎么做到只花这么少的钱？丽塔：每一分钱都省着花，我们只买了需要的东西。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们怎么做到只花这么少的钱？
messages.en: How did you manage to spend so little?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kull ċenteżmu tqanċeċ, u xtrajna biss dak li kellna bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Kull ċenteżmu tqanċeċ, u xtrajna biss dak li kellna bżonn.
messages.zh: 每一分钱都省着花，我们只买了需要的东西。
messages.en: Every cent was saved, and we bought only what we needed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象账本里一枚被省下的硬币，重点记住钱或资源是被节省的对象，英语 saved 在这里表示省下。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The habit or practice of spending carefully and avoiding waste.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 谨慎花钱、节约使用资源并避免浪费的习惯或做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-drawwa jew il-prattika li wieħed jonfoq bil-qies u jevita l-ħela.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 节俭；善于节省钱财和资源。
俭省；生活或开支节制、不浪费。

formal.mt: It-tqanċiċ fl-infiq għen lill-familja twarrab somma żgħira kull xahar.
formal.en: Thrift in spending helped the family set aside a small amount each month.
formal.zh: 节俭开支帮助这家人每个月存下一小笔钱。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex qed issewwi l-borża l-qadima? Luqa: Għat-tqanċiċ; għadha tajba u m'għandix għalfejn nixtri oħra.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why are you repairing the old bag? Luqa: To be frugal; it's still good, and I don't need to buy another one.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你为什么在修那个旧包？卢卡：为了节省，它还好好的，我没必要再买一个。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么在修那个旧包？
messages.en: Why are you repairing the old bag?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tqanċiċ; għadha tajba u m'għandix għalfejn nixtri oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tqanċiċ; għadha tajba u m'għandix għalfejn nixtri oħra.
messages.zh: 为了节省，它还好好的，我没必要再买一个。
messages.en: To be frugal; it's still good, and I don't need to buy another one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把修旧包、按需购物和每月存钱放进同一个生活画面，用 tqanċiċ 给这种节俭习惯命名。

gloss_zh: 过度用力；过分勉强自己

teaching_sense.en_definition: To strain oneself excessively or put too much effort into trying to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做某事时过度用力，或努力过头而勉强自己。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jisforza lilu nnifsu żżejjed jew jagħmel sforz akbar milli jiflaħ biex iwettaq xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过度耗费体力或精力；使自己劳累过度。

sense_translations.en_definition: to try too hard at doing sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 做某事时努力过头；过分勉强自己。

collocations.en: strained himself trying to lift a box
collocations.zh: 为了抬箱子而过度用力

collocations.en: pushed himself too hard to finish the work
collocations.zh: 为了完成工作而过分勉强自己

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem tqanżaħ biex jerfa' l-kaxxa tqila mingħajr għajnuna.
formal.en: The worker overexerted himself trying to lift the heavy box without help.
formal.zh: 那名工人试图独自抬起沉重的箱子，结果用力过度。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark waqaf jistrieħ? Pawlu: Tqanżaħ biex iġorr kollox waħdu. Maja: Ejja ngħinuh bil-bqija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark stop to rest? Pawlu: He overexerted himself trying to carry everything alone. Maja: Let's help him with the rest.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 为什么停下来休息了？Pawlu：他想一个人搬完所有东西，太勉强自己了。Maja：我们帮他搬剩下的吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 为什么停下来休息了？
messages.en: Why did Mark stop to rest?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 他想一个人搬完所有东西，太勉强自己了。
messages.en: He overexerted himself trying to carry everything alone.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们帮他搬剩下的吧。
messages.en: Let's help him with the rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人硬搬超出能力的大箱子，脸都憋红了；把“用力超过限度”与“过分勉强自己”一起记。

gloss_zh: 过度使劲；费力或勉强地做事

teaching_sense.en_definition: Excessive physical effort, or the effort involved in doing something with great difficulty or reluctance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指身体用力过度，也指十分费劲或不情愿地完成某件事的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sforz fiżiku żejjed, jew it-twettiq ta' xi ħaġa b'diffikultà kbira jew kontra qalbek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过度用力；身体付出超出适当程度的力气。

sense_translations.en_definition: carrying out of an action with great difficulty or reluctance
sense_translations.zh_definition: 十分费劲或很不情愿地做某件事。

collocations.zh: 十分费劲地；很不情愿地

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ċaqlaq il-kaxxa tqila b'ħafna tqanżiħ.
formal.en: The worker moved the heavy box with considerable effort.
formal.zh: 工人费了很大的劲才搬动那个沉重的箱子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Irnexxielek tiftaħ il-vażett? Pawlu: Iva, imma b'ħafna tqanżiħ; l-għatu kien issikkat ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you manage to open the jar? Pawlu: Yes, but it took a lot of effort; the lid was very tight.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你把罐子打开了吗？保罗：打开了，不过费了很大的劲，盖子拧得特别紧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你把罐子打开了吗？
messages.en: Did you manage to open the jar?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma b'ħafna tqanżiħ; l-għatu kien issikkat ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma b'ħafna tqanżiħ; l-għatu kien issikkat ħafna.
messages.zh: 打开了，不过费了很大的劲，盖子拧得特别紧。
messages.en: Yes, but it took a lot of effort; the lid was very tight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拧紧罐盖时憋足力气的画面：既能记住“过度使劲”，也能联想到“费劲或勉强做事”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To confess one's sins to a priest in the religious rite of confession.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在宗教告解仪式中向神父承认自己的罪过，接受神父听取告解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqerr id-dnubiet tiegħu lil qassis fis-sagrament tal-qrar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向神父办告解，由神父听取自己的认罪。

collocations.en: went to confession with the priest

formal.mt: Pawlu tqarar għand il-qassis qabel il-quddiesa tal-Ħadd.
formal.en: Pawlu went to confession with the priest before Sunday Mass.
formal.zh: 保罗在主日弥撒前向神父办了告解。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu tqarar illum? Mark: Iva, mar għand il-qassis qabel il-quddiesa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu go to confession today? Mark: Yes, he went to the priest before Mass.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗今天办告解了吗？马克：办了，他在弥撒前去找了神父。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗今天办告解了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu go to confession today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, mar għand il-qassis qabel il-quddiesa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, mar għand il-qassis qabel il-quddiesa.
messages.zh: 办了，他在弥撒前去找了神父。
messages.en: Yes, he went to the priest before Mass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把场景固定为“信徒向神父说出自己的罪过”：主语是办告解的信徒，神父负责听取告解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive Holy Communion during Mass; also, to eat only a very small amount.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指在弥撒中领受圣体；也可指吃得极少，只吃一点点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirċievi l-Ewkaristija waqt il-quddiesa; jista' jfisser ukoll li jiekol ftit ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在弥撒中领圣体。
吃得很少；只吃一点点。

collocations.en: ate only a tiny amount at the meal

formal.mt: Pawlu attenda l-quddiesa u tqarben mal-bqija tal-familja.
formal.en: Pawlu attended Mass and received Communion with the rest of the family.
formal.zh: 保罗参加了弥撒，并和其他家人一起领了圣体。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark kiel sew waqt l-ikla? Pawlu: Le, tqarben biss; ħa żewġ gidmiet u waqaf.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark eat much at the meal? Pawlu: No, he barely ate; he took two bites and stopped.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克这顿饭吃得多吗？保罗：不多，他只吃了一点点，吃了两口就停了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克这顿饭吃得多吗？
messages.en: Did Mark eat much at the meal?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tqarben biss; ħa żewġ gidmiet u waqaf.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tqarben biss; ħa żewġ gidmiet u waqaf.
messages.zh: 不多，他只吃了一点点，吃了两口就停了。
messages.en: No, he barely ate; he took two bites and stopped.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个情境分别记忆：教堂弥撒中是“领圣体”，日常饭桌上可能是“只吃一点点”，靠上下文区分。

gloss_zh: 领圣体礼；圣体领受仪式

teaching_sense.en_definition: The rite in a Catholic Mass in which the faithful receive Holy Communion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 天主教弥撒中信徒领受圣体的礼仪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-rit fil-quddiesa Kattolika li fih il-fidili jirċievu l-Ewkaristija.

sense_translations.en_definition: rite of holy communion in the Catholic mass
sense_translations.zh_definition: 天主教弥撒中的领圣体礼。

formal.mt: Il-familja attendiet għall-ewwel tqarbin ta' Marija fil-knisja tal-parroċċa.
formal.en: The family attended Marija's First Holy Communion at the parish church.
formal.zh: 家人到堂区教堂参加了玛丽亚的初领圣体礼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta se jkun l-ewwel tqarbin ta' Marija? Pawlu: Il-Ħadd filgħodu, fil-knisja tal-parroċċa.
colloquial.en: Maja: When is Marija's First Holy Communion? Pawlu: On Sunday morning, at the parish church.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：玛丽亚什么时候初领圣体？保罗：星期天早上，在堂区教堂。

messages.speaker: Maja (亲友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta se jkun l-ewwel tqarbin ta' Marija?
messages.mt_standard: Meta se jkun l-ewwel tqarbin ta' Marija?
messages.zh: 玛丽亚什么时候初领圣体？
messages.en: When is Marija's First Holy Communion?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 星期天早上，在堂区教堂。
messages.en: On Sunday morning, at the parish church.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tqarbin 当作礼仪名称来记：“参加领圣体礼”。与动词 tqarben“领圣体”配对，分清仪式和动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To undergo a process in which the fibres of a material are separated from one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指材料经过处理，其中的纤维被梳理或分离开来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaddi minn proċess li fih il-fibri tiegħu jinfirdu minn xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使其纤维得到分离；指纤维材料被梳理分开。

collocations.en: the wool had its fibres separated
had its fibres separated before spinning
collocations.zh: 在纺纱前经过纤维梳理

formal.mt: Is-suf tqardax sabiex il-fibri jinfirdu minn xulxin qabel l-għażil.
formal.en: The wool was processed to separate its fibres before spinning.
formal.zh: 羊毛在纺纱前经过梳理，使纤维彼此分开。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan is-suf diġà tqardax? Toni: Iva, il-fibri nferrdu u issa nistgħu nibdew l-għażil.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has this wool already had its fibres separated? Toni: Yes, the fibres have been separated, and now we can start spinning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些羊毛已经梳理开了吗？托尼：是的，纤维已经分开，现在可以开始纺纱了。

messages.speaker: Maja (学徒)
messages.zh: 这些羊毛已经梳理开了吗？
messages.en: Has this wool already had its fibres separated?

messages.speaker: Toni (纺织师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-fibri nferrdu u issa nistgħu nibdew l-għażil.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-fibri nferrdu u issa nistgħu nibdew l-għażil.
messages.zh: 是的，纤维已经分开，现在可以开始纺纱了。
messages.en: Yes, the fibres have been separated, and now we can start spinning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一团缠在一起的羊毛被梳理开，重点记住“材料的纤维被分开”，主语可以是接受处理的羊毛。

gloss_zh: 生长受阻；发育不良而矮小

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have one's growth restricted or to remain undersized because growth has been hindered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指生长受到抑制，或因生长受阻而未能长到正常大小。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tkabbir tiegħu jixxekkel, jew jibqa' żgħir għax ma jikbirx kif suppost.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生长受到抑制或阻碍。
因生长受阻而矮小；发育不充分。

collocations.en: became stunted because of a lack of water

formal.mt: Il-ħaxix f'din il-parti tal-ġnien tqarden minħabba n-nuqqas ta' ilma.
formal.en: The grass in this part of the garden became stunted because of a lack of water.
formal.zh: 花园这一部分的草因缺水而生长不良。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-ħaxix hawn baqa' daqshekk qasir? Toni: Tqarden għax għal żmien twil ma kellux biżżejjed ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why has the grass here stayed so short? Toni: Its growth was stunted because it did not have enough water for a long time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的草怎么一直这么矮？托尼：它很长时间都缺水，生长受到了抑制。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-ħaxix hawn baqa' daqshekk qasir?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-ħaxix hawn baqa' daqshekk qasir?
messages.zh: 这里的草怎么一直这么矮？
messages.en: Why has the grass here stayed so short?

messages.speaker: Toni (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Tqarden għax għal żmien twil ma kellux biżżejjed ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Tqarden għax għal żmien twil ma kellux biżżejjed ilma.
messages.zh: 它很长时间都缺水，生长受到了抑制。
messages.en: Its growth was stunted because it did not have enough water for a long time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一片草地中有一块始终长不高：先记“生长受到阻碍”，再连到结果“长得矮小、发育不足”。

gloss_zh: 植物生长受阻；植株长不大

teaching_sense.en_definition: Stunted growth in plants, which remain small instead of developing normally.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指植物生长受到阻碍，未能正常长大而保持矮小的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tkabbir imfixkel tal-pjanti, li jibqgħu żgħar minflok jiżviluppaw b'mod normali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: （指植物）生长受阻，长不大或发育不良。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tqardin tal-pjanti li baqgħu żgħar matul l-istaġun.
formal.en: The report describes the stunted growth of the plants that remained small throughout the season.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这些植物在整个生长季一直长不大的情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dawn il-pjanti baqgħu żgħar ħafna. Mark: Iva, qed juru sinjali ta' tqardin.
colloquial.en: Maja: These plants have stayed very small. Mark: Yes, they are showing signs of stunted growth.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这些植物一直都很小。Mark：是啊，它们有生长受阻的迹象。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 这些植物一直都很小。
messages.en: These plants have stayed very small.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed juru sinjali ta' tqardin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed juru sinjali ta' tqardin.
messages.zh: 是啊，它们有生长受阻的迹象。
messages.en: Yes, they are showing signs of stunted growth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tqardin 和一盆迟迟长不大的幼苗一起记：重点是植物生长受阻，并非单纯株型小。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The separation or carding of fibres to loosen and disentangle them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把纤维分开、梳松并理开纠结的过程，也指纺织中的梳理工序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih il-fibri jinfirdu u jitħabblu inqas permezz tat-tqardix.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将纤维彼此分开的过程。
梳理纤维的工序，即把纤维梳松、理开。

formal.mt: Matul il-lezzjoni, l-għalliema wriet kif it-tqardix jifred il-fibri tas-suf.
formal.en: During the lesson, the teacher demonstrated how carding separates wool fibres.
formal.zh: 课堂上，老师演示了如何通过梳理把羊毛纤维分开。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tuża dawn l-għodod fuq is-suf? Pawlu: Għat-tqardix, biex nifred il-fibri.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you using these tools on the wool? Pawlu: For carding, to separate the fibres.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么用这些工具处理羊毛？Pawlu：用来梳理，把纤维分开。

messages.speaker: Lara (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tuża dawn l-għodod fuq is-suf?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tuża dawn l-għodod fuq is-suf?
messages.zh: 你为什么用这些工具处理羊毛？
messages.en: Why are you using these tools on the wool?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (手工艺老师)
messages.zh: 用来梳理，把纤维分开。
messages.en: For carding, to separate the fibres.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tqardix 时想象把一团纠结的羊毛梳松：从纤维挤成团，变成纤维分开。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To start behaving mischievously or become naughty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 开始做调皮捣蛋的事，或变得淘气、不守规矩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Beda jagħmel il-praspar jew iġib ruħu b'mod imqareb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开始调皮捣蛋，变得爱搞恶作剧。
变得淘气或不听话。

collocations.en: he started acting mischievously during play
collocations.zh: 他玩耍时开始调皮捣蛋

formal.mt: Waqt l-attività, it-tifel tqareb u beda jaħbi l-lapsijiet ta' sħabu.
formal.en: During the activity, the boy became mischievous and began hiding his classmates' pencils.
formal.zh: 活动中，男孩开始调皮，把同学们的铅笔藏了起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ħbejtli l-kappell? Ben: Għax ridt niċċajta! Maja: Illum tqareb sew!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you hide my hat? Ben: Because I wanted to play a joke! Maja: You've really become mischievous today!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么把我的帽子藏起来？Ben：因为我想开个玩笑！Maja：你今天可真调皮！

messages.speaker: Maja (姐姐)
messages.zh: 你为什么把我的帽子藏起来？
messages.en: Why did you hide my hat?

messages.speaker: Ben (弟弟)
messages.zh: 因为我想开个玩笑！
messages.en: Because I wanted to play a joke!

messages.speaker: Maja (姐姐)
messages.zh: 你今天可真调皮！
messages.en: You've really become mischievous today!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用藏帽子的恶作剧记 tqareb：原本安分的人开始调皮，注意它表达行为发生变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be crushed or broken by crunching, as when something crisp is bitten.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指脆的东西被咬碎或压碎，呈现嘎嘣碎裂的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inkiser jew tfarrak bi ħoss, bħal ikel iqarmeċ meta jingidem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被嘎嘣咬碎或压碎。

collocations.en: it was crunched between the teeth
it was crunched with the first bite

formal.mt: Il-gallettun niexef tqarmeċ bejn is-snien mal-ewwel gidma.
formal.en: The dry cracker was crunched between the teeth with the first bite.
formal.zh: 干脆饼第一口就在牙齿间被嘎嘣咬碎了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-gallettun iebes? Mark: Le, tqarmeċ mal-ewwel gidma.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this cracker hard? Mark: No, it crunched apart with the first bite.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这块脆饼硬吗？Mark：不硬，第一口就嘎嘣咬碎了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这块脆饼硬吗？
messages.en: Is this cracker hard?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 不硬，第一口就嘎嘣咬碎了。
messages.en: No, it crunched apart with the first bite.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象脆饼在牙齿间嘎嘣裂开来记 tqarmeċ：关注的是东西被咬碎，而非谁在吃。

gloss_zh: 嘎嘣嚼碎；嘎吱咬碎的动作

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of crunching something crisp or hard, often with an audible cracking sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把脆硬的东西嘎嘣咬碎、嚼碎的动作，常伴有清脆的碎裂声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tkisser jew tfarrak xi ħaġa tqarmeċ bis-snien, spiss bi ħoss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嘎嘣咬碎或嚼碎的动作。

formal.mt: Fir-reġistrazzjoni jinstema' b'mod ċar il-ħoss tat-tqarmiċ tal-gallettini.
formal.en: The sound of biscuits being crunched can be heard clearly in the recording.
formal.zh: 录音中可以清楚听到嘎嘣嚼饼干的声音。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak il-ħoss? Ben: It-tqarmiċ tal-lewż; qed niekol ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that sound? Ben: Almonds crunching; I'm eating some.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那是什么声音？Ben：嚼杏仁的声音，我正吃一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 那是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that sound?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.zh: 嚼杏仁的声音，我正吃一点。
messages.en: Almonds crunching; I'm eating some.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tqarmiċ 配上嚼杏仁的嘎嘣声，作为名词记住整个咬碎动作，与动词 tqarmeċ 对照。

gloss_zh: 变得不情愿参与；开始打退堂鼓

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become reluctant to take part in something or undertake an activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对参加某件事或着手某项活动变得不情愿，开始退缩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Beda jsibha bi tqila biex jieħu sehem f'xi ħaġa jew jibda jagħmel xi xogħol.

sense_translations.en_definition: to become reluctant to engage in sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得不愿参与某事或不愿着手做某事。

collocations.en: he became reluctant when he heard about the work
collocations.zh: 他听到要干的活便打起了退堂鼓

collocations.mt: tqarnas u ma riedx jieħu sehem
collocations.en: he became reluctant and did not want to take part

formal.mt: Meta sar jaf kemm kien se jdum il-proġett, il-voluntier tqarnas u talab aktar żmien biex jiddeċiedi.
formal.en: When he learned how long the project would last, the volunteer became reluctant and asked for more time to decide.
formal.zh: 得知项目需要持续多久后，这名志愿者开始退缩，并要求多一点时间考虑。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ben se jiġi jgħinna? Mark: Għall-ewwel qal iva, imma meta sema' kemm hemm xogħol, tqarnas.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is Ben coming to help us? Mark: He said yes at first, but when he heard how much work there was, he became reluctant.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Ben会来帮我们吗？Mark：他起初答应了，可听说有这么多活，就打起了退堂鼓。

messages.speaker: Lara (活动组织者)
messages.zh: Ben会来帮我们吗？
messages.en: Is Ben coming to help us?

messages.speaker: Mark (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għall-ewwel qal iva, imma meta sema' kemm hemm xogħol, tqarnas.
messages.mt_standard: Għall-ewwel qal iva, imma meta sema' kemm hemm xogħol, tqarnas.
messages.zh: 他起初答应了，可听说有这么多活，就打起了退堂鼓。
messages.en: He said yes at first, but when he heard how much work there was, he became reluctant.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用先答应、听完任务又退缩的画面记 tqarnas：关键是变得不情愿参与某事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A condition of living in hardship or having limited means.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指生活艰难、可用钱财有限，需要勉强维持生计的处境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qagħda ta' ħajja diffiċli, bi ftit mezzi biex wieħed jgħix.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在艰难困苦中度日的生活状态。
经济条件有限、生活拮据的处境。

collocations.en: years of living with limited means

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont tagħha, l-awtriċi tiddeskrivi s-snin ta' tqarnis li għaddiet minnhom il-familja.
formal.en: In her account, the author describes the years of hardship that the family went through.
formal.zh: 作者在叙述中描写了这个家庭经历的那些艰苦年月。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kienet il-ħajja tagħkom dak iż-żmien? Rita: Kienet ħajja ta' tqarnis; kellna ftit flus u konna noqogħdu attenti għal kull sold.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was life like for you back then? Rita: It was a life of hardship; we had little money and watched every penny.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你们那时候过得怎么样？Rita：日子很拮据，钱很少，每一分钱都得算着花。

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kienet il-ħajja tagħkom dak iż-żmien?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kienet il-ħajja tagħkom dak iż-żmien?
messages.zh: 你们那时候过得怎么样？
messages.en: What was life like for you back then?

messages.speaker: Rita (祖母)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienet ħajja ta' tqarnis; kellna ftit flus u konna noqogħdu attenti għal kull sold.
messages.mt_standard: Kienet ħajja ta' tqarnis; kellna ftit flus u konna noqogħdu attenti għal kull sold.
messages.zh: 日子很拮据，钱很少，每一分钱都得算着花。
messages.en: It was a life of hardship; we had little money and watched every penny.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tqarnis 放进艰苦年月的回忆中：钱少、处处节省，作为名词表示拮据的生活处境。

gloss_zh: 变硬开裂；被燎焦；变得调皮

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become stiff and crack, to become singed, or, of a person, to become mischievous or naughty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指物体变硬并开裂、表面被燎焦，也可指人变得调皮或淘气；须根据主语和语境区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sar iebes u xxaqqaq, inħaraq ftit minn barra, jew, meta jingħad fuq persuna, sar imqareb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐变得僵硬，并出现裂纹或开裂。
被燎焦，表面受到轻微烧灼。
变得调皮、淘气或爱捣蛋。

collocations.en: the leather became stiff and cracked
it became singed by the heat of the flame
collocations.zh: 它被火焰的热力燎焦了

formal.mt: Il-ġild taċ-ċinturin tqarqaċ: sar iebes u dehru xquq fil-wiċċ tiegħu.
formal.en: The leather of the belt became stiff and cracked: it hardened, and cracks appeared on its surface.
formal.zh: 皮带的皮革变硬开裂了：质地发硬，表面出现了裂纹。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'għamel Ben illum? Mark: Ħeba ż-żraben ta' oħtu u daħak. Rita: Mela tqarqaċ illum!
colloquial.en: Rita: What did Ben do today? Mark: He hid his sister's shoes and laughed. Rita: So he became mischievous today!
colloquial.zh: Rita：Ben今天干了什么？Mark：他把姐姐的鞋藏起来，还笑个不停。Rita：看来他今天调皮起来了！

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: Ben今天干了什么？
messages.en: What did Ben do today?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħeba ż-żraben ta' oħtu u daħak.
messages.mt_standard: Ħeba ż-żraben ta' oħtu u daħak.
messages.zh: 他把姐姐的鞋藏起来，还笑个不停。
messages.en: He hid his sister's shoes and laughed.

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 看来他今天调皮起来了！
messages.en: So he became mischievous today!

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 tqarqaċ 分别画三张记忆卡：硬裂的皮革、燎焦的表面、捣蛋的孩子；靠语境选择义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action or process of crumpling, cracking, or singeing something, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据语境，指把东西揉皱、使其开裂，或将其表面轻轻燎焦的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni jew il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa titkemmex, tinqasam jew tinħaraq ħafif, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 揉皱；使纸张等物体起皱、变形的动作。
开裂；使物体产生裂缝或裂开的动作或过程。
燎烧；将毛发或物体表面轻微烧焦的动作。

formal.mt: It-tqarqiċ tal-karta jista' jagħmel it-test aktar diffiċli biex jinqara.
formal.en: Crumpling the paper can make the text harder to read.
formal.zh: 把纸揉皱可能会使文字更难辨读。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak it-tqarqiċ? Pawlu: Il-friegħi niexfa qed jinqasmu taħt saqajna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that cracking? Pawlu: The dry branches are breaking under our feet.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那是什么断裂声？保罗：是干树枝在我们脚下断裂。

messages.speaker: Maja (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 那是什么断裂声？
messages.en: What's that cracking?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-friegħi niexfa qed jinqasmu taħt saqajna.
messages.mt_standard: Il-friegħi niexfa qed jinqasmu taħt saqajna.
messages.zh: 是干树枝在我们脚下断裂。
messages.en: The dry branches are breaking under our feet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅小图记住三个义项：纸被揉皱、木头开裂、毛发表面被燎焦；每次都把词与具体材料一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made or prompted to read by someone else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在他人的要求、安排或引导下进行阅读或朗读。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mġiegħel jew imħeġġeġ minn xi ħadd biex jaqra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被他人要求、促使或安排去读。

collocations.en: was made to read in front of the class
collocations.zh: 被安排在全班面前朗读

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni, l-istudent tqarra s-silta b'leħen għoli mill-għalliem.
formal.en: During the lesson, the student was made by the teacher to read the passage aloud.
formal.zh: 上课时，老师要求这名学生大声朗读那段文字。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel Pawlu fil-klassi llum? Sara: Tqarra poeżija quddiem kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Pawlu do in class today? Sara: He was made to read a poem in front of everyone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗今天在课堂上做了什么？萨拉：他被要求在大家面前朗读一首诗。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 保罗今天在课堂上做了什么？
messages.en: What did Pawlu do in class today?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 他被要求在大家面前朗读一首诗。
messages.en: He was made to read a poem in front of everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师点名让学生朗读：记忆重点是“有人促使他读”，而不只是学生自己主动阅读。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lose hair on the head and become bald.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 头上的头发脱落，逐渐变秃或出现秃顶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef ix-xagħar ta' rasu u jsir qargħi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变秃；因头发脱落而成为秃头或出现秃顶。

collocations.en: went bald at a young age

formal.mt: Fil-bijografija tiegħu, l-awtur jgħid li tqarra' ta' età żgħira.
formal.en: In his biography, the author says that he went bald at a young age.
formal.zh: 作者在自己的传记中说，他很年轻时就秃顶了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad għandu xagħru twil Karl? Pawlu: Le, tqarra' minn fuq, imma għad għandu xagħar fil-ġnub.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does Karl still have long hair? Pawlu: No, he went bald on top, but he still has hair at the sides.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：卡尔还留着长发吗？保罗：没有了，他头顶秃了，不过两边还有头发。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 卡尔还留着长发吗？
messages.en: Does Karl still have long hair?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tqarra' minn fuq, imma għad għandu xagħar fil-ġnub.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tqarra' minn fuq, imma għad għandu xagħar fil-ġnub.
messages.zh: 没有了，他头顶秃了，不过两边还有头发。
messages.en: No, he went bald on top, but he still has hair at the sides.

cognitive_memory_aid: 认准词尾撇号，把整个词配上“头顶头发逐渐减少”的画面，并与没有词尾撇号的 tqarra 分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop or have an abscess, usually in the foot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体某处形成或长有脓肿，通常用于脚部。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu axxess, jiġifieri nefħa bil-materja, ġeneralment f'siequ.

sense_translations.en_definition: to have an abscess (usually in the foot)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 长脓肿；通常指脚部长有脓肿。

collocations.en: developed an abscess in his foot
developed an abscess in the right foot

formal.mt: Il-pazjent tqarrad f'siequ u ġie eżaminat mit-tabib.
formal.en: The patient developed an abscess in his foot and was examined by the doctor.
formal.zh: 这名患者脚上长了脓肿，并接受了医生的检查。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex mhux ġej jimxi magħna Pawlu? Sara: Tqarrad f'siequ u qed jistrieħ id-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why isn't Pawlu coming for a walk with us? Sara: He has an abscess in his foot and is resting at home.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么不来和我们散步？萨拉：他脚上长了脓肿，正在家休息。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex mhux ġej jimxi magħna Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex mhux ġej jimxi magħna Pawlu?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么不来和我们散步？
messages.en: Why isn't Pawlu coming for a walk with us?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tqarrad f'siequ u qed jistrieħ id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Tqarrad f'siequ u qed jistrieħ id-dar.
messages.zh: 他脚上长了脓肿，正在家休息。
messages.en: He has an abscess in his foot and is resting at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与“脚上鼓起一个脓包，走路不方便”的场景绑定；记住它比一般的脚痛更具体。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be picked or gathered, especially when referring to fruit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指水果等被人从生长处摘下、采集。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqata' jew jinġabar minn fejn ikun qed jikber, speċjalment meta jkun frott.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be picked (used of fruit etc.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被采摘；用于水果等被摘下或采集。

formal.mt: Il-frott tqarraf bl-idejn u tqiegħed fil-kaxxi għat-trasport.
formal.en: The fruit was picked by hand and placed in boxes for transport.
formal.zh: 水果由人工采摘，随后装箱运输。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-frott frisk? Mark: Iva, tqarraf dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this fruit fresh? Mark: Yes, it was picked this morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些水果新鲜吗？马克：新鲜，今天早上刚摘的。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这些水果新鲜吗？
messages.en: Is this fruit fresh?

messages.speaker: Mark (水果摊主)
messages.zh: 新鲜，今天早上刚摘的。
messages.en: Yes, it was picked this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象水果从枝头进入采摘篮：叙述焦点放在“水果被摘下”，就容易记住这个词的被动意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be bitten off or gnawed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被牙齿咬掉一部分，或遭到反复啃咬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tinqatagħlu biċċa b'gidma jew jiġi migdum ripetutament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被咬掉；某一部分被牙齿咬断、咬下。
被啃咬；被牙齿反复咬磨。

collocations.en: was bitten off in one bite

formal.mt: Il-ħobż li tħalla fuq il-mejda tqarram mill-ġurdien matul il-lejl.
formal.en: The bread left on the table was gnawed by the mouse during the night.
formal.zh: 留在桌上的面包夜里被老鼠啃咬了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar tarf il-gallettina? Pawlu: Tqarram b'gidma waħda; ħija ħa biċċa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did the end of the biscuit go? Pawlu: It was bitten off in one bite; my brother took a piece.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：饼干的一角去哪儿了？保罗：被一口咬掉了，我弟弟咬了一块。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 饼干的一角去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did the end of the biscuit go?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tqarram b'gidma waħda; ħija ħa biċċa.
messages.mt_standard: Tqarram b'gidma waħda; ħija ħa biċċa.
messages.zh: 被一口咬掉了，我弟弟咬了一块。
messages.en: It was bitten off in one bite; my brother took a piece.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用饼干边缘帮助记忆：缺了一角对应“被咬掉”，留下许多细小齿痕对应“被啃咬”，两义都从被咬的物体来看。

gloss_zh: 遭妻子背叛；妻子与他人有染

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have one's wife be sexually unfaithful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指男子的妻子与他人有染，男子因此遭到配偶的背叛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu martu tkun infidila lejh billi jkollha relazzjoni sesswali ma' persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: （指男子）妻子与他人有染；遭妻子背叛，俗称被戴绿帽子。

collocations.en: was cuckolded after years of marriage
collocations.zh: 结婚多年后遭妻子背叛

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, Karl tqarran meta martu bdiet relazzjoni ma' raġel ieħor.
formal.en: In the novel, Karl was cuckolded when his wife began an affair with another man.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，卡尔的妻子与另一名男子发生婚外情，背叛了他。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fir-rumanz, għaliex Karl telaq minn daru? Pawlu: Għax tqarran u ma riedx jibqa' jgħix ma' martu.
colloquial.en: Maja: In the novel, why did Karl leave home? Pawlu: Because his wife cheated on him and he no longer wanted to live with her.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：小说里的卡尔为什么离家了？保罗：因为妻子背叛了他，他不想再和她一起生活。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fir-rumanz, għaliex Karl telaq minn daru?
messages.mt_standard: Fir-rumanz, għaliex Karl telaq minn daru?
messages.zh: 小说里的卡尔为什么离家了？
messages.en: In the novel, why did Karl leave home?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax tqarran u ma riedx jibqa' jgħix ma' martu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax tqarran u ma riedx jibqa' jgħix ma' martu.
messages.zh: 因为妻子背叛了他，他不想再和她一起生活。
messages.en: Because his wife cheated on him and he no longer wanted to live with her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用小说人物关系图记忆：妻子与第三者有染，丈夫是遭背叛的一方；把词贴在丈夫身旁，记清叙述视角。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be misled into believing something false, whether through deception or a mistaken impression.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因他人的欺骗或自身的错误印象而相信不真实的事，受到蒙骗或陷入错觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Temmen xi ħaġa li mhix vera minħabba qerq jew impressjoni żbaljata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到欺骗；因别人提供的虚假信息而信以为真。
陷入错觉或错误信念；误把不真实的情况当成事实。

formal.mt: Ix-xerrej tqarraq bid-deskrizzjoni tal-prodott u ħaseb li kien ġdid.
formal.en: The buyer was deceived by the product description and thought it was new.
formal.zh: 买家被产品描述蒙骗，以为那件商品是新的。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex Pawlu xtara dak l-arloġġ? Luqa: Tqarraq bid-dehra; ħaseb li kien jiswa ħafna.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did Pawlu buy that watch? Luqa: He was misled by its appearance; he thought it was worth a lot.
colloquial.zh: Marija：Pawlu为什么买那块手表？Luqa：他被外表迷惑了，以为它很值钱。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu为什么买那块手表？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu buy that watch?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tqarraq bid-dehra; ħaseb li kien jiswa ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Tqarraq bid-dehra; ħaseb li kien jiswa ħafna.
messages.zh: 他被外表迷惑了，以为它很值钱。
messages.en: He was misled by its appearance; he thought it was worth a lot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象买家看见漂亮包装便信以为真：把这个词与“被骗而相信”相连，同时记住它也能表示陷入错觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become sour, or to make a strained facial expression in response to an unpleasant taste or feeling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指食物等变酸，也可指因难受的味道或感觉而龇牙皱脸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir qares, jew jagħmel espressjoni b'wiċċu minħabba togħma jew sensazzjoni mhux pjaċevoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变酸；食物或饮料的味道发生变化而带有酸味。
龇牙皱脸；因疼痛、不适或难吃的味道而扭动面部。

formal.mt: Il-ħalib tqarras wara li tħalla barra mill-friġġ għal żmien twil.
formal.en: The milk went sour after being left out of the fridge for a long time.
formal.zh: 牛奶在冰箱外放了很久，之后变酸了。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex Ġanni tqarras hekk? Toni: Daq il-meraq tal-lumi mingħajr zokkor.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did Ġanni grimace like that? Toni: He tasted the lemon juice without sugar.
colloquial.zh: Rita：Ġanni怎么皱成那副表情？Toni：他尝了没加糖的柠檬汁。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: Ġanni怎么皱成那副表情？
messages.en: Why did Ġanni grimace like that?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 他尝了没加糖的柠檬汁。
messages.en: He tasted the lemon juice without sugar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“牛奶变酸”和“尝酸后皱脸”两幅相邻画面记住两个义项；这是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To get scratched or bruised.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因刮擦或碰撞而受伤，出现擦伤、抓伤或瘀伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġarrab grif jew tbenġil minħabba brix jew daqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被刮伤、擦伤或碰伤；出现抓痕或瘀伤。

collocations.en: got scratched or bruised when he fell

formal.mt: It-tifel tqarraħ meta waqa' fil-bitħa tal-iskola.
formal.en: The boy got scratched or bruised when he fell in the school playground.
formal.zh: 这个男孩在学校操场跌倒时擦伤或碰伤了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għandu dawk il-grif fuq idejh Karl? Pawlu: Tqarraħ bix-xewk waqt li kien qed jaħdem fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does Karl have those scratches on his hands? Pawlu: He got scratched by thorns while working in the garden.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：卡尔手上为什么有那些划痕？保罗：他在花园干活时被荆棘刮伤了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għandu dawk il-grif fuq idejh Karl?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għandu dawk il-grif fuq idejh Karl?
messages.zh: 卡尔手上为什么有那些划痕？
messages.en: Why does Karl have those scratches on his hands?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tqarraħ bix-xewk waqt li kien qed jaħdem fil-ġnien.
messages.mt_standard: Tqarraħ bix-xewk waqt li kien qed jaħdem fil-ġnien.
messages.zh: 他在花园干活时被荆棘刮伤了。
messages.en: He got scratched by thorns while working in the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它配上两种皮肤痕迹：荆棘留下的划痕、跌倒留下的瘀青；共同记忆点是身体被刮碰而受伤。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be moved or caused to come nearer to a person, object, or place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在外力或某种安排下被移得更近，或被使向某个人、物体或地点靠近。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitressaq eqreb lejn persuna, oġġett jew post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被移近；被带到距离某人或某物更近的位置。
被使靠近；在他人或外力作用下向某个目标接近。

collocations.en: was moved closer to the table
collocations.zh: 被移到更靠近桌子的位置

collocations.en: was moved closer to the window
collocations.zh: 被移到更靠近窗户的位置

formal.mt: Il-mikrofonu tqarreb lejn il-kelliem sabiex il-vuċi tiegħu tinstema' aħjar.
formal.en: The microphone was moved closer to the speaker so that his voice could be heard more clearly.
formal.zh: 麦克风被移近发言者，以便更清楚地听到他的声音。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn hu s-siġġu li kien ħdejn il-bieb? Mark: Tqarreb lejn il-mejda biex ikun hemm aktar spazju ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where is the chair that was by the door? Mark: It was moved closer to the table to make more room by the door.
colloquial.zh: Anna：原来门边那把椅子在哪儿？Mark：它被移近桌子了，好让门边更宽敞。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu s-siġġu li kien ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu s-siġġu li kien ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.zh: 原来门边那把椅子在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is the chair that was by the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tqarreb lejn il-mejda biex ikun hemm aktar spazju ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Tqarreb lejn il-mejda biex ikun hemm aktar spazju ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 它被移近桌子了，好让门边更宽敞。
messages.en: It was moved closer to the table to make more room by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一把椅子被人推向桌边，距离逐渐缩短；重点记住“被移近、被使接近”的受动含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of bringing things closer together or making them more similar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把人或事物之间的距离拉近，或使其特点、做法等变得更相似的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih persuni jew affarijiet jitressqu eqreb lejn xulxin jew isiru aktar simili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拉近；使人或事物之间的距离缩小这一行为或过程。
使更相似；使不同事物在特点、标准或做法上更加接近。

formal.mt: It-tqarrib tal-metodi taż-żewġ skejjel għandu jagħmilha aktar faċli biex jitqabblu r-riżultati.
formal.en: Making the two schools' methods more similar should make their results easier to compare.
formal.zh: 使两所学校的方法更加一致，应能让结果更便于比较。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'għen biex kulħadd jisma' aħjar? Ben: It-tqarrib tas-siġġijiet lejn il-kelliem.
colloquial.en: Sara: What helped everyone hear better? Ben: Moving the chairs closer to the speaker.
colloquial.zh: Sara：怎样做让大家听得更清楚了？Ben：把椅子移近发言者。

messages.speaker: Sara (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 怎样做让大家听得更清楚了？
messages.en: What helped everyone hear better?

messages.speaker: Ben (活动助手)
messages.zh: 把椅子移近发言者。
messages.en: Moving the chairs closer to the speaker.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两把椅子靠拢记作空间上的拉近，把两套方法调整得相似记作特点上的拉近；本词是过程名词。

gloss_zh: 抢先挑取；抢先摘走好果子

teaching_sense.en_definition: Taking the choice items, such as fruit, before other people have a chance to get them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 趁别人还没有机会取用之前，先把较好的东西挑走，例如抢先摘走好果子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għażla u t-teħid tal-aħjar affarijiet, bħal frott, qabel ma ħaddieħor ikollu ċans jeħodhom.

sense_translations.en_definition: taking the pickings (e.g. of fruit) before others can get at them
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在别人来得及取用之前抢先挑取，例如果实尚未被别人采到就先挑走好的。

collocations.en: taking the choice fruit before others can get it
collocations.zh: 抢在别人之前挑走好水果

collocations.en: taking the choice figs before others can get them
collocations.zh: 抢在别人之前挑走好无花果

formal.mt: It-tqarrif tal-frott qabel il-ħin miftiehem ħalla lill-parteċipanti l-oħra mingħajr l-aħjar frott.
formal.en: Taking the choice fruit before the agreed time left the other participants without the best fruit.
formal.zh: 有人在约定时间之前抢先挑走好水果，其他参与者因此分不到最好的果子。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex fadal biss it-tin iż-żgħir? Pawlu: Minħabba t-tqarrif; xi ħadd ħa l-aħjar tin qabel wasalna aħna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are only the small figs left? Pawlu: Because someone got the pickings first; they took the best figs before we arrived.
colloquial.zh: Nina：怎么只剩小无花果了？Pawlu：有人抢先挑过了，在我们到之前就拿走了最好的无花果。

messages.speaker: Nina (采果伙伴)
messages.zh: 怎么只剩小无花果了？
messages.en: Why are only the small figs left?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (采果伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tqarrif; xi ħadd ħa l-aħjar tin qabel wasalna aħna.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tqarrif; xi ħadd ħa l-aħjar tin qabel wasalna aħna.
messages.zh: 有人抢先挑过了，在我们到之前就拿走了最好的无花果。
messages.en: Because someone got the pickings first; they took the best figs before we arrived.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象大家还没到果树旁，好果子就已被人挑走；记忆重点是“抢在别人之前挑取”，不只是普通采摘。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instance of reading a written text, silently or aloud.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 阅读书面文字的一次活动，可以是默读，也可以是朗读。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Darba li fiha jinqara test miktub, fis-skiet jew b'leħen għoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次阅读或朗读；对一段书面文字进行阅读的活动。

formal.mt: Il-lezzjoni bdiet bi tqarrija b'leħen għoli tat-test, segwita minn diskussjoni qasira.
formal.en: The lesson began with a reading of the text aloud, followed by a short discussion.
formal.zh: 这堂课先朗读课文，随后进行简短讨论。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fhimtu t-test? Ġorġ: Għandi bżonn tqarrija oħra, speċjalment tal-aħħar paragrafu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did you understand the text? Ġorġ: I need another reading, especially of the last paragraph.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你读懂这篇文章了吗？Ġorġ：我还需要再读一遍，尤其是最后一段。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.zh: 你读懂这篇文章了吗？
messages.en: Did you understand the text?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi bżonn tqarrija oħra, speċjalment tal-aħħar paragrafu.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi bżonn tqarrija oħra, speċjalment tal-aħħar paragrafu.
messages.zh: 我还需要再读一遍，尤其是最后一段。
messages.en: I need another reading, especially of the last paragraph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中给“读一遍”画一个计数圈：本词把阅读当作一次活动来命名，可结合“再读一次”的场景记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cropping of grass or the repeated biting and wearing away of something by gnawing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指啃食草的行为，也指通过反复啃咬逐渐损耗某物的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li bih annimal jaqta' l-ħaxix bi snienu jew jigdem xi ħaġa ripetutament u jnaqqasha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 啃食草；动物用牙齿咬取草的行为。
啃咬；反复用牙齿咬磨某物的行为。

formal.mt: It-tqarrim tal-ħaxix min-nagħaġ kien l-aktar qawwi qrib id-daħla tal-għalqa.
formal.en: The cropping of grass by the sheep was most intense near the entrance to the field.
formal.zh: 羊群对草的啃食在田地入口附近最为集中。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhuma dawn il-marki fuq l-injam? David: Huma marki tat-tqarrim tal-fenek; kien qed jigdem it-tarf.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are these marks on the wood? David: They are marks from the rabbit's gnawing; it was biting the edge.
colloquial.zh: Lara：木头上这些是什么痕迹？David：是兔子啃咬留下的，它刚才在啃边缘。

messages.speaker: Lara (宠物主人)
messages.zh: 木头上这些是什么痕迹？
messages.en: What are these marks on the wood?

messages.speaker: David (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Huma marki tat-tqarrim tal-fenek; kien qed jigdem it-tarf.
messages.mt_standard: Huma marki tat-tqarrim tal-fenek; kien qed jigdem it-tarf.
messages.zh: 是兔子啃咬留下的，它刚才在啃边缘。
messages.en: They are marks from the rabbit's gnawing; it was biting the edge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想羊用牙齿啃短青草，再想兔子反复啃木边；用“牙齿一点点咬去东西”串联两个名词义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dishonest conduct involving cheating, misleading others, or scheming to gain an advantage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过作弊、误导他人或暗中耍诡计来取得好处的不诚实行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imġiba diżonesta li tinvolvi ksur tar-regoli, ingann jew pjanijiet moħbija biex jinkiseb vantaġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作弊；以不诚实或违反规则的方式取得优势。
欺骗；使他人相信虚假情况的行为。
暗中耍诡计；秘密谋划以取得不正当优势的行为。

formal.mt: Ir-regolamenti tal-iskola jipprojbixxu t-tqarriq fl-eżamijiet u jitolbu li kull student jippreżenta xogħlu stess.
formal.en: The school regulations prohibit cheating in examinations and require every student to submit their own work.
formal.zh: 学校规定禁止考试作弊，并要求每名学生提交自己完成的作业。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex ma tridx tilgħab ma' Mark? Samwel: Minħabba t-tqarriq; jaħbi l-karti biex jirbaħ.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why don't you want to play with Mark? Samwel: Because of the cheating; he hides cards to win.
colloquial.zh: Elena：你为什么不想和Mark玩？Samwel：因为他作弊，会藏牌来赢。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tridx tilgħab ma' Mark?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tridx tilgħab ma' Mark?
messages.zh: 你为什么不想和Mark玩？
messages.en: Why don't you want to play with Mark?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tqarriq; jaħbi l-karti biex jirbaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tqarriq; jaħbi l-karti biex jirbaħ.
messages.zh: 因为他作弊，会藏牌来赢。
messages.en: Because of the cheating; he hides cards to win.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“考场偷看、广告误导、暗中藏牌”三幅画面记住作弊、欺骗和耍诡计；这里命名的是不诚实行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming sour, or the act of twisting the face into a grimace.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指食物等变酸的过程，也指扭动面部、做出鬼脸或难受表情的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir qarsa, jew l-att li wieħed jgħawweġ wiċċu f'espressjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变酸；食物或液体逐渐产生酸味的过程。
做鬼脸；扭曲面部，做出表示不适、厌恶等的表情。

collocations.en: the twisting of the face into a grimace

formal.mt: Fir-rapport ġie deskritt it-tqarris tal-ħalib u l-bidla fit-togħma tiegħu.
formal.en: The report described the souring of the milk and the change in its taste.
formal.zh: 报告描述了牛奶变酸的过程及其味道的变化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dak it-tqarris tal-wiċċ? Mark: Għax il-lumi qares wisq!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why that grimace? Mark: Because the lemon is too sour!
colloquial.zh: Maja：怎么脸都皱起来了？Mark：因为柠檬太酸了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 怎么脸都皱起来了？
messages.en: Why that grimace?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为柠檬太酸了！
messages.en: Because the lemon is too sour!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“牛奶变酸”和“吃酸柠檬皱脸”连成一个画面，帮助记住这个名词的两个义项；这只是联想记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be cut off or separated from something by cutting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某物或某一部分被切断、剪掉，从原来连接的东西上分离。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqata' u jinfired minn xi ħaġa oħra permezz tal-qtugħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被切断；被剪掉；因切割而与原物分离。

formal.mt: Waqt ix-xogħol, it-tarf tal-ħabel tqartaf b'imqass.
formal.en: During the work, the end of the rope was cut off with scissors.
formal.zh: 作业过程中，绳子的末端被剪刀剪掉了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ġara mill-ħabel? Toni: It-tarf tqartaf, imma għad fadal biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened to the rope? Toni: The end was cut off, but there is still enough left.
colloquial.zh: Lara：绳子怎么了？Toni：末端被剪掉了，不过剩下的还够用。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 绳子怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the rope?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tarf tqartaf, imma għad fadal biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: It-tarf tqartaf, imma għad fadal biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 末端被剪掉了，不过剩下的还够用。
messages.en: The end was cut off, but there is still enough left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一根绳子的末端被剪下并掉落，用“原物与末端分开”的画面记住被切断这一动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have wool or hair removed by shearing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指身上的羊毛或毛发被剪除，承受剪毛这一动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitneħħielu s-suf jew ix-xagħar permezz tal-qtugħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被剪毛；身上的毛被剪除。

formal.mt: Il-muntun tqartam fir-rebbiegħa, u s-suf inġabar f'boroż.
formal.en: The ram was sheared in spring, and the wool was collected in bags.
formal.zh: 这只公羊在春季被剪毛，剪下的羊毛装进了袋子。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex il-muntun jidher iżgħar illum? Pawlu: Għax tqartam dalgħodu!
