colloquial.en: Nina: Why does the ram look smaller today? Pawlu: Because he was sheared this morning!
colloquial.zh: Nina：这只公羊今天怎么看着小了一圈？Pawlu：因为今天早上给它剪毛了！

messages.speaker: Nina (农场访客)
messages.zh: 这只公羊今天怎么看着小了一圈？
messages.en: Why does the ram look smaller today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场主)
messages.zh: 因为今天早上给它剪毛了！
messages.en: Because he was sheared this morning!

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“厚毛公羊变得清爽”的前后对比：这里说的是羊被剪毛，注意动作落在羊身上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be wrapped in paper so that the paper covers the item.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物品被纸包起来，由纸覆盖或包住。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mgeżwer fil-karta biex il-karta tgħatti l-oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被纸包裹；用纸包起来。

collocations.en: the book was wrapped in paper

formal.mt: Il-ktieb tqartas f'karta kkulurita qabel tqiegħed fil-kaxxa.
formal.en: The book was wrapped in coloured paper before it was placed in the box.
formal.zh: 这本书先用彩纸包好，然后放进盒子里。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-ktieb lest għar-rigal? Ben: Iva, tqartas f'karta blu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is the book ready to give as a present? Ben: Yes, it has been wrapped in blue paper.
colloquial.zh: Sara：那本书准备好当礼物了吗？Ben：好了，已经用蓝色纸包起来了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那本书准备好当礼物了吗？
messages.en: Is the book ready to give as a present?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 好了，已经用蓝色纸包起来了。
messages.en: Yes, it has been wrapped in blue paper.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一本书披上彩色纸外衣，看到这个动词就回忆“物品被纸包起来”的完整画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of shearing wool or hair, or of cutting a part off something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指剪除羊毛或毛发的动作，也指把某一部分剪掉或切下来的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jitneħħa s-suf jew ix-xagħar bil-qtugħ, jew li tinqata' parti minn xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剪毛；把羊毛或毛发剪除的动作。
剪断；切除；把某一部分切下或剪掉的动作。

collocations.en: the cutting off of the rope ends

formal.mt: It-tqartif tan-nagħaġ sar filgħodu, u s-suf inġabar biex jinħażen.
formal.en: The shearing of the sheep took place in the morning, and the wool was collected for storage.
formal.zh: 给羊剪毛的工作在上午进行，剪下的羊毛被收集起来储存。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad fadal xogħol fuq il-ħabel? Toni: Iva, it-tqartif tat-truf biss.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there still work to do on the rope? Toni: Yes, just cutting off the ends.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这根绳子还需要处理吗？Toni：需要，只剩剪掉两端了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 这根绳子还需要处理吗？
messages.en: Is there still work to do on the rope?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.zh: 需要，只剩剪掉两端了。
messages.en: Yes, just cutting off the ends.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给剪刀配两幅图：一幅剪羊毛，一幅剪掉绳头；这个名词指两类剪除动作，靠宾语判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of shearing wool or hair, or of pruning a plant by cutting back its growth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指剪除羊毛或毛发的动作，也指剪去植物部分枝条以进行修剪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jitneħħa s-suf jew ix-xagħar bil-qtugħ, jew li jitnaqqsu l-friegħi ta' pjanta biż-żbir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剪毛；剪除羊毛或毛发的动作。
修剪；剪去树木或其他植物的部分枝条。

formal.mt: Il-pjan tax-xogħol jinkludi t-tqartim tas-siġar u l-ġbir tal-friegħi maqtugħa.
formal.en: The work plan includes pruning the trees and collecting the cut branches.
formal.zh: 工作计划包括修剪树木，以及收集剪下的枝条。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-tqartim tan-nagħaġ lest? Pawlu: Iva, issa rridu niġbru s-suf.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the sheep shearing finished? Pawlu: Yes, now we need to collect the wool.
colloquial.zh: Lara：羊都剪完毛了吗？Pawlu：剪完了，现在得把羊毛收起来。

messages.speaker: Lara (农场帮工)
messages.zh: 羊都剪完毛了吗？
messages.en: Is the sheep shearing finished?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场主)
messages.zh: 剪完了，现在得把羊毛收起来。
messages.en: Yes, now we need to collect the wool.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象农场的一天：先给羊剪毛，再给树修枝；把这两项工作并排记住，分别对应两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of wrapping an item in paper.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指用纸把物品包起来的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih oġġett jitgeżwer fil-karta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用纸包裹；以纸包装物品的动作或过程。

collocations.en: the wrapping of presents in paper

formal.mt: It-tqartis tar-rigali jsir wara li jitneħħew it-tikketti tal-prezz.
formal.en: The presents are wrapped in paper after the price labels are removed.
formal.zh: 礼物上的价格标签去掉后，再进行纸包装。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tqartis tar-rigali? Ben: Jien, jekk iġġibli l-karta u t-tejp.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who will take care of wrapping the presents? Ben: I will, if you bring me the paper and tape.
colloquial.zh: Sara：谁来负责用纸包礼物？Ben：我来，你把包装纸和胶带拿给我就行。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tqartis tar-rigali?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tqartis tar-rigali?
messages.zh: 谁来负责用纸包礼物？
messages.en: Who will take care of wrapping the presents?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, jekk iġġibli l-karta u t-tejp.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, jekk iġġibli l-karta u t-tejp.
messages.zh: 我来，你把包装纸和胶带拿给我就行。
messages.en: I will, if you bring me the paper and tape.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中播放“铺纸、放礼物、折纸、贴胶带”的连续动作，记住这个名词指用纸包装的过程。

gloss_zh: 被剪毛；头发被剪得很短

teaching_sense.en_definition: To get sheared, or to have one's hair cut very short.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指被剪毛，也指头发被剪得很短。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitneħħielu s-suf bil-qtugħ, jew jinqatagħlu xagħru qasir ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被剪毛；身上的毛被剪除。

sense_translations.en_definition: to get cut very short (used of hair)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 头发被剪得很短；用于描述头发受到很短的修剪。

collocations.en: had his hair cut very short at the barber's
collocations.zh: 在理发店把头发剪得很短

formal.mt: Il-muntun tqarweż, u s-suf tiegħu nġabar f'borża separata.
formal.en: The ram was sheared, and its wool was collected in a separate bag.
formal.zh: 这只公羊被剪了毛，它的羊毛被单独收进一个袋子里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajtu lil Mark? Tqarweż! Lara: Iva, xagħru qasir ħafna issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you seen Mark? He's had his hair cut really short! Lara: Yes, his hair is very short now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你见到Mark了吗？他把头发剪得特别短！Lara：见到了，他现在头发真的很短。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你见到Mark了吗？他把头发剪得特别短！
messages.en: Have you seen Mark? He's had his hair cut really short!

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 见到了，他现在头发真的很短。
messages.en: Yes, his hair is very short now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排想象剪毛后的羊和刚剪超短发的朋友：两幅图都突出毛发变少，人物义尤其强调头发很短。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of shearing wool or cutting hair short.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 剪下动物的毛，或把头发剪短的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li bih jinqata' s-suf tal-annimali jew jinqata' x-xagħar qasir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给羊等动物剪毛；剪取羊毛。
把头发剪短；短剪头发。

formal.mt: It-tqarwiż tan-nagħaġ għandu jsir b'attenzjoni biex l-annimali ma jweġġgħux.
formal.en: Sheep shearing should be carried out carefully so that the animals are not injured.
formal.zh: 给羊剪毛时应小心操作，以免伤到动物。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Illum se jsir it-tqarwiż tan-nagħaġ? Pawlu: Iva, u wara niġbru s-suf.
colloquial.en: Marta: Are the sheep being sheared today? Pawlu: Yes, and afterwards we'll collect the wool.
colloquial.zh: Marta：今天要给羊剪毛吗？Pawlu：对，剪完后我们把羊毛收起来。

messages.speaker: Marta (农场帮手)
messages.zh: 今天要给羊剪毛吗？
messages.en: Are the sheep being sheared today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (牧羊人)
messages.zh: 对，剪完后我们把羊毛收起来。
messages.en: Yes, and afterwards we'll collect the wool.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上两幅学习图：羊身上剪下羊毛，人的头发剪成短发；共同画面都是把毛发剪下来或剪短。

gloss_zh: 把头发做卷；接受卷发造型

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have one's hair styled into curls.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让人把自己的头发做成卷发，接受卷发造型。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ix-xagħar tiegħu nokkli għand xi ħadd, bħal parrukkier.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 让人把自己的头发弄卷；接受卷发造型。

collocations.en: had his hair curled at the hairdresser's
had his hair curled for the celebration
collocations.zh: 为参加庆祝活动做了卷发

formal.mt: Mark tqarċel għand il-parrukkier bi tħejjija għar-ritratti tat-tieġ.
formal.en: Mark had his hair curled at the hairdresser's in preparation for the wedding photographs.
formal.zh: 马克为拍婚礼照片，到理发店做了卷发。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark tqarċel għall-festa? Pawlu: Iva, mar għand il-parrukkier dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark have his hair curled for the celebration? Pawlu: Yes, he went to the hairdresser's this morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为参加庆祝活动做卷发了吗？保罗：做了，他今天早上去了理发店。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为参加庆祝活动做卷发了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark have his hair curled for the celebration?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 做了，他今天早上去了理发店。
messages.en: Yes, he went to the hairdresser's this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人坐在理发椅上，让理发师把头发卷起来；用“人接受卷发造型”的画面记住这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making something curl, especially the styling of hair into curls.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物卷曲的处理过程，主要用于指把头发做成卷发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa, l-aktar ix-xagħar, tingħata għamla ta' nokkli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使之卷曲的过程，主要指头发的卷曲处理或卷发造型。

formal.mt: Il-parrukkier temm it-tqarċil tax-xagħar qabel ma beda jieħu r-ritratti.
formal.en: The hairdresser finished curling the hair before he began taking photographs.
formal.zh: 理发师完成卷发造型后才开始拍照。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm se jdum it-tqarċil tax-xagħar? Toni: Madwar nofs siegħa; imbagħad tkun lesta għall-festa.
colloquial.en: Maja: How long will the hair curling take? Toni: About half an hour; then you'll be ready for the celebration.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：做卷发要多久？托尼：大约半小时，然后你就可以去参加庆祝活动了。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 做卷发要多久？
messages.en: How long will the hair curling take?

messages.speaker: Toni (理发师)
messages.mt_spoken: Madwar nofs siegħa; imbagħad tkun lesta għall-festa.
messages.mt_standard: Madwar nofs siegħa; imbagħad tkun lesta għall-festa.
messages.zh: 大约半小时，然后你就可以去参加庆祝活动了。
messages.en: About half an hour; then you'll be ready for the celebration.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tqarċil 记成可计算时间的“卷发过程”：问卷发要多久，就是在谈这个名词所表示的处理过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have a surface made smooth and shiny by rubbing or polishing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面经过擦拭或抛光而变得平滑、光亮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li l-wiċċ ta' oġġett isir lixx u jleqq permezz tat-togħrok jew tal-illustrar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被擦亮；表面经过擦拭抛光。
被磨光；表面经过摩擦而变得光滑明亮。

formal.mt: Il-wiċċ tal-metall tqasdar sakemm sar lixx u jleqq.
formal.en: The metal surface was burnished until it became smooth and shiny.
formal.zh: 金属表面经过抛光，直到变得平滑光亮。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan ir-ram għaliex qed jiddi daqshekk? Toni: Għax tqasdar dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is this copper shining so much? Toni: Because it was polished this morning.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这块铜怎么这么亮？Toni：因为今天早上擦亮过了。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ir-ram għaliex qed jiddi daqshekk?
messages.mt_standard: Dan ir-ram għaliex qed jiddi daqshekk?
messages.zh: 这块铜怎么这么亮？
messages.en: Why is this copper shining so much?

messages.speaker: Toni (工匠)
messages.zh: 因为今天早上擦亮过了。
messages.en: Because it was polished this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一块暗淡的铜被布反复擦拭，最后映出亮光；用这个完成后的画面记住“被擦亮、被抛光”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making a surface smooth and shiny by rubbing or polishing it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过摩擦或抛光，使物体表面平滑、光亮的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li jagħmel wiċċ lixx u jleqq permezz tat-togħrok jew tal-illustrar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磨光；通过摩擦使表面光滑明亮的处理。
抛光；擦亮物体表面的过程。

formal.mt: Wara t-tindif, sar it-tqasdir tal-metall biex il-wiċċ ikun lixx u jleqq.
formal.en: After cleaning, the metal was polished to give it a smooth, shiny surface.
formal.zh: 清洁后，对金属进行了抛光，使其表面平滑光亮。

colloquial.mt: Nina: It-tqasdir tar-ram jieħu ħafna ħin? Ġużeppi: Jiddependi mill-kundizzjoni tal-wiċċ.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does polishing copper take a long time? Ġużeppi: It depends on the condition of the surface.
colloquial.zh: Nina：给铜抛光很费时间吗？Ġużeppi：要看表面的状况。

messages.speaker: Nina (学徒)
messages.zh: 给铜抛光很费时间吗？
messages.en: Does polishing copper take a long time?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (工匠)
messages.zh: 要看表面的状况。
messages.en: It depends on the condition of the surface.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它写在“抛光工序”的标签上：先清洁，再摩擦，最后发亮；记住这里指整个处理过程，是一个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be supported with cane stakes, especially when growing plants.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被插设的芦苇秆支撑，尤指生长中的植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li pjanta jew wiċċ tar-raba' jingħata appoġġ permezz ta' qasab imwaħħal fl-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被用插入土中的芦苇秆支撑或固定。

collocations.en: the tomato plants were supported with cane stakes
collocations.zh: 番茄植株用芦苇秆支撑起来了

collocations.en: was supported with cane stakes to grow upright
collocations.zh: 被用芦苇秆支撑，以便直立生长

formal.mt: It-tadam tqassab biex il-pjanti jkollhom appoġġ waqt it-tkabbir.
formal.en: The tomato plants were provided with cane stakes to support them as they grew.
formal.zh: 番茄植株用芦苇秆支撑起来，以便在生长过程中获得支撑。

colloquial.mt: Sara: It-tadam tqassab diġà? Ġanni: Iva, issa l-pjanti għandhom appoġġ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have the tomato plants been staked with canes already? Ġanni: Yes, the plants have support now.
colloquial.zh: Sara：番茄植株已经用芦苇秆支撑好了吗？Ġanni：对，现在植株有支撑了。

messages.speaker: Sara (园艺帮手)
messages.zh: 番茄植株已经用芦苇秆支撑好了吗？
messages.en: Have the tomato plants been staked with canes already?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (菜农)
messages.zh: 对，现在植株有支撑了。
messages.en: Yes, the plants have support now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象番茄苗旁插着芦苇秆，柔软的茎有了依靠；用“植物被支起来”的画面记住这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be distributed, divided into shares, or handed out to recipients.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被分送给接收者，或按份额分配出去。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa tingħata lil diversi persuni jew tinqasam f'ishma għalihom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被分发；被分送到不同的人或地方。
被按份额分配；被划分给各方。
被发放；被逐一交给接收者。

collocations.en: the budget was apportioned among the departments

formal.mt: Il-baġit tqassam bejn id-dipartimenti skont il-ħtiġijiet tagħhom.
formal.en: The budget was apportioned among the departments according to their needs.
formal.zh: 预算根据各部门的需要进行了分配。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-ikel tqassam lil kulħadd? Mark: Iva, kull persuna ħadet sehemha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the food been handed out to everyone? Mark: Yes, everyone has received their share.
colloquial.zh: Maja：食物已经发给每个人了吗？Mark：对，每个人都领到自己的一份了。

messages.speaker: Maja (志愿者)
messages.zh: 食物已经发给每个人了吗？
messages.en: Has the food been handed out to everyone?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动负责人)
messages.zh: 对，每个人都领到自己的一份了。
messages.en: Yes, everyone has received their share.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一大盘食物分成小份，再送到每个人手里；一个画面串起“被分发、按份分配、被发放”三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be cut or trimmed with scissors using small cuts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被用剪刀一下一下地剪切或修短。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa tinqata' jew titqassar b'qatgħat żgħar bl-imqass.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被用剪刀剪切；被剪刀小幅剪短或修整。

collocations.en: the hair was snipped with scissors
the fabric was snipped with scissors

formal.mt: Id-drapp tqassas bl-imqass tul il-linja mmarkata.
formal.en: The fabric was snipped with scissors along the marked line.
formal.zh: 布料沿着标记线用剪刀剪开了。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Ix-xagħar tqassas wisq? Rita: Le, it-truf biss.
colloquial.en: Anna: Was too much hair snipped off? Rita: No, just the ends.
colloquial.zh: Anna：头发是不是剪掉太多了？Rita：没有，只剪了发梢。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 头发是不是剪掉太多了？
messages.en: Was too much hair snipped off?

messages.speaker: Rita (理发师)
messages.zh: 没有，只剪了发梢。
messages.en: No, just the ends.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象剪刀咔嚓咔嚓地修掉发梢，注意头发是被剪的对象；用小幅剪切的动作记住这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be spoken aloud as a recitation, for example a verse or a learned text.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 诗句或学过的文本被出声朗诵或背诵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li vers jew test jingħad b'leħen għoli bħala reċitazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被朗诵；被出声背诵。

collocations.en: the text was recited in front of the class
collocations.zh: 文本在全班面前被朗诵了

formal.mt: Il-vers tqassat b'leħen ċar waqt iċ-ċerimonja tal-iskola.
formal.en: The verse was recited in a clear voice during the school ceremony.
formal.zh: 在学校典礼上，这句诗被清晰地朗诵出来。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-vers tqassat diġà? David: Iva, u kulħadd semgħu sew.
colloquial.en: Marija: Has the verse been recited already? David: Yes, and everyone heard it clearly.
colloquial.zh: Marija：那句诗已经朗诵过了吗？David：对，大家都听得很清楚。

messages.speaker: Marija (教师)
messages.zh: 那句诗已经朗诵过了吗？
messages.en: Has the verse been recited already?

messages.speaker: David (学生)
messages.zh: 对，大家都听得很清楚。
messages.en: Yes, and everyone heard it clearly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象课本中的诗句变成台上清晰的声音；把诗句作为主角，记成“这句诗被朗诵出来了”。

gloss_zh: 被祝圣为神父；领受司铎圣秩

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be ordained as a priest through a religious ceremony.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过宗教祝圣仪式领受司铎圣秩，成为神父。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li raġel jirċievi l-ordinazzjoni saċerdotali u jsir qassis.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be ordained as a priest
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被祝圣为神父；领受司铎圣秩。

collocations.en: was ordained as a priest by the bishop
was ordained as a priest in the cathedral
collocations.zh: 在主教座堂领受司铎圣秩

formal.mt: Pawlu tqasses mill-isqof waqt ċerimonja fil-katidral.
formal.en: Pawlu was ordained as a priest by the bishop during a ceremony in the cathedral.
formal.zh: Pawlu在主教座堂举行的仪式中，由主教祝圣为神父。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Ħuk meta tqasses? Luqa: Is-sena l-oħra, fil-katidral.
colloquial.en: Elena: When was your brother ordained as a priest? Luqa: Last year, in the cathedral.
colloquial.zh: Elena：你兄弟是什么时候领受司铎圣秩的？Luqa：去年，在主教座堂。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟是什么时候领受司铎圣秩的？
messages.en: When was your brother ordained as a priest?

messages.speaker: Luqa (神父的兄弟)
messages.zh: 去年，在主教座堂。
messages.en: Last year, in the cathedral.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象主教在庄严仪式中祝圣一位新神父；把人物身份从候选者变为神父的时刻，与这个动词联系起来。

gloss_zh: 给植物插支柱；搭设棚架

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of putting stakes into the soil to support plants, or erecting a trellis for them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为支撑植物而在土中插入支柱，或为植物搭设棚架的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħidma li jitwaħħlu arbli fil-ħamrija biex isostnu l-pjanti, jew li jinbena qafas li fuqu jistgħu jitilgħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: putting stakes in the soil for plants
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在土中插入支柱以支撑植物。
搭设供植物攀附或获得支撑的棚架。

collocations.en: putting in stakes for tomato plants

formal.mt: It-tqassib tat-tadam għandu jsir b'attenzjoni biex l-għeruq ma jiġux imħassra. L-arbli għandhom ikunu mwaħħlin sew fil-ħamrija.
formal.en: Staking the tomato plants should be done carefully to avoid damaging the roots. The stakes should be firmly secured in the soil.
formal.zh: 给番茄植株插支柱时应小心，以免损伤根部。支柱应牢固地插在土中。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'għandna bżonn għat-tqassib tat-tadam? Pawlu: Ftit arbli u spag biex norbtu l-pjanti magħhom.
colloquial.en: Rita: What do we need for staking the tomato plants? Paul: A few stakes and some string to tie the plants to them.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：给番茄植株插支柱需要什么？保罗：几根支柱和一些绳子，用来把植株绑在支柱上。

messages.speaker: Rita (园艺学员)
messages.zh: 给番茄植株插支柱需要什么？
messages.en: What do we need for staking the tomato plants?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit arbli u spag biex norbtu l-pjanti magħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit arbli u spag biex norbtu l-pjanti magħhom.
messages.zh: 几根支柱和一些绳子，用来把植株绑在支柱上。
messages.en: A few stakes and some string to tie the plants to them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上一幅园艺图：先把支柱插进土里，再搭架让藤蔓攀爬，两种意思都围绕支撑植物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of distributing things among recipients, or sharing something with others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品分发或分配给各个接收者，或与他人分享某物的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' affarijiet lil diversi persuni, jew il-qsim ta' xi ħaġa ma' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把物品或资源分发、分配给不同的人或地方。
与他人分享或分用某物。

formal.mt: It-tqassim tal-ikel se jibda fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu. Il-voluntiera għandhom jiżguraw li kull familja tirċievi pakkett.
formal.en: Food distribution will begin at nine in the morning. Volunteers should ensure that every family receives a package.
formal.zh: 食物分发将于上午九点开始。志愿者应确保每个家庭都领到一份物资包。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tqassim tal-kejk? Mark: Jien. Se nagħti biċċa lil kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maya: Who's going to handle sharing out the cake? Mark: I will. I'll give everyone a slice.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁来负责分蛋糕？马克：我来。我会给每个人一块。

messages.speaker: Maja (聚会主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tqassim tal-kejk?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tqassim tal-kejk?
messages.zh: 谁来负责分蛋糕？
messages.en: Who's going to handle sharing out the cake?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Se nagħti biċċa lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Se nagħti biċċa lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: 我来。我会给每个人一块。
messages.en: I will. I'll give everyone a slice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一个蛋糕分给围坐的朋友：从组织者角度是分发，从大家一起享用的角度是分享。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making something shorter, including reducing a text to its main points.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变短的行为，也指把文字压缩为主要内容的概括或摘要过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħidma li tagħmel xi ħaġa iqsar, jew li tqassar test billi żżomm il-punti ewlenin tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使长度、篇幅或持续时间减少；缩短。
提取主要内容并用较短文字表达；概括或作摘要。

formal.mt: Fit-tqassir ta' test, għandhom jinżammu l-ideat ewlenin. Id-dettalji li mhumiex meħtieġa jistgħu jitħallew barra.
formal.en: When summarising a text, the main ideas should be retained. Details that are unnecessary may be omitted.
formal.zh: 概括文本时，应保留主要观点。不必要的细节可以省略。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm jiswa t-tqassir tal-kmiem? Nina: Għaxar ewro. Nista' nlestihom sa għada.
colloquial.en: Sara: How much does shortening the sleeves cost? Nina: Ten euros. I can have them ready by tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：改短袖子要多少钱？妮娜：十欧元。我明天之前能改好。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 改短袖子要多少钱？
messages.en: How much does shortening the sleeves cost?

messages.speaker: Nina (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaxar ewro. Nista' nlestihom sa għada.
messages.mt_standard: Għaxar ewro. Nista' nlestihom sa għada.
messages.zh: 十欧元。我明天之前能改好。
messages.en: Ten euros. I can have them ready by tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张图记忆：袖子剪短是长度缩短，长文章变成几句要点是内容概括；共同线索都是变短。

gloss_zh: 剪切；剪成小片；司铎授秩

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of snipping or cutting material into small pieces; in a separate religious sense, the ordination of a priest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指用剪刀剪切或把材料剪成小片；另有宗教义，指授予司铎圣秩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qtugħ b'imqass jew f'biċċiet żgħar; f'sens reliġjuż separat, l-għoti tal-ordni saċerdotali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用剪刀作短促的小幅剪切。
把材料剪切成许多小片或小块。
授予司铎圣秩，使受秩者成为神父。

collocations.en: the candidate's ordination to the priesthood

formal.mt: It-tqassis tal-kandidat se jsir fil-katidral nhar il-Ħadd. Il-familja tiegħu se tattendi ċ-ċerimonja.
formal.en: The candidate's ordination to the priesthood will take place in the cathedral on Sunday. His family will attend the ceremony.
formal.zh: 这位候选人的司铎授秩礼将于星期日在主教座堂举行。他的家人将出席仪式。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għandna bżonn imqass? Ben: Għat-tqassis tal-karta f'biċċiet żgħar għall-collage.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do we need scissors? Ben: To cut the paper into small pieces for the collage.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们为什么需要剪刀？本：要把纸剪成小片，做拼贴画。

messages.speaker: Lara (手工课学生)
messages.zh: 我们为什么需要剪刀？
messages.en: Why do we need scissors?

messages.speaker: Ben (手工课同学)
messages.zh: 要把纸剪成小片，做拼贴画。
messages.en: To cut the paper into small pieces for the collage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分成两张独立记忆卡：手工桌上的剪刀对应剪切与碎片，教堂里的授秩仪式对应成为神父；不要混淆语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of reciting the prayers of the rosary.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 诵念天主教玫瑰经祷文的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li jingħadu t-talbiet tar-rużarju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诵念玫瑰经；按玫瑰经的形式进行祈祷。

formal.mt: It-tqassit tar-rużarju se jibda fis-sitta ta' filgħaxija fil-kappella. Dawk li jixtiequ jistgħu jingħaqdu fit-talb.
formal.en: The recitation of the rosary will begin at six in the evening in the chapel. Those who wish may join in the prayers.
formal.zh: 玫瑰经诵念将于傍晚六点在小圣堂开始。有意者可以一同祈祷。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Se tiġi għat-tqassit tar-rużarju llejla? Ġużeppi: Iva, niltaqgħu ħdejn il-kappella ftit qabel is-sitta.
colloquial.en: Maria: Are you coming to the rosary recitation tonight? Joseph: Yes, let's meet by the chapel just before six.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你今晚来一起念玫瑰经吗？约瑟夫：来，我们六点前一会儿在小圣堂旁边见。

messages.speaker: Marija (教区朋友)
messages.zh: 你今晚来一起念玫瑰经吗？
messages.en: Are you coming to the rosary recitation tonight?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (教区朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, niltaqgħu ħdejn il-kappella ftit qabel is-sitta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, niltaqgħu ħdejn il-kappella ftit qabel is-sitta.
messages.zh: 来，我们六点前一会儿在小圣堂旁边见。
messages.en: Yes, let's meet by the chapel just before six.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词放进小圣堂的场景：人们一起开口念玫瑰经。重点记住它表示诵念活动，而不是手里的念珠。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fight with an opponent, or struggle hard against difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与对手搏斗，或面对困难奋力挣扎、努力抗争。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daħal fi ġlied ma' avversarju, jew għamel sforz kbir biex jegħleb diffikultà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与对手交战、打斗或搏斗。
面对阻力或困难奋力挣扎、努力抗争。

collocations.zh: 为取得成功而奋力拼搏

formal.mt: L-atleta tqata' mal-avversarju sal-aħħar tal-logħba. Minkejja l-għeja, baqa' jagħmel ħiltu.
formal.en: The athlete fought against his opponent until the end of the match. Despite his fatigue, he kept doing his best.
formal.zh: 这名运动员与对手拼搏到比赛结束。尽管疲惫，他仍然全力以赴。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar Pawlu fl-eżami? Rita: Għadda, imma tqata' biex jirnexxi.
colloquial.en: Maya: How did Paul do in the exam? Rita: He passed, but he struggled to succeed.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗考试考得怎么样？丽塔：他通过了，不过他费了很大劲才成功。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 保罗考试考得怎么样？
messages.en: How did Paul do in the exam?

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.zh: 他通过了，不过他费了很大劲才成功。
messages.en: He passed, but he struggled to succeed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人咬牙使劲：面对对手是搏斗，面对难题是奋力挣扎。抄写时留意这个词只有一个连续的字母 t。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Participation in a fight or struggle, viewed as an activity or process.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参与打斗、搏斗或抗争的活动或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-involviment fi ġlied jew f'taqbida, meqjus bħala attività jew proċess.

sense_translations.en_definition: engagement in a fight or struggle
sense_translations.zh_definition: 参与打斗或抗争；进行搏斗、奋力相争的过程。

formal.mt: Il-pulizija intervjeniet wara li beda tqatil bejn żewġ gruppi barra l-istadium. L-aċċess għaż-żona twaqqaf għal ftit ħin.
formal.en: The police intervened after fighting broke out between two groups outside the stadium. Access to the area was temporarily suspended.
formal.zh: 体育场外两个群体发生打斗后，警方进行了干预。该区域一度暂停通行。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma nistgħux ngħaddu minn hawn? Mark: Hemm tqatil fit-triq. Ejja nieħdu triq oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why can't we go through here? Mark: There's fighting in the street. Let's take another route.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们为什么不能从这里走？马克：街上有人打架。我们换条路吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistgħux ngħaddu minn hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistgħux ngħaddu minn hawn?
messages.zh: 我们为什么不能从这里走？
messages.en: Why can't we go through here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm tqatil fit-triq. Ejja nieħdu triq oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm tqatil fit-triq. Ejja nieħdu triq oħra.
messages.zh: 街上有人打架。我们换条路吧。
messages.en: There's fighting in the street. Let's take another route.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成新闻里的一项事件：某处发生了打斗。这里用名词给整个搏斗过程命名，不是在指某一个参与者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be chopped into pieces, or to be torn through or into pieces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被切成碎块，或被撕裂、撕成碎片。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġie maqtugħ f'biċċiet, jew iċċarrat u sar fih tiċrit jew inqasam f'biċċiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被切碎、剁碎或切成小块。
被撕破、扯裂或撕成碎片。

collocations.en: the paper was torn into pieces

formal.mt: Il-basal tqatta' f'biċċiet żgħar qabel żdied mat-taħlita. B'dan il-mod, seta' jitqassam indaqs.
formal.en: The onion was chopped into small pieces before being added to the mixture. This allowed it to be distributed evenly.
formal.zh: 洋葱先被切成小块，再加入混合物中。这样可以使其分布均匀。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għadni rrid inqatta' l-basal? Pawlu: Le, il-basal diġà tqatta'. Tista' żżidu fit-taġen.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do I still need to chop the onion? Paul: No, the onion has already been chopped. You can add it to the pan.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我还需要切洋葱吗？保罗：不用，洋葱已经切好了。你可以把它放进平底锅里。

messages.speaker: Nina (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 我还需要切洋葱吗？
messages.en: Do I still need to chop the onion?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-basal diġà tqatta'. Tista' żżidu fit-taġen.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-basal diġà tqatta'. Tista' żżidu fit-taġen.
messages.zh: 不用，洋葱已经切好了。你可以把它放进平底锅里。
messages.en: No, the onion has already been chopped. You can add it to the pan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把连续的 tt 当作视觉提示，联想材料变成碎块：洋葱被切碎，纸被撕破。这只是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be released in drops or to undergo distillation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指液体被一滴一滴地滴下，或经过蒸馏处理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinżel qatra qatra jew jgħaddi minn proċess ta' distillazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被逐滴滴下
被蒸馏

formal.mt: L-ilma tqattar fil-laboratorju biex jinkiseb kampjun aktar pur.
formal.en: The water was distilled in the laboratory to obtain a purer sample.
formal.zh: 这些水在实验室中经过蒸馏，以获得更纯净的样本。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'tqattar' hawn? Pawlu: Hawn ifisser li l-ilma għadda minn distillazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'tqattar' mean here? Pawlu: Here it means that the water underwent distillation.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 tqattar 是什么意思？保罗：这里指水经过了蒸馏。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这里的 tqattar 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tqattar' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ifisser li l-ilma għadda minn distillazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ifisser li l-ilma għadda minn distillazzjoni.
messages.zh: 这里指水经过了蒸馏。
messages.en: Here it means that the water underwent distillation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上两个学习画面：滴管逐滴落水，以及蒸馏装置收集液体；用上下文区分两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To try to kill someone, without necessarily succeeding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 试图杀死某人；这个词本身不表示行动已经成功。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jipprova joqtol lil xi ħadd, mingħajr ma bilfors jirnexxilu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 试图杀死；企图杀害

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tat-test, il-verb 'tqattel' jindika tentattiv ta' qtil u ma jikkonfermax li l-vittma mietet.
formal.en: In the analysis of the text, the verb 'tqattel' indicates an attempt to kill and does not confirm that the victim died.
formal.zh: 在这段文本的分析中，动词 tqattel 表示试图杀害，并不能据此确认受害者已经死亡。

colloquial.mt: Lara: 'Tqattel' ifisser li xi ħadd miet? Mark: Mhux bilfors. Ifisser li xi ħadd ipprova joqtol.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does 'tqattel' mean that someone died? Mark: Not necessarily. It means that someone tried to kill.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：tqattel 是说有人死了吗？马克：不一定。它表示有人试图杀人。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: tqattel 是说有人死了吗？
messages.en: Does 'tqattel' mean that someone died?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux bilfors. Ifisser li xi ħadd ipprova joqtol.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux bilfors. Ifisser li xi ħadd ipprova joqtol.
messages.zh: 不一定。它表示有人试图杀人。
messages.en: Not necessarily. It means that someone tried to kill.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时给动作前面加上中文“试图”，想到企图杀害的情节，别把尝试直接理解成已经造成死亡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be tied securely or gathered and tied into a bundle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被牢牢捆住，或被集中起来扎成一束、一捆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jintrabat sew jew jinġabar u jintrabat f'qatta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被捆住；被绑紧
被扎成束；被捆成捆

formal.mt: Il-ħuxlief tqattet f'qatet biex ikun aktar faċli jinġarr.
formal.en: The hay was tied into bundles to make it easier to carry.
formal.zh: 干草被扎成一捆捆，以便搬运。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħuxlief għadu maħlul? Toni: Le, tqattet bil-ħabel u lest biex jinġarr.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the hay still loose? Toni: No, it has been bound with rope and is ready to be carried.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：干草还是散着的吗？托尼：不是，已经用绳子捆好了，可以搬走了。

messages.speaker: Maja (农场帮工)
messages.zh: 干草还是散着的吗？
messages.en: Is the hay still loose?

messages.speaker: Toni (农场主)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tqattet bil-ħabel u lest biex jinġarr.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tqattet bil-ħabel u lest biex jinġarr.
messages.zh: 不是，已经用绳子捆好了，可以搬走了。
messages.en: No, it has been bound with rope and is ready to be carried.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象散落的干草被绳子收拢扎紧：既能记住“被捆住”，也能记住“被扎成束”的结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of cutting something into pieces, including slicing, chopping, and dicing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西切开或切成小块的动作，包括切片、剁切和切丁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li taqsam xi ħaġa f'biċċiet, flieli jew kubi żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 切割；切开
切片
剁切；切碎
切丁；切成小方块

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, it-tqattigħ tal-patata f'kubi żgħar jgħinha tissajjar b'mod uniformi.
formal.en: For this recipe, dicing the potatoes into small cubes helps them cook evenly.
formal.zh: 做这道菜时，把土豆切成小丁有助于均匀烹熟。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tista' tieħu ħsieb it-tqattigħ tal-ħaxix? Mark: Iva. Tridu fi flieli jew f'kubi? Lara: F'kubi żgħar, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you take care of cutting the vegetables? Mark: Yes. Do you want them in slices or cubes? Lara: In small cubes, please.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你能负责切蔬菜吗？马克：可以。要切片还是切丁？拉拉：切成小丁，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你能负责切蔬菜吗？
messages.en: Can you take care of cutting the vegetables?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Tridu fi flieli jew f'kubi?
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Tridu fi flieli jew f'kubi?
messages.zh: 可以。要切片还是切丁？
messages.en: Yes. Do you want them in slices or cubes?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 切成小丁，谢谢。
messages.en: In small cubes, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放在厨房砧板旁记忆：刀落下可以切片、剁碎或切丁，这个名词概括这些切的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The killing of many people or animals, especially in a massacre or large-scale slaughter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大量人或动物遭到杀害的事件或行为，尤指大屠杀或大规模杀戮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qtil ta' ħafna nies jew annimali, speċjalment f'massakru jew fuq skala kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大屠杀
大规模杀戮；大量屠杀

collocations.en: the slaughter of animals in large numbers

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jiddeskrivi t-tqattil taċ-ċivili u l-effett tiegħu fuq il-komunità.
formal.en: The chapter describes the massacre of civilians and its effect on the community.
formal.zh: 这一章描述了针对平民的大屠杀及其对社区的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dwar xiex inhu dan il-kapitlu? Pawlu: Dwar it-tqattil taċ-ċivili waqt il-gwerra. Huwa qari ta' niket.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this chapter about? Pawlu: About the massacre of civilians during the war. It is sad reading.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这一章讲什么？保罗：讲战争期间对平民的大屠杀。读起来很令人难过。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 这一章讲什么？
messages.en: What is this chapter about?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar it-tqattil taċ-ċivili waqt il-gwerra. Huwa qari ta' niket.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar it-tqattil taċ-ċivili waqt il-gwerra. Huwa qari ta' niket.
messages.zh: 讲战争期间对平民的大屠杀。读起来很令人难过。
messages.en: About the massacre of civilians during the war. It is sad reading.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词义重点记在“大量”上：阅读战争或历史文本时，想到许多生命遭到杀害的大规模事件。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of liquid falling or being released one drop at a time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 液体一滴一滴落下或流出的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih likwidu jinżel jew joħroġ qatra qatra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滴落；液体逐滴流出

formal.mt: It-tqattir kontinwu mill-vit wassal għal ħela ta' ilma.
formal.en: The continuous dripping from the tap led to wasted water.
formal.zh: 水龙头持续滴水，造成了水资源浪费。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed tisma' t-tqattir fil-kċina? Mark: Iva, ġej mill-vit. Se nagħlqu sew.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you hear the dripping in the kitchen? Mark: Yes, it is coming from the tap. I'll close it properly.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你听见厨房的滴水声了吗？马克：听见了，是水龙头。我去把它关紧。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你听见厨房的滴水声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear the dripping in the kitchen?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej mill-vit. Se nagħlqu sew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej mill-vit. Se nagħlqu sew.
messages.zh: 听见了，是水龙头。我去把它关紧。
messages.en: Yes, it is coming from the tap. I'll close it properly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中播放水龙头“滴答、滴答”的声音，把这个名词和连续逐滴落水的过程连在一起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of tying something securely or gathering things together into bundles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物捆紧，或把若干东西聚拢后扎成束的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li torbot xi ħaġa sew jew tiġbor affarijiet u torbothom f'qatet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 捆紧；捆扎固定
扎束；捆成捆

formal.mt: It-tqattit tal-ħuxlief f'qatet jagħmilha aktar faċli biex jinġarr u jinħażen.
formal.en: Bundling hay makes it easier to carry and store.
formal.zh: 把干草扎成捆，便于搬运和储存。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Tista' tgħinni bit-tqattit tal-friegħi? Maja: Żgur. Int żommhom flimkien u jien norbothom.
colloquial.en: Toni: Can you help me bundle the branches? Maja: Sure. You hold them together and I'll tie them.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：你能帮我把树枝扎成束吗？玛雅：当然。你把它们拢在一起，我来绑。

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.zh: 你能帮我把树枝扎成束吗？
messages.en: Can you help me bundle the branches?

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur. Int żommhom flimkien u jien norbothom.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur. Int żommhom flimkien u jien norbothom.
messages.zh: 当然。你把它们拢在一起，我来绑。
messages.en: Sure. You hold them together and I'll tie them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手把树枝拢齐，再用绳子绕紧；用“聚拢加绑紧”的动作记住捆扎和扎束两个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To talk with another person in a conversation or an informal chat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与别人交谈，可以指一般对话，也可以指轻松随意的聊天。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li titkellem ma' xi ħadd f'konverżazzjoni jew f'taħdita informali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 交谈；进行对话
聊天；闲谈

formal.mt: Wara l-laqgħa, Pawlu tqawel mal-kollega tiegħu dwar il-proġett il-ġdid.
formal.en: After the meeting, Pawlu had a conversation with his colleague about the new project.
formal.zh: 会议结束后，保罗与同事谈了谈新项目。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu Pawlu? Toni: Għadu fil-kafetterija. Tqawel ma' ħabib u nesa l-ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Pawlu? Toni: He is still at the café. He chatted with a friend and lost track of time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗在哪儿？托尼：他还在咖啡馆。他跟朋友聊天，聊得忘了时间。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu fil-kafetterija. Tqawel ma' ħabib u nesa l-ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu fil-kafetterija. Tqawel ma' ħabib u nesa l-ħin.
messages.zh: 他还在咖啡馆。他跟朋友聊天，聊得忘了时间。
messages.en: He is still at the café. He chatted with a friend and lost track of time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友在咖啡馆里一来一往地说话，聊得忘了时间；用这个场景同时记住“交谈”和“聊天”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a rhythmic clip-clop sound, especially with hooves striking a hard surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出有节奏的嗒嗒声，尤指马蹄敲击坚硬地面的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħoss ritmiku ta' nagħal jolqot wiċċ iebes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出嗒嗒的马蹄声。

collocations.en: The horse clip-clopped over the stones.
collocations.zh: 马踩在石头上，发出嗒嗒声。

collocations.en: The horse clip-clopped along the road.
collocations.zh: 马沿着道路走，马蹄嗒嗒作响。

formal.mt: Iż-żiemel tqawqab bil-mod fuq il-ġebel tal-pjazza waqt li l-karrettun għadda quddiem il-knisja.
formal.en: The horse clip-clopped slowly over the square's paving stones as the cart passed in front of the church.
formal.zh: 马车经过教堂前方时，马缓缓踏过广场的石板，发出嗒嗒的蹄声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kien dak il-ħoss fit-triq? Mark: Żiemel tqawqab fuq il-ġebel u għadda minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was that sound in the street? Mark: A horse clip-clopped over the stones and passed this way.
colloquial.zh: Maja：刚才街上是什么声音？Mark：一匹马踩着石头嗒嗒地从这里走过。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 刚才街上是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that sound in the street?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żiemel tqawqab fuq il-ġebel u għadda minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Żiemel tqawqab fuq il-ġebel u għadda minn hawn.
messages.zh: 一匹马踩着石头嗒嗒地从这里走过。
messages.en: A horse clip-clopped over the stones and passed this way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象马蹄一下一下敲石板；把这个动词和耳边连续的“嗒嗒”声一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The rhythmic clip-clop sound of hooves striking a hard surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马蹄敲击坚硬地面时发出的、有节奏的嗒嗒声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħoss ritmiku tan-nagħal meta jolqot wiċċ iebes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嗒嗒的蹄声，尤指马蹄踏在硬地上的声音。

collocations.zh: 踏在石头上的嗒嗒蹄声

formal.mt: It-tqawqib taż-żwiemel instema' fit-triq dejqa qabel ma deher il-karrettun.
formal.en: The clip-clop of the horses could be heard in the narrow street before the cart came into view.
formal.zh: 马车还未进入视野，狭窄街道上就已传来嗒嗒的马蹄声。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Qed tisma' dak it-tqawqib? Pawlu: Iva, ġej minn żiemel li qed jgħaddi mit-triq.
colloquial.en: Rita: Can you hear that clip-clop? Pawlu: Yes, it's coming from a horse passing along the street.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你听见那嗒嗒的蹄声了吗？Pawlu：听见了，是一匹正从街上经过的马发出的。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.zh: 你听见那嗒嗒的蹄声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that clip-clop?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej minn żiemel li qed jgħaddi mit-triq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej minn żiemel li qed jgħaddi mit-triq.
messages.zh: 听见了，是一匹正从街上经过的马发出的。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from a horse passing along the street.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它当成一段可以录下来的马蹄声来记：这里指“嗒嗒声”这个声音名词。

gloss_zh: 变强；势力增强；体重增加

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become stronger or more powerful; also, to gain body weight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 力量、强度或势力增强；也可指体重增加。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aktar b'saħħtu jew aktar qawwi; jista' jfisser ukoll li jiżdied fil-piż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得更强壮，或强度增加。
变得更有力量、权力或影响力。
体重增加，长胖。

collocations.en: The party became more powerful politically.
collocations.zh: 该党的政治势力增强了。

collocations.en: The boy filled out and gained weight.
collocations.zh: 男孩长壮了，体重也增加了。

formal.mt: Ir-riħ tqawwa matul il-lejl, u filgħodu l-mewġ kien ogħla minn dak tal-jum ta' qabel.
formal.en: The wind grew stronger during the night, and by morning the waves were higher than on the previous day.
formal.zh: 夜间风力增强，到了早晨，海浪比前一天更高了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu Leo wara l-marda? Rita: Tqawwa sew; issa għandu aktar saħħa u żdied ftit fil-piż.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is Leo after his illness? Rita: He's built himself up well; he has more strength now and has gained a little weight.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Leo病后恢复得怎么样？Rita：他壮实多了，现在更有力气，体重也增加了一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Leo病后恢复得怎么样？
messages.en: How is Leo after his illness?

messages.speaker: Rita (Leo的母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Tqawwa sew; issa għandu aktar saħħa u żdied ftit fil-piż.
messages.mt_standard: Tqawwa sew; issa għandu aktar saħħa u żdied ftit fil-piż.
messages.zh: 他壮实多了，现在更有力气，体重也增加了一点。
messages.en: He's built himself up well; he has more strength now and has gained a little weight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面记多义：风吹得更猛、政党势力更大、孩子体重增加；具体意思看主语和上下文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become round or take on a rounded, ball-like shape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变圆，或逐渐呈现圆润、近似球体的形状。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir tond jew jieħu forma ta' ballun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变圆，呈现圆形或球状。

collocations.en: The clay became round between the hands.
collocations.zh: 黏土在双手之间变圆了。

collocations.en: The dough became rounded into a ball.

formal.mt: Matul l-eżerċizzju, it-tafal tqawwar bejn il-pali tal-istudent sakemm ħa forma ta' ballun.
formal.en: During the exercise, the clay became rounded between the student's palms until it took the shape of a ball.
formal.zh: 练习中，黏土在学生的双掌之间逐渐变圆，最后呈现球状。

colloquial.mt: Mark: It-tafal għadu ċatt? Maja: Le, tqawwar bejn idejja; issa qisu ballun żgħir.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is the clay still flat? Maja: No, it became round between my hands; now it looks like a little ball.
colloquial.zh: Mark：黏土还是扁的吗？Maja：不是了，它在我手里变圆了，现在像个小球。

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 黏土还是扁的吗？
messages.en: Is the clay still flat?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tqawwar bejn idejja; issa qisu ballun żgħir.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tqawwar bejn idejja; issa qisu ballun żgħir.
messages.zh: 不是了，它在我手里变圆了，现在像个小球。
messages.en: No, it became round between my hands; now it looks like a little ball.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一块不规则黏土在掌心滚动，最后自己呈现圆球状；重点记住“变圆”的结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be curved or bent into an arc rather than remaining straight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发生弯曲，呈现弧形而不再笔直。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun mgħawweġ jew jieħu forma ta' ark minflok jibqa' dritt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弯曲，呈弧形。

formal.mt: Meta ġie applikat il-piż, il-wajer tqawwas u ma baqax f'linja dritta.
formal.en: When the weight was applied, the wire curved and no longer formed a straight line.
formal.zh: 施加重量后，金属丝发生弯曲，不再保持直线形状。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex il-wajer ma jidħolx fit-toqba? Pawlu: Għax tqawwas; l-ewwel irridu niddrittawh.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why won't the wire go into the hole? Pawlu: Because it's bent; we need to straighten it first.
colloquial.zh: Rita：这根金属丝怎么穿不进孔里？Pawlu：因为它弯了，我们得先把它弄直。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 这根金属丝怎么穿不进孔里？
messages.en: Why won't the wire go into the hole?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 因为它弯了，我们得先把它弄直。
messages.en: Because it's bent; we need to straighten it first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中把一条直线压成弧线；这个词记“弯成弧”，不要和变成圆球混在一起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making something stronger or giving someone renewed strength and energy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物或身体变得更强的过程，也指使人恢复力量和活力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir aktar b'saħħitha, jew persuna terġa' tikseb is-saħħa u l-enerġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 增强，加强；使力量或强度提高的过程。
恢复活力，振奋精神；使人重新有力气和精神。

collocations.en: the invigoration of the body after rest
collocations.zh: 休息后身体活力的恢复

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi eżerċizzji ħfief għat-tqawwija tal-muskoli u perjodi regolari ta' mistrieħ.
formal.en: The programme includes gentle exercises for strengthening the muscles and regular periods of rest.
formal.zh: 该计划包括增强肌肉力量的轻度练习，以及定期安排的休息时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għal xiex huma dawn l-eżerċizzji? Mark: Għat-tqawwija tal-muskoli tar-riġlejn; nibdew bi ftit kull darba.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are these exercises for? Mark: For strengthening the leg muscles; we'll start with a little at a time.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这些练习有什么作用？Mark：用来增强腿部肌肉力量；我们先从每次做一点开始。

messages.speaker: Maja (学员)
messages.zh: 这些练习有什么作用？
messages.en: What are these exercises for?

messages.speaker: Mark (教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tqawwija tal-muskoli tar-riġlejn; nibdew bi ftit kull darba.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tqawwija tal-muskoli tar-riġlejn; nibdew bi ftit kull darba.
messages.zh: 用来增强腿部肌肉力量；我们先从每次做一点开始。
messages.en: For strengthening the leg muscles; we'll start with a little at a time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成“给力量充电”的过程名词：练习使肌肉增强，休息使人恢复活力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action or process of shaping something into a sphere or ball.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物加工、揉搓或塑造成球形的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni jew il-proċess li bih tingħata forma ta' sfera jew ballun lil xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物呈球形的动作或过程，即将其塑造成球体。

collocations.en: rounding dough into a ball between the palms
collocations.zh: 在双掌之间把面团搓成球形

formal.mt: L-ewwel stadju tal-attività huwa t-tqawwir tat-tafal f'ballun lixx bejn il-pali.
formal.en: The first stage of the activity is shaping the clay into a smooth ball between the palms.
formal.zh: 这项活动的第一步是在双掌之间把黏土塑成光滑的圆球。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: X'nagħmel b'din il-biċċa tafal? Rita: Ibda bit-tqawwir bejn il-pali sakemm ikollok ballun lixx.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: What should I do with this piece of clay? Rita: Start by rounding it between your palms until you have a smooth ball.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：这块黏土我要怎么处理？Rita：先在双掌之间把它搓圆，直到形成一个光滑的球。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学生)
messages.zh: 这块黏土我要怎么处理？
messages.en: What should I do with this piece of clay?

messages.speaker: Rita (美术老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ibda bit-tqawwir bejn il-pali sakemm ikollok ballun lixx.
messages.mt_standard: Ibda bit-tqawwir bejn il-pali sakemm ikollok ballun lixx.
messages.zh: 先在双掌之间把它搓圆，直到形成一个光滑的球。
messages.en: Start by rounding it between your palms until you have a smooth ball.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手正在搓汤圆，把“搓成球的整个过程”作为记忆画面；这里是动作名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of making something bow-shaped, or the activity of shooting arrows with a bow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物弯成弓形的动作；也指使用弓发射箭的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' forma ta' ark lil xi ħaġa, jew l-isparar ta' vleġeġ bil-qaws.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物弯成弓形或弧形的动作、过程。
用弓射箭的动作或活动。

collocations.en: bending wood into a bow shape

formal.mt: It-tqawwis tal-injam jagħti lill-biċċa forma ta' ark li tintuża fid-disinn finali.
formal.en: Bending the wood gives the piece an arch shape that is used in the final design.
formal.zh: 将木材弯曲，可使木件形成最终设计所需的弓形。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn se nipprattikaw it-tqawwis bil-qaws? Maja: Fil-klabb, fejn hemm il-miri; il-lezzjoni tibda fl-erbgħa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where are we going to practise shooting arrows with a bow? Maja: At the club, where the targets are; the lesson starts at four.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我们要去哪里练习用弓射箭？Maja：去俱乐部，那里有箭靶；课程四点开始。

messages.speaker: Mark (射箭学员)
messages.zh: 我们要去哪里练习用弓射箭？
messages.en: Where are we going to practise shooting arrows with a bow?

messages.speaker: Maja (射箭学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-klabb, fejn hemm il-miri; il-lezzjoni tibda fl-erbgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-klabb, fejn hemm il-miri; il-lezzjoni tibda fl-erbgħa.
messages.zh: 去俱乐部，那里有箭靶；课程四点开始。
messages.en: At the club, where the targets are; the lesson starts at four.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面分别记义项：先把木条弯成弓形，再想象拿弓向靶子射箭；这是学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become hard, or to dry out, especially when vegetables become dry enough to be shelled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变硬，或逐渐干燥；尤指豆类等蔬菜干到可以剥壳的程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir iebes jew jinxef, speċjalment meta ħaxix bħall-ful ikun niexef biżżejjed biex jitneħħa mill-miżwed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变硬；表面或质地变得坚硬。

sense_translations.en_definition: to dry (e.g. used of vegetables which are ready to be shelled)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 干燥；例如豆类等蔬菜干到可以剥壳。

collocations.en: broad beans that have dried enough to be shelled
collocations.zh: 已经干到可以剥壳的蚕豆

formal.mt: Il-ful tqaxlef wara li tħalla jinxef; issa jista' jitneħħa mill-miżwed.
formal.en: The broad beans have dried after being left to dry; they can now be removed from their pods.
formal.zh: 蚕豆放置晾干后已经干透，现在可以从豆荚里剥出来了。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Il-ful tqaxlef diġà? Pawlu: Iva, issa nistgħu nneħħuh mill-miżwed.
colloquial.en: Marta: Have the broad beans dried enough already? Pawlu: Yes, we can take them out of their pods now.
colloquial.zh: Marta：蚕豆已经干到可以剥壳了吗？Pawlu：是的，现在可以把豆子从豆荚里剥出来了。

messages.speaker: Marta (农民)
messages.zh: 蚕豆已经干到可以剥壳了吗？
messages.en: Have the broad beans dried enough already?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场助手)
messages.zh: 是的，现在可以把豆子从豆荚里剥出来了。
messages.en: Yes, we can take them out of their pods now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个动词配上豆荚晾干、外层变硬的画面，记住“变硬”和“干到能剥壳”两个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming hard or dry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体逐渐变硬或变干的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir iebsa jew tinxef.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 硬化；质地逐渐变硬的过程。
干燥；水分逐渐减少、物体变干的过程。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tqaxlif tal-wiċċ tat-taħlita matul il-lejl.
formal.en: The report describes the hardening of the mixture's surface overnight.
formal.zh: 报告描述了混合物表面在夜间逐渐硬化的过程。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tistenna qabel tiftaħ il-miżwed? Toni: It-tqaxlif tal-ful għadu ma spiċċax; irrid inħallih jinxef aktar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you waiting before opening the pods? Toni: The broad beans haven't finished drying; I need to let them dry some more.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么还等着，不打开豆荚？Toni：蚕豆还没有完全干好，我得让它们再干一会儿。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tistenna qabel tiftaħ il-miżwed?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tistenna qabel tiftaħ il-miżwed?
messages.zh: 你为什么还等着，不打开豆荚？
messages.en: Why are you waiting before opening the pods?

messages.speaker: Toni (菜农)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tqaxlif tal-ful għadu ma spiċċax; irrid inħallih jinxef aktar.
messages.mt_standard: It-tqaxlif tal-ful għadu ma spiċċax; irrid inħallih jinxef aktar.
messages.zh: 蚕豆还没有完全干好，我得让它们再干一会儿。
messages.en: The broad beans haven't finished drying; I need to let them dry some more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它当作“过程名称”来记：豆子慢慢变干、表面慢慢变硬，这整个变化就是这个名词所指的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become dry or to be drained of water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得干燥，或因水流失、耗尽而干涸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinxef jew jispiċċa bla ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变干；失去水分而变得干燥。
水被排尽或耗尽；变得无水。

collocations.en: a valley watercourse that has dried up
a reservoir that has been drained

formal.mt: Il-ġibjun tqaxqax wara li l-ilma kollu ġie ppumpjat 'il barra.
formal.en: The reservoir was drained after all the water was pumped out.
formal.zh: 所有水被抽出后，蓄水池已经排空。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għad hemm ilma fil-wied? Ġużeppi: Le, il-wied tqaxqax wara tant ġranet bla xita.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is there still water in the valley watercourse? Ġużeppi: No, it has dried up after so many days without rain.
colloquial.zh: Nina：谷地水道里还有水吗？Ġużeppi：没有，连续这么多天没下雨，水道已经干了。

messages.speaker: Nina (徒步游客)
messages.zh: 谷地水道里还有水吗？
messages.en: Is there still water in the valley watercourse?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (当地居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-wied tqaxqax wara tant ġranet bla xita.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-wied tqaxqax wara tant ġranet bla xita.
messages.zh: 没有，连续这么多天没下雨，水道已经干了。
messages.en: No, it has dried up after so many days without rain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象水位一格格下降，最后只剩干底：用这个画面同时记住“变干”和“水分耗尽”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of drying or losing moisture, including thorough drying.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 水分减少而变干的过程，也可指较彻底的脱水干化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa tinxef jew titlef l-umdità, ukoll meta tinxef sewwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 干燥；水分减少而变干的过程。
干化；水分大量流失或被去除而变得十分干燥。

formal.mt: L-istudju jkejjel it-tqaxqix tal-ħamrija billi jqabbel l-umdità tagħha filgħodu u filgħaxija.
formal.en: The study measures soil drying by comparing its moisture in the morning and evening.
formal.zh: 这项研究通过比较早晚的土壤含水情况，测量土壤的干燥过程。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tiżen il-kampjun darbtejn? David: Biex insegwi t-tqaxqix tiegħu u nara kemm tilef ilma.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you weighing the sample twice? David: To track its drying and see how much water it has lost.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么给样本称两次重？David：为了跟踪它的干燥过程，看看它失去了多少水。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 你为什么给样本称两次重？
messages.en: Why are you weighing the sample twice?

messages.speaker: David (实验伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex insegwi t-tqaxqix tiegħu u nara kemm tilef ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Biex insegwi t-tqaxqix tiegħu u nara kemm tilef ilma.
messages.zh: 为了跟踪它的干燥过程，看看它失去了多少水。
messages.en: To track its drying and see how much water it has lost.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中放一张土壤含水量逐渐下降的记录表，把这个名词记成“变干这件事或整个过程”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To peel, with skin, a shell, or an outer layer coming off.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脱皮或脱壳；皮肤、外皮或外层从表面脱落。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titneħħielu jew taqagħlu l-ġilda, il-qoxra jew is-saff ta' barra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脱皮；表面的皮或外层剥落。

sense_translations.en_definition: to have one's skin or shell come off
sense_translations.zh_definition: 自身的皮肤、外皮或壳脱落。

collocations.en: a nose whose skin has peeled
a wall whose surface has peeled

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni ġie osservat li l-ħajt tqaxxar f'diversi postijiet.
formal.en: During the inspection, it was observed that the wall's surface had peeled in several places.
formal.zh: 检查时发现，墙壁表层有多处剥落。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex imnieħrek jidher hekk? Mark: Tqaxxar wara l-ġurnata li qattajt fix-xemx.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why does your nose look like that? Mark: The skin peeled after the day I spent in the sun.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你的鼻子怎么这样了？Mark：我在太阳下待了一天，之后鼻子就脱皮了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的鼻子怎么这样了？
messages.en: Why does your nose look like that?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tqaxxar wara l-ġurnata li qattajt fix-xemx.
messages.mt_standard: Tqaxxar wara l-ġurnata li qattajt fix-xemx.
messages.zh: 我在太阳下待了一天，之后鼻子就脱皮了。
messages.en: The skin peeled after the day I spent in the sun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想鼻尖脱皮或墙面起皮的画面，注意动作落在物体自身：它的外层掉下来了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of shaving hair from the skin, or of removing the skin from an animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 剃除皮肤表面的毛发，或给动物剥皮的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jitneħħa x-xagħar minn fuq il-ġilda bil-leħja, jew li titneħħa l-ġilda ta' annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剃毛；刮除胡须等毛发的行为。
动物剥皮；去除动物皮的行为。

formal.mt: Il-manwal jiddeskrivi l-għodod użati għat-tqaxxir tal-annimali.
formal.en: The manual describes the tools used for skinning animals.
formal.zh: 手册介绍了给动物剥皮所使用的工具。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Tixtieq tqaxxir tal-leħja wkoll? Ġanni: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, wara li taqtagħli xagħri.
colloquial.en: Marija: Would you like a beard shave as well? Ġanni: Yes, please, after you cut my hair.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你也要剃一下胡须吗？Ġanni：要的，谢谢，剪完头发后再剃吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (理发师)
messages.zh: 你也要剃一下胡须吗？
messages.en: Would you like a beard shave as well?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, wara li taqtagħli xagħri.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, wara li taqtagħli xagħri.
messages.zh: 要的，谢谢，剪完头发后再剃吧。
messages.en: Yes, please, after you cut my hair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景分开记义项：理发店里剃胡须，动物处理时去除皮；两者都表示一种操作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be cut or cut off, or to be left out of a list, group, or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被切断或截去；也指未被列入名单、群体或活动而被遗漏、排除。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqata' jew jitneħħa; ukoll jitħalla barra minn lista, grupp jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被切开、切断或截去。
被遗漏，未被包括在内。
被排除，不被纳入某个群体或活动。

collocations.en: His name was left out of the list.
collocations.zh: 他的名字未被列入名单。

collocations.en: The player was excluded from the team.
collocations.zh: 这名球员被排除在球队之外。

formal.mt: Matul iż-żbir, iz-zokk niexef tqaċċat u tneħħa mill-ġnien.
formal.en: During pruning, the dry stem was cut off and removed from the garden.
formal.zh: 修剪期间，干枯的茎被切断并移出了花园。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex isem Leo tqaċċat mil-lista? Toni: Kien żball; se nżidu mill-ġdid.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why was Leo's name left out of the list? Toni: It was a mistake; we'll add it again.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：利奥的名字怎么没列在名单上？托尼：弄错了，我们会重新加上。

messages.speaker: Marta (活动参加者)
messages.zh: 利奥的名字怎么没列在名单上？
messages.en: Why was Leo's name left out of the list?

messages.speaker: Toni (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 弄错了，我们会重新加上。
messages.en: It was a mistake; we'll add it again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅教学图记忆 tqaċċat：一根茎被切断，一个名字留在名单外；分别对应实物和名单语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cutting off of parts, or the breaking off of things such as branches.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某些部分截除的动作，或枝条等从原处折断、脱离的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qtugħ ta' partijiet jew il-ksur u l-firda ta' friegħi u affarijiet simili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 截除、砍去枝条等突出部分的动作。
折断、断离，例如树枝的折断。

collocations.en: the lopping off of dry branches
the breaking off of branches in the wind

formal.mt: It-tqaċċit tal-friegħi niexfa sar qabel ma nfetaħ il-ġnien għall-pubbliku.
formal.en: The lopping off of dry branches was carried out before the garden opened to the public.
formal.zh: 花园向公众开放前，工作人员完成了枯枝的截除。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Smajt dak it-tqaċċit tal-friegħi lbieraħ filgħaxija? Ġużi: Iva, ir-riħ kien qawwi ħafna.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did you hear those branches breaking off yesterday evening? Ġużi: Yes, the wind was very strong.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你昨晚听到那些树枝折断的声音了吗？朱齐：听到了，风特别大。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt dak it-tqaċċit tal-friegħi lbieraħ filgħaxija?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt dak it-tqaċċit tal-friegħi lbieraħ filgħaxija?
messages.zh: 你昨晚听到那些树枝折断的声音了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear those branches breaking off yesterday evening?

messages.speaker: Ġużi (邻居)
messages.zh: 听到了，风特别大。
messages.en: Yes, the wind was very strong.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象园丁截枝和大风折枝两个场景，把 tqaċċit 记成“截除或折断这一过程”的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coughing that occurs repeatedly with pauses between coughs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 咳几声、停一会儿又咳的间歇性咳嗽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sogħla li tiġi minn ħin għal ieħor, b'waqfiet bejn darba u oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 时断时续、间歇发生的咳嗽。

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa nstema' tqaħqiħ minn ħin għal ieħor fuq wara tas-sala.
formal.en: During the meeting, intermittent coughing could be heard at the back of the hall.
formal.zh: 会议期间，大厅后方不时传来咳嗽声。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Irqadt sew ilbieraħ? Mark: Mhux wisq; it-tqaħqiħ żammni mqajjem għal xi ħin.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did you sleep well yesterday? Mark: Not very well; the intermittent coughing kept me awake for a while.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你昨天睡得好吗？马克：不太好，断断续续的咳嗽让我有一阵子睡不着。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你昨天睡得好吗？
messages.en: Did you sleep well yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux wisq; it-tqaħqiħ żammni mqajjem għal xi ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux wisq; it-tqaħqiħ żammni mqajjem għal xi ħin.
messages.zh: 不太好，断断续续的咳嗽让我有一阵子睡不着。
messages.en: Not very well; the intermittent coughing kept me awake for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时想象咳两声、停一停、再咳两声，突出咳嗽并非连续不停。

gloss_zh: 卖淫；自贬身价；勉强提供不愿提供的服务

teaching_sense.en_definition: To prostitute oneself; figuratively, to sell oneself cheap or perform services one would prefer not to perform. The word is coarse and can be derogatory.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指自己卖淫；比喻自贬身价，或提供自己本来不愿提供的服务。用语粗俗，可能带有贬损意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jipprostitwixxi ruħu; b'mod figurattiv, ibigħ ruħu bl-irħis jew jagħmel servizzi li jippreferi ma jagħmilx. Il-kelma hija vulgari u tista' tkun dispreġġjattiva.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自己从事卖淫；以提供性服务换取报酬。该词用语粗俗，可能带贬义。
比喻自贬身价、廉价出卖自己或自己的原则，带贬义。

sense_translations.en_definition: to perform services one would rather not
sense_translations.zh_definition: 勉强提供自己本来不愿提供的服务，含有自贬或不情愿的意味。

collocations.en: sold himself cheap for a little money
collocations.zh: 为了一点钱而自贬身价

formal.mt: Fil-kritika, il-verb tqaħħab jintuża b'mod figurattiv biex juri li l-personaġġ biegħ ruħu bl-irħis.
formal.en: In the critique, the verb tqaħħab is used figuratively to show that the character sold himself cheap.
formal.zh: 在这篇评论中，动词 tqaħħab 被用于比喻，表示这个人物自贬身价、廉价出卖了自己。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Meta qal li Mark tqaħħab għal ftit flus, kien qed jitkellem litteralment? Noel: Le, ried jgħid li biegħ ruħu bl-irħis; hija espressjoni ħarxa.
colloquial.en: Lara: When he said Mark tqaħħab for a little money, was he speaking literally? Noel: No, he meant that Mark sold himself cheap; it's a harsh expression.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：他说马克为了一点钱 tqaħħab，是按字面说的吗？诺埃尔：不是，他是说马克自贬身价、廉价出卖了自己；这个说法很难听。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta qal li Mark tqaħħab għal ftit flus, kien qed jitkellem litteralment?
messages.mt_standard: Meta qal li Mark tqaħħab għal ftit flus, kien qed jitkellem litteralment?
messages.zh: 他说马克为了一点钱 tqaħħab，是按字面说的吗？
messages.en: When he said Mark tqaħħab for a little money, was he speaking literally?

messages.speaker: Noel (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ried jgħid li biegħ ruħu bl-irħis; hija espressjoni ħarxa.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ried jgħid li biegħ ruħu bl-irħis; hija espressjoni ħarxa.
messages.zh: 不是，他是说马克自贬身价、廉价出卖了自己；这个说法很难听。
messages.en: No, he meant that Mark sold himself cheap; it's a harsh expression.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按三层意思记忆：自己卖淫、自贬身价、勉强提供服务；三层都围绕自身行为，并给这个词加上“粗俗贬损”的语气标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To complain that money, food, or other necessities are scarce or insufficient.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 抱怨钱、食物或其他必需品不足，诉说匮乏或缺少所需之物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jilmenta għax m'hemmx biżżejjed flus, ikel jew affarijiet oħra meħtieġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to complain about scarcity or want
sense_translations.zh_definition: 抱怨物资短缺、生活匮乏或缺少所需之物。

collocations.en: complained about a lack of money

collocations.mt: tqaħħat għax ma kellux biżżejjed ikel
collocations.en: complained because he did not have enough food

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, ir-raġel tqaħħat minħabba n-nuqqas ta' flus għall-ħtiġijiet ta' kuljum.
formal.en: In his letter, the man complained about not having enough money for everyday needs.
formal.zh: 这名男子在信中诉说钱不够，无法满足日常所需。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu reġa' tqaħħat illum? Mark: Qal li l-flus ma kinux biżżejjed għall-ikel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why was Pawlu complaining about being short again today? Mark: He said there wasn't enough money for food.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗今天为什么又在诉说手头拮据？马克：他说买食物的钱不够。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗今天为什么又在诉说手头拮据？
messages.en: Why was Pawlu complaining about being short again today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qal li l-flus ma kinux biżżejjed għall-ikel.
messages.mt_standard: Qal li l-flus ma kinux biżżejjed għall-ikel.
messages.zh: 他说买食物的钱不够。
messages.en: He said there wasn't enough money for food.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人打开空钱包，说“钱不够，吃的也不够”；把“缺少东西”和“开口抱怨”两个要素一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of causing another person to engage in prostitution.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使另一个人从事卖淫的行为；行为对象是他人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iġiegħel lil persuna oħra tipprostitwixxi ruħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of prostituting another person
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使他人从事卖淫的行为。

collocations.en: a case of causing another person to engage in prostitution
collocations.zh: 一起使他人卖淫的事件

collocations.en: a victim of being made to engage in prostitution
collocations.zh: 被迫从事卖淫的受害者

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi każ ta' tqaħħib u l-għajnuna mogħtija lill-vittma.
formal.en: The report describes a case of someone being made to engage in prostitution and the assistance provided to the victim.
formal.zh: 这份报告描述了一起使他人卖淫的事件，以及向受害者提供的援助。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ifisser tqaħħib f'dan ir-rapport? Pawlu: Ifisser li xi ħadd iġiegħel lil persuna oħra tipprostitwixxi ruħha.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does tqaħħib mean in this report? Pawlu: It means that someone makes another person engage in prostitution.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这份报告里的 tqaħħib 是什么意思？保罗：指有人使另一个人从事卖淫。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这份报告里的 tqaħħib 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tqaħħib mean in this report?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li xi ħadd iġiegħel lil persuna oħra tipprostitwixxi ruħha.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li xi ħadd iġiegħel lil persuna oħra tipprostitwixxi ruħha.
messages.zh: 指有人使另一个人从事卖淫。
messages.en: It means that someone makes another person engage in prostitution.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“甲使乙卖淫”的双人关系图记忆这个名词；特别标出行为指向他人，帮助与 tqaħħab 的“自己卖淫”义区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reduction in available supplies that leaves too little to meet needs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可用物资减少，造成供应不足以满足需要的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqis fil-provvisti li jwassal biex ma jkunx hemm biżżejjed għall-ħtiġijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使供应减少并出现短缺的情况。

formal.mt: It-tqaħħit fil-provvisti tal-ilma wassal għal restrizzjonijiet ġodda fuq l-użu tiegħu.
formal.en: The shortage of water supplies led to new restrictions on its use.
formal.zh: 供水短缺导致了新的用水限制。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex ma nistgħux nixtru aktar ross? Pawlu: Hemm tqaħħit fil-provvisti, u l-ħanut qed ibigħ borża waħda lil kull persuna.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why can't we buy more rice? Pawlu: Supplies are short, and the shop is selling one bag per person.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：为什么我们不能多买些米？保罗：现在供应短缺，商店每人只卖一袋。

messages.speaker: Marta (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistgħux nixtru aktar ross?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistgħux nixtru aktar ross?
messages.zh: 为什么我们不能多买些米？
messages.en: Why can't we buy more rice?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm tqaħħit fil-provvisti, u l-ħanut qed ibigħ borża waħda lil kull persuna.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm tqaħħit fil-provvisti, u l-ħanut qed ibigħ borża waħda lil kull persuna.
messages.zh: 现在供应短缺，商店每人只卖一袋。
messages.en: Supplies are short, and the shop is selling one bag per person.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象商店货架逐渐变空，用这个画面记住物资减少、供应短缺的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a low, throaty grunting sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出低沉、来自喉部的咕噜声或哼叫声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħoss baxx mill-gerżuma, bħal dak li jagħmel ħanżir.

sense_translations.en_definition: the making of a grunting sound
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出低沉的咕噜声或哼叫声这一动作。

collocations.zh: 他睡着时发出了低哼声

formal.mt: Matul l-osservazzjoni, il-ħanżir tqażqaż meta l-ħaddiem resaq lejn il-maqjel.
formal.en: During the observation, the pig grunted when the worker approached the pen.
formal.zh: 观察期间，工人走近猪圈时，猪发出了哼叫声。

colloquial.mt: Ella: X'kien dak il-ħoss? Ben: Il-ħanżir tqażqaż meta rana.
colloquial.en: Ella: What was that sound? Ben: The pig grunted when it saw us.
colloquial.zh: Ella：刚才那是什么声音？Ben：猪看见我们时哼了一声。

messages.speaker: Ella (农场游客)
messages.zh: 刚才那是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that sound?

messages.speaker: Ben (农场向导)
messages.zh: 猪看见我们时哼了一声。
messages.en: The pig grunted when it saw us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象走近猪圈听到低低的“哼哼”声，把这个动词与“发出声音的动作”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or sound of making low, throaty grunts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出低沉喉音的行为，或这种咕噜声、哼叫声本身。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-ħoss ta' ħsejjes baxxi mill-gerżuma, bħal dawk ta' ħanżir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 哼叫；发出低沉咕噜声的行为或声音。

formal.mt: Ir-reġistrazzjoni tinkludi t-tqażqiż tal-ħanżir qabel l-għalf.
formal.en: The recording includes the pig's grunting before feeding.
formal.zh: 录音中包含了喂食前猪发出的哼叫声。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Qed tisma' dak it-tqażqiż? Samwel: Iva, ġej mill-maqjel; il-ħanżir qiegħed hemm.
colloquial.en: Rita: Can you hear that grunting? Samwel: Yes, it's coming from the pen; the pig is in there.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你听到那阵哼叫声了吗？Samwel：听到了，是从猪圈里传来的，猪就在里面。

messages.speaker: Rita (农场游客)
messages.zh: 你听到那阵哼叫声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that grunting?

messages.speaker: Samwel (农场工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej mill-maqjel; il-ħanżir qiegħed hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej mill-maqjel; il-ħanżir qiegħed hemm.
messages.zh: 听到了，是从猪圈里传来的，猪就在里面。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from the pen; the pig is in there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把猪圈里的低哼声录成一段音频：这个名词就像音频的标签，指“哼叫这件事或这种声音”。

gloss_zh: 厌恶；炫耀作态；强烈的烦躁

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong feeling of disgust or revulsion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面对令人反感的事物时产生的强烈厌恶或恶心感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens qawwi ta' stmerrija jew dardir quddiem xi ħaġa li ddejqek ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 厌恶；恶心；强烈的反感。
炫耀作态；故意卖弄、引人注目的举止。
强烈的烦躁或恼怒。

formal.mt: L-awtriċi tesprimi tqażżiż bl-imġiba krudili tal-karattru prinċipali.
formal.en: The author expresses disgust at the main character's cruel behaviour.
formal.zh: 作者表达了对主人公残忍行为的厌恶。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak ir-riħa taż-żibel tqanqal fija sens ta' tqażżiż. Pawlu: Ejja nimxu ftit aktar 'il bogħod.
colloquial.en: Maja: That smell of rubbish gives me a feeling of disgust. Pawlu: Let's move a little farther away.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那股垃圾味让我觉得恶心。保罗：我们走远一点吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ir-riħa taż-żibel tqanqal fija sens ta' tqażżiż.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ir-riħa taż-żibel tqanqal fija sens ta' tqażżiż.
messages.zh: 那股垃圾味让我觉得恶心。
messages.en: That smell of rubbish gives me a feeling of disgust.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们走远一点吧。
messages.en: Let's move a little farther away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“闻到臭味便皱眉”的画面记住厌恶义；另把炫耀作态和强烈烦躁分开记，按语境选择。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To shiver because of the cold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由于寒冷而身体不由自主地发抖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jirtogħod minħabba l-kesħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因寒冷而发抖；冷得打哆嗦。

formal.mt: It-tifel tqebbex bil-kesħa waqt li kien qed jistenna barra l-iskola.
formal.en: The boy shivered with cold while waiting outside the school.
formal.zh: 那个男孩在学校外等候时冷得发抖。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħuk tqebbex bil-kesħa meta ħareġ mill-baħar. Mark: Iva, tajtu xugaman mill-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Sara: Your brother shivered with cold when he came out of the sea. Mark: Yes, I gave him a towel straight away.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你兄弟从海里出来时冷得直打哆嗦。马克：是啊，我马上给了他一条毛巾。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħuk tqebbex bil-kesħa meta ħareġ mill-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Ħuk tqebbex bil-kesħa meta ħareġ mill-baħar.
messages.zh: 你兄弟从海里出来时冷得直打哆嗦。
messages.en: Your brother shivered with cold when he came out of the sea.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我马上给了他一条毛巾。
messages.en: Yes, I gave him a towel straight away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刚游完泳站在寒风中打哆嗦；这个词记作“冷得发抖”的动作，与表示这种现象的名词 tqebbix 配对记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bodily trembling that occurs because of cold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由于寒冷而出现的身体颤抖这一现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tregħid tal-ġisem minħabba l-kesħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因寒冷而发抖的现象；冷得打哆嗦。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tqebbix bil-kesħa tat-tifel wara li dam jistenna fix-xita.
formal.en: The report describes the boy's shivering with cold after he spent a long time waiting in the rain.
formal.zh: 报告描述了那个男孩在雨中久候后冷得发抖的情况。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-tqebbix bil-kesħa ma ħallinix inżomm it-tazza sew. Nina: Ejja oqgħod ħdejn il-heater.
colloquial.en: Lara: Shivering with cold stopped me from holding the cup properly. Nina: Come and sit next to the heater.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我冷得发抖，连杯子都拿不稳。妮娜：过来坐在暖气旁边吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tqebbix bil-kesħa ma ħallinix inżomm it-tazza sew.
messages.mt_standard: It-tqebbix bil-kesħa ma ħallinix inżomm it-tazza sew.
messages.zh: 我冷得发抖，连杯子都拿不稳。
messages.en: Shivering with cold stopped me from holding the cup properly.

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 过来坐在暖气旁边吧。
messages.en: Come and sit next to the heater.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面定格在双手冷得拿不稳杯子的一刻：tqebbix 给“冷得发抖”这一现象命名，按名词记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of putting something in its intended place or position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物放到指定位置或适当位置的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed ipoġġi xi ħaġa fil-post jew fil-pożizzjoni maħsuba għaliha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放置；把某物安放到位。

collocations.en: putting the books on the shelf

formal.mt: It-tqegħid tal-imwejjed għandu jħalli biżżejjed spazju biex in-nies jgħaddu.
formal.en: The placement of the tables should leave enough space for people to pass.
formal.zh: 桌子的摆放应留出足够空间供人通行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'taħseb dwar it-tqegħid tas-sufan ħdejn it-tieqa? Pawlu: Jogħġobni, imma rridu nħallu spazju għall-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you think about placing the sofa next to the window? Pawlu: I like it, but we need to leave space for the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得把沙发放在窗边怎么样？保罗：我觉得不错，不过得给门留出空间。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'taħseb dwar it-tqegħid tas-sufan ħdejn it-tieqa?
messages.mt_standard: X'taħseb dwar it-tqegħid tas-sufan ħdejn it-tieqa?
messages.zh: 你觉得把沙发放在窗边怎么样？
messages.en: What do you think about placing the sofa next to the window?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jogħġobni, imma rridu nħallu spazju għall-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Jogħġobni, imma rridu nħallu spazju għall-bieb.
messages.zh: 我觉得不错，不过得给门留出空间。
messages.en: I like it, but we need to leave space for the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象布置房间时把沙发、桌子逐件放到合适位置；这个名词指“安放、摆放”这件事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive worship or religious veneration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成为人们崇拜或宗教敬奉的对象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jingħata qima jew ikun meqjum minn oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到崇拜；被人敬奉。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-idolu tqejjem bħala alla mill-abitanti tar-raħal.
formal.en: In the story, the idol was worshipped as a god by the village's inhabitants.
formal.zh: 在故事中，村民把那尊偶像当作神来崇拜。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fir-rakkont, dak l-idolu tqejjem bħala alla? Mark: Iva, in-nies kienu jitolbu quddiemu.
colloquial.en: Sara: In the story, was that idol worshipped as a god? Mark: Yes, people used to pray before it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：故事里，那尊偶像是被当作神来崇拜的吗？马克：是的，人们会在它面前祈祷。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fir-rakkont, dak l-idolu tqejjem bħala alla?
messages.mt_standard: Fir-rakkont, dak l-idolu tqejjem bħala alla?
messages.zh: 故事里，那尊偶像是被当作神来崇拜的吗？
messages.en: In the story, was that idol worshipped as a god?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 是的，人们会在它面前祈祷。
messages.en: Yes, people used to pray before it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故事里一尊偶像面前有人祈祷，把视角放在偶像身上，记住“受到崇拜”的被动含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be measured so that a size, length, or other quantity is determined.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接受测量，以确定尺寸、长度或其他数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jsir kejl ta' xi ħaġa biex jiġu stabbiliti d-daqs, it-tul jew kwantità oħra tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被测量；经过量度。

collocations.en: was measured with a tape measure

formal.mt: L-ispazju tqejjes bir-reqqa qabel ma tqiegħdet l-għamara.
formal.en: The space was measured carefully before the furniture was put in place.
formal.zh: 在摆放家具之前，该空间经过了仔细测量。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-bieb tqejjes qabel xtrajna s-sufan? Mark: Iva, is-sufan jgħaddi minnu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Was the doorway measured before we bought the sofa? Mark: Yes, the sofa will fit through it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们买沙发之前量过门口的尺寸吗？马克：量过，沙发能搬进去。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 我们买沙发之前量过门口的尺寸吗？
messages.en: Was the doorway measured before we bought the sofa?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 量过，沙发能搬进去。
messages.en: Yes, the sofa will fit through it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象买沙发前用卷尺量门口，把门口当作句子主角，记住它“被测量、经过量度”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or practice of showing religious reverence to a deity or sacred object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向神明或神圣对象表达宗教敬意的行为或活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-prattika li tingħata qima lil alla jew lil oġġett sagru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 崇拜；敬奉；表达宗教敬意的活动。

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi t-tqejjim tal-idoli bħala parti mill-ħajja reliġjuża tal-komunità fir-rakkont.
formal.en: The text describes the worship of idols as part of the religious life of the community in the story.
formal.zh: 文章把偶像崇拜描述为故事中该群体宗教生活的一部分。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-kapitlu jitkellem dwar it-tqejjim tal-idoli? Pawlu: Iva, jispjega kif in-nies kienu jagħtuhom qima.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this chapter discuss the worship of idols? Pawlu: Yes, it explains how people used to worship them.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这一章讲的是偶像崇拜吗？保罗：是的，它解释了人们怎样敬奉这些偶像。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-kapitlu jitkellem dwar it-tqejjim tal-idoli?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-kapitlu jitkellem dwar it-tqejjim tal-idoli?
messages.zh: 这一章讲的是偶像崇拜吗？
messages.en: Does this chapter discuss the worship of idols?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jispjega kif in-nies kienu jagħtuhom qima.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jispjega kif in-nies kienu jagħtuhom qima.
messages.zh: 是的，它解释了人们怎样敬奉这些偶像。
messages.en: Yes, it explains how people used to worship them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把祈祷和敬奉的场景当作一项活动来命名：tqejjim 是名词“崇拜”，可与 tqejjem 的“受到崇拜”配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become fierce, aggressive, or ferocious.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 性情或表现变得凶猛、凶暴，具有攻击性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed isir feroċi jew aggressiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得凶猛；变得凶暴。

collocations.en: became ferocious when he felt threatened
collocations.zh: 感到受威胁时变得凶猛

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-lupu tqellel meta l-kaċċatur resaq lejn il-frieħ tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the wolf became ferocious when the hunter approached its young.
formal.zh: 在故事中，猎人靠近狼崽时，那只狼变得凶猛起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-kelb tqellel f'daqqa? Mark: Ħassu mhedded meta resqu lejh; ejja nagħtuh ftit spazju.
