colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the dog suddenly become ferocious? Mark: It felt threatened when they approached it; let's give it some space.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那只狗怎么突然凶起来了？马克：他们走近时，它觉得受到了威胁；我们给它留点空间吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那只狗怎么突然凶起来了？
messages.en: Why did the dog suddenly become ferocious?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħassu mhedded meta resqu lejh; ejja nagħtuh ftit spazju.
messages.mt_standard: Ħassu mhedded meta resqu lejh; ejja nagħtuh ftit spazju.
messages.zh: 他们走近时，它觉得受到了威胁；我们给它留点空间吧。
messages.en: It felt threatened when they approached it; let's give it some space.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只原本平静的狗受到威胁后突然露齿，抓住“变得凶猛”的变化过程，把这个词按动词记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Great intensity in expression or feeling, especially when driven by anger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 言语或情绪表现出的强烈、激烈程度，尤指伴随愤怒的猛烈情绪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qawwa kbira fl-espressjoni jew fis-sentimenti, speċjalment meta jkun hemm rabja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 言语、态度或情绪的激烈与强烈。
暴怒；极其强烈的愤怒。

collocations.zh: 极其激烈的情绪；强烈的暴怒

formal.mt: Ix-xhud iddeskriva t-tqellil li bih ir-raġel wieġeb għall-akkuża.
formal.en: The witness described the vehemence with which the man responded to the accusation.
formal.zh: 证人描述了那名男子回应指控时的激烈态度。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tkellem b'dak it-tqellil kollu? Mark: Kien irrabjat ħafna għax ħaseb li ħadd ma kien qed jisimgħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did he speak with so much vehemence? Mark: He was very angry because he thought nobody was listening to him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他为什么说话那么激烈？马克：他很生气，因为他觉得没人听他说话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么说话那么激烈？
messages.en: Why did he speak with so much vehemence?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien irrabjat ħafna għax ħaseb li ħadd ma kien qed jisimgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Kien irrabjat ħafna għax ħaseb li ħadd ma kien qed jisimgħu.
messages.zh: 他很生气，因为他觉得没人听他说话。
messages.en: He was very angry because he thought nobody was listening to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进争论场景记忆：声音和情绪都很激烈时，对应“激烈”；愤怒达到顶点时，对应“暴怒”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of making a hole through material, including by drilling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在材料上打出孔洞的动作或过程，包括用钻具钻孔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil ta' toqba f'materjal, pereżempju permezz ta' trapan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿孔；使材料出现通孔的动作或过程。
钻孔；使用工具钻出孔洞的过程。

collocations.en: making a hole with a drill

formal.mt: Qabel it-tqib tal-metall, it-tekniku mmarka l-post eżatt tat-toqba.
formal.en: Before drilling the metal, the technician marked the exact position of the hole.
formal.zh: 在金属上钻孔之前，技术人员标出了孔洞的准确位置。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak il-ħoss? Pawlu: Qed isir tqib fil-ħajt biex jitwaħħal l-ixkaff.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's that noise? Pawlu: A hole is being drilled in the wall so the shelf can be fitted.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那是什么声音？保罗：有人正在墙上钻孔，好把架子装上去。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 那是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that noise?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed isir tqib fil-ħajt biex jitwaħħal l-ixkaff.
messages.mt_standard: Qed isir tqib fil-ħajt biex jitwaħħal l-ixkaff.
messages.zh: 有人正在墙上钻孔，好把架子装上去。
messages.en: A hole is being drilled in the wall so the shelf can be fitted.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象钻头接触墙面、逐渐钻出一个洞的连续画面，用整个动作记住“钻孔、穿孔”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be put or positioned in a particular place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被放到某个位置，或被安置在指定的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mqiegħed jew impoġġi f'post partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被放置；被安放到某处。

formal.mt: Id-dokument tqiegħed f'envelopp magħluq qabel intbagħat lill-uffiċċju.
formal.en: The document was placed in a sealed envelope before it was sent to the office.
formal.zh: 文件被放入密封信封后，才寄往办公室。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn tqiegħed il-ktieb? David: Tqiegħed fuq il-mejda, ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where was the book placed? David: It was placed on the table, beside the window.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：书被放到哪里了？戴维：放在桌上，靠窗的地方。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 书被放到哪里了？
messages.en: Where was the book placed?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.zh: 放在桌上，靠窗的地方。
messages.en: It was placed on the table, beside the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把镜头对准被移动的书：书最后被放到桌上，重点记住“物品被放置”的被动视角。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extremely heavy, described as being as heavy as lead.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某物非常沉重，像铅一样重。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqil ħafna, bħal ċomb fil-piż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常重的；极其沉重的。

formal.mt: Is-senduq kien tqil ċomb, u għalhekk il-ħaddiema użaw tagħmir apposta biex iċaqalquh.
formal.en: The chest was extremely heavy, so the workers used special equipment to move it.
formal.zh: 大箱子非常沉重，因此工人们使用了专门的设备来搬动它。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-basket tqil ċomb! X'hemm fih? Mark: Kotba. Stenna, ngħinek inġorruh.
colloquial.en: Maja: This basket is really heavy! What's in it? Mark: Books. Wait, I'll help you carry it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个篮子也太沉了！里面装了什么？马克：书。等一下，我帮你一起搬。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-basket tqil ċomb! X'hemm fih?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-basket tqil ċomb! X'hemm fih?
messages.zh: 这个篮子也太沉了！里面装了什么？
messages.en: This basket is really heavy! What's in it?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 书。等一下，我帮你一起搬。
messages.en: Books. Wait, I'll help you carry it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象提起一个仿佛装满铅块的篮子，手臂立刻往下沉，用这种重量感记住“非常重”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cooking food in a frying pan with a small amount of oil or fat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在平底锅中使用少量油或脂肪煎熟食物的烹调方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tisjir tal-ikel f'taġen bi ftit żejt jew xaħam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平底锅煎制；在煎锅中用少量油煎熟食物。

collocations.en: pan frying with a little oil

formal.mt: Għat-tqollija tal-ħut, saħħan ftit żejt fit-taġen qabel iżżid il-biċċiet.
formal.en: To pan-fry the fish, heat a little oil in the frying pan before adding the pieces.
formal.zh: 煎鱼时，先在平底锅中加热少量油，再放入鱼块。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kemm żejt għandi npoġġi għat-tqollija? Nina: Ftit biss, biżżejjed biex jgħatti l-qiegħ tat-taġen.
colloquial.en: Rita: How much oil should I put in for pan frying? Nina: Just a little, enough to cover the bottom of the pan.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：煎东西要放多少油？妮娜：一点就够，能铺满锅底就行。

messages.speaker: Rita (学做饭的女儿)
messages.zh: 煎东西要放多少油？
messages.en: How much oil should I put in for pan frying?

messages.speaker: Nina (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit biss, biżżejjed biex jgħatti l-qiegħ tat-taġen.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit biss, biżżejjed biex jgħatti l-qiegħ tat-taġen.
messages.zh: 一点就够，能铺满锅底就行。
messages.en: Just a little, enough to cover the bottom of the pan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象锅底薄薄一层油、鱼块贴着锅面滋滋作响，把这个厨房画面与“平底锅煎制”联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A very small particle of dust.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 极小的一粒灰尘或尘埃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Partiċella żgħira ħafna ta' trab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一粒灰尘；一小点尘埃。

collocations.en: a speck of dust in the eye
a speck of dust on the lens

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstabet traba fuq il-lenti, u din tneħħiet b'pinzell artab.
formal.en: During the inspection, a speck of dust was found on the lens and removed with a soft brush.
formal.zh: 检查时发现镜片上有一粒灰尘，随后用软刷将其清除。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi traba fl-għajn u qed iddejjaqni. Sara: Ejja ħdejn id-dawl biex nara fejn qiegħda.
colloquial.en: Lara: I've got a speck of dust in my eye and it's bothering me. Sara: Come over to the light so I can see where it is.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我眼睛里进了一粒灰尘，很不舒服。萨拉：到灯光这边来，我看看它在哪里。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi traba fl-għajn u qed iddejjaqni.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi traba fl-għajn u qed iddejjaqni.
messages.zh: 我眼睛里进了一粒灰尘，很不舒服。
messages.en: I've got a speck of dust in my eye and it's bothering me.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja ħdejn id-dawl biex nara fejn qiegħda.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja ħdejn id-dawl biex nara fejn qiegħda.
messages.zh: 到灯光这边来，我看看它在哪里。
messages.en: Come over to the light so I can see where it is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象干净镜片上唯一可见的小灰点，把注意力缩到那“一粒”，帮助记住微小尘埃的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grow up under someone's care, or to develop gradually over time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在他人的照料和教育下长大；也可指某种兴趣、感情等逐渐发展形成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jikber taħt il-kura ta' xi ħadd, jew jiżviluppa bil-mod maż-żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被抚养长大；在某种家庭或教育环境中成长。
发展；逐渐形成或成长。

collocations.en: was brought up by his grandparents
collocations.zh: 由祖父母或外祖父母抚养长大

formal.mt: Pawlu trabba f'familja ta' mużiċisti, u maż-żmien trabba fih interess fil-kompożizzjoni.
formal.en: Pawlu was brought up in a family of musicians, and over time an interest in composition developed in him.
formal.zh: 保罗在一个音乐家庭中长大，并逐渐对作曲产生了兴趣。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn trabba ħuk? Mark: Trabba Għawdex man-nanniet, u ġie jgħix magħna meta kellu għaxar snin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where was your brother brought up? Mark: He was brought up in Gozo by our grandparents and came to live with us when he was ten.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你哥哥在哪里长大的？马克：他在戈佐岛由祖父母抚养长大，十岁时搬来和我们一起住。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥在哪里长大的？
messages.en: Where was your brother brought up?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trabba Għawdex man-nanniet, u ġie jgħix magħna meta kellu għaxar snin.
messages.mt_standard: Trabba Għawdex man-nanniet, u ġie jgħix magħna meta kellu għaxar snin.
messages.zh: 他在戈佐岛由祖父母抚养长大，十岁时搬来和我们一起住。
messages.en: He was brought up in Gozo by our grandparents and came to live with us when he was ten.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅成长画面连接义项：孩子在家人照料下长大，兴趣也随时间慢慢形成；两者都突出逐渐成长。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be secured with a rope, string, or similar fastening, or to secure oneself in this way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被绳子、细绳等绑住或固定；也可指用这类东西把自己系住。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi marbut b'ħabel, spag jew xi ħaġa simili, jew jorbot lilu nnifsu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被绑住；被系住或捆扎固定。
把自己绑住或系住。

collocations.en: was tied to the pole or tied himself to the pole
collocations.zh: 被绑在杆子上；把自己绑在杆子上

formal.mt: Il-pakkett trabbat bi spag qawwi biex jibqa' magħluq waqt it-trasport.
formal.en: The parcel was tied with strong string to keep it closed during transport.
formal.zh: 包裹用结实的细绳捆扎，以便在运输过程中保持封闭。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex l-attur trabbat mal-arblu? Pawlu: Għax fix-xena kellu jagħmel ta' priġunier; rabat lilu nnifsu qabel beda l-filming.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did the actor tie himself to the pole? Pawlu: Because he had to play a prisoner in the scene; he tied himself up before filming started.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那个演员为什么把自己绑在杆子上？保罗：因为那场戏里他要扮演囚犯；开拍前他就把自己绑好了。

messages.speaker: Lara (剧组助理)
messages.zh: 那个演员为什么把自己绑在杆子上？
messages.en: Why did the actor tie himself to the pole?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (剧组同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax fix-xena kellu jagħmel ta' priġunier; rabat lilu nnifsu qabel beda l-filming.
messages.mt_standard: Għax fix-xena kellu jagħmel ta' priġunier; rabat lilu nnifsu qabel beda l-filming.
messages.zh: 因为那场戏里他要扮演囚犯；开拍前他就把自己绑好了。
messages.en: Because he had to play a prisoner in the scene; he tied himself up before filming started.

cognitive_memory_aid: 围绕一根绳子记两个视角：包裹是“被绑住”，演员主动操作则是“把自己绑住”；根据主语和语境区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool with a metal spiral used to pull a cork out of a bottle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有金属螺旋、用于拔出瓶口软木塞的工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'spirali tal-metall li tintuża biex tinġibed is-sufra minn flixkun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 螺旋开瓶器；拔软木塞的工具

collocations.en: to open a bottle with a corkscrew
to pull out the cork with a corkscrew
collocations.zh: 用螺旋开瓶器拔出软木塞

formal.mt: Il-wejter uża trabixù biex neħħa s-sufra mill-flixkun tal-inbid.
formal.en: The waiter used a corkscrew to remove the cork from the wine bottle.
formal.zh: 服务员用螺旋开瓶器拔出了葡萄酒瓶的软木塞。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek trabixù? Ma nistax niftaħ dan il-flixkun. Mark: Iva, qiegħed fil-kexxun ħdejn il-kuċċarini.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a corkscrew? I can't open this bottle. Mark: Yes, it's in the drawer next to the teaspoons.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你有螺旋开瓶器吗？我打不开这个瓶子。Mark：有，在抽屉里，茶匙旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek trabixù? Ma nistax niftaħ dan il-flixkun.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek trabixù? Ma nistax niftaħ dan il-flixkun.
messages.zh: 你有螺旋开瓶器吗？我打不开这个瓶子。
messages.en: Do you have a corkscrew? I can't open this bottle.

messages.speaker: Mark (主人)
messages.zh: 有，在抽屉里，茶匙旁边。
messages.en: Yes, it's in the drawer next to the teaspoons.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 trabixù 配上“螺旋钻进木塞，再向上拔”的动作画面，记住它专指拔软木塞的开瓶器。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive milk by suckling at a mother's or nursing woman's breast.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接受母亲或哺乳者的母乳喂养，强调婴儿得到哺乳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tarbija tingħata l-ħalib billi terda' minn sider ommha jew ta' mara oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被喂母乳；得到哺乳

collocations.en: was breastfed during the first months of his life
collocations.zh: 在出生后的最初几个月接受母乳喂养

formal.mt: It-tifel tradda' minn ommu fl-ewwel xhur ta' ħajtu.
formal.en: The boy was breastfed by his mother during the first months of his life.
formal.zh: 这个男孩在出生后的最初几个月由母亲哺乳。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħuk tradda' minn ommok meta kien tarbija? Nina: Iva, fl-ewwel xhur ta' ħajtu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Was your brother breastfed by your mother when he was a baby? Nina: Yes, during the first months of his life.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你弟弟还是婴儿时，是你妈妈喂母乳的吗？Nina：是的，出生后的最初几个月是。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħuk tradda' minn ommok meta kien tarbija?
messages.mt_standard: Ħuk tradda' minn ommok meta kien tarbija?
messages.zh: 你弟弟还是婴儿时，是你妈妈喂母乳的吗？
messages.en: Was your brother breastfed by your mother when he was a baby?

messages.speaker: Nina (姐姐)
messages.zh: 是的，出生后的最初几个月是。
messages.en: Yes, during the first months of his life.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tradda' 时把镜头对准怀里的婴儿：说的是他“得到哺乳”，用受乳者的视角帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be returned or given back to the person who previously owned or held something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物品被送回或交回原来的主人或持有人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li oġġett jingħata lura lil sidu jew lill-persuna li kellha qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被归还；被送回
被交还；被还给原持有人

formal.mt: Il-portafoll li nstab fl-istazzjon traddad lil sidu l-għada.
formal.en: The wallet found at the station was returned to its owner the following day.
formal.zh: 在车站发现的钱包于次日被归还给主人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'sar mill-ktieb li sellef Pawlu? Mark: Traddad lilu lbieraħ; issa għandu d-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to the book Pawlu lent out? Mark: It was given back to him yesterday; he has it at home now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 借出去的那本书怎么样了？Mark：昨天还给他了，现在在他家里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 借出去的那本书怎么样了？
messages.en: What happened to the book Pawlu lent out?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Traddad lilu lbieraħ; issa għandu d-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Traddad lilu lbieraħ; issa għandu d-dar.
messages.zh: 昨天还给他了，现在在他家里。
messages.en: It was given back to him yesterday; he has it at home now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 traddad 画一条从借用者指回主人的箭头，想象书或钱包沿箭头“被归还”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be produced as thread by spinning fibres, for example cotton fibres.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指棉等纤维通过纺纱过程被纺成线。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ħajt, bħal ħajt tal-qoton, isir billi l-fibri jiddawru flimkien.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be spun (used of thread such as cotton thread)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被纺成线，指棉线等线材

formal.mt: Il-ħajt tal-qoton li ntuża f'dan id-drapp tradden bl-idejn.
formal.en: The cotton thread used in this fabric was spun by hand.
formal.zh: 这块布所用的棉线是手工纺成的。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-ħajt tradden bl-idejn? Toni: Iva, u mbagħad intuża biex jinħadem dan id-drapp.
colloquial.en: Lara: Was this thread spun by hand? Toni: Yes, and then it was used to make this fabric.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这根线是手工纺成的吗？Toni：是的，后来用它做成了这块布。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.zh: 这根线是手工纺成的吗？
messages.en: Was this thread spun by hand?

messages.speaker: Toni (手工艺人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u mbagħad intuża biex jinħadem dan id-drapp.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u mbagħad intuża biex jinħadem dan id-drapp.
messages.zh: 是的，后来用它做成了这块布。
messages.en: Yes, and then it was used to make this fabric.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tradden 连到“松散棉纤维被捻成一根线”的画面，记住重点是线经过纺制而成。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pillow-like support on which lace is made.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制作蕾丝时用作操作表面的枕垫状支撑物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett qisu mħadda li fuqu tinħadem il-bizzilla.

sense_translations.en_definition: a pillow-like object used as a surface on which lace is woven
sense_translations.zh_definition: 制作蕾丝时用作编织表面的枕垫状物体。
木偶；供人操纵表演的偶人。

collocations.en: to make lace on a lace pillow
collocations.zh: 在编织垫枕上制作蕾丝

formal.mt: Matul id-dimostrazzjoni, l-għalliema poġġiet it-trajbu fuq il-mejda u wriet kif tinħadem il-bizzilla fuqu.
formal.en: During the demonstration, the teacher placed the lace pillow on the table and showed how lace is made on it.
formal.zh: 示范时，老师把蕾丝编织垫枕放在桌上，展示如何在上面制作蕾丝。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed iċċaqlaq dak it-trajbu? Mark: Qed nipprova nagħmlu jsellem lit-tfal fl-ispettaklu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you moving that puppet? Mark: I am trying to make it wave to the children in the show.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么在摆弄那个木偶？马克：我在试着让它在演出中向孩子们挥手。

messages.speaker: Lara (演员)
messages.zh: 你为什么在摆弄那个木偶？
messages.en: Why are you moving that puppet?

messages.speaker: Mark (木偶表演者)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nipprova nagħmlu jsellem lit-tfal fl-ispettaklu.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nipprova nagħmlu jsellem lit-tfal fl-ispettaklu.
messages.zh: 我在试着让它在演出中向孩子们挥手。
messages.en: I am trying to make it wave to the children in the show.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做两张场景卡：编蕾丝的桌上放垫枕，表演的舞台上有木偶；用场景区分 trajbu 的两个意思。

gloss_zh: 有些耳背的；听力稍弱的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having some difficulty hearing, though not completely unable to hear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 听声音有些困难，听力稍弱，但并非完全听不见。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu xi diffikultà biex jisma', iżda xorta jisma' sa ċertu punt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有些耳背的；听力稍弱的。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipant huwa trajjax, għalhekk il-kelliem għandu jitkellem b'mod ċar u jħares lejh.
formal.en: The participant is somewhat hard of hearing, so the speaker should speak clearly and face him.
formal.zh: 这位参与者有些耳背，因此说话者应面对他并把话说清楚。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nannu, trid kikkra te? Ġużeppi: Erġa' għidli, jekk jogħġbok; jien trajjax. Maja: Trid kikkra te, Nannu?
colloquial.en: Maja: Grandpa, would you like a cup of tea? Ġużeppi: Say that again, please; I am a little hard of hearing. Maja: Would you like a cup of tea, Grandpa?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：爷爷，你想喝杯茶吗？朱塞佩：请再说一遍，我有点耳背。玛雅：爷爷，你想喝杯茶吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷，你想喝杯茶吗？
messages.en: Grandpa, would you like a cup of tea?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (爷爷)
messages.mt_spoken: Erġa' għidli, jekk jogħġbok; jien trajjax.
messages.mt_standard: Erġa' għidli, jekk jogħġbok; jien trajjax.
messages.zh: 请再说一遍，我有点耳背。
messages.en: Say that again, please; I am a little hard of hearing.

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷，你想喝杯茶吗？
messages.en: Would you like a cup of tea, Grandpa?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象对方把手拢在耳边，请你再说一遍；trajjax 表示有点耳背，记住听力只是稍有困难。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small staircase, expressed by the diminutive of taraġ.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由若干踏步构成的小楼梯或小段阶梯，是 taraġ 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taraġ żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' taraġ.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small staircase (the diminutive form of 'taraġ')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小楼梯；小段阶梯，为 taraġ 的指小形式。

collocations.en: to go up the small staircase

formal.mt: Trajjaġ tal-injam jgħaqqad il-kamra t'isfel mal-gallerija żgħira ta' fuq.
formal.en: A small wooden staircase connects the downstairs room to the small gallery above.
formal.zh: 一座小木楼梯把楼下的房间与上方的小廊台连接起来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif nasal fil-kamra ta' fuq? Mark: Itla' t-trajjaġ ħdejn it-tieqa; il-bieb qiegħed fuq ix-xellug.
colloquial.en: Lara: How do I get to the upstairs room? Mark: Go up the small staircase by the window; the door is on the left.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：怎么去楼上的房间？马克：走窗边的小楼梯上去，门在左边。

messages.speaker: Lara (访客)
messages.zh: 怎么去楼上的房间？
messages.en: How do I get to the upstairs room?

messages.speaker: Mark (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Itla' t-trajjaġ ħdejn it-tieqa; il-bieb qiegħed fuq ix-xellug.
messages.mt_standard: Itla' t-trajjaġ ħdejn it-tieqa; il-bieb qiegħed fuq ix-xellug.
messages.zh: 走窗边的小楼梯上去，门在左边。
messages.en: Go up the small staircase by the window; the door is on the left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一座缩小的楼梯来记 trajjaġ；再与 trajġa 对照：前者是一小段楼梯，后者是单独一级小踏步。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small edge or narrow border of something; the diminutive of 'tarf'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体的一小段边缘或窄小的边沿，是 tarf 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tarf żgħir jew dejjaq ta' xi ħaġa; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'tarf'.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small edge (the diminutive form of 'tarf')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小边缘；小边沿，是 tarf 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small edge of the fabric
a small edge of the paper

formal.mt: Ħalli trajjef tad-drapp jidher minn taħt il-ħjata.
formal.en: Leave a small edge of the fabric showing beneath the seam.
formal.zh: 让布料的一小段边缘露在缝线下面。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Naqta' dan it-trajjef tal-karta? Pawlu: Iva, aqta' ftit biss biex it-tarf ikun dritt.
colloquial.en: Marta: Shall I cut off this small edge of the paper? Pawlu: Yes, trim just a little so that the edge is straight.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：要把纸上这一小段边缘剪掉吗？保罗：要，只剪一点，让边缘平直就行。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: 要把纸上这一小段边缘剪掉吗？
messages.en: Shall I cut off this small edge of the paper?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, aqta' ftit biss biex it-tarf ikun dritt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, aqta' ftit biss biex it-tarf ikun dritt.
messages.zh: 要，只剪一点，让边缘平直就行。
messages.en: Yes, trim just a little so that the edge is straight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tarf 想成整条边缘，再把镜头拉近到一小段：trajjef 就是这个小边沿。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Somewhat tender, as of food that has softened but is not necessarily fully tender.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有一定的软嫩程度，可形容食物已经有些嫩，但不一定十分软嫩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun xi ftit tari, bħal ikel li jkun irtab ftit iżda mhux bilfors ikun tari għalkollox.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有些嫩的；略微软嫩的。

formal.mt: Wara t-tisjir, il-laħam kien trajju, iżda kellu bżonn aktar ħin biex isir tari sew.
formal.en: After cooking, the meat was somewhat tender, but it needed more time to become fully tender.
formal.zh: 烹煮之后，肉已经有些嫩了，但还需要更长时间才能充分软嫩。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif inhu l-laħam? Toni: Trajju, imma nħallih jissajjar ftit ieħor.
colloquial.en: Lara: How is the meat? Toni: Somewhat tender, but I'll let it cook a little longer.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：肉怎么样了？托尼：有些嫩了，不过我会让它再煮一会儿。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 肉怎么样了？
messages.en: How is the meat?

messages.speaker: Toni (做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trajju, imma nħallih jissajjar ftit ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Trajju, imma nħallih jissajjar ftit ieħor.
messages.zh: 有些嫩了，不过我会让它再煮一会儿。
messages.en: Somewhat tender, but I'll let it cook a little longer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象炖肉刚开始变嫩，叉子能插进去一些：trajju 表示有些嫩，记住程度还有限。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small individual step or tread, expressed by the diminutive of tarġa.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 单独一级较小的踏步或台阶，是 tarġa 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tarġa żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' tarġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small tread (the diminutive form of 'tarġa')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小踏步；小台阶，为 tarġa 的指小形式。

collocations.en: to go up a small step

formal.mt: Quddiem il-bieb hemm trajġa tal-ġebel li għandha tkun tidher sew biex ħadd ma jitfixkel.
formal.en: There is a small stone step in front of the door that should be clearly visible so that nobody trips.
formal.zh: 门前有一级小石阶，应让它清楚可见，以免有人绊倒。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Oqgħod attent għal dik it-trajġa ħdejn il-bieb. Pawlu: Rajtha, grazzi. Se ngħolli saqajja sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: Watch out for that small step by the door. Pawlu: I saw it, thanks. I will lift my feet properly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：小心门边那级小台阶。保罗：我看到了，谢谢。我会把脚抬高些。

messages.speaker: Maja (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Oqgħod attent għal dik it-trajġa ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Oqgħod attent għal dik it-trajġa ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 小心门边那级小台阶。
messages.en: Watch out for that small step by the door.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtha, grazzi. Se ngħolli saqajja sew.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtha, grazzi. Se ngħolli saqajja sew.
messages.zh: 我看到了，谢谢。我会把脚抬高些。
messages.en: I saw it, thanks. I will lift my feet properly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tarġa 和 trajġa 画成一大一小两级台阶；看到 trajġa 就想起需要抬脚迈过的那一级小踏步。

gloss_zh: 靠泊；系泊；变得十分依恋

teaching_sense.en_definition: To dock or moor a ship; also, to become very emotionally attached to someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指船只靠泊或系泊；也可指一个人变得十分依恋某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieqaf jew jintrabat ma' moll, bħal vapur; ukoll, jintrabat ħafna ma' xi ħadd b'mod affettiv.

sense_translations.en_definition: to dock, to berth, to moor (a ship)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使船只靠泊、停靠泊位或系泊。
变得十分依恋某人；与某人形成很深的感情依附。

collocations.en: became very attached to his grandmother

formal.mt: Il-vapur trakka mal-moll qabel ma l-passiġġieri niżlu l-art.
formal.en: The ship docked at the quay before the passengers went ashore.
formal.zh: 船只靠泊码头之后，乘客才上岸。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex it-tifel irid jibqa' man-nanna? Mark: Trakka ħafna magħha minn meta beda jqatta' l-waranofsinhar għandha.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why does the boy want to stay with his grandmother? Mark: He has become very attached to her since he started spending afternoons at her house.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：孩子为什么想留在奶奶身边？马克：自从开始下午去奶奶家，他就变得特别依恋她。

messages.speaker: Rita (姑姑)
messages.zh: 孩子为什么想留在奶奶身边？
messages.en: Why does the boy want to stay with his grandmother?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Trakka ħafna magħha minn meta beda jqatta' l-waranofsinhar għandha.
messages.mt_standard: Trakka ħafna magħha minn meta beda jqatta' l-waranofsinhar għandha.
messages.zh: 自从开始下午去奶奶家，他就变得特别依恋她。
messages.en: He has become very attached to her since he started spending afternoons at her house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记两个义项：船停靠码头，孩子依偎奶奶；画面只帮助记忆，不表示词源关系。

gloss_zh: 质地变得像沙一样；变得有沙粒感

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop a sandy or sand-like texture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 质地变得像沙一样，呈现松散的细颗粒感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu konsistenza bħar-ramel, bi frak jew ħbub żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 质地变得像沙一样；变得具有沙粒般的颗粒感。

collocations.en: the mixture became sandy in texture
the plaster became sandy in texture
collocations.zh: 灰泥的质地变得像沙一样

formal.mt: Wara li nixef, it-taħlit trammel u tilef il-konsistenza lixxa tiegħu.
formal.en: After drying, the mixture became sandy in texture and lost its smooth consistency.
formal.zh: 干燥之后，混合物的质地变得像沙一样，失去了原来的细腻感。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex dan it-taħlit m'għadux lixx? Karl: Trammel waqt li kien qed jinxef; issa jinħass bħar-ramel.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is this mixture no longer smooth? Karl: It became sandy as it dried; now it feels like sand.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这份混合物怎么不再细腻了？卡尔：它干燥时变得有沙粒感了，现在摸起来像沙一样。

messages.speaker: Nina (学徒)
messages.zh: 这份混合物怎么不再细腻了？
messages.en: Why is this mixture no longer smooth?

messages.speaker: Karl (师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Trammel waqt li kien qed jinxef; issa jinħass bħar-ramel.
messages.mt_standard: Trammel waqt li kien qed jinxef; issa jinħass bħar-ramel.
messages.zh: 它干燥时变得有沙粒感了，现在摸起来像沙一样。
messages.en: It became sandy as it dried; now it feels like sand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指摸过原本光滑的材料，现在却摸到沙粒感；用这种质地变化记住 trammel。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be caught or secured with a hook.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被钩子钩住或挂住，强调物体受到钩挂的状态或变化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqabad jew jinżamm permezz ta' ganċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被钩住；被钩子挂住。

collocations.en: the bucket was caught with the hook

formal.mt: Il-barmil trampel bil-ganċ u ttella' bil-mod mill-bir.
formal.en: The bucket was caught with the hook and slowly lifted out of the well.
formal.zh: 桶被钩子钩住，然后从井里缓缓提了上来。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Il-barmil trampel bil-ganċ? Ġanni: Iva, issa nistgħu ntellgħuh bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Lina: Has the bucket been caught with the hook? Ġanni: Yes, now we can lift it slowly.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：桶被钩子钩住了吗？詹尼：钩住了，现在可以慢慢把它提上来。

messages.speaker: Lina (园丁)
messages.zh: 桶被钩子钩住了吗？
messages.en: Has the bucket been caught with the hook?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同事)
messages.zh: 钩住了，现在可以慢慢把它提上来。
messages.en: Yes, now we can lift it slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把视线放在桶上：桶已经被钩住，就是 trampel；先记物体受到的动作，避免把它记成主动钩取。

gloss_zh: 用钩子钩取物品的动作

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of picking up or retrieving things with a hook.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用钩子把物品钩起或取回的动作，指钩取这一行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li biha jinġabru jew jintrefgħu affarijiet permezz ta' ganċ.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of picking things up with a hook
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用钩子把物品钩起来的动作；钩取物品的行为。

collocations.en: picking up objects with a hook
retrieving things from the water with a hook
collocations.zh: 用钩子从水中钩取物品

formal.mt: It-trampil tal-oġġetti mill-ilma sar b'ganċ twil.
formal.en: The retrieval of the objects from the water was carried out using a long hook.
formal.zh: 从水中钩取这些物品时，使用了一把长钩。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ġibt ganċ twil? David: Għat-trampil tal-oġġetti li waqgħu fl-ilma.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you bring a long hook? David: To retrieve the objects that fell into the water.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么带了一把长钩？戴维：用来钩取掉进水里的那些东西。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么带了一把长钩？
messages.en: Why did you bring a long hook?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 用来钩取掉进水里的那些东西。
messages.en: To retrieve the objects that fell into the water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象长钩把水里的东西逐件钩上来，整项钩取动作叫 tr impil 的连写形式 tr impil？

gloss_zh: 被整理；被摆正；得到纠正或解决

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be put in order or set straight, or for a mistake or problem to be corrected or resolved.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物被整理妥当或摆正，也可指错误得到纠正、问题得到解决。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitqiegħed fl-ordni jew dritt; ukoll, jiġi kkoreġut jew solvut, bħal żball jew problema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被整理；被安排妥当。
被摆正；被调整到端正的位置。
得到纠正或解决。

collocations.en: the place was put in order

formal.mt: L-iżball fir-rapport tranġa qabel ma d-dokument intbagħat lill-klijenti.
formal.en: The mistake in the report was corrected before the document was sent to the clients.
formal.zh: 报告中的错误在文件发给客户之前得到了纠正。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-kwadru għadu mgħawweġ? Pietru: Le, tranġa; issa qiegħed dritt.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is the picture still crooked? Pietru: No, it has been straightened; now it is straight.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：那幅画还歪着吗？彼得：没有，已经摆正了，现在是正的。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 那幅画还歪着吗？
messages.en: Is the picture still crooked?

messages.speaker: Pietru (室友)
messages.zh: 没有，已经摆正了，现在是正的。
messages.en: No, it has been straightened; now it is straight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个结果画面记 tranġa：房间整理好了、歪画摆正了、报告错误改好了，核心是事情得到处理。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To go rancid, developing the unpleasant smell or taste associated with spoiled fat or oil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 油脂类食物发生酸败，产生令人不快的哈喇气味或味道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitħassar u jieħu riħa jew togħma ħażina, bħal żejt jew xaħam li ma jibqax tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变哈喇；发生油脂酸败，产生异味。

formal.mt: Matul il-ħażna, iż-żejt tranġat u żviluppa riħa qawwija u spjaċevoli.
formal.en: During storage, the oil went rancid and developed a strong, unpleasant smell.
formal.zh: 储存期间，油发生了酸败，产生强烈而难闻的气味。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex dan iż-żejt għandu riħa ħażina? Luqa: Tranġat; irridu niftħu flixkun ieħor.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why does this oil smell bad? Luqa: It has gone rancid; we need to open another bottle.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这油怎么有股难闻的味道？卢卡：已经变哈喇了，我们得另开一瓶。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan iż-żejt għandu riħa ħażina?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan iż-żejt għandu riħa ħażina?
messages.zh: 这油怎么有股难闻的味道？
messages.en: Why does this oil smell bad?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.zh: 已经变哈喇了，我们得另开一瓶。
messages.en: It has gone rancid; we need to open another bottle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 tranġat 就联想打开旧油瓶闻到哈喇味；把完整拼写与油脂酸败的场景一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process by which food spoils or fats and oils become rancid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 食物逐渐腐坏，或油脂发生酸败、产生不良气味和味道的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih l-ikel jitħassar jew iż-żjut u x-xaħmijiet jieħdu riħa u togħma ħażina.

sense_translations.en_definition: process of spoiling or going rancid
sense_translations.zh_definition: 食物腐坏或油脂酸败的过程。

collocations.en: the prevention of spoilage or rancidity

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tranġit taż-żejt waqt il-ħażna.
formal.en: The report describes the oil becoming rancid during storage.
formal.zh: 报告描述了油在储存期间发生酸败的过程。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex dan iż-żejt għandu riħa ħażina? Pawlu: Jista' jkun minħabba t-tranġit; ilu miftuħ ħafna.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why does this oil smell bad? Pawlu: It could be due to rancidity; it has been open for a long time.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这油为什么有股难闻的气味？保罗：可能是酸败了；它开封很久了。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan iż-żejt għandu riħa ħażina?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan iż-żejt għandu riħa ħażina?
messages.zh: 这油为什么有股难闻的气味？
messages.en: Why does this oil smell bad?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jista' jkun minħabba t-tranġit; ilu miftuħ ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Jista' jkun minħabba t-tranġit; ilu miftuħ ħafna.
messages.zh: 可能是酸败了；它开封很久了。
messages.en: It could be due to rancidity; it has been open for a long time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开一瓶久放的油，闻到异味：用这个场景记住 tranġit 指逐渐腐坏、酸败的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A change or passage from one state, stage, situation, or system to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从一种状态、阶段、情境或制度转向另一种的变化或过渡过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bidla jew passaġġ minn stat, stadju, sitwazzjoni jew sistema għal oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过渡；从一种状态或阶段转向另一种。

formal.mt: L-iskola se toffri appoġġ lill-istudenti matul it-tranżizzjoni għas-sistema l-ġdida.
formal.en: The school will offer students support during the transition to the new system.
formal.zh: 学校将在向新制度过渡期间为学生提供支持。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif sejra t-tranżizzjoni għax-xogħol il-ġdid? Mark: Bil-mod, imma l-kollegi qed jgħinuni ħafna.
colloquial.en: Sara: How is the transition to your new job going? Mark: Slowly, but my colleagues are helping me a lot.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：适应新工作的过渡过程怎么样？马克：慢慢来，不过同事们给了我很多帮助。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 适应新工作的过渡过程怎么样？
messages.en: How is the transition to your new job going?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bil-mod, imma l-kollegi qed jgħinuni ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Bil-mod, imma l-kollegi qed jgħinuni ħafna.
messages.zh: 慢慢来，不过同事们给了我很多帮助。
messages.en: Slowly, but my colleagues are helping me a lot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tranżizzjoni 想成连接两个阶段的桥：桥的一头是旧状态，另一头是新状态，过桥就是过渡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be repaired by having a patch placed over a hole or damaged part.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 破洞或损坏处通过加上一块补片而得到修补。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jissewwa b'roqqa li tgħatti toqba jew parti mqattgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被打上补丁；通过补缀而得到修补。

formal.mt: Il-qalziet traqqa' b'biċċa drapp tal-istess kulur.
formal.en: The trousers were patched up with a piece of fabric of the same colour.
formal.zh: 这条裤子用一块同色布料打上了补丁。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-qalziet għadu mqatta'? Rita: Le, traqqa' lbieraħ; tista' tilbsu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are these trousers still torn? Rita: No, they were patched up yesterday; you can wear them.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这条裤子还是破的吗？丽塔：不是，昨天已经补好了；你可以穿了。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.zh: 这条裤子还是破的吗？
messages.en: Are these trousers still torn?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 不是，昨天已经补好了；你可以穿了。
messages.en: No, they were patched up yesterday; you can wear them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象裤子的破洞被一块同色布盖住：traqqa' 关注衣物已经得到修补，可用“裤子被补好”来记。

gloss_zh: 被哄睡；被使入睡；被施行安乐死

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made to sleep; in another sense, to be euthanised.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被哄睡或通过其他方式被使入睡；另一义为被施行安乐死。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddaħħal fl-irqad; f'sens ieħor, jingħata mewta biex tintemm it-tbatija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被哄睡；被使进入睡眠状态。
被施行安乐死。

collocations.en: the boy was gently put to sleep
the dog was euthanised by the vet
collocations.zh: 狗被兽医施行了安乐死

formal.mt: Il-kelb marid traqqad mill-veterinarju biex tintemm it-tbatija tiegħu.
formal.en: The sick dog was euthanised by the vet to end its suffering.
formal.zh: 这只病犬被兽医施行了安乐死，以结束它的痛苦。

colloquial.mt: Nina: It-tifel għadu mqajjem? David: Le, traqqad ftit ilu; issa rieqed fil-kamra tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is the boy still awake? David: No, he was put to sleep a little while ago; now he is asleep in his room.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：孩子还醒着吗？戴维：没有，刚才已经哄睡了；现在正在自己的房间里睡觉。

messages.speaker: Nina (母亲)
messages.zh: 孩子还醒着吗？
messages.en: Is the boy still awake?

messages.speaker: David (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, traqqad ftit ilu; issa rieqed fil-kamra tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, traqqad ftit ilu; issa rieqed fil-kamra tiegħu.
messages.zh: 没有，刚才已经哄睡了；现在正在自己的房间里睡觉。
messages.en: No, he was put to sleep a little while ago; now he is asleep in his room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景分别记忆 traqqad：摇篮旁是“被哄睡”，病犬与兽医的语境可表示“被施行安乐死”；要靠上下文区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made thinner, or to become skinny.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 厚度被减小或逐渐变薄；也可指人变得消瘦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir irqaq fil-ħxuna; meta jingħad għal persuna, isir irqiq f'ġismu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弄薄；厚度被减小。
变瘦；逐渐变得消瘦。

collocations.en: the fabric became thin through use
he grew very skinny after the illness

formal.mt: Id-drapp traqqaq minħabba l-użu fit-tul, speċjalment ħdejn il-ħjatat.
formal.en: The fabric became thin through prolonged use, especially near the seams.
formal.zh: 布料由于长期使用而变薄，尤其是在接缝附近。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif inhu Mark wara l-marda? Lara: Aħjar, imma traqqaq ħafna; il-qalziet sar kbir wisq għalih.
colloquial.en: Anna: How is Mark after his illness? Lara: Better, but he has grown very skinny; his trousers are now too big for him.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马克病后怎么样了？拉拉：好些了，不过消瘦了很多；他的裤子现在都太宽了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克病后怎么样了？
messages.en: How is Mark after his illness?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar, imma traqqaq ħafna; il-qalziet sar kbir wisq għalih.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar, imma traqqaq ħafna; il-qalziet sar kbir wisq għalih.
messages.zh: 好些了，不过消瘦了很多；他的裤子现在都太宽了。
messages.en: Better, but he has grown very skinny; his trousers are now too big for him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 traqqaq 配上两幅图：布料越来越薄，人的衣服越来越宽松；共同记忆点是厚度或体形变小。

gloss_zh: 蹒跚前行；一瘸一拐地走

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move along with short, uneven steps and difficulty walking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 迈着短小、不稳的步子艰难前行，或一瘸一拐地走。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimxi b'passi qosra u mhux indaqs, b'diffikultà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蹒跚前行；一瘸一拐地向前走。

collocations.zh: 他一瘸一拐地走到门口

formal.mt: Wara li weġġa' siequ, ir-raġel traqqas sal-bank u qagħad bilqiegħda.
formal.en: After hurting his foot, the man hobbled to the bench and sat down.
formal.zh: 脚受伤后，那名男子一瘸一拐地走到长椅旁坐下。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kif wasal sal-karozza? Toni: Traqqas bil-mod, u jien għintu jidħol.
colloquial.en: Rita: How did he get to the car? Toni: He hobbled along slowly, and I helped him get in.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：他怎么走到车旁的？托尼：他慢慢地一瘸一拐走过去，我扶他上了车。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 他怎么走到车旁的？
messages.en: How did he get to the car?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Traqqas bil-mod, u jien għintu jidħol.
messages.mt_standard: Traqqas bil-mod, u jien għintu jidħol.
messages.zh: 他慢慢地一瘸一拐走过去，我扶他上了车。
messages.en: He hobbled along slowly, and I helped him get in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 traqqas 时想象短短两步、一高一低地走到门口，把这个不均匀的步态和“蹒跚前行”连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of making someone fall asleep.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人入睡的行为或过程，例如把婴儿哄睡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih xi ħadd jitwassal biex jorqod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使入睡；把人哄睡的行为或过程。

collocations.en: help with putting someone to sleep

formal.mt: It-traqqid tat-tarbija ħa madwar għoxrin minuta.
formal.en: Putting the baby to sleep took about twenty minutes.
formal.zh: 把婴儿哄睡大约花了二十分钟。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Kemm dam it-traqqid tat-tarbija? Marija: Xi għoxrin minuta; issa rieqda.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: How long did putting the baby to sleep take? Marija: About twenty minutes; she is asleep now.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：哄宝宝入睡花了多久？玛丽亚：大约二十分钟；她现在睡着了。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 哄宝宝入睡花了多久？
messages.en: How long did putting the baby to sleep take?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 大约二十分钟；她现在睡着了。
messages.en: About twenty minutes; she is asleep now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象家长抱着宝宝轻摇二十分钟：traqqid 是“哄睡这件事”，用整个过程帮助记住它是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be pressed tightly between things or crushed into a flatter shape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被夹在物体之间挤压，或受到压力而被压扁、压坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħafas bejn affarijiet oħra jew jiġi ċċattjat bil-pressjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被挤压；受到周围物体的夹压。
被压扁；被挤压得变形或压坏。

collocations.en: it was squeezed between two boxes
collocations.zh: 它被挤在两个箱子之间

collocations.en: the tomatoes were squashed in the bag
collocations.zh: 番茄在袋子里被压坏了

formal.mt: Il-kartun trass taħt il-piż tal-kaxxi l-oħra waqt it-trasport.
formal.en: The cardboard was squashed under the weight of the other boxes during transport.
formal.zh: 运输过程中，纸板被其他箱子的重量压扁了。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'ġara lit-tadam? Mark: Trass fil-borża taħt il-patata.
colloquial.en: Marta: What happened to the tomatoes? Mark: They got squashed in the bag under the potatoes.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：番茄怎么了？马克：它们在袋子里被上面的土豆压坏了。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.zh: 番茄怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the tomatoes?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 它们在袋子里被上面的土豆压坏了。
messages.en: They got squashed in the bag under the potatoes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象购物袋里土豆压着番茄：先是被挤住，再可能被压扁，用这个连续画面记住 trass 的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become soft or softer after being affected by water, heat, or another softening influence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到水、热或其他因素的作用而被软化、变得更软。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir artab jew aktar artab minħabba l-ilma, is-sħana jew xi ħaġa oħra li tnaqqas l-ebusija tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被软化；变得柔软。

formal.mt: Il-materjal trattab wara li tħalla fl-ilma għal siegħa.
formal.en: The material softened after being left in water for an hour.
formal.zh: 该材料在水中放置一小时后变软了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħobż għadu iebes? Mark: Le, trattab ftit fis-soppa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the bread still hard? Mark: No, it has softened a little in the soup.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：面包还硬吗？马克：不硬了，在汤里泡软了一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 面包还硬吗？
messages.en: Is the bread still hard?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 不硬了，在汤里泡软了一点。
messages.en: No, it has softened a little in the soup.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象硬面包放进汤里慢慢变软，把 trattab 与“受到作用后变软”的画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A discussion between parties who are trying to agree on a price, conditions, or another disputed matter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 各方为就价格、条件或有分歧的事项达成一致而进行的谈判、磋商或议价。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Diskussjoni bejn partijiet li jippruvaw jilħqu ftehim dwar prezz, kundizzjonijiet jew kwistjoni li fuqha ma jaqblux.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为达成协议而进行的谈判、磋商或讨价还价。

formal.mt: Wara trattativa twila, iż-żewġ partijiet laħqu ftehim dwar il-kundizzjonijiet tal-kuntratt.
formal.en: After a lengthy negotiation, the two parties reached an agreement on the terms of the contract.
formal.zh: 经过漫长的谈判，双方就合同条款达成了协议。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif marret it-trattativa dwar il-prezz? Pawlu: Tajjeb, qbilna fuq mitt ewro.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did the negotiation over the price go? Pawlu: Well, we agreed on one hundred euros.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：价格谈得怎么样？保罗：挺好，我们谈妥了一百欧元。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 价格谈得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the negotiation over the price go?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (买家)
messages.zh: 挺好，我们谈妥了一百欧元。
messages.en: Well, we agreed on one hundred euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象买卖双方围着价格反复商量，最后握手成交；trattativa 就是这段谈判过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become covered or soiled with excrement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被粪便覆盖或弄脏，指物体、衣物等沾上粪便。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitgħatta jew jitħammeġ bil-ħmieġ tal-imsaren.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被粪便覆盖；沾满粪便。

collocations.en: a shoe that became soiled with excrement
trousers that became soiled with excrement

formal.mt: Iż-żarbun trawwat waqt ix-xogħol fir-razzett u kellu jitnaddaf qabel ma ntuża mill-ġdid.
formal.en: The shoe became soiled with excrement during work on the farm and had to be cleaned before being used again.
formal.zh: 这只鞋在农场作业时沾上了粪便，必须清洗后才能再次使用。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex ħallejt iż-żarbun barra? Toni: Għax trawwat meta rfist fil-ħmieġ tal-kelb.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did you leave the shoe outside? Toni: Because it got soiled with excrement when I stepped in dog mess.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你为什么把鞋留在外面？托尼：因为我踩到了狗屎，鞋被弄脏了。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把鞋留在外面？
messages.en: Why did you leave the shoe outside?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax trawwat meta rfist fil-ħmieġ tal-kelb.
messages.mt_standard: Għax trawwat meta rfist fil-ħmieġ tal-kelb.
messages.zh: 因为我踩到了狗屎，鞋被弄脏了。
messages.en: Because it got soiled with excrement when I stepped in dog mess.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“踩到狗屎后把鞋留在门外”的情景记 trawwat，注意这里明确涉及粪便，并非一般弄脏。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have a liquid scattered over one's surface in small drops.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面被洒上细小的液滴；被少量喷洒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintlaqat minn qtar żgħir ta' likwidu li jinxtered fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被洒上液滴；被喷洒。

formal.mt: Il-wiċċ tal-materjal traxxax bl-ilma qabel it-tindif.
formal.en: The surface of the material was sprinkled with water before cleaning.
formal.zh: 清洁前，材料表面被洒上了水。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex il-mejda mxarrba? Ben: Il-wiċċ traxxax bl-ilma meta kont insaqqi l-pjanti.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why is the table wet? Ben: The surface got sprinkled with water while I was watering the plants.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：桌子怎么湿了？本：我浇植物的时候，桌面被洒上了水。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 桌子怎么湿了？
messages.en: Why is the table wet?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-wiċċ traxxax bl-ilma meta kont insaqqi l-pjanti.
messages.mt_standard: Il-wiċċ traxxax bl-ilma meta kont insaqqi l-pjanti.
messages.zh: 我浇植物的时候，桌面被洒上了水。
messages.en: The surface got sprinkled with water while I was watering the plants.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象喷壶留下许多小水点，把 traxxax 记成“表面被洒上点点液滴”的状态变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a tragic way, involving great suffering, loss, or an unhappy ending.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以悲惨或具有悲剧性的方式，常涉及严重痛苦、失去或不幸结局。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod traġiku, b'tbatija kbira, telf jew tmiem ta' niket.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 悲惨地；以悲剧性的方式

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-vjaġġ jintemm traġikament bil-mewt tal-protagonist.
formal.en: In the novel, the journey ends tragically with the protagonist's death.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，旅程以主人公的死亡悲惨收场。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif jispiċċa l-film? Toni: Jispiċċa traġikament; il-protagonist imut fl-aħħar.
colloquial.en: Lara: How does the film end? Toni: It ends tragically; the protagonist dies at the end.
colloquial.zh: Lara：电影的结局怎么样？Toni：以悲剧告终；主人公最后死了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影的结局怎么样？
messages.en: How does the film end?

messages.speaker: Toni (观众)
messages.zh: 以悲剧告终；主人公最后死了。
messages.en: It ends tragically; the protagonist dies at the end.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“故事怎样结束？悲惨地结束”来记 traġikament，把它放在动作旁边，记住这是表示方式的副词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The tragic quality of an event, situation, or story, especially its connection with suffering or loss.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事件、处境或故事所具有的悲剧性，尤其指其中令人痛苦或涉及失去的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-karattru traġiku ta' ġrajja, sitwazzjoni jew storja, speċjalment minħabba t-tbatija jew it-telf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 悲剧性；悲惨、令人哀痛的性质

collocations.en: the tragic nature of the event
the tragic nature of the situation

formal.mt: L-awtur juri t-traġiċità tal-ġrajja permezz tat-tbatija tal-familja.
formal.en: The author conveys the tragic nature of the event through the family's suffering.
formal.zh: 作者通过这个家庭所遭受的痛苦，展现了事件的悲剧性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ħassejt meta spiċċa d-dramm? Mark: Ħassejt it-traġiċità tal-istorja; il-familja tilfet kollox.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did you feel when the play ended? Mark: I felt the tragic nature of the story; the family lost everything.
colloquial.zh: Maja：戏结束时，你有什么感受？Mark：我感受到了故事的悲剧性；那个家庭失去了一切。

messages.speaker: Maja (观众)
messages.zh: 戏结束时，你有什么感受？
messages.en: What did you feel when the play ended?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħassejt it-traġiċità tal-istorja; il-familja tilfet kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Ħassejt it-traġiċità tal-istorja; il-familja tilfet kollox.
messages.zh: 我感受到了故事的悲剧性；那个家庭失去了一切。
messages.en: I felt the tragic nature of the story; the family lost everything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 traġiċità 写在故事评论中的“悲剧性”一栏，记住这里命名的是一种性质，按名词理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grow from boyhood into manhood or become mature as a man.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 男孩逐渐长大成为成年男子，或在成长中变得成熟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tifel jikber u jsir raġel, jew isir aktar matur hekk kif jikber.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长大成为成年男子
逐渐成熟，成长为成年男子

collocations.zh: 随着时间推移长大成人

collocations.en: matured into a man and became more responsible
collocations.zh: 长大成人，变得更有责任心

formal.mt: Matul dawk is-snin, iż-żagħżugħ traġġel u beda jerfa' aktar responsabbiltà.
formal.en: During those years, the young man matured into manhood and began to take on more responsibility.
formal.zh: 在那些年里，这名青年逐渐成熟，开始承担更多责任。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm kiber ħuk! Nina: Veru, traġġel; issa jaħdem u jieħu ħsieb tiegħu nnifsu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Your brother has grown so much! Nina: Yes, he's grown into a man; he works and looks after himself now.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你弟弟长大了好多！Nina：是啊，他已经长大成人，现在工作了，也能照顾自己。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你弟弟长大了好多！
messages.en: Your brother has grown so much!

messages.speaker: Nina (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, traġġel; issa jaħdem u jieħu ħsieb tiegħu nnifsu.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, traġġel; issa jaħdem u jieħu ħsieb tiegħu nnifsu.
messages.zh: 是啊，他已经长大成人，现在工作了，也能照顾自己。
messages.en: Yes, he's grown into a man; he works and looks after himself now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 traġġel 放进男孩逐年长大的相册：从童年走到成年，帮助记住“成长为男子、逐渐成熟”。

gloss_zh: 形成村落；人变得乡土保守、眼界狭窄

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop into a village, or, of a person, to become provincial in outlook.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指地方逐渐形成村落；用于人时，指思想变得局限于本地、缺少开阔眼界。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li post isir raħal, jew li persuna ssir provinċjali fil-mod kif taħseb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐形成村落；变成村庄

sense_translations.en_definition: to become provincial (used of a person)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得乡土保守、眼界狭窄，指人

collocations.en: the place developed into a village over time
collocations.zh: 这个地方逐渐形成了村落

collocations.en: became provincial in his way of thinking
collocations.zh: 思想变得局限于本地、眼界狭窄

formal.mt: Maż-żmien, il-grupp ta' djar traħħal u sar raħal b'ħajja komunitarja attiva.
formal.en: Over time, the group of houses developed into a village with an active community life.
formal.zh: 随着时间推移，这片房屋逐渐形成了一个社区生活活跃的村庄。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu għadu jinteressa ruħu f'ideat ġodda? Mark: Dan l-aħħar traħħal fil-mod kif jaħseb; ma jridx jisma' b'xejn minn barra r-raħal.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Pawlu still interested in new ideas? Mark: Lately he's become provincial in his thinking; he doesn't want to hear about anything from outside the village.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 还对新想法感兴趣吗？Mark：他最近的想法越来越局限于本地；村子以外的事情，他什么都不想听。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu għadu jinteressa ruħu f'ideat ġodda?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu għadu jinteressa ruħu f'ideat ġodda?
messages.zh: Pawlu 还对新想法感兴趣吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu still interested in new ideas?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-aħħar traħħal fil-mod kif jaħseb; ma jridx jisma' b'xejn minn barra r-raħal.
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-aħħar traħħal fil-mod kif jaħseb; ma jridx jisma' b'xejn minn barra r-raħal.
messages.zh: 他最近的想法越来越局限于本地；村子以外的事情，他什么都不想听。
messages.en: Lately he's become provincial in his thinking; he doesn't want to hear about anything from outside the village.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅图记 traħħal：房屋聚成村落；人的视野缩在本地。后一幅只是词义记忆图，不代表乡村居民都眼界狭窄。

gloss_zh: 受到恳求；被覆上大理石

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be earnestly asked or begged to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到他人的恳切请求，被恳求做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħadd jitolbok bil-ħerqa biex tagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被恳求；受到他人的恳切请求。
被覆上大理石；表面铺设大理石。

collocations.en: a wall that was covered with marble

formal.mt: Waqt ir-restawr, il-ħajt tad-daħla traħħam biex jaqbel mal-bqija tal-bini.
formal.en: During the restoration, the entrance wall was covered with marble to match the rest of the building.
formal.zh: 修复期间，入口处的墙面覆上了大理石，以便与建筑其余部分相配。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu baqa' jgħinna? Mark: Traħħam minna biex jibqa' siegħa oħra, u aċċetta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu stay to help us? Mark: We entreated him to stay another hour, and he agreed.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么留下来帮我们？马克：我们恳求他再留一个小时，他答应了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么留下来帮我们？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu stay to help us?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Traħħam minna biex jibqa' siegħa oħra, u aċċetta.
messages.mt_standard: Traħħam minna biex jibqa' siegħa oħra, u aċċetta.
messages.zh: 我们恳求他再留一个小时，他答应了。
messages.en: We entreated him to stay another hour, and he agreed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面分别记忆：一个人受到恳求，一面墙覆上大理石；遇到此词先看主语和上下文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have its price lowered and become cheaper to buy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 商品或服务的价格被调低，购买时比原来便宜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li l-prezz ta' xi ħaġa jitbaxxa u ssir irħas biex tixtriha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 价格被降低；降价出售。

collocations.en: was reduced in price by ten euros

collocations.mt: traħħas minn mitt ewro għal tmenin ewro
collocations.en: was reduced from one hundred euros to eighty euros
collocations.zh: 从一百欧元降至八十欧元

formal.mt: Il-mudell traħħas minn mitt ewro għal tmenin ewro matul il-bejgħ ta' tmiem l-istaġun.
formal.en: The model was reduced from one hundred euros to eighty euros during the end-of-season sale.
formal.zh: 在季末促销期间，这款产品从一百欧元降至八十欧元。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-flokk għadu jiswa tletin ewro? Mark: Le, traħħas. Issa jiswa għoxrin ewro.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this shirt still cost thirty euros? Mark: No, it has been reduced. It now costs twenty euros.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这件上衣还卖三十欧元吗？马克：不，降价了。现在卖二十欧元。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-flokk għadu jiswa tletin ewro?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-flokk għadu jiswa tletin ewro?
messages.zh: 这件上衣还卖三十欧元吗？
messages.en: Does this shirt still cost thirty euros?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, traħħas. Issa jiswa għoxrin ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Le, traħħas. Issa jiswa għoxrin ewro.
messages.zh: 不，降价了。现在卖二十欧元。
messages.en: No, it has been reduced. It now costs twenty euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象价签上的三十被划掉，换成二十；把 traħħas 和价格向下的箭头一起记。

gloss_zh: 放牧照管；照料吃草的牲畜

teaching_sense.en_definition: The work of looking after grazing animals while they feed on pasture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 牲畜在草地上吃草时，对它们进行看管和照料的工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħarsien u l-kura tal-annimali waqt li jkunu jirgħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对吃草牲畜的看管和照料；放牧照管。

formal.mt: It-traħħil tan-nagħaġ jeħtieġ attenzjoni biex l-annimali ma jitbiegħdux mill-merħla waqt li jirgħu.
formal.en: Tending grazing sheep requires attention so that the animals do not stray from the flock while feeding.
formal.zh: 照管吃草的羊群需要保持留意，防止羊在进食时离群走远。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se tagħmel dalgħodu fir-razzett? Pawlu: Għandi t-traħħil tan-nagħaġ; se noqgħod magħhom waqt li jirgħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you going to do on the farm this morning? Pawlu: I have the sheep-tending to do; I will stay with them while they graze.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天上午你在农场做什么？保罗：我要照管放牧的羊群；它们吃草时，我会待在旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天上午你在农场做什么？
messages.en: What are you going to do on the farm this morning?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (牧羊人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi t-traħħil tan-nagħaġ; se noqgħod magħhom waqt li jirgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi t-traħħil tan-nagħaġ; se noqgħod magħhom waqt li jirgħu.
messages.zh: 我要照管放牧的羊群；它们吃草时，我会待在旁边。
messages.en: I have the sheep-tending to do; I will stay with them while they graze.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面定在草地上：羊群低头吃草，牧人留意照管；traħħil 记的是这项照料工作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An earnest plea, or the act of asking someone urgently and sincerely for help or mercy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 恳切的请求，或为了获得帮助、怜悯等而真诚急切地恳求的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Talba ħerqana, jew l-att li titlob lil xi ħadd bil-ħerqa għall-għajnuna jew għall-ħniena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恳求；一项恳切的请求。
苦苦哀求；十分恳切地请求的行为。

formal.mt: L-ittra kienet mimlija traħħim għall-għajnuna biex il-familja ssib post fejn toqgħod.
formal.en: The letter was full of entreaty for help so that the family could find somewhere to stay.
formal.zh: 信中满是恳切求助的话语，希望能帮助这家人找到住处。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif talabek tibqa'? Maja: Bi traħħim kbir; qalli li kellu bżonn l-għajnuna tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did he ask you to stay? Maja: With great earnestness; he told me he needed my help.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他是怎么请求你留下的？玛雅：他苦苦恳求，说他需要我的帮助。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他是怎么请求你留下的？
messages.en: How did he ask you to stay?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bi traħħim kbir; qalli li kellu bżonn l-għajnuna tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Bi traħħim kbir; qalli li kellu bżonn l-għajnuna tiegħi.
messages.zh: 他苦苦恳求，说他需要我的帮助。
messages.en: With great earnestness; he told me he needed my help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人双手合拢、语气恳切地请求帮助；traħħim 是名词，指这番恳求或恳求的行为。

gloss_zh: 受到约束；被阻止；被抑制

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be kept under control or prevented from moving, acting, or developing freely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到控制或限制，无法自由移动、行动或发展。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinżamm taħt kontroll jew ma jitħalliex jiċċaqlaq, jaġixxi jew jiżviluppa liberament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到约束或控制；行动受到限制。
被拦住；受到阻碍；进展或发展被抑制。

collocations.en: be held back by a lack of funds
collocations.zh: 因资金不足而受到限制

formal.mt: L-iżvilupp tal-proġett trażżan minħabba nuqqas ta' fondi.
formal.en: The development of the project was held back by a lack of funds.
formal.zh: 该项目的发展因资金不足而受到限制。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kelb laħaq ħareġ mill-bieb? Mark: Le, trażżan biċ-ċinga qabel ma wasal fit-triq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the dog manage to get out through the door? Mark: No, he was held back by the leash before he reached the road.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：狗跑出门了吗？马克：没有，还没到马路就被牵引绳拦住了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 狗跑出门了吗？
messages.en: Did the dog manage to get out through the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, trażżan biċ-ċinga qabel ma wasal fit-triq.
messages.mt_standard: Le, trażżan biċ-ċinga qabel ma wasal fit-triq.
messages.zh: 没有，还没到马路就被牵引绳拦住了。
messages.en: No, he was held back by the leash before he reached the road.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想牵引绳把狗拦住，再想资金不足把项目拖住；trażżan 的两种用法都抓住“受到限制”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Control over one's own impulses or emotions, or a restriction placed on actions or behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对自身冲动、情绪的控制，或对行动、行为施加的限制与约束。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kontroll fuq l-impulsi jew l-emozzjonijiet tiegħu nnifsu, jew limitazzjoni fuq azzjonijiet jew imġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自制力；对自身情绪、欲望或冲动的控制。
克制；约束；对行动或行为的限制。

formal.mt: Waqt id-dibattitu, il-parteċipanti wrew trażżin u evitaw attakki personali.
formal.en: During the debate, the participants showed restraint and avoided personal attacks.
formal.zh: 辩论过程中，参与者保持克制，避免了人身攻击。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif irnexxielek ma tirrabjax? Pawlu: Kelli bżonn ħafna trażżin; ħadt nifs u stennejt qabel weġibt.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did you manage not to get angry? Pawlu: It took a lot of self-control; I took a breath and waited before replying.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你怎么忍住没发火？保罗：很需要自制力；我先吸了一口气，等了一下才回答。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你怎么忍住没发火？
messages.en: How did you manage not to get angry?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kelli bżonn ħafna trażżin; ħadt nifs u stennejt qabel weġibt.
messages.mt_standard: Kelli bżonn ħafna trażżin; ħadt nifs u stennejt qabel weġibt.
messages.zh: 很需要自制力；我先吸了一口气，等了一下才回答。
messages.en: It took a lot of self-control; I took a breath and waited before replying.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象生气时先深呼吸、把话停在嘴边；trażżin 是这种自制或约束本身，是名词。

gloss_zh: 被使之获胜；被安排赢得比赛

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made to win through another person's action or arrangement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由于他人的行动或安排而被使之获胜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi megħjun jew imwassal biex jirbaħ permezz tal-azzjoni jew tal-arranġament ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被使之获胜；由他人促成或安排而赢。

collocations.en: be made to win the game

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, it-tifel trebbaħ apposta sabiex jikseb aktar fiduċja fih innifsu.
formal.en: In the exercise, the boy was deliberately made to win so that he would gain more self-confidence.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，大人有意让男孩获胜，以增强他的自信心。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ħallejt lil ħuk jirbaħ? Toni: Iva, trebbaħ apposta għax kienet l-ewwel logħba tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did you let your brother win? Toni: Yes, he was deliberately made to win because it was his first game.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你让你弟弟赢了吗？托尼：对，我特意让他赢的，因为这是他第一次玩。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你让你弟弟赢了吗？
messages.en: Did you let your brother win?

messages.speaker: Toni (哥哥)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, trebbaħ apposta għax kienet l-ewwel logħba tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, trebbaħ apposta għax kienet l-ewwel logħba tiegħu.
messages.zh: 对，我特意让他赢的，因为这是他第一次玩。
messages.en: Yes, he was deliberately made to win because it was his first game.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象哥哥在游戏里让弟弟赢，从弟弟的角度记 trebbaħ：有人促成了自己的胜利。

gloss_zh: 不停的闲聊；滔滔不绝的话语

teaching_sense.en_definition: Continuous or plentiful talk, especially chatter that goes on for a long time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持续不断或大量的话语，尤指长时间不停的闲聊、絮叨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem jew tpaċpiċ li jibqa' għaddej fit-tul jew li jkun abbundanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不停的闲聊；持续不断的叽叽喳喳或絮叨。
滔滔不绝的话语；接连不断的健谈。

formal.mt: It-treddin bla waqfien ta' xi parteċipanti għamilha diffiċli għall-oħrajn biex jisimgħu l-ispjegazzjoni.
formal.en: The constant chatter of some participants made it difficult for the others to hear the explanation.
formal.zh: 部分参与者不停地闲聊，使其他人难以听清讲解。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Irnexxielek taqra fuq il-karozza tal-linja? Ben: Le, bit-treddin ta' dawk ta' warajja ma stajtx nikkonċentra.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did you manage to read on the bus? Ben: No, I couldn't concentrate because of the chatter from the people behind me.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你在公交车上看成书了吗？本：没有，后面的人一直聊天，我没法集中注意力。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在公交车上看成书了吗？
messages.en: Did you manage to read on the bus?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, bit-treddin ta' dawk ta' warajja ma stajtx nikkonċentra.
messages.mt_standard: Le, bit-treddin ta' dawk ta' warajja ma stajtx nikkonċentra.
messages.zh: 没有，后面的人一直聊天，我没法集中注意力。
messages.en: No, I couldn't concentrate because of the chatter from the people behind me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象公交车后排的话声一串接一串，让你读不进书；treddin 指这股不断的话语或闲聊。

gloss_zh: 兔羊等动物的排便；动物粪便

teaching_sense.en_definition: The excretion of animals such as rabbits and sheep, or the faecal matter they produce.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指兔、羊等动物排出粪便的过程，也指这些动物排出的粪便。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħruġ tal-ħmieġ minn annimali bħall-fniek u n-nagħaġ, jew il-ħmieġ li joħroġ minnhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 兔、羊等动物排泄粪便的过程。
动物排出的粪便。

formal.mt: Waqt it-tindif tal-maqjel, il-ħaddiem ġabar it-treddis tan-nagħaġ.
formal.en: While cleaning the pen, the worker collected the sheep droppings.
formal.zh: 清洁畜栏时，工人收集了羊的粪便。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm treddis tal-fniek ħdejn il-gaġġa. Mark: Rajtu. Se niġbru u nnaddaf hemmhekk.
colloquial.en: Maja: There are rabbit droppings beside the cage. Mark: I saw them. I'll collect them and clean that spot.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：笼子旁边有兔子的粪便。马克：我看到了。我来把粪便收走，再把那里清理一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (饲养员)
messages.zh: 笼子旁边有兔子的粪便。
messages.en: There are rabbit droppings beside the cage.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu. Se niġbru u nnaddaf hemmhekk.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu. Se niġbru u nnaddaf hemmhekk.
messages.zh: 我看到了。我来把粪便收走，再把那里清理一下。
messages.en: I saw them. I'll collect them and clean that spot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和清理兔笼的画面相连：既可指动物排便这件事，也可指清扫时收集的粪便。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A trembling or shaking movement, including a quake; also the rumbling of thunder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体或物体的颤抖、震动，也可指地面震动或雷声轰鸣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Moviment ta' rogħda jew theżżiż, inkluż theżżiż tal-art; ukoll id-daqq tar-ragħad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 颤抖；轻微的震动。
震动，尤指地面的震动。
雷鸣；雷声轰响。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi tregħid ħafif tal-art li nħass fir-raħal.
formal.en: The report describes a slight shaking of the ground that was felt in the village.
formal.zh: 报告描述了村中居民感受到的一次轻微地面震动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi tregħid f'idejja bil-kesħa. Mark: Idħol ġewwa; hawn ħafna aktar sħun.
colloquial.en: Maja: My hands are trembling from the cold. Mark: Come inside; it's much warmer here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我的手冷得发抖。马克：进来吧，这里暖和多了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的手冷得发抖。
messages.en: My hands are trembling from the cold.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Idħol ġewwa; hawn ħafna aktar sħun.
messages.mt_standard: Idħol ġewwa; hawn ħafna aktar sħun.
messages.zh: 进来吧，这里暖和多了。
messages.en: Come inside; it's much warmer here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面区分词义：手在发抖、地面震动、天空雷鸣；根据周围谈的是身体、地面还是天气来选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of eating something, such as having a little food during a break.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吃东西这一行为，例如休息时吃一点食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jiekol xi ħaġa, bħal ftit ikel waqt waqfa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吃某种东西的行为；进食。

collocations.en: a break to have something to eat
time to have something to eat

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi waqfa qasira għat-trejjiq qabel tibda t-tieni sessjoni.
formal.en: The programme includes a short break to have something to eat before the second session begins.
formal.zh: 日程安排在第二场活动开始前留出一小段休息时间，供大家吃点东西。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandna ħin għat-trejjiq? Mark: Iva, ejja nieklu xi ħaġa qabel nitilqu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do we have time to have something to eat? Mark: Yes, let's eat something before we leave.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们有时间吃点东西吗？马克：有，出发前先吃点吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 我们有时间吃点东西吗？
messages.en: Do we have time to have something to eat?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nieklu xi ħaġa qabel nitilqu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nieklu xi ħaġa qabel nitilqu.
messages.zh: 有，出发前先吃点吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's eat something before we leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象活动中间停下来吃几口面包：这个词指吃东西这一行为，记忆重点放在“进食”上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A narrow street or a small path or trail used to get from one place to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人通行的窄街、小路或小径，可位于建筑之间或乡野之中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Triq dejqa jew mogħdija żgħira li minnha wieħed jgħaddi minn post għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狭窄的街道；窄街。
供人行走的小径，例如乡野中的步道。
小路；供人通过的路径。

formal.mt: Trejqa bejn l-għelieqi twassal mill-villaġġ sal-kappella.
formal.en: A path between the fields leads from the village to the chapel.
formal.zh: 一条穿行于田地之间的小路从村庄通往小教堂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn immorru sal-pjazza? Mark: Ħu dik it-trejqa bejn id-djar; twasslek dritt hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which way do we go to the square? Mark: Take that narrow street between the houses; it leads straight there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：去广场该走哪边？马克：走房子之间的那条窄街，直接就到了。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 去广场该走哪边？
messages.en: Which way do we go to the square?

messages.speaker: Mark (当地居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu dik it-trejqa bejn id-djar; twasslek dritt hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu dik it-trejqa bejn id-djar; twasslek dritt hemm.
messages.zh: 走房子之间的那条窄街，直接就到了。
messages.en: Take that narrow street between the houses; it leads straight there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中画一条细细的通行路线：穿过房屋时是窄街，穿过田野时是小径，共同特点是路面较窄。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small sash worn around the waist; the diminutive form of terħa.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 系在腰间的小型布带或腰巾，是 terħa 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Terħa żgħira li tintlibes madwar il-qadd.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small sash (the diminutive form of 'terħa')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小腰巾或小腰带；terħa 的指小形式。

collocations.en: to tie a small sash around her waist
collocations.zh: 把小腰巾系在她的腰间

formal.mt: Il-kostum jinkludi trejħa ħamra li tintrabat madwar il-qadd.
formal.en: The costume includes a small red sash that is tied around the waist.
formal.zh: 这套服装配有一条系在腰间的红色小腰巾。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din it-trejħa tmur mal-libsa tiegħi? Anna: Iva, orbotha madwar qaddek.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this small sash go with my dress? Anna: Yes, tie it around your waist.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这条小腰巾配我的连衣裙吗？安娜：配，把它系在腰间吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这条小腰巾配我的连衣裙吗？
messages.en: Does this small sash go with my dress?

messages.speaker: Anna (店员)
messages.zh: 配，把它系在腰间吧。
messages.en: Yes, tie it around your waist.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给连衣裙系上一条小巧的布腰带，把“小”和“腰间”一起记住；它是 terħa 的指小形式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be moved by rolling, or to move along by rolling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因滚动而被移动，或以滚动的方式沿着某个方向前行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mċaqlaq billi jdur fuq wiċċ, jew jimxi b'dan il-mod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被滚动；被人以滚动的方式移动。
滚着前行；沿着某个表面滚动。

formal.mt: Il-barmil vojt trembel 'l isfel mat-triq sakemm waqaf ħdejn il-ħajt.
formal.en: The empty barrel rolled down the road until it stopped beside the wall.
formal.zh: 空桶沿着道路向下滚动，直到墙边才停下来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar il-ballun? Mark: Trembel taħt il-mejda. Se nġibu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did the ball go? Mark: It rolled under the table. I'll get it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：球去哪儿了？马克：滚到桌子底下了。我去拿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 球去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did the ball go?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 滚到桌子底下了。我去拿。
messages.en: It rolled under the table. I'll get it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象圆球或空桶一边转一边前进：有人推动时可理解为被滚动，描述移动过程时就是滚着前行。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of rolling something up, such as making a cigarette by rolling tobacco in paper.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西卷起来的动作，例如用卷烟纸把烟草卷成香烟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li biha xi ħaġa titkebbeb, bħal meta t-tabakk jitkebbeb fil-karta biex isir sigarett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卷起；卷制，例如把烟草卷成香烟。

formal.mt: It-trembil ta' sigarett bl-idejn jeħtieġ karta adattata.
formal.en: Rolling a cigarette by hand requires suitable paper.
formal.zh: 手工卷制香烟需要合适的纸。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għal xiex tintuża din il-karta? Pawlu: Għat-trembil tas-sigaretti.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this paper used for? Pawlu: For rolling cigarettes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这种纸是做什么用的？保罗：用来卷香烟。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这种纸是做什么用的？
messages.en: What is this paper used for?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 用来卷香烟。
messages.en: For rolling cigarettes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手把一张纸慢慢卷成细管，用这个动作记住 trembil 表示卷制这件事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a bell to be rung so that it produces a sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指钟被人敲响或摇响，从而发出声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta qanpiena tindaqq u tagħmel il-ħoss tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被敲响；被摇响，指钟等发声器物。

collocations.en: was rung at the start of the ceremony

formal.mt: Il-qanpiena trenda fil-bidu taċ-ċerimonja biex tħabbar il-ftuħ tagħha.
formal.en: The bell was rung at the start of the ceremony to announce its opening.
formal.zh: 仪式开始时，钟被敲响，宣告仪式开幕。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt il-qanpiena? Pawlu: Iva, trenda ftit ilu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear the bell? Pawlu: Yes, it was rung a little while ago.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听见钟声了吗？保罗：听见了，刚才有人敲响了钟。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听见钟声了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear the bell?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 听见了，刚才有人敲响了钟。
messages.en: Yes, it was rung a little while ago.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把镜头对准发声的钟：钟是被敲响的对象，用这个被动场景记住 trenda。

gloss_zh: 呈现；利润；产出；教堂鸣钟

teaching_sense.en_definition: A profit, return, or yield obtained from an activity or resource.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某项活动或资源带来的利润、回报或产出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qligħ, ir-ritorn jew il-prodott li jinkiseb minn attività jew riżorsa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呈现；表达；对某项内容的表现或诠释。
利润；经营或其他活动所得的盈利。
产出；产量；某项资源或活动带来的收益。

sense_translations.en_definition: ringing of church bells (traditionally to indicate that the Lenten fast may be broken)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 教堂钟声的敲响，传统上用于表示可以结束当日的四旬期禁食。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri li l-attività tat trendija tajba matul is-sena.
formal.en: The report shows that the activity produced a good return during the year.
formal.zh: 报告显示，这项活动在这一年带来了良好的回报。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kien dak il-ħoss? Pawlu: Kienet it-trendija tal-qniepen tal-knisja.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was that sound? Pawlu: It was the ringing of the church bells.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：刚才那是什么声音？保罗：是教堂敲钟的声音。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 刚才那是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that sound?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是教堂敲钟的声音。
messages.en: It was the ringing of the church bells.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 trendija 做四格记忆卡：内容呈现、经营利润、资源产出、教堂鸣钟；阅读时用上下文选择对应的一格。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be moved or brought nearer to a person or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被移动或带到某人、某物附近，使距离缩短。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mċaqlaq jew miġjub eqreb lejn persuna jew ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be brought close to sth. or sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被带到某物或某人近旁；被移近。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be made to approach sth. or sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被使得靠近某物或某人；在外力作用下接近。

collocations.en: was moved closer to the table
was brought closer to the window
collocations.zh: 被移到更靠近窗户的位置

formal.mt: Is-siġġu tressaq lejn il-mejda biex il-parteċipant seta' jikteb aktar komdu.
formal.en: The chair was moved closer to the table so that the participant could write more comfortably.
formal.zh: 椅子被移近桌子，让参与者能够更舒适地书写。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar is-siġġu? Pawlu: Tressaq eqreb lejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did the chair go? Pawlu: It was moved closer to the window.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：椅子放到哪里去了？保罗：被移到更靠近窗户的地方了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 椅子放到哪里去了？
messages.en: Where did the chair go?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 被移到更靠近窗户的地方了。
messages.en: It was moved closer to the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象椅子被人推向桌边，距离一点点缩短；用被移近的画面记住 tressaq。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move air towards oneself with a fan or another object in order to feel cooler.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用扇子或其他物品朝自己扇动空气，让自己凉快一些。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juża mrewħa jew oġġett ieħor biex jagħmel ir-riħ fuqu nnifsu u jħossu aktar frisk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给自己扇风；通过扇动空气使自己凉快。

collocations.en: fanned himself with a piece of cardboard
collocations.zh: 用一块硬纸板给自己扇风

formal.mt: Waqt il-waqfa, il-parteċipant trewwaħ b'mrewħa minħabba s-sħana fis-sala.
formal.en: During the break, the participant fanned himself with a fan because of the heat in the hall.
formal.zh: 休息期间，由于大厅里很热，这位参与者用扇子给自己扇风。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu ħa dik il-biċċa kartun? Rita: Trewwaħ biha għax kien jaħraq ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu take that piece of cardboard? Rita: He fanned himself with it because he was very hot.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么拿了那块硬纸板？丽塔：他太热了，就用它给自己扇风。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu ħa dik il-biċċa kartun?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu ħa dik il-biċċa kartun?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么拿了那块硬纸板？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu take that piece of cardboard?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trewwaħ biha għax kien jaħraq ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Trewwaħ biha għax kien jaħraq ħafna.
messages.zh: 他太热了，就用它给自己扇风。
messages.en: He fanned himself with it because he was very hot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象天气炎热时拿纸板朝自己扇风；动作的发出者也享受凉风，帮助记住 trewwaħ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The work of administering and managing the affairs of an institution or organization.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对机构或组织的事务进行安排、协调和管理的工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol ta' amministrazzjoni u tmexxija tal-affarijiet ta' istituzzjoni jew organizzazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行政管理；对机构或组织事务的管理。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat huwa responsabbli għat-treġija tal-istituzzjoni u għat-tqassim tar-riżorsi tagħha.
formal.en: The committee is responsible for administering the institution and allocating its resources.
formal.zh: 该委员会负责机构的行政管理及其资源分配。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min jieħu ħsieb it-treġija tal-klabb? Mark: Anna tieħu ħsieb il-karti u torganizza l-laqgħat.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who handles the club's administration? Mark: Anna handles the paperwork and organizes the meetings.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁负责俱乐部的管理工作？马克：安娜处理文书，也安排会议。

messages.speaker: Maja (新会员)
messages.zh: 谁负责俱乐部的管理工作？
messages.en: Who handles the club's administration?

messages.speaker: Mark (俱乐部会员)
messages.mt_spoken: Anna tieħu ħsieb il-karti u torganizza l-laqgħat.
messages.mt_standard: Anna tieħu ħsieb il-karti u torganizza l-laqgħat.
messages.zh: 安娜处理文书，也安排会议。
messages.en: Anna handles the paperwork and organizes the meetings.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进俱乐部办公室的画面：处理文件、安排会议、分配资源，合起来就是行政管理。

gloss_zh: 被遣回；被迫返回；被击退

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be sent or forced back, made to return, or driven back.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到外力或他人要求而退回、返回，或被抵挡而后退。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintbagħat lura, jiġi mġiegħel jirritorna, jew jiġi mġiegħel jirtira.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be made to go back
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被要求或迫使退回去。
被要求或迫使返回原处。
被击退或被抵挡回去。

formal.mt: Il-grupp treġġa' lura mid-daħla minħabba xogħlijiet fil-bini.
formal.en: The group was sent back from the entrance because work was being carried out in the building.
formal.zh: 由于楼内正在施工，这一组人在入口处被要求返回。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-vann treġġa' lura? Mark: Għax it-triq kienet magħluqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why was the van sent back? Mark: Because the road was closed.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那辆面包车为什么被要求返回？马克：因为道路封闭了。

messages.speaker: Maja (乘客)
messages.zh: 那辆面包车为什么被要求返回？
messages.en: Why was the van sent back?

messages.speaker: Mark (司机)
messages.zh: 因为道路封闭了。
messages.en: Because the road was closed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象车辆在路障前被示意掉头，把这个词记成受到外力而返回；遇到进攻语境则理解为被击退。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become very cold, especially after being exposed to cold conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得非常冷，尤其指人在寒冷环境中冻得厉害。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir kiesaħ ħafna jew iħoss ħafna bard, speċjalment wara li jkun espost għall-kesħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得非常冷；冻得厉害。

collocations.en: became very cold in the cold weather
collocations.zh: 在寒冷天气里冻得厉害

collocations.en: became very cold after the swim

formal.mt: Wara li qatta' siegħa barra mingħajr kowt, ir-raġel treżżaħ.
formal.en: After spending an hour outside without a coat, the man became very cold.
formal.zh: 这名男子没穿外套在外面待了一小时后，冻得厉害。
