colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu daħal ġewwa daqshekk malajr? Rita: Treżżaħ wara l-għawma u mar iġib xugaman.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu come inside so quickly? Rita: He became very cold after the swim and went to get a towel.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么这么快就进屋了？丽塔：他游泳后冻得厉害，就去拿毛巾了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu daħal ġewwa daqshekk malajr?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu daħal ġewwa daqshekk malajr?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么这么快就进屋了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu come inside so quickly?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Treżżaħ wara l-għawma u mar iġib xugaman.
messages.mt_standard: Treżżaħ wara l-għawma u mar iġib xugaman.
messages.zh: 他游泳后冻得厉害，就去拿毛巾了。
messages.en: He became very cold after the swim and went to get a towel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刚游完泳的人在冷风中缩起肩膀，急着找毛巾；用冻得厉害的感觉记住 treżżaħ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of chasing or pursuing someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某人或某物后面追赶、追逐或追捕的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tiġri wara persuna jew ħaġa biex tilħaqha jew taqbadha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 追赶；追逐的行为。
追逐；追捕；为赶上或抓住目标而进行的追赶。

formal.mt: L-osservazzjoni turi li t-trid tal-priża dam ftit minuti biss.
formal.en: The observation shows that the pursuit of the prey lasted only a few minutes.
formal.zh: 观察结果显示，对猎物的追逐只持续了几分钟。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kien qed jagħmel il-kelb? Pawlu: Kien wara fenek, iżda t-trid ma damx ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was the dog doing? Pawlu: It was after a rabbit, but the chase did not last long.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那只狗刚才在做什么？保罗：它在追一只兔子，不过这场追逐没持续多久。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那只狗刚才在做什么？
messages.en: What was the dog doing?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien wara fenek, iżda t-trid ma damx ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Kien wara fenek, iżda t-trid ma damx ħafna.
messages.zh: 它在追一只兔子，不过这场追逐没持续多久。
messages.en: It was after a rabbit, but the chase did not last long.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把狗追兔子的整段过程想成一场追逐；本词条的 trid 是给这场追逐命名的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feed on grass or other low plants, or to be at pasture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指牲畜啃食草或其他低矮植物，也指牲畜处于牧场上放牧的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiekol il-ħaxix jew pjanti baxxi oħra, jew ikun fil-mergħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吃草；啃食草地上的植物。
在牧场上放牧；处于放养吃草的状态。

formal.mt: Il-ħaruf triegħa fil-mergħa matul il-għodwa, taħt il-ħarsien tar-ragħaj.
formal.en: The lamb grazed in the pasture during the morning, under the shepherd's care.
formal.zh: 上午，小羊在牧羊人的看护下在牧场上吃草。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn kien il-ħaruf dalgħodu? Pawlu: Triegħa fil-mergħa wara d-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where was the lamb this morning? Pawlu: It grazed in the pasture behind the house.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天早上小羊在哪里？保罗：它在屋后的牧场上吃草。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天早上小羊在哪里？
messages.en: Where was the lamb this morning?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (牧羊人)
messages.zh: 它在屋后的牧场上吃草。
messages.en: It grazed in the pasture behind the house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 triegħa 和“小羊低头吃草”的画面一起记：低头啃草对应动作，留在牧场对应状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become unwilling to spend or share, or to develop an excessive desire for more.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得不愿花费或分享，或变得过分想要得到更多东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir xħiħ u ma jkunx irid jonfoq jew jaqsam ma' ħaddieħor, jew isir rgħib u jkun irid iżjed milli għandu bżonn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得吝啬；变得舍不得花钱或与人分享。
变得贪婪；产生过分索取或占有的欲望。

collocations.mt: triegħeb u ma ried jonfoq xejn
collocations.en: became miserly and refused to spend anything
collocations.zh: 变得吝啬，一点钱也不肯花

collocations.en: became greedy and wanted everything for himself
collocations.zh: 变得贪婪，想把一切据为己有

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, in-negozjant triegħeb wara li sar sinjur u ma baqax lest jaqsam il-ġid tiegħu ma' ħaddieħor.
formal.en: In the story, the merchant became miserly after growing rich and was no longer willing to share his wealth with others.
formal.zh: 故事中，商人富裕后变得吝啬，不再愿意与别人分享自己的财富。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark ried il-kejk kollu għalih? Nina: Triegħeb malli rah; lanqas ried jagħtina biċċa!
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Mark want the whole cake for himself? Nina: He got greedy as soon as he saw it; he wouldn't even give us a piece!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克为什么想独占整个蛋糕？妮娜：他一看见就贪心起来，连一块也不肯给我们！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark ried il-kejk kollu għalih?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark ried il-kejk kollu għalih?
messages.zh: 马克为什么想独占整个蛋糕？
messages.en: Why did Mark want the whole cake for himself?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Triegħeb malli rah; lanqas ried jagħtina biċċa!
messages.mt_standard: Triegħeb malli rah; lanqas ried jagħtina biċċa!
messages.zh: 他一看见就贪心起来，连一块也不肯给我们！
messages.en: He got greedy as soon as he saw it; he wouldn't even give us a piece!

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 triegħeb 的两个镜头：钱包越捂越紧是变吝啬，蛋糕越拿越多是变贪婪；两者都突出变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become red or reddened, including to blush from embarrassment or another emotion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变红或泛红，也指因害羞、尴尬或其他情绪而脸红。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aħmar jew jagħtih il-ħmura, ukoll minħabba mistħija jew emozzjoni oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变红；呈现泛红的状态。
脸红；因害羞、尴尬等情绪而面部泛红。

formal.mt: Meta rċieva tifħir quddiem il-klassi kollha, l-istudent triegħex bil-mistħija.
formal.en: When he received praise in front of the whole class, the student blushed with embarrassment.
formal.zh: 这名学生在全班面前受到表扬时，害羞得脸红了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt lil Mark meta faħħritu l-għalliema? Lara: Iva, triegħex bil-mistħija u tbissem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see Mark when the teacher praised him? Lara: Yes, he blushed with embarrassment and smiled.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：老师表扬马克时，你看到他了吗？拉拉：看到了，他害羞得脸红了，还笑了笑。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt lil Mark meta faħħritu l-għalliema?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt lil Mark meta faħħritu l-għalliema?
messages.zh: 老师表扬马克时，你看到他了吗？
messages.en: Did you see Mark when the teacher praised him?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 看到了，他害羞得脸红了，还笑了笑。
messages.en: Yes, he blushed with embarrassment and smiled.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 triegħex 配上一张逐渐泛红的脸：先记“变红”，再用受到表扬后害羞的情景记“脸红”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make an attempt to fall asleep, whether or not sleep follows.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尝试让自己入睡；这个动作本身不表示已经睡着。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel tentattiv biex jorqod, mingħajr ma jfisser li bilfors jirnexxilu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 试着睡觉；尝试入睡。

collocations.en: tried to sleep for a short while
tried to sleep after the meal

formal.mt: Wara l-vjaġġ twil, il-passiġġier trieqed għal ftit, iżda l-istorbju żammu mqajjem.
formal.en: After the long journey, the passenger tried to sleep for a short while, but the noise kept him awake.
formal.zh: 长途旅行后，这名乘客试着睡一小会儿，但噪声使他一直醒着。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark raqad wara l-ikel? Pawlu: Trieqed għal ftit, imma ma setax jorqod minħabba l-istorbju.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Mark sleep after the meal? Pawlu: He tried to sleep for a short while, but he couldn't because of the noise.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克饭后睡着了吗？保罗：他试着睡了一会儿，但因为太吵，没能睡着。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克饭后睡着了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark sleep after the meal?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trieqed għal ftit, imma ma setax jorqod minħabba l-istorbju.
messages.mt_standard: Trieqed għal ftit, imma ma setax jorqod minħabba l-istorbju.
messages.zh: 他试着睡了一会儿，但因为太吵，没能睡着。
messages.en: He tried to sleep for a short while, but he couldn't because of the noise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 trieqed 时想象闭眼数羊的人：他正在努力入睡，是否睡着还不知道，重点放在“试着”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be held up or kept in position by a support.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由支撑物托住或固定住，从而保持位置或站立状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinżamm wieqaf jew f'postu permezz ta' appoġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被支撑；被托住；得到支承。

collocations.en: was held up by a temporary support

formal.mt: Il-ħajt trieġa b'appoġġ temporanju waqt ix-xogħol ta' tiswija.
formal.en: The wall was held up by a temporary support during the repair work.
formal.zh: 维修期间，这面墙由临时支撑物撑住。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm dawk it-travi taħt is-saqaf? Pawlu: Is-saqaf trieġa bihom waqt it-tiswija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are those beams under the ceiling? Pawlu: The ceiling was supported with them during the repair.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：天花板下面为什么有那些梁？保罗：维修时用它们撑住了天花板。

messages.speaker: Maja (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm dawk it-travi taħt is-saqaf?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm dawk it-travi taħt is-saqaf?
messages.zh: 天花板下面为什么有那些梁？
messages.en: Why are those beams under the ceiling?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (维修工)
messages.zh: 维修时用它们撑住了天花板。
messages.en: The ceiling was supported with them during the repair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一根梁从下方稳稳托住天花板，把注意力放在被撑住的天花板上，记住 trieġa。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To shiver because of cold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由于寒冷而身体发抖或打寒战。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirtogħod minħabba l-kesħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在寒冷中发抖；冷得打寒战。

formal.mt: Il-vjaġġatur trieżaħ bil-kesħa waqt li kien jistenna l-karozza tal-linja mingħajr kowt.
formal.en: The traveller shivered with cold while waiting for the bus without a coat.
formal.zh: 这名旅客没有穿外套，在等公交车时冷得发抖。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex tajt il-kutra lil Mark? Sara: Għax trieżaħ bil-kesħa wara li ħareġ mix-xita.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you give Mark the blanket? Sara: Because he shivered with cold after coming in out of the rain.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么把毯子给马克？萨拉：因为他从雨中进来后冷得发抖。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把毯子给马克？
messages.en: Why did you give Mark the blanket?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax trieżaħ bil-kesħa wara li ħareġ mix-xita.
messages.mt_standard: Għax trieżaħ bil-kesħa wara li ħareġ mix-xita.
messages.zh: 因为他从雨中进来后冷得发抖。
messages.en: Because he shivered with cold after coming in out of the rain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 trieżaħ 和冷风中抱紧双臂、牙齿打战的画面绑定，记住发抖的原因是寒冷。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be held up or kept in position by a support placed against or beneath something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被放在下方或抵在一旁的支撑物撑住，从而保持位置或避免倒塌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinżamm wieqaf jew f'postu permezz ta' appoġġ minn taħt jew mill-ġenb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被撑起；由支撑物抵住或托住。

collocations.en: was propped up with a piece of wood

formal.mt: Il-ħajt triffed b'appoġġ temporanju sakemm setgħu jibdew ix-xogħlijiet ta' tiswija.
formal.en: The wall was propped up with a temporary support until repair work could begin.
formal.zh: 在维修工程能够开始之前，这面墙由临时支撑物撑住。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-bank għadu jixxengel? Pawlu: Le, triffed b'biċċa njama u issa jinsab stabbli.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is the bench still wobbling? Pawlu: No, it was propped up with a piece of wood and is stable now.
colloquial.zh: 马克：长凳还在晃吗？保罗：不晃了，用一块木头撑住后，现在稳了。

messages.speaker: Mark (住户)
messages.zh: 长凳还在晃吗？
messages.en: Is the bench still wobbling?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (木匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, triffed b'biċċa njama u issa jinsab stabbli.
messages.mt_standard: Le, triffed b'biċċa njama u issa jinsab stabbli.
messages.zh: 不晃了，用一块木头撑住后，现在稳了。
messages.en: No, it was propped up with a piece of wood and is stable now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 triffed 就想象一面歪墙被木杆顶住：主语是得到支撑的东西，画面重点是“被撑住”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be stepped on or pressed under someone's feet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被人的脚踩到、踩压或践踏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintlaqat jew jingħafas taħt saqajn xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被踩到；被脚踩压或践踏。

formal.mt: Il-ħaxix ħdejn il-mogħdija triffes meta l-viżitaturi għaddew minn fuqu.
formal.en: The grass beside the path was trodden on when visitors walked over it.
formal.zh: 游客从上面走过时，小路旁的草被踩踏了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-ħaxix ħdejn il-bieb hu mgħaffeġ? Mark: Triffes meta għaddew it-tfal minn hemm.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the grass by the door flattened? Mark: It was trodden on when the children walked through there.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：门边的草为什么被压扁了？马克：孩子们从那里走过时把它踩了。

messages.speaker: Lara (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-ħaxix ħdejn il-bieb hu mgħaffeġ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-ħaxix ħdejn il-bieb hu mgħaffeġ?
messages.zh: 门边的草为什么被压扁了？
messages.en: Why is the grass by the door flattened?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Triffes meta għaddew it-tfal minn hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Triffes meta għaddew it-tfal minn hemm.
messages.zh: 孩子们从那里走过时把它踩了。
messages.en: It was trodden on when the children walked through there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用草地上的鞋印记 triffes：脚走过去，草被踩下去；把注意力放在承受踩踏的草上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A closed geometric shape with three straight sides and three angles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由三条直线边围成、具有三个角的封闭几何图形。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Figura ġeometrika magħluqa bi tliet naħat dritti u tliet angoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 三角形，具有三条边和三个角的几何图形。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom ipinġu trijangolu ekwilaterali u jkejlu n-naħat tiegħu.
formal.en: In this exercise, students must draw an equilateral triangle and measure its sides.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，学生需要画一个等边三角形，并测量它的各条边。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan it-trijangolu għandu tliet naħat indaqs? Mark: Iva, mela huwa trijangolu ekwilaterali.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this triangle have three equal sides? Mark: Yes, so it is an equilateral triangle.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这个三角形的三条边一样长吗？Mark：对，所以它是等边三角形。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-trijangolu għandu tliet naħat indaqs?
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-trijangolu għandu tliet naħat indaqs?
messages.zh: 这个三角形的三条边一样长吗？
messages.en: Does this triangle have three equal sides?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 对，所以它是等边三角形。
messages.en: Yes, so it is an equilateral triangle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 trijangolu，就在纸上画三条边、点三个角；用同一幅三角形把词形和图形连起来。

gloss_zh: 被安排骑乘；被扶上坐骑

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be put on an animal or vehicle to ride by someone else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由别人使其骑乘，或被别人扶上坐骑、安排乘坐交通工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tkun imqiegħed fuq annimal jew vettura biex tirkeb minn xi ħadd ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被别人安排骑乘，或被扶上坐骑；强调由他人促成骑乘。

collocations.en: was put on a horse to ride
was put on a donkey to ride

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni, it-tifel trikkeb fuq żiemel bl-għajnuna tal-għalliem.
formal.en: During the lesson, the boy was put on a horse to ride with the instructor's help.
formal.zh: 上课时，男孩在教练的帮助下被扶上马骑乘。

colloquial.mt: Anna: It-tifel trikkeb fuq iż-żiemel? Ġużeppi: Iva, l-għalliem għenu jitla' u baqa' ħdejh.
colloquial.en: Anna: Was the boy put on the horse to ride? Ġużeppi: Yes, the instructor helped him get on and stayed beside him.
colloquial.zh: Anna：男孩被扶上马了吗？Ġużeppi：对，教练帮他上马，并一直待在他旁边。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.zh: 男孩被扶上马了吗？
messages.en: Was the boy put on the horse to ride?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, l-għalliem għenu jitla' u baqa' ħdejh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-għalliem għenu jitla' u baqa' ħdejh.
messages.zh: 对，教练帮他上马，并一直待在他旁边。
messages.en: Yes, the instructor helped him get on and stayed beside him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象教练把孩子扶上马背：记忆重点是别人促成骑乘，句中的孩子承受这个安排。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number one million million, written as 1,000,000,000,000 or 10¹².
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数词，表示一百万个一百万，即一万亿，写作 1,000,000,000,000 或 10¹²。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru ta' miljun miljun, miktub 1,000,000,000,000 jew 10¹².

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一万亿，即一百万乘以一百万，数值为 10¹²。

formal.mt: Għall-finijiet ta' dan l-eżerċizzju, il-baġit totali huwa ta' triljun ewro.
formal.en: For the purposes of this exercise, the total budget is one trillion euros.
formal.zh: 在本练习的设定中，总预算为一万亿欧元。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Triljun kemm ikollu żerijiet? David: Tnax; huwa miljun miljun.
colloquial.en: Maja: How many zeros does a trillion have? David: Twelve; it is a million million.
colloquial.zh: Maja：一万亿后面有几个零？David：十二个；就是一百万乘以一百万。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 一万亿后面有几个零？
messages.en: How many zeros does a trillion have?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.zh: 十二个；就是一百万乘以一百万。
messages.en: Twelve; it is a million million.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 triljun 和数字 1,000,000,000,000 一起记：四组三个零，共十二个零，中文读一万亿。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tripoli, the capital city of Libya.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 地名，指利比亚的首都的黎波里。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-belt kapitali tal-Libja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 的黎波里，利比亚的首都。

formal.mt: Fit-test tal-ġeografija, l-istudenti għandhom jidentifikaw Tripli bħala l-belt kapitali tal-Libja.
formal.en: In the geography test, students must identify Tripoli as the capital city of Libya.
formal.zh: 在地理测验中，学生需要指出的黎波里是利比亚的首都。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn hi Tripli fuq din il-mappa? Samwel: Hawn, fil-Libja; hija l-kapitali.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where is Tripoli on this map? Samwel: Here, in Libya; it is the capital.
colloquial.zh: Rita：的黎波里在这张地图的哪里？Samwel：这里，在利比亚；它是首都。

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi Tripli fuq din il-mappa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi Tripli fuq din il-mappa?
messages.zh: 的黎波里在这张地图的哪里？
messages.en: Where is Tripoli on this map?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同学)
messages.zh: 这里，在利比亚；它是首都。
messages.en: Here, in Libya; it is the capital.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Tripli、Tripoli、的黎波里写在同一张地图卡上，并加注利比亚首都；地名书写记得大写开头。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality or state of being triple, or consisting of three parts or aspects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有三重性质，或由三个部分、三个方面构成的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità jew l-istat ta' xi ħaġa li tkun tripla jew magħmula minn tliet partijiet jew aspetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 三重性，指具有三重性质或由三个部分、方面构成的状态。

collocations.en: the threefold nature of the function

formal.mt: It-tripliċità tal-istruttura tidher fit-tliet partijiet tagħha: l-introduzzjoni, id-diskussjoni u l-konklużjoni.
formal.en: The triplicity of the structure is evident in its three parts: the introduction, the discussion and the conclusion.
formal.zh: 这一结构的三重性体现在它的三个部分：引言、讨论和结论。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex semmejt it-tripliċità tal-pjan? Toni: Għax għandu tliet partijiet li jaħdmu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why did you mention the threefold nature of the plan? Toni: Because it has three parts that work together.
colloquial.zh: Elena：你为什么提到这个计划的三重性？Toni：因为它有三个相互配合的部分。

messages.speaker: Elena (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么提到这个计划的三重性？
messages.en: Why did you mention the threefold nature of the plan?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għandu tliet partijiet li jaħdmu flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għandu tliet partijiet li jaħdmu flimkien.
messages.zh: 因为它有三个相互配合的部分。
messages.en: Because it has three parts that work together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个整体，里面分成三格，再标上 tripliċità；记的是整体具有三重结构或性质，而非单纯数到三。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A trip or journey from one place to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从一个地方到另一个地方的一次旅行或行程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vjaġġ minn post għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 旅行；旅程；一趟出行。

formal.mt: Għal dan l-eżerċizzju, ikteb deskrizzjoni ta' tripp qasir u semmi l-postijiet li żort.
formal.en: For this exercise, write a description of a short trip and name the places you visited.
formal.zh: 本练习要求描写一次短途旅行，并列出你游览过的地方。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Tiġi għal tripp qasir magħna nhar is-Sibt? Luqa: Iva! Se mmorru bil-karozza jew bil-karozza tal-linja?
colloquial.en: Marta: Will you come on a short trip with us on Saturday? Luqa: Yes! Are we going by car or by bus?
colloquial.zh: Marta：星期六要和我们一起去短途旅行吗？Luqa：好啊！我们开车去还是坐公交车去？

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tiġi għal tripp qasir magħna nhar is-Sibt?
messages.mt_standard: Tiġi għal tripp qasir magħna nhar is-Sibt?
messages.zh: 星期六要和我们一起去短途旅行吗？
messages.en: Will you come on a short trip with us on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Se mmorru bil-karozza jew bil-karozza tal-linja?
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Se mmorru bil-karozza jew bil-karozza tal-linja?
messages.zh: 好啊！我们开车去还是坐公交车去？
messages.en: Yes! Are we going by car or by bus?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用熟悉的英语 trip 帮助联想旅行，再留意马耳他语 tripp 末尾写两个 p；配上周末出游画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Milky Way, visible in a dark night sky as a pale band of light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 银河；在黑暗夜空中可见的一条淡淡的光带。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-faxxa ċara ta' dawl li tidher fis-sema bil-lejl, speċjalment fejn hemm ftit dawl artifiċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 银河。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-faxxa ċara ta' dawl li tidher fis-sema bil-lejl.

collocations.en: a photograph of the Milky Way

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tas-sema, l-istudenti ħadu ritratt ta' Triq ta' Sant'Anna.
formal.en: During the sky observation, the students took a photograph of the Milky Way.
formal.zh: 在观测天空时，学生们拍摄了一张银河照片。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dik il-faxxa ċara fis-sema x'inhi? Leo: Dik hi Triq ta' Sant'Anna. Minn hawn tidher sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that pale band in the sky? Leo: That's the Milky Way. You can see it clearly from here.
colloquial.zh: Maja：天空中那条淡淡的光带是什么？Leo：那是银河。从这里看得很清楚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 天空中那条淡淡的光带是什么？
messages.en: What is that pale band in the sky?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik hi Triq ta' Sant'Anna. Minn hawn tidher sew.
messages.mt_standard: Dik hi Triq ta' Sant'Anna. Minn hawn tidher sew.
messages.zh: 那是银河。从这里看得很清楚。
messages.en: That's the Milky Way. You can see it clearly from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个专名整体联想成夜空中一条发亮的道路，看到完整词组就回忆“银河”；这是记忆画面，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A light sweeping or scrubbing of a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对表面进行的轻度清扫或轻轻刷洗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tindif ħafif ta' wiċċ permezz ta' knis jew għorik.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻度清扫或刷洗。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Knis jew għorik ħafif.

collocations.en: a light sweeping or scrubbing of the floor
collocations.zh: 对地面的轻度清扫或刷洗

formal.mt: Wara x-xogħol, kien meħtieġ biss trix ħafif tal-art.
formal.en: After the work, only a light sweeping or scrubbing of the floor was needed.
formal.zh: 工作结束后，只需轻轻清扫或刷洗一下地面。

colloquial.mt: Nina: L-art trid ħafna tindif? Mark: Le, trix ħafif biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does the floor need much cleaning? Mark: No, a light sweep or scrub is enough.
colloquial.zh: Nina：地面需要花很大力气清洁吗？Mark：不用，轻轻扫洗一下就够了。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 地面需要花很大力气清洁吗？
messages.en: Does the floor need much cleaning?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 不用，轻轻扫洗一下就够了。
messages.en: No, a light sweep or scrub is enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地上只有薄薄一层灰，拿扫帚或刷子轻轻处理即可；把 trix 和“轻度扫洗”的动作画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be worked or cleared with a rake.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被用耙子耙整或清理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mnaddaf jew irranġat b'rastell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被耙；被用耙子整理或清理。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiġi maħdum jew imnaddaf b'rastell.

formal.mt: Il-ġnien trixtel bir-reqqa qabel iż-żrigħ.
formal.en: The garden was carefully raked before sowing.
formal.zh: 花园在播种前经过了仔细耙整。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-ġnien lest għaż-żrigħ? Pawlu: Iva, trixtel dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is the garden ready for sowing? Pawlu: Yes, it was raked this morning.
colloquial.zh: Sara：花园准备好播种了吗？Pawlu：好了，今天早上已经耙过了。

messages.speaker: Sara (园艺同伴)
messages.zh: 花园准备好播种了吗？
messages.en: Is the garden ready for sowing?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园艺同伴)
messages.zh: 好了，今天早上已经耙过了。
messages.en: Yes, it was raked this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把注意力放在“土地被耙整”的结果上：trixtel 是动词，记忆画面是花园经过耙子整理后变得平整。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of working or clearing an area with a rake.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用耙子整理土地或清理地面的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol ta' tindif jew arranġament tal-art b'rastell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 耙地；用耙子整理或清理地面。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xogħol li jsir b'rastell biex titnaddaf jew tiġi rranġata l-art.

formal.mt: It-trixtil tal-ġnien sar qabel iż-żrigħ.
formal.en: The raking of the garden was carried out before sowing.
formal.zh: 花园的耙整作业在播种前完成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-trixtil tal-weraq? Leo: Jien. Ġib ir-rastell, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will take care of raking the leaves? Leo: I will. Bring the rake, please.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁来负责耙落叶？Leo：我来。请把耙子拿来。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-trixtil tal-weraq?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-trixtil tal-weraq?
messages.zh: 谁来负责耙落叶？
messages.en: Who will take care of raking the leaves?

messages.speaker: Leo (邻居)
messages.zh: 我来。请把耙子拿来。
messages.en: I will. Bring the rake, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 trixtil 放进待办清单：“今天的任务是耙地”。用“这项作业”帮助记住它是名词，并与表示被耙整的动词区分。

gloss_zh: 用夹板固定；给家具装上腿

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be supported with splints, or, of furniture, to be fitted with legs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指肢体等用夹板支撑固定；也指家具被装上腿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinżamm sod permezz ta' q splints, jew, fil-każ ta' għamara, jitwaħħlulu s-saqajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用夹板支撑或固定。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be fitted with legs (used of furniture)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被装上腿或支脚，用于家具。

collocations.en: the arm was supported with splints
the bench was fitted with legs

formal.mt: Fir-rapport ġie nnutat li d-driegħ tal-pazjent triġġel biex jinżamm sod waqt it-trasport.
formal.en: The report noted that the patient's arm was supported with splints to keep it steady during transport.
formal.zh: 报告记载，患者的手臂用夹板固定，以便在转运期间保持稳定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-bank il-ġdid għadu mingħajr saqajn? Pawlu: Le, triġġel dalgħodu u issa lest biex nużawh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the new bench still without legs? Pawlu: No, it was fitted with legs this morning and is ready for us to use now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新长凳还没有装腿吗？保罗：已经装了，今天早上装好的，现在可以用了。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 新长凳还没有装腿吗？
messages.en: Is the new bench still without legs?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (木匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, triġġel dalgħodu u issa lest biex nużawh.
messages.mt_standard: Le, triġġel dalgħodu u issa lest biex nużawh.
messages.zh: 已经装了，今天早上装好的，现在可以用了。
messages.en: No, it was fitted with legs this morning and is ready for us to use now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 triġġel 分成两个学习画面：手臂旁绑着夹板，长凳下面装上支腿；根据主语辨认具体义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making something firm with splints, or fitting an item of furniture with legs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用夹板使某物稳固的操作，也指给家具安装支腿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tisħiħ ta' xi ħaġa b'appoġġi riġidi, jew it-twaħħil tas-saqajn ma' għamara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用夹板固定、加固，使其稳固。

sense_translations.en_definition: fitting with legs (used of items of furniture)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给家具安装支腿。

formal.mt: It-triġġil tal-mejda għandu jitlesta qabel ma l-mejda tintuża.
formal.en: Fitting the table with legs must be completed before the table is used.
formal.zh: 桌子使用前，必须完成桌腿的安装。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'inhu t-triġġil tal-mejda? Pawlu: Hawn ifisser li twaħħlilha s-saqajn.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does fitting the table with legs mean? Pawlu: Here it means attaching its legs.
colloquial.zh: Marija：给桌子做 triġġil 是什么意思？Pawlu：这里指给它装上桌腿。

messages.speaker: Marija (学徒)
messages.zh: 给桌子做 triġġil 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does fitting the table with legs mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (木匠)
messages.zh: 这里指给它装上桌腿。
messages.en: Here it means attaching its legs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成两幅支撑画面：夹板把物体固定，桌腿把家具撑起；这是记义联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 过早产卵；早产；流产、堕胎

teaching_sense.en_definition: Premature egg-laying or birth, or the ending of a pregnancy through abortion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指过早产卵、早产，或通过流产、堕胎而结束妊娠；具体含义依语境区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqegħid tal-bajd jew twelid qabel iż-żmien, jew it-tmiem ta' tqala permezz ta' abort.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过早产卵，指尚未到正常时间就产下卵。
早产，指在正常孕期结束之前分娩。
流产；堕胎，指妊娠在正常分娩之前终止。

collocations.en: a case of premature birth or abortion, depending on context
collocations.zh: 一例早产或流产，具体依语境判断

formal.mt: Fir-rapport dwar l-għasafar, il-kelma triħ tirreferi għat-tqegħid tal-bajd qabel iż-żmien.
formal.en: In the report on birds, the word triħ refers to premature egg-laying.
formal.zh: 在这份关于鸟类的报告中，triħ 一词指过早产卵。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser triħ f'dan it-test dwar l-għasafar? Nina: Hawn ifisser li l-bajd jitqiegħed qabel iż-żmien.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does triħ mean in this text about birds? Nina: Here it means that eggs are laid too early.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这篇关于鸟类的文章里，triħ 是什么意思？Nina：这里指过早产卵。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser triħ f'dan it-test dwar l-għasafar?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser triħ f'dan it-test dwar l-għasafar?
messages.zh: 这篇关于鸟类的文章里，triħ 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does triħ mean in this text about birds?

messages.speaker: Nina (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ifisser li l-bajd jitqiegħed qabel iż-żmien.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ifisser li l-bajd jitqiegħed qabel iż-żmien.
messages.zh: 这里指过早产卵。
messages.en: Here it means that eggs are laid too early.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住三个语境格：鸟类对应过早产卵，分娩对应早产，妊娠终止对应流产；读句子时先辨语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The care, guidance, and education a child receives while growing up.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 儿童成长过程中受到的照料、引导和教育。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kura, il-gwida u l-edukazzjoni li jingħataw lit-tfal huma u jikbru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 养育与教养；成长过程中接受的教育和引导。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-mod kif it-tfal jingħataw kura, gwida u edukazzjoni huma u jikbru.

formal.mt: It-trobbija tat-tfal teħtieġ paċenzja, kura u gwida.
formal.en: Bringing up children requires patience, care, and guidance.
formal.zh: 养育和教育孩子需要耐心、关爱与引导。

colloquial.mt: Nina: It-tifla tiegħek dejjem tgħid grazzi. Mark: Nippruvaw nagħtuha trobbija tajba.
colloquial.en: Nina: Your daughter always says thank you. Mark: We try to give her a good upbringing.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你女儿总会说谢谢。Mark：我们努力让她养成良好的教养。

messages.speaker: Nina (家庭朋友)
messages.zh: 你女儿总会说谢谢。
messages.en: Your daughter always says thank you.

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.zh: 我们努力让她养成良好的教养。
messages.en: We try to give her a good upbringing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 trobbija 联想成孩子从小到大受到的照顾、引导和礼貌教育；用 trobbija tajba“良好教养”整组记忆。

gloss_zh: 号角；小号；亦指两种海鱼

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bugle or a small trumpet, played by blowing into a mouthpiece.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 号角或小型小号，一种通过吹奏吹嘴发声的管乐器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument mużikali, bħal bugle jew trumbetta żgħira, li jindaqq billi jonfoħ fih min idoqq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 号角；小型小号。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Strument mużikali bħal bugle jew trumbetta żgħira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种海鱼，学名为 Macroramphosus scolopax，英文名为 longspine snipefish。
一种海鱼，学名为 Capros aper，英文名为 boarfish。

collocations.en: play the bugle or small trumpet
the sound of the bugle or small trumpet

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċerimonja, il-mużiċist daqq it-trombetta.
formal.en: During the ceremony, the musician played the bugle.
formal.zh: 仪式期间，乐手吹奏了号角。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dak il-ħoss ġej mit-trombetta? Pawlu: Iva, qed nipprattika għall-kunċert.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is that sound coming from the small trumpet? Pawlu: Yes, I'm practising for the concert.
colloquial.zh: Sara：那个声音是小号发出来的吗？Pawlu：是的，我正在为音乐会练习。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个声音是小号发出来的吗？
messages.en: Is that sound coming from the small trumpet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (乐手)
messages.zh: 是的，我正在为音乐会练习。
messages.en: Yes, I'm practising for the concert.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“吹响小号”的画面记住常用乐器义；另设两张带学名的海鱼词卡，提醒自己同一拼写还有两个独立鱼类义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who plays a bugle or trumpet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吹奏号角或小号的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ddoqq il-bugle jew it-trumbetta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 号手；吹奏号角或小号的乐手。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li ddoqq il-bugle jew it-trumbetta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沙雀，学名为 Bucanetes githagineus，英文名为 trumpeter finch。

formal.mt: It-trombettier tal-banda daqq silta qasira fil-bidu tal-kunċert.
formal.en: The band's trumpeter played a short piece at the beginning of the concert.
formal.zh: 乐队的小号手在音乐会开始时演奏了一首短曲。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jdoqq is-solo llejla? Leo: It-trombettier tal-banda tagħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is playing the solo tonight? Leo: The trumpeter in our band.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今晚谁来独奏？Leo：我们乐队的小号手。

messages.speaker: Maja (观众)
messages.zh: 今晚谁来独奏？
messages.en: Who is playing the solo tonight?

messages.speaker: Leo (乐队成员)
messages.zh: 我们乐队的小号手。
messages.en: The trumpeter in our band.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 trombetta 和 trombettier 配成“乐器—演奏者”两张学习卡：一个是号，一个是号手；再单独记住它也可以指沙雀。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A trombone, a brass musical instrument whose pitch is usually changed by moving a slide.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长号，一种通常通过移动伸缩管来改变音高的铜管乐器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument mużikali tar-ram li normalment jinbidel il-ħoss tiegħu billi tiċċaqlaq parti mill-pajp 'il quddiem u lura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长号。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Strument tar-ram b'parti li tiżżerżaq biex jinbidel il-ħoss.

formal.mt: L-istudent daqq it-trombettun waqt il-kunċert tal-iskola.
formal.en: The student played the trombone during the school concert.
formal.zh: 这名学生在学校音乐会上吹奏了长号。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'se titgħallem iddoqq din is-sena? Mark: It-trombettun. Għandi l-ewwel lezzjoni għada.
colloquial.en: Nina: What will you learn to play this year? Mark: The trombone. I have my first lesson tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你今年要学吹什么乐器？Mark：长号。我明天上第一堂课。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你今年要学吹什么乐器？
messages.en: What will you learn to play this year?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 长号。我明天上第一堂课。
messages.en: The trombone. I have my first lesson tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象长号演奏者把伸缩管前后拉动，同时默念 trombettun；用这个鲜明动作把“长号”与“小号、号手”分开记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of looking at something through binoculars.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过双筒望远镜观看或观察事物的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tħares lejn xi ħaġa permezz ta' trombi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使用双筒望远镜观看或观察的行为。

collocations.en: looking through binoculars from the balcony
collocations.zh: 从阳台用双筒望远镜观察

collocations.en: looking through binoculars towards the sea
collocations.zh: 用双筒望远镜朝海上观察

formal.mt: It-trombjatura mill-gallarija għenet lill-osservaturi jaraw il-vapuri fil-bogħod.
formal.en: Looking through binoculars from the balcony helped the observers see the ships in the distance.
formal.zh: 从阳台使用双筒望远镜观察，帮助观察者看清了远处的船只。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed tagħmel ħdejn it-tieqa? Toni: Qed nagħmel ftit trombjatura lejn il-baħar biex nara l-vapuri.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you doing by the window? Toni: I'm looking towards the sea through binoculars for a bit to see the ships.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在窗边做什么？托尼：我正用双筒望远镜朝海上看一会儿，看看那些船。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在窗边做什么？
messages.en: What are you doing by the window?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħmel ftit trombjatura lejn il-baħar biex nara l-vapuri.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħmel ftit trombjatura lejn il-baħar biex nara l-vapuri.
messages.zh: 我正用双筒望远镜朝海上看一会儿，看看那些船。
messages.en: I'm looking towards the sea through binoculars for a bit to see the ships.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象举起双筒望远镜看远处船只，把这个词记成使用望远镜的观察动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Grapefruit or pomelo fruit, referred to collectively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 葡萄柚或柚子，也可集合地指这类水果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frott taċ-ċitru kbir, bħall-grejpfrut jew il-pomelo, imsemmi b'mod kollettiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 葡萄柚或柚子，可指一个或多个果实。

formal.mt: Aħsel it-tronġ qabel ma taqtgħu u neħħi ż-żerriegħa qabel isservih.
formal.en: Wash the grapefruit or pomelo before cutting it, and remove the seeds before serving it.
formal.zh: 切开葡萄柚或柚子之前先清洗，上桌前去掉籽。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xtrajt tronġ mis-suq? Mark: Iva, trid idduq ftit? Lara: Iva, imma neħħi ż-żerriegħa, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you buy grapefruit or pomelo at the market? Mark: Yes, would you like to taste some? Lara: Yes, but remove the seeds, please.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你在市场买葡萄柚或柚子了吗？马克：买了，你想尝一点吗？拉拉：想，不过请先把籽去掉。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你在市场买葡萄柚或柚子了吗？
messages.en: Did you buy grapefruit or pomelo at the market?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 买了，你想尝一点吗？
messages.en: Yes, would you like to taste some?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma neħħi ż-żerriegħa, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma neħħi ż-żerriegħa, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 想，不过请先把籽去掉。
messages.en: Yes, but remove the seeds, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词卡画成剥开的大柑橘，旁边写葡萄柚和柚子，帮助记住两种对应水果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A steady running gait of a horse, faster than a walk and slower than a gallop.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马的一种有节奏的小跑步态，速度快于慢走、慢于疾驰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pass taż-żiemel aktar mgħaġġel mill-mixi iżda aktar bil-mod mill-galopp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小跑，尤指马介于慢走与疾驰之间的步态。

formal.mt: Matul it-taħriġ, iż-żiemel mexa bit-trott għal ħames minuti.
formal.en: During training, the horse moved at a trot for five minutes.
formal.zh: 训练期间，这匹马以小跑步态前进了五分钟。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan iż-żiemel qed jiġri malajr? Pawlu: Le, għadu bit-trott. Nina: Mela għadu ma bediex il-galopp.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this horse running fast? Pawlu: No, it's still trotting. Nina: So it hasn't started galloping yet.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这匹马跑得很快吗？保罗：没有，它还在小跑。妮娜：那它还没有开始疾驰。

messages.speaker: Nina (骑术学员)
messages.zh: 这匹马跑得很快吗？
messages.en: Is this horse running fast?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (骑术教练)
messages.zh: 没有，它还在小跑。
messages.en: No, it's still trotting.

messages.speaker: Nina (骑术学员)
messages.zh: 那它还没有开始疾驰。
messages.en: So it hasn't started galloping yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中播放马蹄有节奏地哒哒前进的画面，记住这是小跑这一中间速度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cosmetics applied to the face to change or enhance its appearance, or the resulting makeup.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涂在脸上以修饰或改变外貌的化妆品，也指化妆后的妆容。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kożmetiċi li jitqiegħdu fuq il-wiċċ biex ibiddlu jew isebbħu d-dehra, jew id-dehra li joħolqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 化妆品，或使用化妆品形成的妆容。

formal.mt: Għar-ritratt uffiċjali, l-attriċi għażlet trukk ħafif li deher naturali.
formal.en: For the official photograph, the actress chose light makeup that looked natural.
formal.zh: 拍摄正式照片时，这位女演员选择了看起来很自然的淡妆。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif jidher it-trukk tiegħi? Maja: Sabiħ ħafna, u jidher naturali. Sara: Tajjeb, ridt trukk ħafif għal-lejla.
colloquial.en: Sara: How does my makeup look? Maja: Very nice, and it looks natural. Sara: Good, I wanted light makeup for this evening.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我的妆看起来怎么样？玛雅：很好看，而且很自然。萨拉：那就好，我今晚想化淡妆。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的妆看起来怎么样？
messages.en: How does my makeup look?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 很好看，而且很自然。
messages.en: Very nice, and it looks natural.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那就好，我今晚想化淡妆。
messages.en: Good, I wanted light makeup for this evening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象镜子旁摆着粉底和口红，把这个词同时联系到化妆用品与脸上的妆容。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose job is to apply makeup to other people, for example for performances or photography.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以给他人化妆为职业的人，例如为演出或摄影提供化妆服务的化妆师。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tagħmel it-trukk lil ħaddieħor, pereżempju għal spettaklu jew għar-ritratti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 化妆师，专门为他人设计或施作妆容的人。

formal.mt: It-trukkatur ħejja lill-atturi qabel ma beda l-iffilmjar.
formal.en: The makeup artist prepared the actors before filming began.
formal.zh: 拍摄开始前，化妆师为演员们做好了化妆准备。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min se jagħmilli t-trukk għar-ritratti? Mark: It-trukkatur jasal fid-disgħa. Lara: Tajjeb, inkun lesta sa dak il-ħin.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who will do my makeup for the photos? Mark: The makeup artist arrives at nine. Lara: Good, I'll be ready by then.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁来给我化拍照用的妆？马克：化妆师九点到。拉拉：好的，到时候我会准备好。

messages.speaker: Lara (模特)
messages.zh: 谁来给我化拍照用的妆？
messages.en: Who will do my makeup for the photos?

messages.speaker: Mark (摄影助理)
messages.zh: 化妆师九点到。
messages.en: The makeup artist arrives at nine.

messages.speaker: Lara (模特)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, inkun lesta sa dak il-ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, inkun lesta sa dak il-ħin.
messages.zh: 好的，到时候我会准备好。
messages.en: Good, I'll be ready by then.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词卡配上一位拿着化妆刷的工作人员，提醒自己这里指化妆师这个人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To acquire a stain or become marked by a substance such as ink, food, or drink.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因墨水、食物或饮料等而沾上污渍，变得有污痕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jispiċċa b'tebgħa jew bi tbajja' minn xi sustanza, bħal linka, ikel jew xorb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被染上污渍；沾污。

formal.mt: Id-drapp abjad ttabba' bil-linka waqt li kienu qed jimlew il-pinna.
formal.en: The white fabric got stained with ink while they were filling the pen.
formal.zh: 他们给钢笔灌墨水时，白布沾上了墨水渍。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Għaliex qed taħsel ix-xugaman? Nina: Ttabba' bil-kafè. Toni: Aħslu malajr qabel tinxef it-tebgħa.
colloquial.en: Toni: Why are you washing the towel? Nina: It got stained with coffee. Toni: Wash it quickly before the stain dries.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：你为什么在洗毛巾？妮娜：它沾上咖啡渍了。托尼：趁污渍还没干，赶快洗。

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么在洗毛巾？
messages.en: Why are you washing the towel?

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 它沾上咖啡渍了。
messages.en: It got stained with coffee.

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 趁污渍还没干，赶快洗。
messages.en: Wash it quickly before the stain dries.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象咖啡滴在白毛巾上留下污点，用画面记住物品沾上污渍这一变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become less severe, painful, or difficult.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 疼痛、困难或其他不适的程度降低，得到缓解或减轻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir inqas qawwi, inqas ta' wġigħ jew inqas diffiċli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 得到舒缓；程度减轻。
痛苦、困难或不适等得到缓解。

formal.mt: Il-piż tax-xogħol ttaffa meta t-tim qasam il-kompiti bejn il-membri kollha.
formal.en: The workload was eased when the team divided the tasks among all its members.
formal.zh: 团队把任务分配给所有成员后，工作负担减轻了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek b'uġigħ f'dahrek? Toni: L-uġigħ ttaffa wara ftit mistrieħ. Maja: Tajjeb, ħu ftit ieħor mistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does your back still hurt? Toni: The pain eased after a little rest. Maja: Good, get some more rest.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的背还疼吗？托尼：休息一会儿后，疼痛减轻了。玛雅：那就好，再休息一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的背还疼吗？
messages.en: Does your back still hurt?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 休息一会儿后，疼痛减轻了。
messages.en: The pain eased after a little rest.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那就好，再休息一会儿吧。
messages.en: Good, get some more rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象疼痛刻度从八降到三，记住它表示程度减轻，不一定已经完全消失。

gloss_zh: 变得满是黏土；变得黏土质；表现幼稚

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become full of clay or clayey; also, to behave childishly or act like a little boy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得含有大量黏土或呈黏土质；也指行为变得幼稚，像小男孩一样行事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimtela bit-tafal jew isir tafli; ukoll, iġib ruħu b'mod infantili jew bħal tifel żgħir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得满是黏土；含有大量黏土。
变成黏土质；变得具有黏土的性质。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be childish in one's behaviour
sense_translations.zh_definition: 举止幼稚；行为表现得不成熟。

sense_translations.en_definition: to act like a little boy
sense_translations.zh_definition: 像小男孩一样行事。

collocations.en: the surface of the soil became clayey
collocations.zh: 土壤表层变成了黏土质

collocations.en: acted like a little boy when he lost
collocations.zh: 输了之后像小男孩一样耍性子

formal.mt: Wara li l-ilma ħalla saff ta' tafal fl-għalqa, il-wiċċ tal-ħamrija ttaffal.
formal.en: After the water left a layer of clay in the field, the surface of the soil became clayey.
formal.zh: 水流在田里留下一层黏土后，土壤表层变成了黏土质。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex telaq Mark mil-logħba? Pawlu: Ttaffal meta tilef u ma riedx jilgħab aktar. Sara: Kienet biss logħba!
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Mark leave the game? Pawlu: He acted childishly when he lost and didn't want to play anymore. Sara: It was only a game!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克为什么退出游戏了？保罗：他输了就耍小孩子脾气，不肯再玩了。萨拉：只是一场游戏而已！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么退出游戏了？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave the game?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ttaffal meta tilef u ma riedx jilgħab aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Ttaffal meta tilef u ma riedx jilgħab aktar.
messages.zh: 他输了就耍小孩子脾气，不肯再玩了。
messages.en: He acted childishly when he lost and didn't want to play anymore.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 只是一场游戏而已！
messages.en: It was only a game!

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两张独立词义卡：一张是满含黏土的田地，一张是输了游戏就闹脾气的人；按上下文分别提取词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To measure how long an action or event takes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 测量某个动作或事件持续了多长时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tkejjel kemm iddum azzjoni jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为活动计时；测量完成某事所需的时间。

collocations.en: timed the length of the speech

formal.mt: L-għalliem ttajmja kull preżentazzjoni biex jiżgura li ma taqbiżx il-ħames minuti.
formal.en: The teacher timed each presentation to ensure that it did not exceed five minutes.
formal.zh: 老师为每次报告计时，以确保时长不超过五分钟。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm dam id-diskors ta' Mark? Pawlu: Tliet minuti; jien ttajmjajt id-diskors bit-telefon.
colloquial.en: Lara: How long was Mark's speech? Pawlu: Three minutes; I timed the speech with my phone.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark的发言用了多久？Pawlu：三分钟；我用手机给他的发言计了时。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: Mark的发言用了多久？
messages.en: How long was Mark's speech?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tliet minuti; jien ttajmjajt id-diskors bit-telefon.
messages.mt_standard: Tliet minuti; jien ttajmjajt id-diskors bit-telefon.
messages.zh: 三分钟；我用手机给他的发言计了时。
messages.en: Three minutes; I timed the speech with my phone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象按下手机秒表，活动开始按一下、结束再按一下，用这幅画面记住“计时”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To enter letters, words, or other characters using a keyboard.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用键盘输入字母、词语或其他字符。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tikkomponi kliem jew iddaħħal karattri permezz ta' tastiera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打字；用键盘键入文字。

formal.mt: Is-segretarju ttajpja r-rapport u bagħtu lill-maniġer għall-approvazzjoni.
formal.en: The secretary typed the report and sent it to the manager for approval.
formal.zh: 秘书打好了报告，并将其发给经理审批。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ir-rapport lest? Mark: Iva, ttajpjajt kollox; fadal biss niċċekkja l-ismijiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the report ready? Mark: Yes, I've typed everything; I just need to check the names.
colloquial.zh: Maja：报告准备好了吗？Mark：好了，我已经全部打完了；只剩下核对姓名。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 报告准备好了吗？
messages.en: Is the report ready?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ttajpjajt kollox; fadal biss niċċekkja l-ismijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ttajpjajt kollox; fadal biss niċċekkja l-ismijiet.
messages.zh: 好了，我已经全部打完了；只剩下核对姓名。
messages.en: Yes, I've typed everything; I just need to check the names.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和双手敲键盘的动作绑定：手指每落下一次，屏幕就多出一个字符。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To join or hold fabric with stitches, including temporary tacking stitches.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用针线把布料缝合或固定，也可指用临时针脚疏缝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħaqqad jew iżżomm id-drapp bil-punti tal-ħjata, anki b'punti temporanji.

sense_translations.en_definition: to tack, to stitch, to sew
sense_translations.zh_definition: 疏缝、缝合或缝纫；用针线暂时固定或缝接布料。

collocations.en: stitched two pieces of fabric together

formal.mt: Il-ħajjat ttakka l-keffa b'punti twal qabel il-ħjata finali.
formal.en: The tailor tacked the hem with long stitches before the final sewing.
formal.zh: 裁缝在正式缝制前，先用长针脚疏缝了折边。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-keffa diġà lesta? Rita: Għadha le; s'issa ttakkajt il-keffa biss biex nipprova t-tul.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the hem finished already? Rita: Not yet; so far I've only tacked the hem to check the length.
colloquial.zh: Lara：折边已经缝好了吗？Rita：还没有；目前只是先疏缝一下，试试长度。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 折边已经缝好了吗？
messages.en: Is the hem finished already?

messages.speaker: Rita (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadha le; s'issa ttakkajt il-keffa biss biex nipprova t-tul.
messages.mt_standard: Għadha le; s'issa ttakkajt il-keffa biss biex nipprova t-tul.
messages.zh: 还没有；目前只是先疏缝一下，试试长度。
messages.en: Not yet; so far I've only tacked the hem to check the length.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象针线穿过两层布：大针脚先固定是疏缝，继续把布接起来就是缝合。

gloss_zh: 使帆船换舷；迎风曲折航行

teaching_sense.en_definition: To tack a sailing boat, changing direction to make progress against the wind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 驾驶帆船换舷转向，通过曲折航线向迎风方向前进。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tibdel id-direzzjoni ta' dgħajsa tal-qlugħ biex tavvanza kontra r-riħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使帆船换舷转向；以曲折航线迎风航行。

formal.mt: Il-baħri ttakkeġġja diversi drabi biex id-dgħajsa tavvanza kontra r-riħ.
formal.en: The sailor tacked several times so that the boat could make progress against the wind.
formal.zh: 水手数次换舷，使船能够迎风前进。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark ma baqax sejjer dritt bid-dgħajsa? Pawlu: Għax ir-riħ kien kontra tiegħu; għalhekk ttakkeġġja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why didn't Mark keep sailing straight? Pawlu: Because the wind was against him; that's why he tacked.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark为什么没有一直直线开船？Pawlu：因为是逆风，所以他换舷转向了。

messages.speaker: Maja (帆船学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark ma baqax sejjer dritt bid-dgħajsa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark ma baqax sejjer dritt bid-dgħajsa?
messages.zh: Mark为什么没有一直直线开船？
messages.en: Why didn't Mark keep sailing straight?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (帆船教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ir-riħ kien kontra tiegħu; għalhekk ttakkeġġja.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ir-riħ kien kontra tiegħu; għalhekk ttakkeġġja.
messages.zh: 因为是逆风，所以他换舷转向了。
messages.en: Because the wind was against him; that's why he tacked.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在纸上画帆船沿之字形迎风前进，把每一次折返换舷都与这个词联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To beg for something, usually with a disparaging implication.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向别人乞求或讨要某物，通常含有贬义或不赞同的语气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titlob xi ħaġa bil-ħniena, ġeneralment b'sens dispreġġjattiv.

sense_translations.en_definition: to beg for something (generally used in a pejorative sense)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 乞求或讨要某物，通常用于带贬义的表达。

collocations.zh: 低声下气地求别人帮忙

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, l-awtur saħaq li talab ħlas ġust u ma ttallab ebda favur.
formal.en: In his letter, the author stressed that he had requested fair payment and had not begged for any favour.
formal.zh: 作者在信中强调，他要求的是公平报酬，并没有乞求任何恩惠。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex int irrabjat ma' Mark? Pawlu: Reġa' ttallab il-flus mingħandi, imma għadu ma raddx dawk tal-aħħar darba.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you angry with Mark? Pawlu: He begged me for money again, but he still hasn't paid back what he borrowed last time.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么生Mark的气？Pawlu：他又来向我讨钱，可上次借的钱还没有还。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么生Mark的气？
messages.en: Why are you angry with Mark?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Reġa' ttallab il-flus mingħandi, imma għadu ma raddx dawk tal-aħħar darba.
messages.mt_standard: Reġa' ttallab il-flus mingħandi, imma għadu ma raddx dawk tal-aħħar darba.
messages.zh: 他又来向我讨钱，可上次借的钱还没有还。
messages.en: He begged me for money again, but he still hasn't paid back what he borrowed last time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“伸手讨要、语气不满”的小场景记忆，既记住乞求的动作，也记住常带贬义。

gloss_zh: 怀抱希望；盼望这一行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of hoping that something desired will happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 盼望所期待的事情发生这一行为或心理过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tittama li sseħħ xi ħaġa mixtieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 怀抱希望、盼望这一行为或过程。

formal.mt: It-ttamar għal futur aħjar jista' jħeġġeġ lill-istudenti biex ikomplu jistudjaw.
formal.en: Hoping for a better future can encourage students to continue studying.
formal.zh: 对更好未来的盼望可以鼓励学生继续学习。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-ttamar biss mhux biżżejjed, hux? Mark: Veru, irridu naħdmu wkoll biex naslu fejn nixtiequ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Hoping alone isn't enough, is it? Mark: True, we also need to work to get where we want to be.
colloquial.zh: Lara：光是盼望还不够，对吧？Mark：没错，我们也得努力，才能达到想要的目标。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 光是盼望还不够，对吧？
messages.en: Hoping alone isn't enough, is it?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, irridu naħdmu wkoll biex naslu fejn nixtiequ.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, irridu naħdmu wkoll biex naslu fejn nixtiequ.
messages.zh: 没错，我们也得努力，才能达到想要的目标。
messages.en: True, we also need to work to get where we want to be.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“盼望”装进名词盒子：这里说的是怀抱希望这件事，可以作句子的主语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be fed or given food by someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由别人给予食物；被喂食或得到喂养。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tingħata l-ikel minn xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被喂食；得到食物喂养。

formal.mt: L-għasfur ferut ttamma' bl-idejn sakemm seta' jiekol waħdu.
formal.en: The injured bird was fed by hand until it could eat on its own.
formal.zh: 这只受伤的鸟一直由人用手喂食，直到能够自行进食。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-qattus żgħir kiel illum? Rita: Iva, ttamma' b'ikel artab dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the kitten eaten today? Rita: Yes, it was fed soft food this morning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：小猫今天吃东西了吗？Rita：吃了，今天早上喂过软食了。

messages.speaker: Maja (宠物主人)
messages.zh: 小猫今天吃东西了吗？
messages.en: Has the kitten eaten today?

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 吃了，今天早上喂过软食了。
messages.en: Yes, it was fed soft food this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象食物从照料者手中送到小动物嘴里，把注意力放在接受食物的一方，记住“被喂食”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become curdled, as when milk separates into thicker lumps.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指牛奶等液体凝结，形成凝乳或凝块。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħaqad f'ċapep, bħalma jiġri lill-ħalib meta ma jibqax likwidu lixx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凝结；结成凝乳或凝块。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, il-ħalib ttammas u dehru fih ċapep żgħar.
formal.en: During the observation, the milk curdled and small lumps appeared in it.
formal.zh: 观察过程中，牛奶凝结了，里面出现了小凝块。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħalib għadu lixx? Mark: Le, ttammas; ara ċ-ċapep fih.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the milk still smooth? Mark: No, it has curdled; look at the lumps in it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：牛奶还是均匀顺滑的吗？马克：不是，已经凝结了；你看里面的凝块。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 牛奶还是均匀顺滑的吗？
messages.en: Is the milk still smooth?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 不是，已经凝结了；你看里面的凝块。
messages.en: No, it has curdled; look at the lumps in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ttammas 配上一杯出现小凝块的牛奶来记：原本均匀的液体变成一团团凝乳，重点是“发生凝结”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be beaten or struck, specifically said of a drum.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指鼓受到敲击而被敲响，描述鼓所承受的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jindaqq bid-daqqiet; jingħad dwar tanbur.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be beaten (used of a drum)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被敲击；被敲响，专用于鼓。

collocations.en: was beaten in a steady rhythm

formal.mt: Matul iċ-ċerimonja, it-tanbur ttanbar b'ritmu regolari.
formal.en: During the ceremony, the drum was beaten in a steady rhythm.
formal.zh: 仪式期间，鼓被有规律地敲响。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'kien dak il-ħoss? Pawlu: It-tanbur ttanbar darbtejn.
colloquial.en: Rita: What was that sound? Pawlu: The drum was struck twice.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：刚才是什么声音？保罗：鼓被敲了两下。

messages.speaker: Rita (观众)
messages.zh: 刚才是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that sound?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (观众)
messages.zh: 鼓被敲了两下。
messages.en: The drum was struck twice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象镜头只对着一面鼓，鼓面随着敲击振动：ttanbar 的记忆重点是“鼓被敲响”，句子的主角是鼓。

gloss_zh: 尝试；使烦恼；向某人示爱或调情；诱惑

teaching_sense.en_definition: To try or attempt something; in other contexts, to vex someone, make a romantic or sexual advance, or tempt someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尝试做某事；也可表示使人烦恼、向人示爱或调情，以及诱惑某人，具体含义由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel tentattiv; f'kuntesti oħra, idejjaq lil xi ħadd, jagħmel avvanz romantiku jew sesswali, jew iħajjar lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尝试；试图做某事。
使烦恼；惹恼；使人感到困扰。
向某人示爱或调情；作出带有恋爱或性意味的主动表示。
诱惑；引诱或使某人心动而想做某事。

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur ttanta jsib soluzzjoni oħra għall-problema.
formal.en: The researcher attempted to find another solution to the problem.
formal.zh: 研究人员尝试为这个问题寻找另一种解决办法。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark irnexxielu jiftaħ il-bieb? Anna: Ttanta, imma l-bieb baqa' magħluq.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Mark manage to open the door? Anna: He tried, but the door stayed shut.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克成功把门打开了吗？安娜：他试过了，但门还是关着。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克成功把门打开了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark manage to open the door?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 他试过了，但门还是关着。
messages.en: He tried, but the door stayed shut.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四张情景卡记 ttanta：试着开门、惹人心烦、主动调情、受到诱惑。每次先看上下文，再选择对应义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cover a wall or the walls of a room with wallpaper.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给墙面或房间的墙壁贴上壁纸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiksi ħajt jew il-ħitan ta' kamra bil-karta tal-ħajt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给墙面贴壁纸；用墙纸覆盖或装饰。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ttapezza l-ħitan tal-kamra b'karta b'disinn sempliċi.
formal.en: The worker covered the room's walls with wallpaper featuring a simple design.
formal.zh: 工人给房间的墙壁贴上了图案简洁的壁纸。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ttapezza din il-kamra? Mark: Missieri; għażel il-karta hu wkoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who wallpapered this room? Mark: My father; he chose the wallpaper too.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个房间是谁贴的壁纸？马克：我爸爸；壁纸也是他选的。

messages.speaker: Maja (来访的朋友)
messages.zh: 这个房间是谁贴的壁纸？
messages.en: Who wallpapered this room?

messages.speaker: Mark (房主)
messages.zh: 我爸爸；壁纸也是他选的。
messages.en: My father; he chose the wallpaper too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ttapezza 和装修画面绑定：展开一卷有图案的壁纸，从墙角开始贴满墙面，看到这个动作就回想“贴壁纸”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To mist over or become less transparent, so that it is harder to see through a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指表面蒙上雾气，或原本透明的物体失去透明度，变得难以看清。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinkesa biċ-ċpar jew jitlef it-trasparenza, u ma tibqax tara ċar minn ġo fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蒙上雾气；因起雾而变得模糊。
失去透明度；变得不再清透。

collocations.en: the mirror misted over with steam
collocations.zh: 镜子因水蒸气而蒙上雾气

formal.mt: Il-ħġieġ tat-tieqa ttappan bil-fwar, u l-veduta ta' barra ma baqgħetx ċara.
formal.en: The window glass misted over with steam, and the view outside was no longer clear.
formal.zh: 窗玻璃因水蒸气而蒙上雾气，外面的景色也看不清了。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex ma nistax nara barra? Pawlu: Il-ħġieġ ttappan; imsaħ parti minnu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why can't I see outside? Pawlu: The glass has misted over; wipe part of it.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：为什么我看不清外面？保罗：玻璃起雾了；擦一下其中一块吧。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 为什么我看不清外面？
messages.en: Why can't I see outside?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 玻璃起雾了；擦一下其中一块吧。
messages.en: The glass has misted over; wipe part of it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象洗澡后镜子蒙上一层白雾：ttappan 表示从清透变模糊。再把画面扩展到失去透明度的玻璃，覆盖两个义项。

gloss_zh: 被刺穿；被打孔；接受针头注射；注射毒品

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be pierced or perforated; also, to be given an injection with a hypodermic needle or to inject drugs, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被刺穿或被打孔；也可指接受皮下注射针头的注射，或注射毒品，须依据语境区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir fih toqba jew toqob; dwar persuna, jingħata injezzjoni b'labra ipodermika jew jinjetta d-droga, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被刺穿；被尖物穿透。
被打孔；被穿出孔洞。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be injected with a hypodermic needle
sense_translations.zh_definition: 接受皮下注射针头的注射。
注射毒品；以注射方式吸毒。

formal.mt: Waqt it-trasport, il-kartun ttaqqab b'musmar u saritlu toqba żgħira.
formal.en: During transport, the cardboard was pierced by a nail, leaving a small hole.
formal.zh: 运输过程中，硬纸板被钉子刺穿，留下了一个小孔。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hemm toqba fil-kartun? Mark: Ttaqqab b'musmar meta ċaqlaqna l-kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is there a hole in the cardboard? Mark: It was pierced by a nail when we moved the box.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：硬纸板上怎么有个洞？马克：我们搬箱子时，它被钉子刺穿了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 硬纸板上怎么有个洞？
messages.en: Why is there a hole in the cardboard?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 我们搬箱子时，它被钉子刺穿了。
messages.en: It was pierced by a nail when we moved the box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ttaqqab 画四格学习卡：钉子刺穿、纸板打孔、接受针头注射、注射毒品。用完整场景区分，不能只凭这个词判断具体行为。

gloss_zh: 被加重；变得更重；怀孕（仅用于女性）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made heavier; when referring to a female, also to become pregnant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被增加重量而变得更重；用于女性时，也可表示怀孕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir itqal minħabba piż miżjud; meta jirreferi għal mara, jista' jfisser ukoll li toħroġ tqila.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被加重；因增加重量而变得更重。
怀孕；仅用于女性。

collocations.en: was made heavier by the load

formal.mt: Il-karrettun ttaqqal meta żdiedu żewġ kaxxi oħra mat-tagħbija.
formal.en: The cart was made heavier when two more boxes were added to the load.
formal.zh: 装载的货物增加了两个箱子后，手推车变得更重了。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex il-karrettun sar daqshekk tqil? Pawlu: Ttaqqal għax żidna żewġ kaxxi oħra.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why has the cart become so heavy? Pawlu: It became heavier because we added two more boxes.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：手推车怎么变得这么重了？保罗：因为我们又加了两个箱子，重量增加了。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 手推车怎么变得这么重了？
messages.en: Why has the cart become so heavy?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ttaqqal għax żidna żewġ kaxxi oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Ttaqqal għax żidna żewġ kaxxi oħra.
messages.zh: 因为我们又加了两个箱子，重量增加了。
messages.en: It became heavier because we added two more boxes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张独立图片记 ttaqqal：加上箱子的手推车对应“被加重”，孕妇对应女性专用的“怀孕”义；这是情景助记，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become affected with dropsy, a condition involving swelling from accumulated fluid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 患上水肿或浮肿病，身体因液体积聚而出现肿胀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimrad b'nefħa fil-ġisem ikkawżata minn ġbir ta' ilma fit-tessuti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 患水肿；患浮肿病。

collocations.en: developed dropsy and his feet swelled
collocations.zh: 患了水肿，双脚肿了起来

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel ttarbaċ u kellu nefħa kbira f'saqajh.
formal.en: In the story, the man developed dropsy and had severe swelling in his feet.
formal.zh: 故事中，那名男子患了水肿，双脚肿得很厉害。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara lir-raġel fir-rakkont? Rita: Ttarbaċ; it-test jgħid li nefħulu saqajh.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to the man in the story? Rita: He developed dropsy; the text says his feet swelled.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：故事里的那个男子怎么了？丽塔：他患了水肿；文中说他的双脚肿了起来。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 故事里的那个男子怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the man in the story?

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ttarbaċ; it-test jgħid li nefħulu saqajh.
messages.mt_standard: Ttarbaċ; it-test jgħid li nefħulu saqajh.
messages.zh: 他患了水肿；文中说他的双脚肿了起来。
messages.en: He developed dropsy; the text says his feet swelled.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ttarbaċ 放进阅读情景中记忆：故事人物双脚明显肿胀，旁边写上“患水肿”。用这一画面联结词义，不拆字猜词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To delay or postpone something, or to arrive later than the agreed or expected time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某事推迟到较晚的时间；也指比约定或预期的时间晚到。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tipposponi xi ħaġa għal aktar tard, jew li tasal wara l-ħin miftiehem jew mistenni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 延迟；推迟某事的进行或发生。
迟到；比约定或预期的时间晚到。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ttardja d-deċiżjoni finali biex ikollu aktar ħin jeżamina d-dokumenti.
formal.en: The committee postponed the final decision to have more time to examine the documents.
formal.zh: 委员会推迟了最终决定，以便有更多时间审阅文件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex wasalt daqshekk tard? Mark: Il-karozza tal-linja ttardjat, u kelli nistenna ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you arrive so late? Mark: The bus was late, and I had to wait a long time.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么这么晚才到？Mark：公交车晚点了，我等了很久。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么这么晚才到？
messages.en: Why did you arrive so late?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-karozza tal-linja ttardjat, u kelli nistenna ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Il-karozza tal-linja ttardjat, u kelli nistenna ħafna.
messages.zh: 公交车晚点了，我等了很久。
messages.en: The bus was late, and I had to wait a long time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把日程上的时间箭头往后挪：事情往后挪是“推迟”，人或车晚到是“迟到、晚点”。用同一幅时间图记住 ttardja 的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cover a road or another surface with tarmac.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在道路或其他地面上铺设柏油，使其形成铺装路面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tiksi triq jew wiċċ ieħor b'saff ta' asfalt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铺柏油；在道路或其他地面上铺设柏油层。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill ttarmakja t-triq wara li tlestew ix-xogħlijiet fuq il-pajpijiet tal-ilma.
formal.en: The council tarmacked the road after the work on the water pipes was completed.
formal.zh: 供水管道工程完工后，地方议会给道路铺设了柏油。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-kunsill ttarmakja t-triq tagħna lbieraħ. Pawlu: Tajjeb! Issa jkun aktar komdu li nsuqu minn hemm.
colloquial.en: Lara: The council tarmacked our road yesterday. Pawlu: Great! Driving along there will be more comfortable now.
colloquial.zh: Lara：地方议会昨天给我们这条路铺了柏油。Pawlu：太好了！现在开车经过那里会舒服些。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 地方议会昨天给我们这条路铺了柏油。
messages.en: The council tarmacked our road yesterday.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb! Issa jkun aktar komdu li nsuqu minn hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb! Issa jkun aktar komdu li nsuqu minn hemm.
messages.zh: 太好了！现在开车经过那里会舒服些。
messages.en: Great! Driving along there will be more comfortable now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ttarmakja 配上一幅施工画面：工人给道路或停车场铺上一层柏油。记住这个词表示“铺柏油”的动作，再分别搭配道路和停车场练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become softer and easier to cut or chew, especially through cooking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得柔软、容易切开或咀嚼，尤其指食物经过烹煮后变嫩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aktar artab u aktar faċli biex jinqata' jew jintmagħad, speċjalment bit-tisjir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变嫩；变软。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isir artab.

formal.mt: Il-laħam ttarra wara sagħtejn ta' tisjir fuq nar baxx.
formal.en: The meat became tender after two hours of cooking over low heat.
formal.zh: 肉用小火煮了两个小时后变嫩了。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-laħam għadu iebes? Pawlu: Le, ttarra. Trid idduqu?
colloquial.en: Marija: Is the meat still tough? Pawlu: No, it has become tender. Would you like to taste it?
colloquial.zh: Marija：肉还硬吗？Pawlu：不硬了，已经变嫩了。你想尝尝吗？

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 肉还硬吗？
messages.en: Is the meat still tough?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 不硬了，已经变嫩了。你想尝尝吗？
messages.en: No, it has become tender. Would you like to taste it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ttarra 配上慢炖的画面：原本难嚼的肉，煮好后用叉子就能轻松分开，帮助记住“变嫩”这一变化。

gloss_zh: 被流放；身处边缘附近；被暗示或泄露

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be forced to leave one's own country and live elsewhere.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被迫离开自己的国家，到其他地方生活，即被流放。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun imġiegħel jitlaq minn pajjiżu u jgħix f'pajjiż ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被流放；被迫离开自己的国家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikun imġiegħel jitlaq minn pajjiżu u jgħix barra minnu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to find oneself near an edge
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发现自己身处边缘附近；来到靠近边缘的位置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isib ruħu qrib xi xifer.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be hinted at or divulged
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被含蓄地提及或暗示；被透露或泄露。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jissemma b'mod indirett jew jinkixef.

formal.mt: Il-kittieb ttarraf minn pajjiżu minħabba l-fehmiet politiċi tiegħu.
formal.en: The writer was exiled from his country because of his political views.
formal.zh: 这位作家因其政治观点而被流放到国外。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif sar magħruf is-sigriet? Pawlu: Ttarraf waqt il-laqgħa tal-bieraħ.
colloquial.en: Marija: How did the secret become known? Pawlu: It was divulged during yesterday's meeting.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这个秘密是怎么传出去的？Pawlu：昨天开会时被透露了。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 这个秘密是怎么传出去的？
messages.en: How did the secret become known?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 昨天开会时被透露了。
messages.en: It was divulged during yesterday's meeting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ttarraf 配三张学习卡：被迫离乡的人、站在边缘附近的人、被透露的秘密。分别记住三个义项，再靠句中主语和语境判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lose the ability to hear and become deaf.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 失去听觉能力，变成耳聋的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef il-ħila li jisma' u jsir trux.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变聋，失去听力。

formal.mt: Wara li ttarrax, ir-raġel beda juża l-kitba biex jikkomunika waqt il-laqgħat.
formal.en: After he became deaf, the man began using writing to communicate during meetings.
formal.zh: 失去听力后，这名男子开始在会议期间通过书写交流。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tikteb il-mistoqsija għan-nannu? Mark: In-nannu ttarrax, u jippreferi jaqra l-mistoqsijiet. Lara: Mela nikteb tiegħi wkoll.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you writing down the question for Grandpa? Mark: Grandpa has become deaf, and he prefers to read the questions. Lara: Then I'll write mine down too.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么把问题写下来给爷爷看？Mark：爷爷失去了听力，他更喜欢读写下来的问题。Lara：那我也把自己的问题写下来。

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.zh: 你为什么把问题写下来给爷爷看？
messages.en: Why are you writing down the question for Grandpa?

messages.speaker: Mark (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nannu ttarrax, u jippreferi jaqra l-mistoqsijiet.
messages.mt_standard: In-nannu ttarrax, u jippreferi jaqra l-mistoqsijiet.
messages.zh: 爷爷失去了听力，他更喜欢读写下来的问题。
messages.en: Grandpa has become deaf, and he prefers to read the questions.

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.zh: 那我也把自己的问题写下来。
messages.en: Then I'll write mine down too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ttarrax 时，想象对话从听声音转为看文字：重点记住“失去听力、变聋”这一状态变化，再用“一耳失聪”和“完全失聪”两个搭配巩固。

gloss_zh: 分成阶梯；变成梯田状；形成渐变层次

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become arranged in steps or terraces, or to develop a series of gradual levels.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变成阶梯状或梯田状，或形成逐级变化的层次。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqasam f'livelli bħal taraġ, jieħu l-għamla ta' għelieqi mtarrġin, jew jiżviluppa gradi li jinbidlu ftit ftit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被分成一个个台阶或阶梯式的层级。
变成梯田状，形成沿坡分布的层层平台。
形成逐级变化的层次或渐变。

collocations.en: became arranged in several stepped levels
formed gradations from light to dark
collocations.zh: 形成由浅到深的渐变层次

formal.mt: Il-ġnien ttarraġ f'diversi livelli, u kull livell tħawwel b'tip differenti ta' pjanti.
formal.en: The garden became terraced on several levels, and each level was planted with a different type of plant.
formal.zh: 花园形成了多个梯田式平台，每一层都种上了不同种类的植物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-ġnien jidher bħal taraġ? Pawlu: Għax ttarraġ meta għamlu x-xogħol fih. Maja: Issa nistgħu nħawlu l-ħxejjex f'kull livell.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does the garden look like a staircase? Pawlu: Because it became terraced when they did the work on it. Maja: Now we can plant vegetables on each level.
colloquial.zh: Maja：花园为什么看起来像楼梯？Pawlu：因为施工时把它修成了层层平台。Maja：现在我们可以在每一层种蔬菜了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 花园为什么看起来像楼梯？
messages.en: Why does the garden look like a staircase?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (花园主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ttarraġ meta għamlu x-xogħol fih.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ttarraġ meta għamlu x-xogħol fih.
messages.zh: 因为施工时把它修成了层层平台。
messages.en: Because it became terraced when they did the work on it.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa nistgħu nħawlu l-ħxejjex f'kull livell.
messages.mt_standard: Issa nistgħu nħawlu l-ħxejjex f'kull livell.
messages.zh: 现在我们可以在每一层种蔬菜了。
messages.en: Now we can plant vegetables on each level.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ttarraġ 配上一幅层层上升的图：近看是台阶，远看是梯田，换成色块就是渐变；用同一个“逐层变化”的画面串起三个义项。

gloss_zh: 呈现杂色；形成斑驳色彩

teaching_sense.en_definition: To show patches or streaks of different colours.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈现不同颜色的斑块或条纹，具有杂色、斑驳的外观。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu rqajja' jew strixxi ta' kuluri differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呈现杂色，带有不同颜色的斑块或条纹。

collocations.en: to be variegated with different colours
collocations.zh: 呈现不同颜色交错的杂色

formal.mt: F'deskrizzjoni ta' drapp, il-verb 'ttarraż' jindika li d-drapp għandu rqajja' jew strixxi ta' kuluri differenti.
formal.en: In a description of fabric, the verb 'ttarraż' indicates that the fabric has patches or streaks of different colours.
formal.zh: 在描述布料时，动词“ttarraż”表示布料带有不同颜色的斑块或条纹。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'ttarraż'? Mark: Ifisser li jkollu rqajja' jew strixxi ta' kuluri differenti. Maja: Bħal dan id-drapp bil-blu u l-aħdar? Mark: Iva, eżatt!
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'ttarraż' mean? Mark: It means to have patches or streaks of different colours. Maja: Like this fabric with blue and green? Mark: Yes, exactly!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：ttarraż是什么意思？马克：就是带有不同颜色的斑块或条纹。玛雅：像这块蓝绿相间的布料吗？马克：对，就是这样！

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: ttarraż是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ttarraż' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li jkollu rqajja' jew strixxi ta' kuluri differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li jkollu rqajja' jew strixxi ta' kuluri differenti.
messages.zh: 就是带有不同颜色的斑块或条纹。
messages.en: It means to have patches or streaks of different colours.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Bħal dan id-drapp bil-blu u l-aħdar?
messages.mt_standard: Bħal dan id-drapp bil-blu u l-aħdar?
messages.zh: 像这块蓝绿相间的布料吗？
messages.en: Like this fabric with blue and green?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 对，就是这样！
messages.en: Yes, exactly!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ttarraż和一块蓝绿相间的花布联系起来：目光从一块颜色移到另一块颜色，记住它表示“呈现杂色、色彩斑驳”。这是画面联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cut or shape an edge at a sloping angle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把材料的边缘切削或加工成倾斜的面，即进行倒角处理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taqta' jew taħdem tarf ta' materjal biex tagħmlu mmejjel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将材料的边缘加工成斜面；给边缘倒角。

collocations.en: to bevel the edge of the wood
to bevel the edges of the metal
collocations.zh: 将金属的边缘加工成斜面

formal.mt: Fl-istruzzjonijiet tax-xogħol, il-verb 'ttastatura' jfisser li t-tarf tal-materjal għandu jinħadem biex jifforma wiċċ immejjel.
formal.en: In the work instructions, the verb 'ttastatura' means that the material's edge is to be shaped to form a sloping surface.
formal.zh: 在作业说明中，动词“ttastatura”表示需要把材料的边缘加工成斜面。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'ttastatura' f'dawn l-istruzzjonijiet? Pawlu: Ifisser li taħdem it-tarf biex tagħmlu mmejjel. Lara: Mela rrid nagħmel wiċċ żgħir immejjel tul it-tarf? Pawlu: Iva, eżatt.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'ttastatura' mean in these instructions? Pawlu: It means to shape the edge so that it slopes. Lara: So I need to make a small sloping surface along the edge? Pawlu: Yes, exactly.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这些说明里的ttastatura是什么意思？保罗：就是把边缘加工成斜面。拉拉：也就是说，我要沿着边缘做出一个小斜面？保罗：对，就是这样。

messages.speaker: Lara (学徒)
messages.zh: 这些说明里的ttastatura是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ttastatura' mean in these instructions?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (木工师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li taħdem it-tarf biex tagħmlu mmejjel.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li taħdem it-tarf biex tagħmlu mmejjel.
messages.zh: 就是把边缘加工成斜面。
messages.en: It means to shape the edge so that it slopes.

messages.speaker: Lara (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela rrid nagħmel wiċċ żgħir immejjel tul it-tarf?
messages.mt_standard: Mela rrid nagħmel wiċċ żgħir immejjel tul it-tarf?
messages.zh: 也就是说，我要沿着边缘做出一个小斜面？
messages.en: So I need to make a small sloping surface along the edge?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (木工师傅)
messages.zh: 对，就是这样。
messages.en: Yes, exactly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ttastatura和木板边缘的小斜面联系起来：想象沿着直角边削去一条材料，留下平整斜面，就能记住“倒角、加工斜边”这一动作。这是操作画面联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To touch or feel something with the hand to discover its texture or condition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用手接触或摸索某物，以感受它的质地或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imiss xi ħaġa bl-id biex iħoss in-nisġa jew il-kundizzjoni tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 触摸；用手感受某物。

collocations.en: feel the surface of the wood

formal.mt: Il-ħajjat ttastja d-drapp biex jivverifika kemm kien artab qabel ma beda jaqta'.
formal.en: The tailor felt the fabric to check how soft it was before he began cutting.
formal.zh: 裁缝在开始裁剪之前，先摸了摸布料，检查它有多柔软。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif indunajt li dan id-drapp hu artab? Mark: Pawlu ttastja d-drapp u qalli kemm hu artab.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you find out that this fabric is soft? Mark: Pawlu felt the fabric and told me how soft it is.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么知道这块布很柔软？Mark：Pawlu摸了摸这块布，告诉我它很柔软。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif indunajt li dan id-drapp hu artab?
messages.mt_standard: Kif indunajt li dan id-drapp hu artab?
messages.zh: 你怎么知道这块布很柔软？
messages.en: How did you find out that this fabric is soft?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu ttastja d-drapp u qalli kemm hu artab.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu ttastja d-drapp u qalli kemm hu artab.
messages.zh: Pawlu摸了摸这块布，告诉我它很柔软。
messages.en: Pawlu felt the fabric and told me how soft it is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象买布时先伸手摸摸软硬：把 ttastja 和指尖接触布料的动作一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a lasting design on someone's skin by putting ink into it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将墨色刺入皮肤，在皮肤上制作持久的文字或图案。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel disinn permanenti fuq il-ġilda billi jdaħħal il-linka fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 文身；把文字或图案刺在皮肤上。

collocations.en: tattoo a flower on an arm
tattoo a name on a wrist

formal.mt: Luca ttattwa fjura fuq id-driegħ tal-klijent skont id-disinn approvat.
formal.en: Luca tattooed a flower on the client's arm according to the approved design.
formal.zh: Luca按照已获认可的设计，在顾客的手臂上文了一朵花。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min għamillek dik il-fjura fuq id-driegħ? Mark: Luca ttattwa l-fjura lbieraħ. Jien għażilt id-disinn.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who did that flower on your arm? Mark: Luca tattooed the flower yesterday. I chose the design.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你手臂上的那朵花是谁文的？Mark：Luca昨天文的，图案是我选的。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min għamillek dik il-fjura fuq id-driegħ?
messages.mt_standard: Min għamillek dik il-fjura fuq id-driegħ?
messages.zh: 你手臂上的那朵花是谁文的？
messages.en: Who did that flower on your arm?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Luca ttattwa l-fjura lbieraħ. Jien għażilt id-disinn.
messages.mt_standard: Luca ttattwa l-fjura lbieraħ. Jien għażilt id-disinn.
messages.zh: Luca昨天文的，图案是我选的。
messages.en: Luca tattooed the flower yesterday. I chose the design.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ttattwa 配上一幅手臂花朵图：记住这是把图案文在皮肤上的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cover a surface with wooden boards or close an opening by fixing boards across it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在表面铺设木板，或用固定的木板封住门窗等开口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħatti wiċċ bit-twavel jew jagħlaq fetħa billi jwaħħal twavel fuqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铺上木板；用木板封闭或封住。

formal.mt: Mario ttavla t-tieqa miksura biex jagħlaq il-fetħa sakemm jasal il-ħġieġ il-ġdid.
formal.en: Mario boarded up the broken window to close the opening until the new glass arrived.
formal.zh: Mario用木板封住了破损的窗户，暂时堵住开口，等待新玻璃送到。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex hemm it-twavel fuq it-tieqa? Pawlu: Mario ttavla t-tieqa dalgħodu għax il-ħġieġ kien miksur.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why are there boards over the window? Pawlu: Mario boarded up the window this morning because the glass was broken.
colloquial.zh: Anna：窗户上为什么有木板？Pawlu：玻璃破了，Mario今天早上用木板把窗户封住了。

messages.speaker: Anna (住户)
messages.zh: 窗户上为什么有木板？
messages.en: Why are there boards over the window?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Mario ttavla t-tieqa dalgħodu għax il-ħġieġ kien miksur.
messages.mt_standard: Mario ttavla t-tieqa dalgħodu għax il-ħġieġ kien miksur.
messages.zh: 玻璃破了，Mario今天早上用木板把窗户封住了。
messages.en: Mario boarded up the window this morning because the glass was broken.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一块块木板铺满地面或封住窗洞，用这两个画面记住 ttavla 的共同动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become full of clumps of earth, leaving the ground or soil uneven and lumpy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 土地或土壤变得满是成团的土块，表面呈现不平整的块状。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimtela b'ċapep tal-ħamrija, b'tali mod li l-wiċċ ma jibqax lixx.

sense_translations.en_definition: to become full of clumps of earth
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得满是土块；土壤中形成许多成团的泥土。

collocations.en: land that has become full of earth clumps
become full of earth clumps after ploughing

formal.mt: Wara l-ħrit, ir-raba' ttawwab u fuq il-wiċċ baqgħu ħafna ċapep tal-ħamrija.
