formal.en: After ploughing, the land became full of earth clumps, and many clods remained on the surface.
formal.zh: 耕作之后，田地变得满是土块，表面留下了许多土疙瘩。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-wiċċ tar-raba' mhux lixx? Pawlu: Ir-raba' ttawwab. Ara kemm hemm ċapep tal-ħamrija!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why isn't the surface of the field smooth? Pawlu: The land has become full of earth clumps. Look how many clods there are!
colloquial.zh: Maja：田地表面怎么不平整？Pawlu：地里变得满是土块了。你看有多少土疙瘩！

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 田地表面怎么不平整？
messages.en: Why isn't the surface of the field smooth?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-raba' ttawwab. Ara kemm hemm ċapep tal-ħamrija!
messages.mt_standard: Ir-raba' ttawwab. Ara kemm hemm ċapep tal-ħamrija!
messages.zh: 地里变得满是土块了。你看有多少土疙瘩！
messages.en: The land has become full of earth clumps. Look how many clods there are!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ttawwab 配上耕后田地的画面：脚下到处是土疙瘩，重点记住变得满是土块。

gloss_zh: 被加长；被加高；探头向外看

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made longer or taller; also, to look out through a window or over an edge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被延长或加高；也指从窗户向外看，或探头越过边缘查看。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir itwal jew ogħla; ukoll, iħares minn tieqa jew minn fuq xifer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被加长；长度得到延伸。
被加高；高度得到增加。

sense_translations.en_definition: to look out of a window or over an edge
sense_translations.zh_definition: 从窗户向外看；探头越过边缘查看。

collocations.en: a cable that was lengthened by one metre
a wall that was made two courses higher

formal.mt: Fir-rapport ġie rreġistrat li l-kejbil it tawwal b'metru u li l-ħajt it tawwal b'żewġ filati.
formal.en: The report recorded that the cable was lengthened by one metre and the wall was made two courses higher.
formal.zh: 报告记载，电缆被加长了一米，墙体被加高了两层砌块。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu Luca? Mark: Għadu kif ttawwal mit-tieqa biex jara min wasal.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Luca? Mark: He has just looked out of the window to see who arrived.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Luca在哪儿？Mark：他刚从窗户探头往外看，想看看谁来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Luca在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is Luca?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu kif ttawwal mit-tieqa biex jara min wasal.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu kif ttawwal mit-tieqa biex jara min wasal.
messages.zh: 他刚从窗户探头往外看，想看看谁来了。
messages.en: He has just looked out of the window to see who arrived.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面记 ttawwal：电缆加长、墙体加高、人在窗边探头；分别对应三个义项。

gloss_zh: 大摇大摆；像孔雀般炫耀

teaching_sense.en_definition: To walk or behave with exaggerated pride, showing off like a peacock.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以夸张而得意的姿态走路或表现自己，像孔雀展示自己一样炫耀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimxi jew iġib ruħu b'kburija żejda, u jiddandan bħal pagun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大摇大摆地走；以得意、炫耀的姿态行走。
像孔雀一样炫耀自己；摆出自鸣得意的姿态。

collocations.en: swagger in front of the crowd
show off in a new jacket
collocations.zh: 穿着新夹克得意地炫耀

formal.mt: Wara r-rebħa, Luca ttawwas quddiem il-folla u wera l-midalja tiegħu lil kulħadd.
formal.en: After the victory, Luca swaggered in front of the crowd and showed his medal to everyone.
formal.zh: 获胜后，Luca在众人面前大摇大摆，向所有人展示他的奖牌。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Rajt kif Pawlu daħal bil-ġakketta l-ġdida? Maja: Iva, ttawwas quddiem kulħadd bħal pagun!
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you see how Pawlu walked in wearing his new jacket? Maja: Yes, he showed off in front of everyone like a peacock!
colloquial.zh: Sara：你看到Pawlu穿着新夹克进来时的样子了吗？Maja：看到了，他在大家面前像孔雀一样炫耀！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt kif Pawlu daħal bil-ġakketta l-ġdida?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt kif Pawlu daħal bil-ġakketta l-ġdida?
messages.zh: 你看到Pawlu穿着新夹克进来时的样子了吗？
messages.en: Did you see how Pawlu walked in wearing his new jacket?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ttawwas quddiem kulħadd bħal pagun!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ttawwas quddiem kulħadd bħal pagun!
messages.zh: 看到了，他在大家面前像孔雀一样炫耀！
messages.en: Yes, he showed off in front of everyone like a peacock!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人穿着新衣服，像开屏孔雀般得意走动；用这个姿态记住 ttawwas。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be humbled or moved to a lower position or rank.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到挫折而降低自负，或被调到较低的职位或级别。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Issir aktar umli jew titniżżel għal kariga jew grad aktar baxx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到挫抑；因经历挫折而变得谦卑。
被降职；被降低职级。

collocations.en: was demoted to a lower rank

formal.mt: Wara l-investigazzjoni, l-uffiċjal ttaħħat għal grad aktar baxx.
formal.en: After the investigation, the officer was demoted to a lower rank.
formal.zh: 调查结束后，这名官员被降低了职级。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark għadu jiftaħar li dejjem jirbaħ? Sara: Le, wara t-telfa tal-bieraħ ttaħħat ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does Mark still boast that he always wins? Sara: No, yesterday's defeat humbled him a little.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark还在吹嘘自己总是赢吗？Sara：没有，昨天输了以后，他收敛了一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark għadu jiftaħar li dejjem jirbaħ?
messages.mt_standard: Mark għadu jiftaħar li dejjem jirbaħ?
messages.zh: Mark还在吹嘘自己总是赢吗？
messages.en: Does Mark still boast that he always wins?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, wara t-telfa tal-bieraħ ttaħħat ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Le, wara t-telfa tal-bieraħ ttaħħat ftit.
messages.zh: 没有，昨天输了以后，他收敛了一点。
messages.en: No, yesterday's defeat humbled him a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上一支向下的箭头：心气降低是受到挫抑，职位降低就是被降职。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be divided into two halves of equal size or amount.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被分成大小或数量相等的两个部分，即均分为两半。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqasam f'żewġ nofsijiet indaqs fid-daqs jew fil-kwantità.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be divided into two equal halves
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被均分成相等的两半。

collocations.en: be divided into two equal halves
bread that was divided into equal halves

formal.mt: Għat-tqassim bejn iż-żewġ parteċipanti, il-ħobż ittebbaq f'żewġ nofsijiet indaqs.
formal.en: For distribution between the two participants, the bread was divided into two equal halves.
formal.zh: 为了分给两名参与者，面包被均分成了相等的两半。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandna biżżejjed ħobż għalina t-tnejn? Mark: Iva, il-ħobż ittebbaq f'żewġ nofsijiet indaqs, wieħed għal kull wieħed minna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do we have enough bread for both of us? Mark: Yes, the bread was divided into two equal halves, one for each of us.
colloquial.zh: Maja：面包够我们两个人吃吗？Mark：够，面包已经均分成两半了，我们一人一半。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 面包够我们两个人吃吗？
messages.en: Do we have enough bread for both of us?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-ħobż ittebbaq f'żewġ nofsijiet indaqs, wieħed għal kull wieħed minna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-ħobż ittebbaq f'żewġ nofsijiet indaqs, wieħed għal kull wieħed minna.
messages.zh: 够，面包已经均分成两半了，我们一人一半。
messages.en: Yes, the bread was divided into two equal halves, one for each of us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ttebbaq 和一块面包均分两半的画面绑定：不仅分成两份，而且两份一样大。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be touched, felt, or manipulated using the fingers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被人用手指接触、摸弄或摆弄，强调手指对物体的操作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintmess jew jiġi mmaniġġjat bis-swaba'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被用手指摸弄、摆弄或操作。

collocations.en: fabric that was handled with the fingers
collocations.zh: 被用手指摸弄过的布料

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżami, il-kampjun tad-drapp itteftef bis-swaba' biex tiġi vverifikata n-nisġa tiegħu.
formal.en: During the examination, the fabric sample was handled with the fingers to check its texture.
formal.zh: 检查时，布料样品被用手指摸弄，以确认它的质地。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex dan id-drapp hu daqshekk imkemmex? Mark: Għax itteftef ħafna bis-swaba' waqt li konna nagħżlu l-kulur.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is this fabric so creased? Mark: Because it was handled a lot with the fingers while we were choosing the colour.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这块布怎么这么皱？Mark：因为我们选颜色的时候，用手指反复摆弄过它。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan id-drapp hu daqshekk imkemmex?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan id-drapp hu daqshekk imkemmex?
messages.zh: 这块布怎么这么皱？
messages.en: Why is this fabric so creased?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax itteftef ħafna bis-swaba' waqt li konna nagħżlu l-kulur.
messages.mt_standard: Għax itteftef ħafna bis-swaba' waqt li konna nagħżlu l-kulur.
messages.zh: 因为我们选颜色的时候，用手指反复摆弄过它。
messages.en: Because it was handled a lot with the fingers while we were choosing the colour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一小块布被夹在指尖之间摸来摸去：用手指摆弄的画面记住 tteftef 的被动含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become better or be improved in quality, condition, or performance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 质量、状况或表现得到改善，变得比原来更好。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aħjar fil-kwalità, fil-kundizzjoni jew fil-prestazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 得到改善；被改进。

formal.mt: Is-servizz ttejjeb wara li ddaħħlet sistema ġdida għall-appuntamenti.
formal.en: The service improved after a new appointment system was introduced.
formal.zh: 引入新的预约系统后，服务得到了改善。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad hemm ħafna dewmien? Mark: Le, is-servizz ttejjeb ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are there still long delays? Mark: No, the service has improved a lot.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：现在还经常等很久吗？马克：不会了，服务改善了很多。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 现在还经常等很久吗？
messages.en: Are there still long delays?

messages.speaker: Mark (工作人员)
messages.zh: 不会了，服务改善了很多。
messages.en: No, the service has improved a lot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象服务评分从两星升到四星，用 ttejjeb 记住“得到改善、变得更好”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop spots or blemishes on the skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 皮肤上出现斑点、斑痕或其他可见瑕疵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiżviluppa tikek jew tbajja' fuq il-ġilda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 皮肤长出斑点或出现瑕疵。

collocations.en: he developed blemishes on his hands

formal.mt: Il-pazjent qal li wiċċu ttekkek matul l-aħħar ġimgħa.
formal.en: The patient said that his face had developed blemishes over the past week.
formal.zh: 患者表示，过去一周他的脸上出现了斑点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara minn wiċċek? Mark: Wiċċi ttekkek u ma nafx għaliex.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to your face? Mark: My face has developed blemishes, and I don't know why.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的脸怎么了？马克：我脸上长了些斑点，不知道为什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的脸怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to your face?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wiċċi ttekkek u ma nafx għaliex.
messages.mt_standard: Wiċċi ttekkek u ma nafx għaliex.
messages.zh: 我脸上长了些斑点，不知道为什么。
messages.en: My face has developed blemishes, and I don't know why.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象照镜子时发现脸上多了小斑点，把 ttekkek 与“皮肤出现斑点”的画面绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be tapped lightly, or, in cooking, to be left to simmer gently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到轻轻敲击；用于烹饪时，指食物被置于小火上缓缓煨煮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintlaqat b'daqqiet ħfief, jew, fit-tisjir, jitħalla jsajjar bil-mod fuq nar baxx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被轻敲；受到轻轻的敲击。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be allowed to simmer (used in a culinary context)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被置于小火上慢慢煨煮，使其保持微沸状态（用于烹饪语境）。

collocations.en: the broth was left to simmer over low heat
collocations.zh: 肉汤被放在小火上慢煨

formal.mt: Il-bieb ttektek bil-mod qabel ma daħal il-viżitatur.
formal.en: The door was tapped gently before the visitor entered.
formal.zh: 访客进入前，门被轻轻敲响了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-brodu lest? Mark: Iva, ttektek fuq nar baxx għal nofs siegħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the broth ready? Mark: Yes, it was left to simmer over low heat for half an hour.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：肉汤好了吗？马克：好了，已经用小火慢煨了半小时。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 肉汤好了吗？
messages.en: Is the broth ready?

messages.speaker: Mark (做饭的家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ttektek fuq nar baxx għal nofs siegħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ttektek fuq nar baxx għal nofs siegħa.
messages.zh: 好了，已经用小火慢煨了半小时。
messages.en: Yes, it was left to simmer over low heat for half an hour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记 ttektek：门受到轻敲，汤在小火上轻轻冒泡；分别对应两个义项。

gloss_zh: 被抬起；被送往上方；被升高

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be lifted, sent upwards, or raised to a higher position or level.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被抬离原处、被送到上方，或被提高到更高的位置或水平。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittella' minn postu, jintbagħat 'il fuq jew jitqiegħed f'pożizzjoni jew f'livell ogħla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被抬起；被提起。
被送往上方或較高的位置。
被升起；位置或水平被提高。

collocations.en: the load was lifted by crane
the parcel was sent up to the third floor

formal.mt: Il-piż ttella' bil-krejn u tqiegħed fuq il-pjattaforma.
formal.en: The load was lifted by crane and placed on the platform.
formal.zh: 重物被起重机吊起，放到了平台上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-pakkett tiegħi? Mark: Ttella' fit-tielet sular; qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is my parcel? Mark: It was sent up to the third floor; it's beside the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我的包裹在哪里？马克：已经送上三楼了，就在门旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (住户)
messages.zh: 我的包裹在哪里？
messages.en: Where is my parcel?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Ttella' fit-tielet sular; qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Ttella' fit-tielet sular; qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 已经送上三楼了，就在门旁边。
messages.en: It was sent up to the third floor; it's beside the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ttella' 配一个向上的箭头：重物被抬起、包裹被送上楼、水平被提高，都围绕“向上”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take part in a race, competing to finish ahead of others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参加以速度或完成先后决胜负的比赛，与其他参赛者竞逐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu sehem f'tellieqa u jikkompeti biex jasal qabel l-oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 参加竞速比赛；参加一场赛跑或其他竞速赛事。

collocations.en: he took part in a race for the first time
collocations.zh: 他第一次参加竞速比赛

formal.mt: L-atleta ttellaq għall-ewwel darba f'kompetizzjoni nazzjonali.
formal.en: The athlete took part in a national competition for the first time.
formal.zh: 这名运动员首次参加了全国性竞速比赛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark ttellaq ilbieraħ? Pawlu: Iva, ttellaq ma' sħabu u ġie t-tieni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark race yesterday? Paul: Yes, he raced against his friends and came second.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克昨天参加比赛了吗？保罗：参加了，他和朋友们比赛，得了第二名。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克昨天参加比赛了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark race yesterday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ttellaq ma' sħabu u ġie t-tieni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ttellaq ma' sħabu u ġie t-tieni.
messages.zh: 参加了，他和朋友们比赛，得了第二名。
messages.en: Yes, he raced against his friends and came second.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象选手站在起跑线上，听到信号就参赛；用这个场景记 ttellaq，重点是“参加竞速比赛”。

gloss_zh: 被制成三份；被重复三次

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made into three copies, or to be repeated three times.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被制作成三份，或同一内容、动作被重复三次。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir fi tliet kopji, jew jiġi ripetut tliet darbiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被制作成一式三份；形成三份副本。
被重复三次。

collocations.en: the document was made in triplicate
the message was repeated three times

formal.mt: Id-dokument ttellet biex kull dipartiment ikollu kopja.
formal.en: The document was made in triplicate so that each department would have a copy.
formal.zh: 文件被制成一式三份，以便每个部门各持一份。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt il-messaġġ? Mark: Iva, ttellet fuq ir-radju; smajtu tliet darbiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear the message? Mark: Yes, it was repeated three times on the radio; I heard it three times.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听到那条消息了吗？马克：听到了，广播重复播放了三次，我听了三遍。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听到那条消息了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear the message?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ttellet fuq ir-radju; smajtu tliet darbiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ttellet fuq ir-radju; smajtu tliet darbiet.
messages.zh: 听到了，广播重复播放了三次，我听了三遍。
messages.en: Yes, it was repeated three times on the radio; I heard it three times.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在学习卡上画三张文件和三个播放符号，用数字三串起 ttellet 的“三份”和“三次”两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To come to an end, or to be fulfilled or brought to completion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事情告一段落或结束；也指承诺、要求或预定之事得到履行或完成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jasal fi tmiemu, jew jitwettaq u jsir kollu kif kien meħtieġ jew imwiegħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 结束；终结。
得到履行；得到实现或完成。

collocations.en: what had been promised was fulfilled
collocations.zh: 先前承诺的事情得到了履行

formal.mt: Dak li kien imwiegħed ttemm sal-aħħar tas-sena.
formal.en: What had been promised was fulfilled by the end of the year.
formal.zh: 先前承诺的事情在年底前得到了履行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kunċert għadu għaddej? Mark: Le, ttemm għaxar minuti ilu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the concert still going on? Mark: No, it ended ten minutes ago.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：音乐会还在进行吗？马克：没有，十分钟前就结束了。

messages.speaker: Maja (观众)
messages.zh: 音乐会还在进行吗？
messages.en: Is the concert still going on?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有，十分钟前就结束了。
messages.en: No, it ended ten minutes ago.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ttemm 放在任务清单的最后一个勾旁边：活动结束了，承诺也履行了，都到了完成之处。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive food by being fed by someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由他人给予食物，接受喂食或喂养。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħata l-ikel minn xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动词 temma'（喂食）的中被动态，表示接受喂食。
被喂食；接受喂养。

collocations.en: the boy was fed with a spoon
the cat was fed in the morning

formal.mt: It-tifel ttemma' bl-imgħarfa taħt is-superviżjoni tal-infermier.
formal.en: The boy was fed with a spoon under the nurse's supervision.
formal.zh: 男孩在护士的监督下接受了勺喂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-qattus diġà kiel? Mark: Iva, ttemma' dalgħodu qabel ħriġt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the cat eaten already? Mark: Yes, he was fed this morning before I went out.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：猫已经吃过了吗？马克：吃过了，我今天早上出门前就喂过它了。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 猫已经吃过了吗？
messages.en: Has the cat eaten already?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 吃过了，我今天早上出门前就喂过它了。
messages.en: Yes, he was fed this morning before I went out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小猫坐着接受喂食，把镜头对准接受食物的一方，用 ttemma' 记住“被喂食”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To begin speaking with involuntary repetitions or interruptions of sounds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 开始说话结巴，出现不由自主的语音重复或停顿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibda jitkellem b'ripetizzjonijiet jew waqfiet involontarji fil-ħsejjes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开始结巴；开始口吃。

collocations.en: started stuttering as soon as he began speaking

formal.mt: Waqt il-preżentazzjoni, l-istudent ttemtem u l-għalliem tah ħin biex ikompli.
formal.en: During the presentation, the student started stuttering, and the teacher gave him time to continue.
formal.zh: 展示时，这名学生开始结巴，老师给了他时间继续说下去。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex waqaft waqt it-tweġiba? Luqa: Ttemtimt u kelli bżonn ftit ħin. Marta: Ħu l-ħin tiegħek, qed nisimgħek.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did you stop while answering? Luqa: I started stuttering and needed a little time. Marta: Take your time; I'm listening.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你刚才回答时为什么停下来了？卢卡：我开始结巴了，需要一点时间。玛尔塔：慢慢来，我在听。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.zh: 你刚才回答时为什么停下来了？
messages.en: Why did you stop while answering?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ttemtimt u kelli bżonn ftit ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Ttemtimt u kelli bżonn ftit ħin.
messages.zh: 我开始结巴了，需要一点时间。
messages.en: I started stuttering and needed a little time.

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.zh: 慢慢来，我在听。
messages.en: Take your time; I'm listening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词联想成一句话刚开头就出现重复和停顿的画面，重点记住“开始结巴”这一变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be said, presented, or carried out again.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某句话、信息或事情再次被说出、呈现或进行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jerġa' jingħad, jintwera jew isir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被重复；再次被说出或进行。

collocations.zh: 这条信息被重复了两遍

formal.mt: L-avviż ttenna fi tmiem il-laqgħa biex il-parteċipanti kollha jisimgħuh.
formal.en: The announcement was repeated at the end of the meeting so that all participants could hear it.
formal.zh: 会议结束时，通知又播报了一遍，让所有与会者都能听到。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ma smajtx l-ewwel avviż. Mark: Tinkwetax, l-avviż ttenna ftit ilu. Sara: Tajjeb, issa naf x'għandi nagħmel.
colloquial.en: Sara: I didn't hear the first announcement. Mark: Don't worry; the announcement was repeated a little while ago. Sara: Good, now I know what to do.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我没听到第一次通知。马克：别担心，刚才通知又播了一遍。萨拉：好，现在我知道该怎么做了。

messages.speaker: Sara (活动参加者)
messages.zh: 我没听到第一次通知。
messages.en: I didn't hear the first announcement.

messages.speaker: Mark (活动参加者)
messages.zh: 别担心，刚才通知又播了一遍。
messages.en: Don't worry; the announcement was repeated a little while ago.

messages.speaker: Sara (活动参加者)
messages.zh: 好，现在我知道该怎么做了。
messages.en: Good, now I know what to do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象广播里的同一条通知又响了一遍，用“内容再次出现”的画面记住被重复的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop loose or unravelled threads, especially along the edge of fabric or rope.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 布料或绳索等的线纤维逐渐松散，尤其指边缘磨损起毛或散线。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibda jinħall f'ħjut maħlula, speċjalment fit-tarf ta' drapp jew ħabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因磨损等而起毛、散线，尤指布料或绳索。

collocations.en: the edge of the fabric became frayed

formal.mt: Wara użu fit-tul, it-tarf tad-drapp ttentex u kellu bżonn tiswija.
formal.en: After prolonged use, the edge of the fabric became frayed and needed repair.
formal.zh: 长期使用后，布料边缘磨损散线，需要修补。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-ħabel għadu tajjeb? Pawlu: It-tarf ttentex; aħjar nużaw wieħed ġdid. Nina: Sewwa, inġib ieħor.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this rope still any good? Pawlu: The end has frayed; we'd better use a new one. Nina: All right, I'll get another one.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这根绳子还能用吗？保罗：绳头已经散线了，最好换根新的。妮娜：好，我再拿一根。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这根绳子还能用吗？
messages.en: Is this rope still any good?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tarf ttentex; aħjar nużaw wieħed ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: It-tarf ttentex; aħjar nużaw wieħed ġdid.
messages.zh: 绳头已经散线了，最好换根新的。
messages.en: The end has frayed; we'd better use a new one.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我再拿一根。
messages.en: All right, I'll get another one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象旧毛巾的边缘冒出一根根松线，把“边缘逐渐散开起毛”的画面和这个词一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop a theory or suggest a theoretical explanation for something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 针对某种现象构思理论，或提出理论性的解释与推测。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiżviluppa teorija jew jipproponi spjegazzjoni teoretika dwar xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提出理论；进行理论思考或推测。

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur tteorizza li d-differenza fir-riżultati kienet marbuta mat-temperatura, iżda kien hemm bżonn aktar provi.
formal.en: The researcher theorized that the difference in the results was linked to temperature, but more evidence was needed.
formal.zh: 研究者提出理论推测，认为结果的差异与温度有关，但仍需要更多证据。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-pjanti ħdejn it-tieqa kibru aktar? David: L-għalliem tteorizza li rċevew aktar dawl. Lara: Nistgħu niċċekkjaw kemm dawl jirċievu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did the plants by the window grow more? David: The teacher theorized that they received more light. Lara: We can check how much light they receive.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么窗边的植物长得更多？戴维：老师推测，它们得到的光照更多。拉拉：我们可以检查一下它们得到多少光照。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-pjanti ħdejn it-tieqa kibru aktar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-pjanti ħdejn it-tieqa kibru aktar?
messages.zh: 为什么窗边的植物长得更多？
messages.en: Why did the plants by the window grow more?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għalliem tteorizza li rċevew aktar dawl.
messages.mt_standard: L-għalliem tteorizza li rċevew aktar dawl.
messages.zh: 老师推测，它们得到的光照更多。
messages.en: The teacher theorized that they received more light.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 我们可以检查一下它们得到多少光照。
messages.en: We can check how much light they receive.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“观察现象、提出解释、再找证据”的学习顺序中，记住它表示提出理论或推测。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stretch or extend the body or limbs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把身体或四肢伸展开来，使姿势舒展。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jifrex jew imeddu ġismu jew riġlejh u dirgħajh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伸展；把身体或四肢舒展开来。

formal.mt: Wara l-mixja twila, il-vjaġġatur tterraħ fuq is-sodda u straħ għal ftit ħin.
formal.en: After the long walk, the traveller stretched out on the bed and rested for a while.
formal.zh: 长途步行后，旅行者在床上舒展开身体，休息了一会儿。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn hu Mark? Rita: Tterraħ fuq is-sufan wara x-xogħol. Anna: Mela nħalluh jistrieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where is Mark? Rita: He stretched out on the sofa after work. Anna: Then let's let him rest for a while.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马克在哪儿？丽塔：他下班后在沙发上舒展开身体躺着了。安娜：那就让他休息一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.zh: 马克在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is Mark?

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 他下班后在沙发上舒展开身体躺着了。
messages.en: He stretched out on the sofa after work.

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.zh: 那就让他休息一会儿吧。
messages.en: Then let's let him rest for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象走累以后在床上把手脚伸展开，借这个身体动作记住“伸展、舒展”的意思。

gloss_zh: 被撕碎；被扯成碎片；破烂不堪

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be shredded or torn into pieces, or to be left in a badly torn condition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被撕成条状或碎片，或处于严重破损、破烂不堪的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitqatta' fi strixxi jew biċċiet, jew jispiċċa mqatta' ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被撕成或切成细条、碎片。
被撕成碎片；被扯得粉碎。
破烂不堪；处于被撕得残破的状态。

collocations.en: the document was torn into small pieces
the coat was left in tatters

formal.mt: Il-poster ttertaq waqt it-tneħħija u ma setax jerġa' jintuża.
formal.en: The poster was torn to pieces during removal and could not be used again.
formal.zh: 海报在取下时被撕成碎片，无法再次使用。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'ġara mill-kowt tiegħek? Ġanni: Ttertaq meta nqabad mal-ilqugħ. Marija: Ġibu hawn, naraw jekk nistgħux insewwuh.
colloquial.en: Marija: What happened to your coat? Ġanni: It got badly torn when it caught on the fence. Marija: Bring it here; let's see whether we can mend it.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你的外套怎么了？詹尼：它挂在围栏上，被扯得破破烂烂。玛丽亚：拿过来，我们看看能不能补好。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 你的外套怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to your coat?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (儿子)
messages.zh: 它挂在围栏上，被扯得破破烂烂。
messages.en: It got badly torn when it caught on the fence.

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġibu hawn, naraw jekk nistgħux insewwuh.
messages.mt_standard: Ġibu hawn, naraw jekk nistgħux insewwuh.
messages.zh: 拿过来，我们看看能不能补好。
messages.en: Bring it here; let's see whether we can mend it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个相连画面记忆：纸变成细条、纸被撕成碎片、衣服破烂不堪，分别对应所列三个义项。

gloss_zh: 零星漏播；有些地块未播种

teaching_sense.en_definition: For land to be left unsown in scattered places.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指土地这里一块、那里一块地没有播种，留下零散的漏播地块。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibqa' bla żrigħ f'xi nħawi 'l hawn u 'l hemm.

sense_translations.en_definition: be left unsown hither and thither
sense_translations.zh_definition: 这里那里有些地方未被播种；零星地留下漏播地块。

collocations.en: land left unsown in scattered places
collocations.zh: 有零星漏播地块的土地

collocations.en: was left unsown in scattered small patches
collocations.zh: 零星留下小块未播种的地方

formal.mt: Wara ż-żrigħ, il-bidwi nnota li xi raba' ttewwaq f'roqgħat żgħar u ddeċieda li jiżra' dawk il-partijiet.
formal.en: After sowing, the farmer noticed that some land had been left unsown in scattered small patches and decided to sow those areas.
formal.zh: 播种后，农民发现田里零星留下了一些未播种的小地块，决定给这些地方补种。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex hawn irqajja' bla żerriegħa? Toni: Xi raba' ttewwaq waqt iż-żrigħ. Rita: Mela niżirgħu dawk l-irqajja' wkoll.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why are there patches without seed here? Toni: Some land was left unsown here and there during sowing. Rita: Then let's sow those patches too.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这里为什么有些小块地方没撒种子？托尼：播种时零星漏了一些地方。丽塔：那我们也把这些小块地方种上吧。

messages.speaker: Rita (农场帮工)
messages.zh: 这里为什么有些小块地方没撒种子？
messages.en: Why are there patches without seed here?

messages.speaker: Toni (农民)
messages.zh: 播种时零星漏了一些地方。
messages.en: Some land was left unsown here and there during sowing.

messages.speaker: Rita (农场帮工)
messages.zh: 那我们也把这些小块地方种上吧。
messages.en: Then let's sow those patches too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象播种后的田里这里空一块、那里空一块，记住这个词强调零星未播种的地方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel hatred or to be made to feel strong aversion or disgust.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产生憎恨，或因某件事受到刺激而感到强烈厌恶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss mibegħda jew jitqanqal fih sens qawwi ta' stmerrija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到憎恨；心生仇恨。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be made to feel repugnance
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被激起强烈厌恶；因所见所闻等而感到反感。

collocations.en: felt hatred or revulsion because of the cruelty
collocations.zh: 因残酷行为而心生憎恶

collocations.en: was filled with repugnance when he saw the abuse
collocations.zh: 看到虐待行为时感到强烈厌恶

formal.mt: Ix-xhud ttiegħeb meta ra l-moħqrija lejn l-annimali u rrapporta dak li kien seħħ.
formal.en: The witness was filled with repugnance when he saw the cruelty towards the animals and reported what had happened.
formal.zh: 目击者看到虐待动物的残酷行为后感到强烈厌恶，并报告了所发生的事情。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex telaq Pawlu? Marija: Ttiegħeb meta sema' kif kienu qed jittrattaw lill-annimali. Elena: Nifhmu; dak li qalulu kien tassew ikrah.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why did Pawlu leave? Marija: He was filled with repugnance when he heard how they were treating the animals. Elena: I understand him; what they told him was truly horrible.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：保罗为什么走了？玛丽亚：他听说那些人怎样对待动物后，感到强烈厌恶。埃莱娜：我理解他，他们告诉他的事情确实很恶劣。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么走了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu leave?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ttiegħeb meta sema' kif kienu qed jittrattaw lill-annimali.
messages.mt_standard: Ttiegħeb meta sema' kif kienu qed jittrattaw lill-annimali.
messages.zh: 他听说那些人怎样对待动物后，感到强烈厌恶。
messages.en: He was filled with repugnance when he heard how they were treating the animals.

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nifhmu; dak li qalulu kien tassew ikrah.
messages.mt_standard: Nifhmu; dak li qalulu kien tassew ikrah.
messages.zh: 我理解他，他们告诉他的事情确实很恶劣。
messages.en: I understand him; what they told him was truly horrible.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象听到残酷行为后内心产生强烈排斥，用“心生憎恨”和“被激起厌恶”两个情绪标签分别记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have one's flavour tested by someone tasting a small amount.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指食物或饮料被人尝过，以判断其味道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal ikel jew xorb li xi ħadd iduq biex jiċċekkja t-togħma tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被品尝；被尝味道。

collocations.mt: L-ikel ttiegħem qabel ma ġie servut.
collocations.en: The food was tasted before it was served.
collocations.zh: 食物在上桌前经过了试味。

collocations.en: The wine was tasted during the meal.
collocations.zh: 用餐时品尝了这款葡萄酒。

formal.mt: L-ikel ttiegħem qabel ma ġie servut lill-mistednin, biex tiġi ċċekkjata t-togħma tiegħu.
formal.en: The food was tasted before being served to the guests so that its flavour could be checked.
formal.zh: 食物在端给宾客之前经过了试味，以检查味道。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-ikel diġà ttiegħem? Mark: Iva, u għandu bżonn ftit aktar melħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the food been tasted already? Mark: Yes, and it needs a little more salt.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：饭菜已经尝过味道了吗？马克：尝过了，还需要再加一点盐。

messages.speaker: Maja (做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 饭菜已经尝过味道了吗？
messages.en: Has the food been tasted already?

messages.speaker: Mark (帮厨的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u għandu bżonn ftit aktar melħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u għandu bżonn ftit aktar melħ.
messages.zh: 尝过了，还需要再加一点盐。
messages.en: Yes, and it needs a little more salt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一道菜上桌前被舀一小勺试味，把这个词与“食物被尝过”的画面联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To keep changing position in bed because one cannot settle comfortably or sleep.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因难以安稳入睡或躺得不舒服，在床上不断翻身、辗转反侧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibqa' jiċċaqlaq u jibdel il-pożizzjoni fis-sodda għax ma jsibx il-mistrieħ jew ma jkunx jista' jorqod.

sense_translations.en_definition: to toss and turn in bed
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在床上翻来覆去；辗转反侧。

formal.mt: Il-pazjent ttieraħ fis-sodda għal diversi sigħat u ma rnexxilux jorqod.
formal.en: The patient tossed and turned in bed for several hours and was unable to sleep.
formal.zh: 病人在床上辗转反侧了几个小时，始终无法入睡。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark raqad sew ilbieraħ? Lara: Le, ttieraħ il-lejl kollu minħabba s-sħana.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark sleep well last night? Lara: No, he tossed and turned all night because of the heat.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克昨晚睡得好吗？拉拉：不好，天太热，他整夜翻来覆去。

messages.speaker: Maja (关心朋友的人)
messages.zh: 马克昨晚睡得好吗？
messages.en: Did Mark sleep well last night?

messages.speaker: Lara (马克的室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ttieraħ il-lejl kollu minħabba s-sħana.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ttieraħ il-lejl kollu minħabba s-sħana.
messages.zh: 不好，天太热，他整夜翻来覆去。
messages.en: No, he tossed and turned all night because of the heat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象炎热夜里在床上左翻右翻，把这个词固定在“躺着却睡不安稳”的场景里。

gloss_zh: 被拿走；被采取；染病；具有传染性；受骗

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be taken, collected, or removed by someone; also used for catching illness, being contagious, or being deceived.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主要表示被拿取、采集或带走；也可表示染上疾病、具有传染性或受骗，具体含义由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħadd jieħu, jiġbor jew ineħħi xi ħaġa; jista' wkoll jirreferi għal mard li jgħaddi minn persuna għal oħra jew għal persuna li tiġi mqarrqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被拿取、带走或采取；具体译法取决于所涉及的事物。
染上；感染上，用于疾病。
具有传染性；能够在人与人之间传播。
被骗；受蒙骗。

collocations.en: The sample was taken in the morning.
The photograph was taken in the garden.
collocations.zh: 照片是在花园里拍摄的。

formal.mt: Il-kampjun ttieħed filgħodu u ntbagħat lill-laboratorju għall-analiżi.
formal.en: The sample was taken in the morning and sent to the laboratory for analysis.
formal.zh: 样本于早上采集，随后送往实验室进行分析。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn ttieħed dan ir-ritratt? Mark: Fil-ġnien tan-nanna, nhar il-Ħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where was this photograph taken? Mark: In Grandma's garden, on Sunday.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张照片是在哪里拍的？马克：星期天在奶奶的花园里拍的。

messages.speaker: Maja (看照片的朋友)
messages.zh: 这张照片是在哪里拍的？
messages.en: Where was this photograph taken?

messages.speaker: Mark (照片的主人)
messages.zh: 星期天在奶奶的花园里拍的。
messages.en: In Grandma's garden, on Sunday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记“样本被取走、照片被拍下”，再另设疾病传播和受骗两张情境卡，避免把所有用法硬译成“拿走”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To tease or bother someone, causing irritation or getting on their nerves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过逗弄、纠缠或其他言行使别人烦恼、恼火或不耐烦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idejjaq jew jipprovoka lil xi ħadd bi kliem jew b'azzjonijiet li jġegħluh jitlef il-paċenzja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逗弄；戏弄。
惹恼；使烦恼。
使某人心烦；让某人受不了。

collocations.zh: 开玩笑惹恼了他的朋友

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni, tifel ttika lil sieħbu biċ-ċajt, u l-għalliem talbu jieqaf.
formal.en: During the lesson, a boy teased his classmate with jokes, and the teacher asked him to stop.
formal.zh: 课堂上，一个男孩开玩笑逗弄同学，老师要求他停止。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark irrabja? Lara: Pawlu ttika lil Mark biċ-ċajt dwar iż-żarbun tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark get angry? Lara: Paul teased Mark with jokes about his shoes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么生气了？拉拉：保罗拿马克的鞋子开玩笑，惹恼了他。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 马克为什么生气了？
messages.en: Why did Mark get angry?

messages.speaker: Lara (在场的同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu ttika lil Mark biċ-ċajt dwar iż-żarbun tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu ttika lil Mark biċ-ċajt dwar iż-żarbun tiegħu.
messages.zh: 保罗拿马克的鞋子开玩笑，惹恼了他。
messages.en: Paul teased Mark with jokes about his shoes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“逗一下、惹烦了、实在受不了”三格漫画记住程度变化，核心都是言行让别人不舒服。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To add punctuation to writing, mark something with spots, or mark an item with a tick.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给文字加标点，给物体加斑点，或在项目旁打勾作记号。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżid sinjali ta' punteġġjatura f'test, jimmarka xi ħaġa b'tikek, jew jagħmel marka ta' verifika ħdejn oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给文字加标点。
加上斑点；用点状记号标记。
打勾；以勾号标记。

collocations.zh: 在正确的方框内打了勾

formal.mt: L-editur ttikkja t-test b'attenzjoni biex il-qarrejja jifhmu aħjar fejn jibdew u jispiċċaw is-sentenzi.
formal.en: The editor carefully added punctuation to the text so that readers could better understand where the sentences began and ended.
formal.zh: 编辑仔细地给文本加上标点，使读者更容易辨认句子的起止。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark mela l-formola? Lara: Iva, ttikkja l-kaxxa t-tajba u ffirma isfel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark fill in the form? Lara: Yes, he ticked the correct box and signed at the bottom.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克填好表格了吗？拉拉：填好了，他在正确的方框内打了勾，还在下面签了名。

messages.speaker: Maja (办公室同事)
messages.zh: 马克填好表格了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark fill in the form?

messages.speaker: Lara (处理表格的同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ttikkja l-kaxxa t-tajba u ffirma isfel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ttikkja l-kaxxa t-tajba u ffirma isfel.
messages.zh: 填好了，他在正确的方框内打了勾，还在下面签了名。
messages.en: Yes, he ticked the correct box and signed at the bottom.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一支笔依次添加标点、画出斑点、勾选方框，用三个小记号区分这个词的三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To push or force one's way through a crowd or a tight space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用力穿过人群或狭窄空间，为自己挤出一条通路。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaddi minn qalb folla jew minn spazju dejjaq billi jimbotta jew jagħmel forza biex jiftaħ triq għalih.

sense_translations.en_definition: to push or force one's way through
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用力挤过去；强行穿过。

collocations.en: pushed his way through the crowd
forced his way towards the exit

formal.mt: Meta nfetaħ il-bieb, raġel ttoffa minn qalb il-folla biex jidħol fis-sala.
formal.en: When the door opened, a man pushed his way through the crowd to enter the hall.
formal.zh: 门打开时，一名男子从人群中挤过去，进入大厅。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif wasal Mark quddiem? Lara: Ttoffa minn qalb il-folla, għax kien hemm ħafna nies.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Mark get to the front? Lara: He pushed his way through the crowd because there were so many people.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克怎么到前面去的？拉拉：人太多了，他从人群中挤过去的。

messages.speaker: Maja (一起看演出的朋友)
messages.zh: 马克怎么到前面去的？
messages.en: How did Mark get to the front?

messages.speaker: Lara (一起看演出的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ttoffa minn qalb il-folla, għax kien hemm ħafna nies.
messages.mt_standard: Ttoffa minn qalb il-folla, għax kien hemm ħafna nies.
messages.zh: 人太多了，他从人群中挤过去的。
messages.en: He pushed his way through the crowd because there were so many people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拥挤车厢里侧身用力挤到出口，记住动作重点是“费力挤出通路”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To endure or put up with something unpleasant, or allow something without trying to stop it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 忍受令人不快的事物，或容许某种行为、状况继续存在而不加制止。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jissaporti xi ħaġa li ddejqu jew iħalli mġiba jew sitwazzjoni tkompli mingħajr ma jwaqqafha.

sense_translations.en_definition: to stand, to endure, to tolerate
sense_translations.zh_definition: 忍受；承受；容忍。

formal.mt: Il-maniġer ttollera d-dewmien fl-ewwel jum, iżda talab li l-ħaddiema jaslu fil-ħin minn dakinhar 'il quddiem.
formal.en: The manager tolerated the lateness on the first day but asked the workers to arrive on time from then on.
formal.zh: 经理容忍了第一天的迟到，但要求员工此后准时到达。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark iddejjaq bil-mużika lbieraħ? Lara: Iva, imma ttollera l-istorbju sakemm spiċċat il-festa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was Mark bothered by the music yesterday? Lara: Yes, but he tolerated the noise until the party ended.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克昨天觉得音乐吵吗？拉拉：觉得，但他一直忍着噪音，直到聚会结束。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 马克昨天觉得音乐吵吗？
messages.en: Was Mark bothered by the music yesterday?

messages.speaker: Lara (马克的室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ttollera l-istorbju sakemm spiċċat il-festa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ttollera l-istorbju sakemm spiċċat il-festa.
messages.zh: 觉得，但他一直忍着噪音，直到聚会结束。
messages.en: Yes, but he tolerated the noise until the party ended.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它和英语 tolerate 配对记忆，再想象听到噪音皱眉却暂时忍住，区分“容忍”和“喜欢”。

gloss_zh: 制作一式三份；复制成三份

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce three copies or instances of the same thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把同一事物制作成三份，尤其指将文件复制为一式三份。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel tliet kopji jew tliet eżemplari tal-istess ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 制作成三份；复制为一式三份。

collocations.zh: 把文件制作成了一式三份
把表格制作成了一式三份

formal.mt: Is-segretarju ttriplika d-dokument sabiex kull wieħed mit-tliet dipartimenti jirċievi kopja.
formal.en: The secretary produced the document in triplicate so that each of the three departments would receive a copy.
formal.zh: 秘书把文件制作成一式三份，以便三个部门各收到一份。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandna kopja għal kull uffiċċju? Mark: Iva, Pawlu ttriplika l-formola, allura għandna tlieta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do we have a copy for each office? Mark: Yes, Paul produced the form in triplicate, so we have three.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：每个办公室都有一份吗？马克：有，保罗把表格制作成了一式三份，所以我们有三份。

messages.speaker: Maja (办公室同事)
messages.zh: 每个办公室都有一份吗？
messages.en: Do we have a copy for each office?

messages.speaker: Mark (负责文件的同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, Pawlu ttriplika l-formola, allura għandna tlieta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, Pawlu ttriplika l-formola, allura għandna tlieta.
messages.zh: 有，保罗把表格制作成了一式三份，所以我们有三份。
messages.en: Yes, Paul produced the form in triplicate, so we have three.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它和英语 triplicate 配对记忆，想象桌面并排放着三份相同文件，牢牢记住“一式三份”。

gloss_zh: （电路或保护开关因过载、短路而）跳闸

teaching_sense.en_definition: To switch off automatically because of an electrical overload or short circuit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指电路或保护开关因电流过载或短路而自动断开，即跳闸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqata' awtomatikament minħabba tagħbija elettrika żejda jew short circuit.

sense_translations.en_definition: to trip, to trip out (through overload, a short circuit)
sense_translations.zh_definition: （电路或保护开关因过载、短路而）跳闸，自动断开。

collocations.en: The circuit breaker tripped because of an overload.
The circuit breaker tripped because of a short circuit.

formal.mt: L-interruttur tas-sigurtà ttrippja meta t-tagħbija elettrika qabżet il-limitu permess.
formal.en: The safety circuit breaker tripped when the electrical load exceeded the permitted limit.
formal.zh: 当电力负载超过允许上限时，安全断路器跳闸了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex intefa d-dawl? Mark: L-interruttur ttrippja. Kellna wisq apparat mixgħul fl-istess ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the lights go out? Mark: The circuit breaker tripped. We had too many appliances on at the same time.
colloquial.zh: Maja：灯怎么灭了？Mark：断路器跳闸了。我们同时开了太多电器。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 灯怎么灭了？
messages.en: Why did the lights go out?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-interruttur ttrippja. Kellna wisq apparat mixgħul fl-istess ħin.
messages.mt_standard: L-interruttur ttrippja. Kellna wisq apparat mixgħul fl-istess ħin.
messages.zh: 断路器跳闸了。我们同时开了太多电器。
messages.en: The circuit breaker tripped. We had too many appliances on at the same time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与“电器开太多，开关啪地跳闸”的画面绑定，记住这里说的是电路自动断开。

gloss_zh: 用双筒望远镜观看；好奇地打量；进行内镜检查

teaching_sense.en_definition: To look through binoculars, look inquisitively, or perform an endoscopic examination, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依语境指用双筒望远镜观察、好奇地打量，或进行内镜检查。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħares bit-tromba, iħares b'kurżità, jew jagħmel eżami bl-endoskopju, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用双筒望远镜观看或观察。
好奇地看，带着探究的神情打量。
进行内镜检查。

collocations.en: The doctor performed an endoscopy on the patient.
collocations.zh: 医生给患者做了内镜检查。

formal.mt: It-tabib ttrombja l-pazjent biex jeżamina l-istonku u jfittex il-kawża tal-uġigħ.
formal.en: The doctor performed an endoscopy on the patient to examine the stomach and investigate the cause of the pain.
formal.zh: 医生给患者做了内镜检查，以观察胃部并查找疼痛原因。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark ttrombja lejn id-dgħajsa bit-tromba? Lara: Iva, u mbagħad ttrombja b'kurżità lejn il-basket li ġabu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark look at the boat through binoculars? Lara: Yes, and then he looked inquisitively at the basket they brought.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 用双筒望远镜看那条船了吗？Lara：看了，随后他又好奇地打量他们带来的篮子。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 用双筒望远镜看那条船了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark look at the boat through binoculars?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u mbagħad ttrombja b'kurżità lejn il-basket li ġabu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u mbagħad ttrombja b'kurżità lejn il-basket li ġabu.
messages.zh: 看了，随后他又好奇地打量他们带来的篮子。
messages.en: Yes, and then he looked inquisitively at the basket they brought.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个独立画面记义：举起双筒镜、好奇地打量、医生做内镜；遇到这个词先看场景，再选中文义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move at a trot, especially of a horse, at a pace faster than walking and slower than galloping.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指马等以小跑步态前进，速度比步行快、比疾驰慢。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimxi bit-trott, speċjalment żiemel, b'pass aktar mgħaġġel mill-mixi iżda aktar bil-mod mill-galopp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: （尤指马）小跑，以快步步态前进。

collocations.en: to trot at a steady pace

formal.mt: Waqt it-taħriġ, iż-żiemel ttrottja b'pass regolari tul il-mogħdija.
formal.en: During training, the horse trotted at a steady pace along the path.
formal.zh: 训练时，那匹马沿着小路以均匀的步伐小跑。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Iż-żiemel ġera malajr? Mark: Le, ttrottja biss sal-bieb u mbagħad waqaf.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the horse run fast? Mark: No, it only trotted to the gate and then stopped.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那匹马跑得很快吗？Mark：没有，它只是小跑到大门口，然后就停了。

messages.speaker: Lara (骑马学员)
messages.zh: 那匹马跑得很快吗？
messages.en: Did the horse run fast?

messages.speaker: Mark (骑马教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ttrottja biss sal-bieb u mbagħad waqaf.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ttrottja biss sal-bieb u mbagħad waqaf.
messages.zh: 没有，它只是小跑到大门口，然后就停了。
messages.en: No, it only trotted to the gate and then stopped.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象马蹄有节奏地“哒哒”小跑，把这个词放在步行与疾驰之间的速度档位来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To apply cosmetics to someone's face, for example for a performance or a particular appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给人的面部涂用化妆品，以形成某种妆容，例如为演出上妆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Japplika prodotti tal-kożmetika fuq wiċċ xi ħadd biex joħloq dehra partikolari, pereżempju għal wirja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 化妆，给人上妆。

collocations.en: to apply makeup to the actress
to apply makeup for the stage

formal.mt: Il-professjonist ttrukka lill-attriċi qabel il-wirja, b'kuluri adattati għad-dawl tal-palk.
formal.en: The professional applied makeup to the actress before the performance, using colours suited to the stage lighting.
formal.zh: 演出前，专业化妆师给女演员上妆，所用色彩适合舞台灯光。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ttrukka lil Lara għall-festa? Mark: Jien. Riedet dehra sempliċi, allura użajt ftit kulur biss.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who did Lara's makeup for the party? Mark: I did. She wanted a simple look, so I used only a little colour.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁给 Lara 化了参加聚会的妆？Mark：我化的。她想要简单的妆容，所以我只用了少量色彩。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁给 Lara 化了参加聚会的妆？
messages.en: Who did Lara's makeup for the party?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友兼化妆师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Riedet dehra sempliċi, allura użajt ftit kulur biss.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Riedet dehra sempliċi, allura użajt ftit kulur biss.
messages.zh: 我化的。她想要简单的妆容，所以我只用了少量色彩。
messages.en: I did. She wanted a simple look, so I used only a little colour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词记在“镜子、粉刷、演员上台前”的画面里；本条的 make up 对应给人化妆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To play a trumpet or produce a trumpet sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吹奏小号或喇叭，发出相应的号声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idoq it-trumbetta jew jagħmel ħoss ta' trumbetta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吹小号，吹喇叭；发出喇叭般的声音。

collocations.en: to play the trumpet with the band
to play the trumpet during the parade

formal.mt: Il-mużiċist ttrumbettja mal-banda waqt iċ-ċerimonja tal-ftuħ.
formal.en: The musician played the trumpet with the band during the opening ceremony.
formal.zh: 开幕仪式上，那位乐手随乐队吹奏了小号。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min ttrumbettja fil-parata lbieraħ? Maja: Ħija! Kien ilu jipprattika għal ġimgħat.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who played the trumpet in the parade yesterday? Maja: My brother! He had been practising for weeks.
colloquial.zh: Lara：昨天游行时是谁吹的小号？Maja：我哥哥！他之前已经练了好几个星期。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天游行时是谁吹的小号？
messages.en: Who played the trumpet in the parade yesterday?

messages.speaker: Maja (乐手的妹妹)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija! Kien ilu jipprattika għal ġimgħat.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija! Kien ilu jipprattika għal ġimgħat.
messages.zh: 我哥哥！他之前已经练了好几个星期。
messages.en: My brother! He had been practising for weeks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象游行乐队里小号手举起金色喇叭，响亮吹出号声，用“举号、吹奏、响声”三个动作记词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone severe or persistent physical pain or mental distress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人承受强烈或持续的身体疼痛或精神痛苦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd ibati ħafna jew għal żmien twil, fiżikament jew mentalment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 折磨，使遭受身体或精神上的痛苦。

formal.mt: L-uġigħ persistenti tturmenta lill-pazjent għal diversi ljieli u ċaħħdu mill-irqad.
formal.en: The persistent pain tormented the patient for several nights and deprived him of sleep.
formal.zh: 持续的疼痛折磨了患者好几个夜晚，使他无法入睡。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma rqadtx sew? Mark: Ħsieb wieħed tturmenta lili l-lejl kollu: jekk għalaqtx il-bieb tal-ħanut.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why didn't you sleep well? Mark: One thought tormented me all night: whether I had locked the shop door.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你怎么没睡好？Mark：一个念头折磨了我整晚：我到底有没有锁好店门。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么没睡好？
messages.en: Why didn't you sleep well?

messages.speaker: Mark (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħsieb wieħed tturmenta lili l-lejl kollu: jekk għalaqtx il-bieb tal-ħanut.
messages.mt_standard: Ħsieb wieħed tturmenta lili l-lejl kollu: jekk għalaqtx il-bieb tal-ħanut.
messages.zh: 一个念头折磨了我整晚：我到底有没有锁好店门。
messages.en: One thought tormented me all night: whether I had locked the shop door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“身体疼痛睡不着”和“心里疑虑放不下”并排记忆，这个词能表达两类痛苦的折磨。

gloss_zh: 放逐，流放，迫使离开本国

teaching_sense.en_definition: To force someone to leave their own country and live abroad in exile.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 迫使某人离开自己的国家，到国外流亡或被放逐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitlaq minn pajjiżu u jgħix barra minnu fl-eżilju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将某人逐出本国，使流亡国外；放逐，流放。

collocations.en: to exile the writer to another country
collocations.zh: 将作家放逐到另一个国家

formal.mt: F'dan ir-rakkont fittizju, il-ħakkiem tturufna lill-kittieb minħabba l-kritika tiegħu lejn il-gvern.
formal.en: In this fictional account, the ruler exiled the writer because of his criticism of the government.
formal.zh: 在这个虚构故事中，统治者因作家批评政府而将其放逐。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-poeta fil-ktieb jgħix barra minn pajjiżu? Mark: Għax ir-re tturufna lill-poeta wara li kiteb poeżija kontra tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does the poet in the book live outside his own country? Mark: Because the king exiled the poet after he wrote a poem against him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：书里的诗人为什么住在国外？Mark：因为他写了一首反对国王的诗，国王随后就把他放逐了。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-poeta fil-ktieb jgħix barra minn pajjiżu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-poeta fil-ktieb jgħix barra minn pajjiżu?
messages.zh: 书里的诗人为什么住在国外？
messages.en: Why does the poet in the book live outside his own country?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ir-re tturufna lill-poeta wara li kiteb poeżija kontra tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ir-re tturufna lill-poeta wara li kiteb poeżija kontra tiegħu.
messages.zh: 因为他写了一首反对国王的诗，国王随后就把他放逐了。
messages.en: Because the king exiled the poet after he wrote a poem against him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故事人物被迫离开故乡、带着行李流亡国外，把这个词与“被放逐而离乡”的情境绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To protect a person or safeguard someone's rights and interests.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 保护某人，或维护、保障某人的权利与利益。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jipproteġi persuna jew iħares id-drittijiet u l-interessi ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.en_definition: to protect, to safeguard one's rights
sense_translations.zh_definition: 保护；维护、保障某人的权利。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, il-ftehim ttutela d-drittijiet tal-ħaddiema billi stabbilixxa kundizzjonijiet ċari għall-ħlas u għall-mistrieħ.
formal.en: In this example, the agreement safeguarded workers' rights by setting clear conditions for pay and rest.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，协议通过明确工资和休息条件，保障了劳动者的权利。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ftehim il-ġdid għenkom? Mark: Iva, ttutela d-dritt tagħna għall-mistrieħ. Issa l-ħinijiet huma ċari għal kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the new agreement help you? Mark: Yes, it safeguarded our right to rest. Now the hours are clear to everyone.
colloquial.zh: Maja：新协议对你们有帮助吗？Mark：有，它保障了我们的休息权。现在大家都清楚具体时间安排了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 新协议对你们有帮助吗？
messages.en: Did the new agreement help you?

messages.speaker: Mark (员工代表)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ttutela d-dritt tagħna għall-mistrieħ. Issa l-ħinijiet huma ċari għal kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ttutela d-dritt tagħna għall-mistrieħ. Issa l-ħinijiet huma ċari għal kulħadd.
messages.zh: 有，它保障了我们的休息权。现在大家都清楚具体时间安排了。
messages.en: Yes, it safeguarded our right to rest. Now the hours are clear to everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一份协议像盾牌一样护住劳动者的休息权，用“保护人、保障权利”这一组搭配记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To apply make-up while seated or standing at a dressing table.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在梳妆台前给自己化妆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel il-make-up quddiem mejda tat-twaletta.

sense_translations.en_definition: to apply make up at a dressing table
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在梳妆台前化妆。

collocations.en: apply make-up at the dressing table
apply make-up at a dressing table before going out
collocations.zh: 出门前在梳妆台前化妆

formal.mt: Qabel ir-ritratt uffiċjali, Marija ttwalettjat quddiem il-mejda tat-twaletta.
formal.en: Before the official photograph, Marija applied her make-up at the dressing table.
formal.zh: 拍摄正式照片前，玛丽娅在梳妆台前化了妆。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Marija lesta biex noħorġu? Nina: Iva, diġà ttwalettjat u qed tistenna ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is Marija ready for us to go out? Nina: Yes, she has already done her make-up at the dressing table and is waiting by the door.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：玛丽娅准备好跟我们出门了吗？妮娜：好了，她已经在梳妆台前化好妆，正在门边等着。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 玛丽娅准备好跟我们出门了吗？
messages.en: Is Marija ready for us to go out?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, diġà ttwalettjat u qed tistenna ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, diġà ttwalettjat u qed tistenna ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 好了，她已经在梳妆台前化好妆，正在门边等着。
messages.en: Yes, she has already done her make-up at the dressing table and is waiting by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个动词配上一幅梳妆台、镜子和化妆刷的画面，整组记住“在梳妆台前化妆”这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lump of earth; figuratively, a person described insultingly as very foolish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一块凝结成团的泥土；也可比喻愚笨的人，用于指人时带有侮辱意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa ħamrija magħquda; b'mod figurattiv, persuna msejħa hekk bi tmaqdir għax titqies iblah ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 土块；凝结成团的一块泥土。
（比喻）笨蛋；迟钝愚笨的人，带贬义。
蠢人；极其愚笨的人，属于侮辱性称呼。

formal.mt: Waqt it-tħejjija tal-ħamrija, il-ġardinar kisser tuba iebsa b'għodda żgħira.
formal.en: While preparing the soil, the gardener broke up a hard clod with a small tool.
formal.zh: 整理土壤时，园丁用一件小工具敲碎了一块硬土。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex ma nistax indaħħal il-pala hawn? Pawlu: Hemm tuba iebsa; ejja nkissruha l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why can't I get the spade into the ground here? Pawlu: There is a hard clod; let's break it up first.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：我怎么没法把铲子插进这里的土里？保罗：这里有块硬土，我们先把它敲碎吧。

messages.speaker: Marta (园艺学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistax indaħħal il-pala hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistax indaħħal il-pala hawn?
messages.zh: 我怎么没法把铲子插进这里的土里？
messages.en: Why can't I get the spade into the ground here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm tuba iebsa; ejja nkissruha l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm tuba iebsa; ejja nkissruha l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 这里有块硬土，我们先把它敲碎吧。
messages.en: There is a hard clod; let's break it up first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用花盆里的一块硬土记住本义，再单独记住指人时是贬义的“笨蛋”；这是学习联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wood pigeon, a particular kind of pigeon.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 林鸽，鸽类中的一种鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur ta' tip partikolari ta' ħamiem, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala wood pigeon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 林鸽，一种鸽类鸟。

collocations.en: a wood pigeon on a branch
a wood pigeon in the garden

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-għasafar, l-istudenti raw tudun fuq fergħa qrib il-mogħdija.
formal.en: During the birdwatching activity, the students saw a wood pigeon on a branch near the path.
formal.zh: 观鸟活动中，学生们看见小径旁的树枝上有一只林鸽。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qed tara dak l-għasfur fuq il-fergħa? Mark: Iva, dak tudun. Ħa nieħu ritratt minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you see that bird on the branch? Mark: Yes, that's a wood pigeon. Let me take a photo from here.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你看见树枝上的那只鸟了吗？马克：看见了，那是只林鸽。我从这里拍张照片。

messages.speaker: Sara (观鸟伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara dak l-għasfur fuq il-fergħa?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara dak l-għasfur fuq il-fergħa?
messages.zh: 你看见树枝上的那只鸟了吗？
messages.en: Can you see that bird on the branch?

messages.speaker: Mark (观鸟伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak tudun. Ħa nieħu ritratt minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak tudun. Ħa nieħu ritratt minn hawn.
messages.zh: 看见了，那是只林鸽。我从这里拍张照片。
messages.en: Yes, that's a wood pigeon. Let me take a photo from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象观鸟笔记里画着树枝上的林鸽，在图旁写下 tudun，并把它与英语 wood pigeon 成对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rough push given to someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对人或物粗暴地推一下，强调动作的猛烈或不客气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imbuttatura ħarxa mogħtija lil persuna jew lil xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗暴的一推；猛推一下。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, ir-raġel ta tuffatura lill-persuna li kienet quddiemu fil-kju.
formal.en: According to the report, the man gave the person ahead of him in the queue a rough push.
formal.zh: 据报告记载，那名男子猛推了一下排在他前面的人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex waqajt? Toni: Xi ħadd tani tuffatura minn wara, imma issa jien sew.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you fall? Toni: Someone gave me a rough push from behind, but I'm all right now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你怎么摔倒了？托尼：有人从后面猛推了我一下，不过我现在没事了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么摔倒了？
messages.en: Why did you fall?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd tani tuffatura minn wara, imma issa jien sew.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd tani tuffatura minn wara, imma issa jien sew.
messages.zh: 有人从后面猛推了我一下，不过我现在没事了。
messages.en: Someone gave me a rough push from behind, but I'm all right now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“排队时突然被猛推一下”的画面记住 tuffatura，重点记它是一次粗暴推动的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A toucan, meaning any bird belonging to the family Ramphastidae.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 巨嘴鸟，指鵎鵼科中的任何一种鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur li jagħmel parti mill-familja Ramphastidae.

sense_translations.en_definition: toucan (any bird of the family Ramphastidae)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 巨嘴鸟；鵎鵼，指鵎鵼科中的任何一种鸟。

collocations.en: a toucan with a large beak
collocations.zh: 一只长着大嘴的巨嘴鸟

formal.mt: Fil-ktieb tal-għasafar, ritratt ta' tukan juri l-munqar tiegħu b'mod ċar.
formal.en: In the bird book, a photograph of a toucan clearly shows its beak.
formal.zh: 鸟类图书中的一张巨嘴鸟照片清楚地展示了它的喙。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jismu dan l-għasfur fl-istampa? Ben: Tukan. Ara kemm hu kbir il-munqar tiegħu!
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this bird in the picture called? Ben: A toucan. Look how big its beak is!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：图片里的这种鸟叫什么？本：巨嘴鸟。你看它的嘴多大！

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 图片里的这种鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What is this bird in the picture called?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tukan. Ara kemm hu kbir il-munqar tiegħu!
messages.mt_standard: Tukan. Ara kemm hu kbir il-munqar tiegħu!
messages.zh: 巨嘴鸟。你看它的嘴多大！
messages.en: A toucan. Look how big its beak is!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tukan 和英语 toucan 放在同一张巨嘴鸟图卡上，借相近的字形和大嘴形象一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tulip, a plant belonging to the genus Tulipa.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 郁金香，郁金香属的一种植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta li tagħmel parti mill-ġeneru Tulipa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 郁金香，郁金香属植物。

formal.mt: L-istudenta ħawlet basla ta' tulipan f'qasrija u kitbet id-data fit-tikketta.
formal.en: The student planted a tulip bulb in a pot and wrote the date on the label.
formal.zh: 那名学生把一颗郁金香种球种进花盆，并在标签上写下日期。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Liema fjura trid ħdejn it-tieqa? Leo: Irrid tulipan aħmar f'dik il-qasrija ż-żgħira.
colloquial.en: Anna: Which flower would you like beside the window? Leo: I'd like a red tulip in that little pot.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你想在窗边放什么花？利奥：我想在那个小花盆里放一株红色郁金香。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 你想在窗边放什么花？
messages.en: Which flower would you like beside the window?

messages.speaker: Leo (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid tulipan aħmar f'dik il-qasrija ż-żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Irrid tulipan aħmar f'dik il-qasrija ż-żgħira.
messages.zh: 我想在那个小花盆里放一株红色郁金香。
messages.en: I'd like a red tulip in that little pot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在郁金香图旁并排写 tulipan 和英语 tulip，利用共同的字母片段记词，再用红色花朵巩固画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called thulium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素铥的名称，对应英语 thulium。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala thulium.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铥，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Fir-reġistru tal-laboratorju, il-kampjun ġie elenkat bħala kampjun ta' tulju.
formal.en: In the laboratory register, the sample was listed as a sample of thulium.
formal.zh: 在实验室登记册中，这份样品被列为铥样品。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'għandi nikteb ħdejn thulium fil-lista bil-Malti? Adam: Ikteb tulju; dak hu l-isem tal-element bil-Malti.
colloquial.en: Nina: What should I write beside thulium in the Maltese list? Adam: Write tulju; that's the element's name in Maltese.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：在马耳他语词表里，thulium 旁边该写什么？亚当：写 tulju，那是这个元素的马耳他语名称。

messages.speaker: Nina (化学学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għandi nikteb ħdejn thulium fil-lista bil-Malti?
messages.mt_standard: X'għandi nikteb ħdejn thulium fil-lista bil-Malti?
messages.zh: 在马耳他语词表里，thulium 旁边该写什么？
messages.en: What should I write beside thulium in the Maltese list?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikteb tulju; dak hu l-isem tal-element bil-Malti.
messages.mt_standard: Ikteb tulju; dak hu l-isem tal-element bil-Malti.
messages.zh: 写 tulju，那是这个元素的马耳他语名称。
messages.en: Write tulju; that's the element's name in Maltese.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张元素词卡，正面写 tulju，背面写“铥／thulium”，用三语对应反复回忆，避免与郁金香混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tunis, the city that is the capital of Tunisia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 突尼斯市，即突尼斯这个国家的首都。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-belt kapitali tat-Tuneżija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 突尼斯市，突尼斯的首都。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir f'Tuneż, il-belt kapitali tat-Tuneżija.
formal.en: The meeting will take place in Tunis, the capital city of Tunisia.
formal.zh: 会议将在突尼斯的首都突尼斯市举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se toqgħod waqt il-vjaġġ? Samir: Se noqgħod f'Tuneż, ħdejn iċ-ċentru tal-belt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where will you stay during the trip? Samir: I'll stay in Tunis, near the city centre.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：旅行期间你会住在哪里？萨米尔：我会住在突尼斯市，靠近市中心。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 旅行期间你会住在哪里？
messages.en: Where will you stay during the trip?

messages.speaker: Samir (旅行者)
messages.mt_spoken: Se noqgħod f'Tuneż, ħdejn iċ-ċentru tal-belt.
messages.mt_standard: Se noqgħod f'Tuneż, ħdejn iċ-ċentru tal-belt.
messages.zh: 我会住在突尼斯市，靠近市中心。
messages.en: I'll stay in Tunis, near the city centre.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在地图上的首都位置写 Tuneż，并配上“突尼斯市／Tunis”；把城市名与国家名分开记，实际书写用大写首字母。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country in North Africa, officially called the Republic of Tunisia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于北非的国家，正式名称为突尼斯共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Afrika ta' Fuq, bl-isem uffiċjali Repubblika tat-Tuneżija.

sense_translations.en_definition: Tunisia (a country in North Africa; official name: Repubblika tat-Tuneżija)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 突尼斯，北非国家，正式名称为突尼斯共和国。

formal.mt: L-istudenti kitbu rapport dwar it-Tuneżija bħala pajjiż fl-Afrika ta' Fuq.
formal.en: The students wrote a report about Tunisia as a country in North Africa.
formal.zh: 学生们撰写了一份关于北非国家突尼斯的报告。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn sejra għall-vaganza? Rita: Se mmur it-Tuneżija ma' ħabibti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are you going on holiday? Rita: I'm going to Tunisia with my friend.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你准备去哪里度假？丽塔：我要和一位女性朋友去突尼斯。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你准备去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要和一位女性朋友去突尼斯。
messages.en: I'm going to Tunisia with my friend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Tuneżija 放在北非地图旁记忆，再用“去突尼斯旅行”的完整短语巩固国家名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or connected with Tunisia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于突尼斯、来自突尼斯或与突尼斯有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu tat-Tuneżija, ġej mit-Tuneżija jew għandu x'jaqsam magħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: Tunisian (of, from or relating to Tunisia)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 突尼斯的；来自突尼斯的；与突尼斯有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Tunisian (native or inhabitant of Tunisia) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 突尼斯人，指出生于或居住在突尼斯的人，通常指男性。

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-festival jinkludi film Tuneżin u diskussjoni mad-direttur tiegħu.
formal.en: The festival programme includes a Tunisian film and a discussion with its director.
formal.zh: 电影节的日程包括一部突尼斯电影，以及与该片导演的讨论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-film Tuneżin? Mark: Iva, u d-direttur tiegħu huwa Tuneżin ukoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this film Tunisian? Mark: Yes, and its director is Tunisian too.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是一部突尼斯电影吗？马克：是的，导演也是突尼斯人。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是一部突尼斯电影吗？
messages.en: Is this film Tunisian?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u d-direttur tiegħu huwa Tuneżin ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u d-direttur tiegħu huwa Tuneżin ukoll.
messages.zh: 是的，导演也是突尼斯人。
messages.en: Yes, and its director is Tunisian too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画区分词性：电影旁写 film Tuneżin，人物旁写 Tuneżin，分别记“突尼斯的”和“突尼斯人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called tungsten.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种化学元素，中文名称为钨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku magħruf bl-isem tungstenu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钨，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-laboratorju jinkludi r-riżultati tal-analiżi ta' kampjun ta' tungstenu.
formal.en: The laboratory report includes the results of the analysis of a tungsten sample.
formal.zh: 实验室报告包含一份钨样品的分析结果。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'hemm f'dan il-kontenitur? Pawlu: Kampjun ta' tungstenu għall-analiżi ta' għada.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's in this container? Pawlu: A tungsten sample for tomorrow's analysis.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个容器里有什么？保罗：一份钨样品，供明天分析使用。

messages.speaker: Sara (实验室同事)
messages.zh: 这个容器里有什么？
messages.en: What's in this container?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (实验室同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kampjun ta' tungstenu għall-analiżi ta' għada.
messages.mt_standard: Kampjun ta' tungstenu għall-analiżi ta' għada.
messages.zh: 一份钨样品，供明天分析使用。
messages.en: A tungsten sample for tomorrow's analysis.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象实验室样品瓶上并排贴着“tungstenu／钨”，用样品标签把马耳他语名称和中文名称配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of getting up into a standing position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体起身并进入站立姿势的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li wieħed iqum biex jiġi f'pożizzjoni wieqfa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 起立，指起身站起来的动作。

formal.mt: Waqt il-prova, l-atturi pprattikaw it-tuqif mis-siġġu bħala parti mix-xena.
formal.en: During the rehearsal, the actors practised standing up from a chair as part of the scene.
formal.zh: 排练时，演员们练习了场景中从椅子上站起的动作。

colloquial.mt: Nina: It-tuqif mis-siġġu nagħmlu malajr jew bil-mod? David: Bil-mod, u mbagħad ħares lejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Nina: Should I stand up from the chair quickly or slowly? David: Slowly, and then look towards the door.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：从椅子上站起这个动作，我该做得快一点还是慢一点？戴维：慢一点，然后看向门口。

messages.speaker: Nina (演员)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tuqif mis-siġġu nagħmlu malajr jew bil-mod?
messages.mt_standard: It-tuqif mis-siġġu nagħmlu malajr jew bil-mod?
messages.zh: 从椅子上站起这个动作，我该做得快一点还是慢一点？
messages.en: Should I stand up from the chair quickly or slowly?

messages.speaker: David (导演)
messages.mt_spoken: Bil-mod, u mbagħad ħares lejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Bil-mod, u mbagħad ħares lejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 慢一点，然后看向门口。
messages.en: Slowly, and then look towards the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tuqif 配上“坐着的人起身站直”的连续画面，重点记住这是起立的动作名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of falling from a higher position to a lower one.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从较高位置向较低位置落下的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa taqa' minn pożizzjoni ogħla għal waħda aktar baxxa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 下落、掉落或跌落这一动作。

formal.mt: Il-filmat juri t-tuqigħ ta' werqa minn siġra sal-art.
formal.en: The video shows a leaf falling from a tree to the ground.
formal.zh: 视频展示了一片叶子从树上落到地面的过程。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Irnexxielek tiffilmja t-tuqigħ tal-werqa? Mark: Iva, mill-fergħa sal-art.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you manage to film the leaf falling? Mark: Yes, from the branch all the way to the ground.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你拍到那片叶子落下的过程了吗？马克：拍到了，从树枝上一直到地面。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你拍到那片叶子落下的过程了吗？
messages.en: Did you manage to film the leaf falling?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 拍到了，从树枝上一直到地面。
messages.en: Yes, from the branch all the way to the ground.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tuqigħ 画一支向下箭头，旁边画叶子落地；再与 tuqif 的起立画面对照，分清下落和站起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The choice or arrangement of when an action or event happens.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对动作或事件发生时间的选择与安排，尤其指时机的把握。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għażla jew l-arranġament tal-ħin meta ssir azzjoni jew iseħħ avveniment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 时机的把握；动作或事件发生时间的安排。

formal.mt: It-tuqit tal-intervent waqt id-dibattitu kien tajjeb, għax il-kelliem kien għadu kemm temm l-argument tiegħu.
formal.en: The intervention during the debate was well timed, because the speaker had just finished his argument.
formal.zh: 辩论中的这次介入时机恰当，因为发言者刚刚讲完自己的论点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kien it-tuqit taċ-ċajta tiegħi? Rita: Tajjeb ħafna! Għedtha eżatt wara l-pawża.
colloquial.en: Maja: How was the timing of my joke? Rita: Very good! You told it right after the pause.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我讲那个笑话的时机把握得怎么样？丽塔：很好！你正好在停顿之后讲了出来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我讲那个笑话的时机把握得怎么样？
messages.en: How was the timing of my joke?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb ħafna! Għedtha eżatt wara l-pawża.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb ħafna! Għedtha eżatt wara l-pawża.
messages.zh: 很好！你正好在停顿之后讲了出来。
messages.en: Very good! You told it right after the pause.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象讲笑话前先停顿、再开口的节奏，把 tuqit 记成“事情在什么时候发生才合适”的时机把握。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large amount of dust, including dust gathered into a cloud in the air.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大量的尘土，也可指尘土扬起后形成的尘云。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħafna trab, jew sħaba ta' trab fl-arja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大量尘土；很多灰尘。
尘云，指尘土在空中聚成的云团。

collocations.en: a lot of dust in the road
a cloud of dust in the air

formal.mt: Il-vetturi qajmu turbien li għal ftit ħin għatta t-triq.
formal.en: The vehicles raised a cloud of dust that briefly obscured the road.
formal.zh: 车辆扬起一团尘云，短暂地遮住了道路。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex għalaqt it-tieqa? Pawlu: Għadda trakk u qajjem turbien sħiħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you close the window? Pawlu: A truck went past and kicked up a huge cloud of dust.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么关上窗户？保罗：一辆卡车经过，扬起了一大团尘土。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么关上窗户？
messages.en: Why did you close the window?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadda trakk u qajjem turbien sħiħ.
messages.mt_standard: Għadda trakk u qajjem turbien sħiħ.
messages.zh: 一辆卡车经过，扬起了一大团尘土。
messages.en: A truck went past and kicked up a huge cloud of dust.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象卡车经过后尘土成团扬起，用同一画面连接 turbien 的两个意思：大量尘土和空中的尘云。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Turkey, a country with territory in southeastern Europe and western Asia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 土耳其，领土横跨欧洲东南部和亚洲西部的国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż b'territorju fix-Xlokk tal-Ewropa u fil-Punent tal-Asja.

sense_translations.en_definition: Turkey (a country located in Eastern Thrace in Southeastern Europe and Anatolia in West Asia; official name: Repubblika tat-Turkija)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 土耳其，位于欧洲东南部的东色雷斯和亚洲西部的安纳托利亚的国家；正式名称为土耳其共和国。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi r-relazzjonijiet kulturali bejn Malta u t-Turkija.
formal.en: The report describes cultural relations between Malta and Turkey.
formal.zh: 这份报告介绍了马耳他与土耳其之间的文化关系。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Fejn sejjer għall-vaganza? Mark: Se mmur it-Turkija ma' ħuti.
colloquial.en: Lina: Where are you going on holiday? Mark: I'm going to Turkey with my siblings.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你要去哪里度假？马克：我要和兄弟姐妹一起去土耳其。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要和兄弟姐妹一起去土耳其。
messages.en: I'm going to Turkey with my siblings.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Turkija 写在横跨欧亚的地图位置上，再用“去土耳其旅行”这一场景记住国名。

gloss_zh: 土库曼斯坦的；土库曼斯坦人；土库曼语

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or connected with Turkmenistan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 土库曼斯坦的、来自土库曼斯坦的，或与土库曼斯坦有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mit-Turkmenistan jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' dan il-pajjiż.

sense_translations.en_definition: Turkmen (of, from or relating to Turkmenistan)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 土库曼斯坦的；来自土库曼斯坦的；与土库曼斯坦有关的。
土库曼斯坦人；出生于土库曼斯坦或居住在该国的人。
土库曼语，一种语言的名称。

collocations.en: a Turkmen person living in Malta
collocations.zh: 住在马耳他的土库曼斯坦人

formal.mt: Il-mużew qed jesponi tapit Turkmen bħala parti minn wirja dwar l-arti tal-Asja Ċentrali.
formal.en: The museum is displaying a Turkmen carpet as part of an exhibition on Central Asian art.
formal.zh: 博物馆正在一场中亚艺术展览中展出一张土库曼地毯。

colloquial.mt: Sara: B'liema lingwa qed jitkellem dak ir-raġel? Pawlu: Bit-Turkmen. Huwa mit-Turkmenistan.
colloquial.en: Sara: What language is that man speaking? Pawlu: Turkmen. He is from Turkmenistan.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那个男人在说什么语言？保罗：土库曼语。他来自土库曼斯坦。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: B'liema lingwa qed jitkellem dak ir-raġel?
messages.mt_standard: B'liema lingwa qed jitkellem dak ir-raġel?
messages.zh: 那个男人在说什么语言？
messages.en: What language is that man speaking?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 土库曼语。他来自土库曼斯坦。
messages.en: Turkmen. He is from Turkmenistan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张卡片记同一形式：地毯旁表示“土库曼的”，人物旁表示“土库曼斯坦人”，说话气泡旁表示“土库曼语”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a blue-green colour like turquoise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈绿松石般的蓝绿色的，用于描述物体的颜色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu lewn bejn il-blu u l-aħdar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绿松石色的；呈蓝绿色的。

formal.mt: Il-logo juża kulur turkwas fuq sfond abjad.
formal.en: The logo uses a turquoise colour on a white background.
formal.zh: 这个标志在白色背景上使用了绿松石色。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema flokk se tilbes? Lara: Dak turkwas; jogħġobni ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which shirt are you going to wear? Lara: The turquoise one; I really like it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你要穿哪件上衣？拉拉：那件蓝绿色的，我很喜欢。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要穿哪件上衣？
messages.en: Which shirt are you going to wear?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那件蓝绿色的，我很喜欢。
messages.en: The turquoise one; I really like it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一块介于蓝色和绿色之间的色块，旁边写 turkwas，再想象自己穿着同色上衣来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of shaping a rotating piece of material on a lathe with a cutting tool.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 车削，即在车床上使工件旋转，并用刀具切削成形的加工过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih biċċa materjal iddur fuq torn u tingħata forma b'għodda li taqta'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 车削；利用车床对旋转的工件进行切削加工。

formal.mt: Matul il-lezzjoni, l-għalliem wera kif it-turnjatura tagħti forma ċilindrika lil biċċa injam.
formal.en: During the lesson, the teacher demonstrated how turning gives a piece of wood a cylindrical shape.
formal.zh: 课堂上，老师演示了如何通过车削把一块木料加工成圆柱形。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif għamilt dan il-manku tond? Toni: Bit-turnjatura tal-injam, fuq it-torn tal-ħanut tax-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did you make this round handle? Toni: By woodturning, on the workshop lathe.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你是怎么做出这个圆形手柄的？托尼：通过木材车削，用的是工坊里的车床。

messages.speaker: Nina (学员)
messages.zh: 你是怎么做出这个圆形手柄的？
messages.en: How did you make this round handle?

messages.speaker: Toni (工坊师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Bit-turnjatura tal-injam, fuq it-torn tal-ħanut tax-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Bit-turnjatura tal-injam, fuq it-torn tal-ħanut tax-xogħol.
messages.zh: 通过木材车削，用的是工坊里的车床。
messages.en: By woodturning, on the workshop lathe.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 turnjatura 配上“木料旋转、刀具切削、圆柱成形”三格图，用加工动作记住“车削”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The maidenhair fern Adiantum capillus-veneris, a fern with delicate leaflets on thin, dark stalks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 铁线蕨，学名 Adiantum capillus-veneris，一种具有纤细深色叶柄和小巧叶片的蕨类植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Felċi tal-ispeċi Adiantum capillus-veneris, b'weraq żgħir u delikat fuq zkuk irqaq u skuri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铁线蕨，学名 Adiantum capillus-veneris。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw il-weraq delikat tat-tursin il-bir waqt il-lezzjoni tal-botanika.
formal.en: The students observed the delicate leaves of the maidenhair fern during the botany lesson.
formal.zh: 学生们在植物学课上观察了铁线蕨纤巧的叶片。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha din il-pjanta fil-qasrija? Rita: Tursin il-bir. Ara kemm għandu weraq żgħir!
colloquial.en: Maja: What's this plant in the pot called? Rita: Maidenhair fern. Look how small its leaves are!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：盆里这株植物叫什么？丽塔：铁线蕨。你看，它的叶片多小啊！

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 盆里这株植物叫什么？
messages.en: What's this plant in the pot called?

messages.speaker: Rita (花店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tursin il-bir. Ara kemm għandu weraq żgħir!
messages.mt_standard: Tursin il-bir. Ara kemm għandu weraq żgħir!
messages.zh: 铁线蕨。你看，它的叶片多小啊！
messages.en: Maidenhair fern. Look how small its leaves are!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tursin il-bir 当作完整植物名来记，在词卡旁画出细黑叶柄和小叶片，与“铁线蕨”对应。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition of being unable to hear, either partly or completely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 耳聋或失聪，指部分或完全丧失听觉的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kundizzjoni li fiha persuna ma tismax, parzjalment jew għalkollox.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 耳聋；失聪，即部分或完全丧失听觉的状态。

formal.mt: Il-fuljett jipprovdi informazzjoni dwar it-turxien u s-servizzi ta' appoġġ disponibbli.
formal.en: The leaflet provides information about deafness and the support services available.
formal.zh: 这本小册子介绍了耳聋及可获得的支持服务。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-filmat għandu sottotitli? Ben: Iva, għandu sottotitli biex ikun aċċessibbli wkoll għal persuni bit-turxien.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this video have subtitles? Ben: Yes, it has subtitles so that it is also accessible to people with deafness.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个视频有字幕吗？本：有，这样失聪人士也能观看并理解内容。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 这个视频有字幕吗？
messages.en: Does this video have subtitles?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandu sottotitli biex ikun aċċessibbli wkoll għal persuni bit-turxien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandu sottotitli biex ikun aċċessibbli wkoll għal persuni bit-turxien.
messages.zh: 有，这样失聪人士也能观看并理解内容。
messages.en: Yes, it has subtitles so that it is also accessible to people with deafness.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 turxien 放在“听觉状态”词卡上，配上耳朵和字幕图标，记住它是表示“失聪”的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who interprets spoken language so that people using different languages can understand one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在不同语言的使用者之间进行口头翻译，帮助双方互相理解的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tittraduċi bil-fomm bejn lingwi differenti biex in-nies jifhmu lil xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 口译员；为使用不同语言的人提供口头翻译的人。

collocations.en: an interpreter between Maltese and Arabic
collocations.zh: 马耳他语与阿拉伯语之间的口译员

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa, turċman ittraduċa l-mistoqsijiet u t-tweġibiet bejn il-Malti u l-Għarbi.
formal.en: During the meeting, an interpreter translated the questions and answers between Maltese and Arabic.
formal.zh: 会议期间，一位口译员在马耳他语和阿拉伯语之间翻译了提问与回答。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Se jkun hemm turċman fil-laqgħa? Maja: Iva, se jgħinna nifhmu l-mistoqsijiet u t-tweġibiet.
