colloquial.en: Mark: Will there be an interpreter at the meeting? Maja: Yes, he'll help us understand the questions and answers.
colloquial.zh: 马克：会上会有口译员吗？玛雅：会有，他会帮助我们听懂提问和回答。

messages.speaker: Mark (参会者)
messages.zh: 会上会有口译员吗？
messages.en: Will there be an interpreter at the meeting?

messages.speaker: Maja (会议组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se jgħinna nifhmu l-mistoqsijiet u t-tweġibiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se jgħinna nifhmu l-mistoqsijiet u t-tweġibiet.
messages.zh: 会有，他会帮助我们听懂提问和回答。
messages.en: Yes, he'll help us understand the questions and answers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两位说不同语言的人，中间站着 turċman，把双方的话口头转达；用这个三人场景记住“口译员”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making something wider or broader, physically or in scope.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使事物在实际宽度或涉及范围上变得更宽、更广的过程；拓宽或扩展。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir usa', fid-daqs jew fil-firxa tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加宽；拓宽，指使宽度增大的过程。
拓展；扩大，指使范围、知识或视野变得更广的过程。

formal.mt: Il-proġett jinkludi t-tusigħ tat-triq biex ikun hemm aktar spazju għall-karozzi tal-linja.
formal.en: The project includes widening the road to provide more space for buses.
formal.zh: 该项目包括拓宽道路，以便为公共汽车提供更多空间。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex hemm ix-xogħol f'din it-triq? Mark: Qed jagħmlu t-tusigħ tat-triq ħdejn il-waqfa tal-karozzi tal-linja.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is there construction work on this road? Mark: They're widening the road near the bus stop.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这条路为什么在施工？马克：他们正在公交车站附近拓宽道路。

messages.speaker: Nina (居民)
messages.zh: 这条路为什么在施工？
messages.en: Why is there construction work on this road?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jagħmlu t-tusigħ tat-triq ħdejn il-waqfa tal-karozzi tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Qed jagħmlu t-tusigħ tat-triq ħdejn il-waqfa tal-karozzi tal-linja.
messages.zh: 他们正在公交车站附近拓宽道路。
messages.en: They're widening the road near the bus stop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两支向外展开的箭头：放在道路两侧表示“加宽”，放在知识圈外表示“拓展”，两种图都标 tusigħ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The small, juicy fruit of a mulberry tree.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 桑葚，即桑树结出的个小、多汁的果实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-frott żgħir u mmerraq li jikber fuq is-siġra tat-tut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 桑葚；桑树的果实。
黑莓；黑莓植株结出的果实。
浆果；日常用语中对某些小而多汁的果实的称呼。

collocations.en: mulberry or blackberry jam, depending on context
collocations.zh: 桑葚酱或黑莓酱，具体依语境而定

collocations.en: fresh mulberries or blackberries, depending on context
collocations.zh: 新鲜桑葚或黑莓，具体依语境而定

formal.mt: L-istudenti ġabru t-tut mis-siġra fil-ġnien u osservaw il-kulur u l-forma tal-frott.
formal.en: The students picked mulberries from the tree in the garden and observed the colour and shape of the fruit.
formal.zh: 学生们从花园里的桑树上采下桑葚，并观察果实的颜色和形状。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan it-tut ġej mis-siġra tal-ġnien? Nannu: Iva, ġbartu dalgħodu. Trid idduqu?
colloquial.en: Maja: Are these mulberries from the tree in the garden? Grandfather: Yes, I picked them this morning. Would you like to taste them?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些桑葚是花园里那棵树上结的吗？爷爷：是啊，我今天早上摘的。你想尝尝吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.zh: 这些桑葚是花园里那棵树上结的吗？
messages.en: Are these mulberries from the tree in the garden?

messages.speaker: Nannu (爷爷)
messages.zh: 是啊，我今天早上摘的。你想尝尝吗？
messages.en: Yes, I picked them this morning. Would you like to taste them?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tut 写在水果篮上，篮内分放桑葚和黑莓图片；读句子时借助树木、果酱等语境确定具体所指。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The responsibility of protecting and caring for someone as their guardian or tutor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为监护人照顾、保护并指导他人的职责或监护关系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-responsabbiltà li tieħu ħsieb persuna, tipproteġiha u tiggwidaha bħala tutur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 监护；担任监护人或指导者的职责。

collocations.en: under the guardianship of an adult
collocations.zh: 在一名成年人的监护下

formal.mt: Id-dokument jispjega min għandu r-responsabbiltà għat-tutela tat-tifel.
formal.en: The document explains who is responsible for the child's guardianship.
formal.zh: 该文件说明了谁负责这名儿童的监护。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min qed jieħu ħsieb it-tifel? Pawlu: Iz-zija tiegħu; qiegħed taħt it-tutela tagħha.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who is looking after the boy? Pawlu: His aunt; he is under her guardianship.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：谁在照顾那个男孩？保罗：他的姨妈；他由她监护。

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.zh: 谁在照顾那个男孩？
messages.en: Who is looking after the boy?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iz-zija tiegħu; qiegħed taħt it-tutela tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Iz-zija tiegħu; qiegħed taħt it-tutela tagħha.
messages.zh: 他的姨妈；他由她监护。
messages.en: His aunt; he is under her guardianship.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tutela 与“有人负责照顾和保护孩子”的画面联系起来，并整组记住 taħt it-tutela，表示“在监护之下”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Providing protection, care, or guidance in the role of a guardian.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 像监护人一样提供保护、照顾或指导的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jipproteġi, jieħu ħsieb jew jiggwida bħal tutur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 监护的；起保护或指导作用的。

formal.mt: L-istituzzjoni għandha funzjoni tutelari fil-ħarsien tat-tfal.
formal.en: The institution has a tutelary function in safeguarding children.
formal.zh: 该机构在保障儿童安全方面承担监护职能。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser li għandha rwol tutelari? Mark: Jiġifieri li tipproteġi u tiggwida lil min jieħu ħsieb.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does it mean that she has a tutelary role? Mark: It means that she protects and guides those in her care.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：说她承担监护角色是什么意思？马克：意思是她保护并指导由她照顾的人。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser li għandha rwol tutelari?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser li għandha rwol tutelari?
messages.zh: 说她承担监护角色是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean that she has a tutelary role?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri li tipproteġi u tiggwida lil min jieħu ħsieb.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri li tipproteġi u tiggwida lil min jieħu ħsieb.
messages.zh: 意思是她保护并指导由她照顾的人。
messages.en: It means that she protects and guides those in her care.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tutelari 放在 rwol“角色”后一起记：这个角色负责保护和指导别人；注意它是描述性质的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making a surface level or even.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使地面或其他表面变得平整的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih wiċċ isir ċatt u mingħajr ħotob.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 整平；使表面平整的过程。

formal.mt: It-tutija tal-art trid titlesta qabel ma jibda t-tqegħid tal-madum.
formal.en: The levelling of the floor must be completed before the laying of tiles begins.
formal.zh: 铺设地砖开始前，必须完成地面找平。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nistgħu nibdew inqiegħdu l-madum? Toni: Għad le; l-ewwel irridu nlestu t-tutija tal-art.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can we start laying the tiles? Toni: Not yet; first we need to finish levelling the floor.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们可以开始铺地砖了吗？托尼：还不行；得先完成地面找平。

messages.speaker: Lara (屋主)
messages.zh: 我们可以开始铺地砖了吗？
messages.en: Can we start laying the tiles?

messages.speaker: Toni (工匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad le; l-ewwel irridu nlestu t-tutija tal-art.
messages.mt_standard: Għad le; l-ewwel irridu nlestu t-tutija tal-art.
messages.zh: 还不行；得先完成地面找平。
messages.en: Not yet; first we need to finish levelling the floor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象铺地砖前先把凹凸地面弄平，用“先找平，再铺砖”的施工顺序记住 tutija 表示整平过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making something stronger or more secure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物更加坚固、牢靠或有力的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir aktar b'saħħitha jew aktar soda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加强；加固；使某物更坚固的过程。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jirrakkomanda t-tutiq tal-ħajt qabel ma jsir aktar xogħol fuq il-bini.
formal.en: The report recommends strengthening the wall before further work is carried out on the building.
formal.zh: 报告建议先加固墙体，再对建筑物开展进一步施工。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex għadna ma bdejniex niżbgħu? Ġorġ: L-ewwel hemm bżonn it-tutiq tal-ħajt.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why haven't we started painting yet? Ġorġ: The wall needs strengthening first.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们怎么还没开始刷漆？乔治：得先加固墙体。

messages.speaker: Nina (屋主)
messages.zh: 我们怎么还没开始刷漆？
messages.en: Why haven't we started painting yet?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (工匠)
messages.zh: 得先加固墙体。
messages.en: The wall needs strengthening first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“墙先加固，再刷颜色”的画面记 tutiq；它强调变得更坚固，可与表示整平的 tutija 分开记忆。

gloss_zh: 图瓦卢的；图瓦卢人；图瓦卢语

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or connected with Tuvalu, its people, or its culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于、来自或涉及图瓦卢及其人民或文化的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej minn Tuvalu jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' Tuvalu, man-nies tiegħu jew mal-kultura tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: Tuvaluan (of, from or relating to Tuvalu)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 图瓦卢的；来自图瓦卢或与图瓦卢有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Tuvaluan (native or inhabitant of Tuvalu) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 图瓦卢本地人或居民，通常指男性。
图瓦卢语。

formal.mt: Il-programm kulturali jinkludi intervista ma' artist Tuvalan dwar ix-xogħol tiegħu.
formal.en: The cultural programme includes an interview with a Tuvaluan artist about his work.
formal.zh: 该文化节目包含一段关于一位图瓦卢艺术家作品的访谈。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kantant Tuvalan? Leo: Iva, ġej minn Tuvalu u jkanta bit-Tuvalan.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this singer Tuvaluan? Leo: Yes, he comes from Tuvalu and sings in Tuvaluan.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这位歌手是图瓦卢的吗？莱奥：是的，他来自图瓦卢，用图瓦卢语唱歌。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这位歌手是图瓦卢的吗？
messages.en: Is this singer Tuvaluan?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej minn Tuvalu u jkanta bit-Tuvalan.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej minn Tuvalu u jkanta bit-Tuvalan.
messages.zh: 是的，他来自图瓦卢，用图瓦卢语唱歌。
messages.en: Yes, he comes from Tuvalu and sings in Tuvaluan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 围绕“图瓦卢”建立三格卡片：形容词表示图瓦卢的，人物名词表示图瓦卢人，语言名词表示图瓦卢语；根据句中位置判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be launched, such as a vessel being put into the water or a project being started.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被正式推出或启动，也可指船只下水。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitniżżel fl-ilma, bħal bastiment, jew li jingħata bidu għalih, bħal proġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被推出；被启动；指船只时为下水。

formal.mt: Il-bastiment il-ġdid tvara waqt ċerimonja li għaliha attendew il-ħaddiema tat-tarzna.
formal.en: The new vessel was launched during a ceremony attended by the shipyard workers.
formal.zh: 新船在造船厂工人出席的仪式中下水。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Il-bastiment għadu fit-tarzna? Ben: Le, tvara dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is the vessel still in the shipyard? Ben: No, it was launched this morning.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：那艘船还在造船厂吗？本：不在了，今天早上下水了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 那艘船还在造船厂吗？
messages.en: Is the vessel still in the shipyard?

messages.speaker: Ben (造船厂工人)
messages.zh: 不在了，今天早上下水了。
messages.en: No, it was launched this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“新船正式进入水中”的画面记 tvara，再联想到项目正式启动；记忆重点是某物被推出或投入运行。

gloss_zh: 被变换；被调整得更多样

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be changed in form or content so that it becomes different or more varied.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形式或内容被变换，从而有所不同或更加多样。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinbidel fil-forma jew fil-kontenut biex ikun differenti jew aktar varjat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被变换；被调整，使形式或内容有所变化。

formal.mt: Il-programm tvarja biex jinkludi kemm diskussjonijiet kif ukoll attivitajiet prattiċi.
formal.en: The programme was varied to include both discussions and practical activities.
formal.zh: 活动安排经过调整，加入了讨论和实践活动，使内容更加多样。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-menu għadu l-istess? Sam: Le, tvarja ftit; issa hemm aktar platti tal-ħaxix.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is the menu still the same? Sam: No, it has been varied a little; there are more vegetable dishes now.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：菜单还是原来那样吗？萨姆：不是，稍微作了些调整；现在蔬菜菜品更多了。

messages.speaker: Rita (顾客)
messages.zh: 菜单还是原来那样吗？
messages.en: Is the menu still the same?

messages.speaker: Sam (服务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tvarja ftit; issa hemm aktar platti tal-ħaxix.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tvarja ftit; issa hemm aktar platti tal-ħaxix.
messages.zh: 不是，稍微作了些调整；现在蔬菜菜品更多了。
messages.en: No, it has been varied a little; there are more vegetable dishes now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象原本单一的菜单经过调整，增加了不同菜品，用“内容被变换”的画面记 tvarja，并与表示启动的 tvara 区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be thrown or hurled with considerable force.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到较大力量而被抛出或猛掷出去。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jintefa' jew jitwaddab b'forza kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被用力抛出；被猛力掷出。

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżerċizzju, il-ballun tvenven lejn ix-xibka b'forza kbira.
formal.en: During the exercise, the ball was hurled towards the net with great force.
formal.zh: 训练过程中，球被猛力掷向球网。

colloquial.mt: Mila: Għaliex waqa' l-vażun? Niko: Il-ballun tvenven lejn il-mejda u laqtu.
colloquial.en: Mila: Why did the vase fall? Niko: The ball was hurled towards the table and hit it.
colloquial.zh: 米拉：花瓶怎么掉下来了？尼科：球被猛力掷向桌子，撞到了花瓶。

messages.speaker: Mila (姐姐)
messages.zh: 花瓶怎么掉下来了？
messages.en: Why did the vase fall?

messages.speaker: Niko (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ballun tvenven lejn il-mejda u laqtu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ballun tvenven lejn il-mejda u laqtu.
messages.zh: 球被猛力掷向桌子，撞到了花瓶。
messages.en: The ball was hurled towards the table and hit it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个球被猛力掷出，快速飞向球网，用这个有力度的动作记 tvenven；重点同时记住“被抛出”和“用力”两层意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Vibration, throwing with great force, or the howling sound of the wind, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依语境指物体的振动、用很大力气投掷的动作，或风呼啸的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rogħda jew ċaqliq ripetut, twaddib b'saħħa kbira, jew ħoss qawwi tar-riħ, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 振动；物体反复颤动的现象。
猛掷；用很大的力气把东西扔出去。
风的呼啸；风发出的持续而强烈的声音。

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl, it-tvenvin tar-riħ instema' minn ġewwa l-bini.
formal.en: During the night, the howling of the wind could be heard from inside the building.
formal.zh: 夜间，在建筑物内可以听到风的呼啸声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tħoss it-tvenvin tal-magna? Mark: Iva, anki l-mejda qed titħawwad. Ejja nitfuha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you feel the machine vibrating? Mark: Yes, even the table is shaking. Let's turn it off.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你感觉到机器的振动了吗？Mark：感觉到了，连桌子都在晃。我们把机器关掉吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你感觉到机器的振动了吗？
messages.en: Can you feel the machine vibrating?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, anki l-mejda qed titħawwad. Ejja nitfuha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, anki l-mejda qed titħawwad. Ejja nitfuha.
messages.zh: 感觉到了，连桌子都在晃。我们把机器关掉吧。
messages.en: Yes, even the table is shaking. Let's turn it off.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个画面并排记：机器振、石头猛掷、狂风呼啸；看到搭配中的机器、投掷物或风，再选择对应义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be overcome or successfully dealt with, especially of an obstacle or difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指障碍或困难被克服、被成功解决。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal ostaklu jew diffikultà li jingħelbu jew jiġu solvuti b'suċċess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被克服；指障碍、困难等被成功战胜。

formal.mt: L-ostaklu ewlieni tvinċa permezz ta' ppjanar bir-reqqa u kooperazzjoni bejn il-membri tat-tim.
formal.en: The main obstacle was overcome through careful planning and cooperation among the team members.
formal.zh: 通过周密规划和团队成员之间的合作，主要障碍被克服了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: L-ostaklu li kellkom ilbieraħ tvinċa? Pawlu: Iva, sibna soluzzjoni u issa nistgħu nkomplu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Was the obstacle you had yesterday overcome? Pawlu: Yes, we found a solution and can carry on now.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你们昨天遇到的障碍克服了吗？Pawlu：克服了，我们找到了解决办法，现在可以继续了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你们昨天遇到的障碍克服了吗？
messages.en: Was the obstacle you had yesterday overcome?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, sibna soluzzjoni u issa nistgħu nkomplu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, sibna soluzzjoni u issa nistgħu nkomplu.
messages.zh: 克服了，我们找到了解决办法，现在可以继续了。
messages.en: Yes, we found a solution and can carry on now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一道已经跨过去的路障：句子的焦点是障碍被克服，而不是谁去克服它，用这个画面记住被动意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A triumph or victory achieved in a contest or after overcoming difficulties.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在竞赛中取胜，或克服困难后取得的重大成功。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Suċċess kbir jew rebħa f'kompetizzjoni jew wara li jingħelbu diffikultajiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 重大成功；克服挑战后取得的辉煌成就。
胜利；在比赛、竞争或斗争中获胜。

collocations.zh: 巨大的成功；重大的胜利

formal.mt: It-tvinċija tat-tim fil-finali kienet ir-riżultat ta' xhur ta' taħriġ regolari.
formal.en: The team's victory in the final was the result of months of regular training.
formal.zh: 球队在决赛中的胜利，是数月坚持训练的成果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tvinċija kbira għat-tim tagħna! Mark: Veru! Wara dak it-taħriġ kollu, għandhom għalfejn jifirħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What a great victory for our team! Mark: Absolutely! After all that training, they have every reason to celebrate.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们队这场胜利太棒了！Mark：是啊！练了那么久，他们完全有理由好好庆祝。

messages.speaker: Maja (球迷朋友)
messages.zh: 我们队这场胜利太棒了！
messages.en: What a great victory for our team!

messages.speaker: Mark (球迷朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru! Wara dak it-taħriġ kollu, għandhom għalfejn jifirħu.
messages.mt_standard: Veru! Wara dak it-taħriġ kollu, għandhom għalfejn jifirħu.
messages.zh: 是啊！练了那么久，他们完全有理由好好庆祝。
messages.en: Absolutely! After all that training, they have every reason to celebrate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词写在想象中的奖杯上：比赛赢了是胜利，艰难任务终于完成是重大成功，两种场景都指向成功的结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be thrown or cast through the air by someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物体被人扔出或投掷出去。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal oġġett li jintrema jew jitwaddab fl-arja minn xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被扔出；被投掷。

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżerċizzju, il-ballun twaddab lejn il-plejer li kien ħdejn il-linja.
formal.en: During the exercise, the ball was thrown towards the player standing near the line.
formal.zh: 练习中，球被投向站在边线附近的球员。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn mar il-ballun? Pawlu: Twaddab wara l-ħajt. Se mmur inġibu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did the ball go? Pawlu: It was thrown over the wall. I'll go and get it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：球到哪里去了？Pawlu：被扔到墙那边去了。我去拿回来。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 球到哪里去了？
messages.en: Where did the ball go?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Twaddab wara l-ħajt. Se mmur inġibu.
messages.mt_standard: Twaddab wara l-ħajt. Se mmur inġibu.
messages.zh: 被扔到墙那边去了。我去拿回来。
messages.en: It was thrown over the wall. I'll go and get it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把注意力放在飞出去的球上，心里说球被扔了；以承受动作的物体为主角，就容易记住这个词的教学义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of throwing something, including hurling it with force.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西投出去的动作，也可指用力猛掷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li titfa' jew twaddab xi ħaġa, kultant b'saħħa kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 投掷；把物体扔出去的动作。
猛掷；用很大的力气把物体投出去。

formal.mt: It-twaddib tal-ġebel lejn il-vetturi jista' jikkawża ġrieħi serji u ħsara.
formal.en: Throwing stones at vehicles can cause serious injuries and damage.
formal.zh: 向车辆投掷石块可能造成严重伤害和损坏。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'se nipprattikaw illum? Sara: It-twaddib tal-ballun. Ibda minn hawn u pprova tolqot il-mira.
colloquial.en: Mark: What are we going to practise today? Sara: Throwing the ball. Start from here and try to hit the target.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我们今天练什么？Sara：练投球。从这里开始，试着投中目标。

messages.speaker: Mark (学员)
messages.zh: 我们今天练什么？
messages.en: What are we going to practise today?

messages.speaker: Sara (教练)
messages.mt_spoken: It-twaddib tal-ballun. Ibda minn hawn u pprova tolqot il-mira.
messages.mt_standard: It-twaddib tal-ballun. Ibda minn hawn u pprova tolqot il-mira.
messages.zh: 练投球。从这里开始，试着投中目标。
messages.en: Throwing the ball. Start from here and try to hit the target.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张投球动作分解图：这里命名的是投掷这件事；力度加强时，就把同一动作理解成猛掷。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Somewhat tall or long; the diminutive form of 'twil'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示有点高或有点长，是 twil 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ftit twil; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'twil'.

sense_translations.en_definition: somewhat tall or long (the diminutive form of 'twil')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有点高或有点长的；twil 的指小形式。

collocations.zh: 一个个子有点高的男人

formal.mt: Kuritur twajjel jgħaqqad id-daħla mal-kamra tal-laqgħat.
formal.en: A somewhat long corridor connects the entrance to the meeting room.
formal.zh: 一条有点长的走廊连接着入口和会议室。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif se nagħraf lil Pawlu? Nina: Hu raġel twajjel bi qmis blu.
colloquial.en: Marta: How will I recognize Pawlu? Nina: He is a somewhat tall man wearing a blue shirt.
colloquial.zh: Marta：我怎么认出Pawlu？Nina：他个子有点高，穿着一件蓝衬衫。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 我怎么认出Pawlu？
messages.en: How will I recognize Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu raġel twajjel bi qmis blu.
messages.mt_standard: Hu raġel twajjel bi qmis blu.
messages.zh: 他个子有点高，穿着一件蓝衬衫。
messages.en: He is a somewhat tall man wearing a blue shirt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 twil 和 twajjel 配对记忆，给后者贴上“有点”的提示：形容人可说有点高，形容走廊可说有点长。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small bird; the diminutive form of 'tajra'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指体形小的鸟；是 tajra 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tajra żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'tajra'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小鸟（tajra 的指小形式）

collocations.en: a small bird on a branch
a small bird in the garden

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni fil-ġnien, it-tfal raw twajra fuq fergħa baxxa.
formal.en: During their observation in the garden, the children saw a small bird on a low branch.
formal.zh: 在花园进行观察时，孩子们看见一只小鸟停在低矮的树枝上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dik it-twajra fuq is-siġra! Pawlu: Rajtha! Ejja noqogħdu kwieti biex ma nbeżżgħuhiex.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that little bird in the tree! Pawlu: I see it! Let's stay quiet so we don't frighten it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看树上那只小鸟！保罗：看到了！我们安静一点，免得吓到它。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看树上那只小鸟！
messages.en: Look at that little bird in the tree!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtha! Ejja noqogħdu kwieti biex ma nbeżżgħuhiex.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtha! Ejja noqogħdu kwieti biex ma nbeżżgħuhiex.
messages.zh: 看到了！我们安静一点，免得吓到它。
messages.en: I see it! Let's stay quiet so we don't frighten it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 twajra 配上一只停在细树枝上的小鸟来记；与 tajra 对照，突出“小小一只”的指小意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A table used for grooming and keeping cosmetics or personal grooming items.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供梳妆打扮并摆放化妆品或个人梳理用品的桌子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mejda li tintuża biex wieħed jitħejja u jżomm kożmetiċi jew oġġetti għall-kura personali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 梳妆台

collocations.en: a dressing table with a mirror
the drawers of the dressing table

formal.mt: Fil-kamra tas-sodda hemm twaletta bil-mera u żewġ kxaxen għall-oġġetti personali.
formal.en: In the bedroom there is a dressing table with a mirror and two drawers for personal items.
formal.zh: 卧室里有一张梳妆台，配有镜子和两个存放个人用品的抽屉。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn qiegħed il-moxt tiegħi? Nina: Fuq it-twaletta, ħdejn il-mera.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is my comb? Nina: On the dressing table, next to the mirror.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：我的梳子在哪里？妮娜：在梳妆台上，镜子旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (姐姐)
messages.zh: 我的梳子在哪里？
messages.en: Where is my comb?

messages.speaker: Nina (妹妹)
messages.zh: 在梳妆台上，镜子旁边。
messages.en: On the dressing table, next to the mirror.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 twaletta 和镜子、梳子、抽屉放在同一幅画面里记，看到这组物品就想到“梳妆台”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be demolished, or to be dropped from a position or height.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指建筑等被拆除，或物体从某个位置或高度被掉落。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża meta bini jitneħħa billi jitkisser, jew meta oġġett jitħalla jaqa' minn xi post jew għoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被拆除；被拆毁
被掉落；被失手落下

collocations.en: the parcel was dropped on the ground

formal.mt: Il-ħajt il-qadim twaqqa' biex jinbena ħajt ġdid fl-istess post.
formal.en: The old wall was demolished so that a new wall could be built in the same place.
formal.zh: 旧墙被拆除了，以便在原处建造一堵新墙。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-pakkett hu miftuħ? Mark: Twaqqa' mal-art waqt li konna nġorruh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the parcel open? Mark: It was dropped on the ground while we were carrying it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：包裹怎么开了？马克：我们搬的时候，它掉到了地上。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 包裹怎么开了？
messages.en: Why is the parcel open?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Twaqqa' mal-art waqt li konna nġorruh.
messages.mt_standard: Twaqqa' mal-art waqt li konna nġorruh.
messages.zh: 我们搬的时候，它掉到了地上。
messages.en: It was dropped on the ground while we were carrying it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个向下的画面记 twaqqa'：旧墙被拆倒，包裹被掉下；都要注意主语是承受动作的对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be stopped from continuing, or to be established as a new organization or institution.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指活动或过程被停止，也可指组织或机构被建立。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża meta attività ma titħalliex tkompli, jew meta organizzazzjoni jew istituzzjoni tinħoloq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被停止；被中止
被建立；被创立

formal.mt: Il-klabb twaqqaf biex joffri attivitajiet sportivi lit-tfal tar-raħal.
formal.en: The club was established to offer sports activities to the village's children.
formal.zh: 该俱乐部成立的目的是为村里的儿童提供体育活动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex m'hemm ħadd jaħdem illum? Mark: Ix-xogħol twaqqaf minħabba x-xita.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is nobody working today? Mark: The work was stopped because of the rain.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：今天怎么没人干活？马克：因为下雨，工作停下来了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 今天怎么没人干活？
messages.en: Why is nobody working today?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 因为下雨，工作停下来了。
messages.en: The work was stopped because of the rain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 twaqqaf 配两张情境卡：工程按下停止键，俱乐部挂上成立牌；结合主语判断“被停止”还是“被建立”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be assigned a specific time, appointed, or placed on a schedule.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指被确定具体时间、被指定或被列入日程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża meta jiġi ffissat ħin għal xi ħaġa, jew meta din tiġi appuntata jew imdaħħla fi skeda.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be set for a specific time
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被安排在某个具体时间；被定时
被指定；被约定
被排期；被列入日程

formal.mt: L-appuntament twaqqat għat-tlieta ta' waranofsinhar, u l-ħin ġie kkonfermat bil-miktub.
formal.en: The appointment was set for three in the afternoon, and the time was confirmed in writing.
formal.zh: 预约被定在下午三点，时间也得到了书面确认。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għal liema ħin twaqqat l-appuntament? Lara: Għall-għaxra ta' filgħodu; niltaqgħu hemm ftit qabel.
colloquial.en: Nina: What time was the appointment set for? Lara: Ten in the morning; let's meet there a little earlier.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：预约定在几点？劳拉：上午十点；我们提前一点在那里碰面吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 预约定在几点？
messages.en: What time was the appointment set for?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għall-għaxra ta' filgħodu; niltaqgħu hemm ftit qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Għall-għaxra ta' filgħodu; niltaqgħu hemm ftit qabel.
messages.zh: 上午十点；我们提前一点在那里碰面吧。
messages.en: Ten in the morning; let's meet there a little earlier.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象预约卡被贴进日历的三点格子，用“这件事被定在几点”记住 twaqqat 的时间安排用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of establishing or founding an organization, institution, or organized activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 建立或创办组织、机构或有组织活动的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tinħoloq jew tiġi stabbilita organizzazzjoni, istituzzjoni jew attività organizzata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建立；设立
创立；创办

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-twaqqif ta' għaqda ġdida għall-ħarsien tal-ambjent.
formal.en: The report describes the founding of a new association for environmental protection.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了一个新环境保护协会的创立。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif sejjer it-twaqqif tal-klabb? Pawlu: Tajjeb! Diġà sibna post fejn niltaqgħu.
colloquial.en: Mark: How is setting up the club going? Pawlu: Well! We've already found a place to meet.
colloquial.zh: 马克：俱乐部的筹建进展怎么样？保罗：很顺利！我们已经找到聚会的地方了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 俱乐部的筹建进展怎么样？
messages.en: How is setting up the club going?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (俱乐部筹办人)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb! Diġà sibna post fejn niltaqgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb! Diġà sibna post fejn niltaqgħu.
messages.zh: 很顺利！我们已经找到聚会的地方了。
messages.en: Well! We've already found a place to meet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 twaqqif 写在俱乐部成立仪式的照片下面，记住这里谈的是“建立、创办”这件事，是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of demolishing something, bringing it down, or dropping it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拆除某物、使其倒下或将其掉落的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jitkisser bini, li xi ħaġa tinġieb 'l isfel, jew li oġġett jitħalla jaqa'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拆除；拆毁
使倒下；使落下
将某物掉落；使某物落下

collocations.en: the dropping of objects on the ground
collocations.zh: 将物品掉落到地上的行为

formal.mt: Matul it-twaqqigħ tal-bini, iż-żona se tingħalaq għall-pubbliku.
formal.en: During the demolition of the building, the area will be closed to the public.
formal.zh: 在建筑物拆除期间，该区域将不对公众开放。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak l-istorbju? Mark: It-twaqqigħ tal-ħajt fil-bitħa ta' ħdejna.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's that noise? Mark: The demolition of the wall in the yard next door.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：那是什么声音？马克：隔壁院子在拆墙。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 那是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that noise?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.zh: 隔壁院子在拆墙。
messages.en: The demolition of the wall in the yard next door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用连续三幅图记 twaqqigħ：拆房、推倒、掉物；把注意力放在动作本身，记成表示这些行为的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The identification or fixing of a time for something, or the arrangement of events on a schedule.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 确定某件事的时间，或为活动安排日程的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-identifikazzjoni jew l-iffissar ta' ħin għal xi ħaġa, jew l-arranġament ta' avvenimenti fi skeda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 时间的确定；某一时刻的识别
排期；日程安排

collocations.zh: 精确的时间确定或安排

formal.mt: It-twaqqit tal-laqgħat għandu jqis il-ħinijiet tax-xogħol tal-parteċipanti kollha.
formal.en: The scheduling of meetings should take all participants' working hours into account.
formal.zh: 安排会议时间时，应考虑所有参与者的工作时间。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-twaqqit tal-laqgħa? Pawlu: Jien. L-ewwel nistaqsi lil kulħadd meta jkun jista' jiġi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who will take care of scheduling the meeting? Pawlu: I will. First I'll ask everyone when they can come.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：谁来负责安排会议时间？保罗：我来。我先问问大家什么时候能来。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-twaqqit tal-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-twaqqit tal-laqgħa?
messages.zh: 谁来负责安排会议时间？
messages.en: Who will take care of scheduling the meeting?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (会议组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. L-ewwel nistaqsi lil kulħadd meta jkun jista' jiġi.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. L-ewwel nistaqsi lil kulħadd meta jkun jista' jiġi.
messages.zh: 我来。我先问问大家什么时候能来。
messages.en: I will. First I'll ask everyone when they can come.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象先询问大家的空闲时间，再把会议填进日历；用这整个“确定时间、安排日程”的过程记 twaqqit。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Continuous chatter, or the harsh calls made by crows.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指没完没了的闲聊，也可指乌鸦发出的粗哑叫声；须根据上下文区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħdit li jibqa' għaddej bla waqfien, jew il-ħsejjes ħorox li jagħmlu ċ-ċawluni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喋喋不休地闲聊；没完没了的絮叨。
乌鸦发出的呱呱叫声。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-għasafar, l-istudenti semgħu t-twaqwiq taċ-ċawluni fis-siġar.
formal.en: During the bird observation, the students heard the cawing of the crows in the trees.
formal.zh: 观察鸟类时，学生们听到了树上乌鸦的叫声。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan it-twaqwiq kollu qed itellifni. Ben: Sewwa, nieqfu nitkellmu sakemm tispiċċa taqra.
colloquial.en: Lara: All this chatter is distracting me. Ben: All right, we'll stop talking until you finish reading.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这一阵没完没了的闲聊让我分心。本：好，我们先不说话，等你读完。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 这一阵没完没了的闲聊让我分心。
messages.en: All this chatter is distracting me.

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, nieqfu nitkellmu sakemm tispiċċa taqra.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, nieqfu nitkellmu sakemm tispiċċa taqra.
messages.zh: 好，我们先不说话，等你读完。
messages.en: All right, we'll stop talking until you finish reading.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两幅有声画面并排记：同学一直闲聊，树上乌鸦一直叫。两种声音都可用这个名词，但要靠说话者或鸟类等语境判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become damaged as a result of moisture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因潮气或湿气而受损，强调材料或物品受到潮湿影响后的变化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġrilu ħsara minħabba l-umdità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因潮湿而损坏；受潮受损。

collocations.en: the wood was damaged by moisture
was damaged because of the damp

formal.mt: L-injam tal-armarju twar minħabba l-umdità fil-maħżen.
formal.en: The wood of the cupboard was damaged by moisture in the storeroom.
formal.zh: 柜子的木材因储藏室里的湿气而受损。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex il-bieb m'għadux jagħlaq sew? Rita: L-injam twar; din il-kamra dejjem niedja.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why doesn't the door close properly anymore? Rita: The wood has been damaged by moisture; this room is always damp.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这扇门怎么关不严了？丽塔：木头受潮损坏了；这间屋子总是很潮湿。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 这扇门怎么关不严了？
messages.en: Why doesn't the door close properly anymore?

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-injam twar; din il-kamra dejjem niedja.
messages.mt_standard: L-injam twar; din il-kamra dejjem niedja.
messages.zh: 木头受潮损坏了；这间屋子总是很潮湿。
messages.en: The wood has been damaged by moisture; this room is always damp.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象潮湿储藏室里的一扇木门受损后关不严，把“湿气造成损坏”的完整场景与 twar 一起记住，而不是只记成“湿”。

gloss_zh: 被搁置；暂时离开；被冷落；被排除

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be put aside, briefly step away, or be avoided or excluded by others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指物品或事项被放到一边、人暂时离开，也可指人遭到冷落或被排除。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitqiegħed fil-ġenb, jitlaq għal ftit ħin, jew jiġi evitat jew eskluż minn oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被放到一边；被暂时搁置。
短暂离开；暂时退开一会儿。
被人避开；受到冷落或疏远。
被排除在外；不被允许参与或纳入。

collocations.en: stepped away for a few minutes

formal.mt: Il-proġett twarrab sakemm jitlestew l-istudji meħtieġa.
formal.en: The project was set aside until the necessary studies are completed.
formal.zh: 该项目被暂时搁置，等待所需研究完成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar Pawlu? Ben: Twarrab għal ftit minuti biex iwieġeb telefonata.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did Paul go? Ben: He stepped away for a few minutes to answer a phone call.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗去哪儿了？本：他暂时离开几分钟，去接个电话。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did Paul go?

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Twarrab għal ftit minuti biex iwieġeb telefonata.
messages.mt_standard: Twarrab għal ftit minuti biex iwieġeb telefonata.
messages.zh: 他暂时离开几分钟，去接个电话。
messages.en: He stepped away for a few minutes to answer a phone call.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“到了旁边”的画面串联各义：项目放一边、人暂时走开、人被冷落或排除。这个画面只是记忆提示，具体含义仍看语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To blossom or become full of flowers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指植物开花，或花园等地方长满鲜花、呈现繁花盛开的景象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ il-fjuri jew jimtela bil-fjuri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开花；绽放。
鲜花繁盛；遍布盛开的花朵。

collocations.en: the garden became full of flowers

formal.mt: Wara x-xita, il-ġnien twarrad u ġibed ħafna naħal.
formal.en: After the rain, the garden became full of flowers and attracted many bees.
formal.zh: 雨后，花园里繁花盛开，吸引了许多蜜蜂。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara kemm twarrad il-ġnien! Ninu: Iva, issa mimli fjuri ta' kull kulur.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look how the garden has blossomed! Ninu: Yes, it's full of flowers of every colour now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看，花园里的花开得多盛啊！尼努：是啊，现在到处都是各种颜色的花。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 看，花园里的花开得多盛啊！
messages.en: Look how the garden has blossomed!

messages.speaker: Ninu (园主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa mimli fjuri ta' kull kulur.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa mimli fjuri ta' kull kulur.
messages.zh: 是啊，现在到处都是各种颜色的花。
messages.en: Yes, it's full of flowers of every colour now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记一段花园延时摄影：先看到花苞开放，再看到满园鲜花。twarrad 描写“开起来、盛起来”的变化，是动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of excluding someone, removing something, or setting something aside.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指把人排除在外、把东西移开，或把事情暂时搁置的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jeskludi lil xi ħadd, ineħħi xi ħaġa, jew iqiegħed xi ħaġa fil-ġenb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 排除；将某人或某事物拒于范围或活动之外。
移开；移除。
放到一边；暂时搁置。

collocations.en: the setting aside of the proposal
the exclusion of someone from the group
collocations.zh: 将某人排除在小组之外

formal.mt: It-twarrib tal-ostakli mill-passaġġ huwa meħtieġ biex kulħadd ikun jista' jgħaddi.
formal.en: The removal of obstacles from the passage is necessary so that everyone can pass through.
formal.zh: 必须移除通道里的障碍物，以便所有人都能通行。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ma naqbilx mat-twarrib ta' Sara mill-grupp. Mark: Lanqas jien; għandna nagħtuha ċans tieħu sehem.
colloquial.en: Rita: I don't agree with excluding Sara from the group. Mark: Neither do I; we should give her a chance to take part.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我不赞成把萨拉排除在小组之外。马克：我也不赞成；我们应该给她参与的机会。

messages.speaker: Rita (小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma naqbilx mat-twarrib ta' Sara mill-grupp.
messages.mt_standard: Ma naqbilx mat-twarrib ta' Sara mill-grupp.
messages.zh: 我不赞成把萨拉排除在小组之外。
messages.en: I don't agree with excluding Sara from the group.

messages.speaker: Mark (小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Lanqas jien; għandna nagħtuha ċans tieħu sehem.
messages.mt_standard: Lanqas jien; għandna nagħtuha ċans tieħu sehem.
messages.zh: 我也不赞成；我们应该给她参与的机会。
messages.en: Neither do I; we should give her a chance to take part.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 twarrib 当作一张写着“排除、移除、搁置”的行为标签：移开障碍是移除，放下提案是搁置，不让人加入是排除。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or occurrence of flowers opening.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指花朵开放这一过程或现象，是表示“开花、绽放”的名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew il-fenomenu tal-ftuħ tal-fjuri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开花；花朵绽放的过程或现象。

formal.mt: L-istudenti rreġistraw iż-żmien tat-twarrid tas-siġar fil-ġnien tal-iskola.
formal.en: The students recorded the flowering period of the trees in the school garden.
formal.zh: 学生们记录了学校花园里树木的花期。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Beda t-twarrid tas-siġra tagħna? Pawlu: Iva, dalgħodu rajt l-ewwel fjuri.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has our tree started blossoming? Pawlu: Yes, I saw the first flowers this morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们那棵树开始开花了吗？保罗：开了，今天早上我看到了第一批花。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 我们那棵树开始开花了吗？
messages.en: Has our tree started blossoming?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 开了，今天早上我看到了第一批花。
messages.en: Yes, I saw the first flowers this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象在观察日记上写下标题“开花过程”，标题就是名词 twarrid；再配一张花苞逐渐打开的照片，帮助记住它表示绽放这一现象。

gloss_zh: 被扩大；被加宽；变宽；发福

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made larger, wider, or broader; of a person, to grow stout.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指事物被扩大、加宽或拓宽；用于人时，也可指身体变胖、发福。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir akbar jew usa'; meta jingħad dwar persuna, jiżdied fil-piż u jsir eħxen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被扩大；规模或范围得到扩展。
被加宽；宽度增加。
被拓宽；幅度或范围变得更广。

sense_translations.en_definition: to grow stout (used of a person who gains weight)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发胖；发福，用于体重增加、身材变胖的人。

collocations.en: he grew stout and his clothes became tight
collocations.zh: 他发胖了，衣服也变紧了

formal.mt: Il-bieb ewlieni twassa' biex ikun jista' jgħaddi tagħmir akbar.
formal.en: The main doorway was widened to allow larger equipment to pass through.
formal.zh: 主入口被加宽了，以便更大的设备通过。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Dan il-passaġġ jidher usa' minn qabel. Lara: Iva, twassa' waqt ix-xogħlijiet ix-xahar li għadda.
colloquial.en: Ben: This passage looks wider than before. Lara: Yes, it was widened during the work last month.
colloquial.zh: 本：这条通道看起来比以前宽了。拉拉：是的，上个月施工时把它加宽了。

messages.speaker: Ben (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-passaġġ jidher usa' minn qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-passaġġ jidher usa' minn qabel.
messages.zh: 这条通道看起来比以前宽了。
messages.en: This passage looks wider than before.

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, twassa' waqt ix-xogħlijiet ix-xahar li għadda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, twassa' waqt ix-xogħlijiet ix-xahar li għadda.
messages.zh: 是的，上个月施工时把它加宽了。
messages.en: Yes, it was widened during the work last month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用向两边展开的箭头记 twassa'：门口变宽、计划扩大，都有范围增加的画面；用于人时，另记衣服变紧所提示的“发福”义。

gloss_zh: 被搭载送达；被带来；被护送

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be taken to a destination by being given a lift, brought there, or escorted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指人被搭车送到目的地、被带到某处，或在他人陪同、护送下到达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittieħed f'post minn xi ħadd, b'vettura jew b'akkumpanjament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被人搭载一程；有人开车送。
被带来；被送到某处。
被陪同前往；被护送。

collocations.en: was escorted to the hall by an official
collocations.zh: 由一名工作人员陪同到了大厅

formal.mt: Il-mistieden twassal sas-sala minn uffiċjal qabel bdiet iċ-ċerimonja.
formal.en: The guest was escorted to the hall by an official before the ceremony began.
formal.zh: 仪式开始前，来宾由一名工作人员陪同到了大厅。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Pawlu kif mar id-dar wara l-ikla? Mark: Twassal id-dar bil-karozza minn ħuh.
colloquial.en: Rita: How did Pawlu get home after the meal? Mark: His brother gave him a lift home.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：保罗吃完饭后怎么回家的？马克：他哥哥开车送他回家的。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu kif mar id-dar wara l-ikla?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu kif mar id-dar wara l-ikla?
messages.zh: 保罗吃完饭后怎么回家的？
messages.en: How did Pawlu get home after the meal?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他哥哥开车送他回家的。
messages.en: His brother gave him a lift home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把镜头对准“被送到的人”：坐车被送回家、被带到酒店、被陪同进大厅。记住本词条中的主语是接受接送或陪同的一方。

gloss_zh: 被放在中间；被置于核心位置

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be placed in the middle of something or given a central position or role.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被放置在某物的中间，或被赋予核心位置、中心作用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitqiegħed fin-nofs ta' xi ħaġa jew jingħata post jew rwol ċentrali.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be put in the middle
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被放在中间。
被置于中心位置；被确立为核心。

collocations.en: was placed in the middle between two windows
collocations.zh: 被放在两扇窗之间的中央

collocations.en: was made central to the discussion
collocations.zh: 被置于讨论的核心位置

formal.mt: Fid-disinn finali, il-pannell twassat bejn iż-żewġ twieqi.
formal.en: In the final design, the panel was placed in the middle between the two windows.
formal.zh: 在最终设计中，面板被放在两扇窗之间的中央。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn tqiegħed il-kwadru? Toni: Twassat bejn iż-żewġ xkafef, eżatt fuq is-sufan.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where was the picture placed? Toni: It was placed in the middle between the two shelves, right above the sofa.
colloquial.zh: Lara：画放在哪里了？Toni：放在两个架子之间的中央，就在沙发正上方。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 画放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where was the picture placed?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Twassat bejn iż-żewġ xkafef, eżatt fuq is-sufan.
messages.mt_standard: Twassat bejn iż-żewġ xkafef, eżatt fuq is-sufan.
messages.zh: 放在两个架子之间的中央，就在沙发正上方。
messages.en: It was placed in the middle between the two shelves, right above the sofa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一幅画被移到墙面正中：先记住“被放在中间”，再联想到议题“被置于核心”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making something wider or extending its range or scope.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变得更宽，或使范围、视野等得到扩展的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir usa', jew jiżdiedu l-firxa jew l-ambitu tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加宽；拓宽，尤指宽度的增加。
扩大；扩展，亦可指范围或视野的拓展。

formal.mt: Il-proġett jinkludi t-twassigħ tat-triq biex ikun hemm aktar spazju għall-karozzi tal-linja.
formal.en: The project includes widening the road to provide more space for buses.
formal.zh: 该项目包括拓宽道路，以便为公共汽车提供更多空间。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex għalqu parti mit-triq? Pawlu: Minħabba t-twassigħ tagħha; se jkun hemm aktar spazju.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why have they closed part of the road? Pawlu: Because of the road widening; there will be more space.
colloquial.zh: Marija：为什么封闭了一部分道路？Pawlu：因为要拓宽道路，以后空间会更大。

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.zh: 为什么封闭了一部分道路？
messages.en: Why have they closed part of the road?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-twassigħ tagħha; se jkun hemm aktar spazju.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-twassigħ tagħha; se jkun hemm aktar spazju.
messages.zh: 因为要拓宽道路，以后空间会更大。
messages.en: Because of the road widening; there will be more space.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把双手向两边拉开，想象道路变宽；再把这个动作对应到知识范围扩大，记住这是表示过程的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of escorting or accompanying someone to a destination, or delivering something to a recipient or place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 护送或陪同某人到达目的地，或把物品递送给收件人、送达指定地点的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed imur ma' persuna sa destinazzjoni, jew iwassal xi ħaġa għand min għandu jirċeviha jew f'post partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 护送；带领并陪同某人前往某处。
陪同某人；陪送某人前往目的地。
递送；交付；把物品送到指定的人或地点。

collocations.en: escorting the guests to the door

formal.mt: Is-servizz jinkludi t-twassil tal-pakketti fid-djar tar-residenti.
formal.en: The service includes delivering parcels to residents' homes.
formal.zh: 该服务包括将包裹送到居民家中。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm jiswa t-twassil? Mark: Ħames ewro, u l-pakkett jasal għandek għada.
colloquial.en: Sara: How much does delivery cost? Mark: Five euros, and the parcel will reach you tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Sara：配送费是多少？Mark：五欧元，包裹明天送到你那里。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 配送费是多少？
messages.en: How much does delivery cost?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħames ewro, u l-pakkett jasal għandek għada.
messages.mt_standard: Ħames ewro, u l-pakkett jasal għandek għada.
messages.zh: 五欧元，包裹明天送到你那里。
messages.en: Five euros, and the parcel will reach you tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“送到目的地”串联三个义项：送客到门口、陪孩子到学校、把包裹送到家。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of inserting something into the middle or centre of something else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某个成分或物件插入另一事物的中间或中央的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tiddaħħal xi ħaġa fin-nofs jew fiċ-ċentru ta' xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.en_definition: insertion in the middle or centre
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在中间或中央插入某物；居中插入。

collocations.en: the insertion of a word in the middle of the sentence
collocations.zh: 在句子中间插入一个词

collocations.en: the insertion of an element in the centre of the design
collocations.zh: 在设计中央插入一个元素

formal.mt: L-eżerċizzju jitlob it-twassit ta' kelma ġdida fin-nofs tas-sentenza mingħajr ma jinbidel it-tifsir tagħha.
formal.en: The exercise requires inserting a new word in the middle of the sentence without changing its meaning.
formal.zh: 这项练习要求在句子中间插入一个新词，同时不改变句子的意思。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'għandi nagħmel f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Rita: It-twassit ta' kelma fin-nofs tas-sentenza; ara l-eżempju ta' fuq.
colloquial.en: Nina: What should I do in this exercise? Rita: Insert a word in the middle of the sentence; look at the example above.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这道练习要做什么？Rita：在句子中间插入一个词；看看上面的例子。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这道练习要做什么？
messages.en: What should I do in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: It-twassit ta' kelma fin-nofs tas-sentenza; ara l-eżempju ta' fuq.
messages.mt_standard: It-twassit ta' kelma fin-nofs tas-sentenza; ara l-eżempju ta' fuq.
messages.zh: 在句子中间插入一个词；看看上面的例子。
messages.en: Insert a word in the middle of the sentence; look at the example above.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一张新卡片插进一排卡片的正中间，记住重点是“在中间插入”这一动作的名词。

gloss_zh: 汽车喇叭声；山羊叫声；闲聊

teaching_sense.en_definition: The honking of car horns, the bleating of goats, or idle conversation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 汽车喇叭的鸣响、山羊的咩叫，或没有重要内容的闲聊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-daqq tal-ħornijiet tal-karozzi, il-ħoss li jagħmlu l-mogħoż, jew taħdit bla suġġett importanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 汽车喇叭的鸣响；汽车鸣笛声。
山羊的咩咩叫声。
闲聊；没有重要内容的随意交谈。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport isemmi t-twatwit kontinwu tal-ħornijiet bħala sors ta' storbju fit-triq.
formal.en: The report mentions the continuous honking of horns as a source of noise in the street.
formal.zh: 报告将持续的汽车喇叭声列为街道噪声的一个来源。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fuq xiex kontu qed titkellmu? Lara: Xejn importanti, ftit twatwit waqt il-kafè.
colloquial.en: Maja: What were you talking about? Lara: Nothing important, just a bit of chit-chat over coffee.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你们刚才在聊什么？Lara：没什么重要的，就是喝咖啡时随便聊聊。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们刚才在聊什么？
messages.en: What were you talking about?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xejn importanti, ftit twatwit waqt il-kafè.
messages.mt_standard: Xejn importanti, ftit twatwit waqt il-kafè.
messages.zh: 没什么重要的，就是喝咖啡时随便聊聊。
messages.en: Nothing important, just a bit of chit-chat over coffee.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个声音场景记忆：路上的喇叭、农场的山羊、咖啡桌旁的闲聊；靠上下文选择对应意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be physically hurt or to feel hurt by an insult.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体受到伤害，或因受到侮辱而感到受伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isofri uġigħ jew ġrieħi fil-ġisem, jew iħossu offiż minħabba insult.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受伤；身体受到伤害或感到疼痛。
受到侮辱；因冒犯性言语或行为而感到受伤。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem twaġġa' f'siequ waqt li kien qed iċaqlaq kaxxa tqila.
formal.en: The worker hurt his foot while moving a heavy box.
formal.zh: 这名工人在搬动一个沉重的箱子时伤了脚。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark telaq daqshekk kmieni? Lara: Twaġġa' b'dak li ntqal dwaru quddiem kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark leave so early? Lara: He was hurt by what was said about him in front of everyone.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark为什么那么早就走了？Lara：有人当着大家的面那样说他，他感到受了伤害。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark为什么那么早就走了？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave so early?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Twaġġa' b'dak li ntqal dwaru quddiem kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Twaġġa' b'dak li ntqal dwaru quddiem kulħadd.
messages.zh: 有人当着大家的面那样说他，他感到受了伤害。
messages.en: He was hurt by what was said about him in front of everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排想象脚上的伤口和听见侮辱后的难过：身体会受伤，感情也会受伤，用两个画面共同记忆这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of being hurt, physically or emotionally, or of feeling offended.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体或感情受到伤害，或感到被冒犯的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat ta' min ikun imweġġa' fil-ġisem jew fis-sentimenti, jew iħossu offiż.

sense_translations.en_definition: the state of being hurt or offended
sense_translations.zh_definition: 受伤或受冒犯的状态；包括身体上的伤痛或感情上受到伤害的感受。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, l-istudent esprima sens ta' twaġġigħ minħabba l-kummenti li saru fil-klassi.
formal.en: In his letter, the student expressed a sense of hurt because of the comments made in class.
formal.zh: 这名学生在信中表示，课堂上的那些评论使他感到受了伤害。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadek tħoss dak is-sens ta' twaġġigħ wara l-kliem ta' lbieraħ? Mark: Iva, imma nixtieq nitkellem magħha bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you still feel hurt after what was said yesterday? Mark: Yes, but I'd like to talk to her calmly.
colloquial.zh: Lara：昨天听了那些话，你现在还觉得受伤吗？Mark：是的，不过我想平静地和她谈谈。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek tħoss dak is-sens ta' twaġġigħ wara l-kliem ta' lbieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek tħoss dak is-sens ta' twaġġigħ wara l-kliem ta' lbieraħ?
messages.zh: 昨天听了那些话，你现在还觉得受伤吗？
messages.en: Do you still feel hurt after what was said yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma nixtieq nitkellem magħha bil-kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma nixtieq nitkellem magħha bil-kalma.
messages.zh: 是的，不过我想平静地和她谈谈。
messages.en: Yes, but I'd like to talk to her calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给受伤后的感受贴上一张名词标签：这个词把身体的伤痛或心里的委屈作为一种状态来谈，适合连同受伤的感受一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The making of loud cries or howls because of pain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由于疼痛而发出大声哀叫或号叫的行为或声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għajjat jew ilfiq qawwi minħabba l-uġigħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因疼痛而哀号；痛苦地大声号叫。

collocations.zh: 因疼痛而发出的响亮哀号

collocations.en: the injured person's howling in pain
collocations.zh: 伤者因疼痛发出的哀号

formal.mt: It-twaħwiħ tal-midrub wassal lil dawk li kienu fil-qrib biex isejħu għall-għajnuna.
formal.en: The injured person's howling in pain prompted those nearby to call for help.
formal.zh: 伤者痛苦的哀号促使附近的人呼叫救援。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Smajt dak it-twaħwiħ? Mark: Iva, xi ħadd weġġa'; ejja nsejħu għall-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you hear that howling in pain? Mark: Yes, someone is hurt; let's call for help.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你听见那阵痛苦的哀号了吗？Mark：听见了，有人受伤了，我们叫人来帮忙吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (路人)
messages.zh: 你听见那阵痛苦的哀号了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that howling in pain?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, xi ħadd weġġa'; ejja nsejħu għall-għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, xi ħadd weġġa'; ejja nsejħu għall-għajnuna.
messages.zh: 听见了，有人受伤了，我们叫人来帮忙吧。
messages.en: Yes, someone is hurt; let's call for help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“疼得大声哀号”的声音画面记忆，把疼痛原因和号叫声音一起记住，避免只记成普通喊叫。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become stuck or unable to move, or to be blamed for something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体被卡住而无法移动，或某人被归咎、被指责应对某事负责。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibqa' maqbud u ma jkunx jista' jiċċaqlaq, jew jingħata t-tort għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被卡住；被困住而不能移动。
被归咎；被指责应对错误或问题负责。

collocations.zh: 被指责应为这个错误负责

formal.mt: L-impjegat twaħħal fl-iżball, għalkemm ir-rapport wera li kien segwa l-istruzzjonijiet.
formal.en: The employee was blamed for the mistake, although the report showed that he had followed the instructions.
formal.zh: 这名员工被指责应为错误负责，尽管报告表明他一直按照指示办事。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma tistax toħroġ il-kuċċarini? Mark: Il-kexxun twaħħal. Tista' tgħinni niftaħ?
colloquial.en: Maja: Why can't you get the teaspoons out? Mark: The drawer got stuck. Can you help me open it?
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么拿不出茶匙？Mark：抽屉卡住了。你能帮我打开吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你怎么拿不出茶匙？
messages.en: Why can't you get the teaspoons out?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 抽屉卡住了。你能帮我打开吗？
messages.en: The drawer got stuck. Can you help me open it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用抽屉卡住和责任落到某人身上两个画面记忆：前者是物体动不了，后者是人被归咎；这是学习联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop a strong desire for something, especially a particular food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某种东西产生强烈的渴望，尤其指突然很想吃某种食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss xewqa qawwija għal xi ħaġa, speċjalment għal xi ikel partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强烈渴望；特别想吃某种食物。

formal.mt: Meta ra l-istampa tal-kejk, twaħħam għal xi ħaġa ħelwa.
formal.en: When he saw the picture of the cake, he developed a craving for something sweet.
formal.zh: 他看到蛋糕的图片后，突然特别想吃甜食。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex Pawlu mar jixtri l-ġelat? Lara: Ra ritratt u twaħħam għall-ġelat.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did Pawlu go to buy ice cream? Lara: He saw a photo and started craving ice cream.
colloquial.zh: Marta：Pawlu为什么去买冰淇淋了？Lara：他看了一张照片，突然特别想吃冰淇淋。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu为什么去买冰淇淋了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu go to buy ice cream?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他看了一张照片，突然特别想吃冰淇淋。
messages.en: He saw a photo and started craving ice cream.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个动词和“看见蛋糕，突然嘴馋”的画面绑定，记住它强调强烈想要的感觉。

gloss_zh: 被延误；比预期更晚发生

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be delayed or to happen later than expected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到延误，或在比原先预期更晚的时间发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġri jew jibda aktar tard milli kien mistenni jew ippjanat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被延误；受到耽搁。
比预期更晚发生。

collocations.en: the event took place later than expected

formal.mt: Il-bidu tal-avveniment twaħħar b'nofs siegħa minħabba problema teknika.
formal.en: The start of the event was delayed by half an hour because of a technical problem.
formal.zh: 由于技术问题，活动延迟了半小时开始。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex għadna qed nistennew? Rita: Il-bidu twaħħar; jibdew fid-disgħa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why are we still waiting? Rita: The start has been delayed; they will begin at nine.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我们怎么还在等？Rita：开始时间延后了，他们九点才开始。

messages.speaker: Mark (观众)
messages.zh: 我们怎么还在等？
messages.en: Why are we still waiting?

messages.speaker: Rita (工作人员)
messages.zh: 开始时间延后了，他们九点才开始。
messages.en: The start has been delayed; they will begin at nine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日程表上的活动被箭头推向更晚的时刻，用这个画面同时记住“被延误”和“晚于预期”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of sticking something to a surface, or the act of assigning blame to someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西粘到某个表面的行为；也指把过错归到某人身上的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li twaħħal xi ħaġa ma' wiċċ, jew li tpoġġi l-ħtija fuq xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粘贴；使物体附着在某个表面上的行为。
责怪；把过错归咎于某人。

formal.mt: Qabel it-twaħħil tat-tikketti, il-wiċċ tal-kaxxa għandu jkun nadif u niexef.
formal.en: Before the labels are stuck on, the surface of the box should be clean and dry.
formal.zh: 粘贴标签之前，箱子表面应保持清洁和干燥。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kulħadd qed jgħid li t-tort tiegħi. Samwel: It-twaħħil tal-ħtija ma jgħinx; ejja naraw x'ġara.
colloquial.en: Nina: Everyone is saying it is my fault. Samwel: Blaming does not help; let's see what happened.
colloquial.zh: Nina：大家都说是我的错。Samwel：一味责怪没有帮助，我们先看看发生了什么。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kulħadd qed jgħid li t-tort tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Kulħadd qed jgħid li t-tort tiegħi.
messages.zh: 大家都说是我的错。
messages.en: Everyone is saying it is my fault.

messages.speaker: Samwel (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: It-twaħħil tal-ħtija ma jgħinx; ejja naraw x'ġara.
messages.mt_standard: It-twaħħil tal-ħtija ma jgħinx; ejja naraw x'ġara.
messages.zh: 一味责怪没有帮助，我们先看看发生了什么。
messages.en: Blaming does not help; let's see what happened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面分开记义：一幅是把标签贴到箱子上，另一幅是把“过错标签”贴到别人身上；这只是学习联想。

gloss_zh: 诱发食欲；激起突然的强烈欲望

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or effect of making someone crave food or develop another sudden, strong desire.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人特别想吃某种食物，或使人突然产生其他强烈欲望的行为或作用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew l-effett li tqanqal f'xi ħadd xewqa qawwija għall-ikel jew xewqa oħra qawwija u għal għarrieda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诱发对食物的强烈渴望；使人特别想吃某种食物。
使人突然产生强烈欲望；激起突然而强烈的渴求。

collocations.en: inducing food cravings through pictures of food
collocations.zh: 通过食物图片诱发强烈食欲

collocations.en: inducing sudden, strong desires through advertisements
collocations.zh: 通过广告激起突然的强烈欲望

formal.mt: L-artiklu jiddiskuti t-twaħħim permezz ta' stampi tal-ikel fir-reklami.
formal.en: The article discusses the inducing of food cravings through pictures of food in advertisements.
formal.zh: 这篇文章讨论了广告中的食物图片如何诱发强烈食欲。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dawn l-istampi tal-kejk iġegħluni nixtieq biċċa! Mark: Dak hu t-twaħħim: l-istampi qajmulek xewqa qawwija għall-kejk.
colloquial.en: Lara: These pictures of cake make me want a slice! Mark: That is the inducing of a craving: the pictures have given you a strong desire for cake.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这些蛋糕图片让我好想吃一块！Mark：这就是诱发渴望：图片让你特别想吃蛋糕。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn l-istampi tal-kejk iġegħluni nixtieq biċċa!
messages.mt_standard: Dawn l-istampi tal-kejk iġegħluni nixtieq biċċa!
messages.zh: 这些蛋糕图片让我好想吃一块！
messages.en: These pictures of cake make me want a slice!

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu t-twaħħim: l-istampi qajmulek xewqa qawwija għall-kejk.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu t-twaħħim: l-istampi qajmulek xewqa qawwija għall-kejk.
messages.zh: 这就是诱发渴望：图片让你特别想吃蛋糕。
messages.en: That is the inducing of a craving: the pictures have given you a strong desire for cake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“香味或图片把馋意勾出来”的过程，重点放在“引发欲望”这个作用，而不只记想吃的感觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A delay that makes something happen or begin later than expected or planned.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某件事比预期或计划更晚发生或开始的延误。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dewmien li minħabba fih xi ħaġa tiġri jew tibda aktar tard milli kien mistenni jew ippjanat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 延误；耽搁；时间上的推迟。

collocations.en: a delay in the start of the meeting
a delay of half an hour

formal.mt: Minħabba t-twaħħir fil-bidu tal-laqgħa, id-diskussjoni ntemmet aktar tard milli kien ippjanat.
formal.en: Because of the delay in the start of the meeting, the discussion ended later than planned.
formal.zh: 由于会议延迟开始，讨论比计划更晚结束。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex il-laqgħa għadha ma bdietx? Pawlu: Hemm twaħħir ta' għaxar minuti.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why has the meeting not started yet? Pawlu: There is a delay of ten minutes.
colloquial.zh: Anna：会议怎么还没开始？Pawlu：要延误十分钟。

messages.speaker: Anna (参会者)
messages.zh: 会议怎么还没开始？
messages.en: Why has the meeting not started yet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (组织者)
messages.zh: 要延误十分钟。
messages.en: There is a delay of ten minutes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它想成日程表里多出来的一段等待时间，并配合“十分钟的延误”记住这是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fear or horror, or the act of causing other people to feel fear or horror.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 恐惧或惊骇的感受，也指使他人产生恐惧或惊骇的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biża' jew terrur, jew l-att li tqanqal biża' jew terrur f'ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恐惧；害怕的感受。
惊骇；强烈的恐怖感。

sense_translations.en_definition: imbuing others with fear or horror
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使他人充满恐惧或惊骇；向他人灌注恐怖感。

collocations.en: a feeling of fear or horror
collocations.zh: 一种恐惧或惊骇的感觉

collocations.en: the frightening or horrifying of others
collocations.zh: 使他人恐惧或惊骇的行为

formal.mt: L-awtur juża d-dlam u s-skiet biex joħloq sens ta' twaħħix fil-qarrej.
formal.en: The author uses darkness and silence to create a feeling of fear or horror in the reader.
formal.zh: 作者利用黑暗和寂静，在读者心中营造恐惧和惊骇感。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dik ix-xena tatni sens ta' twaħħix. David: Lili wkoll; trid nieqfu ftit?
colloquial.en: Maja: That scene gave me a feeling of horror. David: Me too; shall we pause for a moment?
colloquial.zh: Maja：那个场景让我感到一阵惊骇。David：我也是，要暂停一下吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik ix-xena tatni sens ta' twaħħix.
messages.mt_standard: Dik ix-xena tatni sens ta' twaħħix.
messages.zh: 那个场景让我感到一阵惊骇。
messages.en: That scene gave me a feeling of horror.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 我也是，要暂停一下吗？
messages.en: Me too; shall we pause for a moment?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象恐怖故事让读者背后一凉：既可记心里的恐惧和惊骇，也可记故事使别人害怕的作用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take a fancy to something, be persuaded to do something, or feel tempted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某物产生喜爱或想要的念头，被劝动去做某事，或受到诱惑而心动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titħajjar b'xi ħaġa, titħajjar tagħmel xi ħaġa minħabba kliem jew influwenza ta' ħaddieħor, jew tħoss ix-xewqa li tagħmilha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 看上某物；对某物产生喜爱或想要的念头。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be induced to do sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被说动或促使去做某事。
受到诱惑；因吸引而心动。

collocations.en: took a fancy to an idea
collocations.zh: 对一个想法产生了兴趣

collocations.en: was tempted to buy a car

formal.mt: Wara l-preżentazzjoni, Mark twebbel bl-idea li jiftaħ ħanut żgħir.
formal.en: After the presentation, Mark took a fancy to the idea of opening a small shop.
formal.zh: 听完介绍后，Mark 对开一家小店的想法产生了兴趣。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Pawlu mar jara dik il-karozza? Maja: Twebbel jixtriha wara li ra r-ritratti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Pawlu go to see that car? Maja: He was tempted to buy it after seeing the photos.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Pawlu 为什么去看那辆车？Maja：他看了照片以后，心动想买。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu mar jara dik il-karozza?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu mar jara dik il-karozza?
messages.zh: Pawlu 为什么去看那辆车？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu go to see that car?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Twebbel jixtriha wara li ra r-ritratti.
messages.mt_standard: Twebbel jixtriha wara li ra r-ritratti.
messages.zh: 他看了照片以后，心动想买。
messages.en: He was tempted to buy it after seeing the photos.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象看见商品照片后心里冒出“想要”：由看上某物，到被别人说动，再到受到诱惑，串成一条记忆线。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be taken into a family as an adopted child.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为养子或养女被接纳进入一个家庭；被收养。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi milqugħ f'familja bħala wild adottat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被收养；成为某个家庭的养子或养女。

collocations.en: was adopted when he was young

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel twebben minn familja li kienet tgħix f'raħal żgħir.
formal.en: In the story, the boy was adopted by a family living in a small village.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个男孩被一个住在小村庄里的家庭收养。

colloquial.mt: Nina: It-tifel fl-istorja twebben? Rita: Iva, twebben meta kien żgħir u trabba ma' żewġ aħwa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Was the boy in the story adopted? Rita: Yes, he was adopted when he was young and grew up with two siblings.
colloquial.zh: Nina：故事里的男孩是被收养的吗？Rita：是的，他年幼时被收养，和另外两个兄弟姐妹一起长大。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 故事里的男孩是被收养的吗？
messages.en: Was the boy in the story adopted?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, twebben meta kien żgħir u trabba ma' żewġ aħwa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, twebben meta kien żgħir u trabba ma' żewġ aħwa.
messages.zh: 是的，他年幼时被收养，和另外两个兄弟姐妹一起长大。
messages.en: Yes, he was adopted when he was young and grew up with two siblings.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用故事画面记忆：孩子被一个家庭接纳，成为家中的一员；句子主语是“被收养的人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become hard or firmer, especially when a soft material dries or sets.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得坚硬或更加坚实，尤指柔软材料干燥或凝固后发生硬化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir iebes jew aktar sod, speċjalment meta materjal artab jinxef jew jagħqad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变硬；硬化；变得坚实。

formal.mt: Wara li nixef, it-tafal twebbes u ma setax jibqa' jingħata forma faċilment.
formal.en: After drying, the clay hardened and could no longer be shaped easily.
formal.zh: 干燥后，黏土变硬了，无法再轻易塑形。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Għadni nista' nbiddel il-forma ta' dan it-tafal? Marija: Le, diġà twebbes; ħu ftit tafal frisk.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Can I still change the shape of this clay? Marija: No, it has already hardened; take some fresh clay.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：这块黏土还能改形状吗？Marija：不能了，已经变硬了；拿些新黏土吧。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (美术学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni nista' nbiddel il-forma ta' dan it-tafal?
messages.mt_standard: Għadni nista' nbiddel il-forma ta' dan it-tafal?
messages.zh: 这块黏土还能改形状吗？
messages.en: Can I still change the shape of this clay?

messages.speaker: Marija (美术教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, diġà twebbes; ħu ftit tafal frisk.
messages.mt_standard: Le, diġà twebbes; ħu ftit tafal frisk.
messages.zh: 不能了，已经变硬了；拿些新黏土吧。
messages.en: No, it has already hardened; take some fresh clay.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象软黏土放干后按不动了，把“原来柔软、后来坚硬”的变化画面与这个动词一起记住。

gloss_zh: 一时的幻想；突发的念头

teaching_sense.en_definition: An imaginative wish or a passing desire to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 想象中的愿望，或突然产生、可能很快消失的念头。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa immaġinata jew ħsieb li jiġi għal għarrieda u jista' jgħaddi malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凭想象产生的愿望或幻想。
突然产生的一时兴致或念头。

formal.mt: Il-proposta għandha tkun ibbażata fuq ħtieġa ċara, mhux fuq twebbil ta' mument.
formal.en: The proposal should be based on a clear need, not on a momentary whim.
formal.zh: 提案应以明确的需求为基础，而不是出于一时兴起。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex trid tmur il-baħar issa? Mark: Ma nafx, twebbil ta' mument. Jekk trid, nibqgħu hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you want to go to the seaside now? Mark: I don't know, just a momentary whim. We can stay here if you prefer.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么现在想去海边？Mark：不知道，就是一时兴起。你愿意的话，我们可以留在这里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么现在想去海边？
messages.en: Why do you want to go to the seaside now?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx, twebbil ta' mument. Jekk trid, nibqgħu hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx, twebbil ta' mument. Jekk trid, nibqgħu hawn.
messages.zh: 不知道，就是一时兴起。你愿意的话，我们可以留在这里。
messages.en: I don't know, just a momentary whim. We can stay here if you prefer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上一朵忽然飘来的思想云：云里是幻想，云很快飘走就是一时兴起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The adoption of a child into a family.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 家庭收养儿童，使其成为家庭成员的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih familja tadotta tifel jew tifla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 儿童收养；将儿童收为子女。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se tipprovdi informazzjoni lill-familji dwar il-proċess tat-twebbin tat-tfal.
formal.en: The meeting will provide families with information about the process of adopting children.
formal.zh: 会议将向家庭介绍儿童收养过程的相关信息。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dwar xiex kienet il-laqgħa? Pawlu: Dwar it-twebbin tat-tfal. Spjegaw il-proċess u wieġbu l-mistoqsijiet tagħna.
colloquial.en: Sara: What was the meeting about? Pawlu: Adopting children. They explained the process and answered our questions.
colloquial.zh: Sara：会议讲了什么？Pawlu：儿童收养。他们解释了整个过程，也回答了我们的问题。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 会议讲了什么？
messages.en: What was the meeting about?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (参会者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar it-twebbin tat-tfal. Spjegaw il-proċess u wieġbu l-mistoqsijiet tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar it-twebbin tat-tfal. Spjegaw il-proċess u wieġbu l-mistoqsijiet tagħna.
messages.zh: 儿童收养。他们解释了整个过程，也回答了我们的问题。
messages.en: Adopting children. They explained the process and answered our questions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一家人迎接孩子的画面记忆这个词；同时记住 tat-tfal，把词义固定为儿童收养。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming hard or making something hard.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体逐渐变硬，或使某物变硬的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir iebsa jew titwassal biex issir iebsa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 硬化；变硬或使某物变硬的过程。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw it-twebbis tat-tafal u rreġistraw il-bidliet fit-tessut tiegħu.
formal.en: The students observed the hardening of the clay and recorded changes in its texture.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了黏土的硬化过程，并记录了其质地的变化。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' nmiss it-tafal issa? Toni: Stenna ftit; it-twebbis għadu ma spiċċax.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I touch the clay now? Toni: Wait a little; the hardening isn't finished yet.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我现在可以碰黏土了吗？Toni：再等一下，还没有完全硬化。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 我现在可以碰黏土了吗？
messages.en: Can I touch the clay now?

messages.speaker: Toni (陶艺老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Stenna ftit; it-twebbis għadu ma spiċċax.
messages.mt_standard: Stenna ftit; it-twebbis għadu ma spiċċax.
messages.zh: 再等一下，还没有完全硬化。
messages.en: Wait a little; the hardening isn't finished yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象柔软黏土逐渐变得坚硬，把这个变化过程整段贴上 twebbis 的标签来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ringing or echoing sounds perceived in the ear, or low mumbling into someone's ear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 耳内感觉到的鸣响或回响，也可指有人在耳边低声咕哝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsejjes li jinstemgħu fil-widna mingħajr sors estern, jew kliem imgerger b'leħen baxx f'widnet xi ħadd.

sense_translations.en_definition: tinittus (echoing sounds in the inner ear)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 耳鸣；感觉内耳有回响等声音。
在某人耳边含糊地低声说话或咕哝。

formal.mt: Fil-formola, il-pazjent kiteb li kien qed iħoss twedwid fil-widnejn.
formal.en: On the form, the patient wrote that he was experiencing ringing in his ears.
formal.zh: 患者在表格上写明自己有耳鸣的感觉。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'qed jgħidlek f'widintek? Karl: Ma nifhimx; dan it-twedwid kollu ma nistax insegwih.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is he saying into your ear? Karl: I don't understand; I can't follow all this mumbling.
colloquial.zh: Nina：他在你耳边说什么？Karl：我听不懂；这样一直低声咕哝，我根本听不清。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 他在你耳边说什么？
messages.en: What is he saying into your ear?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nifhimx; dan it-twedwid kollu ma nistax insegwih.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nifhimx; dan it-twedwid kollu ma nistax insegwih.
messages.zh: 我听不懂；这样一直低声咕哝，我根本听不清。
messages.en: I don't understand; I can't follow all this mumbling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一只耳朵，里面画鸣响波纹，旁边画低声说话的人；用两个画面同时记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of saying that one will do something or that something will happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示自己将做某事或某事将会实现的许诺行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iwiegħed li jagħmel xi ħaġa jew li xi ħaġa se sseħħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 许诺的行为；作出承诺。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iwiegħed xi ħaġa.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza li t-twegħid ta' għajnuna għandu jkun segwit minn azzjoni konkreta.
formal.en: The report emphasizes that promising help should be followed by concrete action.
formal.zh: 报告强调，承诺提供帮助之后，应当采取具体行动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qal li se jgħinna, imma għadu ma għamel xejn. Mark: It-twegħid waħdu mhux biżżejjed; hemm bżonn l-azzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: He said he would help us, but he hasn't done anything yet. Mark: Promising alone isn't enough; action is needed.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他说会帮我们，可到现在还什么都没做。马克：光许诺还不够，还得行动。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qal li se jgħinna, imma għadu ma għamel xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Qal li se jgħinna, imma għadu ma għamel xejn.
messages.zh: 他说会帮我们，可到现在还什么都没做。
messages.en: He said he would help us, but he hasn't done anything yet.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-twegħid waħdu mhux biżżejjed; hemm bżonn l-azzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: It-twegħid waħdu mhux biżżejjed; hemm bżonn l-azzjoni.
messages.zh: 光许诺还不够，还得行动。
messages.en: Promising alone isn't enough; action is needed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人举手说“我答应帮忙”，把 twegħid 记作这个“作出承诺”的动作，再用后续行动检查承诺是否兑现。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Difficulties or obstacles that make progress or life harder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使事情难以推进的困难，也指人生道路上遇到的阻碍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Diffikultajiet jew ostakli li jagħmlu l-ħajja jew il-progress aktar diffiċli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 困难；使事情不易完成的难处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Diffikultajiet li wieħed jiltaqa' magħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人生中的阻碍；生活道路上需要克服的障碍。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ostakli li wieħed jiltaqa' magħhom matul ħajtu.

formal.mt: Minkejja t-twegħir li ltaqgħet miegħu, l-istudenta kompliet bl-istudji tagħha u temmet il-kors.
formal.en: Despite the difficulties she encountered, the student continued her studies and completed the course.
formal.zh: 尽管遇到了困难，这名学生仍然坚持学习，并完成了课程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan it-twegħir kollu qed jaqtagħli qalbi. Mark: Ejja naraw x'nistgħu nagħmlu, pass pass.
colloquial.en: Maja: All these difficulties are discouraging me. Mark: Let's see what we can do, one step at a time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这么多困难让我有些灰心。马克：我们一步一步来，看看能做些什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-twegħir kollu qed jaqtagħli qalbi.
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-twegħir kollu qed jaqtagħli qalbi.
messages.zh: 这么多困难让我有些灰心。
messages.en: All these difficulties are discouraging me.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja naraw x'nistgħu nagħmlu, pass pass.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja naraw x'nistgħu nagħmlu, pass pass.
messages.zh: 我们一步一步来，看看能做些什么。
messages.en: Let's see what we can do, one step at a time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 twegħir 想成前进道路上的几块石头：眼前的是“困难”，放到整个人生道路上就是“生活中的阻碍”。

gloss_zh: 被摊派某事；被交付责任

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have something imposed on oneself or to be assigned responsibility for something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被摊派某项事情，或被交付处理某事的责任。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jitgħabba b'xi ħaġa jew jingħata r-responsabbiltà tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被摊派某事；被迫接下某项负担或麻烦事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li wieħed jitgħabba b'xi ħaġa li jkollu jieħu ħsiebha.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be given responsibility for sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被交付某事的责任；被安排负责某事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li wieħed jingħata r-responsabbiltà ta' xi ħaġa.

collocations.en: was landed with all the work
was given responsibility for the project

formal.mt: Wara t-tluq tal-maniġer, Mark twekka bir-responsabbiltà tal-proġett sakemm inħatar maniġer ġdid.
formal.en: After the manager's departure, Mark was given responsibility for the project until a new manager was appointed.
formal.zh: 经理离任后，马克被安排负责该项目，直到新经理获任。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jlesti x-xogħol li fadal? Mark: Pawlu twekka bih kollu, allura se ngħinu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who's going to finish the remaining work? Mark: Paul has been landed with all of it, so we're going to help him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：剩下的工作谁来完成？马克：全都摊给保罗了，所以我们打算帮帮他。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jlesti x-xogħol li fadal?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jlesti x-xogħol li fadal?
messages.zh: 剩下的工作谁来完成？
messages.en: Who's going to finish the remaining work?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu twekka bih kollu, allura se ngħinu.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu twekka bih kollu, allura se ngħinu.
messages.zh: 全都摊给保罗了，所以我们打算帮帮他。
messages.en: Paul has been landed with all of it, so we're going to help him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一叠任务突然放到某人桌上，用 twekka 记住“事情落到他头上”；既可表示摊派负担，也可表示交付责任。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be transferred to another party or leased, especially of a shop or business.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被转交给另一方，或被出租，尤其用于商店、商号等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġi trasferit lil ħaddieħor jew jingħata bil-kera, speċjalment ħanut jew negozju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被转交；被转让给另一方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jiġi trasferit lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be leased (especially used of a shop, business, etc)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被出租、交由他人承租，尤其指商店、商号等。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jingħata bil-kera, speċjalment ħanut jew negozju.

collocations.en: was transferred to a new owner

formal.mt: Skont il-ftehim, il-ħanut twella b'kera lil operatur ġdid għal perjodu ta' ħames snin.
formal.en: Under the agreement, the shop was leased to a new operator for a period of five years.
formal.zh: 根据协议，这家店被出租给一名新的经营者，租期为五年。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħanut għadu għand l-istess sid? Mark: Iva, iżda twella b'kera lil familja oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does the shop still have the same owner? Mark: Yes, but it has been leased to another family.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这家店还是原来的业主吗？马克：是，不过已经出租给另一家人了。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 这家店还是原来的业主吗？
messages.en: Does the shop still have the same owner?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iżda twella b'kera lil familja oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iżda twella b'kera lil familja oħra.
messages.zh: 是，不过已经出租给另一家人了。
messages.en: Yes, but it has been leased to another family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 twella 配上店铺钥匙交到另一人手中的画面，再看上下文分辨是“转交”，还是以租赁方式“出租”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be brought into existence through birth or to be conceived as an idea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过分娩被生下，或指某个想法、计划被构想出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinġieb fid-dinja permezz tat-twelid jew jiġi kkonċepit bħala idea.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被生下；经由分娩来到世上。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinġieb fid-dinja permezz tat-twelid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被孕育、被构想出来；可用于想法或计划的形成。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jiġi kkonċepit.

collocations.en: was brought into the world with a midwife's help
collocations.zh: 在助产士的帮助下被生下

collocations.en: a project conceived through a discussion
collocations.zh: 在讨论中构想出来的项目

formal.mt: Il-proġett twelled minn diskussjoni bejn l-għalliema dwar il-ħtiġijiet tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The project was conceived through a discussion among the teachers about the students' needs.
formal.zh: 这个项目是在教师们讨论学生需求时构想出来的。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif twelled dan il-proġett? Mark: Konna qed nitkellmu dwar l-iskola, u minn hemm ġiet l-idea.
colloquial.en: Maja: How was this project conceived? Mark: We were talking about the school, and that's where the idea came from.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个项目是怎么构想出来的？马克：我们当时在聊学校的事，想法就是那时产生的。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 这个项目是怎么构想出来的？
messages.en: How was this project conceived?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Konna qed nitkellmu dwar l-iskola, u minn hemm ġiet l-idea.
messages.mt_standard: Konna qed nitkellmu dwar l-iskola, u minn hemm ġiet l-idea.
messages.zh: 我们当时在聊学校的事，想法就是那时产生的。
messages.en: We were talking about the school, and that's where the idea came from.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅“诞生”画面记 twelled：一幅是孩子被生下，另一幅是讨论中一个计划被构想出来；这是学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Birth, or the conception and initial formation of ideas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出生这一事件，也指想法的孕育和最初形成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-miġja fid-dinja ta' tarbija, jew il-konċepiment u l-bidu ta' ideat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出生；新生命来到世上的事件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-miġja fid-dinja ta' tarbija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 想法的孕育；构思的产生和形成。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-konċepiment ta' ideat.

formal.mt: Il-laqgħat bejn studenti minn oqsma differenti jħeġġu t-twellid ta' ideat ġodda.
