formal.en: Meetings between students from different fields encourage the conception of new ideas.
formal.zh: 不同领域学生之间的交流会促进新想法的孕育。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tiġbor nies minn oqsma differenti? Mark: Għax konversazzjoni tajba tista' tgħin fit-twellid ta' ideat ġodda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you bringing together people from different fields? Mark: Because a good conversation can help new ideas take shape.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么要把不同领域的人聚在一起？马克：因为一次好的交流能帮助孕育新想法。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tiġbor nies minn oqsma differenti?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tiġbor nies minn oqsma differenti?
messages.zh: 你为什么要把不同领域的人聚在一起？
messages.en: Why are you bringing together people from different fields?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax konversazzjoni tajba tista' tgħin fit-twellid ta' ideat ġodda.
messages.mt_standard: Għax konversazzjoni tajba tista' tgħin fit-twellid ta' ideat ġodda.
messages.zh: 因为一次好的交流能帮助孕育新想法。
messages.en: Because a good conversation can help new ideas take shape.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 twellid 放进“某物的诞生”这个名词框架：婴儿的出生、新想法的孕育；用 ta' 后面的内容帮助区分两个意思。

gloss_zh: 被使相信；受影响而相信

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be led or made to believe something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由于他人的话语、行为或其他影响而相信某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jitwassal biex jemmen xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被使相信某事；在外界影响下信以为真。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li wieħed jitwassal biex jemmen xi ħaġa.

collocations.en: was led to believe that the news was true
collocations.zh: 被使相信那则消息是真的

collocations.en: was led to believe that everything was ready
collocations.zh: 被使相信一切已经准备就绪

formal.mt: Wara li sema' l-istess storja mingħand diversi persuni, Pawlu twemmen li l-aħbar kienet vera.
formal.en: After hearing the same story from several people, Paul was led to believe that the news was true.
formal.zh: 从几个人那里听到同样的说法后，保罗便相信了那则消息是真的。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu ħaseb li kollox kien lest? Mark: Twemmen hekk għax kulħadd qallu li x-xogħol kien spiċċa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Paul think everything was ready? Mark: He was led to believe that because everyone told him the work was finished.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么以为一切都准备好了？马克：因为大家都告诉他工作已经完成，他就信了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu ħaseb li kollox kien lest?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu ħaseb li kollox kien lest?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么以为一切都准备好了？
messages.en: Why did Paul think everything was ready?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Twemmen hekk għax kulħadd qallu li x-xogħol kien spiċċa.
messages.mt_standard: Twemmen hekk għax kulħadd qallu li x-xogħol kien spiċċa.
messages.zh: 因为大家都告诉他工作已经完成，他就信了。
messages.en: He was led to believe that because everyone told him the work was finished.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象几个人反复告诉你同一件事，你因此相信了：用 twemmen 记住“受到影响而相信”，并用 li 接出相信的内容。

gloss_zh: 呼呼声；嗡嗡声；嘈杂人声

teaching_sense.en_definition: A continuous whirring or humming sound, or the indistinct sound of many voices.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持续的呼呼声或嗡嗡声，也可指许多人说话时混杂不清的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss kontinwu bħal ta' mutur jew fann, jew taħlit ta' ħafna ilħna li ma jingħarfux sew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 机械等快速转动时发出的呼呼声。
持续而低沉的嗡嗡声。
多人说话混杂在一起、难以听清的嘈杂人声。

formal.mt: It-twerdin tal-fann kien jinstema' tul il-laqgħa kollha.
formal.en: The whirring of the fan could be heard throughout the meeting.
formal.zh: 整场会议都能听到风扇的呼呼声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tisma' dak it-twerdin? Mark: Iva, ġej mill-fann. Nitfih?
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you hear that whirring? Mark: Yes, it's coming from the fan. Shall I turn it off?
colloquial.zh: Maja：你听到那阵呼呼声了吗？Mark：听到了，是风扇发出的。要我关掉吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听到那阵呼呼声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that whirring?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 听到了，是风扇发出的。要我关掉吗？
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from the fan. Shall I turn it off?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把风扇呼呼、马达嗡嗡和人群交谈连成一幅声音图：twerdin 的三个义项都可借持续混杂的声音来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop or put out leaves, as a tree or other plant does.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指树木或其他植物长出叶子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ il-weraq, bħalma tagħmel siġra jew pjanta oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长出叶子；生叶。

formal.mt: Wara x-xita tar-rebbiegħa, is-siġra twerraq u l-ġnien reġa' ħa l-ħajja.
formal.en: After the spring rain, the tree grew leaves and the garden came back to life.
formal.zh: 春雨过后，树木长出了叶子，花园又恢复了生机。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara, is-siġra fl-aħħar twerraq! Pawlu: Iva, il-ġimgħa l-oħra kienet għadha bla weraq.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look, the tree has finally grown leaves! Pawlu: Yes, last week it still had no leaves.
colloquial.zh: Lara：看，这棵树终于长叶子了！Pawlu：是啊，上星期还光秃秃的。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 看，这棵树终于长叶子了！
messages.en: Look, the tree has finally grown leaves!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-ġimgħa l-oħra kienet għadha bla weraq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-ġimgħa l-oħra kienet għadha bla weraq.
messages.zh: 是啊，上星期还光秃秃的。
messages.en: Yes, last week it still had no leaves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一根光秃树枝在春雨后冒出绿叶，用这个动态画面记 twerraq：重点是植物发生了长叶的变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become the heir to something, such as property or possessions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成为某项财产或物品的继承人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir il-werriet ta' xi ħaġa, bħal proprjetà jew ġid.

sense_translations.en_definition: to become the inheritor of sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 成为某物或某项财产的继承人。

collocations.en: became an heir after his uncle's death
collocations.zh: 在叔叔去世后成为继承人

collocations.en: became an heir and took ownership of the house
collocations.zh: 成为继承人并取得房屋所有权

formal.mt: Wara l-mewt ta' zijuh, Pawlu twerret u sar sid ir-razzett tal-familja.
formal.en: After his uncle's death, Pawlu became the heir and took ownership of the family farm.
formal.zh: 叔叔去世后，Pawlu 成为继承人，取得了家族农场的所有权。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sar sid dik id-dar Pawlu? Mark: Twerret wara l-mewt ta' zijuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Pawlu become the owner of that house? Mark: He became the heir after his uncle died.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 怎么成了那栋房子的主人？Mark：他叔叔去世后，他成了继承人。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sar sid dik id-dar Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sar sid dik id-dar Pawlu?
messages.zh: Pawlu 怎么成了那栋房子的主人？
messages.en: How did Pawlu become the owner of that house?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他叔叔去世后，他成了继承人。
messages.en: He became the heir after his uncle died.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用人物身份变化来记 twerret：在故事人物旁添上“继承人”标签，再画一把继承房屋的钥匙。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive a slap in the face.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脸部被人用手掌打了一下，即挨耳光。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqla' daqqa ta' ħarta fuq wiċċu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be slapped in the face
sense_translations.zh_definition: 脸上被扇耳光；挨了一巴掌。

collocations.en: was slapped in the face during the fight
was slapped in the face in front of everyone
collocations.zh: 当着所有人的面被扇了耳光

formal.mt: Ix-xhud qal li r-raġel twerrex waqt il-ġlieda.
formal.en: The witness said that the man was slapped in the face during the fight.
formal.zh: 证人说，那名男子在打斗中被扇了耳光。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ġara lil Mark? Pawlu: Twerrex waqt il-ġlieda. Lara: Se mmur nara jekk għandux bżonn l-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened to Mark? Pawlu: He was slapped in the face during the fight. Lara: I'll go and see whether he needs help.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark 怎么了？Pawlu：他在打斗中挨了一巴掌。Lara：我去看看他需不需要帮忙。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to Mark?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 他在打斗中挨了一巴掌。
messages.en: He was slapped in the face during the fight.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur nara jekk għandux bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur nara jekk għandux bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.zh: 我去看看他需不需要帮忙。
messages.en: I'll go and see whether he needs help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 twerrex 时，把镜头对准捂着脸的人：句子的主语是挨耳光的人，以此记住这个动词的受事视角。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of a tree or other plant developing leaves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 树木或其他植物长出叶子的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih siġra jew pjanta oħra toħroġ il-weraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 植物生叶、长出叶子的过程。

collocations.en: the growth of leaves on trees

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw it-twerriq tas-siġar fil-ġnien matul ir-rebbiegħa.
formal.en: The students observed the growth of leaves on the trees in the garden during spring.
formal.zh: 学生们在春季观察了花园里树木长叶的过程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed tikteb fin-noti tiegħek? Mark: Qed nikteb dwar it-twerriq ta' din is-siġra. Kuljum qed nara weraq ġdid.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you writing in your notes? Mark: I'm writing about this tree's leaf growth. Every day I see new leaves.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你在笔记里写什么？Mark：我在记录这棵树长叶的过程。每天都能看到新叶子。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你在笔记里写什么？
messages.en: What are you writing in your notes?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nikteb dwar it-twerriq ta' din is-siġra. Kuljum qed nara weraq ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nikteb dwar it-twerriq ta' din is-siġra. Kuljum qed nara weraq ġdid.
messages.zh: 我在记录这棵树长叶的过程。每天都能看到新叶子。
messages.en: I'm writing about this tree's leaf growth. Every day I see new leaves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 twerriq 记成观察日记的标题“长叶过程”，旁边画连续几天的新叶照片，帮助记住它是过程名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bequeathing of something to an heir, or its passing to someone by inheritance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把财产遗赠给继承人的行为，或财产通过继承而转移的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' xi ħaġa lil werriet bħala wirt, jew il-mogħdija tagħha għand min jirtu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将财产或物品遗赠给继承人的行为。
继承；财产作为遗产传给继承人的过程。

collocations.en: the bequeathing of the house to the heir

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi t-twerrit tad-dar lill-werriet u l-importanza tagħha għall-familja.
formal.en: The author describes the bequeathing of the house to the heir and its importance to the family.
formal.zh: 作者描述了将房屋遗赠给继承人的事情，以及这栋房屋对家族的重要性。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dwar xiex inhu dan il-kapitlu? Pawlu: Dwar it-twerrit ta' dar antika minn ġenerazzjoni għal oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this chapter about? Pawlu: It's about an old house passing by inheritance from one generation to the next.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这一章讲什么？Pawlu：讲一栋老房子如何通过继承代代相传。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 这一章讲什么？
messages.en: What is this chapter about?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar it-twerrit ta' dar antika minn ġenerazzjoni għal oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar it-twerrit ta' dar antika minn ġenerazzjoni għal oħra.
messages.zh: 讲一栋老房子如何通过继承代代相传。
messages.en: It's about an old house passing by inheritance from one generation to the next.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一栋房子和两代人，用箭头表示财产传递：从留下财产的一端记“遗赠”，从接收的一端记“继承”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of slapping someone in the face.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用手掌打别人脸部的行为，即扇耳光或掌掴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' daqqa ta' ħarta fuq wiċċ xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扇耳光；用手掌打脸的行为。

collocations.en: the face slapping during the fight

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi każ ta' twerrix li seħħ waqt argument.
formal.en: The report describes a case of face slapping that occurred during an argument.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一起在争执中发生的掌掴事件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ifisser twerrix? Mark: Meta xi ħadd jagħti daqqa ta' ħarta fuq wiċċ persuna oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does twerrix mean? Mark: It means someone slapping another person in the face.
colloquial.zh: Maja：twerrix 是什么意思？Mark：就是一个人扇另一个人耳光的行为。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: twerrix 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does twerrix mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta xi ħadd jagħti daqqa ta' ħarta fuq wiċċ persuna oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Meta xi ħadd jagħti daqqa ta' ħarta fuq wiċċ persuna oħra.
messages.zh: 就是一个人扇另一个人耳光的行为。
messages.en: It means someone slapping another person in the face.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 twerrix 放进“掌掴事件”这个标题里记忆：它给整个扇耳光的行为命名，学习时可与表示挨耳光的 twerrex 对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become frightened or feel scared.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到惊吓，或产生害怕的感觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss biża' jew jibża' minħabba xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到害怕；受到惊吓。

collocations.en: was scared when he saw the dog

formal.mt: It-tifel twerwer meta sema' ħoss qawwi barra t-tieqa.
formal.en: The boy was frightened when he heard a loud noise outside the window.
formal.zh: 男孩听到窗外一声巨响，吓了一跳。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex mar ħdejk it-tifel? Pawlu: Twerwer bil-ħoss tal-bieb. Lara: Mela noqogħdu hawn miegħu sakemm jikkalma.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did the boy go over to you? Pawlu: He was scared by the sound of the door. Lara: Then let's stay here with him until he calms down.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那孩子怎么跑到你身边去了？Pawlu：他被门响吓到了。Lara：那我们在这儿陪他，等他平静下来。

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.zh: 那孩子怎么跑到你身边去了？
messages.en: Why did the boy go over to you?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 他被门响吓到了。
messages.en: He was scared by the sound of the door.

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela noqogħdu hawn miegħu sakemm jikkalma.
messages.mt_standard: Mela noqogħdu hawn miegħu sakemm jikkalma.
messages.zh: 那我们在这儿陪他，等他平静下来。
messages.en: Then let's stay here with him until he calms down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门突然一响，孩子吓得靠近父母，把这个反应与 twerwer 连起来；画面中的害怕者就是动词的主语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong feeling of fear or dismay caused by something frightening or upsetting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 遇到可怕或令人不安的事情时产生的强烈恐惧或惊惶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biża' qawwija jew ħasda kbira minħabba xi ħaġa tal-biża' jew li tinkwieta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恐惧；害怕的情绪。
因意外或坏消息而产生的惊惶、沮丧或不安。

collocations.en: a sense of dismay or fear

formal.mt: L-istudent iddeskriva t-twerwir li ħass meta sema' l-allarm.
formal.en: The student described the fear he felt when he heard the alarm.
formal.zh: 这名学生描述了听到警报时感到的恐惧。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek imbeżżgħa wara l-maltempata? Lara: Iva, għadni nħoss it-twerwir ta' dak il-lejl.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you still frightened after the storm? Lara: Yes, I can still feel the fear from that night.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：暴风雨过后，你还害怕吗？拉拉：是啊，我现在还感受得到那天晚上的恐惧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 暴风雨过后，你还害怕吗？
messages.en: Are you still frightened after the storm?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadni nħoss it-twerwir ta' dak il-lejl.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadni nħoss it-twerwir ta' dak il-lejl.
messages.zh: 是啊，我现在还感受得到那天晚上的恐惧。
messages.en: Yes, I can still feel the fear from that night.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 twerwir 和警报响起时心里一紧的画面相连，记住它表示恐惧或惊惶这种内心感受。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or sound of screaming or shrieking in a loud, high voice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用高而响亮的声音尖叫的行为，或这种尖叫发出的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għajjat b'leħen għoli u rqiq, jew il-ħoss ta' dan l-għajjat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尖叫；大声叫喊的行为或声音。
发出尖锐刺耳的叫声；尖声喊叫。

formal.mt: It-twerżiq fil-kuritur waqqaf il-lezzjoni għal ftit minuti.
formal.en: The screaming in the corridor interrupted the lesson for a few minutes.
formal.zh: 走廊里的尖叫声使课堂中断了几分钟。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'inhu dak it-twerżiq fil-ġnien? Nina: It-tfal qed jilagħbu; immur nara jekk kollox sew.
colloquial.en: Mark: What's all that shrieking in the garden? Nina: The children are playing; I'll go and check that everything is all right.
colloquial.zh: 马克：花园里怎么有那么多尖叫声？妮娜：孩子们在玩；我去看看是不是一切都好。

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.zh: 花园里怎么有那么多尖叫声？
messages.en: What's all that shrieking in the garden?

messages.speaker: Nina (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tfal qed jilagħbu; immur nara jekk kollox sew.
messages.mt_standard: It-tfal qed jilagħbu; immur nara jekk kollox sew.
messages.zh: 孩子们在玩；我去看看是不是一切都好。
messages.en: The children are playing; I'll go and check that everything is all right.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象走廊里传来一阵尖叫声，用 twerżiq 记整段尖叫活动或声音，再和表示一声尖叫的 twerżiqa 对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A single loud, high cry, especially one expressing fear, surprise, or pain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一声高而响亮的叫声，尤其用于表达恐惧、惊讶或疼痛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għajta waħda b'leħen għoli u rqiq, speċjalment minħabba biża', sorpriża jew uġigħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一声尖叫；一声高声喊叫。
一声尖锐刺耳的叫声。

formal.mt: Ix-xhud sema' twerżiqa waħda qawwija ġejja mill-kamra ta' fuq.
formal.en: The witness heard a single loud scream coming from the upstairs room.
formal.zh: 目击者听到楼上的房间里传来一声响亮的尖叫。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Smajt dik it-twerżiqa? Maja: Iva, rajt ġurdien u għajjatt!
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you hear that scream? Maja: Yes, I saw a mouse and screamed!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你听见那声尖叫了吗？玛雅：听见了，是我看到一只老鼠，叫了出来！

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你听见那声尖叫了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that scream?

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 听见了，是我看到一只老鼠，叫了出来！
messages.en: Yes, I saw a mouse and screamed!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 twerżiqa 配上看到老鼠后突然叫出一声的画面，突出可单独数出的一声，与 twerżiq 的尖叫活动区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become greater in quantity as a result of an increase.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某物的数量得到增加，变得比原来更多。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiżdied fil-kwantità jew fl-għadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 数量被增加；数量得到提升。

collocations.en: the quantity of food was increased
the number of places was increased

formal.mt: L-ammont ta' materjal għall-kors twessaq biex ikun biżżejjed għall-istudenti kollha.
formal.en: The quantity of material for the course was increased so that there would be enough for all the students.
formal.zh: 课程材料的数量增加了，以确保足够供所有学生使用。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandna biżżejjed ikel għall-mistednin kollha? Mark: Iva, l-ammont twessaq dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do we have enough food for all the guests? Mark: Yes, the quantity was increased this morning.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们的食物够所有客人吃吗？马克：够，今天早上已经增加了数量。

messages.speaker: Nina (聚会组织者)
messages.zh: 我们的食物够所有客人吃吗？
messages.en: Do we have enough food for all the guests?

messages.speaker: Mark (聚会助手)
messages.zh: 够，今天早上已经增加了数量。
messages.en: Yes, the quantity was increased this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 twessaq 放进前后数量对比图：原来十份，后来二十份，记住它表达数量被增加这一变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An increase in the amount or number of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物在数量、总量或数目上的增加。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żieda fil-kwantità jew fl-għadd ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 数量上的增加；总量或数目的增长。

collocations.en: an increase in the number of places

formal.mt: It-twessiq tal-provvisti ppermetta lill-iskola tqassam aktar materjal lill-istudenti.
formal.en: The increase in supplies allowed the school to distribute more material to the students.
formal.zh: 供应物资数量的增加，使学校能够向学生分发更多材料。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Issa hemm post għal aktar nies fil-kors? Lara: Iva, it-twessiq fl-għadd ta' postijiet għen ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there room for more people on the course now? Lara: Yes, the increase in the number of places helped a lot.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：现在这个课程能容纳更多人了吗？拉拉：是的，名额数量的增加帮了很大的忙。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa hemm post għal aktar nies fil-kors?
messages.mt_standard: Issa hemm post għal aktar nies fil-kors?
messages.zh: 现在这个课程能容纳更多人了吗？
messages.en: Is there room for more people on the course now?

messages.speaker: Lara (课程助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, it-twessiq fl-għadd ta' postijiet għen ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, it-twessiq fl-għadd ta' postijiet għen ħafna.
messages.zh: 是的，名额数量的增加帮了很大的忙。
messages.en: Yes, the increase in the number of places helped a lot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象统计表上的数量从十变成二十，把这次增加标成 twessiq；它是名词，可理解为数量的增加。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or sound of speaking very quietly in a whisper.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用很轻的声音说话的行为，或这种耳语发出的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kliem li jingħad b'leħen baxx ħafna, jew il-ħoss ta' dan il-kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 低声耳语；窃窃私语的行为或声音。

formal.mt: L-għalliema talbet lill-istudenti jwaqqfu t-tweswis waqt il-qari.
formal.en: The teacher asked the students to stop whispering during the reading.
formal.zh: 老师要求学生在阅读活动期间停止窃窃私语。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Qed tisma' t-tweswis minn wara l-bieb? Nina: Iva, imma ma nistax nifhem x'qed jgħidu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can you hear the whispering behind the door? Nina: Yes, but I can't make out what they're saying.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你听得到门后有人在低声说话吗？妮娜：听得到，不过我听不清他们在说什么。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tisma' t-tweswis minn wara l-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tisma' t-tweswis minn wara l-bieb?
messages.zh: 你听得到门后有人在低声说话吗？
messages.en: Can you hear the whispering behind the door?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ma nistax nifhem x'qed jgħidu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ma nistax nifhem x'qed jgħidu.
messages.zh: 听得到，不过我听不清他们在说什么。
messages.en: Yes, but I can't make out what they're saying.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友靠近耳边轻声说秘密，把 tweswis 与这种几乎只有身边人听得到的耳语场景相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A helpful or beneficial effect produced by an action, activity, or other cause.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某种行为、活动或其他因素产生的有益作用或良好效果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Effett tajjeb jew ta' għajnuna li jirriżulta minn azzjoni, attività jew xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有益的作用；带来帮助或改善的效果。

collocations.en: a beneficial effect on the group

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-twetija tal-attivitajiet ta' qari fuq it-tagħlim tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The report describes the beneficial effect of reading activities on students' learning.
formal.zh: 报告描述了阅读活动对学生学习产生的有益作用。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-laqgħa għenet lill-grupp? Maja: Iva, kellha twetija kbira; issa nafu x'għandna nagħmlu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the meeting help the group? Maja: Yes, it had a very beneficial effect; now we know what we need to do.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这次会议对团队有帮助吗？玛雅：有，效果很好；现在我们知道该做什么了。

messages.speaker: Lara (团队成员)
messages.zh: 这次会议对团队有帮助吗？
messages.en: Did the meeting help the group?

messages.speaker: Maja (团队成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kellha twetija kbira; issa nafu x'għandna nagħmlu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kellha twetija kbira; issa nafu x'għandna nagħmlu.
messages.zh: 有，效果很好；现在我们知道该做什么了。
messages.en: Yes, it had a very beneficial effect; now we know what we need to do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 twetija 写在一次活动带来的好结果旁边，记成有益作用；再留意它只有一个 t，避免与 twettija 混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of a surface or area being made level and even.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 地面或其他表面被处理得平坦、齐平的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih art jew wiċċ isiru ċatti u ndaqs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被整平的过程；表面被处理得平坦或齐平。

formal.mt: It-twettija tal-art saret qabel it-tqegħid tal-madum.
formal.en: The ground was levelled before the tiles were laid.
formal.zh: 铺设地砖之前，地面先进行了整平。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nistgħu nqiegħdu l-mejda hawn? Pawlu: Wara t-twettija tal-art; bħalissa mhix ċatta biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can we put the table here? Pawlu: After the ground has been levelled; it isn't flat enough at the moment.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们能把桌子放在这里吗？保罗：等地面整平以后吧；现在还不够平。

messages.speaker: Mark (屋主)
messages.zh: 我们能把桌子放在这里吗？
messages.en: Can we put the table here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara t-twettija tal-art; bħalissa mhix ċatta biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Wara t-twettija tal-art; bħalissa mhix ċatta biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 等地面整平以后吧；现在还不够平。
messages.en: After the ground has been levelled; it isn't flat enough at the moment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 twettija 和凹凸地面逐渐变平的画面绑定；可把中间的 tt 想成两块同样高的砖，辅助记住整平之义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of giving an answer to a question or responding to someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对问题作出回答，或对某人作出回应的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' risposta għal mistoqsija jew ta' reazzjoni għal dak li jgħid xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 回答；作答或回应的行为。

formal.mt: Fi tmiem il-preżentazzjoni, se jkun hemm ħin għat-tweġib għall-mistoqsijiet tal-parteċipanti.
formal.en: At the end of the presentation, there will be time for answering the participants' questions.
formal.zh: 报告结束时，将安排时间回答参与者的问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' nistaqsi issa? Mark: Iva, dan hu l-ħin għat-tweġib għall-mistoqsijiet. Għidli x'tixtieq tkun taf.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I ask a question now? Mark: Yes, this is the time for answering questions. Tell me what you'd like to know.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我现在可以提问吗？Mark：可以，现在是答疑时间。说说你想了解什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (参与者)
messages.zh: 我现在可以提问吗？
messages.en: Can I ask a question now?

messages.speaker: Mark (讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan hu l-ħin għat-tweġib għall-mistoqsijiet. Għidli x'tixtieq tkun taf.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan hu l-ħin għat-tweġib għall-mistoqsijiet. Għidli x'tixtieq tkun taf.
messages.zh: 可以，现在是答疑时间。说说你想了解什么。
messages.en: Yes, this is the time for answering questions. Tell me what you'd like to know.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象问号后面接上一个回答气泡，把 tweġib 记成正在作答这一行为，再连记回答问题的搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The singing or melodious calls of birds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟儿发出的鸣唱声，尤其指听起来悦耳的啼唱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kant tal-għasafar, speċjalment meta jkun ħelu u melodjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸟的鸣唱；鸟儿的啼叫声。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kant tal-għasafar.

formal.mt: Matul l-osservazzjoni fil-ġnien, ir-riċerkaturi semgħu t-tweġwiġ tal-għasafar fis-siġar.
formal.en: During the observation in the garden, the researchers heard birds singing in the trees.
formal.zh: 在花园进行观察时，研究人员听见树上传来鸟儿的鸣唱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tisma' t-tweġwiġ tal-għasafar? Mark: Iva, ejja noqogħdu hawn ftit u nisimgħuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you hear the birds singing? Mark: Yes, let's stay here for a bit and listen.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听见鸟儿在唱歌吗？马克：听见了，我们在这里待一会儿，听听吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听见鸟儿在唱歌吗？
messages.en: Can you hear the birds singing?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja noqogħdu hawn ftit u nisimgħuh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja noqogħdu hawn ftit u nisimgħuh.
messages.zh: 听见了，我们在这里待一会儿，听听吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's stay here for a bit and listen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tweġwiġ 配上清晨树梢的小鸟画面，记成“鸟儿在唱歌”；练习时连着 tal-għasafar 一起读。

gloss_zh: 受到表彰；受到尊重；备受敬重

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive honour or respect, or to be regarded very highly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 得到他人的表彰、尊重或高度敬重。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħata ġieħ jew rispett, jew ikun stmat ħafna minn ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到表彰；获授荣誉。
受到尊重。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be held in high estee,
sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到高度敬重；备受推崇。

formal.mt: L-għalliem tweġġaħ waqt iċ-ċerimonja għall-ħidma tiegħu fl-edukazzjoni.
formal.en: The teacher was honoured during the ceremony for his work in education.
formal.zh: 这位教师在典礼上因其教育工作而受到表彰。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tweġġaħ Pawlu lbieraħ? Mark: Għax ilu snin jgħin lin-nies tar-raħal.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why was Pawlu honoured yesterday? Mark: Because he has been helping the people of the village for years.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 昨天为什么受到表彰？Mark：因为他多年来一直帮助村里的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 昨天为什么受到表彰？
messages.en: Why was Pawlu honoured yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ilu snin jgħin lin-nies tar-raħal.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ilu snin jgħin lin-nies tar-raħal.
messages.zh: 因为他多年来一直帮助村里的人。
messages.en: Because he has been helping the people of the village for years.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人站在台上接受大家的敬意；把 tweġġaħ 记作这个人受到表彰或尊重。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The experience of being physically hurt or emotionally wounded or offended.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体受伤，或感情受到伤害、感到被冒犯的经历或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-esperjenza li wieħed iweġġa' f'ġismu jew iħossu mweġġa' jew offiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动词 tweġġa' 的动名词，表示受伤或感情受伤。
受伤；身体或感情受到伤害。
受到冒犯；因言语或行为而感到受伤。

formal.mt: Id-diskussjoni enfasizzat li kliem iebes jista' jwassal għal tweġġigħ tas-sentimenti.
formal.en: The discussion emphasised that harsh words can lead to hurt feelings.
formal.zh: 讨论强调，尖刻的言语可能伤害他人的感情。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex waqaft iċ-ċajta? Ben: Biex nevita t-tweġġigħ tas-sentimenti. Indunajt li ma kinitx qed togħġob lil kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you stop the joke? Ben: To avoid hurting anyone's feelings. I realised that not everyone was enjoying it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么不继续开那个玩笑了？Ben：为了避免伤害别人的感情。我发现并不是每个人都喜欢那个玩笑。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不继续开那个玩笑了？
messages.en: Why did you stop the joke?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nevita t-tweġġigħ tas-sentimenti. Indunajt li ma kinitx qed togħġob lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Biex nevita t-tweġġigħ tas-sentimenti. Indunajt li ma kinitx qed togħġob lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: 为了避免伤害别人的感情。我发现并不是每个人都喜欢那个玩笑。
messages.en: To avoid hurting anyone's feelings. I realised that not everyone was enjoying it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tweġġigħ 配上身体和心各贴一块创可贴的图，提醒自己既可表示身体受伤，也可表示感情受伤。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of honouring someone or showing respect towards them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人授予荣誉、表达敬意或表示尊重的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' ġieħ lil xi ħadd jew il-wiri ta' rispett lejh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表彰；向某人致敬或授予荣誉。
向某人表示尊重或敬意。

formal.mt: L-iskola organizzat ċerimonja ta' tweġġiħ lill-għalliema li kienu waslu biex jirtiraw.
formal.en: The school organised a ceremony honouring the teachers who were about to retire.
formal.zh: 学校举行了仪式，向即将退休的教师致敬。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għal min huma dawn il-fjuri? Toni: Għall-għalliema tagħna. Huma sinjal ta' tweġġiħ wara tant snin ta' ħidma.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who are these flowers for? Toni: Our teacher. They are a sign of respect after so many years of work.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这些花是送给谁的？Toni：送给我们的老师，向她多年的付出表达敬意。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这些花是送给谁的？
messages.en: Who are these flowers for?

messages.speaker: Toni (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għall-għalliema tagħna. Huma sinjal ta' tweġġiħ wara tant snin ta' ħidma.
messages.mt_standard: Għall-għalliema tagħna. Huma sinjal ta' tweġġiħ wara tant snin ta' ħidma.
messages.zh: 送给我们的老师，向她多年的付出表达敬意。
messages.en: Our teacher. They are a sign of respect after so many years of work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用献花致敬的画面记 tweġġiħ；对照 tweġġigħ，看到中间多出的 g，就换成受伤的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of measuring weight; also balance or support that keeps something steady.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 测量重量的过程；也可指使物体保持稳定的平衡或支撑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tkejjel il-piż; ukoll bilanċ jew appoġġ li jżomm xi ħaġa stabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 称重；测量物体重量的过程。
平衡；重量或力量相互协调而保持稳定的状态。
支撑；承托物体或使其保持稳定的支持。

formal.mt: It-tweżin tal-pakketti għandu jsir qabel ma jiġu kkalkulati l-ispejjeż tat-trasport.
formal.en: The parcels must be weighed before the transport costs are calculated.
formal.zh: 应先对包裹称重，再计算运输费用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għadna ma nafux kemm se jiswa t-trasport? Mark: Għax għad irridu nagħmlu t-tweżin tal-pakketti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't we know how much shipping will cost yet? Mark: Because we still need to weigh the parcels.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么我们还不知道运费是多少？马克：因为我们还得给包裹称重。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għadna ma nafux kemm se jiswa t-trasport?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għadna ma nafux kemm se jiswa t-trasport?
messages.zh: 为什么我们还不知道运费是多少？
messages.en: Why don't we know how much shipping will cost yet?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għad irridu nagħmlu t-tweżin tal-pakketti.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għad irridu nagħmlu t-tweżin tal-pakketti.
messages.zh: 因为我们还得给包裹称重。
messages.en: Because we still need to weigh the parcels.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象包裹放上秤盘：先称重量，再看两边是否平衡，最后想到秤架的支撑；用同一画面串起三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bigotry, resentment, or hypocrisy, according to the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依语境指偏执排他的态度、心中的怨愤，或表里不一的虚伪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Intolleranza lejn fehmiet jew gruppi oħra, riżentiment, jew ipokrezija, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偏执排他；顽固地排斥不同信仰、观点或群体的态度。
怨愤；因受到不公或冒犯而产生的持续不满。
虚伪；言行不一，或假装具有自己实际并不具备的道德立场。

collocations.zh: 充满偏执排他言论的讲话
藏在漂亮话背后的虚伪

formal.mt: L-awtur jikkritika t-tweżwiż ta' dawk li jipprietkaw l-onestà iżda jqarrqu bin-nies.
formal.en: The author criticises the hypocrisy of those who preach honesty but deceive people.
formal.zh: 作者批评那些宣扬诚实却欺骗人们的人的虚伪。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Jgħid li kulħadd għandu jgħid il-verità, imma hu jigdeb. Pawlu: Dak tweżwiż; għandu jagħmel dak li jgħid.
colloquial.en: Lara: He says everyone should tell the truth, but he lies. Pawlu: That's hypocrisy; he should practise what he preaches.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他说人人都应该讲真话，自己却撒谎。保罗：这就是虚伪；他应该言行一致。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jgħid li kulħadd għandu jgħid il-verità, imma hu jigdeb.
messages.mt_standard: Jgħid li kulħadd għandu jgħid il-verità, imma hu jigdeb.
messages.zh: 他说人人都应该讲真话，自己却撒谎。
messages.en: He says everyone should tell the truth, but he lies.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak tweżwiż; għandu jagħmel dak li jgħid.
messages.mt_standard: Dak tweżwiż; għandu jagħmel dak li jgħid.
messages.zh: 这就是虚伪；他应该言行一致。
messages.en: That's hypocrisy; he should practise what he preaches.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张情境卡分别记忆：排斥异己、心怀怨愤、嘴上正义却行为相反；读句子时先判断对应哪张卡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To listen secretly to a conversation that is not intended for you.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 暗中听取并非说给自己听的谈话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tisma' bil-moħbi konversazzjoni li mhijiex maħsuba għalik.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偷听；在别人不知情的情况下暗中听取其谈话。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, ir-raġel twidden wara l-bieb waqt laqgħa privata.
formal.en: According to the report, the man eavesdropped behind the door during a private meeting.
formal.zh: 据报告，该男子在一次私人会议期间躲在门后偷听。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sar jaf Mark bis-sorpriża? Lara: Twidden wara l-bieb waqt li konna nitkellmu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Mark find out about the surprise? Lara: He eavesdropped behind the door while we were talking.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克是怎么知道那个惊喜的？拉拉：我们说话时，他在门后偷听了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克是怎么知道那个惊喜的？
messages.en: How did Mark find out about the surprise?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Twidden wara l-bieb waqt li konna nitkellmu.
messages.mt_standard: Twidden wara l-bieb waqt li konna nitkellmu.
messages.zh: 我们说话时，他在门后偷听了。
messages.en: He eavesdropped behind the door while we were talking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人把耳朵贴在门上偷偷听话；把 twidden 记成动作词，用“他偷听了”这一完整句意帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of secretly listening to other people's conversations without their knowledge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在他人不知情的情况下暗中听取其谈话的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tisma' bil-moħbi l-konversazzjonijiet ta' ħaddieħor mingħajr ma jkunu jafu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偷听；暗中听取他人谈话这一行为。

formal.mt: Il-kodiċi tal-imġiba jipprojbixxi t-twiddin fuq konversazzjonijiet privati bejn il-kollegi.
formal.en: The code of conduct prohibits eavesdropping on private conversations between colleagues.
formal.zh: 行为准则禁止偷听同事之间的私人谈话。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għalaqt il-bieb? Mark: Biex inkunu nistgħu nitkellmu fil-privat; ma rridx twiddin.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you close the door? Mark: So we can talk privately; I don't want any eavesdropping.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么把门关上了？马克：这样我们就能私下谈话；我不想有人偷听。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么把门关上了？
messages.en: Why did you close the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex inkunu nistgħu nitkellmu fil-privat; ma rridx twiddin.
messages.mt_standard: Biex inkunu nistgħu nitkellmu fil-privat; ma rridx twiddin.
messages.zh: 这样我们就能私下谈话；我不想有人偷听。
messages.en: So we can talk privately; I don't want any eavesdropping.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 twiddin 写在“偷听行为”的标签上，再与动词 twidden 对照记忆：一个给行为命名，一个叙述偷听动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be given a promise that something will be provided or done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 得到别人作出的承诺，获许将得到某物或某项安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tingħata wegħda li se tirċievi xi ħaġa jew li se jsir xi ħaġa għalik.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被许诺；得到将获某物或某种待遇的承诺。

collocations.en: was promised a place on the course
collocations.zh: 被许诺会获得课程名额

formal.mt: L-applikant twiegħed post fil-kors wara li ssodisfa r-rekwiżiti kollha.
formal.en: The applicant was promised a place on the course after meeting all the requirements.
formal.zh: 申请人满足全部要求后，得到了会获得课程名额的承诺。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark qed jistenna hawn? Pawlu: Twiegħed l-għajnuna, u qed jistenna lil xi ħadd jiġi jgħinu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is Mark waiting here? Pawlu: He was promised help, and he's waiting for someone to come and help him.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克为什么在这里等？保罗：有人答应会帮他，他正等着有人过来帮忙。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么在这里等？
messages.en: Why is Mark waiting here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Twiegħed l-għajnuna, u qed jistenna lil xi ħadd jiġi jgħinu.
messages.mt_standard: Twiegħed l-għajnuna, u qed jistenna lil xi ħadd jiġi jgħinu.
messages.zh: 有人答应会帮他，他正等着有人过来帮忙。
messages.en: He was promised help, and he's waiting for someone to come and help him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人把写着“会给你奖励”的承诺卡交到你手里：你是收到承诺的人；承诺卡到手不等于奖励已经到手。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To encounter obstacles or have progress hindered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 遇到困难或障碍，使行动或进展受到阻碍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiltaqa' ma' ostakli jew isib diffikultajiet li jfixklu l-progress.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 面临障碍；遇到阻力。
受到阻碍；进展受阻。

collocations.en: encountered obstacles because of a lack of funds
collocations.zh: 因资金不足而遇到障碍

formal.mt: Il-proġett twiegħer minħabba nuqqas ta' fondi, iżda l-ħidma kompliet wara li nstabet soluzzjoni.
formal.en: The project faced obstacles because of a lack of funds, but work continued after a solution was found.
formal.zh: 该项目因资金不足而受阻，但在找到解决办法后，工作继续进行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-proġett twiegħer fil-bidu? Mark: Iva, ma kellniex biżżejjed flus, imma issa sejjer tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the project face obstacles at the beginning? Mark: Yes, we didn't have enough money, but it's going well now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：项目一开始遇到阻碍了吗？马克：是啊，我们当时资金不够，不过现在进展顺利。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 项目一开始遇到阻碍了吗？
messages.en: Did the project face obstacles at the beginning?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ma kellniex biżżejjed flus, imma issa sejjer tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ma kellniex biżżejjed flus, imma issa sejjer tajjeb.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们当时资金不够，不过现在进展顺利。
messages.en: Yes, we didn't have enough money, but it's going well now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 twiegħer 配上项目走到路障前的画面，记住它表示遇阻或受阻。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To come into the world as a baby.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为婴儿来到世上，即出生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi fid-dinja bħala tarbija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出生；诞生。

collocations.en: was born into a large family

formal.mt: Skont ir-reġistru tal-iskola, Daniel twieled f'Malta u beda jistudja f'din l-iskola meta kellu ħames snin.
formal.en: According to the school register, Daniel was born in Malta and began studying at this school when he was five.
formal.zh: 根据学校登记册，丹尼尔出生于马耳他，五岁时开始在这所学校就读。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn twieled ħuk? Pawlu: Twieled Għawdex, imma trabba Malta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where was your brother born? Pawlu: He was born in Gozo, but grew up in Malta.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你兄弟在哪里出生的？保罗：他在戈佐岛出生，不过是在马耳他岛长大的。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟在哪里出生的？
messages.en: Where was your brother born?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 他在戈佐岛出生，不过是在马耳他岛长大的。
messages.en: He was born in Gozo, but grew up in Malta.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 twieled 就想象出生登记卡，再联想两个常见问题：在哪里出生、何时出生。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive an answer or response, as when a question or request is answered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指问题、请求等得到回答或回应，强调被答复的一方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tingħata tweġiba, bħal meta mistoqsija jew talba tirċievi risposta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被回答；问题、请求等得到答复。

formal.mt: Il-kwestjonarju twieġeb bil-miktub u ntbagħat lura lill-uffiċċju.
formal.en: The questionnaire was answered in writing and sent back to the office.
formal.zh: 问卷得到了书面作答，并被寄回办公室。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-email tiegħi għadu bla tweġiba? Mark: Le, twieġeb dalgħodu; iċċekkja l-posta tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is my email still unanswered? Mark: No, it was answered this morning; check your inbox.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我的邮件还没得到回复吗？马克：不是，今天早上已经回复了；看看你的收件箱。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 我的邮件还没得到回复吗？
messages.en: Is my email still unanswered?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, twieġeb dalgħodu; iċċekkja l-posta tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Le, twieġeb dalgħodu; iċċekkja l-posta tiegħek.
messages.zh: 不是，今天早上已经回复了；看看你的收件箱。
messages.en: No, it was answered this morning; check your inbox.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一封收到回信的邮件，让回复箭头指向原邮件；记住本词强调“得到回答”，把注意力放在被答复的对象上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive support, either physical support or help and backing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 得到支撑，或获得他人的帮助与支持。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirċievi appoġġ fiżiku jew għajnuna u sostenn minn ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 得到支持；受到支撑。

formal.mt: Il-pjan twieżen mill-kumitat minħabba l-benefiċċji tiegħu għall-komunità.
formal.en: The plan was supported by the committee because of its benefits to the community.
formal.zh: 由于该计划有益于社区，委员会给予了支持。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-pjan tiegħek twieżen mit-tim? Daniel: Iva, kulħadd qabel u offra l-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did your plan receive support from the team? Daniel: Yes, everyone agreed and offered to help.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你的计划得到团队支持了吗？丹尼尔：是的，大家都同意了，还主动提出帮忙。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你的计划得到团队支持了吗？
messages.en: Did your plan receive support from the team?

messages.speaker: Daniel (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kulħadd qabel u offra l-għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kulħadd qabel u offra l-għajnuna.
messages.zh: 是的，大家都同意了，还主动提出帮忙。
messages.en: Yes, everyone agreed and offered to help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 twieżen 想成一个计划被许多双手托住，用支撑的画面记住得到支持。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be given food by someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由别人给予食物或帮助进食，即被喂食。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħata l-ikel minn xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被喂食；得到喂养。

formal.mt: It-tifel twikkel bl-imgħarfa minn ommu qabel l-eżami mediku.
formal.en: The boy was fed with a spoon by his mother before the medical examination.
formal.zh: 体检前，男孩由母亲用勺子喂食。

colloquial.mt: Mark: It-tifel diġà twikkel? Sara: Iva, tajtu jiekol jien. Issa qed jilgħab.
colloquial.en: Mark: Has the boy been fed already? Sara: Yes, I fed him. He's playing now.
colloquial.zh: 马克：孩子已经喂过了吗？萨拉：是的，我喂过了。他现在正在玩。

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.zh: 孩子已经喂过了吗？
messages.en: Has the boy been fed already?

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tajtu jiekol jien. Issa qed jilgħab.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tajtu jiekol jien. Issa qed jilgħab.
messages.zh: 是的，我喂过了。他现在正在玩。
messages.en: Yes, I fed him. He's playing now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 twikkel 时想象勺子送到孩子嘴边，句子的主角是接受喂食的人。

gloss_zh: 被摊派某事；被加上负担

teaching_sense.en_definition: The experience of having a task, responsibility, or burden imposed on oneself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某项任务、责任或负担被摊派到自己身上的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li wieħed jitgħabba b'xi xogħol, responsabbiltà jew piż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被摊派某事；被迫承担某项任务或负担。

collocations.en: being saddled with a new responsibility

formal.mt: It-twikkija b'xogħol żejjed mingħajr riżorsi addizzjonali ħolqot diffikultajiet għat-tim.
formal.en: Being saddled with extra work without additional resources created difficulties for the team.
formal.zh: 在没有增加资源的情况下被摊派额外工作，给团队造成了困难。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejjer bix-xogħol il-ġdid? Mark: Din it-twikkija b'xogħol żejjed għajjietni. Għandi bżonn min jgħinni.
colloquial.en: Maja: How are you getting on with the new work? Mark: Being saddled with all this extra work has worn me out. I need someone to help me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新接的工作做得怎么样？马克：被摊上这些额外工作，真把我累坏了。我需要有人帮忙。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 新接的工作做得怎么样？
messages.en: How are you getting on with the new work?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Din it-twikkija b'xogħol żejjed għajjietni. Għandi bżonn min jgħinni.
messages.mt_standard: Din it-twikkija b'xogħol żejjed għajjietni. Għandi bżonn min jgħinni.
messages.zh: 被摊上这些额外工作，真把我累坏了。我需要有人帮忙。
messages.en: Being saddled with all this extra work has worn me out. I need someone to help me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 twikkija 配上桌面突然多出一叠任务的画面，记住被摊派负担的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An excessive eagerness to eat, or eating greedily and without restraint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对食物表现出过度的欲望，或贪婪而不加节制地进食。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa eċċessiva għall-ikel jew ikel b'regħba u bla rażan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贪食；暴食；毫无节制地吃东西。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-twikkil tal-karattru jidher meta jieħu l-ikel kollu u ma jħalli xejn għall-oħrajn.
formal.en: In the story, the character's gluttony is shown when he takes all the food and leaves nothing for the others.
formal.zh: 故事中，这个角色拿走所有食物，一点也不留给别人，表现出他的贪食。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ħa t-tielet platt jekk diġà kien xaba'? Pawlu: Dak twikkil! Lanqas ħalla kejk għalina.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did he take a third plate if he was already full? Pawlu: That's gluttony! He didn't even leave us any cake.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他都已经吃饱了，为什么还拿第三盘？保罗：那就是贪吃！他连蛋糕都没给我们留。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħa t-tielet platt jekk diġà kien xaba'?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħa t-tielet platt jekk diġà kien xaba'?
messages.zh: 他都已经吃饱了，为什么还拿第三盘？
messages.en: Why did he take a third plate if he was already full?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak twikkil! Lanqas ħalla kejk għalina.
messages.mt_standard: Dak twikkil! Lanqas ħalla kejk għalina.
messages.zh: 那就是贪吃！他连蛋糕都没给我们留。
messages.en: That's gluttony! He didn't even leave us any cake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 twikkil 和吃饱后仍不断堆满盘子的画面相连，记住贪食与不节制的意味。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of formally giving up or transferring a right or possession to another party.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式将某项权利或财产让与另一方的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti jew it-trasferiment formali ta' dritt jew proprjetà lil parti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 让与；将权利或财产正式转让给另一方。

formal.mt: Id-dokument jiddeskrivi t-twillija tad-drittijiet minn parti għall-oħra u jispeċifika d-data tat-trasferiment.
formal.en: The document describes the cession of rights from one party to the other and specifies the transfer date.
formal.zh: 该文件说明了一方向另一方让与权利的事项，并明确了转让日期。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser 'twillija' f'dan id-dokument? Daniel: Hawn tfisser li parti tgħaddi d-drittijiet tagħha lill-parti l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does 'twillija' mean in this document? Daniel: Here it means that one party transfers its rights to the other party.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这份文件里的 twillija 是什么意思？丹尼尔：这里指一方把自己的权利转让给另一方。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这份文件里的 twillija 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'twillija' mean in this document?

messages.speaker: Daniel (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser li parti tgħaddi d-drittijiet tagħha lill-parti l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser li parti tgħaddi d-drittijiet tagħha lill-parti l-oħra.
messages.zh: 这里指一方把自己的权利转让给另一方。
messages.en: Here it means that one party transfers its rights to the other party.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 twillija 时画一个权利文件从甲方交到乙方的箭头，联想正式让与。

gloss_zh: 警告；告诫；劝勉；训诫；忠告

teaching_sense.en_definition: A message that alerts someone to danger or urges them to act properly, sometimes through advice or reprimand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提醒他人注意危险或采取适当行动的话语，可表现为警告、告诫、劝勉、训诫或忠告。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Messaġġ li jiġbed l-attenzjoni għal periklu jew iħeġġeġ lil xi ħadd jaġixxi kif suppost, permezz ta' parir jew ċanfira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 警告；提醒注意危险或不良后果。
告诫；带有纠正或责备意味的提醒。
劝勉；恳切地敦促他人采取行动或认真行事。
训诫；因过错或不当行为而受到的责备。
忠告；为帮助他人作出适当选择而给予的劝告。

collocations.en: to give a warning or admonishment

formal.mt: L-avviż jinkludi twissija dwar l-art tiżloq u jitlob lill-viżitaturi jimxu bil-mod.
formal.en: The notice includes a warning about the slippery floor and asks visitors to walk slowly.
formal.zh: 告示中包含地面湿滑的警告，并要求访客慢行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt it-twissija ħdejn il-bieb? Mark: Iva, l-art tiżloq. Se nimxi bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see the warning by the door? Mark: Yes, the floor is slippery. I'll walk slowly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到门边的警告了吗？马克：看到了，地面很滑。我会慢慢走。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到门边的警告了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the warning by the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, l-art tiżloq. Se nimxi bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-art tiżloq. Se nimxi bil-mod.
messages.zh: 看到了，地面很滑。我会慢慢走。
messages.en: Yes, the floor is slippery. I'll walk slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 twissija 放进提醒你留意的场景：路牌是警告，长辈的话可作忠告，责备过错时可作训诫。

gloss_zh: 被整平；被夷平；得到便利

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made level, to be razed to the ground, or figuratively to be made easier.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指地面被整平、建筑物被夷为平地，也可比喻事情得到便利、变得容易。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir ċatt, jinqered sal-art, jew, f'sens figurattiv, isir aktar faċli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被整平；变得平坦。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be razed to the ground
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被夷为平地；被彻底拆毁。
得到便利；受到促成而变得容易。

collocations.en: the building was razed to the ground

formal.mt: It-terren twitta qabel ma beda x-xogħol fuq il-ġnien il-ġdid.
formal.en: The ground was levelled before work began on the new garden.
formal.zh: 新花园的施工开始前，地面已经整平。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-terren diġà twitta? Pawlu: Iva, issa hu ċatt u nistgħu nibdew inħawlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the ground been levelled already? Pawlu: Yes, it's flat now and we can start planting.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：地面已经整平了吗？保罗：是啊，现在平坦了，我们可以开始种植了。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺伙伴)
messages.zh: 地面已经整平了吗？
messages.en: Has the ground been levelled already?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园艺伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa hu ċatt u nistgħu nibdew inħawlu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa hu ċatt u nistgħu nibdew inħawlu.
messages.zh: 是啊，现在平坦了，我们可以开始种植了。
messages.en: Yes, it's flat now and we can start planting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个意思连成画面：地面被整平，建筑被夷平，办事的障碍也被扫平；注意这里表达的是受到处理后的变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a grimace or to wear a mask, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依语境指扭动面部做出怪相，或戴上面具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel wiċċ stramb jew tilbes maskra, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 做怪相；因不适、厌恶或其他感受而扭动面部表情。
戴面具；用面具遮住面部。

collocations.en: grimaced when he tasted the medicine

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżami, il-pazjent twiċċeċ meta ħass l-uġigħ f'irkopptu.
formal.en: During the examination, the patient grimaced when he felt pain in his knee.
formal.zh: 检查时，病人感到膝盖疼痛，脸上露出了痛苦的表情。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark twiċċeċ hekk? Lara: Għadu kif daq il-lumi mingħajr zokkor!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark make that face? Lara: He's just tasted the lemon without any sugar!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么做出那副表情？拉拉：他刚尝了没加糖的柠檬！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么做出那副表情？
messages.en: Why did Mark make that face?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu kif daq il-lumi mingħajr zokkor!
messages.mt_standard: Għadu kif daq il-lumi mingħajr zokkor!
messages.zh: 他刚尝了没加糖的柠檬！
messages.en: He's just tasted the lemon without any sugar!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把脸想成舞台：一幕是尝酸柠檬时五官皱起，一幕是戴上节日面具；两个画面对应两个动词义项。

gloss_zh: 主动出面；冒昧主动；鼓起勇气求人帮忙

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coming forward or acting with forwardness, including overcoming hesitation to ask someone for a favour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主动站出来或表现得大胆主动的行为，也包括克服顾虑、开口请求别人帮忙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li toħroġ 'il quddiem jew turi ruħek kuraġġuż, inkluż li tegħleb it-tlaqliq biex titlob pjaċir lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 主动出面；站出来表明意愿或采取行动。
大胆主动；表现得不拘谨，有时带有冒昧或过分主动的意味。

sense_translations.en_definition: overcoming reluctance to ask for a favour
sense_translations.zh_definition: 克服开口求人的顾虑；鼓起勇气请别人帮忙。

collocations.en: overcoming hesitation to ask for a favour
collocations.zh: 鼓起勇气开口请人帮忙

formal.mt: It-twiċċiċ biex titlob l-għajnuna jista' jkun pass importanti biex issolvi problema.
formal.en: Overcoming hesitation to ask for help can be an important step towards solving a problem.
formal.zh: 克服顾虑、开口求助，可以是解决问题的重要一步。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nistħi nitlob lil Maja tgħinni. Pawlu: Ftit twiċċiċ u staqsiha; forsi tkun kuntenta tgħinek.
colloquial.en: Lara: I feel embarrassed to ask Maja to help me. Pawlu: Pluck up a little courage and ask her; she might be happy to help.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我不好意思请玛雅帮我。保罗：鼓起一点勇气问问她；她也许很乐意帮忙。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我不好意思请玛雅帮我。
messages.en: I feel embarrassed to ask Maja to help me.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit twiċċiċ u staqsiha; forsi tkun kuntenta tgħinek.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit twiċċiċ u staqsiha; forsi tkun kuntenta tgħinek.
messages.zh: 鼓起一点勇气问问她；她也许很乐意帮忙。
messages.en: Pluck up a little courage and ask her; she might be happy to help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己从人群后面走到前面开口：适度是主动出面，过头可能冒昧，求助时则是克服不好意思。

gloss_zh: 使正式化；使获得正式地位

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give something official status or recognition, such as an agreement, decision, or appointment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使协议、决定或任命等获得正式地位或官方认可。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti status jew għarfien uffiċjali lil xi ħaġa, bħal ftehim, deċiżjoni jew ħatra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使正式化；使获得正式地位或官方认可。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat uffiċjalizza l-ħatra tad-direttur b'deċiżjoni bil-miktub.
formal.en: The committee made the director's appointment official through a written decision.
formal.zh: 委员会通过书面决定正式确认了主任的任命。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Il-klabb uffiċjalizza l-ftehim mal-kowċ? David: Iva, ħabbar kollox dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Has the club made the agreement with the coach official? David: Yes, it announced everything this morning.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：俱乐部正式确认与教练的协议了吗？戴维：是的，今天早上已经公布了。

messages.speaker: Anna (球迷)
messages.zh: 俱乐部正式确认与教练的协议了吗？
messages.en: Has the club made the agreement with the coach official?

messages.speaker: David (球迷朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，今天早上已经公布了。
messages.en: Yes, it announced everything this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象口头谈好的协议终于盖章确认：uffiċjalizza 就是给事情正式地位；可与“协议、任命”一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 官僚主义；过分拘泥官方程序的作风

teaching_sense.en_definition: Excessive attachment to official rules, procedures, or authority, especially when it obstructs practical action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 过分依赖官方规则、程序或权威的作风，尤其指因此妨碍实际办事的官僚主义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rabta żejda mar-regoli, mal-proċeduri jew mal-awtorità uffiċjali, speċjalment meta din tfixkel ix-xogħol prattiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 官僚主义；过分强调官方权威、规章和程序的作风。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jirrakkomanda proċeduri aktar sempliċi biex jitnaqqas l-uffiċjaliżmu fis-servizzi pubbliċi.
formal.en: The report recommends simpler procedures to reduce officialism in public services.
formal.zh: 报告建议简化程序，以减少公共服务中的官僚作风。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għal kopja waħda talbuni nimla tliet formoli! Ġużeppi: Dan uffiċjaliżmu żejjed; il-proċess għandu jkun aktar sempliċi.
colloquial.en: Marija: They asked me to fill in three forms for a single copy! Ġużeppi: That's excessive officialism; the process should be simpler.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：只要一份副本，他们竟让我填三张表！朱塞佩：这官僚作风太重了，流程应该更简单。

messages.speaker: Marija (办事居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal kopja waħda talbuni nimla tliet formoli!
messages.mt_standard: Għal kopja waħda talbuni nimla tliet formoli!
messages.zh: 只要一份副本，他们竟让我填三张表！
messages.en: They asked me to fill in three forms for a single copy!

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan uffiċjaliżmu żejjed; il-proċess għandu jkun aktar sempliċi.
messages.mt_standard: Dan uffiċjaliżmu żejjed; il-proċess għandu jkun aktar sempliċi.
messages.zh: 这官僚作风太重了，流程应该更简单。
messages.en: That's excessive officialism; the process should be simpler.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象为了拿一张副本却反复填表、盖章的场景，把 uffiċjaliżmu 与“程序压过办事目的”的官僚作风联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country in East Africa whose official Maltese name is Repubblika tal-Uganda.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 东非国家乌干达，其马耳他语正式名称为 Repubblika tal-Uganda，即乌干达共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Lvant li l-isem uffiċjali tiegħu huwa r-Repubblika tal-Uganda.

sense_translations.en_definition: Uganda (a country in East Africa; official name: Repubblika tal-Uganda)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 乌干达，位于东非的国家；正式名称为乌干达共和国，马耳他语为 Repubblika tal-Uganda。

formal.mt: L-Uganda hija pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Lvant, u l-isem uffiċjali tagħha huwa r-Repubblika tal-Uganda.
formal.en: Uganda is a country in East Africa, and its official name is the Republic of Uganda.
formal.zh: 乌干达是东非国家，正式名称为乌干达共和国。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn tixtieq tivvjaġġa? Mark: Nixtieq immur l-Uganda. Maja: Allura nistgħu nfittxu informazzjoni dwar il-vjaġġ flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where would you like to travel? Mark: I'd like to go to Uganda. Maja: Then we can look for information about the trip together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想去哪里旅行？马克：我想去乌干达。玛雅：那我们可以一起查查这趟旅行的信息。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想去哪里旅行？
messages.en: Where would you like to travel?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我想去乌干达。
messages.en: I'd like to go to Uganda.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Allura nistgħu nfittxu informazzjoni dwar il-vjaġġ flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Allura nistgħu nfittxu informazzjoni dwar il-vjaġġ flimkien.
messages.zh: 那我们可以一起查查这趟旅行的信息。
messages.en: Then we can look for information about the trip together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Uganda 写在东非地图上的乌干达位置，再连读 l-Uganda、fl-Uganda 和 tal-Uganda，分别记住国名、在该国和该国的。

gloss_zh: 乌干达的；乌干达人，通常指男性

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or relating to Uganda.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自乌干达的、属于乌干达的，或与乌干达有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Uganda jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Uganda.

sense_translations.en_definition: Ugandan (of, from or relating to Uganda)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 乌干达的；来自乌干达的；与乌干达有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Ugandan (native or inhabitant of Uganda) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 乌干达人，即乌干达本地人或居民，通常指男性。

collocations.en: a Ugandan man living in Malta
collocations.zh: 一位住在马耳他的乌干达男子

formal.mt: Il-kittieb Ugandiż ippreżenta x-xogħol tiegħu waqt laqgħa mal-qarrejja.
formal.en: The Ugandan writer presented his work during a meeting with readers.
formal.zh: 这位乌干达作家在读者见面会上介绍了自己的作品。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Minn fejn hu l-ħabib il-ġdid tiegħek? Pawlu: Hu Ugandiż u issa jgħix Malta. Sara: Nixtieq niltaqa' miegħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is your new friend from? Pawlu: He's Ugandan and now lives in Malta. Sara: I'd like to meet him.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你的新朋友来自哪里？保罗：他是乌干达人，现在住在马耳他。萨拉：我想认识他。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn hu l-ħabib il-ġdid tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn hu l-ħabib il-ġdid tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你的新朋友来自哪里？
messages.en: Where is your new friend from?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu Ugandiż u issa jgħix Malta.
messages.mt_standard: Hu Ugandiż u issa jgħix Malta.
messages.zh: 他是乌干达人，现在住在马耳他。
messages.en: He's Ugandan and now lives in Malta.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我想认识他。
messages.en: I'd like to meet him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张词卡区分词性：kittieb Ugandiż 是“乌干达的作家”，一个 Ugandiż 则是“乌干达人”，名词用法通常指男性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of being equal, including equality in rights, opportunities, status, or value.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于平等或相等的状态，可指权利、机会、地位或数值等方面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda li fiha jkun hemm l-istess drittijiet, opportunitajiet, status jew valur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平等；相等，指权利、机会、地位或数值等方面相同。

formal.mt: Il-politika tal-iskola tippromwovi l-ugwalità fl-opportunitajiet għall-istudenti kollha.
formal.en: The school's policy promotes equality of opportunity for all students.
formal.zh: 学校的政策促进所有学生享有平等机会。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kulħadd jista' japplika għal dan il-kors? Mark: Iva, l-iskola trid tiżgura l-ugwalità fl-opportunitajiet. Lara: Tajjeb, mela se napplika wkoll.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can everyone apply for this course? Mark: Yes, the school wants to ensure equality of opportunity. Lara: Good, then I'll apply too.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：每个人都能申请这门课程吗？马克：是的，学校希望确保机会平等。拉拉：太好了，那我也申请。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kulħadd jista' japplika għal dan il-kors?
messages.mt_standard: Kulħadd jista' japplika għal dan il-kors?
messages.zh: 每个人都能申请这门课程吗？
messages.en: Can everyone apply for this course?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, l-iskola trid tiżgura l-ugwalità fl-opportunitajiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-iskola trid tiżgura l-ugwalità fl-opportunitajiet.
messages.zh: 是的，学校希望确保机会平等。
messages.en: Yes, the school wants to ensure equality of opportunity.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 太好了，那我也申请。
messages.en: Good, then I'll apply too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象所有学生站在同一条起跑线上，用这个画面记住 ugwalità 的“平等”；再搭配权利和机会巩固抽象名词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make amounts, levels or scores equal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使数量、水平或比分变得相等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib ammonti, livelli jew punteġġi ndaqs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使相等；使均衡；将比分扳平。

formal.mt: Biex il-qsim ikun ġust, ugwalizza ż-żewġ ammonti qabel tqassamhom.
formal.en: To ensure a fair division, make the two amounts equal before distributing them.
formal.zh: 为确保分配公平，请先将两个数量调整为相等，再进行分配。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dawn iż-żewġ porzjonijiet mhumiex indaqs. Mark: Sewwa, ugwalizza l-porzjonijiet u mbagħad nieklu.
colloquial.en: Maja: These two portions aren't equal. Mark: All right, make the portions equal and then we'll eat.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这两份分量不一样。Mark：好，那就把分量分匀，然后我们吃饭。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这两份分量不一样。
messages.en: These two portions aren't equal.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, ugwalizza l-porzjonijiet u mbagħad nieklu.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, ugwalizza l-porzjonijiet u mbagħad nieklu.
messages.zh: 好，那就把分量分匀，然后我们吃饭。
messages.en: All right, make the portions equal and then we'll eat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象天平两边逐渐一样重，把 ugwalizza 与“调到相等”这一动作绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In equal amounts or to the same degree.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以相等的数量，或达到相同的程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'ammonti ndaqs jew bl-istess grad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 同等地；同样地；平均地。

formal.mt: Ir-riżorsi għandhom jitqassmu ugwalment bejn iż-żewġ gruppi.
formal.en: The resources should be distributed equally between the two groups.
formal.zh: 这些资源应当在两个小组之间平均分配。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif se naqsmu l-kejk? Pawlu: Naqsmuh ugwalment, biex kulħadd jieħu l-istess ammont.
colloquial.en: Sara: How are we going to divide the cake? Pawlu: We'll divide it equally, so everyone gets the same amount.
colloquial.zh: Sara：蛋糕怎么分？Pawlu：我们平均分，让每个人拿到一样多。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 蛋糕怎么分？
messages.en: How are we going to divide the cake?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naqsmuh ugwalment, biex kulħadd jieħu l-istess ammont.
messages.mt_standard: Naqsmuh ugwalment, biex kulħadd jieħu l-istess ammont.
messages.zh: 我们平均分，让每个人拿到一样多。
messages.en: We'll divide it equally, so everyone gets the same amount.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象蛋糕被切成完全相等的几份，用 ugwalment 记住“怎样分：平均地”。

gloss_zh: 乌克兰的；乌克兰人；乌克兰语

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from or relating to Ukraine, its people or its language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于、来自或涉及乌克兰、乌克兰人或乌克兰语的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tal-Ukrajna, ġej mill-Ukrajna jew marbut mal-poplu jew mal-lingwa tagħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: Ukrainian (of, from or relating to Ukraine)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 乌克兰的；来自乌克兰的；与乌克兰有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Ukrainian (native or inhabitant of Ukraine) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 乌克兰人；乌克兰本地人或居民，通常指男性。
乌克兰语。

collocations.en: a Ukrainian man living in Malta
collocations.zh: 一位住在马耳他的乌克兰男子

formal.mt: Kittieb Ukren ippreżenta x-xogħol tiegħu bl-Ukren waqt il-laqgħa letterarja.
formal.en: A Ukrainian writer presented his work in Ukrainian during the literary meeting.
formal.zh: 一位乌克兰作家在文学交流会上用乌克兰语介绍了自己的作品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ġar il-ġdid tiegħek huwa Ukren? Pawlu: Iva, u kultant jgħallimni xi kelma bl-Ukren.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is your new neighbour Ukrainian? Pawlu: Yes, and sometimes he teaches me a word in Ukrainian.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)

messages.mt_standard: Iva, u kultant jgħallimni xi kelma bl-Ukren.

cognitive_memory_aid: 围绕乌克兰画三个记忆格：作家的身份、一个当地男子、他说的语言，分别对应三个词义。

gloss_zh: 从人的角度；就人的能力而言

teaching_sense.en_definition: From a human point of view or within the limits of human ability.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从人的角度来看，或就人的能力与限度而言。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mill-perspettiva tal-bniedem jew skont il-ħila u l-limiti tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从人的角度；以人的能力而言；在人力所及的范围内。

collocations.zh: 从人的感受和承受能力来看很困难的

formal.mt: It-tim għamel dak kollu li kien umanament possibbli biex itemm ix-xogħol fil-ħin.
formal.en: The team did everything humanly possible to finish the work on time.
formal.zh: 团队尽了人力所能做到的一切，力求按时完成工作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tista' tlesti dan kollu llejla? Mark: Se nagħmel dak li hu umanament possibbli, imma x-xogħol huwa ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you finish all this tonight? Mark: I'll do what's humanly possible, but there's a lot of work.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你今晚能把这些全做完吗？Mark：我会尽人力所能，但工作量很大。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你今晚能把这些全做完吗？
messages.en: Can you finish all this tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nagħmel dak li hu umanament possibbli, imma x-xogħol huwa ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Se nagħmel dak li hu umanament possibbli, imma x-xogħol huwa ħafna.
messages.zh: 我会尽人力所能，但工作量很大。
messages.en: I'll do what's humanly possible, but there's a lot of work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个普通人努力搬箱子的能力上限，用 umanament possibbli 记住“人力所能做到”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The belief in protecting human welfare and dignity and helping people who are suffering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 重视人的福祉与尊严，并主张帮助受苦者的理念。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-twemmin fil-ħarsien tal-ġid u d-dinjità tal-bnedmin u fl-għajnuna lil min qed ibati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人道主义；以维护人的福祉和尊严、减轻人的苦难为核心的理念。

formal.mt: L-umanitarjaniżmu jiggwida l-ħidma tal-għaqda biex tgħin lil min qed ibati u tħares id-dinjità tiegħu.
formal.en: Humanitarianism guides the organisation's work to help those who are suffering and protect their dignity.
formal.zh: 人道主义指导着该组织的工作，使其帮助受苦者并维护他们的尊严。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu l-umanitarjaniżmu, fi kliem sempliċi? David: Li tagħti valur lill-ħajja u d-dinjità ta' kull persuna u tgħin lil min qed ibati.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is humanitarianism, in simple terms? David: Valuing every person's life and dignity and helping those who are suffering.
colloquial.zh: Sara：简单来说，人道主义是什么？David：就是重视每个人的生命与尊严，并帮助正在受苦的人。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 简单来说，人道主义是什么？
messages.en: What is humanitarianism, in simple terms?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Li tagħti valur lill-ħajja u d-dinjità ta' kull persuna u tgħin lil min qed ibati.
messages.mt_standard: Li tagħti valur lill-ħajja u d-dinjità ta' kull persuna u tgħin lil min qed ibati.
messages.zh: 就是重视每个人的生命与尊严，并帮助正在受苦的人。
messages.en: Valuing every person's life and dignity and helping those who are suffering.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 umanitarjaniżmu 配上一幅救助受苦者并尊重其尊严的画面，整体记作“人道主义”。

gloss_zh: 人道主义的；人道援助的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Concerned with protecting people's lives and dignity and relieving their suffering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 旨在保护人的生命与尊严、减轻苦难的，常用于描述援助、工作或行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-għan li jħares il-ħajja u d-dinjità tan-nies u jtaffi t-tbatija tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人道主义的；以救助受苦者、维护人的生命与尊严为目的的。

formal.mt: L-appoġġ umanitarju jinkludi ikel, ilma nadif u kenn għall-familji milquta mill-għargħar.
formal.en: Humanitarian support includes food, clean water and shelter for families affected by the floods.
formal.zh: 人道援助包括为受洪灾影响的家庭提供食物、清洁饮水和住所。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'tip ta' xogħol tagħmel mal-għaqda? Mark: Nagħmel xogħol umanitarju; ngħin biex jitqassam l-ikel lill-familji fil-bżonn.
colloquial.en: Lara: What kind of work do you do with the organization? Mark: I do humanitarian work; I help distribute food to families in need.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你在那个组织里做什么工作？马克：我做人道救援工作，帮忙给有需要的家庭分发食物。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在那个组织里做什么工作？
messages.en: What kind of work do you do with the organization?

messages.speaker: Mark (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħmel xogħol umanitarju; ngħin biex jitqassam l-ikel lill-familji fil-bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Nagħmel xogħol umanitarju; ngħin biex jitqassam l-ikel lill-familji fil-bżonn.
messages.zh: 我做人道救援工作，帮忙给有需要的家庭分发食物。
messages.en: I do humanitarian work; I help distribute food to families in need.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个形容词与灾后送水送粮的画面相连：关注人的生命、尊严和苦难，就想到“人道主义的”。

gloss_zh: 使人性化；使更有人情味

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something more considerate of people's feelings, needs and dignity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使制度、服务或做法更体谅人的感受、需要和尊严，更有人情味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa aktar sensittiva għas-sentimenti, il-ħtiġijiet u d-dinjità tan-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人性化；使更体谅人的感受与需要，或更有人情味。

collocations.zh: 使工作环境更有人情味了

formal.mt: Id-direttur umanizza s-servizz billi ta aktar ħin lill-persunal biex jisma' lill-pazjenti.
formal.en: The director humanized the service by giving staff more time to listen to patients.
formal.zh: 主管让员工有更多时间倾听患者，从而使服务更人性化。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex tħossok aħjar fuq ix-xogħol issa? Mark: Il-maniġer il-ġdid umanizza l-ambjent tax-xogħol; issa jisma' l-bżonnijiet tagħna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do you feel better at work now? Mark: The new manager humanized the working environment; he now listens to our needs.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么现在工作时感觉更好了？马克：新经理让工作环境更有人情味了；他现在会倾听我们的需要。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tħossok aħjar fuq ix-xogħol issa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tħossok aħjar fuq ix-xogħol issa?
messages.zh: 你为什么现在工作时感觉更好了？
messages.en: Why do you feel better at work now?

messages.speaker: Mark (员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-maniġer il-ġdid umanizza l-ambjent tax-xogħol; issa jisma' l-bżonnijiet tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Il-maniġer il-ġdid umanizza l-ambjent tax-xogħol; issa jisma' l-bżonnijiet tagħna.
messages.zh: 新经理让工作环境更有人情味了；他现在会倾听我们的需要。
messages.en: The new manager humanized the working environment; he now listens to our needs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“把人的需要放回服务里”这个动作：愿意倾听、给予体谅，就是使服务人性化。

gloss_zh: 人性化；使更有人情味的过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making something more considerate of people's feelings, needs and dignity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使制度、服务或环境更体谅人的感受、需要和尊严的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir aktar sensittiva għas-sentimenti, il-ħtiġijiet u d-dinjità tan-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人性化；使事物更体谅人的感受、需要与尊严的过程。

formal.mt: L-umanizzazzjoni tal-kura teħtieġ attenzjoni għall-bżonnijiet emozzjonali tal-pazjenti kif ukoll għall-bżonnijiet fiżiċi tagħhom.
formal.en: The humanization of care requires attention to patients' emotional needs as well as their physical needs.
formal.zh: 照护的人性化要求既关注患者的身体需要，也关注他们的情感需要。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'tifhem bl-umanizzazzjoni tas-servizz? Mark: Li nisimgħu lin-nies u naddattaw l-għajnuna għall-bżonnijiet tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Lara: What do you mean by the humanization of the service? Mark: Listening to people and adapting the assistance to their needs.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你说的服务人性化是什么意思？马克：就是倾听人们的意见，并根据他们的需要调整帮助方式。

messages.speaker: Lara (新同事)
messages.zh: 你说的服务人性化是什么意思？
messages.en: What do you mean by the humanization of the service?

messages.speaker: Mark (服务主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Li nisimgħu lin-nies u naddattaw l-għajnuna għall-bżonnijiet tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Li nisimgħu lin-nies u naddattaw l-għajnuna għall-bżonnijiet tagħhom.
messages.zh: 就是倾听人们的意见，并根据他们的需要调整帮助方式。
messages.en: Listening to people and adapting the assistance to their needs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它当作一个过程名称来记：从只按流程办事，到照顾每个人的需要，这个变化叫“人性化”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something slightly wet or moist.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物带上少量水分，变得微湿或潮湿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa kemxejn imxarrba billi jżid magħha ftit ilma jew umdità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使微湿；润湿；使带上少量水分。

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar umda l-ħamrija bi ftit ilma qabel ma żera' ż-żrieragħ.
formal.en: The gardener dampened the soil with a little water before sowing the seeds.
formal.zh: 园丁在播种前用少量水润湿了土壤。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex id-drapp hu ftit imxarrab? Mark: Pawlu umda d-drapp biex inaddaf il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the cloth slightly wet? Mark: Paul dampened the cloth to clean the table.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这块布怎么有点湿？马克：保罗把布润湿了，用来擦桌子。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 这块布怎么有点湿？
messages.en: Why is the cloth slightly wet?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu umda d-drapp biex inaddaf il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu umda d-drapp biex inaddaf il-mejda.
messages.zh: 保罗把布润湿了，用来擦桌子。
messages.en: Paul dampened the cloth to clean the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象擦桌前往布上洒一点水：记住“让它变得微湿”的动作，就能抓住这个动词的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Moisture in the air or in materials, or the condition of being damp.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 空气或物体中的水分、湿气，也指潮湿的状态或空气的湿度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-preżenza ta' ilma fl-arja jew fil-materjali, jew il-kundizzjoni ta' xi ħaġa li tkun niedja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 潮湿；湿气；湿度，尤指空气中的水分或物体受潮的状态。

formal.mt: L-umdità fil-ħitan tista' tagħmel ħsara liż-żebgħa u tħalli tbajja' fuq il-wiċċ.
formal.en: Dampness in the walls can damage the paint and leave stains on the surface.
formal.zh: 墙体潮湿可能损坏油漆，并在表面留下污斑。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-ħwejjeġ għadhom ma nixfux? Mark: Illum hawn ħafna umdità; se ndaħħalhom ġewwa u nixgħel il-fann.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why haven't the clothes dried yet? Mark: It's very humid today; I'll bring them inside and turn on the fan.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：衣服怎么还没干？马克：今天湿气很重；我把它们拿进屋，再打开风扇。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 衣服怎么还没干？
messages.en: Why haven't the clothes dried yet?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum hawn ħafna umdità; se ndaħħalhom ġewwa u nixgħel il-fann.
messages.mt_standard: Illum hawn ħafna umdità; se ndaħħalhom ġewwa u nixgħel il-fann.
messages.zh: 今天湿气很重；我把它们拿进屋，再打开风扇。
messages.en: It's very humid today; I'll bring them inside and turn on the fan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把晾不干的衣服和墙上的潮斑放在一起记：它们都提示“湿气”；谈空气含水多少时就是“湿度”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Slightly wet or containing a noticeable amount of moisture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有明显水分或湿气的，可描述物体潮湿或天气湿润。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun fih ilma jew umdità li tinħass, bħal ħajt jew temp b'ħafna umdità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 潮湿的；湿润的；带有水分或较多湿气的。

formal.mt: Il-ħajt umduż għandu jinxef sew qabel ma jingħata saff ġdid ta' żebgħa.
formal.en: The damp wall should dry thoroughly before a new coat of paint is applied.
formal.zh: 潮湿的墙应充分干燥后再涂一层新漆。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' nqiegħed il-kotba ma' dan il-ħajt? Mark: Aħjar le, għax għadu umduż. Poġġihom fuq l-ixkaffa l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I put the books against this wall? Mark: Better not, because it's still damp. Put them on the other shelf.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我可以把书靠着这面墙放吗？马克：最好别放，因为墙还潮着。把书放到另一个架子上吧。

messages.zh: 我可以把书靠着这面墙放吗？
messages.en: Can I put the books against this wall?

messages.en: Better not, because it's still damp. Put them on the other shelf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 摸到墙面带着湿气时，用这个形容词描述墙的状态；想到天气里湿气重，也能记住“潮湿的”。

gloss_zh: 令人屈辱的；使人丢脸的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Making someone feel ashamed, degraded or deprived of dignity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人感到羞耻、受贬低或失去尊严的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss mistħija jew iħoss li ġie mċekken fid-dinjità tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人屈辱的；使人感到受辱、丢脸或尊严受损的。

formal.mt: Kumment umiljanti quddiem il-kollegi jista' jagħmel ħsara lid-dinjità tal-impjegat.
formal.en: A humiliating comment in front of colleagues can harm an employee's dignity.
formal.zh: 当着同事的面发表使人受辱的评论，可能损害员工的尊严。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex tlaqt mil-laqgħa? Mark: Dak il-kumment kien umiljanti; ma ridtx nibqa' hemm waqt li jidħku bija.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you leave the meeting? Mark: That comment was humiliating; I didn't want to stay there while they laughed at me.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么离开了会议？马克：那句话太让人受辱了；我不想待在那里任他们嘲笑。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么离开了会议？
messages.en: Why did you leave the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-kumment kien umiljanti; ma ridtx nibqa' hemm waqt li jidħku bija.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-kumment kien umiljanti; ma ridtx nibqa' hemm waqt li jidħku bija.
messages.zh: 那句话太让人受辱了；我不想待在那里任他们嘲笑。
messages.en: That comment was humiliating; I didn't want to stay there while they laughed at me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词连到“当众被嘲笑，觉得尊严受损”的情境，记住它描述令人产生屈辱感的言语或经历。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a modest and respectful manner, without acting as though one is superior to others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以谦虚、尊重他人且不自以为高人一等的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod modest u b'rispett lejn l-oħrajn, mingħajr ma wieħed iqis ruħu aħjar minnhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谦逊地；谦恭地；以不自大、尊重他人的态度。

formal.mt: Fir-rimarki tiegħu, ir-rebbieħ aċċetta t-tifħir umilment u rringrazzja lit-tim kollu.
formal.en: In his remarks, the winner accepted the praise humbly and thanked the entire team.
formal.zh: 获奖者在致辞中谦逊地接受了赞扬，并感谢了整个团队。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qal Mark meta faħħruh? Pawlu: Wieġeb umilment: 'Grazzi, imma t-tim kollu ħadem ħafna.'
colloquial.en: Lara: What did Mark say when they praised him? Paul: He replied humbly: 'Thank you, but the whole team worked hard.'
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：大家表扬马克时，他说了什么？保罗：他谦逊地回答：“谢谢，不过整个团队都很努力。”

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 大家表扬马克时，他说了什么？
messages.en: What did Mark say when they praised him?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Wieġeb umilment: 'Grazzi, imma t-tim kollu ħadem ħafna.'
messages.mt_standard: Wieġeb umilment: 'Grazzi, imma t-tim kollu ħadem ħafna.'
messages.zh: 他谦逊地回答：“谢谢，不过整个团队都很努力。”
messages.en: He replied humbly: 'Thank you, but the whole team worked hard.'

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象受表扬后真诚道谢，并把功劳分享给团队：这个词说明回答或接受赞扬时“谦逊地”的态度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person's mood or emotional state at a particular time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人在某个时候的心情或情绪状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat emozzjonali ta' persuna f'mument partikolari, jiġifieri kif tkun qed tħossha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 心情；情绪；此处的 humour 指情绪状态。

formal.mt: Wara li sema' l-aħbar it-tajba, id-direttur kien ta' umur tajjeb matul il-laqgħa.
formal.en: After hearing the good news, the director was in a good mood throughout the meeting.
formal.zh: 听到好消息后，主任在整场会议中都心情很好。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Illum tidher ta' umur tajjeb! Pawlu: Iva, għadni kemm iltqajt ma' ħabib antik.
colloquial.en: Maja: You seem to be in a good mood today! Pawlu: Yes, I've just met up with an old friend.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天看起来心情很好！保罗：是啊，我刚和一位老朋友见了面。
