messages.en: Yes, I've just met up with an old friend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 umur 放进心情温度计里记：tajjeb 对应好心情，ħażin 对应坏心情，整组搭配一起练。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of Hungary, a country in Central Europe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 匈牙利的国名，指位于中欧的一个国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ta' pajjiż fl-Ewropa Ċentrali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 匈牙利，中欧的一个国家。

collocations.zh: 在匈牙利的访问；赴匈牙利游览

formal.mt: L-istudenti qraw test qasir dwar l-Ungerija u mbagħad wieġbu l-mistoqsijiet.
formal.en: The students read a short text about Hungary and then answered the questions.
formal.zh: 学生们阅读了一篇介绍匈牙利的短文，然后回答问题。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn sejjer għall-vaganza? Mark: Se mmur l-Ungerija ma' ħabib tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are you going on holiday? Mark: I'm going to Hungary with a friend of mine.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你要去哪里度假？马克：我要和一个朋友去匈牙利。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur l-Ungerija ma' ħabib tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur l-Ungerija ma' ħabib tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我要和一个朋友去匈牙利。
messages.en: I'm going to Hungary with a friend of mine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在想象的中欧地图上给匈牙利贴上 Ungerija 标签，再用“去匈牙利旅行”的句子反复定位。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bring separate parts, groups or systems together into one whole.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把原本分开的部分、群体或系统合成一个整体，使其统一。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaqqad partijiet, gruppi jew sistemi separati f'ħaġa waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使统一；把分散的部分整合为一个整体。

collocations.zh: 把两个部门合并为一体

formal.mt: Il-kumitat unifika ż-żewġ sistemi ta' reġistrazzjoni biex l-istudenti jużaw servizz wieħed.
formal.en: The committee unified the two registration systems so that students could use a single service.
formal.zh: 委员会整合了两个注册系统，让学生能够使用同一个服务。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għad għandna żewġ gruppi għall-istess proġett? Toni: Le, Mark unifika l-gruppi lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do we still have two groups for the same project? Toni: No, Mark unified the groups yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：同一个项目现在还有两个小组吗？托尼：没有了，马克昨天把两个小组合并了。

messages.speaker: Lara (项目成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad għandna żewġ gruppi għall-istess proġett?
messages.mt_standard: Għad għandna żewġ gruppi għall-istess proġett?
messages.zh: 同一个项目现在还有两个小组吗？
messages.en: Do we still have two groups for the same project?

messages.speaker: Toni (项目成员)
messages.zh: 没有了，马克昨天把两个小组合并了。
messages.en: No, Mark unified the groups yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两条分开的队伍合成一条：unifika 表示“使统一”这个动作，用“谁把什么合起来”造句记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Capable of being brought together into a single whole or system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够合成一个整体或整合到同一个系统中的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jingħaqad ma' partijiet oħra f'ħaġa jew sistema waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可统一的；能够整合为一体的。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, iż-żewġ sistemi huma unifikabbli jekk jużaw l-istess format tad-data.
formal.en: According to the report, the two systems are unifiable if they use the same data format.
formal.zh: 根据报告，如果两个系统使用相同的数据格式，就可以将它们整合起来。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dawn iż-żewġ proċessi huma unifikabbli? David: Naħseb li iva, għax għandhom kważi l-istess passi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Are these two processes unifiable? David: I think so, because they have almost the same steps.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这两个流程可以整合吗？戴维：我觉得可以，因为它们的步骤几乎相同。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 这两个流程可以整合吗？
messages.en: Are these two processes unifiable?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li iva, għax għandhom kważi l-istess passi.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li iva, għax għandhom kważi l-istess passi.
messages.zh: 我觉得可以，因为它们的步骤几乎相同。
messages.en: I think so, because they have almost the same steps.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给两块能够拼合的拼图贴上 unifikabbli：强调“可以合起来”的性质，尚未说明已经合并。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or result of bringing separate parts, groups or systems into one whole.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把分开的部分、群体或系统合成一个整体的过程或结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew ir-riżultat ta' għaqda ta' partijiet, gruppi jew sistemi separati f'ħaġa waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 统一；整合；把分散部分合为一体的过程或结果。

formal.mt: L-unifikazzjoni taż-żewġ dipartimenti se tippermetti koordinazzjoni aħjar tax-xogħol.
formal.en: The unification of the two departments will allow better coordination of the work.
formal.zh: 两个部门的合并将有助于更好地协调工作。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif sejra l-unifikazzjoni tal-gruppi? Ben: Sejra tajjeb; issa lkoll nużaw kalendarju wieħed.
colloquial.en: Anna: How is the unification of the groups going? Ben: It's going well; now we all use one calendar.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：各小组的整合进展如何？本：进展不错，我们现在都用同一个日历。

messages.speaker: Anna (项目协调员)
messages.zh: 各小组的整合进展如何？
messages.en: How is the unification of the groups going?

messages.speaker: Ben (项目成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Sejra tajjeb; issa lkoll nużaw kalendarju wieħed.
messages.mt_standard: Sejra tajjeb; issa lkoll nużaw kalendarju wieħed.
messages.zh: 进展不错，我们现在都用同一个日历。
messages.en: It's going well; now we all use one calendar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“两套系统变成一套”的整段过程画成箭头，给箭头标上 unifikazzjoni，记住它是过程或结果的名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making things follow the same standard, format or procedure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使事物遵循相同标准、格式或程序的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih affarijiet differenti jibdew isegwu l-istess standard, format jew proċedura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 标准化；使不同事物遵循统一标准的过程。

formal.mt: L-uniformazzjoni tal-formoli se tgħin lill-impjegati jiġbru l-istess informazzjoni f'kull uffiċċju.
formal.en: The standardisation of forms will help employees collect the same information in every office.
formal.zh: 表格标准化将帮助员工在每个办事处收集相同的信息。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex qed nagħmlu l-uniformazzjoni tal-formoli? Karl: Biex kull uffiċċju jitlob l-istess informazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why are we standardising the forms? Karl: So that every office asks for the same information.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我们为什么要把表格标准化？卡尔：这样每个办事处要求填写的信息就都一样了。

messages.speaker: Rita (行政人员)
messages.zh: 我们为什么要把表格标准化？
messages.en: Why are we standardising the forms?

messages.speaker: Karl (行政同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex kull uffiċċju jitlob l-istess informazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Biex kull uffiċċju jitlob l-istess informazzjoni.
messages.zh: 这样每个办事处要求填写的信息就都一样了。
messages.en: So that every office asks for the same information.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把各式表格逐张改成同一模板，uniformazzjoni 就是这项“统一标准”的过程；抓住正在整理的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality or state of being consistent or the same in relevant features across different things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不同事物在相关特征上保持相同或一致的性质或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità jew l-istat ta' affarijiet li jkunu l-istess jew konsistenti fil-karatteristiċi rilevanti tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一致性；统一性；各部分在特征上相同或一致的状态。

formal.mt: L-editur talab uniformità fl-istil u fil-format tal-kapitli kollha.
formal.en: The editor requested uniformity in the style and format of all the chapters.
formal.zh: 编辑要求所有章节的风格和格式保持一致。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex użajt l-istess kulur fit-titli kollha? Sam: Biex ikun hemm uniformità fid-disinn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you use the same colour for all the headings? Sam: To create uniformity in the design.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么把所有标题都用了同一种颜色？萨姆：为了让设计保持统一。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex użajt l-istess kulur fit-titli kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex użajt l-istess kulur fit-titli kollha?
messages.zh: 你为什么把所有标题都用了同一种颜色？
messages.en: Why did you use the same colour for all the headings?

messages.speaker: Sam (同学)
messages.zh: 为了让设计保持统一。
messages.en: To create uniformity in the design.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一排标题颜色、字号都一致，uniformità 就是眼前呈现出的“一致状态”，用整齐的画面帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make things follow a common standard, format or procedure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使不同事物遵循共同的标准、格式或程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel affarijiet differenti skont l-istess standard, format jew proċedura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使标准化；按照统一标准调整，使之保持一致。

formal.mt: L-editur uniformizza l-format tad-dokumenti kollha qabel il-pubblikazzjoni.
formal.en: The editor standardised the format of all the documents before publication.
formal.zh: 编辑在出版前统一了所有文档的格式。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min uniformizza l-format tal-paġni? Mark: Jien; issa t-titli kollha għandhom l-istess daqs.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who standardised the page format? Mark: I did; now all the headings are the same size.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：是谁统一了页面格式？马克：是我，现在所有标题的字号都一样了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 是谁统一了页面格式？
messages.en: Who standardised the page format?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien; issa t-titli kollha għandhom l-istess daqs.
messages.mt_standard: Jien; issa t-titli kollha għandhom l-istess daqs.
messages.zh: 是我，现在所有标题的字号都一样了。
messages.en: I did; now all the headings are the same size.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象编辑亲手把不同字号改成相同字号，uniformizza 抓住“动手使之统一”的动作，用人物加动作造句记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A unit of distance used in astronomy, especially for distances within the Solar System.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 天文学中使用的一种距离单位，尤其用于表示太阳系内的距离。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità ta' distanza użata fl-astronomija, speċjalment għad-distanzi fis-Sistema Solari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天文单位，一种天文学距离单位。

collocations.en: a distance of one astronomical unit

collocations.zh: 以天文单位进行的测量

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, id-distanzi bejn l-oġġetti tas-Sistema Solari huma espressi f'unitajiet astronomiċi.
formal.en: In the report, distances between objects in the Solar System are expressed in astronomical units.
formal.zh: 报告以天文单位表示太阳系各天体之间的距离。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi unità astronomika? Ben: Hija unità ta' distanza li nużaw fl-astronomija.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is an astronomical unit? Ben: It is a unit of distance that we use in astronomy.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：什么是天文单位？本：它是我们在天文学中使用的一种距离单位。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是天文单位？
messages.en: What is an astronomical unit?

messages.speaker: Ben (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija unità ta' distanza li nużaw fl-astronomija.
messages.mt_standard: Hija unità ta' distanza li nużaw fl-astronomija.
messages.zh: 它是我们在天文学中使用的一种距离单位。
messages.en: It is a unit of distance that we use in astronomy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它想成太阳系地图上的距离尺：记住它量的是距离，不是时间。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who supports universalism, holding that certain principles or values apply to everyone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支持普遍主义的人，主张某些原则或价值适用于所有人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tappoġġja l-universaliżmu u tqis li ċerti prinċipji jew valuri japplikaw għal kulħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 普遍主义者，主张某些原则或价值具有普遍适用性的人。

formal.mt: Bħala universalista, l-awtur jiddefendi l-fehma li d-dinjità ta' kull persuna għandha valur ugwali.
formal.en: As a universalist, the author defends the view that every person's dignity has equal value.
formal.zh: 作为普遍主义者，作者捍卫每个人的尊严具有同等价值这一观点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tgħid li int universalista? Mark: Għax nemmen li l-istess prinċipji ta' dinjità japplikaw għal kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you say you are a universalist? Mark: Because I believe the same principles of dignity apply to everyone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么说自己是普遍主义者？马克：因为我相信，同样的尊严原则适用于所有人。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么说自己是普遍主义者？
messages.en: Why do you say you are a universalist?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax nemmen li l-istess prinċipji ta' dinjità japplikaw għal kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Għax nemmen li l-istess prinċipji ta' dinjità japplikaw għal kulħadd.
messages.zh: 因为我相信，同样的尊严原则适用于所有人。
messages.en: Because I believe the same principles of dignity apply to everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个举着“原则适用于人人”标语的人，用人物画面记住“普遍主义者”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of applying to everyone or to all cases within the scope being considered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在所讨论的范围内适用于所有人或所有情况的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa li tapplika għal kulħadd jew għall-każijiet kollha fil-qasam li jkun qed jiġi kkunsidrat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 普遍性，适用于所有人或相关范围内所有情况的性质。

collocations.zh: 某项原则的普遍适用性

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina l-universalità ta' dan il-prinċipju billi jqabbel l-applikazzjoni tiegħu f'kuntesti differenti.
formal.en: The study examines the universality of this principle by comparing its application in different contexts.
formal.zh: 该研究通过比较这项原则在不同情境中的应用，考察其普遍适用性。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'tifhem bl-universalità ta' din ir-regola? Pawlu: Li tapplika għal kulħadd, mhux biss għal xi wħud.
colloquial.en: Sara: What do you mean by the universality of this rule? Pawlu: That it applies to everyone, not just to some people.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你说这条规则具有普遍性，是什么意思？保罗：意思是它适用于所有人，而不只适用于某些人。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你说这条规则具有普遍性，是什么意思？
messages.en: What do you mean by the universality of this rule?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Li tapplika għal kulħadd, mhux biss għal xi wħud.
messages.mt_standard: Li tapplika għal kulħadd, mhux biss għal xi wħud.
messages.zh: 意思是它适用于所有人，而不只适用于某些人。
messages.en: That it applies to everyone, not just to some people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一把罩住所有人的大伞，把“人人都适用”这一性质记作普遍性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something apply to everyone or extend it to all relevant cases.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某事物适用于所有人，或将其推广到所有相关情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa applikabbli għal kulħadd jew jestendiha għall-każijiet rilevanti kollha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使普遍化，使某种原则、做法或安排获得普遍适用性。

collocations.zh: 使人人都能获得使用机会

collocations.en: made the application of the rule universal

formal.mt: Il-kunsill universalizza l-aċċess għas-servizz billi estendieh lir-residenti kollha.
formal.en: The council universalized access to the service by extending it to all residents.
formal.zh: 地方议会将服务扩展至全体居民，使所有居民都能使用该服务。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Il-kumitat universalizza din ir-regola. Toni: Mela issa tapplika għal kulħadd? Lina: Iva, għall-membri kollha.
colloquial.en: Lina: The committee made this rule universally applicable. Toni: So it applies to everyone now? Lina: Yes, to all members.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：委员会让这条规则普遍适用了。托尼：所以现在它适用于所有人？莉娜：对，适用于全体成员。

messages.speaker: Lina (委员会成员)
messages.zh: 委员会让这条规则普遍适用了。
messages.en: The committee made this rule universally applicable.

messages.speaker: Toni (委员会成员)
messages.zh: 所以现在它适用于所有人？
messages.en: So it applies to everyone now?

messages.speaker: Lina (委员会成员)
messages.zh: 对，适用于全体成员。
messages.en: Yes, to all members.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一条规则从少数人的桌上推向所有人，用这个动作记住“使普遍化”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making something apply to everyone or extending it to all relevant cases.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某事物适用于所有人，或扩展到所有相关情况的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir applikabbli għal kulħadd jew tiġi estiża għall-każijiet rilevanti kollha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 普遍化，将某种原则、做法或服务推广至所有相关对象的过程。

collocations.en: the universalization of access to education

formal.mt: Il-pjan jiddeskrivi l-passi meħtieġa għall-universalizzazzjoni tal-aċċess għall-edukazzjoni.
formal.en: The plan describes the steps needed for the universalization of access to education.
formal.zh: 该计划说明了普及教育机会所需采取的步骤。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'tfisser l-universalizzazzjoni tas-servizz? Ġorġ: Tfisser li nwessgħu l-aċċess biex kulħadd ikun jista' jużah.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does the universalization of the service mean? Ġorġ: It means widening access so that everyone can use it.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：服务普及化是什么意思？乔治：就是扩大使用机会，让每个人都能使用这项服务。

messages.speaker: Marija (居民)
messages.zh: 服务普及化是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the universalization of the service mean?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (社区工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li nwessgħu l-aċċess biex kulħadd ikun jista' jużah.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li nwessgħu l-aċċess biex kulħadd ikun jista' jużah.
messages.zh: 就是扩大使用机会，让每个人都能使用这项服务。
messages.en: It means widening access so that everyone can use it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把服务覆盖图从几个点逐步涂满：整段扩展过程就是“普遍化”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The view that certain principles, values, or rights apply to all people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 认为某些原则、价值或权利适用于所有人的观点或思想。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fehma li ċerti prinċipji, valuri jew drittijiet japplikaw għall-bnedmin kollha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 普遍主义，主张某些原则、价值或权利适用于所有人的思想。

formal.mt: L-artiklu jiddiskuti l-universaliżmu morali u jistaqsi jekk l-istess prinċipji morali japplikawx għall-bnedmin kollha.
formal.en: The article discusses moral universalism and asks whether the same moral principles apply to all human beings.
formal.zh: 文章讨论道德普遍主义，并探讨同样的道德原则是否适用于所有人。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Illum tkellimna dwar l-universaliżmu fil-klassi. Adam: Jiġifieri l-idea li ċerti prinċipji japplikaw għal kulħadd? Nina: Iva, eżatt.
colloquial.en: Nina: We talked about universalism in class today. Adam: You mean the idea that certain principles apply to everyone? Nina: Yes, exactly.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们今天在课堂上讨论了普遍主义。亚当：你是说某些原则适用于所有人这一思想吗？妮娜：对，正是这个意思。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 我们今天在课堂上讨论了普遍主义。
messages.en: We talked about universalism in class today.

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri l-idea li ċerti prinċipji japplikaw għal kulħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri l-idea li ċerti prinċipji japplikaw għal kulħadd?
messages.zh: 你是说某些原则适用于所有人这一思想吗？
messages.en: You mean the idea that certain principles apply to everyone?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 对，正是这个意思。
messages.en: Yes, exactly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“人人适用”写成一套思想：人是普遍主义者，思想本身是普遍主义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Connected with a university, its teaching, studies, or activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与大学及其教学、学习或活动有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut mal-università, mat-tagħlim, mal-istudji jew mal-attivitajiet tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与大学有关的；大学的。

formal.mt: Dan il-kors universitarju jgħaqqad tagħlim teoretiku ma' xogħol prattiku.
formal.en: This university course combines theoretical instruction with practical work.
formal.zh: 这门大学课程将理论教学与实践工作相结合。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Qed taħseb li tibda kors universitarju? Luqa: Iva, nixtieq nistudja l-lingwi.
colloquial.en: Emma: Are you thinking of starting a university course? Luqa: Yes, I would like to study languages.
colloquial.zh: 埃玛：你在考虑开始读大学课程吗？卢卡：是的，我想学习语言。

messages.speaker: Emma (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed taħseb li tibda kors universitarju?
messages.mt_standard: Qed taħseb li tibda kors universitarju?
messages.zh: 你在考虑开始读大学课程吗？
messages.en: Are you thinking of starting a university course?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，我想学习语言。
messages.en: Yes, I would like to study languages.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放在“课程”和“学生”后面练习，想象大学校园，记住它表示“大学的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bring separate people, groups, or parts together into a united whole.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把分散的人、群体或部分联合起来，使其形成统一或团结的整体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib persuni, gruppi jew partijiet separati flimkien biex jiffurmaw ħaġa waħda jew jaħdmu magħqudin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使统一，使团结；把原本分开的成员或部分联合起来。

formal.mt: Il-proġett unixxa ż-żewġ gruppi madwar għan komuni u ħeġġeġ il-kooperazzjoni bejniethom.
formal.en: The project united the two groups around a common goal and encouraged cooperation between them.
formal.zh: 该项目围绕共同目标将两个群体联合起来，并促进了双方合作。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dak il-proġett tassew unixxa t-tim. David: Veru, issa kulħadd qed jgħin lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Rita: That project really united the team. David: True, now everyone is helping one another.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：那个项目确实让团队团结起来了。戴维：没错，现在大家都在互相帮助。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 那个项目确实让团队团结起来了。
messages.en: That project really united the team.

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, issa kulħadd qed jgħin lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, issa kulħadd qed jgħin lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 没错，现在大家都在互相帮助。
messages.en: True, now everyone is helping one another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象原本分开的两队人围成一个圆，用“聚成整体”的画面记住联合与团结。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The European Union, an organization of European member countries.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 欧洲联盟，简称欧盟，由欧洲成员国组成的组织。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-Unjoni Ewropea, organizzazzjoni ta' pajjiżi membri fl-Ewropa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欧洲联盟，简称欧盟。

collocations.en: a member country of the European Union
the institutions of the European Union

formal.mt: Dan ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-ħidma tal-istituzzjonijiet tal-Unjoni Ewropea.
formal.en: This report describes the work of the institutions of the European Union.
formal.zh: 本报告介绍欧盟各机构的工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fuq xiex se tkun il-preżentazzjoni tiegħek? Mark: Fuq l-Unjoni Ewropea u l-pajjiżi membri tagħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What will your presentation be about? Mark: The European Union and its member countries.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的演讲准备讲什么？马克：讲欧盟及其成员国。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq xiex se tkun il-preżentazzjoni tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq xiex se tkun il-preżentazzjoni tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你的演讲准备讲什么？
messages.en: What will your presentation be about?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq l-Unjoni Ewropea u l-pajjiżi membri tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq l-Unjoni Ewropea u l-pajjiżi membri tagħha.
messages.zh: 讲欧盟及其成员国。
messages.en: The European Union and its member countries.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个名称与“欧洲联盟”配对记忆，再用“欧盟成员国”和“欧盟机构”两个词组巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Soviet Union, a former country spanning Europe and Asia that existed from 1922 to 1991.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 苏联，存在于1922年至1991年、横跨欧洲和亚洲的前国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-Unjoni Sovjetika, stat li kien jinfirex fl-Ewropa u fl-Asja u li eżista mill-1922 sal-1991.

sense_translations.en_definition: Soviet Union (a former transcontinental country in Europe and Asia (1922–1991), now split into Russia and fourteen other countries)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 苏联（1922年至1991年间存在、横跨欧洲和亚洲的前国家，现已分为俄罗斯及其他十四个国家）。

collocations.en: the history of the Soviet Union
the end of the Soviet Union

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jiddeskrivi l-Unjoni Sovjetika bħala stat li eżista mill-1922 sal-1991.
formal.en: The chapter describes the Soviet Union as a state that existed from 1922 to 1991.
formal.zh: 本章将苏联介绍为一个存在于1922年至1991年的国家。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qed taqra? Pawlu: Ktieb dwar l-Unjoni Sovjetika. Lara: Nista' nissellfu meta tlestih?
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you reading? Pawlu: A book about the Soviet Union. Lara: Can I borrow it when you finish it?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你在读什么？保罗：一本关于苏联的书。拉拉：你读完后我能借来看看吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在读什么？
messages.en: What are you reading?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 一本关于苏联的书。
messages.en: A book about the Soviet Union.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你读完后我能借来看看吗？
messages.en: Can I borrow it when you finish it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把名称与“苏联历史书”的画面联系起来，旁边写上1922—1991，提醒自己这是历史上的国家。

gloss_zh: 工会主义者；联合主义者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who supports unionism, such as a supporter of trade unions or of political union.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支持工会运动或政治联合的人；具体指工会主义者还是联合主义者，须结合语境判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tappoġġja l-unjoniżmu, pereżempju l-għaqda tal-ħaddiema fit-trejdjunjins jew għaqda politika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 工会主义者；支持政治联合的联合主义者，具体含义依语境而定。

collocations.zh: 积极参与活动的工会主义者或联合主义者
工会主义者或联合主义者的讲话

formal.mt: L-unjonista tkellem dwar l-importanza li l-ħaddiema jingħaqdu biex jiddefendu l-interessi tagħhom.
formal.en: The unionist spoke about the importance of workers joining together to defend their interests.
formal.zh: 这位工会主义者谈到了工人团结起来维护自身利益的重要性。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jitkellem fil-laqgħa tal-ħaddiema? Toni: Unjonista attiv li jaħdem magħna. Sara: Tajjeb, nixtieq nisma' x'għandu jgħid.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is going to speak at the workers' meeting? Toni: An active unionist who works with us. Sara: Good, I'd like to hear what he has to say.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁会在工人会议上发言？托尼：一位和我们共事、积极参与工会活动的人。萨拉：好，我想听听他怎么说。

messages.speaker: Sara (工人)
messages.zh: 谁会在工人会议上发言？
messages.en: Who is going to speak at the workers' meeting?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.zh: 一位和我们共事、积极参与工会活动的人。
messages.en: An active unionist who works with us.

messages.speaker: Sara (工人)
messages.zh: 好，我想听听他怎么说。
messages.en: Good, I'd like to hear what he has to say.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给这个词画一个正在会议上发言的人，记住它指“支持者本人”；再看语境判断支持工会还是政治联合。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Support for organization in trade unions or for political union, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主张通过工会组织起来，或支持政治联合的思想与运动，具体含义取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħsieb jew il-moviment favur l-għaqda fit-trejdjunjins jew favur għaqda politika, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 工会主义、工会运动；或主张政治联合的联合主义，须依语境理解。

collocations.zh: 工会主义或联合主义的原则

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina l-unjoniżmu fost il-ħaddiema u l-importanza tal-azzjoni kollettiva.
formal.en: The study examines unionism among workers and the importance of collective action.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察工人中的工会主义及集体行动的重要性。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'suġġett għażilt għall-esej? David: L-unjoniżmu fost il-ħaddiema. Nina: Allura se tikteb dwar għaliex jingħaqdu fit-trejdjunjins?
colloquial.en: Nina: What topic did you choose for your essay? David: Unionism among workers. Nina: So you're going to write about why they join trade unions?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你的文章选了什么题目？戴维：工人中的工会主义。妮娜：所以你要写他们为什么加入工会？

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你的文章选了什么题目？
messages.en: What topic did you choose for your essay?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.zh: 工人中的工会主义。
messages.en: Unionism among workers.

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Allura se tikteb dwar għaliex jingħaqdu fit-trejdjunjins?
messages.mt_standard: Allura se tikteb dwar għaliex jingħaqdu fit-trejdjunjins?
messages.zh: 所以你要写他们为什么加入工会？
messages.en: So you're going to write about why they join trade unions?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放在写着“思想与运动”的笔记本上，与指人的 unjonista 对照，记住这里说的是主张本身。

gloss_zh: 掉落；坠落；跌倒这一动作

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of falling, whether a person falls down or something drops from a higher position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人跌倒或物体从较高处掉下的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li persuna jew ħaġa taqa', minn pożizzjoni wieqfa jew minn post ogħla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 掉落、坠落或跌倒这一动作。

formal.mt: Il-passaġġ għandu jinżamm ħieles mill-ostakli biex jitnaqqas ir-riskju ta' uqigħ.
formal.en: The passage should be kept clear of obstacles to reduce the risk of falling.
formal.zh: 通道应保持畅通，避免障碍物，以降低跌倒风险。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex neħħejt it-tapit minn ħdejn il-bieb? Ġorġ: Biex innaqqas ir-riskju ta' uqigħ; it-tarf tiegħu kien merfugħ.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did you remove the rug from beside the door? Ġorġ: To reduce the risk of falling; its edge was sticking up.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你为什么把门边的地毯拿走了？乔治：为了减少跌倒的风险；它的边翘起来了。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex neħħejt it-tapit minn ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex neħħejt it-tapit minn ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.zh: 你为什么把门边的地毯拿走了？
messages.en: Why did you remove the rug from beside the door?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex innaqqas ir-riskju ta' uqigħ; it-tarf tiegħu kien merfugħ.
messages.mt_standard: Biex innaqqas ir-riskju ta' uqigħ; it-tarf tiegħu kien merfugħ.
messages.zh: 为了减少跌倒的风险；它的边翘起来了。
messages.en: To reduce the risk of falling; its edge was sticking up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人被翘起的地毯绊倒，把 uqigħ 贴在“跌落这个动作”的画面上，记住它是名词。

gloss_zh: 传统重量单位，约26.46克；盎司

teaching_sense.en_definition: A traditional weight unit equal to one thirtieth of a ratal, officially 26.46 grams, sometimes informally treated as 30 grams; also an ounce in other weight systems.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种传统重量单位，等于一拉特尔的三十分之一，正式为26.46克，有时在非正式使用中按30克计算；也指其他衡制中的盎司。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità tradizzjonali tal-piż, daqs wieħed minn tletin ta' ratal, uffiċjalment 26.46 gramma, kultant meqjusa informalment bħala 30 gramma; tintuża wkoll għal uqija f'sistemi oħra tal-piż.

sense_translations.en_definition: a traditional unit of weight, still used e.g. in household contexts, equivalent to ¹⁄₃₀ of a ratal, that is officially 0.933 imperial ounces (26.46 g), now sometimes metrified informally to mean 30 grammes (which would be ³⁄₈₀ of a metrical ratal)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种至今仍用于家庭等场合的传统重量单位，等于一拉特尔的三十分之一，正式相当于0.933英制盎司（26.46克）；如今有时非正式地按公制取为30克，此时相当于一公制拉特尔的八十分之三。
盎司，指其他衡制中称为盎司的单位。

formal.mt: F'din ir-riċetta, uqija tfisser il-miżura tradizzjonali ta' 26.46 gramma.
formal.en: In this recipe, an uqija means the traditional measure of 26.46 grams.
formal.zh: 在这份食谱中，一 uqija 指26.46克的传统计量单位。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Ir-riċetta tan-nanna tgħid uqija butir. Kemm niżen? Marija: Skont il-miżura tradizzjonali, 26.46 gramma; hawn id-dar normalment inqisuha 30 gramma.
colloquial.en: Anna: Grandma's recipe says an uqija of butter. How much should I weigh out? Marija: By the traditional measure, 26.46 grams; here at home we usually count it as 30 grams.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：奶奶的食谱写着一 uqija 黄油。我该称多少？玛丽亚：按传统单位是26.46克；我们家平时按30克算。

messages.speaker: Anna (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-riċetta tan-nanna tgħid uqija butir. Kemm niżen?
messages.mt_standard: Ir-riċetta tan-nanna tgħid uqija butir. Kemm niżen?
messages.zh: 奶奶的食谱写着一 uqija 黄油。我该称多少？
messages.en: Grandma's recipe says an uqija of butter. How much should I weigh out?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Skont il-miżura tradizzjonali, 26.46 gramma; hawn id-dar normalment inqisuha 30 gramma.
messages.mt_standard: Skont il-miżura tradizzjonali, 26.46 gramma; hawn id-dar normalment inqisuha 30 gramma.
messages.zh: 按传统单位是26.46克；我们家平时按30克算。
messages.en: By the traditional measure, 26.46 grams; here at home we usually count it as 30 grams.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老食谱旁放着电子秤，标签写“传统26.46克，家用有时取30克”；遇到其他衡制时再确认盎司的具体标准。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small rose; the diminutive form of the Maltese word warda.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小玫瑰；马耳他语 warda 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Warda żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' warda.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small rose (the diminutive form of 'warda')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一朵小玫瑰（warda 的指小形式）。

collocations.en: a small rose in the vase

formal.mt: Fin-nofs tal-mejda tqiegħdet urajda ħamra f'vażun żgħir.
formal.en: A small red rose was placed in a small vase in the middle of the table.
formal.zh: 桌子中央摆着一个小花瓶，里面插着一朵红色小玫瑰。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Din l-urajda għalik. Rita: Kemm hi sabiħa! Se npoġġiha fil-vażun ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Elena: This little rose is for you. Rita: How lovely it is! I'll put it in the vase by the window.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这朵小玫瑰送给你。丽塔：真漂亮！我要把它插在窗边的花瓶里。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 这朵小玫瑰送给你。
messages.en: This little rose is for you.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hi sabiħa! Se npoġġiha fil-vażun ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hi sabiħa! Se npoġġiha fil-vażun ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 真漂亮！我要把它插在窗边的花瓶里。
messages.en: How lovely it is! I'll put it in the vase by the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在学习卡上把 warda 画成普通玫瑰，再把 urajda 画成旁边的小玫瑰，用大小对照记住指小含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Uranium, the chemical element.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 铀，一种化学元素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku msejjaħ uranju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铀（化学元素）。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-proprjetajiet tal-uranju u jippreżenta r-riżultati tal-analiżi tal-kampjun.
formal.en: The report describes the properties of uranium and presents the results of the sample analysis.
formal.zh: 报告介绍铀的性质，并呈现样品分析的结果。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Xi jfisser uranju bl-Ingliż? Emma: Uranium. Huwa isem ta' element kimiku. Luca: Tajjeb, se niktbu fin-noti tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Luca: What does uranju mean in English? Emma: Uranium. It is the name of a chemical element. Luca: Good, I'll write it in my notes.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：uranju 用英语怎么说？埃玛：Uranium，是一种化学元素的名称。卢卡：好，我把它记到笔记里。

messages.speaker: Luca (同学)
messages.zh: uranju 用英语怎么说？
messages.en: What does uranju mean in English?

messages.speaker: Emma (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Uranium. Huwa isem ta' element kimiku.
messages.mt_standard: Uranium. Huwa isem ta' element kimiku.
messages.zh: Uranium，是一种化学元素的名称。
messages.en: Uranium. It is the name of a chemical element.

messages.speaker: Luca (同学)
messages.zh: 好，我把它记到笔记里。
messages.en: Good, I'll write it in my notes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 uranju、uranium 和“铀”写在同一张元素学习卡上，通过马耳他语与英语拼写的相似处帮助回忆中文名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The planning of towns and cities, including the arrangement of buildings, roads, and public spaces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对城镇中的建筑、道路和公共空间等进行布局与安排的规划活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ippjanar tal-ibliet u l-irħula, inkluż it-tqassim tal-bini, it-toroq u l-ispazji pubbliċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 城市规划；对城镇空间及其设施布局进行规划。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport dwar l-urbanistika jipproponi aktar spazji ħodor bejn il-binjiet.
formal.en: The report on urban planning proposes more green spaces between the buildings.
formal.zh: 这份城市规划报告建议在建筑之间增加绿地。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qed tistudja din is-sena? Ben: Qed nistudja l-urbanistika, speċjalment kif jiġu ppjanati t-toroq u l-pjazez.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you studying this year? Ben: I'm studying urban planning, especially how streets and squares are planned.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你今年在学什么？Ben：我在学城市规划，尤其是街道和广场如何规划。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你今年在学什么？
messages.en: What are you studying this year?

messages.speaker: Ben (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nistudja l-urbanistika, speċjalment kif jiġu ppjanati t-toroq u l-pjazez.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nistudja l-urbanistika, speċjalment kif jiġu ppjanati t-toroq u l-pjazez.
messages.zh: 我在学城市规划，尤其是街道和广场如何规划。
messages.en: I'm studying urban planning, especially how streets and squares are planned.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象在城市地图上安排道路、住宅和公园，把 urbanistika 与“城市规划图”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop an area so that it becomes more like a town or city.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过开发建设，使某个地区逐渐具有城镇或城市的形态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiżviluppa żona sabiex tieħu aktar il-karatteristiċi ta' belt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使城市化；使某个地区发展成为具有城镇特征的区域。

collocations.zh: 使一个农村地区城市化了

collocations.en: urbanized the area around the port
collocations.zh: 使港口周边地区城市化了

formal.mt: Il-proġett urbanizza ż-żona billi żied toroq, djar u servizzi pubbliċi.
formal.en: The project urbanized the area by adding roads, homes, and public services.
formal.zh: 该项目通过增建道路、住宅和公共服务设施，使这个地区实现了城市化。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din iż-żona dejjem kienet mimlija bini? Pawlu: Le, il-proġett il-ġdid urbanizza ż-żona; qabel kien hemm ħafna għelieqi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Was this area always full of buildings? Pawlu: No, the new project urbanized the area; there used to be many fields.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个地方以前就到处都是建筑吗？Pawlu：不是，新项目使这里城市化了；以前有很多田地。

messages.speaker: Nina (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Din iż-żona dejjem kienet mimlija bini?
messages.mt_standard: Din iż-żona dejjem kienet mimlija bini?
messages.zh: 这个地方以前就到处都是建筑吗？
messages.en: Was this area always full of buildings?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-proġett il-ġdid urbanizza ż-żona; qabel kien hemm ħafna għelieqi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-proġett il-ġdid urbanizza ż-żona; qabel kien hemm ħafna għelieqi.
messages.zh: 不是，新项目使这里城市化了；以前有很多田地。
messages.en: No, the new project urbanized the area; there used to be many fields.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用田地逐渐变成道路和楼房的连续画面记 urbanizza，抓住“使一个地方城市化”的动作含义。

gloss_zh: 都市主义；城市生活与组织的研究

teaching_sense.en_definition: The study and ideas concerning city life and how cities are organized and develop.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 关于城市生活、城市组织形式及城市发展的研究与思想。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istudju u l-ideat dwar il-ħajja fl-ibliet u kif l-ibliet huma organizzati u jiżviluppaw.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 都市主义；有关城市生活方式、空间组织和发展的思想与研究。

formal.mt: Il-kors dwar l-urbaniżmu jeżamina r-relazzjoni bejn l-ispazji pubbliċi u l-ħajja ta' kuljum fl-ibliet.
formal.en: The course on urbanism examines the relationship between public spaces and everyday life in cities.
formal.zh: 这门都市主义课程探讨公共空间与城市日常生活之间的关系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dwar xiex inhu dan il-ktieb? Toni: Dwar l-urbaniżmu u kif il-belt tinfluwenza l-mod kif ngħixu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this book about? Toni: It's about urbanism and how the city influences the way we live.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这本书讲什么？Toni：讲都市主义，以及城市如何影响我们的生活方式。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这本书讲什么？
messages.en: What is this book about?

messages.speaker: Toni (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar l-urbaniżmu u kif il-belt tinfluwenza l-mod kif ngħixu.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar l-urbaniżmu u kif il-belt tinfluwenza l-mod kif ngħixu.
messages.zh: 讲都市主义，以及城市如何影响我们的生活方式。
messages.en: It's about urbanism and how the city influences the way we live.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 urbaniżmu 放进“城市怎样塑造生活”这个问题中记忆，联想广场、街区和居民之间的关系。

gloss_zh: 小大腿；小腿肚以上的大腿部分

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small thigh; the diminutive form of 'wirk', referring to the upper part of the leg.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小大腿，指髋部与膝盖之间较小的大腿部分；是 wirk 的小称形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Koxxa żgħira, bejn il-ġenbejn u l-irkoppa; id-diminuttiv ta' 'wirk'.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small thigh (the diminutive form of 'wirk')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小大腿；wirk 的小称形式，指较小的大腿。

formal.en: In the illustration, an arrow points to the baby's little thigh.
formal.zh: 插图中的一个箭头指向婴儿的小大腿。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara l-urejjek ta' din il-pupa. Rita: Iva, huwa żgħir ħafna, u l-libsa tgħattih.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at this doll's little thigh. Rita: Yes, it's very small, and the dress covers it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看这个玩偶的小大腿。Rita：是呀，很小，裙子把它遮住了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看这个玩偶的小大腿。
messages.en: Look at this doll's little thigh.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa żgħir ħafna, u l-libsa tgħattih.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa żgħir ħafna, u l-libsa tgħattih.
messages.zh: 是呀，很小，裙子把它遮住了。
messages.en: Yes, it's very small, and the dress covers it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 wirk 与 urejjek 配成“大腿—小大腿”记忆卡，指一指髋部和膝盖之间的位置，避免误记成小腿。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having eyes that appear slightly misaligned when looking at something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容眼睛在注视时显得略微不对齐、有点斜视的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għajnejh jidhru xi ftit mhux allinjati meta jħares.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有点斜视的；双眼视线略微不对齐的。

formal.mt: L-illustratur pinġa karattru urejjeċ fl-ewwel paġna tal-ktieb.
formal.en: The illustrator drew a somewhat squint-eyed character on the first page of the book.
formal.zh: 插画师在书的第一页画了一个有点斜视的角色。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema karattru qed tiddeskrivi? Mark: Dak urejjeċ bil-kappell aħmar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which character are you describing? Mark: The somewhat squint-eyed one with the red hat.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你在描述哪个角色？Mark：戴红帽子、有点斜视的那个。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你在描述哪个角色？
messages.en: Which character are you describing?

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 戴红帽子、有点斜视的那个。
messages.en: The somewhat squint-eyed one with the red hat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在人物插画旁写上 urejjeċ，记住它描述“眼位略有偏斜”，并把“有点”的程度一起记牢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small leaf, expressed using a diminutive form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小小的一片叶子，用叶子的指小形式表达。

formal.en: The student placed a small dry leaf between two pages to keep it flat.
formal.zh: 这名学生把一片干枯的小叶子夹在两页纸之间，让它保持平整。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Ara, ħarġet urejqa ġdida fuq il-pjanta! Ninu: Iva, għadha żgħira ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lina: Look, a new little leaf has appeared on the plant! Ninu: Yes, it's still very small.
colloquial.zh: Lina：看，植物上长出了一片新的小叶子！Ninu：是呀，还很小呢。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara, ħarġet urejqa ġdida fuq il-pjanta!
messages.mt_standard: Ara, ħarġet urejqa ġdida fuq il-pjanta!

messages.zh: 是呀，还很小呢。
messages.en: Yes, it's still very small.

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Werżieq żgħir; id-diminuttiv ta' 'werżieq'.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small cricket (the diminutive form of 'werżieq')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小蟋蟀；werżieq 的小称形式。

a small cricket hidden under a leaf

formal.en: During their observation in the garden, the students spotted a small cricket beside a stone.
formal.zh: 学生们在花园里观察时，发现一块石头旁边有一只小蟋蟀。

messages.mt_standard: Hemm urejżaq; ara kemm hu żgħir!

teaching_sense.en_definition: The tube through which urine passes from the bladder to the outside of the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将尿液从膀胱输送到体外的管道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kanal li minnu tgħaddi l-awrina mill-bużżieqa tal-awrina għal barra mill-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尿道；将尿液从膀胱排向体外的管道。

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi l-uretra bħala l-kanal li jwassal l-awrina mill-bużżieqa tal-awrina għal barra mill-ġisem.

colloquial.en: Sara: Where is the urethra in this picture? Ben: Here, this tube leading out of the bladder.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这张图里的尿道在哪里？Ben：这里，就是这条从膀胱通出来的管道。

messages.mt_standard: Hawn, dan il-kanal li joħroġ mill-bużżieqa tal-awrina.
messages.zh: 这里，就是这条从膀胱通出来的管道。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone emotional pain through words or actions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过言语或行为使别人感到伤心，伤害其感情。

formal.mt: Il-kumment urta s-sentimenti tal-istudenta, u għalhekk l-għalliem talab skuża.

formal.zh: 那句评论伤害了这名女学生的感情，因此老师道了歉。

messages.en: What you said hurt my feelings.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 对不起，我不是有意让你伤心的。
messages.en: I'm sorry; I didn't mean to hurt you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 urta 放进“一句话伤了心”的场景记忆，重点联想感情受伤。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Uruguay, a country in South America officially called the Oriental Republic of Uruguay.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乌拉圭，南美洲国家；正式名称为乌拉圭东岸共和国。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or relating to Uruguay or its people.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乌拉圭的；来自乌拉圭的；与乌拉圭有关的。
