messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm usejgħa quddiem id-dar; nistennew hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm usejgħa quddiem id-dar; nistennew hemm.
messages.zh: 房子前有一小片空地，我们去那里等吧。
messages.en: There's a small open space in front of the house; let's wait there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 wesgħa 想成一片空地，再把画面缩小成门前一小块，帮助记住指小形式 usejgħa。

gloss_zh: 容纳能力；可用空间；容纳

teaching_sense.en_definition: The capacity or available space to hold something, or the containment of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容纳某物的能力或可用空间，也可指容纳本身。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħila jew l-ispazju biex xi ħaġa żżomm fiha xi ħaġa oħra, jew iż-żamma tagħha ġewwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容纳能力，即能够装入或容下事物的能力。
供某物放置或容身的空间。
容纳；将某物容于内部。

formal.mt: Qabel jintgħażel il-kontenitur, għandu jiġi ċċekkjat jekk għandux usigħ biżżejjed għall-materjal kollu.
formal.en: Before the container is selected, it should be checked to ensure that it has enough capacity for all the material.
formal.zh: 选择容器之前，应检查它是否有足够的容量装下全部材料。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din il-kaxxa għandha usigħ biżżejjed għall-kotba kollha? Sam: Iva, u jibqa' ftit spazju wkoll.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does this box have enough room for all the books? Sam: Yes, and there will even be a little space left.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个箱子放得下所有的书吗？Sam：放得下，而且还会剩一点空间。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-kaxxa għandha usigħ biżżejjed għall-kotba kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-kaxxa għandha usigħ biżżejjed għall-kotba kollha?
messages.zh: 这个箱子放得下所有的书吗？
messages.en: Does this box have enough room for all the books?

messages.speaker: Sam (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u jibqa' ftit spazju wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u jibqa' ftit spazju wkoll.
messages.zh: 放得下，而且还会剩一点空间。
messages.en: Yes, and there will even be a little space left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象往箱子里装书：能装多少是容纳能力，书放哪里是空间，装在里面是容纳。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or event of reaching a place or destination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 到达某个地方或目的地这一行为或事件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-wasla ta' xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa f'post jew fid-destinazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 到达；抵达目的地这一事件。

formal.mt: Il-programm jindika l-ħin tal-usil tal-mistednin u l-bidu taċ-ċerimonja.
formal.en: The programme indicates the guests' arrival time and the start of the ceremony.
formal.zh: 活动安排注明了宾客的到达时间以及仪式的开始时间。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'ħin hu mistenni l-usil tal-mistednin? Luqa: Għall-ħamsa; sa dakinhar inkunu lesti.
colloquial.en: Anna: What time are the guests expected to arrive? Luqa: At five; we'll be ready by then.
colloquial.zh: Anna：预计宾客几点到？Luqa：五点，我们到时候会准备好的。

messages.speaker: Anna (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 预计宾客几点到？
messages.en: What time are the guests expected to arrive?

messages.speaker: Luqa (活动助手)
messages.zh: 五点，我们到时候会准备好的。
messages.en: At five; we'll be ready by then.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 usil 写在行程表的“到达”一栏，配上宾客跨进门的画面，记住它是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Stronger or more vigorous than another person or thing, or than before.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 比另一人或事物更强壮、更有力，或比以前更有活力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu aktar saħħa jew ħeġġa minn ħaddieħor, minn xi ħaġa oħra jew minn qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 更强壮的；力量更大的；更坚固的。
更有活力的；精力更充沛的。

collocations.en: stronger or more vigorous than before
collocations.zh: 比以前更强壮或更有活力

formal.mt: Wara perjodu ta' taħriġ regolari, l-atleta sar utaq u seta' jġorr piż akbar.
formal.en: After a period of regular training, the athlete became stronger and could carry a heavier load.
formal.zh: 经过一段时间的规律训练，这名运动员变得更强壮，能够负担更大的重量。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dan il-ħabel tajjeb biex norbtu l-kaxxa? Ġanni: Aħjar nużaw wieħed utaq; il-kaxxa tqila ħafna.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is this rope suitable for tying up the box? Ġanni: We'd better use a stronger one; the box is very heavy.
colloquial.zh: Rita：这根绳子适合捆箱子吗？Ġanni：最好用更结实的一根，箱子很重。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ħabel tajjeb biex norbtu l-kaxxa?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ħabel tajjeb biex norbtu l-kaxxa?
messages.zh: 这根绳子适合捆箱子吗？
messages.en: Is this rope suitable for tying up the box?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar nużaw wieħed utaq; il-kaxxa tqila ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar nużaw wieħed utaq; il-kaxxa tqila ħafna.
messages.zh: 最好用更结实的一根，箱子很重。
messages.en: We'd better use a stronger one; the box is very heavy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两根绳子作比较，把 utaq 标在更结实的一根旁边，牢牢记住其中的“更”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rather strong; having a noticeable degree of strength.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 颇为强壮或相当有力，具有比较明显的力量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu saħħa mhux ħażin; pjuttost b'saħħtu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 颇强壮的；相当有力的。

collocations.zh: 一名相当有力气的工人

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem kien utejjaq u seta' jerfa' l-kaxxa mingħajr għajnuna.
formal.en: The worker was rather strong and could lift the box without help.
formal.zh: 这名工人颇有力气，无须别人帮助就能抬起箱子。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Taħseb li David jista' jgħinna nċaqalqu l-mejda? Karl: Iva, hu utejjaq; jista' jerfa' tarf wieħed magħna.
colloquial.en: Marta: Do you think David can help us move the table? Karl: Yes, he's rather strong; he can help us lift one end.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你觉得 David 能帮我们搬桌子吗？Karl：能，他挺有力气，可以帮我们抬起一头。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li David jista' jgħinna nċaqalqu l-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li David jista' jgħinna nċaqalqu l-mejda?
messages.zh: 你觉得 David 能帮我们搬桌子吗？
messages.en: Do you think David can help us move the table?

messages.speaker: Karl (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu utejjaq; jista' jerfa' tarf wieħed magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu utejjaq; jista' jerfa' tarf wieħed magħna.
messages.zh: 能，他挺有力气，可以帮我们抬起一头。
messages.en: Yes, he's rather strong; he can help us lift one end.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“他挺有力气”记 utejjaq：评价一个人颇强壮；另用 utaq 记比较时的“更强壮”。

gloss_zh: 变强；变得有活力；强健的；精力充沛的

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become stronger or more vigorous.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 力量增强，或身体变得更强健、更有活力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aktar b'saħħtu jew mimli ħajja u enerġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得强壮；力量增强。
变得有活力；精神或体力变得旺盛。
强壮的；强健的。
精力充沛的；有活力的。

formal.mt: Wara perjodu ta' taħriġ regolari, l-atleta utieq u seta' jkompli jeżerċita għal aktar ħin.
formal.en: After a period of regular training, the athlete grew stronger and could continue exercising for longer.
formal.zh: 经过一段时间的规律训练，这名运动员变得更强健，能够持续锻炼更长时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejjer ħuk bit-taħriġ? Mark: Tajjeb ħafna! Utieq u issa jiġri aktar minn qabel.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is your brother getting on with training? Mark: Very well! He has grown stronger and now runs more than before.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你弟弟训练得怎么样？马克：很好！他变强壮了，现在比以前跑得更多。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你弟弟训练得怎么样？
messages.en: How is your brother getting on with training?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb ħafna! Utieq u issa jiġri aktar minn qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb ħafna! Utieq u issa jiġri aktar minn qabel.
messages.zh: 很好！他变强壮了，现在比以前跑得更多。
messages.en: Very well! He has grown stronger and now runs more than before.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象训练前后对比：动词记“变强了”，形容词记“强健的”，用词性区分变化和状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making or becoming stronger or more vigorous.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使力量增强、身体更强健或活力增加的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa jsir aktar b'saħħtu jew jikseb aktar enerġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 增强；强化；变得更强健的过程。
活力的增强或恢复；振奋。

collocations.en: the strengthening or invigoration of the body
collocations.zh: 身体的强健或活力增强

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi eżerċizzji għall-utiq tal-muskoli, b'żieda gradwali fid-diffikultà.
formal.en: The programme includes exercises for strengthening the muscles, with a gradual increase in difficulty.
formal.zh: 该计划包括增强肌肉力量的练习，难度逐步提高。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex tagħmel dawn l-eżerċizzji? Pawlu: Għall-utiq tal-muskoli ta' saqajja; irrid insir aktar b'saħħti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do you do these exercises? Pawlu: To strengthen my leg muscles; I want to become stronger.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么做这些练习？保罗：为了增强腿部肌肉力量；我想变得更强壮。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么做这些练习？
messages.en: Why do you do these exercises?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għall-utiq tal-muskoli ta' saqajja; irrid insir aktar b'saħħti.
messages.mt_standard: Għall-utiq tal-muskoli ta' saqajja; irrid insir aktar b'saħħti.
messages.zh: 为了增强腿部肌肉力量；我想变得更强壮。
messages.en: To strengthen my leg muscles; I want to become stronger.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 utiq 放进“肌肉增强计划”这个画面，记住它是表示增强过程的名词，不是“强壮的”这个形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Strengthening or invigoration: the process of gaining or restoring strength and energy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 增强力量或增进活力的过程，也可指恢复体力和精神。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih tiżdied jew terġa' tinkiseb is-saħħa jew l-enerġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 增强；强化；力量的增加。
增进或恢复活力；使精神或体力振奋。

collocations.en: the strengthening or invigoration of the body
collocations.zh: 身体的强健或活力恢复

formal.mt: Il-pjan jagħti importanza lill-utiqa tal-ġisem permezz ta' eżerċizzju regolari u mistrieħ biżżejjed.
formal.en: The plan places importance on strengthening and invigorating the body through regular exercise and sufficient rest.
formal.zh: 该计划重视通过规律运动和充分休息来增强体质、增进活力。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu l-għan ta' dan il-programm? Sara: L-utiqa tal-ġisem. Nagħmlu ftit eżerċizzju kuljum u nistrieħu biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is the aim of this programme? Sara: Strengthening the body. We do a little exercise every day and get enough rest.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个计划的目标是什么？萨拉：增强体质。我们每天做一点运动，也保证充分休息。

messages.speaker: Nina (学员)
messages.zh: 这个计划的目标是什么？
messages.en: What is the aim of this programme?

messages.speaker: Sara (教练)
messages.mt_spoken: L-utiqa tal-ġisem. Nagħmlu ftit eżerċizzju kuljum u nistrieħu biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: L-utiqa tal-ġisem. Nagħmlu ftit eżerċizzju kuljum u nistrieħu biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 增强体质。我们每天做一点运动，也保证充分休息。
messages.en: Strengthening the body. We do a little exercise every day and get enough rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 utiqa 写在“增强体质、恢复活力”的训练卡上，与 utiq 并列记忆；本词条给出的两个意思都是名词。

gloss_zh: 哎呀；啧；唉（表示不耐烦或恼火）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An exclamation expressing impatience or annoyance; a longer utterance expresses greater impatience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达不耐烦或恼火的感叹声；声音拖得越长，不耐烦的程度越强。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Esclamazzjoni li tesprimi nuqqas ta' sabar jew dwejjaq; aktar ma tittawwal, aktar turi nuqqas ta' sabar.

sense_translations.en_definition: Used to express impatience (the lengthier the more impatient).
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于表示不耐烦；发音拖得越长，表示越不耐烦。
用于表达恼火、烦躁或不快。

formal.mt: Fid-djalogu miktub, il-karattru jgħid: 'Uu, kemm se ndumu nistennew?' biex jesprimi n-nuqqas ta' sabar tiegħu.
formal.en: In the written dialogue, the character says, 'Ugh, how long are we going to wait?' to express his impatience.
formal.zh: 在书面对话中，人物说“哎呀，我们还要等多久？”，以表达自己的不耐烦。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Uu, kemm iddum! Il-karozza tal-linja waslet. Ben: Sekonda biss, qed nilbes iż-żarbun!
colloquial.en: Maja: Ugh, you're taking so long! The bus is here. Ben: Just a second, I'm putting my shoes on!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：哎呀，你也太慢了！公交车都到了。本：等一下，我正在穿鞋！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Uu, kemm iddum! Il-karozza tal-linja waslet.
messages.mt_standard: Uu, kemm iddum! Il-karozza tal-linja waslet.
messages.zh: 哎呀，你也太慢了！公交车都到了。
messages.en: Ugh, you're taking so long! The bus is here.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 等一下，我正在穿鞋！
messages.en: Just a second, I'm putting my shoes on!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象等人时拖长一声“呜——”：声音越长，耐心越少。借这个声音画面记住不耐烦和恼火。

gloss_zh: 来吧；快点；得了吧；不可能吧

teaching_sense.en_definition: An exclamation used to urge someone on, ask them to hurry, or express disbelief or rejection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于催促、鼓动别人行动，或表示不相信、不接受；具体可译为“来吧”“快点”或“得了吧”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Esclamazzjoni biex tħeġġeġ lil xi ħadd, tgħidlu jgħaġġel, jew turi li ma temminx jew ma taċċettax xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 来吧；快点；得了吧或不可能吧，依语境表示催促、鼓动或不相信。

collocations.en: no way, I don't believe it!

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifla tħeġġeġ lil ħuha bil-kliem: 'Uwejja, għaġġel, għax se nitilfu l-ferrovija!'
formal.en: In the story, the girl urges her brother on with the words, 'Come on, hurry up, or we'll miss the train!'
formal.zh: 故事中，女孩催促弟弟说：“快点，抓紧，不然我们就赶不上火车了！”

colloquial.mt: Mark: Uwejja, għaġġel! Il-film se jibda. Lara: Ġejja, ġejja! Qed nieħu l-borża.
colloquial.en: Mark: Come on, hurry up! The film is about to start. Lara: I'm coming, I'm coming! I'm getting my bag.
colloquial.zh: 马克：快点，抓紧！电影就要开始了。拉拉：来了，来了！我在拿包。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 快点，抓紧！电影就要开始了。
messages.en: Come on, hurry up! The film is about to start.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 来了，来了！我在拿包。
messages.en: I'm coming, I'm coming! I'm getting my bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两种表情记 uwejja：招手催人时是“快来、快点”，听到难以相信的话时是“得了吧、不可能吧”。

gloss_zh: 不过；尽管如此；话虽如此

teaching_sense.en_definition: An exclamation acknowledging what has been said while introducing a response meaning 'still' or 'all the same'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 承接前面的话，同时引出“不过”“尽管如此”这一类回应的感叹语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Esclamazzjoni li tintuża biex, minkejja dak li jkun intqal, tintroduċi ħsieb jew tweġiba oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不过；尽管如此；话虽如此，用于承认前述情况后作出转折回应。

collocations.en: all the same, not everything is lost
collocations.zh: 尽管如此，还没有全盘落空

formal.mt: Fid-djalogu tar-rakkont, il-karattru jwieġeb: 'Uwijja, għad għandna ċans,' minkejja d-diffikultajiet li ssemmew.
formal.en: In the story's dialogue, the character replies, 'Still, we have a chance,' despite the difficulties that have been mentioned.
formal.zh: 在故事的对话中，尽管前面提到了种种困难，人物仍回答：“不过，我们还有机会。”

colloquial.mt: Nina: Illum ma lħaqniex inlestu kollox. Pawlu: Uwijja, nistgħu nkomplu għada.
colloquial.en: Nina: We didn't manage to finish everything today. Pawlu: Still, we can carry on tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们今天没能把所有事情做完。保罗：不过，我们可以明天继续。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 我们今天没能把所有事情做完。
messages.en: We didn't manage to finish everything today.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 不过，我们可以明天继续。
messages.en: Still, we can carry on tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 uwijja 记成对话中的转弯：“情况是这样，不过还可以……”。与表示催促的 uwejja 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small face; the diminutive form of wiċċ.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小脸、小脸蛋，是 wiċċ（脸）的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wiċċ żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' wiċċ.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small face (the diminutive form of 'wiċċ')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小脸、小脸蛋；wiċċ（脸）的指小形式。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt jidher uċejjaħ it-tarbija, imdawwal mid-dawl tat-tieqa.
formal.en: The photograph shows the baby's little face, illuminated by the light from the window.
formal.zh: 照片中可以看到婴儿的小脸蛋，窗外透进来的光照在脸上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara x'uċejjaħ ħelu għandu! Nina: Iva, speċjalment meta jitbissem.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look what a sweet little face he has! Nina: Yes, especially when he smiles.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看他的小脸蛋多可爱！妮娜：是啊，尤其是他笑的时候。

messages.speaker: Lara (探访的朋友)
messages.zh: 看他的小脸蛋多可爱！
messages.en: Look what a sweet little face he has!

messages.speaker: Nina (婴儿的母亲)
messages.zh: 是啊，尤其是他笑的时候。
messages.en: Yes, especially when he smiles.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 wiċċ 记作普通的“脸”，再用婴儿照片把 uċejjaħ 对应到“小脸蛋”，成对记住普通形式与指小形式。

gloss_zh: 脸、面孔的复数形式；wċuħ 的另一基本形式及辅音后形式

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plural noun form meaning faces, used after a consonant and also as an alternative basic form of wċuħ.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示多个脸或面孔的名词形式，既用于辅音之后，也是 wċuħ 的另一基本形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma fil-plural li tfisser aktar minn wiċċ wieħed; tintuża wara konsonanti u wkoll bħala forma bażika alternattiva ta' wċuħ.

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of wċuħ
sense_translations.zh_definition: wċuħ 的辅音后形式，同时也是其另一基本形式，表示多个脸或面孔。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt tal-klassi, l-uċuħ tat-tfal jidhru ċari.
formal.en: In the class photograph, the children's faces are clearly visible.
formal.zh: 在班级合影中，孩子们的面孔清晰可见。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Illum rajt ħafna uċuħ ġodda fil-klassi. Mark: Jien ukoll, imma kien hemm ukoll xi uċuħ familjari.
colloquial.en: Sara: I saw lots of new faces in class today. Mark: Me too, but there were also some familiar faces.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：今天我在班里看到了很多新面孔。马克：我也是，不过也有一些熟悉的面孔。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum rajt ħafna uċuħ ġodda fil-klassi.
messages.mt_standard: Illum rajt ħafna uċuħ ġodda fil-klassi.
messages.zh: 今天我在班里看到了很多新面孔。
messages.en: I saw lots of new faces in class today.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien ukoll, imma kien hemm ukoll xi uċuħ familjari.
messages.mt_standard: Jien ukoll, imma kien hemm ukoll xi uċuħ familjari.
messages.zh: 我也是，不过也有一些熟悉的面孔。
messages.en: Me too, but there were also some familiar faces.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张班级合影记住 uċuħ 表示多个面孔；把 uċuħ 与 wċuħ 并排记作同一个复数词的不同形式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The crop gathered from cultivated land, or the harvesting of that crop.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从耕地收获的农作物或收成，也指收获这些作物的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prodott li jinġabar mill-għelieqi, jew il-ġbir ta' dan il-prodott.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收获的农作物；收成。
收获；庄稼的收割或采收。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport agrikolu jiddeskrivi l-uħid ta' din is-sena bħala wieħed abbundanti.
formal.en: The agricultural report describes this year's crop as abundant.
formal.zh: 农业报告将今年的收成描述为丰盛。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kif kien l-uħid din is-sena? Ġużeppi: Tajjeb ħafna; ġbarna aktar mis-sena l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Rita: How was the harvest this year? Ġużeppi: Very good; we gathered more than last year.
colloquial.zh: Rita：今年收成怎么样？Ġużeppi：很好，收得比去年多。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.zh: 今年收成怎么样？
messages.en: How was the harvest this year?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb ħafna; ġbarna aktar mis-sena l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb ħafna; ġbarna aktar mis-sena l-oħra.
messages.zh: 很好，收得比去年多。
messages.en: Very good; we gathered more than last year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 uħid 放进丰收画面：既看见装满的作物篮，也看见田里正在进行的收获。

gloss_zh: 固定住的过程；卡住的过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of something becoming fixed or lodged in place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物逐渐固定在一个位置或卡住的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih xi ħaġa titwaħħal jew tinqabad f'postha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 固定住、嵌住或卡住的过程。

collocations.en: the wheel becoming stuck in the mud
collocations.zh: 车轮陷入泥中卡住的过程

collocations.en: the process of becoming fixed in place

formal.mt: L-uħil tar-rota fit-tajn seħħ gradwalment hekk kif il-vettura kompliet timxi.
formal.en: The wheel gradually became stuck in the mud as the vehicle continued moving.
formal.zh: 随着车辆继续前进，车轮逐渐陷入泥中并卡住。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Meta beda l-uħil tar-rota fit-tajn? Lara: Malli dħalna f'dik il-ħofra; imbagħad ir-rota ma setgħetx iddur.
colloquial.en: Mark: When did the wheel start getting stuck in the mud? Lara: As soon as we entered that hole; then the wheel couldn't turn.
colloquial.zh: Mark：车轮什么时候开始陷进泥里卡住的？Lara：一进那个坑就开始了，后来轮子就转不动了。

messages.speaker: Mark (司机)
messages.zh: 车轮什么时候开始陷进泥里卡住的？
messages.en: When did the wheel start getting stuck in the mud?

messages.speaker: Lara (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Malli dħalna f'dik il-ħofra; imbagħad ir-rota ma setgħetx iddur.
messages.mt_standard: Malli dħalna f'dik il-ħofra; imbagħad ir-rota ma setgħetx iddur.
messages.zh: 一进那个坑就开始了，后来轮子就转不动了。
messages.en: As soon as we entered that hole; then the wheel couldn't turn.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象车轮一点点陷入泥地，最后固定不动；用连续画面记住 uħil 表示卡住的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The horrific or frightening quality of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某种事物所具有的恐怖、骇人或令人害怕的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa li tqanqal biża' qawwija jew waħx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恐怖、骇人的性质；使人感到惊骇的可怖之处。
令人害怕的性质；使人产生恐惧的可怕之处。

collocations.en: the horrific quality of the scene

formal.mt: L-awtur iwassal l-uħix tax-xena permezz ta' deskrizzjoni qasira u preċiża.
formal.en: The author conveys the horrific quality of the scene through a brief, precise description.
formal.zh: 作者通过简短而准确的描写，传达出场景的骇人之处。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex waqqaft il-film? David: L-uħix ta' dik ix-xena kien wisq għalija.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you stop the film? David: The horror of that scene was too much for me.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你为什么把电影停了？David：那个场景太恐怖了，我受不了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把电影停了？
messages.en: Why did you stop the film?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-uħix ta' dik ix-xena kien wisq għalija.
messages.mt_standard: L-uħix ta' dik ix-xena kien wisq għalija.
messages.zh: 那个场景太恐怖了，我受不了。
messages.en: The horror of that scene was too much for me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 uħix 与恐怖片中让人捂住眼睛的场景相连，记住它指向场景的恐怖性质。

gloss_zh: 乌兹别克斯坦的；乌兹别克人（通常指男性）；乌兹别克语

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or relating to Uzbekistan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于、来自或涉及乌兹别克斯坦的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Użbekistan jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Użbekistan.

sense_translations.en_definition: Uzbek (of, from or relating to Uzbekistan)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 乌兹别克斯坦的；来自或与乌兹别克斯坦有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Uzbek (native or inhabitant of Uzbekistan) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 乌兹别克斯坦本地人或居民，通常指男性。
乌兹别克语。

collocations.en: an Uzbek man who lives in Malta
collocations.zh: 住在马耳他的乌兹别克斯坦男子

formal.mt: Il-kittieb Użbek ippreżenta l-ktieb tiegħu bl-Użbek, u interpretu qaleb id-diskors għall-Malti.
formal.en: The Uzbek writer presented his book in Uzbek, and an interpreter translated the speech into Maltese.
formal.zh: 这位乌兹别克斯坦作家用乌兹别克语介绍了自己的书，一名口译员将讲话译成马耳他语。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak ir-raġel Użbek? Mark: Iva, u jitkellem bl-Użbek ma' ibnu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that man Uzbek? Mark: Yes, and he speaks Uzbek with his son.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个男人是乌兹别克斯坦人吗？马克：是的，他和儿子说乌兹别克语。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个男人是乌兹别克斯坦人吗？
messages.en: Is that man Uzbek?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u jitkellem bl-Użbek ma' ibnu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u jitkellem bl-Użbek ma' ibnu.
messages.zh: 是的，他和儿子说乌兹别克语。
messages.en: Yes, and he speaks Uzbek with his son.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“作家、居民、语言”三格卡记 Użbek：修饰作家时是形容词，指人和语言时是名词，结合上下文判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Uzbekistan, a country in Central Asia whose official name is the Republic of Uzbekistan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 乌兹别克斯坦，位于中亚的国家，正式名称为乌兹别克斯坦共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Asja Ċentrali li l-isem uffiċjali tiegħu huwa r-Repubblika tal-Użbekistan.

sense_translations.en_definition: Uzbekistan (a country in Central Asia; official name: Repubblika tal-Użbekistan)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 乌兹别克斯坦，中亚国家；正式名称为乌兹别克斯坦共和国，马耳他语为 Repubblika tal-Użbekistan。

collocations.zh: 前往乌兹别克斯坦的旅行

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-Użbekistan bħala pajjiż fl-Asja Ċentrali u juża l-isem uffiċjali tiegħu, ir-Repubblika tal-Użbekistan.
formal.en: The report describes Uzbekistan as a country in Central Asia and uses its official name, the Republic of Uzbekistan.
formal.zh: 该报告将乌兹别克斯坦介绍为中亚国家，并使用其正式名称“乌兹别克斯坦共和国”。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn sejjer għall-vaganza? Ben: Se mmur l-Użbekistan ma' ħabib. Lara: Kemm se ddumu hemm? Ben: Ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are you going on holiday? Ben: I'm going to Uzbekistan with a friend. Lara: How long will you stay there? Ben: A week.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你打算去哪里度假？本：我要和一个朋友去乌兹别克斯坦。拉拉：你们会在那里待多久？本：一周。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你打算去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要和一个朋友去乌兹别克斯坦。
messages.en: I'm going to Uzbekistan with a friend.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们会在那里待多久？
messages.en: How long will you stay there?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 一周。
messages.en: A week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在中亚地图上贴上 Użbekistan，再画一条旅行箭头并写 lejn l-Użbekistan，把国名和“前往该国”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Heavy or weighty; having considerable physical weight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 重量较大的；拿起或搬动时让人觉得沉重的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu piż kbir u jinħass tqil meta terfgħu jew iġġorru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 重的；沉重的。
有分量的；沉甸甸的。

formal.mt: Il-pakkett kien użieni, għalhekk żewġ ħaddiema ġarrewh flimkien.
formal.en: The parcel was heavy, so two workers carried it together.
formal.zh: 包裹很重，因此两名工人一起搬运。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ktieb użieni! Mark: Poġġih fil-borża; inġorru jien.
colloquial.en: Maja: This book is heavy! Mark: Put it in the bag; I'll carry it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书真重！马克：把它放进包里，我来拿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这本书真重！
messages.en: This book is heavy!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 把它放进包里，我来拿。
messages.en: Put it in the bag; I'll carry it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手托着一本沉甸甸的大书，用 użieni 描述书带来的重量感，记住它是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The weight of something, or the act of measuring how much it weighs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体的重量，或用秤测定物体重量的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-piż ta' xi ħaġa, jew l-att li tkejjel il-piż tagħha b'miżien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 重量；物体有多重。
称重；用秤测量重量的行为。

formal.mt: L-użin tal-pakketti jsir qabel ma tiġi kkalkulata l-ispiża tat-tbaħħir.
formal.en: Parcels are weighed before the shipping cost is calculated.
formal.zh: 计算运输费用之前，先对包裹进行称重。

colloquial.mt: Lara: L-użin tal-bagalja jsir hawn? Pawlu: Iva, poġġiha fuq il-miżien.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this where the suitcase is weighed? Pawlu: Yes, put it on the scales.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：行李箱是在这里称重吗？保罗：是的，把它放到秤上。

messages.speaker: Lara (旅客)
messages.zh: 行李箱是在这里称重吗？
messages.en: Is this where the suitcase is weighed?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (机场工作人员)
messages.zh: 是的，把它放到秤上。
messages.en: Yes, put it on the scales.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 użin 连到秤的画面：秤上显示的是重量，把物品放上去测量则是称重，一个名词记住两层意思。

gloss_zh: 依用益权使用并享有收益

teaching_sense.en_definition: To use property belonging to another and enjoy its benefits under a right of usufruct.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依据用益权使用他人的财产，并享有该财产带来的收益。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juża proprjetà ta' ħaddieħor u jgawdi l-frott tagħha bis-saħħa ta' dritt ta' użufrutt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以用益权人的身份使用财产并享有其收益。

collocations.en: enjoyed the use of a house in usufruct
collocations.zh: 依用益权享用一所房屋
依用益权使用农地并享有其收益

formal.mt: Skont il-ftehim, Pawlu użufruwixxa mill-art għal għaxar snin u gawda l-frott tagħha.
formal.en: Under the agreement, Pawlu enjoyed the land in usufruct for ten years and received its produce.
formal.zh: 根据协议，保罗依用益权使用该土地十年，并享有土地的出产。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu użufruwixxa minn dik id-dar? Lara: Iva, kellu dritt jgħix fiha, iżda d-dar ma kinitx tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu enjoy that house in usufruct? Lara: Yes, he had the right to live in it, but the house did not belong to him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗曾依用益权享用那所房屋吗？拉拉：是的，他有权住在那里，但房屋并不属于他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗曾依用益权享用那所房屋吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu enjoy that house in usufruct?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kellu dritt jgħix fiha, iżda d-dar ma kinitx tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kellu dritt jgħix fiha, iżda d-dar ma kinitx tiegħu.
messages.zh: 是的，他有权住在那里，但房屋并不属于他。
messages.en: Yes, he had the right to live in it, but the house did not belong to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象果园归别人所有，而你依法可以使用果园并收取果实；用这个场景记住 użufruwixxa 的用益权含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take power, a position, or a right without legitimate authority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 未经正当授权而夺取权力、职位或本属于他人的权利。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu poter, kariga jew dritt mingħajr awtorità leġittima.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 篡夺；非法夺取权力、地位或权利。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-ġeneral użurpa t-tron wara li keċċa lir-re.
formal.en: In the novel, the general usurped the throne after expelling the king.
formal.zh: 小说中，将军赶走国王后篡夺了王位。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu dak li qiegħed fuq it-tron fil-film? Mark: Hu l-ġeneral li użurpa l-poter fl-ewwel xena.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is that on the throne in the film? Mark: He's the general who usurped power in the first scene.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：电影里坐在王位上的那个人是谁？马克：他就是第一场戏里篡夺权力的将军。

messages.speaker: Lara (观影的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak li qiegħed fuq it-tron fil-film?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak li qiegħed fuq it-tron fil-film?
messages.zh: 电影里坐在王位上的那个人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that on the throne in the film?

messages.speaker: Mark (观影的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu l-ġeneral li użurpa l-poter fl-ewwel xena.
messages.mt_standard: Hu l-ġeneral li użurpa l-poter fl-ewwel xena.
messages.zh: 他就是第一场戏里篡夺权力的将军。
messages.en: He's the general who usurped power in the first scene.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 użurpa 记成一个动作镜头：将军赶走国王、夺走王位；重点是未经正当授权的夺取。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who takes power, a position, or a right without legitimate authority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 未经正当授权而夺取权力、职位或权利的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tieħu poter, kariga jew dritt mingħajr awtorità leġittima.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 篡夺者；非法夺取权力、职位或权利的人。

formal.mt: Fid-dramm, l-użurpatur ħa t-tron mingħajr ebda dritt u tilef l-appoġġ tal-poplu.
formal.en: In the play, the usurper took the throne without any right and lost the people's support.
formal.zh: 剧中，篡位者无权却夺取了王位，随后失去了民众的支持。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex isejħulu użurpatur? Pawlu: Għax ħa t-tron mingħajr ma kellu dritt għalih.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do they call him a usurper? Pawlu: Because he took the throne without having a right to it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么他们称他为篡位者？保罗：因为他没有继位的权利，却夺取了王位。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 为什么他们称他为篡位者？
messages.en: Why do they call him a usurper?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ħa t-tron mingħajr ma kellu dritt għalih.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ħa t-tron mingħajr ma kellu dritt għalih.
messages.zh: 因为他没有继位的权利，却夺取了王位。
messages.en: Because he took the throne without having a right to it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 użurpatur，就想象坐在夺来的王位上的那个人：这个词指篡夺者本人，记忆焦点放在人身上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of taking power, a position, or a right without legitimate authority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 未经正当授权而夺取权力、职位或权利的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jieħu poter, kariga jew dritt mingħajr awtorità leġittima.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 篡夺；非法夺取权力、地位或权利的行为。

formal.mt: L-esej janalizza l-użurpazzjoni tal-poter fir-rumanz u l-konsegwenzi tagħha għall-poplu.
formal.en: The essay analyzes the usurpation of power in the novel and its consequences for the people.
formal.zh: 这篇文章分析了小说中的篡权行为及其对民众造成的后果。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-kapitlu jitkellem dwar elezzjoni? Lara: Le, dwar l-użurpazzjoni tal-poter; il-ġeneral ħa l-kontroll bil-forza.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is the chapter about an election? Lara: No, it's about the usurpation of power; the general took control by force.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这一章讲的是选举吗？拉拉：不是，讲的是篡权；将军以武力夺取了控制权。

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 这一章讲的是选举吗？
messages.en: Is the chapter about an election?

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dwar l-użurpazzjoni tal-poter; il-ġeneral ħa l-kontroll bil-forza.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dwar l-użurpazzjoni tal-poter; il-ġeneral ħa l-kontroll bil-forza.
messages.zh: 不是，讲的是篡权；将军以武力夺取了控制权。
messages.en: No, it's about the usurpation of power; the general took control by force.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张写着“篡权事件”的新闻标题卡片记住 użurpazzjoni，把整场非法夺权行为作为这个名词的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unoccupied or unfilled, especially when describing a position available for someone to take.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尚未有人占用或担任的，尤指等待人员填补的职位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhuwiex okkupat jew mimli, speċjalment post tax-xogħol li għadu mingħajr persuna fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 空缺的；无人占用或尚无人担任的。

formal.mt: L-iskola ħabbret post vaganti għal għalliem tal-Malti u stiednet lill-interessati japplikaw.
formal.en: The school announced a vacant position for a teacher of Maltese and invited interested candidates to apply.
formal.zh: 学校公布了一个马耳他语教师空缺职位，并邀请有意者申请。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad hemm post vaganti fil-ħanut? Mark: Iva, qed ifittxu lil xi ħadd biex jaħdem is-Sibt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there still a vacant position at the shop? Mark: Yes, they're looking for someone to work on Saturdays.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：店里还有空缺职位吗？马克：有，他们正在找一个星期六上班的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (求职者)
messages.zh: 店里还有空缺职位吗？
messages.en: Is there still a vacant position at the shop?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed ifittxu lil xi ħadd biex jaħdem is-Sibt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed ifittxu lil xi ħadd biex jaħdem is-Sibt.
messages.zh: 有，他们正在找一个星期六上班的人。
messages.en: Yes, they're looking for someone to work on Saturdays.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象招聘公告旁有一张还没人坐的办公椅，把 post vaganti 整体记成“等待有人来填补的空缺职位”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not occupied or filled; available because no person is using a place or holding a position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 无人占用或尚未填补的，可用于描述空置场所或空缺职位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhuwiex okkupat jew mimli, bħal appartament fejn ma joqgħod ħadd jew post tax-xogħol mingħajr persuna fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 空着的；空置的；职位等尚未有人填补的。

formal.mt: L-appartament baqa' vakant għal tliet xhur qabel ma nkera lil familja.
formal.en: The apartment remained vacant for three months before it was rented to a family.
formal.zh: 这套公寓空置了三个月，之后租给了一个家庭。

colloquial.mt: Lara: L-appartament ta' fuq għadu vakant? Pawlu: Iva, għadu ma mar joqgħod fih ħadd.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the upstairs apartment still vacant? Pawlu: Yes, no one has moved into it yet.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：楼上的公寓还空着吗？保罗：是的，还没有人搬进去。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 楼上的公寓还空着吗？
messages.en: Is the upstairs apartment still vacant?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadu ma mar joqgħod fih ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadu ma mar joqgħod fih ħadd.
messages.zh: 是的，还没有人搬进去。
messages.en: Yes, no one has moved into it yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一套亮着灯却没有住户的公寓，用 appartament vakant 记住“空置”；再把同一空位画面移到尚无人担任的职位上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that meets the conditions needed to be valid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以符合有效性条件的方式，常用于描述签署文件或完成手续。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li jissodisfa l-kundizzjonijiet meħtieġa biex xi ħaġa tkun valida.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有效地；以符合有效性条件的方式

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, il-ftehim ġie ffirmat validament miż-żewġ partijiet.
formal.en: According to the report, the agreement was validly signed by both parties.
formal.zh: 根据报告，该协议已由双方有效签署。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dan id-dokument ġie ffirmat validament? Pawlu: Iva, kollox sar kif suppost.
colloquial.en: Marta: Was this document validly signed? Pawlu: Yes, everything was done properly.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这份文件的签署有效吗？保罗：有效，一切都按要求办妥了。

messages.speaker: Marta (客户)
messages.zh: 这份文件的签署有效吗？
messages.en: Was this document validly signed?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (办事员)
messages.zh: 有效，一切都按要求办妥了。
messages.en: Yes, everything was done properly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“文件有效签署”的画面里，记住它修饰办事方式，回答“怎样才有效”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality or status of being valid, accepted, or in force.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物被认可为有效或仍具效力的性质或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità jew l-istat ta' xi ħaġa li hija valida, aċċettata jew fis-seħħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有效性；有效状态；效力

formal.mt: Il-validità ta' dan il-biljett tintemm fil-31 ta' Diċembru.
formal.en: The validity of this ticket ends on 31 December.
formal.zh: 这张票的有效期截至十二月三十一日。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn nista' niċċekkja l-validità tal-biljett? Mark: Ħares lejn id-data fuq wara.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where can I check the validity of the ticket? Mark: Look at the date on the back.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：在哪里能查看这张票是否有效？马克：看看背面的日期。

messages.speaker: Lara (乘客)
messages.zh: 在哪里能查看这张票是否有效？
messages.en: Where can I check the validity of the ticket?

messages.speaker: Mark (车站工作人员)
messages.zh: 看看背面的日期。
messages.en: Look at the date on the back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象检查票背面的到期日期：validità 是要检查的“有效性”，属于名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing great courage when facing danger or difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面对危险或困难时表现出极大勇气的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri kuraġġ kbir quddiem il-periklu jew id-diffikultà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 英勇的；勇敢无畏的

formal.mt: Is-suldat valoruż ġie onorat għall-kuraġġ li wera waqt il-missjoni.
formal.en: The valorous soldier was honoured for the courage he showed during the mission.
formal.zh: 这位英勇的士兵因在任务中展现的勇气而受到表彰。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajt kif għen lil dak ir-raġel fil-periklu? David: Iva, kien ġest valoruż.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you see how he helped that man in danger? David: Yes, it was a valorous act.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你看到他是怎么帮助那个身处险境的男人了吗？戴维：看到了，那是个英勇的举动。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt kif għen lil dak ir-raġel fil-periklu?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt kif għen lil dak ir-raġel fil-periklu?
messages.zh: 你看到他是怎么帮助那个身处险境的男人了吗？
messages.en: Did you see how he helped that man in danger?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，那是个英勇的举动。
messages.en: Yes, it was a valorous act.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“危险面前挺身而出”的场景记忆，valoruż 描写人物或举动表现出的英勇。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element vanadium, a metal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素钒，是一种金属。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku vanadju, li huwa metall.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钒，一种化学元素

formal.mt: L-istudenti qraw dwar il-vanadju fil-kapitlu dwar l-elementi kimiċi.
formal.en: The students read about vanadium in the chapter on chemical elements.
formal.zh: 学生们在介绍化学元素的章节中读到了有关钒的内容。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu l-vanadju? Toni: Huwa element kimiku u huwa metall.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is vanadium? Toni: It is a chemical element and a metal.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：钒是什么？托尼：它是一种化学元素，也是一种金属。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 钒是什么？
messages.en: What is vanadium?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa element kimiku u huwa metall.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa element kimiku u huwa metall.
messages.zh: 它是一种化学元素，也是一种金属。
messages.en: It is a chemical element and a metal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 vanadju 写在元素学习卡上，正面记马耳他语，背面记“钒，一种金属元素”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Giving someone a benefit or improving their position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能带来好处或使处境更有利的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti benefiċċju lil xi ħadd jew itejjeb il-pożizzjoni tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有利的；能带来好处的

formal.mt: Il-ftehim il-ġdid huwa vantaġġuż għaż-żewġ kumpaniji għax inaqqas l-ispejjeż.
formal.en: The new agreement is advantageous to both companies because it reduces costs.
formal.zh: 新协议降低了成本，因此对两家公司都有利。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Taħseb li dan il-prezz huwa vantaġġuż? Lara: Iva, l-istess mudell jiswa aktar fil-ħanut l-ieħor.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you think this is an advantageous price? Lara: Yes, the same model costs more at the other shop.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你觉得这个价格划算吗？拉拉：划算，同一款在另一家店卖得更贵。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li dan il-prezz huwa vantaġġuż?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li dan il-prezz huwa vantaġġuż?
messages.zh: 你觉得这个价格划算吗？
messages.en: Do you think this is an advantageous price?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, l-istess mudell jiswa aktar fil-ħanut l-ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-istess mudell jiswa aktar fil-ħanut l-ieħor.
messages.zh: 划算，同一款在另一家店卖得更贵。
messages.en: Yes, the same model costs more at the other shop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象比较两家店后找到划算价格：vantaġġuż 就是“对自己有利、能带来好处的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Christian gospel, or a written account of the life and teachings of Jesus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基督教的福音，或记述耶稣生平及教导的福音书。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-messaġġ Nisrani, jew kitba li tirrakkonta l-ħajja u t-tagħlim ta' Ġesù.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 福音；记述耶稣生平与教导的福音书

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni, l-għalliema spjegat silta mill-vanġelu dwar l-imħabba lejn il-proxxmu.
formal.en: In the lesson, the teacher explained a passage from the gospel about love for one's neighbour.
formal.zh: 课堂上，老师讲解了福音书中一段关于爱邻人的经文。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Minn fejn hi din is-silta? Marija: Mill-vanġelu; qrajnieha fil-lezzjoni tal-lum.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where is this passage from? Marija: From the gospel; we read it in today's lesson.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这段文字出自哪里？玛丽亚：出自福音书，我们今天上课读过。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 这段文字出自哪里？
messages.en: Where is this passage from?

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.zh: 出自福音书，我们今天上课读过。
messages.en: From the gospel; we read it in today's lesson.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象课堂上翻开福音书读一段经文，把 vanġelu 与“福音、福音书”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To launch something, such as putting a newly built boat into the water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物正式投入使用或推出，例如使新造的船下水。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jniedi xi ħaġa, bħal meta jqiegħed dgħajsa ġdida fl-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使下水；推出；启动

formal.mt: Il-bennej vara d-dgħajsa l-ġdida fil-preżenza tas-sidien.
formal.en: The builder launched the new boat in the presence of its owners.
formal.zh: 造船工人在船主们在场时让新船下了水。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-bennej vara d-dgħajsa llum? Ġużeppi: Iva, dalgħodu. Issa qiegħda fl-ilma.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did the builder launch the boat today? Ġużeppi: Yes, this morning. It is in the water now.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：造船工人今天让船下水了吗？朱塞佩：是的，今天早上。船现在已经在水里了。

messages.speaker: Rita (船主)
messages.zh: 造船工人今天让船下水了吗？
messages.en: Did the builder launch the boat today?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (船厂工作人员)
messages.zh: 是的，今天早上。船现在已经在水里了。
messages.en: Yes, this morning. It is in the water now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用新船从岸上进入水中的动作记 vara：这是“使船下水”的动作，不是下水活动的名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An event at which something is launched, especially when a new ship or boat is put into the water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式进行下水或推出的活动，尤其指新船下水的活动或仪式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Avveniment li fih titnieda xi ħaġa, speċjalment meta vapur jew dgħajsa ġdida titqiegħed fl-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 下水活动；正式推出的活动，尤指船舶下水仪式

formal.mt: Il-varatura tal-vapur il-ġdid se ssir nhar il-Ġimgħa filgħodu fit-tarzna.
formal.en: The launching of the new ship will take place at the shipyard on Friday morning.
formal.zh: 新船的下水仪式将于星期五上午在船厂举行。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Se tiġi għall-varatura tad-dgħajsa għada? Pawlu: Iva, irrid nara d-dgħajsa tidħol fl-ilma.
colloquial.en: Marija: Are you coming to the boat's launching tomorrow? Pawlu: Yes, I want to see the boat enter the water.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你明天来参加小船的下水活动吗？保罗：来，我想看看船入水的样子。

messages.speaker: Marija (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 你明天来参加小船的下水活动吗？
messages.en: Are you coming to the boat's launching tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (受邀朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irrid nara d-dgħajsa tidħol fl-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irrid nara d-dgħajsa tidħol fl-ilma.
messages.zh: 来，我想看看船入水的样子。
messages.en: Yes, I want to see the boat enter the water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象邀请函上写着新船下水的时间地点：varatura 是可以出席的一场活动，按名词记忆。

gloss_zh: 变化；使多样化；在乐器上即兴演奏

teaching_sense.en_definition: To change or differ, to introduce variety, or to improvise while playing an instrument.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发生变化或呈现差异，也可指主动变换内容；用于音乐时，指在乐器上即兴演奏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinbidel jew ikun differenti, jagħmel xi ħaġa aktar diversa, jew jimprovizza fuq strument mużikali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变化；有所不同；使内容或形式有所变化。
在乐器上即兴演奏。

collocations.en: vary from one day to the next

formal.mt: Il-prezz tal-biljett ivarja skont il-jum u l-ħin tal-vjaġġ.
formal.en: The ticket price varies according to the day and time of the journey.
formal.zh: 票价随出行日期和时间而变化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dejjem issajjar l-istess ħaġa? Mark: Le, inħobb invarja l-menu kull ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you always cook the same thing? Mark: No, I like to vary the menu every week.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你总是做同一道菜吗？Mark：不是，我喜欢每周变换菜单。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你总是做同一道菜吗？
messages.en: Do you always cook the same thing?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, inħobb invarja l-menu kull ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Le, inħobb invarja l-menu kull ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 不是，我喜欢每周变换菜单。
messages.en: No, I like to vary the menu every week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 varja 联想到每周变换菜单的动作：今天换一道菜，明天换一种做法；音乐场景再联想到即兴弹奏。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to vary in value or amount, or likely to change rather than remain fixed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数值、数量或状态可以变化的，或容易改变、并非固定不变的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jinbidel fil-valur, fl-ammont jew fl-istat tiegħu, jew li ma jibqax dejjem l-istess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可变的；数值、数量或程度并非固定的。
易变的；状态或情况容易发生变化的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddistingwi bejn l-ispejjeż fissi u l-ispejjeż varjabbli tal-produzzjoni.
formal.en: The report distinguishes between the fixed costs and the variable costs of production.
formal.zh: 报告区分了生产中的固定成本与可变成本。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nieħdu umbrella magħna? Pawlu: Iva, it-temp illum varjabbli ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall we take an umbrella with us? Pawlu: Yes, the weather is very changeable today.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们带把伞吗？Pawlu：带吧，今天的天气很多变。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们带把伞吗？
messages.en: Shall we take an umbrella with us?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 带吧，今天的天气很多变。
messages.en: Yes, the weather is very changeable today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两个画面：账单金额会上下变，天气会由晴转雨；varjabbli 描述的就是这种可变或易变的性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality or degree of variation across cases, conditions, or times.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不同个体、条件或时间之间存在变化的性质或程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-karatteristika jew il-grad ta' bidla jew differenza bejn każijiet, kundizzjonijiet jew żminijiet differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变异性；事物在不同情况或时间中表现出的差异与变化程度。

formal.mt: L-istudju jkejjel il-varjabilità fit-temperatura matul is-sena.
formal.en: The study measures variability in temperature over the year.
formal.zh: 这项研究测量一年中温度的变化程度。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex il-kejl ma jagħtiniex l-istess numru kull darba? David: Hemm ftit varjabilità fir-riżultati, għalhekk nieħdu diversi kejlijiet.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why doesn't the measurement give us the same number every time? David: There is some variability in the results, so we take several measurements.
colloquial.zh: Nina：为什么每次测量得到的数值都不一样？David：结果存在一定的变异性，所以我们会测量几次。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-kejl ma jagħtiniex l-istess numru kull darba?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-kejl ma jagħtiniex l-istess numru kull darba?
messages.zh: 为什么每次测量得到的数值都不一样？
messages.en: Why doesn't the measurement give us the same number every time?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm ftit varjabilità fir-riżultati, għalhekk nieħdu diversi kejlijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm ftit varjabilità fir-riżultati, għalhekk nieħdu diversi kejlijiet.
messages.zh: 结果存在一定的变异性，所以我们会测量几次。
messages.en: There is some variability in the results, so we take several measurements.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一周气温画成折线图：起伏显示变化程度。用这幅图记住 varjabilità 是谈论变化性质或程度的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form or version of something that differs from another form or version of the same thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 同一事物中与其他形式或版本有所不同的一种形式，即变体或不同版本。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma jew verżjoni ta' xi ħaġa li tkun differenti minn forma jew verżjoni oħra tal-istess ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某事物的一种变体。
某事物的不同版本。

collocations.zh: 该食谱的一种不同版本

formal.mt: Id-dizzjunarju jagħti varjant tal-kelma u jispjega fejn jintuża.
formal.en: The dictionary gives a variant of the word and explains where it is used.
formal.zh: 词典列出了该词的一种变体，并解释其使用范围。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din ir-riċetta fiha l-ġewż? Toni: Le, dan hu varjant mingħajr ġewż.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this recipe contain nuts? Toni: No, this is a variant without nuts.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个食谱里有坚果吗？Toni：没有，这是不加坚果的版本。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个食谱里有坚果吗？
messages.en: Does this recipe contain nuts?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dan hu varjant mingħajr ġewż.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dan hu varjant mingħajr ġewż.
messages.zh: 没有，这是不加坚果的版本。
messages.en: No, this is a variant without nuts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一道菜有加坚果和不加坚果两个版本：每个不同版本都可作为一个 varjant 来记，重点是具体的一种变体。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Differing in amount, form, or condition, or changing over time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在数量、形式或状况上有所变化的，或随着时间而改变的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jvarjaw fl-ammont, fil-forma jew fil-kundizzjoni, jew li jinbidlu maż-żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有变化的；在程度、形式或数量上各不相同的。
正在变化的；随时间而改变的。

formal.mt: Il-programm ġie adattat għall-ħtiġijiet varjanti tal-istudenti matul is-sena.
formal.en: The programme was adapted to the students' changing needs throughout the year.
formal.zh: 该课程在全年中进行了调整，以适应学生不断变化的需求。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex qed nibdlu l-pjan mill-ġdid? Ġanni: Irridu nqisu l-kundizzjonijiet varjanti tat-temp.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why are we changing the plan again? Ġanni: We need to take the changing weather conditions into account.
colloquial.zh: Marta：为什么我们又要修改计划？Ġanni：我们得考虑不断变化的天气状况。

messages.speaker: Marta (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 为什么我们又要修改计划？
messages.en: Why are we changing the plan again?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同事)
messages.zh: 我们得考虑不断变化的天气状况。
messages.en: We need to take the changing weather conditions into account.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 varjanti 放在 kundizzjonijiet 后一起记：条件一会儿这样、一会儿那样。本词条把它当作描述变化状态的形容词来学。

gloss_zh: 各种的；多样的；经常变化的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of different kinds, containing a range of things, or changing frequently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 种类不同的、包含多种内容的，或经常发生变化的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta' tipi differenti, li fih taħlita ta' affarijiet differenti, jew li jinbidel ta' spiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 各种的；不同种类的。
经常变化的；多变的。
具有多样性的；包含多种内容的。

collocations.zh: 内容丰富多样的节目安排

formal.mt: Il-festival joffri programm varju li jinkludi mużika, teatru u żfin.
formal.en: The festival offers a varied programme that includes music, theatre, and dance.
formal.zh: 艺术节提供丰富多样的节目，包括音乐、戏剧和舞蹈。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'se jkun hemm fil-festival? Luqa: Il-programm hu varju ħafna: hemm kunċerti, films u attivitajiet għat-tfal.
colloquial.en: Anna: What will there be at the festival? Luqa: The programme is very varied: there are concerts, films, and activities for children.
colloquial.zh: Anna：艺术节会有什么活动？Luqa：节目很多样，有音乐会、电影和儿童活动。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 艺术节会有什么活动？
messages.en: What will there be at the festival?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-programm hu varju ħafna: hemm kunċerti, films u attivitajiet għat-tfal.
messages.mt_standard: Il-programm hu varju ħafna: hemm kunċerti, films u attivitajiet għat-tfal.
messages.zh: 节目很多样，有音乐会、电影和儿童活动。
messages.en: The programme is very varied: there are concerts, films, and activities for children.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张艺术节节目单，同时列着音乐、戏剧和舞蹈：用 programm varju 记住内容多样，再用多变天气记住经常变化的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used as a person's family name, written Vassallo.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用作个人家族姓氏的专名，书写形式为 Vassallo。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom ta' persuna jew familja, li jinkiteb Vassallo.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个姓氏，写作 Vassallo，可音译为“瓦萨洛”。

formal.mt: Is-Sur Vassallo se jippreżenta r-rapport waqt il-laqgħa ta' għada.
formal.en: Mr Vassallo will present the report at tomorrow's meeting.
formal.zh: 瓦萨洛先生将在明天的会议上提交报告。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għandi appuntament mas-Sur Vassallo. Marija: Tajjeb, is-Sur Vassallo qiegħed fl-uffiċċju tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Rita: I have an appointment with Mr Vassallo. Marija: All right, Mr Vassallo is in his office.
colloquial.zh: Rita：我预约了与瓦萨洛先生见面。Marija：好的，瓦萨洛先生在他的办公室里。

messages.speaker: Rita (访客)
messages.zh: 我预约了与瓦萨洛先生见面。
messages.en: I have an appointment with Mr Vassallo.

messages.speaker: Marija (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, is-Sur Vassallo qiegħed fl-uffiċċju tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, is-Sur Vassallo qiegħed fl-uffiċċju tiegħu.
messages.zh: 好的，瓦萨洛先生在他的办公室里。
messages.en: All right, Mr Vassallo is in his office.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象办公室门牌写着“Sur Vassallo”：把称呼与姓氏一起记，注意姓氏首字母大写，并留意拼写中的双 s 和双 l。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A document or code that can be exchanged for goods or services, or used towards their cost.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可用于兑换商品、服务或抵扣相应费用的凭证或代码。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument jew kodiċi li jista' jintuża biex jinkisbu prodotti jew servizzi, jew biex jitħallas parti mill-prezz tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 代金券、礼券或其他可用于兑换商品、服务或抵扣费用的凭券。

formal.mt: Il-vawċer jista' jintuża darba biss u jibqa' validu sad-data indikata fuqu.
formal.en: The voucher can be used only once and remains valid until the date shown on it.
formal.zh: 该代金券仅可使用一次，有效期截至券面所示日期。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nista' nuża dan il-vawċer għal dawn iż-żraben? Lara: Iva, tista' tużah u tħallas id-differenza.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can I use this voucher for these shoes? Lara: Yes, you can use it and pay the difference.
colloquial.zh: Mark：买这双鞋可以用这张代金券吗？Lara：可以，你可以用券后再补差价。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nuża dan il-vawċer għal dawn iż-żraben?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nuża dan il-vawċer għal dawn iż-żraben?
messages.zh: 买这双鞋可以用这张代金券吗？
messages.en: Can I use this voucher for these shoes?

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tista' tużah u tħallas id-differenza.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tista' tużah u tħallas id-differenza.
messages.zh: 可以，你可以用券后再补差价。
messages.en: Yes, you can use it and pay the difference.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 vawċer 与英语 voucher 对照记忆，再想象结账时递出礼券、补付差价的画面；这只是学习联想，帮助记住凭券用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a speech sound produced with the back of the tongue against or near the soft palate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 描述由舌后部接触或接近软腭而发出的语音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi ħoss tad-diskors li jsir bil-parti ta' wara tal-ilsien mal-palat artab jew qribu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 软腭的；语音学中指发音部位在软腭处的。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-fonetika, l-istudenti jidentifikaw il-ħoss k bħala ħoss velari u jiddeskrivu l-pożizzjoni tal-ilsien.
formal.en: In the phonetics exercise, the students identify the sound k as a velar sound and describe the position of the tongue.
formal.zh: 在语音学练习中，学生将 k 音识别为软腭音，并描述舌头的位置。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħoss k huwa velari? Pawlu: Iva, meta tgħidu, il-parti ta' wara ta' lsienek tmiss il-palat artab.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the sound k velar? Pawlu: Yes, when you say it, the back of your tongue touches the soft palate.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：k 音是软腭音吗？保罗：是的，发这个音时，舌后部会接触软腭。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: k 音是软腭音吗？
messages.en: Is the sound k velar?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, meta tgħidu, il-parti ta' wara ta' lsienek tmiss il-palat artab.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, meta tgħidu, il-parti ta' wara ta' lsienek tmiss il-palat artab.
messages.zh: 是的，发这个音时，舌后部会接触软腭。
messages.en: Yes, when you say it, the back of your tongue touches the soft palate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 velari 和发 k 音时的舌后部动作一起记：舌后靠近软腭，便想到“软腭的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large fabric awning stretched over an open space to provide shade.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 张设在露天空间上方、用来遮阳的大型布篷或布幕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tinda kbira tad-drapp mifruxa fuq spazju miftuħ biex tipprovdi d-dell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大型遮阳篷或遮阳幕，张设在露天场地上方以提供阴凉。

formal.mt: Il-pjanta turi velarju kbir fuq il-bitħa, maħsub biex jipprovdi d-dell lill-viżitaturi waqt l-attivitajiet ta' barra.
formal.en: The plan shows a large velarium over the courtyard, intended to provide shade for visitors during outdoor activities.
formal.zh: 平面图显示庭院上方设有大型遮阳篷，用于在户外活动期间为访客遮阳。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn se noqogħdu biex nevitaw ix-xemx? Mark: Taħt il-velarju; hemm biżżejjed dell għalina t-tnejn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where shall we sit to stay out of the sun? Mark: Under the velarium; there is enough shade for both of us.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：我们坐在哪里可以避开太阳？马克：坐到大型遮阳篷下面吧，那里有足够我们两个人乘凉的地方。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se noqogħdu biex nevitaw ix-xemx?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se noqogħdu biex nevitaw ix-xemx?
messages.zh: 我们坐在哪里可以避开太阳？
messages.en: Where shall we sit to stay out of the sun?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħt il-velarju; hemm biżżejjed dell għalina t-tnejn.
messages.mt_standard: Taħt il-velarju; hemm biżżejjed dell għalina t-tnejn.
messages.zh: 坐到大型遮阳篷下面吧，那里有足够我们两个人乘凉的地方。
messages.en: Under the velarium; there is enough shade for both of us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 velarju 时想象庭院上方撑起一大片布，大家走到下面乘凉；用“大布篷遮太阳”的画面记词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The covering of something with a thin veil or layer; also a haze that makes a view less clear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用薄纱或薄层遮覆某物；也指使景物变得不清晰的薄雾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kisi ta' xi ħaġa b'velu jew saff irqiq; ukoll ċpar ħafif li jagħmel il-veduta inqas ċara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用薄纱或薄层进行的遮盖、遮覆。
使视野或景物显得模糊的薄雾。

formal.mt: Il-fotografija turi l-velatura tal-wiċċ b'drapp irqiq, li jħalli l-kontorni jidhru mingħajr ma jikxef id-dettalji kollha.
formal.en: The photograph shows the veiling of the face with thin fabric, which allows the outlines to remain visible without revealing every detail.
formal.zh: 照片呈现了用薄布遮覆面部的效果：轮廓仍然可见，但并未显露全部细节。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex il-gżira tidher daqshekk imċajpra llum? Toni: Hemm velatura ta' ċpar fuq il-baħar, għalhekk ma tidhirx ċara.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why does the island look so hazy today? Toni: There is a veil of haze over the sea, so it does not look clear.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：今天那座岛为什么看起来这么模糊？托尼：海面上有一层薄雾，所以看不清楚。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-gżira tidher daqshekk imċajpra llum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-gżira tidher daqshekk imċajpra llum?
messages.zh: 今天那座岛为什么看起来这么模糊？
messages.en: Why does the island look so hazy today?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm velatura ta' ċpar fuq il-baħar, għalhekk ma tidhirx ċara.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm velatura ta' ċpar fuq il-baħar, għalhekk ma tidhirx ċara.
messages.zh: 海面上有一层薄雾，所以看不清楚。
messages.en: There is a veil of haze over the sea, so it does not look clear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“隔着薄纱看风景”的画面记 velatura：薄纱对应遮覆，朦胧的风景对应薄雾，两个义项一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality or degree of being poisonous.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物具有毒的性质，或其毒性的程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proprjetà li xi ħaġa tkun velenuża, jew il-grad sa fejn tkun velenuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有毒的性质；毒性。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-velenożità tas-sustanza u jenfasizza l-ħtieġa li tiġi mmaniġġjata b'attenzjoni skont l-istruzzjonijiet.
formal.en: The report describes the poisonousness of the substance and emphasizes the need to handle it carefully according to the instructions.
formal.zh: 报告描述了该物质的毒性，并强调需要按照说明小心处理。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser velenożità fuq din il-folja? David: Tfisser kemm sustanza tkun velenuża; hawn qed jiddeskrivu l-periklu tagħha.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does velenożità mean on this sheet? David: It means how poisonous a substance is; here they are describing its danger.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这张说明上的 velenożità 是什么意思？戴维：就是一种物质有多毒，这里是在说明它的危险性。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser velenożità fuq din il-folja?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser velenożità fuq din il-folja?
messages.zh: 这张说明上的 velenożità 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does velenożità mean on this sheet?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser kemm sustanza tkun velenuża; hawn qed jiddeskrivu l-periklu tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser kemm sustanza tkun velenuża; hawn qed jiddeskrivu l-periklu tagħha.
messages.zh: 就是一种物质有多毒，这里是在说明它的危险性。
messages.en: It means how poisonous a substance is; here they are describing its danger.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 velenożità 放进“这东西的毒性有多高”这个问题中记忆，注意它表示性质或程度，是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A family name used as a person's surname.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用作个人姓氏的专有名称 Vella，可音译为“韦拉”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża bħala l-isem tal-familja ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个姓氏：Vella，可音译为“韦拉”。

formal.mt: Is-Sinjura Vella ppreżentat id-dokumenti mitluba u kkonfermat li l-kunjom tagħha kien miktub sew fuq il-formola.
formal.en: Ms Vella submitted the requested documents and confirmed that her surname was written correctly on the form.
formal.zh: 韦拉女士提交了所需文件，并确认表格上的姓氏拼写正确。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Bonġu, għandi appuntament mas-Sur Vella. Marija: Bonġu! Is-Sur Vella qiegħed fl-uffiċċju; se ngħidlu li wasalt.
colloquial.en: Anna: Good morning, I have an appointment with Mr Vella. Marija: Good morning! Mr Vella is in his office; I will tell him you have arrived.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：早上好，我和韦拉先生有预约。玛丽亚：早上好！韦拉先生在办公室，我去告诉他您到了。

messages.speaker: Anna (访客)
messages.zh: 早上好，我和韦拉先生有预约。
messages.en: Good morning, I have an appointment with Mr Vella.

messages.speaker: Marija (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Bonġu! Is-Sur Vella qiegħed fl-uffiċċju; se ngħidlu li wasalt.
messages.mt_standard: Bonġu! Is-Sur Vella qiegħed fl-uffiċċju; se ngħidlu li wasalt.
messages.zh: 早上好！韦拉先生在办公室，我去告诉他您到了。
messages.en: Good morning! Mr Vella is in his office; I will tell him you have arrived.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张写着“Mr Vella／韦拉先生”的名牌，把 Vella 记作姓氏，并记住正文中首字母要大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird called the glossy ibis in English, belonging to the species Plegadis falcinellus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种称为彩鹮的鸟，学名为 Plegadis falcinellus，英语称 glossy ibis。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ispeċi Plegadis falcinellus, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala glossy ibis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 彩鹮，学名 Plegadis falcinellus。

collocations.en: a sighting of a glossy ibis
a photograph of a glossy ibis

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-osservazzjoni, l-istudenta identifikat l-għasfur bħala velleran u niżżlet l-isem xjentifiku Plegadis falcinellus ħdejn ir-ritratt.
formal.en: In the observation report, the student identified the bird as a glossy ibis and wrote the scientific name Plegadis falcinellus beside the photograph.
formal.zh: 在观察报告中，这名学生将该鸟识别为彩鹮，并在照片旁写下学名 Plegadis falcinellus。

colloquial.mt: Luca: X'jismu dan l-għasfur fir-ritratt? Rita: Dak velleran. Fil-ktieb bl-Ingliż issibu bħala glossy ibis.
colloquial.en: Luca: What is the bird in this photograph called? Rita: That is a glossy ibis. In the English book, you will find it under glossy ibis.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：照片里的这只鸟叫什么？丽塔：那是彩鹮，马耳他语叫 velleran。在英文书里可以查 glossy ibis。

messages.speaker: Luca (学生)
messages.zh: 照片里的这只鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What is the bird in this photograph called?

messages.speaker: Rita (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak velleran. Fil-ktieb bl-Ingliż issibu bħala glossy ibis.
messages.mt_standard: Dak velleran. Fil-ktieb bl-Ingliż issibu bħala glossy ibis.
messages.zh: 那是彩鹮，马耳他语叫 velleran。在英文书里可以查 glossy ibis。
messages.en: That is a glossy ibis. In the English book, you will find it under glossy ibis.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张彩鹮图片卡，正面写 velleran，背面写“彩鹮／glossy ibis”，用同一只鸟连接三种语言。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A liturgical cloth worn over the shoulders, called a humeral veil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宗教礼仪中披在肩上的布巾或肩纱，英语称 humeral veil。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Drapp liturġiku li jintlibes fuq l-ispallejn, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala humeral veil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 礼仪肩纱；宗教礼仪中披在肩上的布巾。

collocations.en: the humeral veil over the shoulders

formal.mt: Il-katalgu tal-wirja jiddeskrivi l-velumeral bħala drapp liturġiku li jitqiegħed fuq l-ispallejn waqt ċerti ċerimonji reliġjużi.
formal.en: The exhibition catalogue describes the humeral veil as a liturgical cloth placed over the shoulders during certain religious ceremonies.
formal.zh: 展览目录将礼仪肩纱描述为在某些宗教仪式中披在肩上的礼仪用布。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'inhu dak id-drapp fuq l-ispallejn tas-saċerdot? Ġużeppi: Dak il-velumeral, drapp li jintuża fil-liturġija.
colloquial.en: Marta: What is that cloth over the priest's shoulders? Ġużeppi: That is the humeral veil, a cloth used in the liturgy.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：神父肩上披的那块布是什么？朱塞佩：那是礼仪肩纱，是礼仪中使用的一种布巾。

messages.speaker: Marta (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak id-drapp fuq l-ispallejn tas-saċerdot?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak id-drapp fuq l-ispallejn tas-saċerdot?
messages.zh: 神父肩上披的那块布是什么？
messages.en: What is that cloth over the priest's shoulders?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-velumeral, drapp li jintuża fil-liturġija.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-velumeral, drapp li jintuża fil-liturġija.
messages.zh: 那是礼仪肩纱，是礼仪中使用的一种布巾。
messages.en: That is the humeral veil, a cloth used in the liturgy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 velumeral 配上一幅“礼仪中肩披布巾”的画面，抓住“礼仪、肩膀、披巾”三个词来记忆。

gloss_zh: 工作班次；交通线路终点站

teaching_sense.en_definition: An assigned turn or period of work; also the end point of a transport route or system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 轮流安排的工作时段或班次；也指交通线路或运输系统的终点站。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu jew dawra ta' xogħol imqassma bejn il-ħaddiema; ukoll il-post fejn tispiċċa rotta jew sistema tat-trasport.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轮到某人工作的时段；工作班次。

sense_translations.en_definition: terminus (end point of a transport system)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 交通线路或运输系统的终点；终点站。

formal.mt: Skont l-iskeda, il-venda tax-xogħol ta' Marija tibda fis-sebgħa ta' filgħodu u tintemm fit-tlieta ta' waranofsinhar.
formal.en: According to the schedule, Marija's work shift begins at seven in the morning and ends at three in the afternoon.
formal.zh: 根据排班表，玛丽亚的工作班次从早上七点开始，到下午三点结束。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn għandi ninżel biex niltaqa' miegħek? Elena: Inżel fil-venda tal-karozzi tal-linja; nistenniek hemm ħdejn il-bank.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where should I get off to meet you? Elena: Get off at the bus terminus; I will wait for you there beside the bench.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我应该在哪里下车和你碰面？埃琳娜：在公交终点站下车吧，我会在那里的长椅旁等你。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn għandi ninżel biex niltaqa' miegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn għandi ninżel biex niltaqa' miegħek?
messages.zh: 我应该在哪里下车和你碰面？
messages.en: Where should I get off to meet you?

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Inżel fil-venda tal-karozzi tal-linja; nistenniek hemm ħdejn il-bank.
messages.mt_standard: Inżel fil-venda tal-karozzi tal-linja; nistenniek hemm ħdejn il-bank.
messages.zh: 在公交终点站下车吧，我会在那里的长椅旁等你。
messages.en: Get off at the bus terminus; I will wait for you there beside the bench.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 venda 画两张学习卡：一张是排班表，记“工作班次”；另一张是公交线路末端，记“终点站”，靠上下文区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Deserving deep respect because of age, character, wisdom, or long service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因年长、品德、智慧或长期贡献而值得深深敬重的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jistħoqqlu rispett kbir minħabba l-età, il-karattru, l-għerf jew is-servizz twil tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可敬的；德高望重的，常形容因年长、德行或贡献而受到敬重的人。

formal.mt: Il-komunità onorat lil dan l-għalliem venerabbli għas-snin twal ta' servizz tiegħu.
formal.en: The community honoured this venerable teacher for his many years of service.
formal.zh: 社区表彰了这位德高望重的教师，感谢他多年来的服务。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tgħid li hu raġel venerabbli? Pawlu: Għax dejjem għen lil kulħadd u kulħadd jirrispettah.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you say he is a venerable man? Pawlu: Because he has always helped everyone, and everyone respects him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么说他德高望重？保罗：因为他一直帮助大家，人人都敬重他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tgħid li hu raġel venerabbli?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tgħid li hu raġel venerabbli?
messages.zh: 你为什么说他德高望重？
messages.en: Why do you say he is a venerable man?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dejjem għen lil kulħadd u kulħadd jirrispettah.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dejjem għen lil kulħadd u kulħadd jirrispettah.
messages.zh: 因为他一直帮助大家，人人都敬重他。
messages.en: Because he has always helped everyone, and everyone respects him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位受全村敬重的老教师，把 venerabbli 与“德高望重的”连起来记；它是描述人的形容词。

gloss_zh: 可敬性；令人敬重的特质

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of deserving deep respect, especially because of age, character, or wisdom.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 值得深深敬重的性质，尤其指因年长、品德或智慧而具有的可敬特质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' min jistħoqqlu rispett kbir, speċjalment minħabba l-età, il-karattru jew l-għerf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可敬性；令人肃然起敬、值得深深敬重的特质。

collocations.zh: 一个人令人敬重的特质
一种令人肃然起敬的感觉

formal.mt: L-awtur juri l-venerabilità tal-għalliem permezz tal-għerf u l-imġiba tiegħu.
formal.en: The author conveys the teacher's venerability through his wisdom and conduct.
formal.zh: 作者通过这位教师的智慧和言行，展现他令人敬重的特质。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser venerabilità hawn? Mark: Tfisser il-kwalità li tagħmel lil persuna denja ta' rispett kbir.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does venerability mean here? Mark: It means the quality that makes a person worthy of deep respect.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这里的 venerabilità 是什么意思？马克：指使一个人值得深深敬重的特质。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 venerabilità 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does venerability mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser il-kwalità li tagħmel lil persuna denja ta' rispett kbir.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser il-kwalità li tagħmel lil persuna denja ta' rispett kbir.
messages.zh: 指使一个人值得深深敬重的特质。
messages.en: It means the quality that makes a person worthy of deep respect.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“他很可敬”与“他的可敬之处”作对照：venerabilità 命名的是“可敬这种特质”，属于抽象名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling or expression of deep respect and reverence for someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某物怀有或表达的深切敬意与敬仰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sentiment jew espressjoni ta' rispett profond u qima lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 崇敬；敬仰，指深切的敬意或表达这种敬意的行为。

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi kif il-komunità tesprimi l-venerazzjoni tagħha lejn il-qaddisin.
formal.en: The study describes how the community expresses its veneration of the saints.
formal.zh: 这项研究描述了该社区如何表达对圣人的崇敬。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex titkellem dwar in-nanna b'tant venerazzjoni? Toni: Għax għamlet ħafna għall-familja tagħna u nirrispettaha ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do you speak about your grandmother with such veneration? Toni: Because she has done so much for our family, and I respect her deeply.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你为什么谈起奶奶时这么敬仰她？托尼：因为她为我们家付出了很多，我非常敬重她。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex titkellem dwar in-nanna b'tant venerazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex titkellem dwar in-nanna b'tant venerazzjoni?
messages.zh: 你为什么谈起奶奶时这么敬仰她？
messages.en: Why do you speak about your grandmother with such veneration?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għamlet ħafna għall-familja tagħna u nirrispettaha ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għamlet ħafna għall-familja tagħna u nirrispettaha ħafna.
messages.zh: 因为她为我们家付出了很多，我非常敬重她。
messages.en: Because she has done so much for our family, and I respect her deeply.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“值得敬重的特质”与“我表达的敬意”分开记：venerazzjoni 对应心中怀有或行动表达的崇敬。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The proper name Venus, referring either to the Roman goddess or to the planet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 专名 Venus，可指罗马女神维纳斯，也可指行星金星，具体含义由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem proprju li jirreferi jew għall-alla mara Rumana jew għall-pjaneta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 维纳斯，罗马神话中的女神。
金星，太阳系中的一颗行星。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu tal-mużew jiddeskrivi statwa ta' Venere, alla mara fil-mitoloġija Rumana.
formal.en: The museum catalogue describes a statue of Venus, a goddess in Roman mythology.
formal.zh: 博物馆目录介绍了一尊维纳斯雕像；维纳斯是罗马神话中的女神。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta tgħid Venere hawn, qed titkellem dwar l-alla? Mark: Le, qed nitkellem dwar il-pjaneta li tidher f'din il-mappa tas-sema.
colloquial.en: Maja: When you say Venus here, are you talking about the goddess? Mark: No, I am talking about the planet shown on this sky map.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你这里说的 Venere 是指那位女神吗？马克：不是，我说的是这张星图上标出的金星。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tgħid Venere hawn, qed titkellem dwar l-alla?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tgħid Venere hawn, qed titkellem dwar l-alla?
messages.zh: 你这里说的 Venere 是指那位女神吗？
messages.en: When you say Venus here, are you talking about the goddess?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, qed nitkellem dwar il-pjaneta li tidher f'din il-mappa tas-sema.
messages.mt_standard: Le, qed nitkellem dwar il-pjaneta li tidher f'din il-mappa tas-sema.
messages.zh: 不是，我说的是这张星图上标出的金星。
messages.en: No, I am talking about the planet shown on this sky map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中并排放一尊女神雕像和一张星图：Venere 遇到 alla 想维纳斯，遇到 pjaneta 想金星，书写时首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lapwing; in the species-specific sense, the northern lapwing, Vanellus vanellus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种称为麦鸡的鸟；具体指物种时，可指凤头麦鸡，学名 Vanellus vanellus。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur magħruf bħala lapwing; fis-sens speċifiku tal-ispeċi, Vanellus vanellus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 麦鸡，一类鸟的名称。
麦鸡，鸟名。
凤头麦鸡，学名 Vanellus vanellus。

formal.mt: F'din il-gwida, l-isem venewwa jirreferi għall-ispeċi Vanellus vanellus.
formal.en: In this guide, the name venewwa refers to the species Vanellus vanellus.
formal.zh: 在这本指南中，venewwa 这个名称指凤头麦鸡，即 Vanellus vanellus。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'jismu dan l-għasfur fil-ktieb? Pawlu: Venewwa. Ejja naqraw id-deskrizzjoni tiegħu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is this bird in the book called? Pawlu: A lapwing. Let's read its description together.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：书里的这只鸟叫什么？保罗：麦鸡。我们一起读读它的介绍吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 书里的这只鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What is this bird in the book called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (观鸟伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Venewwa. Ejja naqraw id-deskrizzjoni tiegħu flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Venewwa. Ejja naqraw id-deskrizzjoni tiegħu flimkien.
messages.zh: 麦鸡。我们一起读读它的介绍吧。
messages.en: A lapwing. Let's read its description together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给鸟类单词卡画一只麦鸡，正面写 venewwa，背面分两行写“麦鸡”和“具体物种：凤头麦鸡”，提醒自己看语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The white-tailed lapwing, a bird species with the scientific name Vanellus leucurus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 白尾麦鸡，一种麦鸡，学名为 Vanellus leucurus。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' venewwa magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Vanellus leucurus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白尾麦鸡，学名 Vanellus leucurus。

collocations.en: a photograph of a white-tailed lapwing

formal.mt: Il-gwida tagħti l-isem xjentifiku Vanellus leucurus għall-venewwa denbha abjad.
formal.en: The guide gives Vanellus leucurus as the scientific name of the white-tailed lapwing.
formal.zh: 这本指南注明，白尾麦鸡的学名是 Vanellus leucurus。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din venewwa denbha abjad? Toni: Ejja nqabblu r-ritratt mad-deskrizzjoni fil-gwida qabel niddeċiedu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this a white-tailed lapwing? Toni: Let's compare the photograph with the description in the guide before we decide.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这是白尾麦鸡吗？托尼：我们先把照片和指南里的描述对照一下，再作判断。

messages.speaker: Lara (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 这是白尾麦鸡吗？
messages.en: Is this a white-tailed lapwing?

messages.speaker: Toni (观鸟伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nqabblu r-ritratt mad-deskrizzjoni fil-gwida qabel niddeċiedu.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nqabblu r-ritratt mad-deskrizzjoni fil-gwida qabel niddeċiedu.
messages.zh: 我们先把照片和指南里的描述对照一下，再作判断。
messages.en: Let's compare the photograph with the description in the guide before we decide.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 denbha abjad 当作“它的尾巴是白色的”这一短语来联想，帮助记住白尾麦鸡；整组名称一起读、一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The sociable lapwing, a bird species with the scientific name Vanellus gregarius.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 黑腹麦鸡，英语称 sociable lapwing，学名为 Vanellus gregarius。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' venewwa magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Vanellus gregarius.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黑腹麦鸡，学名 Vanellus gregarius，英语名称为 sociable lapwing。

collocations.en: a photograph of a sociable lapwing
an observation of a sociable lapwing

formal.mt: Il-lista tal-ispeċi tinkludi l-venewwa Ingliża taħt l-isem xjentifiku Vanellus gregarius.
formal.en: The species list includes the sociable lapwing under the scientific name Vanellus gregarius.
formal.zh: 这份物种名录收录了黑腹麦鸡，并注明其学名为 Vanellus gregarius。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif insib il-venewwa Ingliża f'dan il-ktieb bl-Ingliż? Mark: Fittex sociable lapwing, jew l-isem xjentifiku Vanellus gregarius.
colloquial.en: Maja: How can I find the venewwa Ingliża in this English-language book? Mark: Look for sociable lapwing, or the scientific name Vanellus gregarius.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我怎么在这本英文书里找到 venewwa Ingliża？马克：查 sociable lapwing，或者查学名 Vanellus gregarius。

messages.speaker: Maja (观鸟初学者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif insib il-venewwa Ingliża f'dan il-ktieb bl-Ingliż?
messages.mt_standard: Kif insib il-venewwa Ingliża f'dan il-ktieb bl-Ingliż?
messages.zh: 我怎么在这本英文书里找到 venewwa Ingliża？
messages.en: How can I find the venewwa Ingliża in this English-language book?

messages.speaker: Mark (观鸟伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Fittex sociable lapwing, jew l-isem xjentifiku Vanellus gregarius.
messages.mt_standard: Fittex sociable lapwing, jew l-isem xjentifiku Vanellus gregarius.
messages.zh: 查 sociable lapwing，或者查学名 Vanellus gregarius。
messages.en: Look for sociable lapwing, or the scientific name Vanellus gregarius.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做一张三语配对卡：venewwa Ingliża—sociable lapwing—黑腹麦鸡；用学名 Vanellus gregarius 核对，避免凭名称猜产地。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The spur-winged lapwing, a bird species with the scientific name Vanellus spinosus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刺翅麦鸡，一种麦鸡，学名为 Vanellus spinosus。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' venewwa magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Vanellus spinosus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刺翅麦鸡，学名 Vanellus spinosus。

collocations.en: a photograph of a spur-winged lapwing

formal.mt: Fil-gwida, il-venewwa tal-ixpruni tidher bl-isem xjentifiku Vanellus spinosus.
formal.en: In the guide, the spur-winged lapwing appears under the scientific name Vanellus spinosus.
formal.zh: 在这本指南中，刺翅麦鸡列于学名 Vanellus spinosus 之下。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird species known as the sociable lapwing, Vanellus gregarius.

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' għasfur bl-isem xjentifiku Vanellus gregarius.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黄颊麦鸡（学名 Vanellus gregarius）。

an observation of a sociable lapwing

teaching_sense.en_definition: Venezuela, a country in South America.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 委内瑞拉，位于南美洲的国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Amerka t'Isfel, bl-isem uffiċjali Repubblika Bolivarjana tal-Venezwela.

sense_translations.en_definition: Venezuela (a country in South America; official name: Repubblika Bolivarjana tal-Venezwela)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 委内瑞拉，南美洲国家；正式名称为委内瑞拉玻利瓦尔共和国。

formal.mt: L-istudenti sabu l-Venezwela fuq il-mappa tal-Amerka t'Isfel.
formal.en: The students located Venezuela on the map of South America.
formal.zh: 学生们在南美洲地图上找到了委内瑞拉。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hi l-Venezwela? Pawlu: Fl-Amerka t'Isfel. Ejja nsibuha fuq il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is Venezuela? Pawlu: In South America. Let's find it on the map.
colloquial.zh: Sara：委内瑞拉在哪里？Pawlu：在南美洲。我们在地图上找找吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 委内瑞拉在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Venezuela?

messages.mt_standard: Fl-Amerka t'Isfel. Ejja nsibuha fuq il-mappa.
messages.zh: 在南美洲。我们在地图上找找吧。
messages.en: In South America. Let's find it on the map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Venezwela 与英语 Venezuela 并排对照，再联系中文“委内瑞拉”；作为国名使用时首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The movement or exchange of air that brings fresh air into a room or other space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让新鲜空气进入房间或其他空间、使空气流通或更换的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment jew it-tiġdid tal-arja f'kamra jew fi spazju ieħor biex tidħol arja friska.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通风；使空气流通或更新的换气过程。

formal.mt: Il-pjan tal-bini jinkludi sistema ta' ventilazzjoni għal kull sala.
formal.en: The building plan includes a ventilation system for every hall.
formal.zh: 建筑方案为每个大厅都配置了通风系统。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Niftħu t-tieqa biex ikun hemm ventilazzjoni aħjar? Ben: Iva, hawn ftit arja friska.
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall we open the window for better ventilation? Ben: Yes, there's little fresh air in here.
