messages.en: I think so, but check the time on the ticket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿着车票逐项核对日期和时间，确认无误后打一个勾；用“检查后确认”的动作记住这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To compose verse or turn a story, idea, or other material into verse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 创作诗句，或把故事、想法等内容改写成诗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jikteb versi jew jagħti forma ta' poeżija lil storja, idea jew materjal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作诗；用诗句表达；把某种内容改写成诗。

formal.mt: Għall-kompetizzjoni letterarja, l-awtur vversja leġġenda lokali f'poeżija ta' għoxrin vers.
formal.en: For the literary competition, the author turned a local legend into a poem of twenty lines.
formal.zh: 为参加文学比赛，作者把一个当地传说改写成了一首二十行的诗。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'għamel Leo għall-proġett tal-Malti? Sam: Vversja storja qasira u qara l-poeżija fil-klassi.
colloquial.en: Rita: What did Leo do for the Maltese project? Sam: He turned a short story into verse and read the poem in class.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：利奥的马耳他语课程项目做了什么？萨姆：他把一个短篇故事改写成诗，还在班上朗读了。

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.zh: 利奥的马耳他语课程项目做了什么？
messages.en: What did Leo do for the Maltese project?

messages.speaker: Sam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Vversja storja qasira u qara l-poeżija fil-klassi.
messages.mt_standard: Vversja storja qasira u qara l-poeżija fil-klassi.
messages.zh: 他把一个短篇故事改写成诗，还在班上朗读了。
messages.en: He turned a short story into verse and read the poem in class.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一段故事重新写成一行行诗句，再在课堂朗读；用“内容变成诗”的过程记住这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To annoy or trouble someone, causing irritation or distress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人感到烦恼、恼怒或不安。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idejjaq jew jirrita lil xi ħadd u jġiegħlu jħoss dwejjaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使烦恼；使恼怒；使感到困扰。

formal.mt: L-istorbju kontinwu vvessa lir-residenti u wassal għal diversi lmenti.
formal.en: The constant noise vexed the residents and led to several complaints.
formal.zh: 持续的噪声使居民烦恼，并引发了多起投诉。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dak l-istorbju vvessa lil kulħadd illum. Pawlu: Veru, lanqas stajt nikkonċentra.
colloquial.en: Marta: That noise vexed everyone today. Pawlu: True, I couldn't even concentrate.
colloquial.zh: Marta：今天那噪声让大家都很烦。Pawlu：确实，我连注意力都集中不了。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak l-istorbju vvessa lil kulħadd illum.
messages.mt_standard: Dak l-istorbju vvessa lil kulħadd illum.
messages.zh: 今天那噪声让大家都很烦。
messages.en: That noise vexed everyone today.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 确实，我连注意力都集中不了。
messages.en: True, I couldn't even concentrate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象噪声一直响，听的人皱眉捂耳；用这个画面记住它表示让别人烦恼。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To examine a person or something carefully before deciding whether they are suitable or acceptable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在决定是否录用、接受或批准之前，仔细审查某人或某项内容。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jeżamina bir-reqqa persuna jew xi ħaġa qabel jiddeċiedi jekk hijiex xierqa jew aċċettabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 审查或审核，以确认是否符合要求、适合接受或可以批准。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat vvettja l-kandidati kollha qabel għażel il-persuni għall-intervisti.
formal.en: The committee vetted all the candidates before selecting people for interviews.
formal.zh: 委员会先审查了所有候选人，再选出参加面试的人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min vvettja din il-proposta? Mark: Il-maniġer; qara d-dettalji kollha lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who vetted this proposal? Mark: The manager; he read all the details yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Lara：谁审核了这份提案？Mark：经理，他昨天看过了所有细节。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 谁审核了这份提案？
messages.en: Who vetted this proposal?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 经理，他昨天看过了所有细节。
messages.en: The manager; he read all the details yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把候选资料放在放大镜下，检查合格后再打勾，记住这是作决定前的审查。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move rapidly and repeatedly back and forth in small movements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 快速、反复地作小幅度往返运动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiċċaqlaq malajr u ripetutament 'il quddiem u lura b'movimenti żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 振动；快速反复地颤动。

formal.mt: Matul it-test, il-ħġieġ vvibra meta żdied il-ħoss mill-lawdspiker.
formal.en: During the test, the glass vibrated when the sound from the loudspeaker increased.
formal.zh: 测试过程中，扬声器的声音增大时，玻璃振动了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: It-telefon tiegħek vvibra? David: Iva, wasalli messaġġ mingħand oħti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did your phone vibrate? David: Yes, I got a message from my sister.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你的手机刚才振动了吗？David：是的，我收到姐姐发来的消息了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的手机刚才振动了吗？
messages.en: Did your phone vibrate?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，我收到姐姐发来的消息了。
messages.en: Yes, I got a message from my sister.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手机收到消息后在桌上嗡嗡颤动，记住振动是小幅度、反复的运动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To mark or decorate a surface with lines resembling veins.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在物体表面绘制或添加像血管、叶脉或石材纹路一样的线条。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel jew ipinġi linji li jixbhu vini fuq wiċċ bħala tiżjin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给表面加上脉状线条或纹理。

collocations.zh: 在涂漆表面绘出脉状纹理
在木板上绘出脉状纹理

formal.mt: L-artiġjan vvina l-pannell b'linji griżi rqaq biex jagħtih dehra ta' rħam.
formal.en: The craftsman veined the panel with thin grey lines to give it the appearance of marble.
formal.zh: 工匠在板面上绘出细细的灰色脉纹，使其呈现大理石的外观。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min vvina dan il-pannell? Toni: Missieri; dawk il-linji kollha pinġihom hu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who veined this panel? Toni: My father; he painted all those lines himself.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这块板上的脉状纹理是谁画的？Toni：我爸爸，那些线条都是他亲手画的。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这块板上的脉状纹理是谁画的？
messages.en: Who veined this panel?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieri; dawk il-linji kollha pinġihom hu.
messages.mt_standard: Missieri; dawk il-linji kollha pinġihom hu.
messages.zh: 我爸爸，那些线条都是他亲手画的。
messages.en: My father; he painted all those lines himself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象画笔在白色板面添上大理石般的细线，把这个词记作给表面画出脉纹。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something subject to a binding condition or obligation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某项安排、用途或行为受到必须遵守的条件或义务约束。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jorbot xi ħaġa ma' kundizzjoni jew obbligu li jrid jitħares.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使附带必须履行的条件或义务；使受约束。

collocations.en: place binding conditions on the use of funds
collocations.zh: 对资金用途施加约束条件

collocations.en: make the provision of aid subject to binding conditions
collocations.zh: 使援助的提供受到约束条件限制

formal.mt: Il-ftehim vvinkla l-użu tal-fondi ma' proġetti edukattivi.
formal.en: The agreement imposed a binding condition that the funds be used for educational projects.
formal.zh: 协议规定资金必须用于教育项目，以此对资金用途作出约束。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-ftehim vvinkla l-użu ta' dawn il-flus? Simon: Iva, nistgħu nużawhom biss għat-taħriġ.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did the agreement place binding conditions on how this money can be used? Simon: Yes, we can use it only for training.
colloquial.zh: Rita：协议对这笔钱的用途作出约束了吗？Simon：是的，我们只能把它用于培训。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ftehim vvinkla l-użu ta' dawn il-flus?
messages.mt_standard: Il-ftehim vvinkla l-użu ta' dawn il-flus?
messages.zh: 协议对这笔钱的用途作出约束了吗？
messages.en: Did the agreement place binding conditions on how this money can be used?

messages.speaker: Simon (同事)
messages.zh: 是的，我们只能把它用于培训。
messages.en: Yes, we can use it only for training.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一笔资金被绳子系在用途标签上，提醒自己这个词强调附带条件和义务约束。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To treat someone unfairly or harmfully, making them a victim.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以不公正或有害的方式对待某人，使其成为受害者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittratta lil xi ħadd b'mod inġust jew jagħmillu ħsara, u b'hekk jagħmlu vittma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使受害；欺压或不公正地对待某人。

collocations.zh: 不公正地对待一名工人

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif is-superviżur vvittimizza ħaddiem wara li dan ressaq ilment.
formal.en: The report describes how the supervisor victimized a worker after the worker filed a complaint.
formal.zh: 报告描述了主管如何在一名工人提出投诉后对其进行不公正的对待。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex Ġorġ talab l-għajnuna? Ben: Għax il-kap vvittimizza lilu wara li tkellem dwar il-problema.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did Ġorġ ask for help? Ben: Because the boss victimized him after he spoke about the problem.
colloquial.zh: Anna：Ġorġ为什么求助？Ben：因为他谈到那个问题后，老板就针对他。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: Ġorġ为什么求助？
messages.en: Why did Ġorġ ask for help?

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-kap vvittimizza lilu wara li tkellem dwar il-problema.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-kap vvittimizza lilu wara li tkellem dwar il-problema.
messages.zh: 因为他谈到那个问题后，老板就针对他。
messages.en: Because the boss victimized him after he spoke about the problem.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一个人被反复排挤、受到不公平对待的场景来记，重点是谁使别人变成受害者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To dissect a living animal for scientific investigation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了科学研究而对活着的动物进行解剖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddisseka annimal ħaj għal skopijiet ta' riċerka xjentifika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对活体动物进行解剖，通常用于科学研究。

formal.mt: Fit-test, l-awtur jiddeskrivi riċerkatur li vvივisezzjona annimal u jiddiskuti l-kwistjonijiet etiċi marbuta ma' dan.
formal.en: In the text, the author describes a researcher who vivisected an animal and discusses the ethical issues associated with this.
formal.zh: 文中，作者描述了一名对动物进行活体解剖的研究者，并讨论了相关伦理问题。

colloquial.mt: Emma: X'għamel ir-riċerkatur fl-istorja? Luqa: Vvivisezzjona annimal; imbagħad il-klassi ddiskutiet jekk dan kienx aċċettabbli.
colloquial.en: Emma: What did the researcher do in the story? Luqa: He vivisected an animal; then the class discussed whether that was acceptable.
colloquial.zh: Emma：故事里的研究者做了什么？Luqa：他对一只动物进行了活体解剖，然后全班讨论了这种做法是否可以接受。

messages.speaker: Emma (同学)
messages.zh: 故事里的研究者做了什么？
messages.en: What did the researcher do in the story?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Vvivisezzjona annimal; imbagħad il-klassi ddiskutiet jekk dan kienx aċċettabbli.
messages.mt_standard: Vvivisezzjona annimal; imbagħad il-klassi ddiskutiet jekk dan kienx aċċettabbli.
messages.zh: 他对一只动物进行了活体解剖，然后全班讨论了这种做法是否可以接受。
messages.en: He vivisected an animal; then the class discussed whether that was acceptable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词义写成两张并排的提示卡：活着的动物、进行解剖；两项同时具备才符合这里的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To spoil or corrupt someone or something, damaging their character, quality, or integrity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或事物变坏，损害其品格、质量或正直性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħassar persuna jew ħaġa billi tagħmel ħsara lill-karattru, lill-kwalità jew lill-integrità tagħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: to corrupt, to ruin, to debase
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使腐化、毁坏或败坏；使人或事物的品质降低。

formal.mt: Ir-rumanz juri kif l-abbuż tal-poter ivvizzja l-karattru tal-protagonist.
formal.en: The novel shows how the abuse of power corrupted the protagonist's character.
formal.zh: 这部小说展现了滥用权力如何败坏主人公的品格。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dak il-poter kollu vvizzja lil Pawlu. Luqa: Iva, issa jimpurtah biss minnu nnifsu.
colloquial.en: Marija: All that power corrupted Pawlu. Luqa: Yes, now he only cares about himself.
colloquial.zh: Marija：那么大的权力使保罗堕落了。Luqa：是啊，他现在只关心自己。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-poter kollu vvizzja lil Pawlu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-poter kollu vvizzja lil Pawlu.
messages.zh: 那么大的权力使保罗堕落了。
messages.en: All that power corrupted Pawlu.

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa jimpurtah biss minnu nnifsu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa jimpurtah biss minnu nnifsu.
messages.zh: 是啊，他现在只关心自己。
messages.en: Yes, now he only cares about himself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“权力败坏品格”的情境记忆，把这个动词与人或事物逐渐变坏联系起来。

gloss_zh: 在脑海中描绘；使可视化

teaching_sense.en_definition: To form a mental picture of something or represent it in a visible form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在脑海中形成某事物的画面，或用可见的图像将其呈现出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jifforma stampa ta' xi ħaġa f'moħħu jew juriha f'forma viżiva.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在脑海中想象或描绘；以图像方式呈现，使可视化。

formal.mt: L-istudent vviżwalizza d-data permezz ta' graff biex juri kif inbidlu t-temperaturi matul il-ġimgħa.
formal.en: The student visualized the data using a graph to show how temperatures changed during the week.
formal.zh: 学生通过图表将数据可视化，展示一周内气温的变化。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif spjega l-idea tiegħu David? Alex: Vviżwalizza l-kamra l-ġdida bi tpinġija, u fhimt mill-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Marija: How did David explain his idea? Alex: He visualized the new room with a drawing, and I understood straight away.
colloquial.zh: Marija：David是怎么解释他的想法的？Alex：他画图展示了新房间的样子，我一下就明白了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: David是怎么解释他的想法的？
messages.en: How did David explain his idea?

messages.speaker: Alex (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Vviżwalizza l-kamra l-ġdida bi tpinġija, u fhimt mill-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Vviżwalizza l-kamra l-ġdida bi tpinġija, u fhimt mill-ewwel.
messages.zh: 他画图展示了新房间的样子，我一下就明白了。
messages.en: He visualized the new room with a drawing, and I understood straight away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住从文字或数字变成画面的过程：画面可以出现在脑海里，也可以画在纸上。

gloss_zh: 给临终者领圣体；授予临终圣餐

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give Holy Communion to a person approaching death, as viaticum.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为接近死亡的人授予圣体，即给予临终圣餐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti t-tqarbin lil persuna qrib il-mewt bħala vjatku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 授予临终圣餐，即给临终者领圣体。

collocations.en: give viaticum to the sick person
collocations.zh: 为病中的临终者授予圣体

formal.mt: Wara li talab miegħu, il-qassis ivvjatka lill-marid li kien qrib il-mewt.
formal.en: After praying with him, the priest gave viaticum to the sick man who was approaching death.
formal.zh: 神父与病人一起祈祷后，为这位接近死亡的病人授予了临终圣餐。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Il-qassis ġie jżur lin-nannu? Pietru: Iva, ivvjatka lin-nannu dalgħodu u talab miegħu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did the priest come to visit Grandad? Pietru: Yes, he gave Grandad viaticum this morning and prayed with him.
colloquial.zh: Anna：神父来看爷爷了吗？Pietru：来了，今天早上为爷爷授予了临终圣餐，还与他一起祈祷。

messages.speaker: Anna (孙女)
messages.zh: 神父来看爷爷了吗？
messages.en: Did the priest come to visit Grandad?

messages.speaker: Pietru (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ivvjatka lin-nannu dalgħodu u talab miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ivvjatka lin-nannu dalgħodu u talab miegħu.
messages.zh: 来了，今天早上为爷爷授予了临终圣餐，还与他一起祈祷。
messages.en: Yes, he gave Grandad viaticum this morning and prayed with him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“神父、临终者、圣体”三个画面连起来记，重点是给予临终圣餐这一宗教行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To travel from one place to another, especially over a considerable distance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从一个地方前往另一个地方，尤其指有一定距离的旅行或出行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tmur minn post għal ieħor, speċjalment fuq distanza twila.

sense_translations.en_definition: to journey, travel, make a trip of some distance
sense_translations.zh_definition: 旅行、远行；进行一段有一定距离的旅程。

formal.mt: Il-grupp ivvjaġġa minn Malta għal Ruma biex jattendi konferenza.
formal.en: The group travelled from Malta to Rome to attend a conference.
formal.zh: 该团体从马耳他前往罗马参加会议。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn ivvjaġġa ħuk dan is-sajf? Mark: Ivvjaġġa lejn l-Italja u żar diversi bliet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did your brother travel this summer? Mark: He travelled to Italy and visited several cities.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你兄弟今年夏天去哪里旅行了？Mark：他去了意大利，游览了好几个城市。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟今年夏天去哪里旅行了？
messages.en: Where did your brother travel this summer?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ivvjaġġa lejn l-Italja u żar diversi bliet.
messages.mt_standard: Ivvjaġġa lejn l-Italja u żar diversi bliet.
messages.zh: 他去了意大利，游览了好几个城市。
messages.en: He travelled to Italy and visited several cities.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象行李箱和跨城路线，把这个动词记成“动身走一段旅程”，再搭配目的地或交通工具练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To break a rule or agreement, or fail to act as it requires.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 违反规则或协议，或没有按照其要求行事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tikser regola jew ftehim, jew ma taġixxix skont dak li jitolbu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to violate (to break or fail to act by rules)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 违反；违犯规则或未按规则行事。

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija vvjolat il-ftehim billi qasmet id-data mingħajr permess.
formal.en: The company violated the agreement by sharing the data without permission.
formal.zh: 该公司未经许可共享数据，违反了协议。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Pawlu vvjola r-regoli tal-logħba? Toni: Iva, mess il-ballun b'idu meta ma kienx permess.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did Pawlu break the rules of the game? Toni: Yes, he touched the ball with his hand when it was not allowed.
colloquial.zh: Rita：保罗违反比赛规则了吗？Toni：是的，他在不允许用手碰球的时候用手碰了球。

messages.speaker: Rita (观众)
messages.zh: 保罗违反比赛规则了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu break the rules of the game?

messages.speaker: Toni (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, mess il-ballun b'idu meta ma kienx permess.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, mess il-ballun b'idu meta ma kienx permess.
messages.zh: 是的，他在不允许用手碰球的时候用手碰了球。
messages.en: Yes, he touched the ball with his hand when it was not allowed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一条写着“规则”的界线，越过界线就是违反；用规则和协议作宾语反复练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To rape or sexually violate someone, or to subject someone to violence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强奸或性侵犯某人，也可指对某人施加暴力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tistupra persuna jew twettaq vjolenza sesswali jew fiżika kontriha.

sense_translations.en_definition: to rape, to violate, to do violence to
sense_translations.zh_definition: 强奸、侵犯；对某人施加暴力。

collocations.en: accused of having raped or assaulted someone
collocations.zh: 被指控曾强奸或侵犯他人

formal.mt: Fix-xhieda tagħha, il-mara qalet li r-raġel ivvjolentaha.
formal.en: In her testimony, the woman said that the man had raped her.
formal.zh: 这名女性在证词中表示，该男子强奸了她。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Qrajt li raġel ġie akkużat li vvjolenta mara. David: Nispera li l-mara qed tirċievi l-għajnuna u l-appoġġ li teħtieġ.
colloquial.en: Elena: I read that a man was charged with raping a woman. David: I hope the woman is receiving the help and support she needs.
colloquial.zh: Elena：我读到一名男子被控强奸一名女性。David：希望她正在获得所需的帮助和支持。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qrajt li raġel ġie akkużat li vvjolenta mara.
messages.mt_standard: Qrajt li raġel ġie akkużat li vvjolenta mara.
messages.zh: 我读到一名男子被控强奸一名女性。
messages.en: I read that a man was charged with raping a woman.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nispera li l-mara qed tirċievi l-għajnuna u l-appoġġ li teħtieġ.
messages.mt_standard: Nispera li l-mara qed tirċievi l-għajnuna u l-appoġġ li teħtieġ.
messages.zh: 希望她正在获得所需的帮助和支持。
messages.en: I hope the woman is receiving the help and support she needs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“受害者陈述遭受侵犯”的严肃语境记忆，牢记它涉及性侵犯或对人施暴。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce sounds with the voice, for example while singing or practising pronunciation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用嗓音发出声音，例如唱歌或练习发音时发声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tipproduċi ħsejjes bil-vuċi, pereżempju waqt il-kant jew l-eżerċizzji tal-pronunzja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发声；用嗓音发出声音或唱出音调。

formal.mt: Il-kantant ivvokalizza l-melodija mingħajr kliem waqt il-prova.
formal.en: The singer vocalized the melody without words during the rehearsal.
formal.zh: 歌手在排练时不带歌词地唱出了旋律。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex il-kantant ivvokalizza l-melodija mingħajr kliem? Adam: Biex jipprattika n-noti qabel iżid il-kliem.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did the singer vocalize the melody without words? Adam: To practise the notes before adding the words.
colloquial.zh: Nina：歌手为什么不带歌词唱这段旋律？Adam：为了先练习音符，再加上歌词。

messages.speaker: Nina (音乐学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-kantant ivvokalizza l-melodija mingħajr kliem?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-kantant ivvokalizza l-melodija mingħajr kliem?
messages.zh: 歌手为什么不带歌词唱这段旋律？
messages.en: Why did the singer vocalize the melody without words?

messages.speaker: Adam (音乐教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex jipprattika n-noti qabel iżid il-kliem.
messages.mt_standard: Biex jipprattika n-noti qabel iżid il-kliem.
messages.zh: 为了先练习音符，再加上歌词。
messages.en: To practise the notes before adding the words.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象歌手先用一个元音唱完整段旋律，把注意力放在“嗓音发声”这个动作上。

gloss_zh: 自愿承担；报名做志愿者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To offer willingly to do a task or help, without being required to do so.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主动表示愿意承担任务或提供帮助，而非受到要求或强迫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Toffri minn jeddek li tagħmel xogħol jew tagħti għajnuna, mingħajr ma tkun obbligat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自愿承担任务或提供帮助；报名做志愿者。

formal.mt: Mark ivvolontarja biex jgħin fl-organizzazzjoni tal-attivitajiet għat-tfal.
formal.en: Mark volunteered to help organize the activities for children.
formal.zh: 马克自愿协助组织儿童活动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min ivvolontarja biex jgħin nhar is-Sibt? Ben: Mark ivvolontarja, u se jasal fid-disgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who volunteered to help on Saturday? Ben: Mark volunteered, and he will arrive at nine.
colloquial.zh: Lara：谁自愿星期六来帮忙？Ben：马克报名了，他会在九点到。

messages.speaker: Lara (活动协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Min ivvolontarja biex jgħin nhar is-Sibt?
messages.mt_standard: Min ivvolontarja biex jgħin nhar is-Sibt?
messages.zh: 谁自愿星期六来帮忙？
messages.en: Who volunteered to help on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Ben (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark ivvolontarja, u se jasal fid-disgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Mark ivvolontarja, u se jasal fid-disgħa.
messages.zh: 马克报名了，他会在九点到。
messages.en: Mark volunteered, and he will arrive at nine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象别人问“谁愿意帮忙”时主动举手，用“我愿意承担”来记住这个动词的核心意思。

gloss_zh: 转好；转坏；发生好坏方面的转变

teaching_sense.en_definition: To change or take a turn, becoming either better or worse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出现转变，向更好或更坏的方向发展。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tinbidel jew tieħu xejra ġdida, għall-aħjar jew għall-agħar.

sense_translations.en_definition: to turn for the better or worse
sense_translations.zh_definition: 转好或转坏；情况向好或向坏发生变化。

collocations.en: take a turn for the better
take a turn for the worse

formal.mt: Wara diversi xhur ta' diffikultajiet, il-qagħda tal-kumpanija vvoltjat għall-aħjar.
formal.en: After several months of difficulties, the company's situation took a turn for the better.
formal.zh: 经历数月的困难后，公司的状况出现了好转。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif sejra l-ħanut? Ġorġ: Il-qagħda vvoltjat għall-aħjar; din il-ġimgħa kellna aktar klijenti.
colloquial.en: Marta: How is the shop doing? Ġorġ: Things have taken a turn for the better; we had more customers this week.
colloquial.zh: Marta：店里经营得怎么样？Ġorġ：情况好转了，这周顾客更多了。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 店里经营得怎么样？
messages.en: How is the shop doing?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qagħda vvoltjat għall-aħjar; din il-ġimgħa kellna aktar klijenti.
messages.mt_standard: Il-qagħda vvoltjat għall-aħjar; din il-ġimgħa kellna aktar klijenti.
messages.zh: 情况好转了，这周顾客更多了。
messages.en: Things have taken a turn for the better; we had more customers this week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把情况想象成走到岔路口：向好是 għall-aħjar，向坏是 għall-agħar，成对记住变化方向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bring the contents of the stomach back out through the mouth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 胃里的东西经口排出，即呕吐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ mill-ħalq dak li jkun hemm fl-istonku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呕吐；将胃里的东西吐出来。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, it-tifel vvomta darbtejn matul il-lejl.
formal.en: According to the report, the boy vomited twice during the night.
formal.zh: 根据报告，男孩夜里呕吐了两次。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex telaq kmieni Mark? Lara: Ħassu ħażin u vvomta, allura mar id-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark leave early? Lara: He felt ill and vomited, so he went home.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么提前走了？拉拉：他不舒服，还吐了，所以回家了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么提前走了？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave early?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħassu ħażin u vvomta, allura mar id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Ħassu ħażin u vvomta, allura mar id-dar.
messages.zh: 他不舒服，还吐了，所以回家了。
messages.en: He felt ill and vomited, so he went home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与胃不舒服、拿起呕吐袋的画面联系起来，记住它表示实际呕吐的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express a choice formally by casting a vote in an election or on a proposal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在选举或议案表决中通过投票正式表达选择。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jesprimi l-għażla tiegħu billi jagħti vot f'elezzjoni jew dwar proposta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 投票；通过选票或其他投票方式表达选择。

collocations.en: voted in favour of the proposal

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ivvota favur il-proposta wara diskussjoni twila.
formal.en: The committee voted in favour of the proposal after a long discussion.
formal.zh: 经过长时间讨论，委员会投票支持了该提案。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark diġà vvota llum? Pawlu: Iva, mar jivvota qabel ix-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has Mark voted today already? Pawlu: Yes, he went to vote before work.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克今天已经投票了吗？保罗：是的，他上班前去投了票。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克今天已经投票了吗？
messages.en: Has Mark voted today already?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，他上班前去投了票。
messages.en: Yes, he went to vote before work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把选票投入票箱，再把支持与反对分别配上 favur 和 kontra，成组记住投票表达。

gloss_zh: 投石索；弹射器；投掷者；古代抛石机

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sling, catapult or military stone-throwing engine; also a person who throws.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于投射物体的投石索、弹射器或军用抛石机；也可指投掷者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda jew magna biex twaddab ġebel jew oġġetti oħra, jew persuna li twaddab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 投石索；借助甩动将石块等物体投出去的器具。
弹射器；利用弹力等力量将物体射出的装置。
投掷者；把物体投出或掷出去的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: mangonel (a military engine used to throw stones or other missiles)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 古代军用抛石机；用于投射石块或其他投射物的军事机械。

collocations.en: to throw a stone with a sling

formal.mt: Il-mudell fil-mużew juri waddaba medjevali li kienet tintuża biex twaddab il-ġebel.
formal.en: The model in the museum shows a medieval stone-throwing engine that was used to launch stones.
formal.zh: 博物馆里的模型展示了一种中世纪抛石机，用来投射石块。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dik x'inhi fil-vetrina? Mark: Waddaba tal-ġilda; kienu jużawha biex iwaddbu l-ġebel.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that in the display case? Mark: A leather sling; people used it to throw stones.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：展柜里那个是什么？马克：皮制投石索，以前人们用它投石头。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 展柜里那个是什么？
messages.en: What is that in the display case?

messages.speaker: Mark (博物馆讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Waddaba tal-ġilda; kienu jużawha biex iwaddbu l-ġebel.
messages.mt_standard: Waddaba tal-ġilda; kienu jużawha biex iwaddbu l-ġebel.
messages.zh: 皮制投石索，以前人们用它投石头。
messages.en: A leather sling; people used it to throw stones.

cognitive_memory_aid: 围绕投出去的画面记四个义项：手里的投石索、弹射装置、投掷的人，以及大型军用抛石机。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to throw things or an ability to throw or hurl them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有投掷东西的倾向，或具有投掷、猛掷能力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jew ħila biex iwaddab jew jitfa' oġġetti.

sense_translations.en_definition: having a tendency or ability to throw or hurl
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有投掷或猛掷倾向的；具有这种能力的。

collocations.en: a player inclined or able to throw
collocations.zh: 爱投掷或善于投掷的球员

formal.mt: Il-kowċ iddeskriva lil Mark bħala plejer waddabi, b'ħila kbira biex iwaddab il-ballun.
formal.en: The coach described Mark as a player with a strong throwing ability, highly skilled at throwing the ball.
formal.zh: 教练形容马克是一名善于投掷的球员，掷球本领很强。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-kowċ qal li Mark huwa plejer waddabi. X'ried jgħid? Pawlu: Li għandu ħila biex iwaddab il-ballun.
colloquial.en: Lara: The coach said Mark is a 'waddabi' player. What did he mean? Pawlu: That he is skilled at throwing the ball.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：教练说马克是个 waddabi 的球员，是什么意思？保罗：就是说他很会掷球。

messages.speaker: Lara (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kowċ qal li Mark huwa plejer waddabi. X'ried jgħid?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kowċ qal li Mark huwa plejer waddabi. X'ried jgħid?
messages.zh: 教练说马克是个 waddabi 的球员，是什么意思？
messages.en: The coach said Mark is a 'waddabi' player. What did he mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Li għandu ħila biex iwaddab il-ballun.
messages.mt_standard: Li għandu ħila biex iwaddab il-ballun.
messages.zh: 就是说他很会掷球。
messages.en: That he is skilled at throwing the ball.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给爱扔球或很会掷球的人贴一张形容词标签，记住它描述投掷倾向或能力，不专指某件器具。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The stopping or interruption of an activity, movement, or process.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 活动、运动或过程的停止、停顿或中止。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li attività, moviment jew proċess jieqaf jew jitwaqqaf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 停顿；中断；停工等停止状态
停止或使某项活动、行动停下的过程

formal.mt: Minħabba ħsara teknika, kien hemm waqfien temporanju fil-produzzjoni.
formal.en: A technical fault caused a temporary stoppage in production.
formal.zh: 技术故障导致生产暂时中断。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex mhux qed jaħdmu l-magni? Pawlu: Hemm waqfien temporanju; nerġgħu nibdew dalwaqt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why aren't the machines running? Pawlu: There is a temporary stoppage; we'll start again soon.
colloquial.zh: Lara：机器怎么没在运转？Pawlu：暂时停了一下，我们很快就重新开工。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 机器怎么没在运转？
messages.en: Why aren't the machines running?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (操作员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm waqfien temporanju; nerġgħu nibdew dalwaqt.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm waqfien temporanju; nerġgħu nibdew dalwaqt.
messages.zh: 暂时停了一下，我们很快就重新开工。
messages.en: There is a temporary stoppage; we'll start again soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象生产线上的暂停按钮：按下之后出现的“停止、停顿”就是这个名词所表达的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instance of falling, used literally for a physical fall and figuratively for yielding to temptation or returning to old habits.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次身体上的跌倒或物体的坠落，也可比喻抵挡不住诱惑而失足，或重新染上旧习。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Darba li fiha xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa taqa'; tintuża wkoll għal ċediment għat-tentazzjoni jew ritorn għal drawwiet qodma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次跌倒、跌落或坠落
向诱惑屈服；因抵挡不住诱惑而失足
旧习复发；重新染上过去的习惯

collocations.zh: 向诱惑屈服；因诱惑而失足

formal.mt: Wara waqgħa mit-taraġ, il-pazjent ġie eżaminat fl-isptar.
formal.en: After a fall down the stairs, the patient was examined at the hospital.
formal.zh: 患者从楼梯上跌落后，在医院接受了检查。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'ġara minn irkopptek? David: Kelli waqgħa waqt li kont niġri, imma issa nħossni aħjar.
colloquial.en: Nina: What happened to your knee? David: I had a fall while running, but I feel better now.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你的膝盖怎么了？David：跑步时摔了一跤，不过现在感觉好些了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的膝盖怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to your knee?

messages.speaker: David (跑步者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kelli waqgħa waqt li kont niġri, imma issa nħossni aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Kelli waqgħa waqt li kont niġri, imma issa nħossni aħjar.
messages.zh: 跑步时摔了一跤，不过现在感觉好些了。
messages.en: I had a fall while running, but I feel better now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个“跌回去”的画面串记：身体跌倒、面对诱惑失足、又跌回旧习；这是帮助区分词义的学习联想。

gloss_zh: 使掉落；使跌倒；引诱失足；拆毁

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause something to fall or drop; also to lead someone into temptation or demolish a structure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物掉落或使人跌倒；也可表示引人陷入诱惑，或拆毁建筑物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa taqa'; ukoll iwassal lil xi ħadd għat-tentazzjoni jew iġarraf bini.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使物体从手中或原处掉落；掉下
使某物倒下或落下
引诱某人；使某人陷入诱惑而失足
拆毁；拆除建筑物或构筑物

collocations.en: he led his friend into temptation

formal.mt: Il-kuntrattur waqqa' l-bini l-qadim wara li kiseb il-permess meħtieġ.
formal.en: The contractor demolished the old building after obtaining the required permit.
formal.zh: 承包商取得所需许可后，拆除了旧建筑。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex hemm ilma mal-art? Mark: It-tifel waqqa' t-tazza bi żball; se nimsaħ l-ilma issa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is there water on the floor? Mark: The boy accidentally dropped the cup; I'll wipe up the water now.
colloquial.zh: Sara：地上怎么有水？Mark：孩子不小心把杯子弄掉了，我现在就把水擦干。

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.zh: 地上怎么有水？
messages.en: Why is there water on the floor?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tifel waqqa' t-tazza bi żball; se nimsaħ l-ilma issa.
messages.mt_standard: It-tifel waqqa' t-tazza bi żball; se nimsaħ l-ilma issa.
messages.zh: 孩子不小心把杯子弄掉了，我现在就把水擦干。
messages.en: The boy accidentally dropped the cup; I'll wipe up the water now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“使……落下”的动作画面：杯子掉落、墙被拆倒，再联想到把人引向诱惑；词尾撇号也要一并记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An upright structural piece that supports or holds something in position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 直立放置、用于承托或固定其他物体的支撑构件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa wieqfa li sservi biex iġġorr jew iżżomm xi ħaġa f'postha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 直立支撑件；竖向承托或固定物体的支柱

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa installa waqqafa tal-injam biex iżomm l-ixkaffa f'postha.
formal.en: The carpenter installed a wooden upright support to hold the shelf in position.
formal.zh: 木匠安装了一根木制直立支撑件，用来固定搁板。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex l-ixkaffa qed tiċċaqlaq? Toni: Il-waqqafa mhix imwaħħla sew; se nwaħħalha aħjar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the shelf moving? Toni: The upright support isn't secured properly; I'll secure it better.
colloquial.zh: Lara：搁板怎么在晃？Toni：直立支撑件没固定好，我来把它固定牢。

messages.speaker: Lara (住户)
messages.zh: 搁板怎么在晃？
messages.en: Why is the shelf moving?

messages.speaker: Toni (木匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-waqqafa mhix imwaħħla sew; se nwaħħalha aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Il-waqqafa mhix imwaħħla sew; se nwaħħalha aħjar.
messages.zh: 直立支撑件没固定好，我来把它固定牢。
messages.en: The upright support isn't secured properly; I'll secure it better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象搁板下面竖着一根支柱，用“站直并撑住东西”的图像记住它是具体的支撑构件名词。

gloss_zh: 有使停止作用的；起中止作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an effect that brings an action, movement, or process to a halt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使某种行动、运动或过程停止下来的作用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-effett li jwaqqaf azzjoni, moviment jew proċess.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the effect of halting sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有使某事停止或中止的作用的

collocations.en: a signal that brings something to a halt

formal.mt: Is-sinjal għandu effett waqqafi fuq il-moviment tal-magna: meta jidher, il-magna tieqaf.
formal.en: The signal has a halting effect on the machine's movement: when it appears, the machine stops.
formal.zh: 该信号具有使机器运动停止的作用：信号一出现，机器就停下来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jiġri meta jidher dan is-sinjal? Pawlu: Għandu effett waqqafi: il-magna tieqaf minnufih.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happens when this signal appears? Pawlu: It has a halting effect: the machine stops immediately.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个信号出现时会怎样？Pawlu：它起停止作用，机器会立即停下来。

messages.speaker: Maja (学徒)
messages.zh: 这个信号出现时会怎样？
messages.en: What happens when this signal appears?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu effett waqqafi: il-magna tieqaf minnufih.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu effett waqqafi: il-magna tieqaf minnufih.
messages.zh: 它起停止作用，机器会立即停下来。
messages.en: It has a halting effect: the machine stops immediately.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它贴在“作用”旁边来记：某个信号一出现，运动便停止；这个形容词强调使事情停下来的效果。

gloss_zh: 确定时间；安排日程；安排时间的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To determine or appoint a time for an event or activity and place it on a schedule.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为事件或活动确定、指定时间，或将其排入日程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħżel jew jistabbilixxi ħin għal avveniment jew attività u jdaħħalha fi skeda.

sense_translations.en_definition: to identify a time for sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为某事确定一个时间
指定或约定时间
安排日程；将某事排定在特定时间
安排日程的人；排程人员

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who appoints a time for sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为某事指定或约定时间的人

formal.mt: Is-segretarju waqqat il-laqgħa għal nhar it-Tnejn fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The secretary scheduled the meeting for Monday at nine in the morning.
formal.zh: 秘书将会议安排在星期一上午九点。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għal xħin waqqat l-intervista Mark? Lara: Għall-għaxra ta' għada filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Sara: What time did Mark schedule the interview for? Lara: For ten tomorrow morning.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Mark把面试安排在几点？Lara：明天上午十点。

messages.speaker: Sara (求职者)
messages.zh: Mark把面试安排在几点？
messages.en: What time did Mark schedule the interview for?

messages.speaker: Lara (招聘助理)
messages.zh: 明天上午十点。
messages.en: For ten tomorrow morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人把面试写进日历：作动词时是“定时间、排日程”，作名词时则指做这项安排的人，要分别记忆词性。

gloss_zh: 安排日程的；指定时间的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Concerned with scheduling events or appointing times for activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于描述安排活动日程、确定或指定活动时间的工作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinvolvi t-tfassil ta' skeda jew l-għażla ta' ħinijiet għal attivitajiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安排日程的；进行排程的
指定或约定时间的

formal.mt: Il-proċess waqqati jinkludi l-għażla ta' ħin għal kull intervista u l-konferma tad-disponibbiltà tal-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The scheduling process includes choosing a time for each interview and confirming the participants' availability.
formal.zh: 日程安排过程包括为每场面试选择时间，并确认参与者届时是否有空。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser xogħol waqqati hawn? Mark: Li tagħżel ħin għal kull laqgħa u tiċċekkja min jista' jattendi.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does scheduling work mean here? Mark: Choosing a time for each meeting and checking who can attend.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这里说的日程安排工作是什么意思？Mark：就是为每场会议选时间，再确认谁能参加。

messages.speaker: Nina (新同事)
messages.zh: 这里说的日程安排工作是什么意思？
messages.en: What does scheduling work mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (行政同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Li tagħżel ħin għal kull laqgħa u tiċċekkja min jista' jattendi.
messages.mt_standard: Li tagħżel ħin għal kull laqgħa u tiċċekkja min jista' jattendi.
messages.zh: 就是为每场会议选时间，再确认谁能参加。
messages.en: Choosing a time for each meeting and checking who can attend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个形容词放在“工作、过程”前理解：内容是在日历上为活动选时间，因此记成“安排日程的、指定时间的”。

gloss_zh: 使东西掉落的人；常把东西弄掉的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who drops something, especially someone who often lets objects fall.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物弄掉的人，尤指经常使手中物品掉落的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li twaqqa' xi ħaġa, speċjalment waħda li spiss twaqqa' l-oġġetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物掉落的人；把东西弄掉的人。

formal.mt: Fit-test, il-kelma waqqiegħ tirreferi għal persuna li twaqqa' l-oġġetti li tkun qed iġġorr.
formal.en: In the text, the word waqqiegħ refers to a person who drops the objects they are carrying.
formal.zh: 在这篇文字中，waqqiegħ 指把所拿物品弄掉的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Erġajt waqqajt tazza? Illum int waqqiegħ tat-tazzi! Mark: Iva, żelqitli minn idi. Se nġorr waħda kull darba.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you drop another cup? You're a cup-dropper today! Mark: Yes, it slipped out of my hand. I'll carry one at a time.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你又把杯子弄掉了？你今天成了专门掉杯子的人！Mark：是啊，它从我手里滑出去了。我接下来一次只拿一个。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Erġajt waqqajt tazza? Illum int waqqiegħ tat-tazzi!
messages.mt_standard: Erġajt waqqajt tazza? Illum int waqqiegħ tat-tazzi!
messages.zh: 你又把杯子弄掉了？你今天成了专门掉杯子的人！
messages.en: Did you drop another cup? You're a cup-dropper today!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żelqitli minn idi. Se nġorr waħda kull darba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żelqitli minn idi. Se nġorr waħda kull darba.
messages.zh: 是啊，它从我手里滑出去了。我接下来一次只拿一个。
messages.en: Yes, it slipped out of my hand. I'll carry one at a time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友拿杯子时总是失手，让杯子掉到地上；把 waqqiegħ 记成画面中那个弄掉东西的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Likely to fall; also used of trees that shed their leaves seasonally.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容容易倒下或掉落；也用于描述会随季节落叶的树木。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jaqa'; jingħad ukoll għal siġar li jwaqqgħu l-weraq tagħhom skont l-istaġun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易倒下的；有掉落倾向的。
落叶性的；用于指随季节脱落叶子的树木。

formal.mt: Fil-glossarju, waqqiegħi jiddeskrivi kemm ħajt li għandu tendenza jaqa' kif ukoll tip ta' siġar li jwaqqgħu l-weraq skont l-istaġun.
formal.en: In the glossary, waqqiegħi describes both a wall liable to fall and a type of tree that sheds its leaves seasonally.
formal.zh: 在词汇表中，waqqiegħi 既可形容容易倒塌的墙，也可形容随季节落叶的一类树木。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser waqqiegħi hawn? Qed naqra dwar is-siġar. Mark: Hawn ifisser li jwaqqgħu l-weraq skont l-istaġun. F'kuntest ieħor jista' jfisser li xi ħaġa għandha tendenza taqa'.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does waqqiegħi mean here? I'm reading about trees. Mark: Here it means they shed their leaves seasonally. In another context, it can mean that something is liable to fall.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的 waqqiegħi 是什么意思？我正在读有关树木的内容。Mark：这里指树木随季节落叶。在其他语境中，它也可以表示某物容易倒下或掉落。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser waqqiegħi hawn? Qed naqra dwar is-siġar.
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser waqqiegħi hawn? Qed naqra dwar is-siġar.
messages.zh: 这里的 waqqiegħi 是什么意思？我正在读有关树木的内容。
messages.en: What does waqqiegħi mean here? I'm reading about trees.

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ifisser li jwaqqgħu l-weraq skont l-istaġun. F'kuntest ieħor jista' jfisser li xi ħaġa għandha tendenza taqa'.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ifisser li jwaqqgħu l-weraq skont l-istaġun. F'kuntest ieħor jista' jfisser li xi ħaġa għandha tendenza taqa'.
messages.zh: 这里指树木随季节落叶。在其他语境中，它也可以表示某物容易倒下或掉落。
messages.en: Here it means they shed their leaves seasonally. In another context, it can mean that something is liable to fall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张画面记两个义项：一面摇摇欲倒的墙，一棵随季节落叶的树；看到 waqqiegħi 时先看它修饰什么。

gloss_zh: 话多的人；发出鸦叫或喳喳声的鸟

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who talks a lot, or a bird that makes cawing or yacking calls.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指说话很多的人，也可指发出鸦叫或喳喳叫声的鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titkellem ħafna, jew għasfur li jagħmel ħsejjes bħal dawk ta' ċawla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 话多的人；爱说个不停的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: a bird that caws or yacks
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出鸦叫或喳喳叫声的鸟。

collocations.en: a chatterbox who talks without stopping
a cawing bird on a branch
collocations.zh: 树枝上发出鸦叫声的鸟

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, in-narratur isejjaħ lill-ġar tiegħu waqwieq għax jibqa' jitkellem anki meta l-oħrajn jixtiequ jwieġbu.
formal.en: In the story, the narrator calls his neighbour a chatterbox because he keeps talking even when others want to respond.
formal.zh: 在故事中，叙述者称邻居为话痨，因为即使别人想回应，他仍然说个不停。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu ilu jitkellem minn meta wasal. Ma waqafx minuta! Mark: Dak waqwieq! Ejja nistennew ftit u mbagħad ngħidu tagħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu has been talking since he arrived. He hasn't stopped for a minute! Mark: He's a chatterbox! Let's wait a little and then have our say.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 从来到这里就一直在说，一分钟都没停！Mark：他可真是个话痨！我们稍等一下，然后也说说自己的想法。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu ilu jitkellem minn meta wasal. Ma waqafx minuta!
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu ilu jitkellem minn meta wasal. Ma waqafx minuta!
messages.zh: Pawlu 从来到这里就一直在说，一分钟都没停！
messages.en: Pawlu has been talking since he arrived. He hasn't stopped for a minute!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak waqwieq! Ejja nistennew ftit u mbagħad ngħidu tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Dak waqwieq! Ejja nistennew ftit u mbagħad ngħidu tagħna.
messages.zh: 他可真是个话痨！我们稍等一下，然后也说说自己的想法。
messages.en: He's a chatterbox! Let's wait a little and then have our say.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一边是说个不停的人，一边是喳喳叫的鸟；用这幅双画面记住 waqwieq 的两个名词义项。

gloss_zh: 健谈的；爱发出鸦叫或喳喳声的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Talkative when describing a person; inclined to caw or yack when describing a bird.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人话多、爱说话；形容鸟时，表示爱发出鸦叫或喳喳声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitkellem ħafna meta jingħad għal persuna; li għandu tendenza jagħmel ħsejjes bħal dawk ta' ċawla meta jingħad għal għasfur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 话多的；爱说话的；健谈的。

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to caw or yack (like a crow, rook, etc)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱发出鸦叫或喳喳声的，如乌鸦、秃鼻乌鸦等鸟的叫声。

collocations.en: a bird inclined to caw or yack
collocations.zh: 一只爱发出鸦叫或喳喳声的鸟

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi lill-karattru bħala raġel waqwieqi li jsib suġġett ġdid għal kull konversazzjoni.
formal.en: The author describes the character as a talkative man who finds a new topic for every conversation.
formal.zh: 作者把这个人物描写成一个健谈的男人，每次交谈都能找到新话题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħuk dejjem jitkellem daqshekk? Għandu ħafna stejjer! Mark: Iva, huwa waqwieqi ħafna. Miegħu dejjem insibu xi ħaġa fuqiex nitkellmu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does your brother always talk this much? He has so many stories! Mark: Yes, he's very talkative. With him, we always find something to talk about.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你哥哥总是这么爱说话吗？他的故事可真多！Mark：是啊，他很健谈。和他在一起，我们总能找到话题。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħuk dejjem jitkellem daqshekk? Għandu ħafna stejjer!
messages.mt_standard: Ħuk dejjem jitkellem daqshekk? Għandu ħafna stejjer!
messages.zh: 你哥哥总是这么爱说话吗？他的故事可真多！
messages.en: Does your brother always talk this much? He has so many stories!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa waqwieqi ħafna. Miegħu dejjem insibu xi ħaġa fuqiex nitkellmu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa waqwieqi ħafna. Miegħu dejjem insibu xi ħaġa fuqiex nitkellmu.
messages.zh: 是啊，他很健谈。和他在一起，我们总能找到话题。
messages.en: Yes, he's very talkative. With him, we always find something to talk about.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 waqwieqi 放进“这个人很爱说话”和“这只鸟很爱叫”两个句框，记住它是描述特征的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used with a year to indicate a date in the AD calendar era.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与年份连用，表示该年份属于公元纪年，对应英语 AD。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża ma' sena biex tindika data fl-era wara Kristu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公元；公元后，用于标示年份。

formal.mt: Skont il-kronoloġija tal-eżerċizzju, il-ġrajja seħħet fis-sena 500 wara Kristu.
formal.en: According to the exercise's chronology, the event took place in AD 500.
formal.zh: 根据练习中的时间线，该事件发生在公元500年。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawn miktub 500 wara Kristu. Jiġifieri AD 500 bl-Ingliż? Mark: Iva, eżatt. Wara Kristu jindika l-era tad-data.
colloquial.en: Maja: It says 500 wara Kristu here. Does that mean AD 500 in English? Mark: Yes, exactly. Wara Kristu indicates the calendar era of the date.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里写着 500 wara Kristu。英语里就是 AD 500 吗？Mark：对，正是这个意思。Wara Kristu 标明这个日期使用的纪年。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn miktub 500 wara Kristu. Jiġifieri AD 500 bl-Ingliż?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub 500 wara Kristu. Jiġifieri AD 500 bl-Ingliż?
messages.zh: 这里写着 500 wara Kristu。英语里就是 AD 500 吗？
messages.en: It says 500 wara Kristu here. Does that mean AD 500 in English?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, eżatt. Wara Kristu jindika l-era tad-data.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, eżatt. Wara Kristu jindika l-era tad-data.
messages.zh: 对，正是这个意思。Wara Kristu 标明这个日期使用的纪年。
messages.en: Yes, exactly. Wara Kristu indicates the calendar era of the date.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“500 wara Kristu—AD 500—公元500年”作为整组记忆，再替换年份练习，注意马耳他语表达放在年份后面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a backward direction, towards the rear rather than forwards.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示朝后方移动，或倒着进行某个动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fid-direzzjoni ta' wara, bħal meta wieħed jimxi jew jagħmel pass lura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向后；倒着。

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżerċizzju, il-parteċipant għandu jagħmel żewġ passi waranijiet u mbagħad jieqaf.
formal.en: During the exercise, the participant should take two steps backwards and then stop.
formal.zh: 练习时，参与者应向后退两步，然后停下。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi nidħol fir-ritratt? Fejn noqgħod? Mark: Iva, agħmel pass waranijiet. Issa nista' narak sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall I get into the photo? Where should I stand? Mark: Yes, take a step backwards. Now I can see you properly.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我要一起入镜吗？我站在哪里？Mark：对，向后退一步。现在我能把你拍清楚了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要一起入镜吗？我站在哪里？
messages.en: Shall I get into the photo? Where should I stand?

messages.speaker: Mark (拍照的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, agħmel pass waranijiet. Issa nista' narak sew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, agħmel pass waranijiet. Issa nista' narak sew.
messages.zh: 对，向后退一步。现在我能把你拍清楚了。
messages.en: Yes, take a step backwards. Now I can see you properly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拍照时朋友示意你后退一步，边做动作边念 pass waranijiet，把这个副词与向后的方向联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Garden balsam or balsamine, the plant species Impatiens balsamina.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 凤仙花，学名 Impatiens balsamina；英语称 garden balsam 或 balsamine。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pjanta tal-ispeċi Impatiens balsamina, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala garden balsam jew balsamine.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凤仙花，学名 Impatiens balsamina，英语亦称 garden balsam 或 balsamine。

formal.mt: It-tikketta fil-ġnien tagħti l-isem ward il-hena flimkien mal-isem xjentifiku Impatiens balsamina.
formal.en: The label in the garden gives the name ward il-hena alongside the scientific name Impatiens balsamina.
formal.zh: 花园中的标签同时标出了名称 ward il-hena 和学名 Impatiens balsamina。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha din il-pjanta? It-tikketta mhix ċara. Mark: Dan ward il-hena. Bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ garden balsam.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's this plant called? The label isn't clear. Mark: This is ward il-hena. In English, it's called garden balsam.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这种植物叫什么？标签看不清。Mark：这是凤仙花，马耳他语叫 ward il-hena，英语叫 garden balsam。

messages.speaker: Maja (花园游客)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jisimha din il-pjanta? It-tikketta mhix ċara.
messages.mt_standard: X'jisimha din il-pjanta? It-tikketta mhix ċara.
messages.zh: 这种植物叫什么？标签看不清。
messages.en: What's this plant called? The label isn't clear.

messages.speaker: Mark (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ward il-hena. Bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ garden balsam.
messages.mt_standard: Dan ward il-hena. Bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ garden balsam.
messages.zh: 这是凤仙花，马耳他语叫 ward il-hena，英语叫 garden balsam。
messages.en: This is ward il-hena. In English, it's called garden balsam.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象凤仙花旁有一张三语标签：ward il-hena、garden balsam、凤仙花；把整个短语当作一个植物名称来记。

gloss_zh: 无忧无虑的幸福；一帆风顺的生活

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of happiness without worries or difficulties; an easy and pleasant situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有烦恼或困难的幸福状态；轻松愉快、一帆风顺的处境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' ferħ bla nkwiet jew diffikultajiet; sitwazzjoni faċli u pjaċevoli.

sense_translations.en_definition: unclouded happiness; a bed of roses
sense_translations.zh_definition: 毫无忧愁的幸福；舒适顺遂、没有困难的生活。

collocations.en: not everything is a bed of roses
a life that is a bed of roses
collocations.zh: 无忧无虑、顺遂幸福的生活

formal.mt: Il-ħajja flimkien mhix dejjem ward u żahar; teħtieġ paċenzja u rispett.
formal.en: Life together is not always a bed of roses; it requires patience and respect.
formal.zh: 共同生活并非总是一帆风顺；它需要耐心和尊重。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejjer fix-xogħol il-ġdid? Mark: Mhux kollox ward u żahar, imma qed nitgħallem ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is your new job going? Mark: It's not all a bed of roses, but I'm learning a lot.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新工作怎么样？马克：并非事事顺利，不过我学到了很多。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 新工作怎么样？
messages.en: How is your new job going?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux kollox ward u żahar, imma qed nitgħallem ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux kollox ward u żahar, imma qed nitgħallem ħafna.
messages.zh: 并非事事顺利，不过我学到了很多。
messages.en: It's not all a bed of roses, but I'm learning a lot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语想成一条没有障碍的幸福小路；连同常见的否定句一起记：生活并非总是一帆风顺。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rose, especially an individual rose flower.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 玫瑰，尤其指单独的一朵玫瑰花。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fjura tal-ward, meqjusa bħala fjura waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 玫瑰；玫瑰花。

formal.mt: Fuq il-mejda tqiegħed vażun żgħir b'warda ħamra waħda bħala dekorazzjoni.
formal.en: A small vase containing a single red rose was placed on the table as a decoration.
formal.zh: 桌上摆放了一个小花瓶，里面插着一朵红玫瑰作为装饰。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nixtieq warda ħamra, jekk jogħġbok. Għandek waħda friska? Mark: Iva, din għadha kemm waslet. Tridni ngeżwirhielek?
colloquial.en: Maja: I'd like a red rose, please. Do you have a fresh one? Mark: Yes, this one has just arrived. Would you like me to wrap it for you?
colloquial.zh: Maja：请给我一朵红玫瑰。有新鲜的吗？Mark：有，这朵刚到。需要我帮你包起来吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq warda ħamra, jekk jogħġbok. Għandek waħda friska?
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq warda ħamra, jekk jogħġbok. Għandek waħda friska?
messages.zh: 请给我一朵红玫瑰。有新鲜的吗？
messages.en: I'd like a red rose, please. Do you have a fresh one?

messages.speaker: Mark (花店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, din għadha kemm waslet. Tridni ngeżwirhielek?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, din għadha kemm waslet. Tridni ngeżwirhielek?
messages.zh: 有，这朵刚到。需要我帮你包起来吗？
messages.en: Yes, this one has just arrived. Would you like me to wrap it for you?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手里拿着一朵红玫瑰，完整地说 warda ħamra；把单独一朵花的画面和 warda 绑定记忆。

gloss_zh: 小石块；另一个较次要的职位

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small stone; also, another post of lesser importance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一块小石头；也可指另一个重要性较低的职位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġebla żgħira; ukoll kariga oħra ta' inqas importanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小石块；另一个（较不重要的）职位。

collocations.en: a small stone on the path

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem neħħa warraba mill-mogħdija biex ħadd ma jitfixkel.
formal.en: The worker removed a small stone from the path so that nobody would trip.
formal.zh: 工人移走了小路上的一块小石头，以免有人绊倒。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Attent, hemm warraba ħdejn saqajk. Rita: Rajtha, se nneħħiha.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Careful, there's a small stone by your feet. Rita: I've seen it; I'll remove it.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：小心，你脚边有块小石头。丽塔：我看见了，我来把它拿走。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工友)
messages.zh: 小心，你脚边有块小石头。
messages.en: Careful, there's a small stone by your feet.

messages.speaker: Rita (工友)
messages.zh: 我看见了，我来把它拿走。
messages.en: I've seen it; I'll remove it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张独立情境卡记忆：一张画路上的小石块，另一张写较次要的职位；根据句子语境选择意思。

gloss_zh: 倾向移除、搁置或排除的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to remove things, set them aside, or exclude people or things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于移除事物、将其搁置，或把人或事物排除在外的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jneħħi l-affarijiet, iwarrabhom jew iħalli nies jew affarijiet barra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于移除或清除的。
倾向于搁置或放到一旁的。
倾向于排除或排斥的。

collocations.en: a method tending to remove or set things aside
collocations.zh: 倾向移除或搁置事物的方法

formal.mt: Atteġġjament warrabi jista' jħalli xi membri tal-grupp mingħajr opportunità li jitkellmu.
formal.en: An exclusionary attitude can leave some group members without an opportunity to speak.
formal.zh: 排斥他人的态度可能使部分小组成员没有发言机会。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma stidintux ukoll? Toni: Kelli atteġġjament warrabi; se nistiednu issa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why didn't you invite him too? Toni: I was being exclusionary; I'll invite him now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么没有也邀请他？托尼：我刚才有点排斥他；我现在就邀请他。

messages.speaker: Lara (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 你为什么没有也邀请他？
messages.en: Why didn't you invite him too?

messages.speaker: Toni (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kelli atteġġjament warrabi; se nistiednu issa.
messages.mt_standard: Kelli atteġġjament warrabi; se nistiednu issa.
messages.zh: 我刚才有点排斥他；我现在就邀请他。
messages.en: I was being exclusionary; I'll invite him now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只总把东西推开的手：移走、搁置、排除，三个义项都用“推到一边”的画面帮助记忆。

gloss_zh: 开花；花商；供花卉生长的土壤

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce or open flowers; to come into bloom.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长出或绽放花朵，进入开花状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ jew jiftaħ il-fjuri; jidħol fi żmien il-fjoritura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开花；长出花朵。
开花；花朵绽放。
花商；经营花卉生意的人。
供花卉生长的土壤。

formal.mt: Il-lewż warrad fir-rebbiegħa, u l-ġnien imtela bil-fjuri.
formal.en: The almond tree blossomed in spring, and the garden filled with flowers.
formal.zh: 杏树在春天开花，花园里开满了花朵。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-lewż diġà warrad? Nannu: Iva, ejja ara kemm għandu fjuri.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the almond tree blossomed already? Grandfather: Yes, come and see how many flowers it has.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：杏树已经开花了吗？爷爷：是啊，来看看它开了多少花。

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.zh: 杏树已经开花了吗？
messages.en: Has the almond tree blossomed already?

messages.speaker: Nannu (爷爷)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja ara kemm għandu fjuri.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja ara kemm għandu fjuri.
messages.zh: 是啊，来看看它开了多少花。
messages.en: Yes, come and see how many flowers it has.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记花朵打开的动作对应动词“开花”；再为两个名词义分别画卖花的人和长花的土，避免混淆词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having conditions that allow flowers to grow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具备让花卉能够生长的条件的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu kundizzjonijiet li jippermettu lill-fjuri jikbru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能让花卉生长的；适合花卉生长的。

collocations.en: an environment that allows flowers to grow

formal.mt: Għall-proġett tal-ġnien, intgħażel terren warradi fejn il-fjuri jistgħu jikbru.
formal.en: For the garden project, land suitable for flowers was selected where the flowers can grow.
formal.zh: 花园项目选用了一块适合花卉生长的土地，让花卉能够在此生长。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dan it-terren warradi? Pawlu: Iva, il-fjuri jikbru tajjeb hawn.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is this land suitable for growing flowers? Pawlu: Yes, flowers grow well here.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这块地适合种花吗？保罗：适合，花在这里长得很好。

messages.speaker: Rita (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 这块地适合种花吗？
messages.en: Is this land suitable for growing flowers?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园丁)
messages.zh: 适合，花在这里长得很好。
messages.en: Yes, flowers grow well here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个形容词记成土地旁的“适宜种花”标签：它说明生长条件合适，不表示花已经开放。

gloss_zh: 向后的；后部的；后部；臀部

teaching_sense.en_definition: Directed towards the back or situated at the rear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 朝向后方的，或位于后部的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħares lejn wara jew li jinsab fuq in-naħa ta' wara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 朝后的；向后方的。
后部的；位于后方的。
后部；身体后侧部位。
臀部；屁股。

formal.mt: Il-passiġġieri għandhom jużaw il-bieb warrani biex jinżlu mix-xarabank.
formal.en: Passengers should use the rear door to get off the bus.
formal.zh: 乘客应使用后门下车。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn inpoġġi l-basket? Lara: Fuq is-sedil warrani, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where should I put the bag? Lara: On the rear seat, please.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我把包放在哪里？拉拉：请放在后座上。

messages.speaker: Mark (乘客)
messages.zh: 我把包放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put the bag?

messages.speaker: Lara (司机)
messages.zh: 请放在后座上。
messages.en: On the rear seat, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一辆车的后门和后座，先固定“后方”的位置；作名词时再联想到身体后部或臀部。

gloss_zh: 容纳得下；使能放入；宽的；宽阔的

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have enough room to contain something or allow it to fit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有足够的空间容纳某物，或使某物能够放入。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu biżżejjed spazju biex iżomm xi ħaġa jew biex xi ħaġa tidħol fih.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be wide enough to contain
sense_translations.zh_definition: 足够宽敞而能容纳；容纳得下。
使能放入；让某物有足够空间容身或放置。
宽的；宽敞的。
宽阔的；宽广的。

formal.mt: Il-bagoll wasa' tliet bagalji u żewġ basktijiet.
formal.en: The car boot held three suitcases and two bags.
formal.zh: 汽车后备箱容纳了三个行李箱和两个包。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-basket wasa' l-kotba kollha? Mark: Iva, u baqa' spazju għal flixkun ilma wkoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the bag hold all the books? Mark: Yes, and there was room left for a bottle of water too.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：包里装得下所有书吗？马克：装得下，而且还剩地方放一瓶水。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 包里装得下所有书吗？
messages.en: Did the bag hold all the books?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u baqa' spazju għal flixkun ilma wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u baqa' spazju għal flixkun ilma wkoll.
messages.zh: 装得下，而且还剩地方放一瓶水。
messages.en: Yes, and there was room left for a bottle of water too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见一个装得下所有书的包，就记“容纳得下”；再用宽阔空间的画面记形容词义，并留意这里写一个 s。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something larger, wider, or broader in extent or scope.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物的大小、宽度、范围或内容增加。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa akbar jew usa', jew iżid il-firxa tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扩大；扩展大小或范围。
加宽；使宽度增加。
拓宽；使范围、见识或内容更加广泛。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill wassa' l-bankina biex il-pedestrians ikollhom aktar spazju.
formal.en: The council widened the pavement so that pedestrians would have more space.
formal.zh: 地方议会加宽了人行道，让行人有更多空间。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-mastrudaxxa wassa' l-bieb? Pawlu: Iva, issa s-siġġu tar-roti jgħaddi faċilment.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did the carpenter widen the doorway? Pawlu: Yes, the wheelchair can now pass through easily.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：木匠把门口加宽了吗？保罗：加宽了，现在轮椅可以轻松通过。

messages.speaker: Rita (住户)
messages.zh: 木匠把门口加宽了吗？
messages.en: Did the carpenter widen the doorway?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa s-siġġu tar-roti jgħaddi faċilment.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa s-siġġu tar-roti jgħaddi faċilment.
messages.zh: 加宽了，现在轮椅可以轻松通过。
messages.en: Yes, the wheelchair can now pass through easily.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把双写 ss 想成两只手向两边推开门框，提醒自己记“使它变宽”；这只是拼写联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 有助于抵达的；使人能够到达的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Helping someone or something reach a destination; making arrival possible.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 帮助人或事物抵达目的地的，或使到达成为可能的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jgħin lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa jaslu fid-destinazzjoni tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人或事物能够抵达的；有助于到达的。

collocations.zh: 帮助抵达的方式或工具

collocations.en: a service that helps people reach their destination
collocations.zh: 帮助人们抵达目的地的服务

formal.mt: It-trasport organizzat mill-iskola huwa mezz wassali għall-istudenti li joqogħdu 'l bogħod.
formal.en: The transport organized by the school is a means of enabling students who live far away to arrive.
formal.zh: 学校安排的交通是帮助住得较远的学生到校的方式。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'mezz wassali'? Mark: Mezz li jgħinek tasal, bħal xarabank li twasslek l-iskola.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'mezz wassali' mean? Mark: A means that helps you arrive, like a bus that takes you to school.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：mezz wassali是什么意思？马克：就是帮助你抵达的方式或工具，比如送你到学校的公交车。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: mezz wassali是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'mezz wassali' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mezz li jgħinek tasal, bħal xarabank li twasslek l-iskola.
messages.mt_standard: Mezz li jgħinek tasal, bħal xarabank li twasslek l-iskola.
messages.zh: 就是帮助你抵达的方式或工具，比如送你到学校的公交车。
messages.en: A means that helps you arrive, like a bus that takes you to school.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一辆帮助学生到校的公交车，给它贴上wassali标签；记住这个形容词强调“使抵达成为可能”。

gloss_zh: 使居于中心；赋予核心地位

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone or something a central place or role.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人或某事物居于中心位置，或在安排、讨论等方面获得核心地位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa post jew rwol ċentrali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使居于中心；给予核心位置或中心地位。

collocations.en: gave students' needs a central place
collocations.zh: 将学生的需求置于核心位置

collocations.en: gave the discussion a central role

formal.mt: Il-pjan il-ġdid wassat il-ħtiġijiet tal-istudenti fit-tfassil tal-lezzjonijiet.
formal.en: The new plan gave students' needs a central place in lesson planning.
formal.zh: 新计划在课程设计中将学生的需求置于核心位置。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser li l-pjan 'wassat il-ħtiġijiet tagħna'? Mark: Ifisser li tahom post ċentrali fid-deċiżjonijiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does it mean that the plan 'gave our needs centrality'? Mark: It means it gave them a central place in the decisions.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：说计划“把我们的需求放在中心”是什么意思？马克：意思是让我们的需求在决策中占据核心位置。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser li l-pjan 'wassat il-ħtiġijiet tagħna'?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser li l-pjan 'wassat il-ħtiġijiet tagħna'?
messages.zh: 说计划“把我们的需求放在中心”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean that the plan 'gave our needs centrality'?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li tahom post ċentrali fid-deċiżjonijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li tahom post ċentrali fid-deċiżjonijiet.
messages.zh: 意思是让我们的需求在决策中占据核心位置。
messages.en: It means it gave them a central place in the decisions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个圆，把“学生需求”放进圆心，用wassat标注这个动作，记住它表示“赋予中心地位”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes something broader or wider.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变宽或使其范围扩大的那个人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel xi ħaġa usa' jew li tkabbar il-firxa tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拓宽或扩展某物的人。

collocations.en: a person who widens the road
a person who widens the path

formal.mt: Il-wassiegħ tat-triq ħadem biex jagħmel aktar spazju għall-vetturi.
formal.en: The person widening the road worked to create more space for vehicles.
formal.zh: 拓宽道路的人进行施工，为车辆腾出更多空间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħdejn il-mogħdija? Mark: Hu l-wassiegħ tal-mogħdija; qed jagħmilha usa'.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that man beside the path? Mark: He is the person widening the path; he is making it wider.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：小路旁边那个男人是谁？马克：他是拓宽小路的人，正在把路弄宽。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħdejn il-mogħdija?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħdejn il-mogħdija?
messages.zh: 小路旁边那个男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that man beside the path?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu l-wassiegħ tal-mogħdija; qed jagħmilha usa'.
messages.mt_standard: Hu l-wassiegħ tal-mogħdija; qed jagħmilha usa'.
messages.zh: 他是拓宽小路的人，正在把路弄宽。
messages.en: He is the person widening the path; he is making it wider.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把wassiegħ和“拓宽道路的人”一起记忆：画面中要有人正在干活，因为这个名词指实施拓宽的人。

gloss_zh: 有扩大作用的；有拓宽效果的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an effect that makes something larger, wider, or broader in scope.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使某物变大、变宽或使其范围扩展的作用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu effett li jkabbar xi ħaġa, jagħmilha usa' jew iwessa' l-firxa tagħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: having an enlarging or broadening effect
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有扩大或拓宽作用的。

collocations.en: a process that brings about enlargement or broadening
collocations.zh: 产生扩大或拓宽作用的过程

formal.mt: Il-qari ta' testi minn kulturi differenti għandu effett wassiegħi fuq il-perspettiva tal-istudent.
formal.en: Reading texts from different cultures has a broadening effect on the student's perspective.
formal.zh: 阅读不同文化的文本具有拓宽学生视野的作用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'effett wassiegħi' hawn? Mark: Ifisser effett li jwessa' l-perspettiva tiegħek u jgħinek tara aktar possibbiltajiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'a broadening effect' mean here? Mark: It means an effect that broadens your perspective and helps you see more possibilities.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的“拓宽作用”是什么意思？马克：就是能拓宽你的视野，帮助你看到更多可能性的作用。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的“拓宽作用”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'a broadening effect' mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser effett li jwessa' l-perspettiva tiegħek u jgħinek tara aktar possibbiltajiet.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser effett li jwessa' l-perspettiva tiegħek u jgħinek tara aktar possibbiltajiet.
messages.zh: 就是能拓宽你的视野，帮助你看到更多可能性的作用。
messages.en: It means an effect that broadens your perspective and helps you see more possibilities.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把wassiegħi写在一幅逐渐展开的视野图旁，记住它描述“有拓宽效果的”；可与表示拓宽者的wassiegħ对照学习。

gloss_zh: 中间；中心（很少单独使用）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rarely independent expression for the middle or centre, illustrated by 'wast il-bitħa', meaning the centre of the yard.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示中间或中心、很少单独使用的成分；例如wast il-bitħa表示院子的中心。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element li jfisser in-nofs jew iċ-ċentru u li rari jintuża waħdu, bħal f''wast il-bitħa'.

sense_translations.en_definition: hardly ever used alone but it occurs in fost 'amongst', i.e. fi + wost/wast 'middle'; wast il-bitħa, the centre of the yard
sense_translations.zh_definition: 几乎不单独使用，但见于表示“在……之中”的fost，即fi与表示“中间”的wost/wast相合；wast il-bitħa表示“院子的中心”。

formal.mt: L-espressjoni 'wast il-bitħa' tindika ċ-ċentru tal-bitħa.
formal.en: The expression 'wast il-bitħa' denotes the centre of the yard.
formal.zh: 表达wast il-bitħa指院子的中心位置。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qrajt 'wast il-bitħa'. Xi jfisser? Mark: Iċ-ċentru tal-bitħa; 'wast' rari tintuża waħedha.
colloquial.en: Maja: I read 'wast il-bitħa'. What does it mean? Mark: The centre of the yard; 'wast' is rarely used on its own.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我读到了wast il-bitħa，是什么意思？马克：院子的中心；wast很少单独使用。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 我读到了wast il-bitħa，是什么意思？
messages.en: I read 'wast il-bitħa'. What does it mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 院子的中心；wast很少单独使用。
messages.en: The centre of the yard; 'wast' is rarely used on its own.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在院子平面图的正中心画一个点，旁边写wast il-bitħa；整组记忆，并记住wast很少单独出现。

gloss_zh: 有用；有益；亦见于田地地名tal-wata

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be useful or beneficial, including when nourishing food does someone good.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发挥用处或带来益处；也可用于滋养身体的食物对人有益。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ta' użu jew ta' ġid, pereżempju meta ikel sustanzjuż jagħmel il-ġid lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有用；能够发挥用处。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be beneficial (used, e.g. of nourishing food)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有益；带来好处，例如用于滋养身体的食物。

sense_translations.en_definition: occurring in tal-wata, name of fields in mosta on the road to mdina inclining towards il-wied tal-isperanza north of tal-ħanżira
sense_translations.zh_definition: 出现于田地名称tal-wata中；这些田地位于莫斯塔通往姆迪纳的道路旁，向tal-ħanżira以北的il-wied tal-isperanza方向倾斜。

collocations.en: the broth did the sick person good

formal.mt: Il-brodu sustanzjuż wata lill-marid u għenu jerġa' jikseb saħħtu.
formal.en: The nourishing broth did the sick person good and helped him regain his strength.
formal.zh: 营养丰富的肉汤对病人有益，帮助他恢复了体力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'il-brodu wata lill-marid'? Mark: Ifisser li l-brodu għamillu l-ġid.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'the broth did the sick person good' mean? Mark: It means that the broth was beneficial to him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：il-brodu wata lill-marid是什么意思？马克：意思是肉汤对那位病人有好处。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: il-brodu wata lill-marid是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'the broth did the sick person good' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 意思是肉汤对那位病人有好处。
messages.en: It means that the broth was beneficial to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一碗汤有益身体，一件工具有用”记住wata的两个动词义；遇到tal-wata时，另作田地名称识别。

gloss_zh: 发出呜呜叫声（猫头鹰等）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a hooting call, as an owl does.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 像猫头鹰那样发出呜呜的鸣叫声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħmel għajta bħal dik ta' kokka.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出呜呜的鸣叫声，用于猫头鹰等。

formal.mt: Il-kokka watwat minn fuq siġra waqt li l-osservaturi kienu qed jistennew fis-skiet.
formal.en: The owl hooted from a tree while the observers were waiting quietly.
formal.zh: 观察者们安静等候时，猫头鹰在树上发出了呜呜叫声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt dik l-għajta? Mark: Iva, kokka watwat fis-siġra ħdejn id-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear that call? Mark: Yes, an owl hooted in the tree beside the house.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听见那声叫了吗？马克：听见了，一只猫头鹰在房子旁边的树上呜呜叫。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听见那声叫了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that call?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kokka watwat fis-siġra ħdejn id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kokka watwat fis-siġra ħdejn id-dar.
messages.zh: 听见了，一只猫头鹰在房子旁边的树上呜呜叫。
messages.en: Yes, an owl hooted in the tree beside the house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把watwat看成两个重复的视觉节拍，联想猫头鹰接连发出两声呜叫；这只是学习联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 疼痛；感到身体或情感上的痛楚

teaching_sense.en_definition: To ache or experience hurt, either physically or emotionally.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到疼痛，或经历身体上、情感上的痛楚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss uġigħ fil-ġisem jew tbatija fis-sentimenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 疼痛；指身体出现酸痛或隐痛的感觉。
身体或情感上的痛楚；指感到疼痛或心里受伤。

formal.mt: Wara li ġarr il-kaxxa tqila, dahru waġa' għal diversi sigħat.
formal.en: After he carried the heavy box, his back ached for several hours.
formal.zh: 搬过那个沉重的箱子后，他的背疼了好几个小时。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dahri waġa' wara l-mixja tal-bieraħ. Maja: Kemm domt timxi? Mark: Kważi tliet sigħat.
colloquial.en: Mark: My back ached after yesterday's walk. Maja: How long did you walk? Mark: Almost three hours.
colloquial.zh: 马克：昨天走完路后，我的背疼了。玛雅：你走了多久？马克：差不多三个小时。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天走完路后，我的背疼了。
messages.en: My back ached after yesterday's walk.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你走了多久？
messages.en: How long did you walk?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 差不多三个小时。
messages.en: Almost three hours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把背部酸痛与内心难过并排画在记忆卡上，用两种痛楚帮助记住身体和情感两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An ache: a feeling of physical pain, often dull or continuing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体上的疼痛感，常指持续的酸痛或隐痛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni ta' uġigħ fil-ġisem, li tista' tkun ħafifa iżda ddum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 疼痛；身体某处的酸痛或隐痛感。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipant semma waġgħa ħafifa fil-muskoli wara l-eżerċizzju.
formal.en: The participant mentioned a mild ache in his muscles after the exercise.
formal.zh: 这位参与者提到，运动后肌肉有轻微酸痛。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi waġgħa fid-dahar illum. Pawlu: Minn meta? Lara: Minn dalgħodu, wara li ġarrejt il-basktijiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: I have an ache in my back today. Pawlu: Since when? Lara: Since this morning, after I carried the bags.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我今天背疼。保罗：从什么时候开始的？拉拉：今天早上搬完那些袋子之后。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我今天背疼。
messages.en: I have an ache in my back today.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 从什么时候开始的？
messages.en: Since when?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn dalgħodu, wara li ġarrejt il-basktijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Minn dalgħodu, wara li ġarrejt il-basktijiet.
messages.zh: 今天早上搬完那些袋子之后。
messages.en: Since this morning, after I carried the bags.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在人体图上圈出背部，再标注一处酸痛，把这个名词当作可以描述位置和轻重的疼痛感来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause physical pain or hurt someone's feelings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人身体疼痛，或使人的感情受到伤害。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jikkawża uġigħ fil-ġisem jew iweġġa' s-sentimenti ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弄疼；使受伤或感到痛苦。
伤害感情；使人在情感上受到伤害。

formal.mt: Il-kumment tiegħu waġġa' s-sentimenti ta' kollega waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: His comment hurt a colleague's feelings during the meeting.
formal.zh: 开会时，他的评论伤害了一位同事的感情。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Anna telqet daqshekk kwieta? Mark: Il-kumment tiegħi waġġa' s-sentimenti tagħha. Se nitlobha skuża.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Anna leave so quietly? Mark: My comment hurt her feelings. I'm going to apologise to her.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：安娜怎么一声不响地走了？马克：我的话伤害了她的感情。我会向她道歉。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 安娜怎么一声不响地走了？
messages.en: Why did Anna leave so quietly?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kumment tiegħi waġġa' s-sentimenti tagħha. Se nitlobha skuża.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kumment tiegħi waġġa' s-sentimenti tagħha. Se nitlobha skuża.
messages.zh: 我的话伤害了她的感情。我会向她道歉。
messages.en: My comment hurt her feelings. I'm going to apologise to her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一句重话让朋友难过，把这个词记成造成伤害的动作，同时联想到弄疼身体和伤害感情。

gloss_zh: 强烈欲望；特别想吃某种食物的渴望

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong desire for something, especially a particular food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某物的强烈渴望，尤其指特别想吃某种食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa qawwija għal xi ħaġa, speċjalment għal ikel partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强烈渴望，尤其指对食物的强烈欲望或特别想吃某种东西的感觉。

formal.mt: Fid-djarju tagħha, Anna kitbet li kellha waħam qawwi għall-ħelu wara l-ikla.
formal.en: In her diary, Anna wrote that she had a strong craving for sweets after the meal.
formal.zh: 安娜在日记里写道，吃完饭后她特别想吃甜食。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandi waħam għaċ-ċikkulata. Għandek biċċa? Maja: Iva, hemm ftit fil-kċina. Ejja naqsmuha.
colloquial.en: Sara: I'm craving chocolate. Do you have a piece? Maja: Yes, there's some in the kitchen. Let's share it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我特别想吃巧克力。你有一块吗？玛雅：有，厨房里有一些。我们分着吃吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我特别想吃巧克力。你有一块吗？
messages.en: I'm craving chocolate. Do you have a piece?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm ftit fil-kċina. Ejja naqsmuha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm ftit fil-kċina. Ejja naqsmuha.
messages.zh: 有，厨房里有一些。我们分着吃吧。
messages.en: Yes, there's some in the kitchen. Let's share it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刚吃完饭却仍一心惦记巧克力，用特别想吃某一样东西的画面记住这种强烈渴望。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Alone, without another person's company, or by oneself without another person's help.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 独自一人，没有别人陪伴；也指靠自己完成某事，没有别人帮助。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mingħajr il-kumpanija ta' ħaddieħor, jew mingħajr l-għajnuna ta' persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 独自地；没有别人陪伴。
靠自己；没有别人协助地。

formal.mt: L-entrata 'waħd' tkopri kemm in-nuqqas ta' kumpanija kif ukoll it-twettiq ta' xi ħaġa mingħajr għajnuna.
formal.en: The entry 'waħd' covers both the absence of company and doing something without help.
formal.zh: 词条“waħd”既涵盖无人陪伴，也涵盖不借助他人帮助完成某事。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed nitgħallem 'waħd'. 'Jaħdem waħdu' jfisser li ħadd ma jgħinu? Mark: Jista' jfisser hekk, jew li ma jkun hemm ħadd miegħu. Is-sitwazzjoni tiċċara t-tifsira.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'm learning 'waħd'. Does 'he works by himself' mean nobody helps him? Mark: It can mean that, or that nobody is with him. The situation makes the meaning clear.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我在学“waħd”。“他独自工作”是说没人帮他吗？马克：可以是这个意思，也可以是说没有人在他身边。具体情境会让意思更清楚。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nitgħallem 'waħd'. 'Jaħdem waħdu' jfisser li ħadd ma jgħinu?
messages.mt_standard: Qed nitgħallem 'waħd'. 'Jaħdem waħdu' jfisser li ħadd ma jgħinu?
messages.zh: 我在学“waħd”。“他独自工作”是说没人帮他吗？
messages.en: I'm learning 'waħd'. Does 'he works by himself' mean nobody helps him?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jista' jfisser hekk, jew li ma jkun hemm ħadd miegħu. Is-sitwazzjoni tiċċara t-tifsira.
messages.mt_standard: Jista' jfisser hekk, jew li ma jkun hemm ħadd miegħu. Is-sitwazzjoni tiċċara t-tifsira.
messages.zh: 可以是这个意思，也可以是说没有人在他身边。具体情境会让意思更清楚。
messages.en: It can mean that, or that nobody is with him. The situation makes the meaning clear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人坐在书桌前：旁边没人是“独自”，作业自己完成是“靠自己”，用同一画面记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being one whole, or a distinguishing quality that sets something apart.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成为一个整体的性质；也可指使某事物与其他事物有所区别的独特性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità li xi ħaġa tkun ħaġa waħda, jew il-kwalità li tagħżilha minn affarijiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一体性；成为一个整体的状态或性质。
区别；使某事物有别于其他事物的独特性质。

formal.mt: L-awtur juża 'waħdanija' biex jiddeskrivi kif il-partijiet differenti jiffurmaw ħaġa waħda.
formal.en: The author uses 'waħdanija' to describe how the different parts form one whole.
formal.zh: 作者用“waħdanija”描述不同部分如何构成一个整体。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hawnhekk, 'il-waħdanija tal-istil' tfisser li l-istil huwa differenti? Pawlu: Iva, qed nitkellmu dwar dak li jagħżlu minn stili oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Here, does 'the distinctiveness of the style' mean that the style is different? Pawlu: Yes, we're talking about what sets it apart from other styles.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里“风格的独特性”是说这种风格与众不同吗？保罗：对，我们说的是它有别于其他风格的地方。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk, 'il-waħdanija tal-istil' tfisser li l-istil huwa differenti?
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk, 'il-waħdanija tal-istil' tfisser li l-istil huwa differenti?
messages.zh: 这里“风格的独特性”是说这种风格与众不同吗？
messages.en: Here, does 'the distinctiveness of the style' mean that the style is different?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed nitkellmu dwar dak li jagħżlu minn stili oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed nitkellmu dwar dak li jagħżlu minn stili oħra.
messages.zh: 对，我们说的是它有别于其他风格的地方。
messages.en: Yes, we're talking about what sets it apart from other styles.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张卡片记忆：一张画拼图合成整体，另一张画独特的图案，分别提示“一体性”和“独特性”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being singular or of forming a united whole.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为单一存在的性质，或各部分形成统一整体的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità li xi ħaġa tkun waħda, jew l-istat li diversi partijiet jiffurmaw ħaġa waħda magħquda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 单一性；统一性；作为单一存在或统一整体的性质。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza l-waħdenija tal-għan minkejja d-differenzi bejn il-membri.
formal.en: The report emphasizes the unity of purpose despite the differences among the members.
formal.zh: 报告强调，尽管成员之间存在差异，他们的目标仍具有统一性。
