colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif nistgħu nuru l-waħdenija tal-grupp fil-preżentazzjoni? David: Nispjegaw li għandna ideat differenti, imma lkoll naħdmu għall-istess għan.
colloquial.en: Sara: How can we show the group's unity in the presentation? David: We can explain that we have different ideas, but we all work toward the same goal.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们怎样在展示中体现小组的统一性？戴维：可以解释说，虽然我们的想法不同，但大家都朝着同一个目标努力。

messages.speaker: Sara (小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nistgħu nuru l-waħdenija tal-grupp fil-preżentazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nistgħu nuru l-waħdenija tal-grupp fil-preżentazzjoni?
messages.zh: 我们怎样在展示中体现小组的统一性？
messages.en: How can we show the group's unity in the presentation?

messages.speaker: David (小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Nispjegaw li għandna ideat differenti, imma lkoll naħdmu għall-istess għan.
messages.mt_standard: Nispjegaw li għandna ideat differenti, imma lkoll naħdmu għall-istess għan.
messages.zh: 可以解释说，虽然我们的想法不同，但大家都朝着同一个目标努力。
messages.en: We can explain that we have different ideas, but we all work toward the same goal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把许多箭头指向同一个圆心：箭头虽多，方向和目标合为一体，帮助记住“单一性、统一性”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Clearly distinct from others, unique in character, or the only one in a particular situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与其他事物明显有别的；具有独特性质的；或在特定情境中唯一的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jingħaraf minn oħrajn, li għandu karattru uniku, jew li huwa l-uniku wieħed f'sitwazzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有明显区别的；可与其他事物区分的。
独特的；具有与众不同性质的。
唯一的；在有关范围内只有一个的。

formal.mt: Dan id-dokument huwa l-eżempju waħdien ta' dan it-tip fil-kollezzjoni.
formal.en: This document is the sole example of this type in the collection.
formal.zh: 这份文件是该收藏中这一类型的唯一实例。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ktibt 'l-eżempju waħdien' taħt dan ir-ritratt? Ġanni: Għax fil-kollezzjoni għandna wieħed biss ta' dan it-tip.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you write 'the sole example' under this photograph? Ġanni: Because we have only one of this type in the collection.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么在这张照片下面写“唯一的实例”？詹尼：因为我们的收藏里，这一类型只有一个。

messages.speaker: Nina (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ktibt 'l-eżempju waħdien' taħt dan ir-ritratt?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ktibt 'l-eżempju waħdien' taħt dan ir-ritratt?
messages.zh: 你为什么在这张照片下面写“唯一的实例”？
messages.en: Why did you write 'the sole example' under this photograph?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (收藏者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax fil-kollezzjoni għandna wieħed biss ta' dan it-tip.
messages.mt_standard: Għax fil-kollezzjoni għandna wieħed biss ta' dan it-tip.
messages.zh: 因为我们的收藏里，这一类型只有一个。
messages.en: Because we have only one of this type in the collection.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象展柜里一件特别醒目的藏品：它与别物有区别、风格独特，而且同类只有这一件，串起三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a character or qualities that make something unlike others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使其有别于其他事物的特征或性质的；独特的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu karattru jew kwalitajiet li jagħżluh minn oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 独特的；独一无二的；具有与众不同特征的。

formal.mt: L-artista żviluppa stil waħdieni li jingħaraf fid-disinn u fl-użu tal-kulur.
formal.en: The artist developed a unique style recognizable in the design and use of color.
formal.zh: 这位艺术家形成了独特的风格，可从设计和色彩运用中辨认出来。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għoġbok il-kantant? Luqa: Iva, għandu leħen waħdieni. Nagħrfu mill-ewwel meta nisimgħu jkanta.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did you like the singer? Luqa: Yes, he has a unique voice. I recognize him immediately when I hear him sing.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你喜欢那位歌手吗？卢卡：喜欢，他的嗓音很独特。我一听见他唱歌就能认出来。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢那位歌手吗？
messages.en: Did you like the singer?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandu leħen waħdieni. Nagħrfu mill-ewwel meta nisimgħu jkanta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandu leħen waħdieni. Nagħrfu mill-ewwel meta nisimgħu jkanta.
messages.zh: 喜欢，他的嗓音很独特。我一听见他唱歌就能认出来。
messages.en: Yes, he has a unique voice. I recognize him immediately when I hear him sing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象闭着眼睛也能认出的嗓音，把“听一次就认得”的鲜明特点与“独特的”联系起来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Without anyone else present or accompanying him, or standing by itself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有其他人在场或陪伴的；孤身的；也可形容单独存在的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jkun hemm ħadd ieħor miegħu, jew li jkun jinsab separat minn affarijiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 独自的；没有别人陪伴或在场的。
孤身的；单独存在的；独自一个的。

formal.mt: Meta wasal l-organizzatur, il-parteċipant kien waħdu fis-sala.
formal.en: When the organizer arrived, the participant was alone in the hall.
formal.zh: 组织者到达时，那位参与者独自一人在大厅里。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Mark għadu waħdu d-dar? Ben: Iva, imma sejjer għandu issa biex nieklu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is Mark still alone at home? Ben: Yes, but I'm going over to his place now so we can eat together.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马克还一个人在家吗？本：是的，不过我现在要去他家，我们一起吃饭。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克还一个人在家吗？
messages.en: Is Mark still alone at home?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma sejjer għandu issa biex nieklu flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma sejjer għandu issa biex nieklu flimkien.
messages.zh: 是的，不过我现在要去他家，我们一起吃饭。
messages.en: Yes, but I'm going over to his place now so we can eat together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画面中只留一个人在房间里，用“身边没有别人”记住这个词；独自的状态本身不一定表示难过。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who howls or cries out because of pain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因疼痛而大声号叫、哀叫的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tgħajjat jew tnewwaħ minħabba l-uġigħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因疼痛而号叫的人；痛得大声哀叫的人。

collocations.en: to hear someone howling in pain
collocations.zh: 听见有人因疼痛而号叫

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, waħwieħ jitlob l-għajnuna wara li jaqa' u jweġġa' siequ.
formal.en: In the story, a person howling in pain asks for help after falling and hurting his foot.
formal.zh: 在故事中，一个人跌倒伤了脚，痛得号叫着求助。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak il-waħwieħ fil-film? Pawlu: Hu r-raġel li waqa' minn fuq is-sellum u weġġa' siequ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that person howling in pain in the film? Pawlu: He's the man who fell off the ladder and hurt his foot.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：电影里那个痛得号叫的人是谁？保罗：就是那个从梯子上摔下来、伤了脚的男人。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影里那个痛得号叫的人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that person howling in pain in the film?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu r-raġel li waqa' minn fuq is-sellum u weġġa' siequ.
messages.mt_standard: Hu r-raġel li waqa' minn fuq is-sellum u weġġa' siequ.
messages.zh: 就是那个从梯子上摔下来、伤了脚的男人。
messages.en: He's the man who fell off the ladder and hurt his foot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故事人物伤了脚后痛得大叫，把 waħwieħ 记作“号叫的那个人”，注意它指人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to howl, especially when describing an animal that howls readily or often.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容动物容易发出或经常发出嚎叫声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jgħajjat b'għajjat twil, speċjalment meta jingħad għal annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易嚎叫的；有嚎叫倾向的

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-kelb bħala waħwieħi, speċjalment meta jitħalla waħdu.
formal.en: The report describes the dog as inclined to howl, especially when left alone.
formal.zh: 报告称这只狗爱嚎叫，尤其是在独处时。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kelb tiegħek waħwieħi? Mark: Iva, speċjalment meta jkun waħdu d-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is your dog inclined to howl? Mark: Yes, especially when he is home alone.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你的狗爱嚎叫吗？Mark：是啊，尤其是独自在家的时候。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的狗爱嚎叫吗？
messages.en: Is your dog inclined to howl?

messages.speaker: Mark (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, speċjalment meta jkun waħdu d-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, speċjalment meta jkun waħdu d-dar.
messages.zh: 是啊，尤其是独自在家的时候。
messages.en: Yes, especially when he is home alone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个形容词配上一只独处时长声嚎叫的狗来记，重点是“爱嚎叫的习性”，而不是某一次叫声。

gloss_zh: 促成统一的；起凝聚作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bringing people or separate parts together into a united whole.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人们或原本分开的部分结合为统一整体的；具有凝聚作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jgħaqqad nies jew partijiet separati biex jiffurmaw ħaġa waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 促成统一的；把人们或不同部分凝聚在一起的。

formal.mt: L-għan komuni kellu rwol waħħadi fil-proġett, għax għaqqad il-ħidma tal-gruppi differenti.
formal.en: The shared goal played a unifying role in the project because it brought the work of the different groups together.
formal.zh: 共同目标在项目中发挥了凝聚作用，把不同小组的工作结合起来。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex sejjaħt l-isport fattur waħħadi? Toni: Għax jiġbor nies minn gruppi differenti biex jilagħbu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why did you call sport a unifying factor? Toni: Because it brings people from different groups together to play.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你为什么说体育是凝聚大家的因素？托尼：因为它让来自不同群体的人聚在一起运动。

messages.speaker: Elena (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么说体育是凝聚大家的因素？
messages.en: Why did you call sport a unifying factor?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jiġbor nies minn gruppi differenti biex jilagħbu flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jiġbor nies minn gruppi differenti biex jilagħbu flimkien.
messages.zh: 因为它让来自不同群体的人聚在一起运动。
messages.en: Because it brings people from different groups together to play.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一根绳子把分散的小旗连成一串，记住它强调“把分散者连接起来”的统一和凝聚作用。

gloss_zh: 猪殃殃；黏附处；胶等黏性材料

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant called cleavers or goose grass, Galium aparine; also a sticky place or a sticky material such as glue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指猪殃殃这种植物，学名为 Galium aparine；也指黏附的地方或胶等具有黏性的材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pjanta Galium aparine; ukoll post li jwaħħal jew materjal li jwaħħal, bħall-kolla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 猪殃殃，学名 Galium aparine；一种植物。

sense_translations.en_definition: sticky place or material such as glue
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有黏性的地方；或胶等能黏附物体的材料。

collocations.en: a sticky material such as glue

formal.mt: Fil-lista tal-pjanti, l-isem 'waħħala' jirreferi għal Galium aparine; f'deskrizzjoni ta' materjali, jista' jirreferi għal materjal li jwaħħal.
formal.en: In the plant list, the name 'waħħala' refers to Galium aparine; in a description of materials, it can refer to a sticky material.
formal.zh: 在植物名录中，“waħħala”指猪殃殃；在材料描述中，它可以指黏性材料。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Hawn miktub 'waħħala'. Qed jitkellem fuq kolla? Mario: Le, din lista ta' pjanti. Hawnhekk tfisser il-pjanta Galium aparine.
colloquial.en: Rita: It says 'waħħala' here. Is it talking about glue? Mario: No, this is a list of plants. Here it means the plant Galium aparine.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这里写着“waħħala”，是在说胶吗？马里奥：不是，这是一份植物清单。这里指的是猪殃殃这种植物。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn miktub 'waħħala'. Qed jitkellem fuq kolla?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub 'waħħala'. Qed jitkellem fuq kolla?
messages.zh: 这里写着“waħħala”，是在说胶吗？
messages.en: It says 'waħħala' here. Is it talking about glue?

messages.speaker: Mario (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, din lista ta' pjanti. Hawnhekk tfisser il-pjanta Galium aparine.
messages.mt_standard: Le, din lista ta' pjanti. Hawnhekk tfisser il-pjanta Galium aparine.
messages.zh: 不是，这是一份植物清单。这里指的是猪殃殃这种植物。
messages.en: No, this is a list of plants. Here it means the plant Galium aparine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词卡分成两格：一格写植物名“猪殃殃”，另一格画胶水和黏性表面；阅读时先看语境属于植物还是黏性事物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sticky to the touch and tending to cling to another surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 摸起来发黏、容易黏附在其他表面上的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jeħel mal-idejn jew ma' wiċċ ieħor meta tmissu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黏的；触摸时容易黏住手或其他物体的。

formal.mt: Il-likwidu waħħali għandu jitnaddaf minnufih biex ma jeħilx mat-tagħmir.
formal.en: The sticky liquid should be cleaned up immediately so that it does not stick to the equipment.
formal.zh: 应立即清理这种黏稠液体，以免它黏附在设备上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan il-mejda għandu wiċċ waħħali? Mark: Waqa' ftit għasel fuqu. Se nimsaħu issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does this table have a sticky surface? Mark: Some honey spilled on it. I'll wipe it now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张桌子的表面怎么黏黏的？马克：上面洒了点蜂蜜。我现在就擦。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-mejda għandu wiċċ waħħali?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-mejda għandu wiċċ waħħali?
messages.zh: 这张桌子的表面怎么黏黏的？
messages.en: Why does this table have a sticky surface?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Waqa' ftit għasel fuqu. Se nimsaħu issa.
messages.mt_standard: Waqa' ftit għasel fuqu. Se nimsaħu issa.
messages.zh: 上面洒了点蜂蜜。我现在就擦。
messages.en: Some honey spilled on it. I'll wipe it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指碰到蜂蜜后黏住的触感，把 waħħali 和“摸起来黏黏的”一起记。

gloss_zh: 使人饥饿；勾起食欲；诱发馋欲或一时念头的东西

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone feel hungry or awaken their desire to eat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人感到饥饿，或勾起某人想吃东西的欲望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss il-ġuħ jew iqajjimlu x-xewqa li jiekol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人感到饥饿；使人想吃东西。
勾起某人的食欲；引发进食的欲望。

sense_translations.en_definition: sth. that induces cravings (e.g. for food)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人产生强烈渴望的东西，例如让人嘴馋的食物或刺激。
使人产生一时兴起的念头或突发欲望的东西。

collocations.en: whetted the appetite of whoever saw it

formal.mt: Ir-ritratt tal-ħobż frisk waħħam lil ħafna qarrejja u qanqal interess fir-riċetta.
formal.en: The photograph of the fresh bread whetted many readers' appetites and sparked interest in the recipe.
formal.zh: 新鲜面包的照片勾起了许多读者的食欲，也激发了他们对食谱的兴趣。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak ir-ritratt tal-kejk waħħam lit-tfal! Pawlu: Mela naqtgħulhom biċċa żgħira.
colloquial.en: Lara: That photo of the cake made the children hungry! Pawlu: Then let's cut them a small piece.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那张蛋糕照片把孩子们都看馋了！保罗：那我们切一小块给他们吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.zh: 那张蛋糕照片把孩子们都看馋了！
messages.en: That photo of the cake made the children hungry!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 那我们切一小块给他们吧。
messages.en: Then let's cut them a small piece.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“看到蛋糕照片，立刻被勾起食欲”记动词；另用词性卡片单独记名词的“诱发欲望之物”义。

gloss_zh: 强烈的渴望；强烈的馋欲

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong desire for something, especially a particular food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某种东西的强烈渴望，尤其指特别想吃某种食物的馋欲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa qawwija għal xi ħaġa, speċjalment għal ikel partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强烈的渴望；难以忽略的馋欲或欲求。

formal.mt: Fid-djarju tagħha, l-awtriċi tiddeskrivi waħħama għall-ħelu li kienet tħoss filgħaxija.
formal.en: In her diary, the author describes a strong craving for sweets that she used to feel in the evening.
formal.zh: 作者在日记中描述了自己过去在晚上会产生的强烈甜食欲望。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandi waħħama għaċ-ċikkulata llum. Rita: Għandi biċċa fil-borża. Trid ftit?
colloquial.en: Nina: I've got a strong craving for chocolate today. Rita: I've got a piece in my bag. Would you like some?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我今天特别馋巧克力。丽塔：我包里有一块。你要来一点吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我今天特别馋巧克力。
messages.en: I've got a strong craving for chocolate today.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 我包里有一块。你要来一点吗？
messages.en: I've got a piece in my bag. Would you like some?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象脑中一直浮现巧克力、特别想吃的感觉，用 waħħama 给这股强烈馋欲命名。

gloss_zh: 勾起馋欲的；令人强烈想要的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing someone to develop a strong craving, especially for food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能使人产生强烈渴望的，尤其指让人看见或闻到后嘴馋的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jqajjem xewqa qawwija għal xi ħaġa, speċjalment għall-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诱发强烈渴望的；勾起馋欲的。

formal.mt: Il-ktejjeb jinkludi ritratt waħħami ta' platt għaġin biz-zalza tat-tadam.
formal.en: The booklet includes a crave-inducing photograph of a plate of pasta with tomato sauce.
formal.zh: 这本小册子收录了一张令人嘴馋的番茄酱意面照片。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan ir-ritratt waħħami wisq! Maja: Veru, issa għandi aptit niekol l-għaġin.
colloquial.en: Mark: This photo really makes you crave food! Maja: It does; now I feel like eating pasta.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这张照片太让人嘴馋了！玛雅：真的，我现在想吃意面了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 这张照片太让人嘴馋了！
messages.en: This photo really makes you crave food!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, issa għandi aptit niekol l-għaġin.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, issa għandi aptit niekol l-għaġin.
messages.zh: 真的，我现在想吃意面了。
messages.en: It does; now I feel like eating pasta.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把美食照片旁贴上 waħħami，记住它形容“让人产生馋欲”的事物，而馋欲本身可用 waħħama 表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ghost: a spirit of a dead person imagined as appearing to the living.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鬼或幽灵，指故事或想象中出现在活人面前的死者灵魂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spirtu ta' persuna mejta li, skont stejjer jew twemmin, jidher lill-ħajjin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鬼；幽灵；传说中显现的死者灵魂。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, waħħaxa tidher fit-tieqa tad-dar il-qadima kull lejl.
formal.en: In the story, a ghost appears at the window of the old house every night.
formal.zh: 在这个故事中，每晚都有一个幽灵出现在老房子的窗前。

colloquial.mt: Lara: F'dan il-film hemm waħħaxa? Nina: Iva, imma tidher biss fl-aħħar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is there a ghost in this film? Nina: Yes, but it only appears at the end.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这部电影里有幽灵吗？妮娜：有，不过到最后才出现。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这部电影里有幽灵吗？
messages.en: Is there a ghost in this film?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，不过到最后才出现。
messages.en: Yes, but it only appears at the end.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象鬼故事里窗前出现的幽灵，用 waħħaxa 给这个角色命名，记住它是表示“鬼”的名词。

gloss_zh: 令人害怕的；吓人的；阴森的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing fear or an uneasy feeling, especially through a spooky atmosphere.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 令人害怕或不安的，尤其可形容带有阴森气氛的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jbeżża' jew iqajjem sens ta' biża' u skumdità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人恐惧的；使人感到害怕的。
吓人的；可怕的。
阴森的；诡异得令人害怕的。

formal.mt: Id-dawl baxx u l-ħsejjes mhux mistennija jagħmlu t-teatru post waħħaxi matul ix-xena.
formal.en: The dim lighting and unexpected sounds make the theatre a spooky place during the scene.
formal.zh: 在这一幕中，昏暗的灯光和突如其来的声响让剧院显得阴森可怕。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Dan il-film waħħaxi wisq għalija. Rita: Trid naraw kummiedja minfloku?
colloquial.en: Pawlu: This film is too scary for me. Rita: Shall we watch a comedy instead?
colloquial.zh: 保罗：这部电影对我来说太吓人了。丽塔：要不我们换一部喜剧看？

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 这部电影对我来说太吓人了。
messages.en: This film is too scary for me.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 要不我们换一部喜剧看？
messages.en: Shall we watch a comedy instead?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 waħħaxi 写在阴森电影海报旁，记“吓人的”这种性质；再与名词 waħħaxa“幽灵”配对区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sticky or adhesive, tending to attach firmly to another surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有黏性、容易附着在其他表面上的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jeħel ma' wiċċ ieħor jew għandu l-ħila jwaħħal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黏的；有黏附性的；能够黏住其他表面的。

formal.mt: Il-materjal waħħieli fuq wara tat-tikketta jżommha mwaħħla mal-kaxxa.
formal.en: The adhesive material on the back of the label keeps it attached to the box.
formal.zh: 标签背面的黏性材料使标签牢牢贴在盒子上。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek tejp waħħieli biex nagħlaq din il-kaxxa? Lara: Iva, qiegħed fil-kexxun ħdejn l-imqass.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have adhesive tape so I can seal this box? Lara: Yes, it's in the drawer next to the scissors.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你有胶带吗？我想封上这个盒子。拉拉：有，在抽屉里，剪刀旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek tejp waħħieli biex nagħlaq din il-kaxxa?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek tejp waħħieli biex nagħlaq din il-kaxxa?
messages.zh: 你有胶带吗？我想封上这个盒子。
messages.en: Do you have adhesive tape so I can seal this box?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 有，在抽屉里，剪刀旁边。
messages.en: Yes, it's in the drawer next to the scissors.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用胶带黏住纸盒的画面记 waħħieli；学习时把“黏性、黏附性”与这个形容词一起复述。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To flow, said of water moving along or coming from a source.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指水流动、流淌，或从水源流出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jnixxi jew jimxi minn post għal ieħor, meta jingħad għall-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 流动；流淌，用于水。

formal.mt: L-ilma ważab mill-għajn u għadda mill-kanal lejn l-għalqa.
formal.en: The water flowed from the spring and passed through the channel towards the field.
formal.zh: 水从泉眼流出，沿水渠流向田地。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn ġie dan l-ilma? Mark: Ważab mill-għajn u wasal sa hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did this water come from? Mark: It flowed from the spring and reached this spot.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些水从哪里来的？马克：从泉眼流出来，一直流到了这里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些水从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where did this water come from?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ważab mill-għajn u wasal sa hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Ważab mill-għajn u wasal sa hawn.
messages.zh: 从泉眼流出来，一直流到了这里。
messages.en: It flowed from the spring and reached this spot.

gloss_zh: 诱惑；促使；给某人出主意或使其产生念头

teaching_sense.en_definition: To tempt or induce someone to do something, or to put an idea into someone's mind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 诱使或促使某人做某事，也可指给某人灌输想法、使其产生某种念头。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħajjar lil xi ħadd jagħmel xi ħaġa jew idaħħallu idea f'moħħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诱惑某人，使其想去做某事。
促使或诱使某人采取某种行动。
给某人出主意，或使某人产生原本没有的念头。

gloss_zh: 诱惑他人或给人灌输奇想的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who tempts someone or puts fanciful ideas into someone's mind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 诱惑他人，或不断使他人产生奇想、幻想的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħajjar lil ħaddieħor jew iddaħħallu f'moħħu ideat ta' fantasija.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who inculcates fancies or tempts sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给别人灌输奇想、幻想，或诱惑别人的人。

collocations.en: someone who fills others with dreams
someone who tempts you to spend

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-webbiel jimla moħħ iż-żagħżugħ b'ħolm ta' ġid faċli.
formal.en: In the story, the tempter fills the young man's mind with dreams of easy wealth.
formal.zh: 在故事中，那个诱惑者让年轻人满脑子都是轻松发财的幻想。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ejja nixtru biljett ieħor tal-lotterija! Mark: Int webbiel! Diġà qed nimmaġina x'nagħmel bil-flus.
colloquial.en: Maja: Let's buy another lottery ticket! Mark: You're a tempter! I'm already imagining what I would do with the money.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们再买一张彩票吧！马克：你可真会诱惑人！我已经开始想象拿到钱后要做什么了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们再买一张彩票吧！
messages.en: Let's buy another lottery ticket!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)

messages.zh: 你可真会诱惑人！我已经开始想象拿到钱后要做什么了。
messages.en: You're a tempter! I'm already imagining what I would do with the money.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 webbiel 记成身边那个总说“想想多美好”的人：这里命名的是诱惑别人、让人产生幻想的人。

gloss_zh: 容易引发幻想或一时兴致的；诱人遐想的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Likely to stir fanciful ideas or sudden whims in someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易使人产生幻想、奇想或一时兴致的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jqanqal fantasiji jew kapriċċi.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to induce fancies or whims
sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于引发幻想、奇想或一时兴致的。

collocations.en: a tone that encourages fanciful ideas

formal.mt: Il-kliem webbieli fir-reklam iqanqal ħolm ta' ħajja lussuża.
formal.en: The advertisement's fancifully enticing language stirs dreams of a luxurious life.
formal.zh: 广告中引人遐想的措辞勾起了人们对奢华生活的幻想。

colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看完那个广告，我想去岛上度假！马克：那些话就是容易让人想入非非。我们先看看要花多少钱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who adopts a child.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过收养成为儿童父亲或母亲的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Adoptive, or connected with the adoption of a child.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示通过收养建立的亲子关系，或与儿童收养有关的。

collocations.zh: 通过收养成为的父亲或母亲

teaching_sense.en_definition: To keep echoing in someone's ear, as words or a sound that seem to repeat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指声音或话语仿佛不断重复，持续在某人耳边回响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibqa' jidwi f'widnejn xi ħadd, bħal kliem jew ħoss li donnu jirrepeti ruħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to echo persistently in sb.'s ear
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某人耳边持续回响、反复萦绕。

collocations.zh: 一直在我耳边回响的话语

collocations.zh: 持续在他耳边回响的声音

formal.zh: 在整个回家途中，老师的话一直在学生耳边回响。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone an assurance that something will be done or will happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人保证会做某事，或保证某事将会发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta kelmtu li jagħmel xi ħaġa jew li xi ħaġa se sseħħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 承诺；答应；保证会做某事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or practice of making promises or solemn vows.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作出承诺、许诺或郑重立誓的行为。

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作出承诺；许诺的行为。
立誓；郑重作出誓言的行为。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat saħaq li l-proġett jeħtieġ azzjoni konkreta, mhux biss wegħid.

formal.zh: 委员会强调，这个项目需要具体行动，不能仅仅停留在许诺上。

messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd li jagħmel wegħda; jekk jien inwiegħdek li ngħinek, inkun il-wegħied.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd li jagħmel wegħda; jekk jien inwiegħdek li ngħinek, inkun il-wegħied.
messages.zh: 就是作出承诺的人；如果我答应帮助你，我就是那个许诺者。
messages.en: Someone who makes a promise; if I promise to help you, I am the promise-maker.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个举手许诺的人，把 wegħied 记在这个人身上；若他宣过誓，就再添一条“受誓言约束”的记忆线索。

gloss_zh: 爱许诺的；惯于作出承诺的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to make promises or to promise things readily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于作出承诺的，或很容易开口答应事情的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jagħmel wegħdiet jew iwiegħed malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于许诺的；爱作出承诺的。

collocations.en: a person inclined to make promises
a leader who readily makes promises
collocations.zh: 一位轻易作出承诺的领导者

formal.mt: Ir-rumanz jippreżenta mexxej wegħiedi li jagħmel ħafna wegħdiet lill-poplu.
formal.en: The novel presents a leader inclined to make promises, who makes many promises to the people.
formal.zh: 这部小说描写了一位爱许诺的领导者，他向民众作出许多承诺。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tgħid li Mark hu wegħiedi? Lara: Għax dejjem jgħid li se jgħinna; imbagħad naraw jekk iżommx kelmtu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you say Mark is always making promises? Lara: Because he always says he will help us; then we will see whether he keeps his word.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么说马克爱许诺？拉拉：因为他总说会帮我们；接下来就看他是否守信了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tgħid li Mark hu wegħiedi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tgħid li Mark hu wegħiedi?
messages.zh: 你为什么说马克爱许诺？
messages.en: Why do you say Mark is always making promises?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dejjem jgħid li se jgħinna; imbagħad naraw jekk iżommx kelmtu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dejjem jgħid li se jgħinna; imbagħad naraw jekk iżommx kelmtu.
messages.zh: 因为他总说会帮我们；接下来就看他是否守信了。
messages.en: Because he always says he will help us; then we will see whether he keeps his word.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给一个总把“我答应”挂在嘴边的人贴上 wegħiedi 标签。它描述爱许诺的倾向，本身不保证这个人会兑现承诺。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who obstructs others or makes a task or situation more difficult.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 妨碍他人行动，或使任务、处境变得更加困难的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tfixkel lil ħaddieħor jew tagħmel xogħol jew sitwazzjoni aktar diffiċli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 妨碍他人或阻碍事情进行的人；阻挠者。
制造困难、给人设置障碍的人。

collocations.zh: 制造障碍、给人添难题的人

formal.mt: F'dan ir-rakkont, il-wegħier joħloq ostakli ġodda kull darba li l-grupp joqrob lejn l-għan tiegħu.
formal.en: In this story, the obstructive character creates new obstacles whenever the group approaches its goal.
formal.zh: 在这个故事中，每当团队接近目标时，那个阻挠者就会制造新的障碍。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex qed issejjaħlu wegħier? Rita: Għax kull darba li naqblu fuq pjan, joħloq problema ġdida u jwaqqafna.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why are you calling him an obstructer? Rita: Because every time we agree on a plan, he creates a new problem and stops us.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你为什么叫他阻挠者？丽塔：因为我们每次商定一个计划，他就制造一个新问题，把我们卡住。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么叫他阻挠者？
messages.en: Why are you calling him an obstructer?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kull darba li naqblu fuq pjan, joħloq problema ġdida u jwaqqafna.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kull darba li naqblu fuq pjan, joħloq problema ġdida u jwaqqafna.
messages.zh: 因为我们每次商定一个计划，他就制造一个新问题，把我们卡住。
messages.en: Because every time we agree on a plan, he creates a new problem and stops us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象大家正向前走，一个人不断往路上摆障碍；把这个“挡路又添难”的人物叫作 wegħier，便能串起两个义项。

gloss_zh: 面积或干容量单位，均相当于四 tomna

teaching_sense.en_definition: A unit equal to four tomna, used either for surface area (4,496 square metres) or for dry volume (72.72 litres).
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 相当于四 tomna 的计量单位；计量面积时为4,496平方米，计量干容量时为72.72升，须根据语境区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità daqs erba' tomna, li tintuża għall-kejl tal-art, b'valur ta' 4,496 metru kwadru, jew għall-kejl tal-volum ta' prodotti niexfa, b'valur ta' 72.72 litru.

sense_translations.en_definition: a unit of surface area, equivalent to 4 tomna, that is officially 1.111 acres (4,496 m2).
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种面积单位，相当于四 tomna，官方定值为1.111英亩，即4,496平方米。

sense_translations.en_definition: a unit of dry volume, equivalent to 4 tomna, that is officially 2.5688 imperial cubic feet (72.72 L).
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种干容量单位，相当于四 tomna，官方定值为2.5688英制立方英尺，即72.72升。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, l-għalqa għandha erja ta' wejba waħda, jiġifieri 4,496 metru kwadru.
formal.en: In the exercise, the field has an area of one wejba, that is, 4,496 square metres.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，田地面积为一 wejba，即4,496平方米。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta tgħid wejba qamħ, qed tkejjel l-art? Toni: Le, hawn qed inkejjel il-volum tal-qamħ: wejba waħda hi 72.72 litru.
colloquial.en: Maja: When you say a wejba of wheat, are you measuring land? Toni: No, here I am measuring the volume of the wheat: one wejba is 72.72 litres.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你说一 wejba 小麦，是在量土地吗？托尼：不是，这里量的是小麦的体积：一 wejba 是72.72升。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tgħid wejba qamħ, qed tkejjel l-art?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tgħid wejba qamħ, qed tkejjel l-art?
messages.zh: 你说一 wejba 小麦，是在量土地吗？
messages.en: When you say a wejba of wheat, are you measuring land?

messages.speaker: Toni (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hawn qed inkejjel il-volum tal-qamħ: wejba waħda hi 72.72 litru.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hawn qed inkejjel il-volum tal-qamħ: wejba waħda hi 72.72 litru.
messages.zh: 不是，这里量的是小麦的体积：一 wejba 是72.72升。
messages.en: No, here I am measuring the volume of the wheat: one wejba is 72.72 litres.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“一 wejba 等于四 tomna”，再画田地与粮桶两张图：田地配4,496平方米，粮桶配72.72升，避免把面积和容量混用。

gloss_zh: 把别人不愿承担的事情强加给别人的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who burdens others with something they dislike or do not want to deal with.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把别人不喜欢、不愿处理的事情或负担强加给别人的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tgħabbi lil ħaddieħor b'xi ħaġa li ma jixtieqx jew li ma jieħux gost jagħmel.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who saddles others with sth. they don't like or enjoy
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把他人不喜欢或不乐意接受的事情强加给他人的人。

collocations.mt: wekkej li jgħabbi lil ħaddieħor bix-xogħol
collocations.en: a person who saddles others with work
collocations.zh: 把工作负担强加给别人的人

collocations.mt: wekkej li jħalli l-inkwiet f'idejn ħaddieħor
collocations.en: a person who leaves others saddled with the trouble
collocations.zh: 把麻烦甩给别人承担的人

formal.mt: Fil-kummiedja, il-kap huwa wekkej li jġiegħel lill-impjegati jieħdu x-xogħol kollu li ħadd ma jrid jagħmel.
formal.en: In the comedy, the boss is someone who saddles others with unwanted tasks, making the employees take all the work nobody wants to do.
formal.zh: 在这部喜剧中，老板是个把讨厌的差事强加给别人的人，所有没人愿意做的工作都被他塞给员工。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex qed issejjaħ lil Mark wekkej? Lara: Għax jaf li ma nħobbx inaddaf il-maħżen, imma dejjem jgħabbi lili b'dak ix-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why are you calling Mark someone who dumps unwanted tasks on others? Lara: Because he knows I dislike cleaning the storeroom, but he always saddles me with that job.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你为什么说马克总把别人不愿做的事塞给别人？拉拉：因为他明知道我不喜欢打扫储藏室，却总把这件差事压给我。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed issejjaħ lil Mark wekkej?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed issejjaħ lil Mark wekkej?
messages.zh: 你为什么说马克总把别人不愿做的事塞给别人？
messages.en: Why are you calling Mark someone who dumps unwanted tasks on others?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jaf li ma nħobbx inaddaf il-maħżen, imma dejjem jgħabbi lili b'dak ix-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jaf li ma nħobbx inaddaf il-maħżen, imma dejjem jgħabbi lili b'dak ix-xogħol.
messages.zh: 因为他明知道我不喜欢打扫储藏室，却总把这件差事压给我。
messages.en: Because he knows I dislike cleaning the storeroom, but he always saddles me with that job.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人把写着“你最讨厌的差事”的重箱塞进别人怀里；给塞箱子的人贴上 wekkej，重点记住负担违背接收者的意愿。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To call out, using one's voice to attract attention or make oneself heard.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出声呼喊，以引起注意或让别人听见。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħajjat biex jiġbed l-attenzjoni jew biex ħaddieħor jisimgħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呼喊；大声叫喊以让别人听见。

formal.mt: Meta ra li t-tifel kien sejjer lejn it-triq, wela biex jiġbidlu l-attenzjoni.
formal.en: When he saw that the boy was heading towards the road, he called out to attract his attention.
formal.zh: 看到男孩正朝马路走去时，他呼喊起来，想引起男孩的注意。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex wela Mark? Toni: Wela għall-għajnuna meta ra d-duħħan.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark call out? Toni: He called out for help when he saw the smoke.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么喊起来了？托尼：他看见烟后就呼喊求助。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 马克为什么喊起来了？
messages.en: Why did Mark call out?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.zh: 他看见烟后就呼喊求助。
messages.en: He called out for help when he saw the smoke.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 wela 放进“看见远处的人，马上开口呼喊”的画面里；记忆重点是发声叫喊、让对方听见这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who gives birth, or a person who creates something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生育、分娩的人，也可指创造出某事物的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li twelled, jew persuna li toħloq xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生育、分娩的人。
创造者；创造出某事物的人。

collocations.en: the creator of an artistic work

formal.mt: L-essay jippreżenta lill-artist bħala l-wellied ta' opra li tgħaqqad il-pittura mal-poeżija.
formal.en: The essay presents the artist as the creator of a work that combines painting with poetry.
formal.zh: 这篇文章把这位艺术家描写为一部融合绘画与诗歌的作品的创造者。

colloquial.mt: Lara: F'dan it-test, wellied tfisser xi ħadd li joħloq? Pawlu: Le, hawn tfisser persuna li twelled; f'test ieħor tista' tfisser kreatur.
colloquial.en: Lara: In this text, does wellied mean someone who creates? Pawlu: No, here it means a person who gives birth; in another text it can mean a creator.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这篇文章里的 wellied 是指创造者吗？保罗：不是，这里指分娩的人；在另一篇文章里，它可以表示创造者。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dan it-test, wellied tfisser xi ħadd li joħloq?
messages.mt_standard: F'dan it-test, wellied tfisser xi ħadd li joħloq?
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 wellied 是指创造者吗？
messages.en: In this text, does wellied mean someone who creates?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hawn tfisser persuna li twelled; f'test ieħor tista' tfisser kreatur.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hawn tfisser persuna li twelled; f'test ieħor tista' tfisser kreatur.
messages.zh: 不是，这里指分娩的人；在另一篇文章里，它可以表示创造者。
messages.en: No, here it means a person who gives birth; in another text it can mean a creator.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 wellied 配两幅学习图：一幅是分娩者迎来孩子，一幅是创作者完成作品。用两种“带来新事物”的画面帮助记住不同义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Capable of producing offspring or bringing new things and ideas into being.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够繁衍后代的；也可形容能够产生新事物或新思想的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jnissel il-frieħ jew joħloq affarijiet u ideat ġodda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能繁殖、孕育后代的。
能创造、产生新事物的。

collocations.en: a mind that generates new ideas

formal.mt: Il-kittieb għandu moħħ welliedi u joħloq karattri ġodda għal kull storja.
formal.en: The writer has a creative mind and invents new characters for every story.
formal.zh: 这位作家的头脑富于创造力，每个故事都会构思出新人物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif jirnexxilek toħroġ b'tant ideat? Pawlu: Għandi moħħ welliedi, imma nikteb kollox biex ma ninsa xejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do you manage to come up with so many ideas? Pawlu: I have a creative mind, but I write everything down so I don't forget anything.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么能想出这么多点子？保罗：我的脑子爱出新点子，不过我会全部记下来，免得忘记。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么能想出这么多点子？
messages.en: How do you manage to come up with so many ideas?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (作家)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi moħħ welliedi, imma nikteb kollox biex ma ninsa xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi moħħ welliedi, imma nikteb kollox biex ma ninsa xejn.
messages.zh: 我的脑子爱出新点子，不过我会全部记下来，免得忘记。
messages.en: I have a creative mind, but I write everything down so I don't forget anything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成“能孕育”：动物孕育后代，头脑孕育点子；用同一幅画面区分繁衍与创造两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To comfort someone who is distressed or help someone feel reassured and less worried.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 安慰难过的人，或通过陪伴、言语等使担忧的人放下心来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti faraġ lil xi ħadd imnikket jew jgħinu jħossu aktar kalm u inqas inkwetat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安慰、抚慰悲伤或难过的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: to put one's mind at rest
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人安心，消除心中的担忧。

collocations.en: he reassured the family with the good news
collocations.zh: 他用好消息使一家人安心

formal.mt: L-għalliem wennes lill-istudent wara r-riżultat ħażin u għenu jħejji pjan ġdid għall-istudju.
formal.en: The teacher comforted the student after the poor result and helped him prepare a new study plan.
formal.zh: 成绩不理想后，老师安慰了这名学生，并帮助他制定新的学习计划。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kont inkwetata ħafna dwar l-eżami. Mark: Min għenek tikkalma? Lara: Ħija wennes lili u qalli li għad għandi żmien biex nipprepara.
colloquial.en: Lara: I was very worried about the exam. Mark: Who helped you calm down? Lara: My brother reassured me and told me I still have time to prepare.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：我之前特别担心考试。马克：谁帮你平静下来了？劳拉：我哥哥安慰了我，说我还有时间准备。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 我之前特别担心考试。
messages.en: I was very worried about the exam.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 谁帮你平静下来了？
messages.en: Who helped you calm down?

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija wennes lili u qalli li għad għandi żmien biex nipprepara.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija wennes lili u qalli li għad għandi żmien biex nipprepara.
messages.zh: 我哥哥安慰了我，说我还有时间准备。
messages.en: My brother reassured me and told me I still have time to prepare.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友先听你诉苦，再说几句话让你放心；把“安慰悲伤”和“解除担忧”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who keeps someone company or shares an activity or experience with them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 陪在某人身边，或与其共同活动、共同经历事情的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li żżomm kumpanija lil xi ħadd jew taqsam miegħu attività jew esperjenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伙伴、同伴；陪伴某人的人。

collocations.en: a companion during a difficult time
collocations.zh: 困难时期陪在身边的人

formal.mt: Matul il-vjaġġ twil, Pawlu kien wennies għal sieħbu u qasam miegħu l-esperjenzi ta' kuljum.
formal.en: During the long journey, Pawlu was a companion to his friend and shared everyday experiences with him.
formal.zh: 在漫长的旅途中，保罗陪伴着朋友，与他分享每天的经历。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Se tmur timxi waħdek? Toni: Le, Pawlu ġej miegħi. Hu wennies tajjeb u dejjem ikollna fuqiex nitkellmu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you going for a walk alone? Toni: No, Pawlu is coming with me. He's a good companion, and we always have something to talk about.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你要一个人去散步吗？托尼：不，保罗会跟我一起去。他是个好伙伴，我们总有话聊。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要一个人去散步吗？
messages.en: Are you going for a walk alone?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, Pawlu ġej miegħi. Hu wennies tajjeb u dejjem ikollna fuqiex nitkellmu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, Pawlu ġej miegħi. Hu wennies tajjeb u dejjem ikollna fuqiex nitkellmu.
messages.zh: 不，保罗会跟我一起去。他是个好伙伴，我们总有话聊。
messages.en: No, Pawlu is coming with me. He's a good companion, and we always have something to talk about.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住并肩散步、一路聊天的两个人：这个名词指“陪伴你的人”，可以是旅伴，也可以是日常伙伴。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Making someone feel safe, supported, and free from a sense of threat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人感到安全、受到支持而不再害怕的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħossu sigur, megħjun u mingħajr biża'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人产生安全感的；令人感到安稳、有依靠的。

collocations.en: a voice that makes one feel safe
words that give a sense of security

formal.mt: L-infermier tkellem b'leħen wenniesi u spjega lit-tifel li ommu kienet se tibqa' ħdejh.
formal.en: The nurse spoke in a reassuring voice and explained to the boy that his mother would stay beside him.
formal.zh: 护士用令人有安全感的声音告诉男孩，妈妈会一直陪在他身旁。

colloquial.mt: Nina: It-tifel kien jibża' meta wasal? Rita: Iva, imma missieru kellmu b'leħen wenniesi u baqa' ħdejh.
colloquial.en: Nina: Was the boy afraid when he arrived? Rita: Yes, but his father spoke to him in a reassuring voice and stayed beside him.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：那个男孩刚到的时候害怕吗？丽塔：害怕，不过他爸爸用让人安心的声音跟他说话，还一直陪在旁边。

messages.speaker: Nina (教师)
messages.zh: 那个男孩刚到的时候害怕吗？
messages.en: Was the boy afraid when he arrived?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma missieru kellmu b'leħen wenniesi u baqa' ħdejh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma missieru kellmu b'leħen wenniesi u baqa' ħdejh.
messages.zh: 害怕，不过他爸爸用让人安心的声音跟他说话，还一直陪在旁边。
messages.en: Yes, but his father spoke to him in a reassuring voice and stayed beside him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象害怕的孩子听到熟悉的声音，马上觉得有人保护自己；这个形容词突出“带来安全感”。

gloss_zh: 令人安心的；带来安全感的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Helping someone feel mentally at ease or giving them a sense of safety and security.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人心情安定、减少忧虑的，或使人感到安全可靠的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jserraħ il-moħħ jew jagħti lil xi ħadd sens ta' sigurtà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人心安、减少忧虑的。
使人产生安全感、感到安稳的。

collocations.en: words that bring peace of mind

formal.mt: Il-kliem wensi tal-għalliem għen lill-istudent iħossu aktar kalm qabel il-preżentazzjoni.
formal.en: The teacher's reassuring words helped the student feel calmer before the presentation.
formal.zh: 老师令人安心的话语帮助这名学生在展示前平静下来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadek inkwetat dwar għada? Mark: Inqas minn qabel. Il-kliem wensi ta' oħti għenni nikkalma.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you still worried about tomorrow? Mark: Less than before. My sister's reassuring words helped me calm down.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你还在担心明天的事吗？马克：比之前好多了。我姐姐那些让人安心的话帮我平静下来了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还在担心明天的事吗？
messages.en: Are you still worried about tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Inqas minn qabel. Il-kliem wensi ta' oħti għenni nikkalma.
messages.mt_standard: Inqas minn qabel. Il-kliem wensi ta' oħti għenni nikkalma.
messages.zh: 比之前好多了。我姐姐那些让人安心的话帮我平静下来了。
messages.en: Less than before. My sister's reassuring words helped me calm down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“心里的石头落地”记住它：既可以是忧虑消退的心安，也可以是觉得受到保护的安全感。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The leaves of a plant or tree, considered together or as more than one leaf.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物或树木的叶子，用于指多片叶子或叶子的整体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-partijiet ċatti ta' pjanta jew siġra li jikbru fuq iz-zkuk jew il-friegħi, meqjusa flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 叶子；树叶，指多片或统称。

formal.mt: Fil-ħarifa, il-weraq ta' xi siġar jibdel il-kulur u jaqa' mal-art.
formal.en: In autumn, the leaves of some trees change colour and fall to the ground.
formal.zh: 秋天，有些树木的叶子会变色并落到地上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tiknes il-ġnien? Toni: Ir-riħ mela l-mogħdija bil-weraq niexef, u rrid innaddafha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you sweeping the garden? Toni: The wind covered the path with dry leaves, and I want to clear it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么在扫花园？托尼：风把枯叶吹得小路上到处都是，我想清理一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 你为什么在扫花园？
messages.en: Why are you sweeping the garden?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-riħ mela l-mogħdija bil-weraq niexef, u rrid innaddafha.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-riħ mela l-mogħdija bil-weraq niexef, u rrid innaddafha.
messages.zh: 风把枯叶吹得小路上到处都是，我想清理一下。
messages.en: The wind covered the path with dry leaves, and I want to clear it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词和“一树绿叶、一地枯叶”两幅画面绑定；看到 weraq，就想到多片叶子或整片叶子的集合。

gloss_zh: 不停地哼唱；警铃或防空警报鸣啸

teaching_sense.en_definition: To keep humming, or, of an alarm bell or air raid alarm, to make a loud howling sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持续地哼唱；也指警铃或防空警报发出响亮的鸣啸声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikanta minn taħt l-ilsien bla waqfien; jew, dwar qanpiena tal-allarm jew allarm ta' attakk mill-ajru, jagħmel ħoss qawwi li jixbah għajta twila.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不停地哼唱，持续低声哼着。

sense_translations.en_definition: to howl (used of an alarm bell or air raid alarm)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸣啸、发出响亮而拖长的警报声，用于警铃或防空警报。

formal.mt: Matul l-eżerċizzju tal-evakwazzjoni, l-allarm werden għal minuta u kulħadd ħareġ mill-bini.
formal.en: During the evacuation drill, the alarm howled for a minute and everyone left the building.
formal.zh: 疏散演习期间，警报鸣啸了一分钟，所有人都离开了大楼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma stajtx tikkonċentra? Toni: Pawlu werden il-ħin kollu waqt li kont naqra. Fl-aħħar tlabtu jieqaf ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why couldn't you concentrate? Toni: Pawlu kept humming the whole time while I was reading. Eventually I asked him to stop for a while.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么没法集中注意力？托尼：我看书时，保罗一直哼个不停。最后我请他停一会儿。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么没法集中注意力？
messages.en: Why couldn't you concentrate?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu werden il-ħin kollu waqt li kont naqra. Fl-aħħar tlabtu jieqaf ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu werden il-ħin kollu waqt li kont naqra. Fl-aħħar tlabtu jieqaf ftit.
messages.zh: 我看书时，保罗一直哼个不停。最后我请他停一会儿。
messages.en: Pawlu kept humming the whole time while I was reading. Eventually I asked him to stop for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两段声音记忆：人低声哼个不停，警报高声拖长鸣响；根据发声的是人还是警报选择对应义项。

gloss_zh: 发出嗡嗡声或呼呼声的东西

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thing that produces a whirring or humming sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 会发出连续嗡嗡声或呼呼声的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tagħmel ħoss kontinwu ta' żanżin jew tidwir.

sense_translations.en_definition: sth. that produces a whirring or humming sound
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出嗡嗡声或呼呼声的东西。

collocations.en: a noisy thing that whirs or hums
collocations.zh: 发出很响嗡嗡声的东西

collocations.en: the sound of something that whirs or hums
collocations.zh: 嗡嗡作响的东西发出的声音

formal.mt: Il-mutur il-qadim huwa werdien li jinstema' minn kull kamra tal-bini.
formal.en: The old motor is a humming object that can be heard from every room in the building.
formal.zh: 那台旧马达嗡嗡作响，楼里每个房间都能听见。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak il-ħoss? Toni: Il-fann il-qadim. Dak werdien storbjuż!
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that noise? Toni: The old fan. That thing really whirs loudly!
colloquial.zh: Maja：那是什么声音？Toni：旧风扇。那东西呼呼响得可真厉害！

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 那是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that noise?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 旧风扇。那东西呼呼响得可真厉害！
messages.en: The old fan. That thing really whirs loudly!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一台一直嗡嗡响的旧风扇，把 werdien 记成发出这种声音的东西。

gloss_zh: 容易发出嗡嗡声或呼呼声的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to make a whirring or humming sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容容易或经常发出嗡嗡声、呼呼声的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jagħmel ħoss ta' żanżin jew tidwir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易或经常发出嗡嗡声、呼呼声的。

collocations.en: a motor that tends to hum
a fan that tends to whir

formal.mt: Il-mutur werdieni għandu jitqiegħed 'il bogħod mill-kamra tal-qari biex ma jfixkilx lill-qarrejja.
formal.en: The motor that tends to hum should be placed away from the reading room so that it does not disturb readers.
formal.zh: 这台容易嗡嗡作响的马达应放在远离阅览室的地方，以免打扰读者。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ma tużax dak il-fann? Mark: Għax hu werdieni wisq u jdejjaqni waqt li naqra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why don't you use that fan? Mark: Because it whirs too much and bothers me while I read.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么不用那台风扇？Mark：因为它老是呼呼响，我看书时觉得很烦。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不用那台风扇？
messages.en: Why don't you use that fan?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu werdieni wisq u jdejjaqni waqt li naqra.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu werdieni wisq u jdejjaqni waqt li naqra.
messages.zh: 因为它老是呼呼响，我看书时觉得很烦。
messages.en: Because it whirs too much and bothers me while I read.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用风扇作画面：werdieni 描述它爱嗡嗡响的特点，学习时记住这是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A leaf of a plant; also foliage, meaning the leaves of a plant considered together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物的叶子；也可指作为整体理解的植物枝叶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti ta' pjanta, ġeneralment ħadra u ċatta; tista' tirreferi wkoll għall-weraq ta' pjanta meqjus flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 叶；叶子，植物上通常呈绿色的扁平部分。
枝叶；作为整体理解的植物叶片。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw werqa ħadra u ddeskrivew il-forma u l-kulur tagħha.
formal.en: The students examined a green leaf and described its shape and colour.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了一片绿叶，并描述了它的形状和颜色。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'sibt fil-ġnien? Ben: Werqa kbira taħt is-siġra. Ara kemm hi sabiħa!
colloquial.en: Lara: What did you find in the garden? Ben: A big leaf under the tree. Look how beautiful it is!
colloquial.zh: Lara：你在花园里找到了什么？Ben：树下的一片大叶子。你看，多漂亮！

messages.speaker: Lara (姐姐)
messages.zh: 你在花园里找到了什么？
messages.en: What did you find in the garden?

messages.speaker: Ben (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Werqa kbira taħt is-siġra. Ara kemm hi sabiħa!
messages.mt_standard: Werqa kbira taħt is-siġra. Ara kemm hi sabiħa!
messages.zh: 树下的一片大叶子。你看，多漂亮！
messages.en: A big leaf under the tree. Look how beautiful it is!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手掌托着一片绿叶来记 werqa；再把视线移向整株植物，联想枝叶义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a plant to grow leaves or begin to come into leaf.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指植物长出叶子，或进入开始展叶的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal pjanta meta tikber il-weraq jew tibda toħroġ il-weraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长出叶子；生长出叶片。
开始展叶；进入长出新叶的阶段。

formal.mt: Wara x-xita tar-rebbiegħa, l-arbuxxell werraq u beda jikber b'ritmu aktar mgħaġġel.
formal.en: After the spring rain, the shrub came into leaf and began to grow more quickly.
formal.zh: 春雨过后，灌木开始展叶，生长速度也加快了。

colloquial.mt: Nina: L-arbuxxell għadu bla weraq? Pawlu: Le, werraq din il-ġimgħa. Ejja ara l-weraq il-ġdid!
colloquial.en: Nina: Is the shrub still bare? Pawlu: No, it came into leaf this week. Come and see the new leaves!
colloquial.zh: Nina：那棵灌木还没长叶子吗？Pawlu：已经长了，这周刚展叶。来看看新叶子！

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.zh: 那棵灌木还没长叶子吗？
messages.en: Is the shrub still bare?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园主)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, werraq din il-ġimgħa. Ejja ara l-weraq il-ġdid!
messages.mt_standard: Le, werraq din il-ġimgħa. Ejja ara l-weraq il-ġdid!
messages.zh: 已经长了，这周刚展叶。来看看新叶子！
messages.en: No, it came into leaf this week. Come and see the new leaves!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把光秃枝条逐渐冒出新叶的过程当作记忆动画：werraq 表示长叶、展叶。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To walk with difficulty, making slow or effortful progress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 走路吃力，艰难地向前行走。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimxi b'diffikultà u bi sforz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 艰难地行走；走路吃力。

collocations.en: walked with difficulty to the door
walked with difficulty along the road

formal.mt: Wara li weġġa' saqajh, ir-raġel werrek sal-bank u qagħad bilqiegħda biex jistrieħ.
formal.en: After hurting his foot, the man walked with difficulty to the bench and sat down to rest.
formal.zh: 脚受伤后，那名男子艰难地走到长椅旁，坐下来休息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif wasal Toni sad-dar? Lara: Werrek sal-bieb, u mbagħad għentu jidħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Toni get home? Lara: He struggled to walk to the door, and then I helped him inside.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Toni 是怎么到家的？Lara：他艰难地走到门口，然后我扶他进去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Toni 是怎么到家的？
messages.en: How did Toni get home?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Werrek sal-bieb, u mbagħad għentu jidħol.
messages.mt_standard: Werrek sal-bieb, u mbagħad għentu jidħol.
messages.zh: 他艰难地走到门口，然后我扶他进去了。
messages.en: He struggled to walk to the door, and then I helped him inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象脚受伤后每一步都很费力，用这段动作画面记住 werrek 的艰难行走义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To slap someone in the face.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用手掌打某人的脸，即打耳光。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti daqqa bil-pala tal-id fuq wiċċ xi ħadd.

sense_translations.en_definition: to slap sb. in the face
sense_translations.zh_definition: 打某人的耳光；用手掌打某人的脸。

collocations.en: slapped his companion in the face during an argument

formal.mt: Ix-xhud stqarr li r-raġel werrex lil sieħbu waqt l-argument.
formal.en: The witness stated that the man slapped his companion in the face during the argument.
formal.zh: 证人陈述，那名男子在争吵时打了同伴耳光。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ġara barra? Mark: Wieħed werrex lil ieħor, u l-gwardjan intervjena minnufih.
colloquial.en: Sara: What happened outside? Mark: One man slapped another in the face, and the guard intervened immediately.
colloquial.zh: Sara：外面发生什么事了？Mark：一个男人打了另一个男人耳光，保安马上介入了。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 外面发生什么事了？
messages.en: What happened outside?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Wieħed werrex lil ieħor, u l-gwardjan intervjena minnufih.
messages.mt_standard: Wieħed werrex lil ieħor, u l-gwardjan intervjena minnufih.
messages.zh: 一个男人打了另一个男人耳光，保安马上介入了。
messages.en: One man slapped another in the face, and the guard intervened immediately.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时把 werrex 对应到手掌打脸这一具体动作，准确区分一般打人与打耳光。

gloss_zh: 罗圈腿的人；走路时双腿分得很开的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is bow-legged or walks with their legs spread wide apart.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指腿向外弯、呈罗圈腿的人；也指走路时双腿分得很开的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha saqajha mgħawġin lejn barra jew li timxi b'saqajha miftuħin ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 罗圈腿的人；双腿向外弯曲的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who walks with legs spread wide
sense_translations.zh_definition: 走路时双腿分得很开的人。

collocations.en: a bow-legged person with curved legs
a person who walks with their legs spread wide
collocations.zh: 走路时双腿分得很开的人

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, il-vjaġġatur huwa deskritt bħala werriek li jimxi b'saqajh miftuħin ħafna.
formal.en: In the story, the traveller is described as a person who walks with his legs spread very wide apart.
formal.zh: 故事中，这位旅人被描写为走路时双腿分得很开的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'werriek' f'din l-istorja? Toni: Xi ħadd li jimxi b'saqajh miftuħin ħafna. Il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll persuna b'saqajha mgħawġin lejn barra.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'werriek' mean in this story? Toni: Someone who walks with their legs spread very wide apart. The word can also mean a bow-legged person.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这篇故事里的 werriek 是什么意思？Toni：指走路时双腿分得很开的人。这个词也可以指罗圈腿的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这篇故事里的 werriek 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'werriek' mean in this story?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd li jimxi b'saqajh miftuħin ħafna. Il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll persuna b'saqajha mgħawġin lejn barra.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd li jimxi b'saqajh miftuħin ħafna. Il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll persuna b'saqajha mgħawġin lejn barra.
messages.zh: 指走路时双腿分得很开的人。这个词也可以指罗圈腿的人。
messages.en: Someone who walks with their legs spread very wide apart. The word can also mean a bow-legged person.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个示意画面记 werriek：一个是双腿外弯的人，一个是双腿分得很开行走的人。

gloss_zh: 罗圈腿的；双腿向外弯曲的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having legs that curve outwards, leaving the knees apart when standing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容双腿向外弯曲、站立时两膝之间留有间隔的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu saqajh mgħawġin 'il barra, bl-irkopptejn mifrudin meta jkun bilwieqfa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 罗圈腿的；双腿向外弯曲的。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt jidher raġel werrieki wieqaf ħdejn siġġu.
formal.en: The photograph shows a bandy-legged man standing beside a chair.
formal.zh: 照片中，一个罗圈腿的男人站在椅子旁边。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema karattru qed tpinġi? Toni: Qed inpinġi raġel werrieki b'kappell kbir.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which character are you drawing? Toni: I'm drawing a bandy-legged man with a big hat.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在画哪个角色？托尼：我在画一个戴着大帽子的罗圈腿男人。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在画哪个角色？
messages.en: Which character are you drawing?

messages.speaker: Toni (绘画者)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed inpinġi raġel werrieki b'kappell kbir.
messages.mt_standard: Qed inpinġi raġel werrieki b'kappell kbir.
messages.zh: 我在画一个戴着大帽子的罗圈腿男人。
messages.en: I'm drawing a bandy-legged man with a big hat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 werrieki 配上一幅双腿向外弯的简笔画，整组记住 raġel werrieki，表示罗圈腿的男人。

gloss_zh: 枝叶茂密的；叶片浓密的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having many leaves growing closely together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容叶片数量多、长得密集的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħafna weraq jikber qrib xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 叶片浓密的；枝叶茂密的。

formal.mt: Ballut werrieqi jagħti dell lill-bank fil-ġnien.
formal.en: A densely leafy oak shades the bench in the garden.
formal.zh: 一棵枝叶茂密的橡树为花园里的长椅遮阴。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn se noqogħdu bilqiegħda? Mark: Taħt dak il-ballut werrieqi; hemm ħafna dell.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where shall we sit? Mark: Under that densely leafy oak; there's plenty of shade.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们坐哪里？马克：坐在那棵枝叶茂密的橡树下吧，那里树荫很足。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们坐哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we sit?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħt dak il-ballut werrieqi; hemm ħafna dell.
messages.mt_standard: Taħt dak il-ballut werrieqi; hemm ħafna dell.
messages.zh: 坐在那棵枝叶茂密的橡树下吧，那里树荫很足。
messages.en: Under that densely leafy oak; there's plenty of shade.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 werrieqi 写在一幅叶片密密层层的树冠图旁，用浓密树荫的画面记住“枝叶茂密的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who receives, or is entitled to receive, another person's property after that person's death.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在他人去世后继承其财产，或有权继承其财产的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tirċievi, jew għandha dritt tirċievi, il-ġid ta' persuna oħra wara mewtha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 继承人；有权承受逝者遗产的人。

formal.mt: It-testment isemmi lil Pawlu bħala l-uniku werriet tal-patrimonju.
formal.en: The will names Pawlu as the sole heir to the estate.
formal.zh: 遗嘱指定保罗为该遗产的唯一继承人。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min hu l-werriet fid-dramm? Ben: In-neputi; iz-ziju ħallielu d-dar.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who is the heir in the play? Ben: The nephew; his uncle left him the house.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：剧里的继承人是谁？本：是侄子，他叔叔把房子留给了他。

messages.speaker: Anna (观众)
messages.zh: 剧里的继承人是谁？
messages.en: Who is the heir in the play?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 是侄子，他叔叔把房子留给了他。
messages.en: The nephew; his uncle left him the house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象遗嘱上标出一个接收房屋钥匙的人，在他旁边写 werriet，记住这个词指继承财产的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Passed from parents to offspring through inheritance, or relating to genes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容通过遗传由亲代传给后代的，或与基因有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jgħaddi mill-ġenituri għall-ulied permezz tal-wirt bijoloġiku, jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-ġeni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遗传的；通过生物遗传由亲代传给后代的。
基因的；与基因或遗传构成有关的。

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jispjega kif fattur werrieti jista' jinfluwenza karatteristika tal-ġisem.
formal.en: The chapter explains how a genetic factor can influence a physical characteristic.
formal.zh: 本章解释遗传因素如何影响身体特征。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'werrieti' hawn? Lara: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mal-ġeni; f'dan l-eżempju, il-karattru jgħaddi mill-ġenituri għall-ulied.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'werrieti' mean here? Lara: It means relating to genes; in this example, the trait passes from parents to children.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 werrieti 是什么意思？拉拉：意思是与基因有关；在这个例子里，这个特征由父母传给子女。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 werrieti 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'werrieti' mean here?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mal-ġeni; f'dan l-eżempju, il-karattru jgħaddi mill-ġenituri għall-ulied.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mal-ġeni; f'dan l-eżempju, il-karattru jgħaddi mill-ġenituri għall-ulied.
messages.zh: 意思是与基因有关；在这个例子里，这个特征由父母传给子女。
messages.en: It means relating to genes; in this example, the trait passes from parents to children.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 werrieti 画两张学习卡：亲代传给后代对应“遗传的”，基因图示对应“基因的”，分别记住两个义项。

gloss_zh: 打人耳光者；使人震惊者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who slaps someone in the face, or who shocks someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指打别人耳光的人，也可指使别人感到震惊的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħti daqqa ta' ħarta lil xi ħadd, jew li taħsad lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who slaps another in the face
sense_translations.zh_definition: 打别人耳光的人。
使别人震惊的人。

collocations.en: a violent person who slaps others in the face
collocations.zh: 一个动手打人耳光的暴力者

collocations.en: someone who shocks people with his words
collocations.zh: 一个言语令人震惊的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-werriex jagħti daqqa ta' ħarta lil raġel waqt argument.
formal.en: In the story, the person who slaps others strikes a man in the face during an argument.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个打人耳光者在争吵时扇了一个男人一巴掌。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex issejjaħlu werriex? Toni: Għax jaħsad lil kulħadd bi kliemu, anki meta jitkellem bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do you call him someone who shocks people? Toni: Because he shocks everyone with his words, even when he speaks calmly.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么说他是个使人震惊的人？托尼：因为他说的话让所有人震惊，即使他语气平静也是如此。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么说他是个使人震惊的人？
messages.en: Why do you call him someone who shocks people?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jaħsad lil kulħadd bi kliemu, anki meta jitkellem bil-kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jaħsad lil kulħadd bi kliemu, anki meta jitkellem bil-kalma.
messages.zh: 因为他说的话让所有人震惊，即使他语气平静也是如此。
messages.en: Because he shocks everyone with his words, even when he speaks calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅人物画记 werriex：一幅是打耳光的人，一幅是说话令人震惊的人；两种意思都指人。

gloss_zh: 如挨耳光般令人震动的；令人震惊的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Producing a sudden shock like a slap in the face, or leaving someone stunned.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容带来如同挨了一记耳光般的突然冲击，或令人震惊、愕然的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħalli effett bħal daqqa ta' ħarta, jew li jħalli lil xi ħadd mistagħġeb u maħsud.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the effect of a slap in the face
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有如同挨了一记耳光般冲击效果的。
令人震惊的；使人愕然的。

collocations.en: an effect like a slap in the face
collocations.zh: 如挨耳光般的冲击效果

formal.mt: Id-diskors kellu effett werriexi fuq l-udjenza, li baqgħet fis-skiet.
formal.en: The speech had an effect like a slap in the face on the audience, who fell silent.
formal.zh: 演讲给听众带来如同挨了一记耳光般的冲击，大家都沉默了。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex kulħadd baqa' sieket? Anna: Dak kien kliem werriexi; ħadd ma stenna li jgħid hekk.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did everyone go quiet? Anna: Those were stunning words; nobody expected him to say that.
colloquial.zh: 马克：大家为什么都不说话了？安娜：那些话太令人震惊了，谁也没想到他会那样说。

messages.speaker: Mark (听众)
messages.zh: 大家为什么都不说话了？
messages.en: Why did everyone go quiet?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak kien kliem werriexi; ħadd ma stenna li jgħid hekk.
messages.mt_standard: Dak kien kliem werriexi; ħadd ma stenna li jgħid hekk.
messages.zh: 那些话太令人震惊了，谁也没想到他会那样说。
messages.en: Those were stunning words; nobody expected him to say that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 werriexi 时想象一句话让全场突然安静，像挨了一记无形耳光；它描述造成震动的效果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that makes a person squint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人不由得眯起眼睛的东西，例如刺眼的光。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li ġġiegħel lil persuna ddejjaq għajnejha, bħal dawl qawwi.

sense_translations.en_definition: sth. that causes one to squint
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人眯起眼睛的东西。

collocations.en: something that makes the eyes squint
a light that makes one squint

formal.mt: Id-dawl rifless mill-ħġieġ huwa werrieċ għall-persuni li jħarsu lejn il-bini.
formal.en: The light reflected from the glass makes people looking at the building squint.
formal.zh: 玻璃反射的光会让望向这栋建筑的人眯起眼睛。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed iddejjaq għajnejk? Ben: Dak id-dawl huwa werrieċ. Nistgħu nimxu ftit fid-dell?
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you squinting? Ben: That light makes me squint. Can we move into the shade?
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么眯着眼睛？Ben：那道光太刺眼了。我们能往阴凉处挪一挪吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么眯着眼睛？
messages.en: Why are you squinting?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak id-dawl huwa werrieċ. Nistgħu nimxu ftit fid-dell?
messages.mt_standard: Dak id-dawl huwa werrieċ. Nistgħu nimxu ftit fid-dell?
messages.zh: 那道光太刺眼了。我们能往阴凉处挪一挪吗？
messages.en: That light makes me squint. Can we move into the shade?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象强光照来时眼睛自动眯起，把 werrieċ 记作引起眯眼反应的东西。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who frightens others or makes them feel intense fear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使他人受惊，或让他人陷入强烈恐惧的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tbeżża' lil ħaddieħor jew iġġiegħlu jħoss biża' kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吓唬别人、使别人害怕的人。
恐吓他人、使他人陷入强烈恐惧的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-werwier tal-viċinat juża t-theddid biex iġiegħel lin-nies jobduh.
formal.en: In the novel, the man who terrorises the neighbourhood uses threats to make people obey him.
formal.zh: 小说中，那个使邻里惶恐的人用威胁迫使人们服从他。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu l-werwier f'din l-istorja? Ben: Dak ir-raġel bil-maskra li jinħeba wara l-bieb u jbeżża' lin-nies.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is the person who scares people in this story? Ben: That masked man who hides behind the door and frightens people.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个故事里吓人的人是谁？本：就是那个戴面具、躲在门后吓人的男人。

messages.speaker: Lara (读者)
messages.zh: 这个故事里吓人的人是谁？
messages.en: Who is the person who scares people in this story?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ir-raġel bil-maskra li jinħeba wara l-bieb u jbeżża' lin-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ir-raġel bil-maskra li jinħeba wara l-bieb u jbeżża' lin-nies.
messages.zh: 就是那个戴面具、躲在门后吓人的男人。
messages.en: That masked man who hides behind the door and frightens people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 werwier 放在故事中吓人的人物旁边，从突然吓一跳到持续恐吓，两个义项都聚焦造成恐惧的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing fear, or causing intense horror because something is very disturbing or terrible.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容使人害怕，或因事物极其可怕、令人不安而使人惊骇的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jqanqal il-biża', jew biża' kbira għax ikun terribbli jew inkwetanti ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 极其可怕的；令人惊骇的。
令人害怕的；使人受惊的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi inċident werwieri li seħħ fit-triq prinċipali.
formal.en: The report describes a horrific accident that occurred on the main road.
formal.zh: 报告描述了发生在主干道上的一起骇人事故。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt dak il-ħoss werwieri? Toni: Iva, kien il-bieb tal-garaxx; ir-riħ għalqu b'saħħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear that frightening sound? Toni: Yes, it was the garage door; the wind slammed it shut.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听见那个吓人的声音了吗？托尼：听见了，是车库门，风把它猛地吹关了。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 你听见那个吓人的声音了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that frightening sound?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien il-bieb tal-garaxx; ir-riħ għalqu b'saħħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien il-bieb tal-garaxx; ir-riħ għalqu b'saħħa.
messages.zh: 听见了，是车库门，风把它猛地吹关了。
messages.en: Yes, it was the garage door; the wind slammed it shut.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“吓人的声音”和“骇人的事故”两张画面记 werwieri：前者帮助记害怕，后者帮助记更强烈的惊骇。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A condition in which the eyes are not aligned and do not look in the same direction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 双眼位置不协调、不能朝同一方向注视的状况，即斜视。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li fiha l-għajnejn ma jkunux allinjati u ma jħarsux fl-istess direzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 斜视，即双眼视轴不一致的状况。
眼睛出现斜视、双眼注视方向不一致的状况。

formal.mt: Wara l-eżami tal-għajnejn, it-tabib spjega lill-ġenituri d-dijanjożi ta' werċiżmu.
formal.en: After the eye examination, the doctor explained the diagnosis of strabismus to the parents.
formal.zh: 眼部检查后，医生向家长解释了斜视的诊断结果。

colloquial.mt: Sara: It-tabib semma l-werċiżmu. Xi jfisser? Mark: Ifisser li l-għajnejn ma jkunux allinjati u ma jħarsux fl-istess direzzjoni.
colloquial.en: Sara: The doctor mentioned strabismus. What does it mean? Mark: It means that the eyes are not aligned and do not look in the same direction.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：医生提到了斜视。那是什么意思？马克：就是说双眼没有对齐，看向的方向不一致。

messages.speaker: Sara (家长)
messages.zh: 医生提到了斜视。那是什么意思？
messages.en: The doctor mentioned strabismus. What does it mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (家长)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-għajnejn ma jkunux allinjati u ma jħarsux fl-istess direzzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-għajnejn ma jkunux allinjati u ma jħarsux fl-istess direzzjoni.
messages.zh: 就是说双眼没有对齐，看向的方向不一致。
messages.en: It means that the eyes are not aligned and do not look in the same direction.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两只眼睛，再画指向不同方向的箭头，用这幅图记“斜视”；这里的英语 squint 指斜视，不是普通眯眼。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give a loud cry or a sharp, high-pitched scream, especially from fear, pain, or excitement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因恐惧、疼痛或激动等发出响亮的叫声或尖锐的喊声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ għajta qawwija jew għolja ħafna, speċjalment minħabba biża', uġigħ jew eċċitament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大叫；因恐惧、疼痛或激动等高声喊叫。
尖叫；发出尖锐而刺耳的叫声。

formal.mt: It-tifel werżaq bil-biża' meta sema' ħoss qawwi fil-kuritur.
formal.en: The boy screamed in fear when he heard a loud noise in the corridor.
formal.zh: 男孩听见走廊里传来一声巨响，吓得大叫起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex werżaq it-tifel? Pawlu: Ra brimba kbira, imma issa kkalma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the boy scream? Pawlu: He saw a big spider, but he has calmed down now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那个男孩为什么大叫？Pawlu：他看见了一只大蜘蛛，不过现在已经平静下来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 那个男孩为什么大叫？
messages.en: Why did the boy scream?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ra brimba kbira, imma issa kkalma.
messages.mt_standard: Ra brimba kbira, imma issa kkalma.
messages.zh: 他看见了一只大蜘蛛，不过现在已经平静下来了。
messages.en: He saw a big spider, but he has calmed down now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个动词与“突然看见蜘蛛，吓得叫出声”的画面绑定，记住它表示发出叫声的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cricket: an insect known for its chirping sound, often heard at night.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蟋蟀，一种以鸣叫声为人熟知、夜间常能听见其叫声的昆虫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insett li jagħmel ħoss karatteristiku li spiss jinstema' billejl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蟋蟀，常在夜间发出鸣叫声的昆虫。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-ġnien, l-istudenti semgħu l-ħoss ta' werżieq ta' billejl qalb il-ħaxix.
formal.en: During their observation of the garden, the students heard a cricket chirping among the grass.
formal.zh: 学生们观察花园时，听见草丛里传来蟋蟀的鸣叫声。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'inhu dak il-ħoss fil-ġnien? Toni: Hemm werżieq ta' billejl qalb il-ħaxix.
colloquial.en: Lina: What's that sound in the garden? Toni: There's a cricket among the grass.
colloquial.zh: Lina：花园里那是什么声音？Toni：草丛里有一只蟋蟀。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.zh: 花园里那是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that sound in the garden?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm werżieq ta' billejl qalb il-ħaxix.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm werżieq ta' billejl qalb il-ħaxix.
messages.zh: 草丛里有一只蟋蟀。
messages.en: There's a cricket among the grass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语记成“夜晚草丛里的小歌手”，看见夜间花园的画面，就联想到蟋蟀。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who tends to scream, or a voice that is high-pitched.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人容易或经常尖叫，也可形容嗓音尖细、音调很高。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li għandu tendenza jgħajjat ħafna, jew leħen li għandu ton għoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易尖叫的；动不动就高声喊叫的。
嗓音尖细的；说话声音音调很高的。

collocations.en: a boy who tends to scream

formal.mt: L-attur uża leħen werżieqi biex jagħti lill-karattru ton komiku.
formal.en: The actor used a high-pitched voice to give the character a comic tone.
formal.zh: 演员用尖细的嗓音为角色增添了喜剧色彩。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dak l-attur għandu leħen werżieqi ħafna. Mark: Iva, nagħrfu mill-ewwel meta jitkellem.
colloquial.en: Sara: That actor has a very high-pitched voice. Mark: Yes, I recognize him as soon as he speaks.
colloquial.zh: Sara：那个演员的嗓音特别尖细。Mark：是啊，他一开口我就认得出来。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak l-attur għandu leħen werżieqi ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Dak l-attur għandu leħen werżieqi ħafna.
messages.zh: 那个演员的嗓音特别尖细。
messages.en: That actor has a very high-pitched voice.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，他一开口我就认得出来。
messages.en: Yes, I recognize him as soon as he speaks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想两张人物卡：一张写“总爱尖叫”，另一张写“嗓音尖细”；这个形容词可描述这两种特点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have enough space or capacity to hold or accommodate someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有足够的空间或容量，可以容纳人或装下东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu biżżejjed spazju jew kapaċità biex iżomm fih nies jew affarijiet.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be wide enough to have a capacity of; to be able to hold; to be able to accommodate
sense_translations.zh_definition: 空间或容量足够；能装下；能容纳。

collocations.en: had room for all the suitcases

formal.mt: Il-vann wesa' l-bagalji kollha tal-grupp mingħajr diffikultà.
formal.en: The van had room for all the group's suitcases without difficulty.
formal.zh: 那辆厢式车轻松装下了全组的所有行李箱。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Il-vann wesa' l-bagalji kollha? David: Iva, u kien għad fadal ftit spazju.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did the van have room for all the suitcases? David: Yes, and there was still a little space left.
colloquial.zh: Anna：那辆厢式车装得下所有行李箱吗？David：装得下，而且还剩了一点空间。

messages.speaker: Anna (旅客)
messages.zh: 那辆厢式车装得下所有行李箱吗？
messages.en: Did the van have room for all the suitcases?

messages.speaker: David (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u kien għad fadal ftit spazju.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u kien għad fadal ftit spazju.
messages.zh: 装得下，而且还剩了一点空间。
messages.en: Yes, and there was still a little space left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把所有行李放进车里，车门还能关上：这个词关注“容量够，装得下”。注意与双写 s 的 wessa' 区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Greater in amount than is needed, suitable, or wanted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数量超过需要、合适程度或期望的；过量的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaqbeż l-ammont meħtieġ, xieraq jew mixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 超出所需数量的；过量的。
太多的；数量多到不合适的。

formal.mt: Ammont wesqa ta' melħ jista' jaħbi t-togħma tal-ingredjenti l-oħra.
formal.en: An excessive amount of salt can mask the flavour of the other ingredients.
formal.zh: 盐放得过多可能会掩盖其他食材的味道。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan l-ammont ta' zokkor hu wesqa għal tazza waħda. Ġanni: Sewwa, se nuża nofsu biss.
colloquial.en: Marija: This amount of sugar is too much for one cup. Ġanni: All right, I'll use only half of it.
colloquial.zh: Marija：一杯放这么多糖太多了。Ġanni：好，那我只用一半。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-ammont ta' zokkor hu wesqa għal tazza waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-ammont ta' zokkor hu wesqa għal tazza waħda.
messages.zh: 一杯放这么多糖太多了。
messages.en: This amount of sugar is too much for one cup.

messages.speaker: Ġanni (儿子)
messages.zh: 好，那我只用一半。
messages.en: All right, I'll use only half of it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一杯茶旁堆着过多的糖，把这个形容词与“超过合适用量”绑定，而不只是一般的“多”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something wider, larger, or broader in scope.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变宽、变大，或使其范围更加广泛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa usa' jew akbar, jew iżid il-firxa tagħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: to widen, to broaden, to expand
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拓宽；使变宽；扩大或扩展范围。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill wessa' l-bankina quddiem l-iskola biex itejjeb l-aċċess għall-persuni mexjin.
formal.en: The council widened the pavement in front of the school to improve access for pedestrians.
formal.zh: 地方议会拓宽了学校门前的人行道，以便行人通行。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-mastrudaxxa wessa' l-mejda? Karl: Iva, issa nistgħu noqogħdu sitta madwarha.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did the carpenter widen the table? Karl: Yes, now six of us can sit around it.
colloquial.zh: Rita：木匠把桌子加宽了吗？Karl：加宽了，现在我们六个人可以围着它坐。

messages.speaker: Rita (妻子)
messages.zh: 木匠把桌子加宽了吗？
messages.en: Did the carpenter widen the table?

messages.speaker: Karl (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa nistgħu noqogħdu sitta madwarha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa nistgħu noqogħdu sitta madwarha.
messages.zh: 加宽了，现在我们六个人可以围着它坐。
messages.en: Yes, now six of us can sit around it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把双写的 ss 当作学习时的视觉提示：两边向外推，空间变宽。wessa' 表示“使扩大”，wesa' 表示“容得下”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To increase the amount or quantity of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物的数量或用量增加。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżid l-ammont jew il-kwantità ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 增加数量；使数量或用量增多。

formal.mt: Il-kok wessaq l-ammont ta' ross biex jipprepara biżżejjed ikel għall-mistednin kollha.
formal.en: The cook increased the amount of rice to prepare enough food for all the guests.
formal.zh: 厨师增加了米的用量，以便为所有客人准备足够的食物。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Wessaq l-ammont ta' ross illum? Pietru: Iva, għax se jiġu żewġ mistednin oħra.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did he increase the amount of rice today? Pietru: Yes, because two more guests are coming.
colloquial.zh: Nina：他今天增加米的用量了吗？Pietru：增加了，因为还会多来两位客人。

messages.speaker: Nina (厨房助手)
messages.zh: 他今天增加米的用量了吗？
messages.en: Did he increase the amount of rice today?

messages.speaker: Pietru (厨房助手)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax se jiġu żewġ mistednin oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax se jiġu żewġ mistednin oħra.
messages.zh: 增加了，因为还会多来两位客人。
messages.en: Yes, because two more guests are coming.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象量杯里的米从一格增加到两格，记住 wessaq 关注数量增多；用“多加一份”的动作帮助回忆。

gloss_zh: 做事过头的人；过度用力的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who habitually does more than is necessary or takes things too far.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 习惯于做得超过必要程度、容易把事情做过头的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li s-soltu tagħmel aktar milli hemm bżonn jew tmur lil hinn mill-miżura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 做事容易过头的人；总是做得超过必要程度的人。

collocations.en: someone who overdoes things at work
collocations.zh: 工作中容易做过头的人

collocations.en: someone who goes overboard with decorating
collocations.zh: 布置装饰时容易做过头的人

formal.mt: L-organizzatur kien wessieq fit-tiżjin: mela s-sala b'tant dekorazzjonijiet li kien diffiċli tgħaddi.
formal.en: The organizer went overboard with decorating: he filled the hall with so many decorations that it was difficult to get through.
formal.zh: 组织者在装饰上做得过了头：他把大厅布置得满满当当，连通行都困难。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex ġab tliet kejkijiet għal erba' persuni? Mario: Hu wessieq meta jipprepara l-ikel; dejjem jagħmel aktar milli hemm bżonn.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why did he bring three cakes for four people? Mario: He overdoes things when preparing food; he always makes more than is needed.
colloquial.zh: Elena：只有四个人，他为什么带了三个蛋糕？Mario：他准备食物时总爱做过头，每次都弄得比需要的多。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ġab tliet kejkijiet għal erba' persuni?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ġab tliet kejkijiet għal erba' persuni?
messages.zh: 只有四个人，他为什么带了三个蛋糕？
messages.en: Why did he bring three cakes for four people?

messages.speaker: Mario (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu wessieq meta jipprepara l-ikel; dejjem jagħmel aktar milli hemm bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Hu wessieq meta jipprepara l-ikel; dejjem jagħmel aktar milli hemm bżonn.
messages.zh: 他准备食物时总爱做过头，每次都弄得比需要的多。
messages.en: He overdoes things when preparing food; he always makes more than is needed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象四个人聚餐，有人却端来三个大蛋糕；把这个词贴在那个人身上，记住它是指“总做过头的人”的名词。

gloss_zh: 做事过头的；过度用力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Doing things excessively or going beyond what is needed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容做事超过必要程度、投入或反应过头的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħmel l-affarijiet iżżejjed jew imur lil hinn minn dak li jkun meħtieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 做事过头的；超过必要程度的

collocations.zh: 清洁时过度用力或做得过头的

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem kien wessieqi fit-tindif u għorok il-wiċċ aktar milli kien meħtieġ.
formal.en: The worker overdid the cleaning and scrubbed the surface more than necessary.
formal.zh: 这名工人清洁时做得过头，擦洗表面的程度超过了实际需要。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għadek qed tnaddaf l-istess mejda? Pawlu: Iva, irridha perfetta. Marija: Int wessieqi fit-tindif; issa nadifa biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Marija: Are you still cleaning the same table? Pawlu: Yes, I want it perfect. Marija: You overdo the cleaning; it is clean enough now.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你还在擦同一张桌子吗？保罗：是啊，我想把它擦得完美无瑕。玛丽娅：你清洁时太容易做过头了，现在已经够干净了。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
