messages.zh: 你还在擦同一张桌子吗？
messages.en: Are you still cleaning the same table?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我想把它擦得完美无瑕。
messages.en: Yes, I want it perfect.

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int wessieqi fit-tindif; issa nadifa biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Int wessieqi fit-tindif; issa nadifa biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 你清洁时太容易做过头了，现在已经够干净了。
messages.en: You overdo the cleaning; it is clean enough now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌面已经干净，一个人仍不停擦洗；把 wessieqi 与“做过头、超过需要”的画面一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To speak very quietly in a whisper, or to mutter words in a low voice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以很轻的声音耳语，或低声嘟囔着说话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitkellem b'leħen baxx ħafna, jew jgħid kliem minn taħt l-ilsien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 耳语；轻声说话
低声嘟囔；小声咕哝

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, is-segretarju weswes f'widnejn id-direttur biex ma jinterrompix lill-kelliem.
formal.en: During the meeting, the secretary whispered in the director's ear so as not to interrupt the speaker.
formal.zh: 会议期间，秘书在主任耳边低声说话，以免打断发言者。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'qal Mark? Luqa: Ma smajtx sew; weswes xi ħaġa minn taħt l-ilsien. Anna: Ejja nitolbuh jirrepeti.
colloquial.en: Anna: What did Mark say? Luqa: I did not hear clearly; he muttered something under his breath. Anna: Let's ask him to repeat it.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马克说了什么？卢卡：我没听清，他小声嘟囔了一句。安娜：我们请他再说一遍吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克说了什么？
messages.en: What did Mark say?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma smajtx sew; weswes xi ħaġa minn taħt l-ilsien.
messages.mt_standard: Ma smajtx sew; weswes xi ħaġa minn taħt l-ilsien.
messages.zh: 我没听清，他小声嘟囔了一句。
messages.en: I did not hear clearly; he muttered something under his breath.

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们请他再说一遍吧。
messages.en: Let's ask him to repeat it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 weswes 配上两个低音量画面：凑到耳边说是“耳语”，自己小声咕哝是“嘟囔”；共同点都是轻声说话。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who whispers, or a person who spreads rumours.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 低声耳语的人，也可指传播未经证实消息、散布传闻的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titkellem b'leħen baxx ħafna, jew li xxerred xnigħat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 低声耳语的人
散布传闻的人；传播小道消息的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-weswies ixerred xnigħat li joħolqu nuqqas ta' fiduċja bejn il-ġirien.
formal.en: In the story, the rumour-monger spreads rumours that create distrust among the neighbours.
formal.zh: 故事中，散布传闻的人传播小道消息，导致邻里之间互不信任。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed issejjaħlu weswies? David: Għax dejjem jitkellem f'widnejn sħabu waqt il-lezzjoni. Sara: Forsi għandu jitkellem aktar ċar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you calling him a whisperer? David: Because he is always speaking into his friends' ears during the lesson. Sara: Perhaps he should speak more clearly.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么说他是个爱耳语的人？戴维：因为他上课时总凑到朋友耳边说话。萨拉：也许他应该说得清楚一些。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么说他是个爱耳语的人？
messages.en: Why are you calling him a whisperer?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dejjem jitkellem f'widnejn sħabu waqt il-lezzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dejjem jitkellem f'widnejn sħabu waqt il-lezzjoni.
messages.zh: 因为他上课时总凑到朋友耳边说话。
messages.en: Because he is always speaking into his friends' ears during the lesson.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 也许他应该说得清楚一些。
messages.en: Perhaps he should speak more clearly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 weswies 指“人”：一个画面是耳边轻语，另一个是传递小道消息；低声说话本身不一定是在散布传闻。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Speaking very quietly in a whisper.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容说话时声音很轻、采用耳语方式的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitkellem b'leħen baxx ħafna, kważi mingħajr ma jinstema'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以耳语方式说话的；低声轻语的

collocations.en: a boy speaking in a whisper
a speaker who speaks in a whisper
collocations.zh: 以耳语方式说话的发言者

formal.mt: Il-kelliem kien weswiesi, u għalhekk dawk bilqiegħda fuq wara ma semgħux il-kumment tiegħu.
formal.en: The speaker spoke in a whisper, so those seated at the back did not hear his comment.
formal.zh: 发言者说话近乎耳语，因此坐在后面的人没有听见他的评论。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex int daqshekk weswiesi llum? Mark: It-tarbija rieqda fil-kamra ta' ħdejna. Elena: Mela nitkellmu bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why are you speaking in such a whisper today? Mark: The baby is asleep in the next room. Elena: Then let's speak quietly.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你今天怎么说话这么轻？马克：宝宝正在隔壁房间睡觉。埃莱娜：那我们轻声说吧。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天怎么说话这么轻？
messages.en: Why are you speaking in such a whisper today?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.zh: 宝宝正在隔壁房间睡觉。
messages.en: The baby is asleep in the next room.

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们轻声说吧。
messages.en: Then let's speak quietly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“宝宝睡了，大家轻声说”来记 weswiesi；它是形容词，描述耳语般的说话状态，不表示说话内容一定保密。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or implement that makes a surface level or even.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把表面整平、使其平坦均匀的人或工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew għodda li tagħmel wiċċ ċatt u ndaqs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 整平者；用于使表面平坦的工具

formal.mt: Il-wettej ħejja wiċċ ċatt u ndaqs qabel ma beda t-tqegħid tal-madum.
formal.en: The leveller prepared a flat, even surface before the laying of the tiles began.
formal.zh: 铺设瓷砖开始之前，整平者先把表面处理得平坦均匀。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Min se jirranġa din l-art imħarbta? Ġużeppi: Il-wettej jiġi għada u jagħmilha ċatta. Rita: Tajjeb, imbagħad inkunu nistgħu nibdew.
colloquial.en: Rita: Who is going to fix this uneven ground? Ġużeppi: The leveller is coming tomorrow and will make it flat. Rita: Good, then we will be able to start.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：谁来处理这块凹凸不平的地面？朱塞佩：整平工明天来，会把它整平。丽塔：好，那我们之后就可以开工了。

messages.speaker: Rita (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jirranġa din l-art imħarbta?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jirranġa din l-art imħarbta?
messages.zh: 谁来处理这块凹凸不平的地面？
messages.en: Who is going to fix this uneven ground?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (施工人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-wettej jiġi għada u jagħmilha ċatta.
messages.mt_standard: Il-wettej jiġi għada u jagħmilha ċatta.
messages.zh: 整平工明天来，会把它整平。
messages.en: The leveller is coming tomorrow and will make it flat.

messages.speaker: Rita (屋主)
messages.zh: 好，那我们之后就可以开工了。
messages.en: Good, then we will be able to start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象铺砖前先把高处削平、低处补齐；把 wettej 记成负责“让表面变平”的整平者或工具。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes someone or something stronger, or gives someone renewed energy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或事物更加有力、稳固的人，或使人恢复精神与活力的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ssaħħaħ lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew li tagħti enerġija ġdida lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人或事物增强、更加稳固的人
使人振作、恢复活力的人

collocations.zh: 促进团结、增强凝聚力的人

collocations.en: a person who invigorates team spirit

formal.mt: Il-kap il-ġdid kien wettieq tal-għaqda bejn il-membri u għenhom jaħdmu flimkien b'aktar fiduċja.
formal.en: The new leader strengthened unity among the members and helped them work together with greater confidence.
formal.zh: 新领导增强了成员之间的团结，帮助他们更有信心地共同工作。

colloquial.mt: Nina: It-tim jidher mimli enerġija llum. Toni: Il-kowċ hu wettieq tal-ispirtu tat-tim; dejjem jagħtina kuraġġ. Nina: Jidher li kliemu għenkom ħafna.
colloquial.en: Nina: The team looks full of energy today. Toni: The coach invigorates team spirit; he always gives us courage. Nina: It looks like his words helped you a lot.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：球队今天看起来活力十足。托尼：教练很能振奋团队精神，他总能给我们勇气。妮娜：看来他的话对你们帮助很大。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 球队今天看起来活力十足。
messages.en: The team looks full of energy today.

messages.speaker: Toni (队员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kowċ hu wettieq tal-ispirtu tat-tim; dejjem jagħtina kuraġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kowċ hu wettieq tal-ispirtu tat-tim; dejjem jagħtina kuraġġ.
messages.zh: 教练很能振奋团队精神，他总能给我们勇气。
messages.en: The coach invigorates team spirit; he always gives us courage.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 看来他的话对你们帮助很大。
messages.en: It looks like his words helped you a lot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 wettieq 想成鼓舞团队的教练：既让大家更团结有力，也让疲惫的人重新振作；两义都围绕“给人力量”。

gloss_zh: 确认性的；起证实作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Serving to confirm a statement, conclusion, or result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于确认某项陈述、结论或结果，使其得到进一步证实的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jservi biex jikkonferma stqarrija, konklużjoni jew riżultat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 确认性的；用来证实的

formal.mt: It-test wettieqi ta l-istess riżultat bħall-ewwel test u saħħaħ il-konklużjoni tar-rapport.
formal.en: The confirmatory test produced the same result as the first test and strengthened the report's conclusion.
formal.zh: 确认性测试得出了与首次测试相同的结果，进一步支持了报告的结论。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex se tagħmel test ieħor? Ben: Dan hu test wettieqi, biex naraw jekk l-ewwel riżultat kienx korrett. Lara: Mela qed tiċċekkja r-riżultat għal darb'oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you going to do another test? Ben: This is a confirmatory test, to see whether the first result was correct. Lara: So you are checking the result again.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么还要再做一次测试？本：这是确认性测试，用来看看第一次的结果是否正确。拉拉：也就是再核实一次结果。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么还要再做一次测试？
messages.en: Why are you going to do another test?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu test wettieqi, biex naraw jekk l-ewwel riżultat kienx korrett.
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu test wettieqi, biex naraw jekk l-ewwel riżultat kienx korrett.
messages.zh: 这是确认性测试，用来看看第一次的结果是否正确。
messages.en: This is a confirmatory test, to see whether the first result was correct.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela qed tiċċekkja r-riżultat għal darb'oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Mela qed tiċċekkja r-riżultat għal darb'oħra.
messages.zh: 也就是再核实一次结果。
messages.en: So you are checking the result again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 wettieqi 和结果旁的确认勾联系起来：一项测试或一份报告提供进一步证实，因此可称为“确认性的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone physical pain or emotional distress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人身体疼痛、受伤，或使其感情受到伤害。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikkawża uġigħ fiżiku jew niket lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弄伤；使疼痛；伤害感情。

collocations.mt: weġa' lil xi ħadd bi kliemu

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem weġa' idu waqt ix-xogħol u ngħata l-ewwel għajnuna.
formal.en: The worker hurt his hand while working and received first aid.
formal.zh: 那名工人在工作时弄伤了手，并接受了急救。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu mhux qed jilgħab magħna? Lara: Għax weġa' siequ lbieraħ u llum qed jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why isn't Pawlu playing with us? Lara: Because he hurt his foot yesterday and is resting today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么没和我们一起玩？拉拉：因为他昨天弄伤了脚，今天在休息。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu mhux qed jilgħab magħna?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu mhux qed jilgħab magħna?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么没和我们一起玩？
messages.en: Why isn't Pawlu playing with us?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax weġa' siequ lbieraħ u llum qed jistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Għax weġa' siequ lbieraħ u llum qed jistrieħ.
messages.zh: 因为他昨天弄伤了脚，今天在休息。
messages.en: Because he hurt his foot yesterday and is resting today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个动词放进“他弄伤了手”的画面中记忆，再联想到言语也能让人心痛。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Experiencing pain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正在感受疼痛或处于痛苦之中的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li qed iħoss uġigħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正在疼痛的；处于痛苦中的。

formal.mt: Il-pazjent kien weġgħan u talab l-għajnuna tal-infermier.
formal.en: The patient was in pain and asked the nurse for help.
formal.zh: 病人感到疼痛，向护士请求帮助。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu għadu weġgħan? Lara: Iva, għadha tuġgħu siequ. Qed jistrieħ fuq is-sufan.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Pawlu still in pain? Lara: Yes, his foot still hurts. He's resting on the sofa.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗还疼吗？拉拉：是的，他的脚还疼。他正在沙发上休息。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗还疼吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu still in pain?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadha tuġgħu siequ. Qed jistrieħ fuq is-sufan.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadha tuġgħu siequ. Qed jistrieħ fuq is-sufan.
messages.zh: 是的，他的脚还疼。他正在沙发上休息。
messages.en: Yes, his foot still hurts. He's resting on the sofa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个捂着伤处的人，把词义记为“他正在疼”，重点是承受疼痛时的状态。

gloss_zh: 鸣唱；啼鸣（用于某些鸟类）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sing or make a song-like call, said of certain kinds of birds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某些鸟类发出鸣唱或歌唱般的叫声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kanta jew ħareġ għana, kif jagħmlu ċerti għasafar.

sense_translations.en_definition: to sing (used of certain types of birds)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸣唱；啼鸣，用于某些种类的鸟。

collocations.en: sang in the morning, of a bird

formal.mt: Il-kanarin weġweġ filgħodu, u l-għana tiegħu nstema' mill-kamra ta' ħdejh.
formal.en: The canary sang in the morning, and its song could be heard from the adjoining room.
formal.zh: 金丝雀早晨鸣唱，隔壁房间也能听见它的歌声。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Smajt lill-kanarin dalgħodu? Mark: Iva, weġweġ hekk kif fetħet it-tieqa Maja.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you hear the canary this morning? Mark: Yes, it sang as soon as Maja opened the window.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你今天早上听到金丝雀的叫声了吗？马克：听到了，玛雅一打开窗户，它就鸣唱起来。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你今天早上听到金丝雀的叫声了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear the canary this morning?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, weġweġ hekk kif fetħet it-tieqa Maja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, weġweġ hekk kif fetħet it-tieqa Maja.
messages.zh: 听到了，玛雅一打开窗户，它就鸣唱起来。
messages.en: Yes, it sang as soon as Maja opened the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 朗读时把重复的音节当作鸟鸣节拍来帮助记忆，再配上清晨金丝雀鸣唱的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To show someone honour, respect, or high regard.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人表达敬意，给予尊重，或表示对其高度评价。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wera ġieħ, rispett jew stima lejn xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向……致敬；给予荣誉。
尊重；以尊重的态度对待。
敬重；对……抱有高度评价。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill weġġeħ lill-għalliem għal ħafna snin ta' servizz lill-komunità.
formal.en: The council honoured the teacher for many years of service to the community.
formal.zh: 委员会表彰了那位教师，感谢他多年来为社区服务。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex il-klabb weġġeħ lil Ġużeppi? Sara: Għax għen lit-tfal għal ħafna snin.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did the club honour Ġużeppi? Sara: Because he helped the children for many years.
colloquial.zh: 马克：俱乐部为什么表彰朱塞佩？萨拉：因为他多年来一直帮助孩子们。

messages.speaker: Mark (俱乐部成员)
messages.zh: 俱乐部为什么表彰朱塞佩？
messages.en: Why did the club honour Ġużeppi?

messages.speaker: Sara (俱乐部成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għen lit-tfal għal ħafna snin.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għen lit-tfal għal ħafna snin.
messages.zh: 因为他多年来一直帮助孩子们。
messages.en: Because he helped the children for many years.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象向老师献花致敬：公开表彰、日常尊重、心中敬重，三个意思围绕同一份敬意。

gloss_zh: 使人痛苦的人；施加痛苦者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who causes pain to another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给别人造成疼痛或痛苦的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tikkawża wġigħ lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给他人施加痛苦的人；使人疼痛的人。

collocations.en: a merciless person who inflicts pain
the person who inflicts pain in the story

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, il-weġġiegħ jikkawża ħafna tbatija lill-karattri l-oħra.
formal.en: In the story, the person who inflicts pain causes the other characters much suffering.
formal.zh: 在故事中，那个施加痛苦的人让其他人物遭受了许多苦难。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed issejjaħlu weġġiegħ? Mark: Għax dejjem iweġġa' lil ħaddieħor bi kliemu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you calling him someone who inflicts pain? Mark: Because he always hurts other people with his words.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么说他是个使人痛苦的人？马克：因为他总是用言语伤害别人。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么说他是个使人痛苦的人？
messages.en: Why are you calling him someone who inflicts pain?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dejjem iweġġa' lil ħaddieħor bi kliemu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dejjem iweġġa' lil ħaddieħor bi kliemu.
messages.zh: 因为他总是用言语伤害别人。
messages.en: Because he always hurts other people with his words.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时给这个词配一张人物卡，卡上写“让别人痛苦的人”，突出它是指人的名词。

gloss_zh: 容易伤人的；倾向于造成痛苦的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to cause pain or hurt to others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使别人疼痛、受伤或感到痛苦的倾向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jikkawża wġigħ lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于使人疼痛或痛苦的；容易伤人的。

collocations.en: a comment that tends to hurt
words that tend to cause hurt

formal.mt: Kumment weġġiegħi jista' jagħmel id-diskussjoni aktar diffiċli u jnaqqas ir-rispett bejn il-parteċipanti.
formal.en: A hurtful comment can make the discussion more difficult and reduce respect among the participants.
formal.zh: 伤人的评论可能使讨论更加困难，并削弱参与者之间的尊重。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dak kien kumment weġġiegħi. Mark: Għandek raġun. Se nitlob skuża lil Lara.
colloquial.en: Sara: That was a hurtful comment. Mark: You're right. I'll apologise to Lara.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那句话很伤人。马克：你说得对。我会向拉拉道歉。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那句话很伤人。
messages.en: That was a hurtful comment.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun. Se nitlob skuża lil Lara.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun. Se nitlob skuża lil Lara.
messages.zh: 你说得对。我会向拉拉道歉。
messages.en: You're right. I'll apologise to Lara.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它贴在“评论”旁边记成“伤人的评论”；它描述容易造成伤害的性质，是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Affixation or sticking; also a jail term, used as a cognate object of weħel in its judicial sense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 附着或黏附，也可表示刑期；表示刑期时，可作动词 weħel 在司法义下的同源宾语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-twaħħil jew il-fatt li xi ħaġa teħel; ukoll żmien ta' ħabs, bħala oġġett tal-verb weħel fis-sens ġudizzjarju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 附着；把某物固定或附加到另一物上的行为。
黏附；黏住或贴住的行为、状态。

sense_translations.en_definition: jail term (the cognate object of weħel, meaning 'to be remanded or found guilty by a court of law')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 刑期；用作 weħel 的同源宾语，此处 weħel 指被法院还押或判定有罪。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru jitkellem dwar weħla ta' sitt xhur ħabs u dwar kif biddlitlu ħajtu.
formal.en: In the story, the character speaks about a six-month jail term and how it changed his life.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这个人物谈到六个月的刑期，以及这段经历如何改变了他的人生。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hawnhekk hemm miktub weħla bil-kolla. Xi tfisser? Pawlu: Tfisser twaħħil bil-kolla, bħal meta twaħħal tikketta fuq kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Lara: It says weħla bil-kolla here. What does it mean? Pawlu: It means sticking with glue, like when you stick a label onto a box.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里写着 weħla bil-kolla，是什么意思？保罗：就是用胶水黏贴，比如把标签贴到盒子上。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk hemm miktub weħla bil-kolla. Xi tfisser?
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk hemm miktub weħla bil-kolla. Xi tfisser?
messages.zh: 这里写着 weħla bil-kolla，是什么意思？
messages.en: It says weħla bil-kolla here. What does it mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser twaħħil bil-kolla, bħal meta twaħħal tikketta fuq kaxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser twaħħil bil-kolla, bħal meta twaħħal tikketta fuq kaxxa.
messages.zh: 就是用胶水黏贴，比如把标签贴到盒子上。
messages.en: It means sticking with glue, like when you stick a label onto a box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做两张情景卡记 weħla：一张画标签黏在盒子上，记“附着、黏附”；另一张画监狱日历，单独记“刑期”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To employ someone, use something for a purpose, or exploit someone or something for an advantage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 雇用某人，使用某物来达到目的，或利用某人、某物以获取利益。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimpjega lil xi ħadd, juża xi ħaġa għal skop, jew jisfrutta lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa biex jikseb vantaġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雇用；任用
使用；运用
利用以获取利益；剥削

collocations.en: exploited their trust for his own advantage
collocations.zh: 利用他们的信任为自己谋利

formal.mt: L-artiġjan weża l-ħiliet tiegħu biex isewwi l-għamara mingħajr ma jagħmel ħsara lill-injam.
formal.en: The craftsman employed his skills to repair the furniture without damaging the wood.
formal.zh: 工匠运用自己的技能修理家具，避免损伤木材。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif irranġa s-siġġu? Ġanni: Weża l-għodda li tajtu u waħħal is-sieq mill-ġdid. Marta: Tajjeb, issa nistgħu nużawh.
colloquial.en: Marta: How did he fix the chair? Ġanni: He used the tools I gave him and reattached the leg. Marta: Good, now we can use it.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：他是怎么修好椅子的？詹尼：他用了我给他的工具，把椅腿重新装好了。玛尔塔：好，现在我们可以用了。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.zh: 他是怎么修好椅子的？
messages.en: How did he fix the chair?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Weża l-għodda li tajtu u waħħal is-sieq mill-ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Weża l-għodda li tajtu u waħħal is-sieq mill-ġdid.
messages.zh: 他用了我给他的工具，把椅腿重新装好了。
messages.en: He used the tools I gave him and reattached the leg.

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.zh: 好，现在我们可以用了。
messages.en: Good, now we can use it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个场景记 weża：请人工作是“雇用”，拿工具办事是“使用”，借别人的信任谋利是“利用”；结合宾语和语境判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of balance or equilibrium in which opposing forces or demands remain evenly matched.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 相互作用的力量或不同方面的要求保持均衡的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' bilanċ li fih forzi jew ħtiġijiet opposti jibqgħu bbilanċjati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平衡；不同方面之间的均衡
均衡状态；相互作用的力量达到平衡的状态

collocations.en: a balance between work and rest
collocations.zh: 工作与休息之间的平衡

formal.mt: L-iskeda l-ġdida għandha żżomm il-weżina bejn ix-xogħol u l-mistrieħ.
formal.en: The new schedule should maintain a balance between work and rest.
formal.zh: 新时间表应保持工作与休息之间的平衡。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed naħdem wisq u ma nsibx ħin biex nistrieħ. Lara: Trid issib weżina bejn ix-xogħol u l-mistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'm working too much and can't find time to rest. Lara: You need to find a balance between work and rest.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我工作太多，都找不到时间休息。Lara：你得在工作与休息之间找到平衡。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed naħdem wisq u ma nsibx ħin biex nistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Qed naħdem wisq u ma nsibx ħin biex nistrieħ.
messages.zh: 我工作太多，都找不到时间休息。
messages.en: I'm working too much and can't find time to rest.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid issib weżina bejn ix-xogħol u l-mistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Trid issib weżina bejn ix-xogħol u l-mistrieħ.
messages.zh: 你得在工作与休息之间找到平衡。
messages.en: You need to find a balance between work and rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象天平两端分别放着工作和休息，两边持平就是 weżina；把它记成一种平衡状态。

gloss_zh: 偏执而不容异见的人；伪君子

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is intolerant of different beliefs or opinions, or who pretends to have principles that their conduct does not reflect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不能容忍不同信仰或意见的人；也可指表面宣扬原则、实际行为却不符合这些原则的伪君子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ma tittollerax twemmin jew fehmiet differenti, jew li tippretendi li għandha prinċipji li ma turihomx fl-imġiba tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偏执而排斥不同信仰或意见的人
伪君子；言行不一、假装有道德原则的人

collocations.mt: weżwież li ma jaċċettax fehmiet differenti
collocations.en: a bigot who does not accept different opinions
collocations.zh: 不接受不同意见的偏执者

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru jidher bħala weżwież: jipprietka l-onestà iżda jigdeb biex jikseb vantaġġ.
formal.en: In the novel, the character appears as a hypocrite: he preaches honesty but lies to gain an advantage.
formal.zh: 小说中的这个人物显得是个伪君子：他宣扬诚实，却为谋取好处而撒谎。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Jgħid li kulħadd għandu jkun onest, imma hu jigdeb. Sara: Meta jagħmel hekk, iġib ruħu ta' weżwież.
colloquial.en: Mark: He says everyone should be honest, but he lies himself. Sara: When he does that, he behaves like a hypocrite.
colloquial.zh: Mark：他说人人都应该诚实，自己却撒谎。Sara：他这样做，就表现得像个伪君子。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jgħid li kulħadd għandu jkun onest, imma hu jigdeb.
messages.mt_standard: Jgħid li kulħadd għandu jkun onest, imma hu jigdeb.
messages.zh: 他说人人都应该诚实，自己却撒谎。
messages.en: He says everyone should be honest, but he lies himself.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta jagħmel hekk, iġib ruħu ta' weżwież.
messages.mt_standard: Meta jagħmel hekk, iġib ruħu ta' weżwież.
messages.zh: 他这样做，就表现得像个伪君子。
messages.en: When he does that, he behaves like a hypocrite.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 weżwież 配两张人物卡：一张捂耳拒听异见，一张嘴上讲诚实却撒谎；记住两义都指人。

gloss_zh: 虚伪的；偏执排他的；爱恶意说闲话的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Hypocritical, intolerant of different beliefs or opinions, or inclined to spread malicious gossip.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容虚伪、不能容忍不同信仰或意见，或倾向于传播恶意闲话的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri wiċċ b'ieħor, ma jittollerax twemmin jew fehmiet differenti, jew iħobb jgħid fuq in-nies b'malizzja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虚伪的；表面宣称的原则与实际行为不一致的
偏执排他的；不容忍不同信仰或意见的

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to indulge in malicious gossip
sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱恶意说闲话的；倾向于传播伤害他人的流言的

collocations.zh: 带有偏执排他态度的评论

collocations.mt: bniedem weżwieżi li jgħid fuq in-nies
collocations.en: a malicious gossip who talks about others
collocations.zh: 爱在背后恶意议论他人的人

formal.mt: Il-kumment weżwieżi ċaħad kull fehma differenti mingħajr ma kkunsidra l-argumenti.
formal.en: The bigoted comment rejected every different opinion without considering the arguments.
formal.zh: 这条偏执排他的评论没有考虑论据，就否定了所有不同意见。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Quddiemha jfaħħarha, imma minn wara jgħid kontra tagħha. Maja: Dak hu kliem weżwieżi; aħjar nitkellmu magħha b'onestà.
colloquial.en: Lara: He praises her to her face, but speaks against her behind her back. Maja: That's hypocritical talk; we'd better speak to her honestly.
colloquial.zh: Lara：他当面夸她，背后却说她坏话。Maja：这话太虚伪了；我们还是坦诚地跟她说吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Quddiemha jfaħħarha, imma minn wara jgħid kontra tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Quddiemha jfaħħarha, imma minn wara jgħid kontra tagħha.
messages.zh: 他当面夸她，背后却说她坏话。
messages.en: He praises her to her face, but speaks against her behind her back.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu kliem weżwieżi; aħjar nitkellmu magħha b'onestà.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu kliem weżwieżi; aħjar nitkellmu magħha b'onestà.
messages.zh: 这话太虚伪了；我们还是坦诚地跟她说吧。
messages.en: That's hypocritical talk; we'd better speak to her honestly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 weżwieżi 放在描述栏，分别贴上虚伪、排斥异见、恶意闲话三张标签；这是形容性质的词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lanolin, a fatty substance obtained from sheep's wool; also, earwax, the waxy substance found in the ear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指从羊毛中提取的羊毛脂；也指耳内的蜡状分泌物，即耳垢。具体词义需要根据语境判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza xaħmija li tinkiseb mis-suf tan-nagħaġ; il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll ix-xama' li jkun hemm fil-widnejn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 羊毛脂，从羊毛中提取的脂状物质。
耳垢，耳道内的蜡状分泌物。

collocations.zh: 从羊毛中提取的羊毛脂

formal.mt: It-tikketta tal-prodott tgħid li din il-krema fiha l-widaħ, sustanza xaħmija li tinkiseb mis-suf tan-nagħaġ.
formal.en: The product label states that this cream contains lanolin, a fatty substance obtained from sheep's wool.
formal.zh: 产品标签注明，这款乳霜含有羊毛脂，即从羊毛中提取的一种脂状物质。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak li semma t-tabib dwar widinti? Toni: Semma l-widaħ; hawnhekk il-kelma tfisser ix-xama' fil-widna.
colloquial.en: Lara: What was that thing the doctor mentioned about my ear? Toni: He mentioned widaħ; here the word means earwax.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：医生说我耳朵里的那个东西是什么？托尼：他说的是 widaħ，这里指耳垢。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak li semma t-tabib dwar widinti?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak li semma t-tabib dwar widinti?
messages.zh: 医生说我耳朵里的那个东西是什么？
messages.en: What was that thing the doctor mentioned about my ear?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Semma l-widaħ; hawnhekk il-kelma tfisser ix-xama' fil-widna.
messages.mt_standard: Semma l-widaħ; hawnhekk il-kelma tfisser ix-xama' fil-widna.
messages.zh: 他说的是 widaħ，这里指耳垢。
messages.en: He mentioned widaħ; here the word means earwax.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景记住 widaħ：乳霜标签旁想到羊毛脂，耳朵示意图旁想到耳垢；靠场景区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An admonition intended to correct someone's conduct, or a warning that draws attention to a danger or possible consequence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指劝人改正行为的告诫，也可指提醒危险或可能后果的警告；重点是告诫或警告本身。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem biex iwissi lil xi ħadd u jħeġġu jġib ruħu aħjar, jew biex jiġbidlu l-attenzjoni għal periklu jew konsegwenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 告诫，旨在劝人改正行为的劝诫或训诫。
警告，提醒他人注意危险或不良后果的话语或信号。

collocations.en: to give an admonition or warning

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, id-direttur inkluda widba ċara dwar il-periklu li jinħoloq meta l-ħaddiema ma jsegwux il-proċeduri tas-sigurtà.
formal.en: In his report, the director included a clear warning about the danger that arises when workers do not follow safety procedures.
formal.zh: 主管在报告中明确警告，员工不遵守安全程序会造成危险。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex l-għalliem tkellem miegħek wara l-lezzjoni? Mark: Tani widba għax erġajt wasalt tard; qal li għandi nitlaq mid-dar qabel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the teacher speak to you after the lesson? Mark: He admonished me because I was late again; he said I should leave home earlier.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：老师为什么课后找你谈话？马克：我又迟到了，他告诫了我一番，说我应该早点出门。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex l-għalliem tkellem miegħek wara l-lezzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex l-għalliem tkellem miegħek wara l-lezzjoni?
messages.zh: 老师为什么课后找你谈话？
messages.en: Why did the teacher speak to you after the lesson?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tani widba għax erġajt wasalt tard; qal li għandi nitlaq mid-dar qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Tani widba għax erġajt wasalt tard; qal li għandi nitlaq mid-dar qabel.
messages.zh: 我又迟到了，他告诫了我一番，说我应该早点出门。
messages.en: He admonished me because I was late again; he said I should leave home earlier.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 widba 写在一张提醒卡上：老师劝你改正是告诫，提醒前方危险是警告；记住它表示那一次提醒本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To listen secretly to other people's conversation; in stoneworking, to cut an angle into a stone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指暗中偷听他人的谈话；在石材加工语境中，也指在石头上切出一个角。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tisma' bil-moħbi dak li jkunu qed jgħidu nies oħra; fix-xogħol tal-ġebel, taqta' angolu f'ġebla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偷听，在他人不知情的情况下暗中听取其谈话。

sense_translations.en_definition: to cut an angle into a stone
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在石头上切出一个角，指石材加工中的切角动作。

collocations.en: cut an angle into the stone
collocations.zh: 在那块石头上切出了一个角

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem widden il-ġebla b'attenzjoni biex l-angolu tagħha jaqbel mal-kantuniera tal-ħajt, skont id-disinn ipprovdut mill-perit.
formal.en: The worker carefully cut an angle into the stone so that it would fit the corner of the wall, following the architect's design.
formal.zh: 工人按照建筑师提供的设计，仔细地在石头上切出一个角，使其与墙角吻合。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif sar jaf Pawlu x'għedna fil-kamra? Nina: Widden wara l-bieb; sema' l-konversazzjoni tagħna mingħajr ma ndunajna.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did Pawlu find out what we said in the room? Nina: He eavesdropped behind the door; he heard our conversation without us noticing.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗怎么知道我们在房间里说了什么？妮娜：他在门后偷听了，我们都没察觉他听到了谈话。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sar jaf Pawlu x'għedna fil-kamra?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sar jaf Pawlu x'għedna fil-kamra?
messages.zh: 保罗怎么知道我们在房间里说了什么？
messages.en: How did Pawlu find out what we said in the room?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Widden wara l-bieb; sema' l-konversazzjoni tagħna mingħajr ma ndunajna.
messages.mt_standard: Widden wara l-bieb; sema' l-konversazzjoni tagħna mingħajr ma ndunajna.
messages.zh: 他在门后偷听了，我们都没察觉他听到了谈话。
messages.en: He eavesdropped behind the door; he heard our conversation without us noticing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 widden 画两张动作卡：一张是门后偷听的人，一张是正在切角的石头。两义分别记忆，不把画面联系当作词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who warns others, drawing their attention to danger, a possible consequence, or conduct that should change.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指向别人发出警告或告诫的人，提醒对方注意危险、可能的后果，或需要改正的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li twissi lil ħaddieħor dwar periklu, konsegwenza possibbli jew imġiba li għandha tinbidel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出警告或给予告诫的人。

collocations.en: a person who warns of danger
the role of a person who gives warnings
to listen to the person giving a warning

formal.mt: F'dan ir-rakkont, il-widdieb jiġbed l-attenzjoni tar-raħħala għall-periklu tax-xmara, iżda huma ma jagħtux kas il-kliem tiegħu.
formal.en: In this story, the person giving the warning draws the villagers' attention to the danger of the river, but they ignore his words.
formal.zh: 在这个故事中，警告者提醒村民注意河流的危险，但村民没有理会他的话。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed issejjaħ lil Toni l-widdieb tal-grupp? Mark: Għax dejjem iwissina meta jkun hemm xi periklu, speċjalment waqt il-mixi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you calling Toni the person who warns everyone in the group? Mark: Because he always warns us when there is danger, especially when we are hiking.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把托尼叫作小组里的警告者？马克：因为一有危险他就提醒我们，尤其是在徒步的时候。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed issejjaħ lil Toni l-widdieb tal-grupp?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed issejjaħ lil Toni l-widdieb tal-grupp?
messages.zh: 你为什么把托尼叫作小组里的警告者？
messages.en: Why are you calling Toni the person who warns everyone in the group?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dejjem iwissina meta jkun hemm xi periklu, speċjalment waqt il-mixi.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dejjem iwissina meta jkun hemm xi periklu, speċjalment waqt il-mixi.
messages.zh: 因为一有危险他就提醒我们，尤其是在徒步的时候。
messages.en: Because he always warns us when there is danger, especially when we are hiking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 widdieb 贴在举手提醒危险的人物旁，记成“发出警告的那个人”；与表示告诫或警告本身的 widba 对照学习。

gloss_zh: 告诫的；带有训诫意味的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expressing an admonition or warning, especially through the tone or wording used to encourage someone to correct their conduct.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容语气或措辞带有告诫、训诫或警示意味，常用于劝人注意后果或改正行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jesprimi twissija jew ċanfira biex xi ħadd jagħti kas il-konsegwenzi jew ibiddel l-imġiba tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 告诫的，带有劝诫、训诫或警示意味的。

formal.mt: L-awtur juża ton widdiebi biex iħeġġeġ lill-qarrejja jaħsbu fil-konsegwenzi tal-għażliet tagħhom u jaġixxu b'aktar responsabbiltà.
formal.en: The author uses an admonitory tone to encourage readers to consider the consequences of their choices and act more responsibly.
formal.zh: 作者采用告诫的语气，促使读者思考自身选择的后果，并以更负责任的方式行事。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Missierek kien irrabjat meta kellem lil ħuk? Toni: It-ton tiegħu kien widdiebi; ried ifakkru biex joqgħod aktar attent.
colloquial.en: Lara: Was your father angry when he spoke to your brother? Toni: His tone was admonitory; he wanted to remind him to be more careful.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你爸爸跟你兄弟说话时生气了吗？托尼：他的语气带着告诫的意味，是想提醒他多加小心。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Missierek kien irrabjat meta kellem lil ħuk?
messages.mt_standard: Missierek kien irrabjat meta kellem lil ħuk?
messages.zh: 你爸爸跟你兄弟说话时生气了吗？
messages.en: Was your father angry when he spoke to your brother?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-ton tiegħu kien widdiebi; ried ifakkru biex joqgħod aktar attent.
messages.mt_standard: It-ton tiegħu kien widdiebi; ried ifakkru biex joqgħod aktar attent.
messages.zh: 他的语气带着告诫的意味，是想提醒他多加小心。
messages.en: His tone was admonitory; he wanted to remind him to be more careful.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 widdiebi 放进“怎样的语气”这个空格，搭配 ton 一起记：ton widdiebi 就是带有告诫意味的语气，注意它是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A muezzin, a person who gives the call inviting Muslims to prayer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指宣礼员，即向穆斯林发出礼拜召唤的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel is-sejħa biex tistieden lill-Musulmani għat-talb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宣礼员，负责向穆斯林发出礼拜召唤的人。

collocations.zh: 宣礼员发出的礼拜召唤

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi kif il-widdien jagħmel is-sejħa għat-talb u jistieden lill-komunità Musulmana biex tinġabar fil-ħin stabbilit.
formal.en: The text describes how the muezzin gives the call to prayer and invites the Muslim community to gather at the appointed time.
formal.zh: 课文描述了宣礼员如何发出礼拜召唤，邀请穆斯林群体在规定时间聚集。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min hu dak li qed jagħmel is-sejħa għat-talb? Sara: Dak hu l-widdien tal-moskea; qed jistieden lin-nies għat-talb.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who is the person giving the call to prayer? Sara: That is the mosque's muezzin; he is inviting people to prayer.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：正在发出礼拜召唤的那个人是谁？萨拉：那是清真寺的宣礼员，他正在召唤人们礼拜。

messages.speaker: Nina (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak li qed jagħmel is-sejħa għat-talb?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak li qed jagħmel is-sejħa għat-talb?
messages.zh: 正在发出礼拜召唤的那个人是谁？
messages.en: Who is the person giving the call to prayer?

messages.speaker: Sara (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu l-widdien tal-moskea; qed jistieden lin-nies għat-talb.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu l-widdien tal-moskea; qed jistieden lin-nies għat-talb.
messages.zh: 那是清真寺的宣礼员，他正在召唤人们礼拜。
messages.en: That is the mosque's muezzin; he is inviting people to prayer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“谁在召唤人们礼拜”来回忆 widdien，脑中固定一位正在宣礼的人；把它当作人物名词学习，避免只记声音。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rottenness or corruption; the word can also refer to pus or fat, with the intended meaning determined by context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指腐烂或腐败，也可指脓或脂肪；应结合描述的对象和上下文确定具体含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħsir jew korruzzjoni; il-kelma tista' tirreferi wkoll għal timbotta jew xaħam, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 腐烂，物质已经腐坏的状态。
腐败，败坏或堕落的状态或现象。
脓；脂肪。这个义项可指这两类物质，具体依语境判断。

formal.mt: F'din is-silta, l-awtur juża l-kelma widek biex jiddeskrivi l-korruzzjoni fis-soċjetà u l-effetti tagħha fuq il-fiduċja bejn in-nies.
formal.en: In this passage, the author uses the word widek to describe corruption in society and its effects on trust between people.
formal.zh: 在这段文字中，作者用 widek 一词描述社会中的腐败，以及它对人际信任的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, x'tifhem bil-kelma widek ħdejn l-istampa tal-ferita? Mark: Hawnhekk tfisser timbotta, jiġifieri s-sustanza li tidher fil-ferita.
colloquial.en: Maja: In this exercise, what do you understand by widek beside the picture of the wound? Mark: Here it means pus, the substance shown in the wound.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这道练习里，伤口图片旁的 widek 是什么意思？马克：这里指脓，也就是图中伤口里的那种物质。

messages.mt_standard: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, x'tifhem bil-kelma widek ħdejn l-istampa tal-ferita?
messages.zh: 这道练习里，伤口图片旁的 widek 是什么意思？

messages.en: Here it means pus, the substance shown in the wound.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 widek 做四格语境卡，分别写腐烂、腐败、脓、脂肪；每次先看句中谈什么，再选词义，不把四种含义混成一种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Hearing, the ability or act of perceiving sound; also, taking advice by listening to it and accepting its guidance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指听觉或听取声音这一行为；也指听从劝告，即听取并接受别人的指点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħila jew l-att li tisma' l-ħsejjes; ukoll li tisma' l-pariri u taċċetta l-gwida li jagħtuk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 听觉；听取声音的能力或行为。
听从劝告，听取并接受他人的建议或指点。

formal.mt: F'din il-lezzjoni, il-kelma widen tintuża kemm għas-sens li bih nisimgħu l-ħsejjes kif ukoll għall-aċċettazzjoni tal-pariri ta' ħaddieħor.
formal.en: In this lesson, the word widen is used both for the sense through which we hear sounds and for the acceptance of other people's advice.
formal.zh: 在本课中，widen 既用于表示感知声音的听觉，也用于表示接受他人的劝告。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hawnhekk widen ifisser biss li tisma' l-ħsejjes? Toni: Le, f'din is-sentenza jfisser li tisma' l-parir ta' xi ħadd u taċċettah.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does widen here only mean hearing sounds? Toni: No, in this sentence it means listening to someone's advice and accepting it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里的 widen 只是指听见声音吗？托尼：不是，在这个句子里，它指听取并接受别人的劝告。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)

messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk widen ifisser biss li tisma' l-ħsejjes?
messages.zh: 这里的 widen 只是指听见声音吗？
messages.en: Does widen here only mean hearing sounds?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)

messages.mt_standard: Le, f'din is-sentenza jfisser li tisma' l-parir ta' xi ħadd u taċċettah.
messages.zh: 不是，在这个句子里，它指听取并接受别人的劝告。
messages.en: No, in this sentence it means listening to someone's advice and accepting it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“听见声音”和“听进劝告”两幅图记 widen：前者帮助记听觉，后者帮助记听从建议；这是词义记忆法，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 耳朵突出的；长着招风耳的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having ears that are prominent or stick out noticeably.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容耳朵明显突出或向两侧张开的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu widnejn prominenti jew li joħorġu 'l barra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 耳朵明显突出的；长着招风耳的。

collocations.zh: 一个长着招风耳的男孩

formal.mt: Fl-illustrazzjoni jidher tifel widni b'xagħru qasir u bi tbissima kbira.
formal.en: The illustration shows a boy with prominent ears, short hair, and a broad smile.
formal.zh: 插图中是一个长着招风耳、留着短发、笑容灿烂的男孩。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema hu Mark fl-istampa? Lara: Huwa dak it-tifel widni bil-flokk aħmar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which one is Mark in the picture? Lara: He is that boy with prominent ears wearing a red T-shirt.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：照片里哪个是马克？拉拉：就是那个穿着红色T恤、长着招风耳的男孩。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 照片里哪个是马克？
messages.en: Which one is Mark in the picture?

messages.mt_standard: Huwa dak it-tifel widni bil-flokk aħmar.

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very wide; extending a great distance from one side to the other.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 非常宽，形容两侧之间的距离很大。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wiesa' ħafna, b'distanza kbira minn naħa għall-oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常宽；宽阔无比。

formal.mt: Il-kuritur huwa wiesa' baħar u jippermetti li ħafna nies jgħaddu fl-istess ħin.
formal.en: The corridor is very wide and allows many people to pass through at the same time.
formal.zh: 这条走廊非常宽，可供许多人同时通行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Is-sufan jgħaddi minn dan il-bieb? Mark: Iva, il-bieb wiesa' baħar!
colloquial.en: Maja: Will the sofa fit through this door? Mark: Yes, the door is very wide!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这张沙发能从这扇门搬进去吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 能，这扇门宽得很！
messages.en: Yes, the door is very wide!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象搬沙发时遇到一扇特别宽的门，张开双臂说出整个短语，把它记成强调“非常宽”的整体表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very wide, describing something with a large distance between its sides.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 非常宽，用来形容物体或空间两侧之间的距离很大。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wiesa' ħafna; jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li għandha distanza kbira bejn il-ġnub tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常宽；十分宽阔。

formal.en: The passage is very wide, so there is enough space for people to pass through.
formal.zh: 这条通道非常宽，因此有足够的空间供人通行。

colloquial.en: Maja: Is there room for both of us to pass through? Mark: Yes, this passage is very wide.

teaching_sense.en_definition: Wide or broad, describing a large distance across something or an extensive range.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宽的；两侧之间距离大的。
宽广的；也可指范围广泛的。

formal.mt: Il-programm ikopri firxa wiesgħa ta' suġġetti marbuta mal-edukazzjoni.

formal.zh: 该项目涵盖了与教育有关的广泛主题。

messages.zh: 全部要多少钱？
messages.en: How much will everything cost?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.zh: 八十一欧元。
messages.en: Eighty-one euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个表达配上数字卡片81，再用“八十一欧元”和“八十一名学生”交替练习，建立数字与数量短语的联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 51, one more than fifty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词五十一，表示比五十多一的数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 51, wieħed aktar minn ħamsin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 五十一；数字51。

formal.mt: Il-librerija rċeviet wieħed u ħamsin ktieb ġdid matul ix-xahar.
formal.en: The library received fifty-one new books during the month.
formal.zh: 图书馆本月收到了五十一本新书。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm għandek kotba fuq din l-ixkaffa? Lara: Għandi wieħed u ħamsin ktieb. Għadni kif għaddejthom!
colloquial.en: Maja: How many books do you have on this shelf? Lara: I have fifty-one books. I have just counted them!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你这个书架上有多少本书？拉拉：有五十一本，我刚刚数过！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm għandek kotba fuq din l-ixkaffa?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm għandek kotba fuq din l-ixkaffa?
messages.zh: 你这个书架上有多少本书？
messages.en: How many books do you have on this shelf?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi wieħed u ħamsin ktieb. Għadni kif għaddejthom!
messages.mt_standard: Għandi wieħed u ħamsin ktieb. Għadni kif għaddejthom!
messages.zh: 有五十一本，我刚刚数过！
messages.en: I have fifty-one books. I have just counted them!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象五十本书旁又放了一本：wieħed 是一，u 是和，ħamsin 是五十；按“一加五十”记住五十一。

gloss_zh: 把事情推给；使承担负担；交付责任

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put a task, burden, or responsibility on someone, sometimes unfairly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把任务、负担或责任交给某人承担，有时带有强加或推卸责任的意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadda xogħol, piż jew responsabbiltà lil xi ħadd, xi drabi b'mod inġust.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把麻烦的事情或负担一股脑儿交给某人。
使某人背上沉重或不情愿承担的负担。

sense_translations.en_definition: to pass the buck onto sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把本应由自己承担的责任推给别人。
交给某人责任，让其负责某项事情。

collocations.mt: wikka lil xi ħadd bix-xogħol kollu
collocations.en: saddled someone with all the work
collocations.zh: 把全部工作都压给某人

formal.mt: Il-kap wikka lil impjegat wieħed bix-xogħol kollu, mingħajr ma tah għajnuna.
formal.en: The manager saddled a single employee with all the work without giving him any help.
formal.zh: 主管把全部工作都压给了一名员工，却没有给他任何帮助。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għadek l-uffiċċju? Mark: Il-kap wikka lili bix-xogħol kollu. Lara: Tridni ngħinek ftit?
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you still at the office? Mark: The boss saddled me with all the work. Lara: Would you like me to help you a little?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你怎么还在办公室？马克：老板把全部工作都压给我了。拉拉：要我帮你一点忙吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你怎么还在办公室？
messages.en: Why are you still at the office?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 老板把全部工作都压给我了。
messages.en: The boss saddled me with all the work.

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 要我帮你一点忙吗？
messages.en: Would you like me to help you a little?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象主管把整摞任务放到一个人的桌上，用这个画面记住 wikka 的交付负担与推卸责任之意。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give food to a person or an animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给人或动物食物吃；喂养。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta l-ikel lil persuna jew lil annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喂食；给人或动物食物吃。

formal.mt: Il-voluntier wikkel il-klieb qabel ma naddaf il-post fejn joqogħdu.
formal.en: The volunteer fed the dogs before cleaning the place where they live.
formal.zh: 志愿者先喂了狗，然后清理它们居住的地方。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-qattus kiel illum? Pawlu: Iva, ħija wikkel il-qattus dalgħodu. Maja: Tajjeb, mela nagħtih ftit ilma frisk.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the cat eaten today? Pawlu: Yes, my brother fed the cat this morning. Maja: Good, then I'll give it some fresh water.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：猫今天吃过了吗？保罗：吃过了，我哥哥今天早上喂了它。玛雅：好，那我给它倒点新鲜的水。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 猫今天吃过了吗？
messages.en: Has the cat eaten today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 吃过了，我哥哥今天早上喂了它。
messages.en: Yes, my brother fed the cat this morning.

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, mela nagħtih ftit ilma frisk.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, mela nagħtih ftit ilma frisk.
messages.zh: 好，那我给它倒点新鲜的水。
messages.en: Good, then I'll give it some fresh water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 wikkel 和把食物放进猫碗的动作一起记：重点是有人给另一个人或动物喂食。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a very large appetite and eating eagerly or in large amounts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 胃口很大、吃得很多或急切想吃东西的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandhom aptit kbir u jieklu ħafna jew bil-ħerqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 食量很大的；贪吃的；进食欲望强烈的。

formal.mt: Dawn il-klieb huma wikkieli ħafna; għalhekk il-persunal iqassmilhom l-ikel f'porzjonijiet imkejla.
formal.en: These dogs are very voracious, so the staff give them food in measured portions.
formal.zh: 这些狗非常贪吃，因此工作人员按量分配它们的食物。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għad fadal ħobż? Toni: Ftit biss! It-tfal kienu wikkieli ħafna llum. Sara: Mela nġib ħobża oħra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is there any bread left? Toni: Only a little! The children had huge appetites today. Sara: Then I'll get another loaf.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：还有面包吗？托尼：只剩一点了！孩子们今天胃口特别大。萨拉：那我再拿一条面包来。

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.zh: 还有面包吗？
messages.en: Is there any bread left?

messages.speaker: Toni (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit biss! It-tfal kienu wikkieli ħafna llum.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit biss! It-tfal kienu wikkieli ħafna llum.
messages.zh: 只剩一点了！孩子们今天胃口特别大。
messages.en: Only a little! The children had huge appetites today.

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.zh: 那我再拿一条面包来。
messages.en: Then I'll get another loaf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象几个孩子吃完一篮面包还想再吃，用空面包篮的画面记住 wikkieli 表示胃口很大。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cockroaches, especially large ones.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蟑螂，尤其指体形较大的蟑螂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insetti b'ġisem ċatt u antenni twal, speċjalment dawk kbar, li spiss jidhru fil-kċejjen jew f'postijiet mudlama.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蟑螂，尤指一只或多只体形较大的蟑螂。

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstabu wirdien kbar wara l-friġġ, u ntalab tindif bir-reqqa tal-kċina.
formal.en: During the inspection, large cockroaches were found behind the refrigerator, and thorough cleaning of the kitchen was requested.
formal.zh: 检查时在冰箱后面发现了大蟑螂，并要求彻底清洁厨房。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajt xi wirdien ħdejn il-bieb. Adam: Kbar kienu? Nina: Iva! Ejja nagħlqu l-bieb u niċċekkjaw il-kċina.
colloquial.en: Nina: I saw some cockroaches near the door. Adam: Were they big? Nina: Yes! Let's close the door and check the kitchen.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我看见门边有几只蟑螂。亚当：很大吗？妮娜：是啊！我们把门关上，检查一下厨房吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 我看见门边有几只蟑螂。
messages.en: I saw some cockroaches near the door.

messages.speaker: Adam (室友)
messages.zh: 很大吗？
messages.en: Were they big?

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Ejja nagħlqu l-bieb u niċċekkjaw il-kċina.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Ejja nagħlqu l-bieb u niċċekkjaw il-kċina.
messages.zh: 是啊！我们把门关上，检查一下厨房吧。
messages.en: Yes! Let's close the door and check the kitchen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 wirdien kbar 整组记成“大蟑螂”，想象开灯后几只大蟑螂躲到冰箱后面的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cockroach, an insect with a flattened body and long antennae.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一只蟑螂，即身体扁平、触角较长的一种昆虫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insett b'ġisem ċatt u antenni twal li spiss jidher fil-kċejjen jew f'postijiet mudlama.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蟑螂；一只蟑螂。

formal.mt: Instabet wirdiena waħda taħt l-armarju waqt it-tindif tal-kċina.
formal.en: One cockroach was found under the cupboard while the kitchen was being cleaned.
formal.zh: 清洁厨房时，在橱柜下面发现了一只蟑螂。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hemm wirdiena taħt il-mejda! Ben: Fejn eżatt? Lara: Ħdejn saqajn is-siġġu.
colloquial.en: Lara: There's a cockroach under the table! Ben: Where exactly? Lara: Near the legs of the chair.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：桌子下面有一只蟑螂！本：具体在哪儿？拉拉：在椅子腿旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 桌子下面有一只蟑螂！
messages.en: There's a cockroach under the table!

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 具体在哪儿？
messages.en: Where exactly?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 在椅子腿旁边。
messages.en: Near the legs of the chair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 wirdiena waħda“一只蟑螂”作记忆卡片，画面里只放一只，帮助记住这个词的单个指称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of showing or displaying something so that people can see it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物呈现给别人观看的行为，如展示、陈列或放映。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li turi jew tesponi xi ħaġa biex in-nies ikunu jistgħu jarawha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 展示；供人观看；影片等的放映。
陈列；把物品或内容展示出来。

formal.mt: Il-wiri tal-film se jsir fis-sala prinċipali u se jkun segwit minn diskussjoni.
formal.en: The film screening will take place in the main hall and will be followed by a discussion.
formal.zh: 影片将在主厅放映，放映后将举行讨论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ħin jibda l-wiri tal-film? Karl: Fit-tmienja. Maja: Mela niltaqgħu quddiem is-sala fit-tmienja neqsin kwart.
colloquial.en: Maja: What time does the film screening start? Karl: At eight. Maja: Then let's meet outside the hall at a quarter to eight.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：电影几点开始放映？卡尔：八点。玛雅：那我们七点四十五分在礼堂门口见。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影几点开始放映？
messages.en: What time does the film screening start?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.zh: 八点。
messages.en: At eight.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela niltaqgħu quddiem is-sala fit-tmienja neqsin kwart.
messages.mt_standard: Mela niltaqgħu quddiem is-sala fit-tmienja neqsin kwart.
messages.zh: 那我们七点四十五分在礼堂门口见。
messages.en: Then let's meet outside the hall at a quarter to eight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象照片摆出来、电影放出来，两种场景都是“让人看见”，用这个共同动作记住名词 wiri。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money, property, or possessions received from someone after their death.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某人去世后，由他人继承的钱财、房产或其他财物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Flus, proprjetà jew oġġetti li persuna tirċievi mingħand xi ħadd wara mewtu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遗产；因继承而获得的钱财、房产或其他财物。

formal.mt: Marija rċeviet wirta mingħand iz-zija tagħha u użat parti mill-flus biex issewwi d-dar.
formal.en: Marija received an inheritance from her aunt and used part of the money to repair the house.
formal.zh: 玛丽娅继承了姑妈的遗产，并用其中一部分钱修缮房屋。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif stajt tixtri dan l-appartament? Mark: Irċevejt wirta mingħand in-nannu. Anna: U issa se tmur toqgħod hemm? Mark: Iva, ix-xahar id-dieħel.
colloquial.en: Anna: How were you able to buy this apartment? Mark: I received an inheritance from my grandfather. Anna: And are you going to live there now? Mark: Yes, next month.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你怎么买得起这套公寓的？马克：我继承了祖父的一笔遗产。安娜：那你现在要搬过去住了吗？马克：是的，下个月搬。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么买得起这套公寓的？
messages.en: How were you able to buy this apartment?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我继承了祖父的一笔遗产。
messages.en: I received an inheritance from my grandfather.

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: U issa se tmur toqgħod hemm?
messages.mt_standard: U issa se tmur toqgħod hemm?
messages.zh: 那你现在要搬过去住了吗？
messages.en: And are you going to live there now?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，下个月搬。
messages.en: Yes, next month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 wirta 放进“长辈去世后留下房屋和积蓄”的情境，记住它指继承所得的遗产。

gloss_zh: 劝诫人的；常告诫他人的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who admonishes others by warning them or correcting their behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容会告诫、劝诫他人，提醒其避免错误或改正行为的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jwissi lil ħaddieħor biex jevita l-iżbalji jew ibiddel l-imġiba tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容会劝诫或告诫他人的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-missier huwa bniedem wissej li jfakkar lil ibnu biex jaħseb qabel jaġixxi.
formal.en: In the story, the father is an admonishing figure who reminds his son to think before acting.
formal.zh: 故事中的父亲是一个会劝诫孩子的人，他提醒儿子做事之前先思考。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Missierek dejjem jgħidilna noqogħdu attenti. Ben: Iva, hu missier wissej, imma jagħmel hekk għax jimpurtah minna. Maja: Nifhem, iridna nkunu għaqlin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Your father always tells us to be careful. Ben: Yes, he's a father who admonishes, but he does it because he cares about us. Maja: I understand; he wants us to be sensible.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你爸爸总是叮嘱我们小心。 本：是啊，他是个常劝诫孩子的父亲，不过他这样做是因为关心我们。玛雅：我明白，他希望我们懂得谨慎行事。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爸爸总是叮嘱我们小心。
messages.en: Your father always tells us to be careful.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu missier wissej, imma jagħmel hekk għax jimpurtah minna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu missier wissej, imma jagħmel hekk għax jimpurtah minna.
messages.zh: 是啊，他是个常劝诫孩子的父亲，不过他这样做是因为关心我们。
messages.en: Yes, he's a father who admonishes, but he does it because he cares about us.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我明白，他希望我们懂得谨慎行事。
messages.en: I understand; he wants us to be sensible.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象父亲反复提醒“先想清楚再行动”，用这个劝诫者的形象记住 wissej 所描述的人的特点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In person, directly facing another person, especially while speaking or meeting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 双方本人直接相对、面对面地，常用于交谈或见面的情境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bil-persuni preżenti direttament quddiem xulxin, speċjalment waqt laqgħa jew taħdita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 面对面地；当面

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentanti ltaqgħu wiċċ imb wiċċ biex jiddiskutu l-proposta u jiċċaraw il-punti pendenti.
formal.en: The representatives met face to face to discuss the proposal and clarify the outstanding points.
formal.zh: 代表们面对面会谈，讨论提案并澄清尚未解决的问题。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nibgħatlek messaġġ dwar il-pjan? Maja: Aħjar nitkellmu wiċċ imb wiċċ. Niltaqgħu fil-kafetterija?
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall I send you a message about the plan? Maja: We'd better talk face to face. Shall we meet at the café?
colloquial.zh: Lara：我要不要发消息跟你说说这个计划？Maja：我们还是当面聊吧。去咖啡馆见面好吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要不要发消息跟你说说这个计划？
messages.en: Shall I send you a message about the plan?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar nitkellmu wiċċ imb wiċċ. Niltaqgħu fil-kafetterija?
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar nitkellmu wiċċ imb wiċċ. Niltaqgħu fil-kafetterija?
messages.zh: 我们还是当面聊吧。去咖啡馆见面好吗？
messages.en: We'd better talk face to face. Shall we meet at the café?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个 wiċċ imb wiċċ 想成两张脸相对的画面，连同中间的 imb 一起记，表达面对面交谈或见面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Masking: the act of covering or concealing the face with a mask.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用面具遮住或掩藏面部这一行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għata jew il-ħabi tal-wiċċ permezz ta' maskra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 戴面具；用面具遮住或掩藏面部

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, il-kelma 'wiċċa' hija marbuta mal-għata tal-wiċċ permezz ta' maskra.
formal.en: In this exercise, the word 'wiċċa' is associated with covering the face with a mask.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，“wiċċa”这个词与用面具遮住面部有关。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser 'wiċċa' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Pawlu: Hawn għandha x'taqsam mal-għata tal-wiċċ b'maskra.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'wiċċa' mean in this exercise? Pawlu: Here it has to do with covering the face with a mask.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这道练习里的“wiċċa”是什么意思？Pawlu：这里说的是用面具遮住面部。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这道练习里的“wiċċa”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'wiċċa' mean in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn għandha x'taqsam mal-għata tal-wiċċ b'maskra.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn għandha x'taqsam mal-għata tal-wiċċ b'maskra.
messages.zh: 这里说的是用面具遮住面部。
messages.en: Here it has to do with covering the face with a mask.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 wiċċa 画一张被面具遮住的脸，借画面记住遮面含义；本条按名词收录，勿据英文释义猜变位。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To twist the face into a grimace, or to force someone to wear a mask.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 扭动面部表情、做鬼脸；也可指强迫某人戴上面具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħawweġ wiċċu biex jagħmel espressjoni, jew iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jilbes maskra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 做鬼脸；扭曲面部表情

sense_translations.en_definition: to force to wear a mask
sense_translations.zh_definition: 强迫某人戴上面具

collocations.en: made a face in front of the mirror

formal.mt: Il-pazjent wiċċeċ bl-uġigħ meta ċċaqlaq driegħu.
formal.en: The patient grimaced in pain when he moved his arm.
formal.zh: 病人移动手臂时，疼得龇牙咧嘴。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Mark wiċċeċ hekk? Lara: Daqu l-lumi u sabu qares wisq.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Mark make that face? Lara: He tasted the lemon and found it too sour.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Mark为什么做出那副表情？Lara：他尝了柠檬，觉得太酸了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark为什么做出那副表情？
messages.en: Why did Mark make that face?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Daqu l-lumi u sabu qares wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Daqu l-lumi u sabu qares wisq.
messages.zh: 他尝了柠檬，觉得太酸了。
messages.en: He tasted the lemon and found it too sour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 wiċċeċ 记两个动作镜头：酸得脸皱起来，以及强迫别人戴面具；用动作区别于表示人的名词。

gloss_zh: 冒失放肆的；厚脸皮的；肆无忌惮的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Too bold or familiar in dealing with others; cheeky or brazen, with little embarrassment about overstepping social limits.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与人交往时过分大胆或随便、言行放肆，越过礼貌界限也不觉得难为情的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitkellem jew iġib ruħu b'kunfidenza żejda u bla mistħija, mingħajr ma jirrispetta l-limiti tal-edukazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冒失放肆的；与人交往时过分主动或随便的
厚脸皮的；说话或举止不够恭敬、放肆的
肆无忌惮的；做出无礼之事也毫不羞怯的

formal.mt: Il-karattru wiċċieni talab trattament speċjali u interrompa lill-kelliema mingħajr ma talab skuża.
formal.en: The brazen character demanded special treatment and interrupted the speakers without apologizing.
formal.zh: 这个厚颜无忌的人物要求特殊待遇，还打断发言者，却毫无歉意。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak it-tifel daħal quddiem kulħadd fil-kju! Mark: Kemm hu wiċċieni! Għandu jistenna bħal kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: That boy pushed in ahead of everyone in the queue! Mark: He's so cheeky! He should wait like everyone else.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那个男孩插到了所有排队的人前面！Mark：他可真厚脸皮！他应该跟大家一样等着。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak it-tifel daħal quddiem kulħadd fil-kju!
messages.mt_standard: Dak it-tifel daħal quddiem kulħadd fil-kju!
messages.zh: 那个男孩插到了所有排队的人前面！
messages.en: That boy pushed in ahead of everyone in the queue!

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu wiċċieni! Għandu jistenna bħal kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu wiċċieni! Għandu jistenna bħal kulħadd.
messages.zh: 他可真厚脸皮！他应该跟大家一样等着。
messages.en: He's so cheeky! He should wait like everyone else.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个插队还理直气壮的人，把 wiċċieni 记成越过礼貌界限也不脸红；此处 forward 描述态度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A symbol or small digital image representing a facial expression or emotion, used in messages and other digital media.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在消息及其他数字媒体中，用来表示面部表情或情绪的符号或小图像。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Simbolu jew stampa diġitali żgħira li turi espressjoni tal-wiċċ jew emozzjoni u tintuża fil-messaġġi u f'mezzi diġitali oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 字符表情；用文字字符组合表示表情或情绪的符号
绘文字表情；在此指表示面部表情或情绪的小图标

sense_translations.en_definition: icon representing a facial or emotional expression used in social and other digital media
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于社交媒体及其他数字媒体、表示面部表情或情绪的图标

collocations.en: add an emoticon or emoji to the message
collocations.zh: 在消息中添加表情符号

formal.mt: Wiċċinu jista' jgħin biex juri t-ton emozzjonali ta' messaġġ, iżda t-tifsira tiegħu tiddependi mill-kuntest.
formal.en: An emoticon or emoji can help convey the emotional tone of a message, but its meaning depends on the context.
formal.zh: 表情符号有助于传达消息的情绪语气，但其含义取决于语境。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-messaġġ tiegħi jidher ftit kiesaħ? Mark: Żid wiċċinu jitbissem fl-aħħar biex turi li int kuntenta.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does my message seem a little cold? Mark: Add a smiling emoji at the end to show that you're happy.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我的消息看起来是不是有点冷淡？Mark：在末尾加个微笑表情，表示你很高兴。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的消息看起来是不是有点冷淡？
messages.en: Does my message seem a little cold?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żid wiċċinu jitbissem fl-aħħar biex turi li int kuntenta.
messages.mt_standard: Żid wiċċinu jitbissem fl-aħħar biex turi li int kuntenta.
messages.zh: 在末尾加个微笑表情，表示你很高兴。
messages.en: Add a smiling emoji at the end to show that you're happy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象聊天框里一张传达心情的小脸，把 wiċċinu 与字符笑脸和图像表情一起记，核心是数字交流中的表情。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An answer given in response to a question or request.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 针对问题或请求所给出的回答、答复。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tweġiba mogħtija għal mistoqsija jew talba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个回答；一项答复。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi wiġba ċara għall-mistoqsija prinċipali.
formal.en: The report includes a clear answer to the main question.
formal.zh: 报告对主要问题作出了明确回答。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Sibt wiġba għall-mistoqsija? Mark: Iva, il-wiġba tinsab fl-aħħar paġna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you find an answer to the question? Mark: Yes, the answer is on the last page.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你找到这个问题的答案了吗？Mark：找到了，答案在最后一页。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你找到这个问题的答案了吗？
messages.en: Did you find an answer to the question?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 找到了，答案在最后一页。
messages.en: Yes, the answer is on the last page.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把问题写在卡片正面，把wiġba写在背面的答案旁；翻卡时记住它指“回答的内容”，而不是回答的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause or prompt someone to give a response.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 促使某人作出回应，或引发某种反应。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqanqal tweġiba jew reazzjoni mingħand xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引出回应；促使作出反应。

collocations.en: elicited a response from the audience

formal.mt: Id-diskors wiġġeb reazzjoni qawwija mill-udjenza.
formal.en: The speech elicited a strong reaction from the audience.
formal.zh: 这场演讲引起了观众的强烈反应。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kumment tiegħek wiġġeb xi reazzjoni? Mark: Iva, kulħadd beda jitkellem dwaru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did your comment elicit any reaction? Mark: Yes, everyone started talking about it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你的评论引起什么反应了吗？Mark：有，大家都开始讨论它了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的评论引起什么反应了吗？
messages.en: Did your comment elicit any reaction?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，大家都开始讨论它了。
messages.en: Yes, everyone started talking about it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条从“评论”指向“大家回应”的箭头，把wiġġeb放在箭头上，记住它表示促成回应的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who gives an answer to a question.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对问题作出回答的人，即回答者或答复者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħti tweġiba għal mistoqsija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 回答者；作出答复的人。

collocations.zh: 认真留意问题的回答者

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, il-wiġġieb jagħti tweġiba sħiħa għal kull mistoqsija.
formal.en: In this exercise, the answerer gives a complete answer to each question.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，回答者对每个问题都要作出完整回答。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jkun il-wiġġieb f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Mark: Jien. Int tistaqsi u jien inwieġeb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will be the answerer in this exercise? Mark: I will. You ask and I answer.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这项练习由谁来当回答者？Mark：我来。你提问，我回答。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jkun il-wiġġieb f'dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jkun il-wiġġieb f'dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.zh: 这项练习由谁来当回答者？
messages.en: Who will be the answerer in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Int tistaqsi u jien inwieġeb.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Int tistaqsi u jien inwieġeb.
messages.zh: 我来。你提问，我回答。
messages.en: I will. You ask and I answer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象问答练习里拿着“回答者”名牌的同学，把wiġġieb贴在他身上；它指作答的人，与表示回答内容的wiġba区分。

gloss_zh: 乐于回答的；回应积极的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to answer and ready to respond when addressed or asked a question.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于回答的；在别人询问或交谈时愿意并积极作出回应的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jwieġeb u jkun lest jagħti tweġiba meta xi ħadd ikellmu jew jistaqsih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于作答的；乐于回答的。
有回应的；对询问或交流反应积极的。

formal.mt: It-tim huwa wiġġiebi u jagħti tweġibiet ċari għall-mistoqsijiet tal-klijenti.
formal.en: The team is responsive and gives clear answers to customers' questions.
formal.zh: 该团队回应积极，并对客户的问题作出清楚的答复。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark iwieġeb meta tistaqsih xi ħaġa? Lara: Iva, huwa wiġġiebi ħafna u dejjem jipprova jgħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does Mark answer when you ask him something? Lara: Yes, he is very responsive and always tries to help.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你问Mark事情时，他会回答吗？Lara：会，他回应很积极，而且总是尽力帮忙。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark iwieġeb meta tistaqsih xi ħaġa?
messages.mt_standard: Mark iwieġeb meta tistaqsih xi ħaġa?
messages.zh: 你问Mark事情时，他会回答吗？
messages.en: Does Mark answer when you ask him something?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa wiġġiebi ħafna u dejjem jipprova jgħin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa wiġġiebi ħafna u dejjem jipprova jgħin.
messages.zh: 会，他回应很积极，而且总是尽力帮忙。
messages.en: Yes, he is very responsive and always tries to help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位每次被问到都愿意回应的同学，用wiġġiebi描述他的特点；同时记住“乐于回答”和“回应积极”两个相近侧面。
